translation: "The crows, hawks and also vultures are joining lowly animals like jackals and making loud noises which is inauspicious and not good."

raw: ददर्श वध्यमानांश्च क्लिश्यमानांश्च देहिनः । क्रोशतश्च महानादं तीव्रनिष्टनतत्परान् ॥७-२१-१२॥
translation: He saw embodied beings being killed and tormented, crying out with a great cry and intent on intense wailing.

raw: मणि स्फटिक मुक्ताभिः मणि कुट्टिम भूषितैः । तप्त हाटक निर्यूहैः राजत अमल पाण्डुरैः ॥५-३-९॥
translation: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

raw: गुल्मैः वृक्षैः च बहुभिः लताभिः च प्रवेष्टितम् । आवृतम् सर्वतो दुर्गम् गहनम् घोर दर्शनम् ॥३-६९-३॥
translation: It was a dense, impenetrable and dreadful forest covered with shrubs, trees and creepers spread all over.

raw: सालैः तालैः तमालैः च खर्जूरैः पनसैः द्रुमैः । नीवारैः तिनिशैः चैव पुन्नागैः च उपशोभिताः ॥३-१५-१६॥
translation: The place is covered with sal and palmyrah trees including mango, jackfruit, dates, kadamba, punnaga, ashoka, champak, tilaka, ketaka, sandalwood, spandan, dhava, asvakarna parnasha, khadira, sami, kimsuka and patala trees. It is full of wild paddy, flowering bushes and creepers that run on the ground.

raw: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धमादाय पुष्कलम् । प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखो ऽनिलः ॥७-२६-११॥
translation: A pleasant wind blew, carrying the abundant fragrance mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, thereby increasing Ravana's desire.

raw: रुद्रो वा यदि वा विष्णुर्महेन्द्रो वा शतक्रतुः । हन्ति नो रामरूपेण यदि वा स्वयमन्तकः ॥६-९५-२३॥
translation: "Is it Rudra, or Lord Vishnu, or Indra, who has done hundred sacrifices in the past or is it that the god of death itself has taken the form of Rama and killed him?"

raw: ततो विस्फारयामास महद्धनुरवस्थितः । उत्ससर्ज च तीक्ष्णाग्रान् राक्षसेषु महाशरान् ॥६-९०-३॥
translation: Then Vibheeshana stood with stretched bow and loosened sharp pointed arrows on Rakshasas.

raw: भरतः कुशलम् वाच्यो वाच्यो मद् वचनेन च । सर्वास्व एव यथा न्यायम् वृत्तिम् वर्तस्व मातृषु ॥२-५८-२१॥
translation: 'Tell Bharata of my welfare and tell him on my behalf that he should honour all our mothers equally.

raw: इति ब्रुवाणम् रामस् तु परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् । अब्रवील् लक्ष्मणम् प्रीतः समुद्राज् जलम् आनय ॥६-१८-२४॥
प्रत्यक्षं ते यथा शापो द्विजाभ्यां मयि पातितः । नरश्रेष्ठ सरोषाभ्यामपराधे ऽपि तादृशे ॥७-५४-१४॥
translation: O best among men, you yourself witnessed how a curse was inflicted upon me by the two angry Brahmins, even for such an offense.

raw: स तैस्तु सहितो राजा लोकपालानयोधयत् ॥६-१९-१६॥
इदम् हि तव विस्तीर्णम् धन धान्य समाचितम् । हस्ति अश्व रथ सम्पूर्णम् राज्यम् निर्यातितम् तया ॥२-७५-१६॥
translation: This vast kingdom, with all its abundance of wealth and grain, elephants, horses and chariots has been delivered to you by her.

raw: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामेन रामः प्रव्राजितो मया । यदि सत्यम् ब्रवीम्य् एतत् तत् असत्यम् भविष्यति ॥२-१३-७॥
translation: If I tell the truth, 'To please Kaikeyi I have sent Rama to the forest', none will believe it and will consider it untruth.

raw: स धूमाः च शराः सर्वे मम युद्ध अभिनन्दिताः । रुक्म पृष्ठानि चापानि विचेष्टन्ते विचक्षण ॥३-२४-५॥
translation: O Lakshmana all my arrows are smoking and this goldplated bow welcomes me to war.

raw: स ददर्श हतानन्दां सीतामिन्द्रजितो रथे । एकवेणीधरां दीनामुपवासकृशाननाम् ॥६-८१-९॥
translation: Hanuman beheld in the chariot of Indrajith, cheerless Sita with one braid, with no desire to live, emaciated by fasting, wearing a single cloth, body not anointed, covered with dust and dirt all over the body, who was dear to Raghava.

raw: बद्धः त्वम् काल पाशेन क्व गतः तस्य मोक्ष्यसे । वधाय बडिशम् गृह्य स अमिषम् जलजो यथा ॥३-५१-२७॥
translation: You are bound by the noose of death like a fish holding on to the bait of the fishing hook. Where can you go now?

raw: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे । हितैषिणो बाल्हिपतेः पृथग्वाक्यान्यथाब्रुवन् ॥७-९०-१०॥
translation: All of them, delighted at their mutual meeting and being well-wishers of the king of Bālhika, then spoke different words.

raw: तां दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतां ब्रुवन्तीं मन्थरां ततः । रामस्यैव गुणान् देवी कैकेयि प्रशशंस ह ॥२-८-१३॥
translation: Having seen that morose Manthara speaking thus, Kaikeyi commended the virtues of Rama.

raw: घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्बद्धौ शरैराशीविषोपमैः । अमोघैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः प्रमथ्येन्द्रजिता युधि ॥६-५१-१४॥
ईदृशे वर्तमाने तु तूर्य उद्घुष्ट निनादिते । त्रिः अग्निम् ते परिक्रम्य ऊहुः भार्या महौजसः ॥१-७३-३९॥
ततो हि मे भयम् देव प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि । एवम् उक्तः तया राम स भयम् भीतया तदा ॥१-६४-४॥
ततः स कदनं चक्रे वानराणां महाबलः । भर्तृवाक्येन तेजस्वी स्वेन वीर्येण चोदितः ॥६-९८-७॥
translation: Thereafter, the mighty and brilliant Mahodara, in obedience to the word of the king, inspired by his own valour, went to fight with Vanaras.

raw: न संतापः त्वया कार्यम् एतत् अर्थम् प्लवंगम । न वयम् भवता चिंत्या न अपि आत्मा हरिसत्तम । वयम् भवत् विशेषेण धर्मतः कृत निश्चयाः ॥४-१८-६०॥
translation: 'O best of monkeys, abandon all your anxiety on this score. Bother not about us or about yourself. Whatever has happened, has happened in consonance with dharma.

raw: सुग्रीव प्रिय कामेन यद् अहम् निहतः त्वया । माम् एव यदि पूर्वम् त्वम् एतद् अर्थम् अचोदयः । मैथिलिम् अहम् एक आह्ना तव च आनीतवान् भवेः ॥४-१७-४९॥
नरकम् कालकम् चैव कालका अपि व्यजायत । क्रौन्चीम् भासीम् तथा श्येनीम् धृतराष्ट्रीम् तथा शुकीम् ॥३-१४-१७॥
translation: To Tamra were born, Krounchi, Bhasi, Syeni, Dhrutharashtri and Suki. Altogether they were five beautiful young maids famous in the world.

raw: यथा एव राजा पूज्यः ते गौरवेण तथा हि अहम् । त्वाम् न अहम् अनुजानामि न गन्तव्यम् इतः वनम् ॥२-२१-२४॥
translation: Just as the king is worthy of your respectful homage, so am I. I will not permit you to go from here to the forest.

raw: सा बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी रक्ताक्षी वाक्यमब्रवीत् । कृता ऽस्मि विधवा राजंस्त्वया बलवता बलात् ॥७-२४-२६॥
translation: With her eyes red and obstructed by tears, she spoke, saying, "O king, I have been forcibly made a widow by you, the powerful one."

raw: हनुमन्तम् कृतात्मानम् कृ६इतवाक्यमुपागतम् । ध्यात्वा पुनरुवाचेदम् वचनम् रघुसत्तमः ॥६-१-१५॥
ऋषयो देव गन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च सह चारणैः । समेत्य च ऊचुः सहिताः ते अन्यायम् पुण्यकर्मणः ॥३-२३-२७॥
या मेरु दुहिता राम तयोर् माता सुमध्यमा । नाम्ना मेना मनोज्ञा वै पत्नी हिमवतः प्रिया ॥१-३५-१५॥
translation: O Rama Himavan's beloved of beautiful waist, wellknown by the name of Manorama is the daughter of Mount Meru. She is the mother to both the daughters.

raw: आलिखन्तीमिवाकाशमुत्थिताम् पश्य लक्ष्मण । मन्सेव कृताम् लङ्काम् नगाग्रे विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-२४-९॥
translation: "Lakshmana, you may see the city of Lanka elevated on top of the mountain as though clasping the sky, like the one created in the mind of Vishwakarma."

raw: कच्चिन्न विगतस्नेहः प्रसादान्मयि राघवः । कच्चिन्मां व्यसनादस्मान्मोक्षयिष्यति वानर ॥५-३६-२०॥
translation: "I hope Rama is not devoid of love towards me by my separation. O Vanara, hope he will liberate me from this misery.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा पूरुमथाब्रवीत् । इयं जरा महाबाहो मदर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥७-५९-६॥
translation: Having heard his words, the king then spoke to Puru, saying, "O mighty-armed one, let this old age be accepted for my sake."

raw: सो ऽहं सन्न्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम् । रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान् ॥७-१०४-८॥
translation: Having indeed relinquished that burden, I now worship you, the Lord of the world; please bestow protection upon all beings and increase my splendor.

raw: एवं स राजा पुरुषो मासं भूत्वाथ कार्दमिः । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी नारी मासमेकमिला ऽभवत् ॥७-८७-२९॥
translation: Thus, that King Ila, the son of Kardama, having been a man for one month, then became Ila, a woman beautiful in the three worlds, for another month. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ताशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 87 ।। Thus ends the eighty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: हत्वा तु तम् भीम बलम् विराधम् राक्षसम् वने । ततः सीताम् परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान् ॥३-५-१॥
translation: On killing Viradha, the demon of terrific strength, heroic Rama embraced Sita, consoled her and said to his brother Lakshmana, glowing like fire:

raw: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् येन ख्यातिम् गमिष्यति । न च तौ रामम् आसाद्य शक्तौ स्थातुम् कथम् च न ॥१-१९-११॥
न शत्रुम् अवमन्येत ज्यायान् कुर्वीत विग्रहम् । तन्मह्यम् रोचते सम्धिः सह रामेण रावण ॥६-३५-१०॥
शूलं शूलाद्विनिष्कृष्य महावीर्यं महाप्रभम् । ददौ महात्मा सुप्रीतो वाक्यं चैतदुवाच ह ॥७-६१-७॥
translation: The great-souled Rudra, very pleased, extracted a trident of great power and splendor from his own trident, gave it, and indeed spoke these words.

raw: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः । प्रचुक्रुशुर् महात्मानो हृष्टाः शत सहस्रशः ॥४-२६-३७॥
translation: As Sugriva was ceremoniously consecrated, thousands of monkeys rejoiced and shrieked out of joy.

raw: वीरं शतवलिं चैव मैन्दं द्विविदमेव च । गजं गवाक्षं गवयं शरभं च महाबलम् । पश्य प्रीतिसमायुक्तो गन्धमादनमेव च ॥७-४०-५॥
translation: Look with affection upon the brave Shatavali, Mainda, Dvivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha of great strength, and Gandhamadana.

raw: सा स्नापयन्ती विपुलौ स्तनौ नेत्रजलस्रवैः । चिन्तयन्ती न शोकस्य तदान्तमधिगच्छति ॥५-२३-७॥
ते चाप्यनुचरास्तस्य चत्वारो भीमविक्रमाः । तेऽपि वर्मायुधोपेता भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः ॥६-१७-३॥
translation: His four companions of terrific prowess were also there with him. They were wearing all weapons and were adorned with excellent ornaments.

raw: यस्त्वा सम्चोदयति मे वच आच्चिद्य राघव । गच्छेदानीम् महाबाहो क्षेमेण पुनरागतः ॥२-२४-३५॥
स्वयम्भूः इव भूतानाम् बभूव गुणवत्तरः । रामः च सीतया सार्धम् विजहार बहून् ऋतून् ॥१-७७-२५॥
सनिर्घाता महोल्काश्च सम्प्रचेरुर्महास्वनाः । विषादयंस्ते रक्षांसि रावणस्य तदा ऽहिताः ॥६-१०८-२३॥
translation: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.

raw: प्रभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् । शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा ॥६-५८-५६॥
translation: From his shattered head much blood flowed from all over the body just as a spring from a mountain.

raw: वनम् तु नेतुम् न कृता मतिस् तदा । बभूव रामेण यदा महात्मना । न तस्य सीता वचनम् चकार तत् । ततः अब्रवीद् रामम् इदम् सुदुह्खिता ॥२-२८-२६॥
translation: When the great Rama decided not to take her along with him to the forest, Sita, deeply grieved said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति । क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम् ॥५-६६-१०॥
translation: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.

raw: अथेन्द्रकल्पस्य दुरासदस्य । महाजसस्तद्वचनम् निशम्य । ततो महार्थम् वचनम् बभाषे । विभीषणः शस्त्रभृताम् वरिष्ठः ॥६-१५-८॥
translation: Vibheeshana, the best among wielders of weapons, spoke the following words of highly beneficial advice after hearing the words of dangerous Indrajith, the foremost of the warriors.

raw: सो ऽभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं रथमारुह्य सुप्रभम् । अयोध्यामगमत्तूर्णं राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः ॥७-७२-६॥
translation: Having saluted the revered sage Valmiki and mounted his splendid chariot, he swiftly departed for Ayodhya, eager to behold Rama.

raw: उपासाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वे तं देवा इव वासवम् । तेषां मध्ये स राजर्षिर्मरुतामिव वासवः ॥२-३-२६॥
तदस्माकं हितार्थाय जहि तांश्च त्रिलोचन । राक्षसान्हुङ्कृतेनैव दह प्रदहतां वर ॥७-६-२६॥
translation: Therefore, O three-eyed one, for our welfare, destroy those Rakshasas and burn them merely with a roar, O best among those who can burn.

raw: हतो योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो रुधिराशनः । क्रोधान्नादं नदन् सो ऽथ पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ॥६-९५-१५॥
translation: "Kabhanda who lived on blood came roaring, enraged, whose arms were eight meters long was also killed and that is a sufficient example."

raw: तदिदम् वर्तयिष्यावः सर्वम् निखिलम् आदितः । धर्म काम अर्थ सहितम् श्रोतव्यम् अनसूयता ॥१-५-४॥
translation: I shall propagate this Ramayanam, incorporating the merits of dharma, artha and kama, and complete in all respects. It deserves to be heard right from the start without prejudice.

raw: क्ष्वेलितास्फोटनिनदैश्चचाल च वसुन्धरा । रक्षसां सिंहनादैश्च पुस्फोटेव तदा ऽम्बरम् ॥६-६९-४०॥
translation: By the sound of their clapping of arms and their lion roar it was as though the sky was breaking and the earth was shaking.

raw: नागाश्च तुष्टुवुर्यक्षा रक्षांसि विबुधाः खगाः ॥५-१-८६॥
translation: Observing the unwearied monkey the nagas, yakshas, the demons (protecting the southwest), the learned sages and birds praised him.

raw: कथम् वैश्रवणम् देवम् सर्व देव नमस्कृतम् । भ्रातरम् व्यपदिश्य त्वम् अशुभम् कर्तुम् इच्छसि ॥३-४८-२१॥
translation: Why do you wish to do something inauspicious by calling Lord Kubera who is worshipped by all beings your brother ?

raw: यत्र रामसखो वीरो गुहो ज्ञातिगणैर्वृतः । निवसत्यप्रमादेन देशम् तम् परिपालयन् ॥२-८३-२०॥
translation: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.

raw: तस्मिंस्तमसि दुष्पारे राक्षसाः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः । परिपेतुर्महावेगा भक्षयन्तः प्लवङ्गमान् ॥६-४४-६॥
translation: In that pitch darkness, which was difficult even to move, the Rakshasas overcome by anger and lost senses were wandering devouring the monkeys.

raw: ततो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम् । रावणं राक्षसा दृष्ट्वा ह्यष्टवत् समुपागमन् ॥७-२३-२॥
translation: Then, having seen Ravana, whose body was drenched in blood and shattered by blows, the demons indeed approached him auspiciously.

raw: नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् । मध्ये वानरकोटीनां सुग्रीवं चामितौजसम् ॥५-३४-३८॥
translation: "Very soon you will see mighty Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva of unlimited prowess surrounded by crores of vanaras.

raw: ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन् । सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः ॥७-७६-३८॥
translation: Those people approached the Lord of gods (Brahma) requesting a king, reminding him that he had already established Indra as the king of the gods.

raw: सा तु सत्यवती पुण्या सत्ये धर्मे प्रतिष्ठिता । पतिव्रता महाभागा कौशिकी सरिताम् वरा ॥१-३४-११॥
translation: Satyavati is sacred, firmly established in truth and righteousness. She is chaste holy and best among rivers. She is known as river Kausiki.

raw: उक्त वाक्यम् तु राजानम् कृपया कुशिक आत्मजः । अब्रवीत् मधुरम् वाक्यम् साक्षात् चण्डालताम् गतम् ॥१-५९-१॥
translation: What the king said was proved by his chandala form which the son of Kushika (Viswamitra) heard and out of compassion spoke these sweet words:

raw: उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम् । सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयं रथकुटुम्बिना ॥६-१०६-२०॥
translation: "To hold the chariot or advance, to go near the (enemy) or retreat, to return back or advance, everything should be known to the charioteer."

raw: अहत्वा रावणं सङ्ख्ये सपुत्रबलबान्धवम् । अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्रिभिस्तैर्भ्रातृभिः शपे ॥६-१९-२२॥
translation: "I vow upon my three brothers that I will not enter Ayodhya without putting an end to Ravana along with his people, sons and relatives."

raw: न त्वाम् इच्चामि अहम् द्रष्टुम् रामेण निहतम् शरैः । शूराः च बलवन्तः च कृत अस्त्राः च नर आजिरे ॥६-१६-२४॥
चतुरश्वो रथः श्रीमान् निस्त्रिंशो धनुरुत्तमम् । वाहनं नरसंयुक्तं चत्रं च शशिपन्निभम् ॥२-१४-३७॥
translation: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

raw: दुःखितो हि भवान् लोकान् तेजसा यदि धक्ष्यते । आर्ताः प्रजा नर व्याघ्र क्व नु यास्यन्ति निर्वृतिम् ॥३-६६-७॥
translation: O best of men if you grieve and burn the world with your brilliance, wherefrom will the (ordinary) afflicted people get relief?

raw: एकस्यैवाभियाने तु हेतुर्यः प्रकृतस्त्वया । तत्राप्यनुपपन्नं ते वक्ष्यामि यदसाधु च ॥६-६४-११॥
translation: "You have set out alone (for war) and the reason adduced by you is ill conceived and improper. I shall tell you."

raw: तत् त्वम् ब्रूहि मनोज्ञान्गी केन त्वम् च विरूपिता । इति उक्ता राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसी क्रोध मूर्च्छिता ॥३-३४-४॥
यो हि देवान्सगन्धर्वानसुरान्सह राक्षसैः । निहन्याद्राघवः क्रुद्धः स दैवमनुवर्तते ॥७-५०-५॥
translation: Even Rama, who when enraged could indeed destroy gods, Gandharvas, Asuras, and Rakshasas, still follows destiny.

raw: तस्य तं रथमास्थाय हनूमान् मारुतत्मजः । प्रममाथ तलेनाशु सह तेनैव रक्षसा ॥६-४३-२२॥
translation: Hanuman the son of wind god, getting on to the chariot quickly destroyed that Rakshasa Jambumali with his palm.

raw: ततः तान् कपि वृद्धान् च शिष्टान् चैव वनौकसः । वाचा मधुरया अभाष्य यथावत् अनुमान्य च ॥४-५३-६॥
ततः कृत्वा महानादम् सा वै लङ्का भयावहम् । तलेन वानरश्रेष्ठम् ताडयामास वेगिता ॥५-३-३८॥
translation: Then the ogress of Lanka made a loud and frightening sound and struck the most powerful vanara with the palm of her hand.

raw: रजः प्रशांतम् स हिमो अद्य वायुःनिदाघ दोष प्रसराः प्रशांताः । स्थिता हि यात्रा वसुधा अधिपानाम्प्रवासिनो यांति नराः स्व देशान् ॥४-२८-१५॥
translation: 'Now the dust has settled and the wind carrying mist is cool. The torments of summer have ceased. The expeditions of kings have come to a stop and the travellers return to their native land.

raw: गवां शतसहस्राणि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिप: । एकैकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रानुद्दिश्य धर्मत: ॥१-७२-२२॥
translation: For the welfare of each of his sons the king (Dasaratha) religiously gave away a hundred thousand cows to brahmins.

raw: अब्रवीच्चतदारामंभरतः स कृताञ्जलिः एतत्तेसकलंराज्यंन्यासंनिर्यातितंमया ॥६-१३०-५३॥
translation: Bharata then greeted Rama with folded palms, spoke saying, "this kingdom and everything held in trust by me is returned to you."

raw: सुसंरब्धं तु सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं क्रोधमूर्च्छितम् । रामस्तु परिसान्त्व्याथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९७-१॥
translation: Thereafter, Rama pacified Lakshmana, son of Sumitra who was violently agitated. He said to him who had swooned with rage:

raw: एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । अभिगम्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥६-१२२-३१॥
translation: "This Indra and also Siddhas, supreme sages who are great souls pay respects to Rama and worship him."

raw: तेषाम् चैव स्वस्त्ययनम् महर्षिः स चकार ह । प्रस्थिताम्श्चैव तान् प्रेक्ष्यपिता पुत्रानिवान्वगात् ॥२-५५-२॥
translation: Seeing them setting forth, the great sage blessed them for a safe journey and followed them like a father following his children.

raw: बहुधानिपतिष्यन्तिबाणोघैश्शकलीकृताः । यद्वा -बहुधा नि पतिष्यन्ति बाण ओघैः शकली कृताः । निर्मर्यादानिमाँल्लोकान्करिष्याम्यद्यसायकैः । यद्वा -निर् मर्यादान् इमान् लोकान् करिष्यामि अद्य सायकैः ॥३-६४-६९॥
पदातिम् वर्जितच् चत्रम् रामम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनाः । ऊचुर् बहु विधा वाचः शोक उपहत चेतसः ॥२-३३-५॥
translation: Seeing Rama walking without the royal umbrella, people were very much shocked. They expressed their reaction in so many words:

raw: वृत्तकामो भवेद्भ्राता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत् । वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः ॥६-११३-२१॥
translation: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."

raw: मन्ये प्रीति विशिष्टा सा मत्तः लक्ष्मण सारिका । यस्याः तत् श्रूयते वाक्यम् शुक पादम् अरेर् दश ॥२-५३-२२॥
translation: (On hearing my banishment) her myna would say to her parrot, 'O parrot, bite the foot of the enemy (Kaikeyi)'. I think that bird is a greater source of joy to my mother than I, O Lakshmana

raw: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य रामस्य विदित आत्मनः । इयम् सा दयिता भार्या राक्षसी वशम् आगता ॥५-१६-१८॥
translation: "She is the loving wife of the righteous, grateful, wise and selfrealised Rama. She has fallen into the hands of these shedemons.

raw: उष्ण आढ्यस्य ओदनस्य अपि राशयः पर्वतोपमाः । मृष्ट अन्नानि च सूपाः च दधि कुल्याः तथैव च ॥१-५३-३॥
translation: Heaps of hot rice as high as mountains, savoury food, condiments and on abundance of curd, various kinds of soups, containers in their thousands completely filled with edibles with all six tastes and preparations made of jaggery (were distributed).

raw: भरतम् च परिष्वज्य यौवराज्ये अभिषिच्य च । अस्मत् सम्तापजम् दुह्खम् न त्वाम् अभिभविष्यति ॥२-५२-३३॥
translation: On embracing Bharata and making him the crownprince the sorrow due to our departure will not affect you.

raw: ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूश्चतुराननो वा रुद्रस्त्रिनेत्रस्त्रिपुरान्तको वा । इन्द्रो महेन्द्रः सुरनायको वा त्रातुं न शक्ता युधि रामवध्यम् ॥५-५१-४५॥
translation: "Even the selfborn, fourfaced Brahma, the threeeyed Siva who destroyed Tripura, Mahendra, the king of suras do not have the power to save one whom Rama decides to kill".

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोनाशीतितमः सर्गः ॥ ७९ ॥६-७९-४१॥
त्वम् पुनः जंबुकः सिंहीम् माम् इह इच्छसि दुर्लभाम् । न अहम् शक्या त्वया स्प्रष्टुम् आदित्यस्य प्रभा यथा ॥३-४७-३७॥
translation: You are a jackal, and you want a lioness like me who is difficult to win. I am like the Sun's radiance whom you cannot even touch.

raw: अपूर्वी भार्यया च अर्थी तरुणः प्रिय दर्शनः । अनुरूपः च ते भर्ता रूपस्य अस्य भविष्यति ॥३-१८-४॥
translation: He is not with his wife, and is in need of one. He is young, handsome and worthy. He will be an appropriate husband to you.

raw: पुनरेवं ब्रुवाणं तं भरतं लक्ष्मणाग्रज: । प्रत्युवाच तत: श्रीमान् ज्ञातिमध्ये ऽभिसत्कृत: ॥२-१०७-१॥
translation: Wellhonoured in the midst of relatives, the celebrated Rama, elder brother of Lakshmana, then said to Bharata who was going to speak again.

raw: कृत्येषु वाली मेधावी राजानो बहु दर्शनः । भवन्ति पर हन्तारः ते ज्ञेयाः प्राकृतैः नरैः ॥४-२-२३॥
translation: 'Vali is wise in his actions. Kings employ many strategies to annihilate their enemies. Our gullible individuals should be able to detect them.

raw: अस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ हरि ऋषाणाम् गणेश्वरे । नष्ट चन्द्रम् इव व्योम न व्यराजत मेदिनी ॥४-१७-३॥
translation: When the lord of the monkey troops fell down, it was as though the earth lost its brightness like the sky loses its brightness devoid of the Moon.

raw: तेषामौत्सुक्यमालक्ष्य रामस्त्वात्मनि शङ्कित: । कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमृषिं कुलपतिं तत: ॥२-११६-४॥
translation: Having observed their anxiety, Rama apprehending somethig in his mind approached the chief of the hermitage with folded palms and said:

raw: ततः त्वाम् निहतम् दृष्ट्वा वायुः गन्ध वहः स्वयम् । त्रैलोक्यम् भृश संक्रुद्धो न ववौ वै प्रभंजनः ॥४-६६-२५॥
translation: The Windgod who is a carrier of fragrance and breaker of trees became very angry on seeing (the injury on) you and stopped blowing in the three worlds.

raw: चिरनिर्वृत्तम् अपि एतत् प्रत्यक्षम् इव दर्शितम् । प्रविश्य ता उभौ सुष्ठु तथा भावम् अगायताम् ॥१-४-१८॥
एवमास्ते महाबाहुरहन्यहनि राघवः । प्रशासत्सर्वकार्याणि पौरजानपदेषु च ॥७-३८-१॥
translation: Thus, the mighty-armed Rama lived day after day, administering all affairs concerning both the city dwellers and the rural populace.

raw: यथाशुष्काण्यरण्यानिग्रीष्मेदहतिपावकः । तथावानरसैन्यानिकुम्बकर्णोविनिर्दहत् ॥६-६७-४०॥
translation: Just as fire god consumes dried forest in summer, Kumbhakarna was consuming the Vanara army.

raw: तस्यैव सदृशं चान्यद्रावणस्योत्थितं शिरः । तत् क्षिप्रं क्षिप्रहस्तेन रामेण क्षिप्रकारिणा ॥६-११०-२७॥
translation: A similar looking head arose on Ravana's head. Rama, endowed with a quick hand, cut off by his hand the other head.

raw: जहार भार्याम् रामस्य गृध्रम् हत्वा जटायुषम् । गृध्रम् च निहतम् दृष्ट्वा हृताम् श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम् ॥१-१-५३॥
सो ऽहं तासां विशेषार्थं स्त्रियमेकां विनिर्ममे । यद्यत्प्रजानां प्रत्यङ्गं विशिष्टं तत्तदुद्धृतम् ॥७-३०-२३॥
translation: Therefore, I created one woman for the sake of distinction among them, extracting whatever was excellent from each limb of the creatures.

raw: जानासि अनियताम् एवम् भूतानाम् आगतिम् गतिम् । तस्मात् शुभम् हि कर्तव्यम् पण्डितेन इह लौकिकम् ॥४-२१-५॥
translation: 'You are aware of the uncertain and transient happenings in the lives of living beings. Therefore, a wise lady should do auspicious work in this world.

raw: न अमित्राणाम् न मित्राणाम् उदासीन जनस्य च । अहम् आर्ततया कम्चित् विशेषम् न उपलक्षये ॥२-५९-१४॥
translation: I did not see any difference in the degree of anguish among friends, those who are not friends and and those who are indifferent. (The degree of agony was same in all).

raw: गदेयं मामिका नैनं संयुगेषु वधिष्यति । इत्येवं वरदः प्राह तदा ह्येकाक्षिपिङ्गलः ॥७-३६-१७॥
translation: Then, Kubera, the bestower of boons, declared that his mace would not kill this child in battles.

raw: कन्यां कमलगर्भाभां प्रगृह्य स्वगृहं ययौ । प्रगृह्य रावणस्त्वेतां दर्शयामास मन्त्रिणे ॥७-१७-३६॥
translation: Having seized the maiden, who shone like the heart of a lotus, the demon went to his own house, and Ravana then showed her to his minister.

raw: बहु रत्न समाकीर्णम् पर अर्ध्य आसन भाजनम् । महा रथ समावासम् महा रथ महा आसनम् ॥५-६-७॥
translation: The palace was embellished with excellent seats and vessels with many precious gems. There were spacious places to accommodate big chariorts filled with shouts of great charioteers.

raw: सुमुखो दुर्मुखः च अत्र वेग दर्शी च वानरः । मृत्युर् वानर रूपेण नूनम् सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा ॥६-३०-२३॥
translation: "Vanaras Sumukha, Durmukha and Vegadarsi are surely created by Brahma in the Vanara form of DeathGod."

raw: शतक्रतोः वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः । पितृ देवान् उपेत्य आहुः सह सर्वैः मरुत् गणैः ॥१-४९-५॥
translation: 'Hearing Indra, all the devatas accompanied by maruts. Lead by the Firegod devatas approached and said':

raw: ज्याम् विधुन्वन् सुबहुशः शिक्षया अस्त्राणि दर्शयन् । चचार समरे मार्गान् शरै रथ गतः खरः ॥३-२८-५॥
translation: Khara, sat on the chariot, and with a twang of his bowstring released arrows in all directions, exhibiting his skill in the use of weapons.

raw: धृष्टं भवन्तो युध्यन्तु हरीणां मोहनाय वै । अहं तु रथमास्थाय आगमिष्यामि संयुगम् ॥६-९१-६॥
translation: "You delude the sight of Vanaras in battle. I will come to the battle taking the chariot."

raw: स तु तां वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् । अब्रवीत्परमोदारो दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा ॥७-९-१६॥
translation: The exceedingly noble sage, having seen her, who had beautiful hips, a face like the full moon, and was shining with her own radiance, spoke to her.

raw: मत्तो मदायुधानां च न वध्यो ऽयं भविष्यति । इत्येवं शङ्करेणापि दत्तो ऽस्य परमो वरः ॥७-३६-१८॥
translation: In this way, even by Shankara (Shiva), a supreme boon was granted to him, declaring that he would not be killable by Shiva or his weapons.

raw: मया निमन्त्रिता पूर्वं कस्मात्त्वमवसर्जिता । पतिमन्यं वृतवती तस्मात्त्वं दुष्टचारिणी ॥७-५६-२३॥
translation: Why did you abandon me, whom I had previously invited, and choose another husband; therefore, you are an ill-behaved woman.

raw: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः ॥५-५८-१५८॥
translation: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.

raw: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । वानराणामनीकेषु चकार कदनं महत् ॥६-९६-४३॥
translation: There the tenheaded Ravana using arrows adorned with gold plumes struck Vanaras and a great war took place.

raw: तान्महर्षिः प्रमुदितः पूजयामास धर्मवित् । आस्यतामिति चोवाच स्वागतम् तु निवेद्य च ॥२-५६-१७॥
translation: The great sage Valmiki conversant with righteousness was delighted. He honoured them by extending welcome and said 'Be seated'.

raw: तथा तस्मिन् विलपति वसिष्ठो राज धर्मवित् । सभाम् इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य प्रविवेश महा यशाः ॥२-८१-९॥
translation: While Bharata was weeping, illustrious Vasistha, conversant with royal traditions, entered the assembly hall of the lord of the Iksvakus (king Dasaratha).

raw: ऐन्द्रश्च विधिवत् दत्तो राजा च अभिषुतोऽनघः । मध्यंदिनम् च सवनम् प्रावर्तत यथा क्रमम् ॥१-१४-६॥
translation: Havis was duly offered to Indra daily. The juice was extracted in the morning by pressing the soma plant. Midday ablutions were performed. All in proper sequence.

raw: उत्तमेनाभिसंयुक्ता हर्षेणार्थपरा सती । राममाता धनं किं नु जनेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति ॥२-७-८॥
translation: Why is Rama's mother, forever interested in the accumulation of money gifting away her wealth to men with great joy?

raw: मृतसञ्जीवनीं चैव विशल्यकरणीमपि । सावर्ण्यकरणीं चैव सन्धानकरणीं तथा ॥६-७४-३३॥
translation: "Mrtasanjivani, Visalyakarani, Suvarnakarani, Sandhani, all these herbs are grown there."

raw: तुल्य शील वयो वृत्ताम् तुल्य अभिजन लक्षणाम् । राघवो अर्हति वैदेहीम् तम् च इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१६-५॥
translation: "Sri Rama matches Vaidehi perfectly in character, age, behaviour, birth and auspicious signs. She is aware that he is the right person for her. Rama deserves Vaidehi and this blackeyed lady deserves him."

raw: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने । शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ॥५-३९-२६॥
translation: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.

raw: आलिङ्ग्य चालिङ्ग़्य च बाहुयोक्त्रैः । संयोजयामासतुराहवे तौ । सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ । सुचेरतुः सम्प्रति युद्धमार्गे ॥६-४०-१८॥
translation: Both pressing their bosom to each other, clung to each other, and fastened themselves in embrace in the comb at having received similar training in war and both endowed with might. At this time, they went on in comb at using several war methods.

raw: श्रिया ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोगूढा । निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः । ददर्श काश्चित्प्रमदोपगूढा । यथा विहङ्गाः कुसुमोपगूढाः ॥५-५-१८॥
translation: There he saw cheerful demonesses shining brightly, abashed by the embrace of their beloveds during the night. He also saw those sporting with their beloveds freely and looking like birds embracing flowers.

raw: तत् सर्वम् प्रत्यनुज्नासीद् रामः सत्य पराक्रमः । न हि तत् प्रत्यगृह्णात् स क्षत्र धर्मम् अनुस्मरन् ॥२-८७-१६॥
translation: Rama whose prowess is his truth, acknowledged all that but remembering the duty enjoined on a kshatriya did not accept them.

raw: अब्रवीद् जननीः सर्वा इह तेन महात्मना । शर्वरी शयिता भूमाउ इदम् अस्य विमर्दितम् ॥२-८८-२॥
translation: After listening to all that Guha had said, Bharatha reached the foot of the ingudi tree accompanied by his ministers and gazing at Rama's bed, said to all his mothers the magnanimous Rama rested that night here on this ground in that crushed bed.

raw: अक्षि सूच्या प्रमृजसि जिह्वया लेढि च क्षुरम् । राघवस्य प्रियाम् भार्याम् अधिगंतुम् त्वम् इच्छसि ॥३-४७-४१॥
translation: You wish to violate the loving wife of Rama. You are rubbing your eyes with a needle and licking the razor with your tongue.

raw: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतम् एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै सगरं ददौ ॥१-७०-३०॥
translation: It is said that his (Asita's) two wives were pregnant. One gave food mixed with poison to the other with the intention of destroying her embryo.

raw: दिशो विप्रद्रुताः सर्वे स्तनयित्नुर् इव उष्णगे । ऋषीणाम् अग्नि कल्पानाम् अग्नि होत्र समुत्थितः ॥६-३५-२१॥
देव गन्धर्व भूतानाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम् । अजेयम् समरे घोरम् व्यात्त आननम् इव अन्तकम् ॥३-३२-६॥
translation: Invincible to gods, gandharvas, all living beings, great sages and seers, he was like Yama, lord of death with wide open jaws.

raw: आविष्टम् तेजसा रामम् संग्राम शिरसि स्थितम् । दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि भयात् विव्यथिरे तदा ॥३-२४-२४॥
translation: Seeing Rama standing on the war front, engrossed and radiating heroic lustre, all beings were alarmed.

raw: ते वीक्षमाणा वृक्षाम् च पुष्प भार अवलम्बिनः । प्रसन्न अंबुवहाः चैव सरितः सागरम् गमाः ॥४-१३-५॥
translation: They saw (on the way) trees bent down with the load of flowers, and rivers with pure water flowing into the sea.

raw: परस्परं च ये तत्र सैनिकाः सम्बभाषिरे । किमिदं क्व च वर्तामः किमेतत्स्वप्नदर्शनम् ॥७-७१-१९॥
translation: And the soldiers present there spoke to each other, wondering, "What is this? Where are we? Is this a dream vision?"

raw: इदम् बहु शलाकम् ते पूर्ण चन्द्रम् इव उदितम् । छत्रम् स वाल व्यजनम् प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम् ॥४-१०-३॥
translation: 'Here is the manyribbed parasol shining like the full Moon above the horizon and the yak's tailfan held by me.Pray accept it.

raw: नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः । कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वनम् ॥६-६०-३७॥
translation: Those night rangers drawing the limbs of Kumbhakarna pushed his arms, clapping loudly to awaken him making a sound.

raw: कृत अंजलौ स्थिते तस्मिन् वानराः च अभवन् तथा । तटाकम् इव तम् दृष्ट्वा रामः कुड्मल पंकजम् ॥४-३८-१७॥
महता दारितेनेव गिरिर्गैरिकधातुना । तस्य वानरसिंहस्य प्लवमानस्य सागरम् ॥५-१-६४॥
एक: पालयते लोकमेक: पालयते कुलम् । मज्जत्येको हि निरय एक: स्वर्गे महीयते ॥२-१०९-१५॥
translation: One protects the world. Another runs his family. One plunges into hell. Another is honoured in heaven. (These are the fruits of truth and untruth).

raw: इति सा दुह्ख सम्तप्ता विललाप आयत ईक्षणा । भर्तुः शिरो धनुस् तत्र समीक्ष्य जनक आत्मजा ॥६-३२-३३॥
translation: Burning in sorrow, the broad eyed Sita gazing at the head of her husband and the bow again and again lamented.

raw: मुहूर्तम् अथ विश्रान्तौ राज पुत्रौ अरिन्दमौ । प्रांजली मुनि शार्दूलम् ऊचतू रघुनंदनौ ॥१-२९-२८॥
translation: The two princes of the lineage of Raghu, destroyers of foes rested a while and then said to Viswamitra, a tiger amon sages:

raw: प्रति आख्याय हि माम् भीरु परितापम् गमिष्यसि । चरणेन अभिहत्य इव पुरूरवसम् ऊर्वशी ॥३-४८-१८॥
translation: O timid lady if you reject me, you will regret like Urvasi who kicked Pururava and regretted later.

raw: नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम् । अशोकवनकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम् ॥५-१८-९॥
translation: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.

raw: गौतमेन एवम् उक्तस्य स रोषेण महात्मना । पेततुः वृषणौ भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत् क्षणात् ॥१-४८-२९॥
translation: Cursed thus out of anger by eminent Gautama the testicles of Indra immediately dropped down on the earth.

raw: अस्माकमपि सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य त्वयास्ति वै । प्रख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु महागुणपरिग्रहः ॥५-१-११८॥
translation: "O chief of monkeys, indeed we too have a relationship with you based on merit which is wellknown to all the three worlds.

raw: महिषान् एक शल्यामः च चागामः च कृत निष्ठितान् । लेख्यम् उच्च अवचम् पेयम् भोज्यानि विविधानि च ॥५-११-१५॥
translation: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds 1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed 3) लेह्य food for licking 4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).

raw: न खलु त्वां महाबाहो स्मारयेयमनुत्तमम् । इमं मुहूर्तं दुर्धर्ष स्मर त्वं जन्म वैष्णवम् ॥७-९८-१३॥
translation: O mighty-armed and unconquerable one, I would indeed remind you of your unsurpassed divine nature; at this very moment, remember your divine birth as Vishnu.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा भरत: श्रीमान् मुमोह सहबान्धव: । अत्र राम इति ज्ञात्वा गत: पारमिवाम्भस: ॥२-९८-१७॥
translation: On seeing the smoke, majestic Bharata in the company of relatives concluded that Rama was staying there and rejoiced like a man who had reached the other bank of the river.

raw: स नुन्नैव तीक्षेन प्रतोदेन हय उत्तमः । राजा प्रदोचितः अभीक्ष्णम् कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-२३॥
translation: The king who was very much incited by her words, like a horse of the best breed whipped by the lash, replied to Kaikeyi:

raw: यावत् सुघोरा महती दुर्धर्षा हरि वाहिनी । न अवस्कन्दति नो लंकाम् तावत् सीता प्रदीयताम् ॥६-९-१८॥
translation: "Lest the highly dreadful, formidable and huge Vanara troops surround all over Lanka. Give away Sita."

raw: रजतानां सुवर्णानामश्मनामथ वाससाम् । अनिशं दीयमानानां राशिः समुपदृश्यते ॥७-९२-१६॥
translation: Heaps of silver, gold, jewels, and clothes, constantly being distributed, were visible everywhere.

raw: एभिः प्रधर्षिताश्चैव वानरा वनरक्षिभिः । मधून्यचिन्तयित्वेमान् भक्षयन्ति पिबन्ति च ॥५-६३-५॥
translation: "Even though the garden guards forcibly tried to prevent them they did not care and have devoured all the honey.

raw: तम् तथा शोक संतप्तम् विलपंतम् अनाथवत् । मोहेन महता आविष्टम् परिद्यूनम् अचेतनम् ॥३-६६-१॥
translation: Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, consoling the mighty miserable Rama, who was afflicted with sorrow, and was weeping helplessly like an orphan, drowned in great delusion, devoid of consciousness, pressed his feet and addressed him:

raw: अर्घ्यम् च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतः सुसमाहितः । वव्रे प्रसादम् विप्रेइन्द्रात् मा विप्रम् मन्युः आविशेत् ॥१-१०-३१॥
translation: He gave that Indra among the brahmins offerings righteously with unstinted devotion and asked for his favour that he should not incur the wrath of the sage (his father Vibhandaka for having brought him to Anga).

raw: तपस्तेपे स धर्मात्मा स्वाध्यायनियतेन्द्रियः । गत्वाश्रमपदं तस्य विघ्नं कुर्वन्ति कन्यकाः ॥७-२-८॥
translation: That righteous-souled sage, with his senses controlled by Vedic study, performed severe penance, but maidens would go to his hermitage and create disturbances.

raw: ऊर्ध्व बाहुः निरालंबो वायु भक्षः तपः चरन् । धर्मे पंच तपा भूत्वा वर्षासु आकाश संश्रयः ॥१-६३-२३॥
गतेषु तेषु काकुत्स्थः पुष्पकादवरुह्य च । ततो ऽभिवादयामास ह्यगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ॥७-७६-२३॥
translation: After the gods had departed, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, descended from the Pushpaka chariot and then saluted Agastya, the foremost of sages.

raw: ताम् चारु नेत्राम् कपि सिंह नाथाम् पतिम् समाश्लिष्य तद शयानाम् । उत्थापयामासुः अदीन सत्त्वाम् मंत्रि प्रधानाः कपि राज पत्नीम् ॥४-२४-२६॥
translation: The foremost ministers of Vali lifted up the beautifuleyed, noble Tara, wife of the monkey hero clinging to the body of her husband, a lion among monkeys.

raw: तत्र पाण्डुर मेघाभम् जाम्बूनद परिष्कृतम् । कुबेर भवनम् रम्यम् निर्मितम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-४३-२१॥
translation: 'There is an exquisite mansion of Kubera built by Visvakarma which, embellished with gold, looks like a pale white cloud.

raw: ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः वानरैः सचिवैः सह । राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञातम् विशेषतः ॥४-७-२३॥
translation: Sugriva and his counsellors felt glad on hearing Rama's words, particularly the assurance given by him.

raw: अस्य वाहनसम्युक्ताम् कर्णग्राहवतीम् शुभाम् । सुप्रताराम् दृढाम् तीर्खे शीग्रम् नावमुपाहर ॥२-५२-६॥
translation: Get quickly to the sacred bank (of Ganga) a strong, auspicious boat equipped with rowing rods and helmsmen who can help cross the river with ease

raw: न च दिक् ज्ञायते याम्या न आग्नेयी न च वारुणी । युग अन्ते नियतो लोको हतो दग्ध इव अग्निना ॥४-६१-११॥
translation: 'I did not know which the southern direction was or the southeast or the west. It looked as if the world had been consumed by fire and dissolved, as if it was the end of the yuga.

raw: सीतां तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र मुनिदारकाः । प्राद्रवन्यत्र भगवानास्ते वाल्मीकिरुग्रधीः ॥७-४९-१॥
translation: Seeing Sita crying there, the hermit boys ran to where the revered Valmiki, of keen intellect, resided.

raw: उदारस्य नृवीरस्य धरण्याम् पतितस्य च । ततः प्रीत मना रजाअ प्राप्य यज्ञम् अनुत्तमम् ॥१-१४-५७॥
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही परिक्रम्य हुताशनम् । विवेश ज्वलनं दीप्तं निस्सङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ॥६-११९-२८॥
translation: Having spoken in that way, Vaidehi went round fire fearlessly, absorbed with in herself and entered the flaming and burning fire.

raw: सत्यम् दानम् तपस्त्यगो वित्रता शौचमार्जवम् । विद्या च गुरुशुश्रूषा ध्रुवाण्येतानि राघवे ॥२-१२-३०॥
translation: Truth, munificence, asceticism, renunciation, purity, uprightness, learning and service to his superiors all those (virtues) are firmly planted in this descendant of the Raghus.

raw: न हि शक्ष्यामि अहम् द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् मैथिलीम् विना । मयि अगच्चति च इहस्थे धर्म आत्मानौ महा रथौ ॥५-१३-३९॥
क्षीणपानोत्तमैर्भिन्नै: शरावैरभिसंवृताम् । हतशौण्डामिवाकाशे पानभूमिमसंस्कृताम् ॥२-११४-१४॥
translation: (Ayodhya looked) like an uncleansed drinking place with broken pitchers emptied of excellent wine scattered around and with drunkards lying dead in the open.

raw: पुनः प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णः संवत्सरोऽभवत् । प्रसवार्थम् गतो यष्टुम् हयमेधेन वीर्यवान् ॥१-१३-१॥
translation: After completion of one year when spring returned, the valiant king (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion to worship celestial beings for begetting sons.

raw: महर्षींस्तु पुरत्कृत्य प्रयान्तु तव सौनिकाः । यथा ग्रीष्मावशेषेण तरेयुर्जाह्नवीजलम् ॥७-६४-११॥
translation: Let your soldiers proceed, placing the great sages in front, so that they may cross the waters of the Ganga with the remaining part of summer.

raw: त्राहि माम् अद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मण इति वरांगना । सु संत्रस्ता समाक्रंदत् शृण्वताम् तु यथा अन्तिके ॥३-५२-५॥
translation: Terribly frightened, the beautiful lady (Sita) cried bitterly, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana, save me', as if they were close by and were listening to her.

raw: ब्राह्मणः सुमहातेजाः तपो बल समन्वितः । उद्धरिष्यति रंभे त्वाम् मत् क्रोध कलुषी कृताम् ॥१-६४-१३॥
translation: 'O Rambha an effulgent brahmin, endowed with the power of asceticism, will liberate you from this state into which you have fallen on account of my anger'.

raw: न बुध्यसे रघुश्रेष्ठम् यस्ते प्राणान् हरिष्यति । ततोऽब्रवीद्वालिसुतोऽप्यङ्गदो हरिसत्तमः ॥६-२०-३०॥
सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः । तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ॥७-२६-४७॥
translation: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.

raw: इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी रामस्य महिषी प्रिया । प्रनष्टा अपि सती यस्य मनसो न प्रणश्यति ॥५-१५-४८॥
translation: "This lady of golden complexion is Rama's beloved queen who does not disappear from his mind, although away.

raw: ततः समुपविष्टेषु ब्रह्मर्षिषु महात्मसु । भविष्यदुत्तरं काव्यं जगतुस्तौ कुशीलवौ ॥७-९९-२॥
translation: Then, as the great-souled Brahmarishis were seated, Kusha and Lava sang the future, latter part of the epic.

raw: आजगाममुहूर्तेनराक्षसैःपरिवारितः ततोमाल्यवतासार्थंक्रियामेवचकारसः ॥६-११४-१०६॥
translation: Surrounded by Rakshasas, in a short time he returned with Malyavan (Maternal uncle of Ravana) and Vibheeshana initiated the task.

raw: अल्पपर्णाहि तरवो घनीभूता: समन्तत: । विप्रकृष्टेपि देशे ऽस्मिन्न प्रकाशन्ति वै दिश: ॥२-११९-६॥
translation: The trees with sparse leaves all over have grown dense, the quarters in the distant region are no longer discernible by the senses.

raw: तिर्यक् च सह नक्षत्रैः सम्गतौ चन्द्रभास्करौ । भास्कराम्शुभिरादीप्तम् तमसा च समावृतम् ॥६-२२-८॥
translation: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.

raw: देव ऋषि यक्ष प्रवरैः अप्सरोभिः च सेवितम् । सिद्ध चारण संघैः च प्रकीर्णम् सुमनोहरम् ॥४-४१-२२॥
translation: 'That mountain with several kinds of colourful trees and vines is frequented by gods, sages and prominent yakshas like siddhas and charanas. It is exceedingly delightful and even the thousandeyed Indra keeps visiting this place on full and new Moon days.

raw: तस्य मे कृच्छ्रभूतस्य कृच्छ्रादस्माद्विमोचय । अन्येषां न गतिर्ह्यत्र कुम्भयोनिमृते द्विजम् ॥७-७८-२३॥
translation: Therefore, release me, who am in this great distress, from this predicament, for indeed, there is no other way or refuge here for anyone except the pot-born brahmin (Agastya).

raw: दक्षिणे बाधताम् द्वारे महा पार्श्व महा उदरौ । हनूमान् पश्चिम द्वारम् निपीड्य पवन आत्मजः ॥६-३७-२८॥
चर्यमाणम् तपस् तीव्रम् सम्तापयति राक्षसान् । देवदानवयक्षेभो गृहीतश्च वरस्त्वया ॥६-३५-२३॥
ताम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीम् शुभाम् । साधु साधु इति शंसन्तो मिथिलाम् समपूजयन् ॥१-४८-११॥
translation: All the ascetics, having seen that auspicious city of Janaka worshipfully admired Mithila saying, 'Excellent, Excellent'

raw: अरिघ्नं सिंहसङ्काशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् । लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणीं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम् ॥५-६८-२५॥
translation: 'You will see the lionlike Rama, a slayer of enemies and Lakshmana wielding bow in hand standing at the entrance of Lanka very soon.

raw: ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कृतज्ञश्च सानुक्रोशश्च राघवः । सद्वृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसंक्षयात् ॥५-२६-१३॥
translation: "Rama is renowned, wise, grateful and kindly. It is due to my misfortune that he has turned pitiless to me. There is no doubt.

raw: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीभिर्वानराणां महात्मनाम् । राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया ॥६-१२६-२४॥
भरतेन एवम् उक्तः तु नृपो मातामहः तदा । तम् उवाच शुभम् वाक्यम् शिरस्य् आघ्राय राघवम् ॥२-७०-१६॥
translation: Then the king of Kekaya, the maternal grandfather of Bharata, having heard the words of the scion of the Raghu dynasty (Bharata), kissed him on his forehead and spoke these auspicious words:

raw: स त्वम् धर्मम् परित्यज्य रामम् राज्येऽभिषिच्यच । सह कौलस्यया नित्यम् रन्तुमिच्छसि दुर्मते ॥२-१२-४५॥
translation: O wickedminded one, deserting righteousness and installing Rama in the kingdom, you want to enjoy life with Kausalya everafter?

raw: शस्त्रवर्णः सुपरुषो मन्दरश्मिर्दिवाकरः । अदृश्यत कबन्धाङ्कः संसक्तो धूमकेतुना ॥६-१०३-३२॥
translation: The Sun seemed without radiance like the colour of weapon (grey), in the form of Kabhanda (headless trunk), combined with Dhumakethu.

raw: दातुमिच्छति तस्मै तु तच्छ्रुत्वा बलदर्पितः । दम्भुर्नाम ततो राजा दैत्यानां कुपितो ऽभवत् ॥७-१७-१२॥
translation: But upon hearing that my father desired to give me to Vishnu, the king of Daityas named Dambhu, who was proud of his strength, became enraged.

raw: इत्येवं घोषयन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । अभ्यधावन्त लङ्कायाः प्राकारं कामरूपिणः ॥६-४२-२१॥
translation: Shouting in that manner, the monkeys who could change their form at their will started roaring and rushed towards the defensive walls.

raw: इति दाशरथीरमो लक्ष्मणम् समभाषत । बलम् च तत्र विभजच्चास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥६-२४-१३॥
translation: Dasaratha's son Rama thus talked to Lakshmana in that manner and asked to divide the task of the army in accordance with what is said in sastras.

raw: अपि आवाम् युगपत् प्राप्तौ अपश्याव मही तले । रथ चक्र प्रमाणानि नगराणि पृथक् पृथक् ॥४-६१-५॥
translation: 'And from there both of us looked at all the cities on the land which seemed like the size of chariot wheels one after the other.

raw: एवम् सम्भाषमाणम् तम् राम हेतोर् नृप आत्मजम् । प्रत्युवाच जनः सर्वः श्रीमद् वाक्यम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-७९-१४॥
translation: When prince Bharata was thus speaking in favour of Rama, all the people responded with these excellent, propitious words:

raw: एवम् उक्तः धिग् इति एव राजा दशरथो अब्रवीत् । व्रीडितः च जनः सर्वः सा च तन् न अवबुध्यत ॥२-३६-१७॥
translation: Hearing the words of Kaikeyi, Dasaratha could say only 'shame'. All the people felt ashamed, but Kaikeyi could not understand this.

raw: तस्य जृम्भितविक्षेपाद्व्यामिश्रा वै दिशो दश । रूपवानिव रुद्रस्य मन्युर्गात्रेष्वदृश्यत ॥६-७५-४४॥
translation: The ten directions were disturbed violently by his yawning and his wrath was perceptible like Rudra' s form in his limbs by his wrath.

raw: वज्रदंष्ट्रो भृशं बाणै रणे वित्रासयन् हरीन् । चचार लोकसंहारे पाशहस्त इवान्तकः ॥६-५३-२५॥
translation: Vajradamshtra went about in the battle striking Vanaras just like death goes with a noose for destruction of the world.

raw: अधिकं शैलराजस्तु धातुभिस्सुविभूषितः । धातुभ्यःप्रसृतो रेणुर्वायुवेग विघट्टितः । सुमहद्वानरानीकं छादयामास सर्वतः ॥६-४-७८॥
translation: That lord of mountains richly adorned with minerals shone very brightly. The mineral particles raised by the stamping of the vanara troops covered the huge vanaras all over.

raw: अथ ते राक्षसामात्या ह्रियमाणं दशाननम् । मुमोक्षयिषवो वालिं रवमाणा अभिद्रुताः ॥७-३४-२३॥
translation: Then, those Rakshasa ministers, seeing Dashanana being carried away by Vali, rushed after him, shouting, desiring to free their king.

raw: अङ्गेश्वरम् महेष्वासम् रोमपादम् सु सत्कृतम् । वयस्यम् राज सिंहस्य सपुत्रम् तम् इह आनय ॥१-१३-२५॥
translation: Bring with honour king of Anga, Romapada, famous and prosperous. He is an intimate friend of the king (Dasaratha).

raw: यक्षा न शेकुः संस्थातुं प्रमुखे तस्य रक्षसः । राज्ञो भ्रातेति विज्ञाय गता यत्र धनेश्वरः ॥७-१४-५॥
translation: The Yakṣas were unable to stand before that Rākṣasa (Ravana), and knowing him to be the king's (Kubera's) brother, they went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, was.

raw: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः । समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्सम्परिरक्षितुम् ॥७-१०४-३॥
translation: And the revered Grandfather Brahma, the mighty lord of the worlds, said, "O gentle one, an agreement has been made by you to protect the worlds well."

raw: यानि चौषधजालानि तस्मिन् जातानि पर्वते । विषघ्नान्यपि नागानां न शेकुः शमितुं विषम् ॥५-१-२१॥
translation: Even the medicinal herbs grown on the mountain could not neutralize the effect of the poison of snakes.

raw: पशोः अर्थे महाभाग कृत कृत्यो अस्मि भार्गव । सर्वे परिगता देशा यज्ञियम् न लभे पशुम् ॥१-६१-१४॥
अपरे अपूरयन् कूपान् पाम्सुभिः श्वभ्रम् आयतम् । निम्न भागाम्स् तथा केचित् समामः चक्रुः समन्ततः ॥२-८०-९॥
translation: Some filled wells and chasms with loose soil, while others made low level grounds plain and wide on all sides.

raw: अहम् च अपि प्रतिज्ञाम् ताम् गुरोह् समनुपालयन् । वनम् अद्य एव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि ॥२-२६-२८॥
translation: I am leaving for the forest right away for fulfilling my father's pledge. O highminded Sita be steady.

raw: अन्ये तु हरि वीराणाम् यूथान् निष्क्रम्य यूथपाः । सुग्रीवेण अभ्यनुज्नाता लन्काम् जग्मुः पताकिनीम् ॥६-३९-१४॥
translation: Some other monkey heroes permitted by Sugriva went to Lanka decorated with flags.

raw: सा भीम वेगा समर अभिकांक्षिणीसुदारुणा राक्षस वीर सेना । तौ राज पुत्रौ सहसा अभ्युपेतामाला ग्रहाणाम् इव चन्द्र सूर्यौ ॥३-२३-३४॥
translation: The mighty, swiftfooted army of valiant demons surrounded the princes (Rama and Lakshmana) all on a sudden like the planets around the Sun and the Moon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रयोविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentythird sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वमीश्वरैर्वानरर्षभ । अहं त्वा भक्षयिष्यामि प्रविशेदं ममाननम् ॥५-१-१५१॥
translation: "O bull among vanaras the lords of the universe have provided you as food for me. I will eat you. Enter my mouth".

raw: भगवन्मम वंशस्य शूलमेतदनुत्तमम् । भवेत्तु सततं देव सुराणामीश्वरो ह्यसि ॥७-६१-१२॥
translation: O Lord, may this excellent spear always remain with my lineage, for you are indeed the lord of the gods.

raw: त्वाम् च माम् च नरव्याघ्र व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितौ । न हि भारो अस्ति दैवस्य सर्व भुतेषु लक्ष्मण ॥३-६९-४९॥
एते हि समुपासीना विहगा जलचारिणः । न अवगाहन्ति सलिलम् अप्रगल्भा इव आवहम् ॥३-१६-२२॥
translation: Just as inefficient warriors do not enter the warfield, aquatic birds sitting near water do not venture to take a plunge into it.

raw: आशन्के तम् निपतितम् जनस्थाने जटायुषम् । अहम् तु पतितो विन्ध्ये दग्ध पक्षो जडी कृतः ॥४-६१-१६॥
translation: 'I thought Jatayu had fallen down somewhere at Janasthana, but I fell on Vindhya, wings burnt, in an unconscious state.

raw: विश्व कर्म सुतो वीरो नलः प्लवग सत्तमः । विक्रान्तो वेगवान् अत्र वसु पुत्रः सुदुर्धरः ॥६-३०-३३॥
translation: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

raw: सीता नाम वरारोहा याम् त्वम् हर्तुम् इह इच्छसि । कथम् राजा स्थितो धर्मे पर दारान् परामृशेत् ॥३-५०-६॥
तस्मात्संचोदयामि त्वामुत्तिष्ठ गिरिसत्तम । न एष कपिशार्दूलस्त्वमुपर्येति वीर्यवान् ॥५-१-९५॥
पालितां राक्षसेन्द्रेण निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा । प्लवमानामिवाकाशे ददर्श हनुमान् पुरीम् ॥५-२-२०॥
translation: The city of Lanka, ruled by the lord of demons and built by Visvakarma looked as if it was a city floating in the sky.

raw: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल हित्वैतद्दारुणं व्रतम् । पुरवर्य्यामित: क्षिप्रमयोध्यां याहि राघव ॥२-१११-१८॥
translation: O Bharata, O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghu race give up this formidable vow. Arise and quickly return to Ayodhya, the best of cities.

raw: मोहमापेदिवान्भूयः शोकोपहतचेतनः । चिरेण तु नृपः सम्ज्ञाम् प्रतिलभ्य सुदुःखितः ॥२-१२-६॥
तेषां वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदां वरः ॥६-७१-४०॥
translation: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.

raw: क्रीडा रति विधिज्ञानाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनाम् । रक्षसाम् चैव संतापम् अनर्थम् च आहरिष्यसि ॥३-३८-२४॥
translation: You will bring grief and disaster into the lives of demons who are sporting in love and who are in the habit of celebrating community festivals with joy.

raw: उच्छिष्टं वा प्रमत्तं वा तापसं धर्मचारिणम् । अदन्त्यस्मिन् महारण्ये तान्निवारय राघव ॥२-११९-१९॥
translation: O Rama, in this great forest demons will devour the ascetics if they find them impure or intoxicated or indolent. Prevent them.

raw: को न्व् अनेन अप्रतीतेन स उत्कण्ठित जनेन च । सम्प्रीयेत अमनोज्ञेन वासेन हृत चेतसा ॥२-४८-२०॥
translation: The people here are choked with grief. Who will like to stay here where life is disagreeable, cheerless, full of despondency and distress?

raw: विमानैर्बहुभिर्लङ्क सम्कीर्णा रचिता पुरा । विष्णोः पदमिवाकाशम् चादितम् पाण्डुभिर्घनैः ॥६-२४-१०॥
translation: "This Lanka appears splendid with a mass of skyscrapers like white clouds covering the path of Vishnu in the sky."

raw: अथ लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्रा अजनयत् सुतौ । वीरौ सर्व अस्त्र कुशलौ विष्णोः अर्ध समन्वितौ ॥१-१८-१४॥
translation: Sumitra gave birth to Lakshmana and Satrughna who were heroic, skilled in the use of all weapons and endowed with the facets of Visnu.

raw: राजतेषु च कुम्भेषु जाम्बूनदमयेषु च । पान श्रेष्ठम् तदा भूरि कपिः तत्र ददर्श ह ॥५-११-२३॥
translation: Hanuman saw the best of wines in large quantities kept in silver and pure gold pots.

raw: अप्राप्तान्येव तान्याशु असम्भ्रान्तस्तदार्जुनः । आयुधान्यमरारीणां जग्राहारिनिषूदनः ॥७-३२-७०॥
translation: Then, the undisturbed Arjuna, the destroyer of enemies, quickly caught those weapons of the Rakshasas even before they reached him.

raw: प्रकीर्ण हंसा अकुल मेखलानाम्प्रबुद्ध पद्म उत्पल मालिनीनाम् । वापीः उत्तमानाम् अधिक अद्य लक्ष्मीःवर अंगनाम् इव भूषितानाम् ॥४-३०-४८॥
translation: 'Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth (also of autumn) appears decorated with deep wells like an excellent lady with swans as girdles and blooming lotuses and lilies as garlands.

raw: विसर्जयित्वा स्वम् वेश्म प्रविवेश महामतिः । ततः स गत्वा ताः पत्नीर् नरेन्द्रो हृदयंगमाः ॥१-८-२३॥
परितुष्टास्मि भद्रं ते मानुषस्ते कृतो विधिः । ममापि तु वचः पथ्यं ब्रुवन्त्याः कुरु मैथिलि ॥५-२२-१७॥
भर्तारमनया सार्धमस्याः प्राप्तो ऽस्मि मार्गितुम् । कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥७-१२-११॥
translation: I have come with her to seek a husband for her, for indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

raw: बलं च सुभृतं वीर हृष्टपुष्टमनुद्धतम् । सम्भाषासम्प्रदानेन रञ्जयस्व नगेत्तम ॥७-६४-५॥
translation: O hero, O best among men, please the well-maintained, cheerful, well-nourished, and disciplined army by engaging in good conversation and bestowing gifts.

raw: बलैकदेशः क्षपितो राक्षसानाम् महात्मनाम् । येन केन तु मार्गेण तराम वरुण आलयम् ॥६-३-३०॥
translation: "I have destroyed some of those roadways, even filled up the moats, burnt parts of the city of Lanka, smashed the boundary walls and killed part of the powerful army."

raw: राजानश्च महात्मानः प्रशंसन्ति स्म राघवम् । उपपन्नं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येव भुवि नान्यतः ॥७-९५-१४॥
translation: The great-souled kings also praised Rama, saying, "O best among men, this is fitting only in you on earth, and not in anyone else."

raw: ऋषिणा च पितुर् वाक्यम् कुर्वता व्रत चारिणा । गौर् हता जानता धर्मम् कण्डुना अपि विपश्चिता ॥२-२१-३०॥
translation: Learned sage Kandu who knew what is righteousness and a strict observant of vows, slew a cow for carrying out the command of his father.

raw: आगम्य च पुरीं रम्यामयोध्यां पुरुषर्षभाः । तानि रत्नानि चित्राणि रामाय समुपाहरन् ॥७-३९-१२॥
translation: Having arrived back in the beautiful city of Ayodhya, those best among men presented the various wonderful jewels to Rama.

raw: त्वया शेषोओ जनश्चैव समाश्वास्यो यदाऽनघे । किमिदानीमिदम् देवि करोषि हृदि विक्लबम् ॥२-४४-२५॥
translation: O sinless lady, O queen when you are overcome by fear, how can you console others?

raw: तदा त्वम् प्राप्स्यसे रूपम् स्वम् एव विपुलम् शुभम् । श्रिया विराजितम् पुत्रम् दनोः त्वम् विद्धि लक्ष्मण ॥३-७१-७॥
एवम् कथयमानस्य तस्य सौमित्रिणा सह । रामस्य अस्तम् गतः सूर्यः संध्या कालो अभ्यवर्तत ॥३-११-६८॥
translation: While Rama was thus narrating to Lakshmana (the story of Agastya), the Sun set and evening closed in.

raw: तत् एनाम् विसृज अनार्याम् क्षत्र धर्म आश्रिताम् मतिम् । धर्मम् आश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यम् मद् बुद्धिर् अनुगम्यताम् ॥२-२१-४३॥
translation: Therefore, leave this ignoble thought, resort to the duty of a kshatriya, take the righteous path. Do not adopt violence. Follow my decision.

raw: सुग्रीवो वालिनम् हत्वा रामेण प्रतिपादितः । शतम् शतसहस्राणाम् कोटिमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥६-२८-३३॥
तैर्वध्यमाना देवाश्च ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । भयार्ताः शरणं जग्मुर्देवदेवं महेश्वरम् ॥७-६-१॥
translation: Tormented by them, the gods and the sages whose wealth was penance, distressed by fear, went to Maheśvara, the god of gods, for refuge.

raw: अलङ्कारं पुरस्त्यवं कृत्वा तत्पुरवासिनः । आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् ॥२-६-१९॥
translation: Thus the residents of Ayodhya decorated the city and eagerly waited for Rama's cornonation as heirapparent. Gathered in groups at public squares and in the assembly halls they conversed among themselves about the event, praising Dasaratha, the lord among men.

raw: वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रसादो न विनाशितः । तस्मात् प्रासादमप्येव भीमं विध्वंसयाम्यहम् । इति ऽञ्चिन्त्य मनसा हनुमान् दर्शयन् बलम् ॥५-४३-१॥
translation: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his strength and jumped on to the top of the palatial building that appeared like the peak of mount Meru.

raw: स च देवर्षिभिर्दिष्टः पिता मम महाकपिः । तार्थे नदीपतेः पुण्ये शम्बसादनमुद्धरत् ॥५-३५-८१॥
translation: "He (Kesari) is said to be my father by the divine sages. He retrieved a piece of land in a holy spot of that sea shore and killed Sambasadana, a demon who was oppressing righteous people.

raw: सीता हि राजवचनादाश्रमं पुण्यकर्मणाम् । मया नेया महर्षीणां श्रीघ्रमानीयतां रथः ॥७-४६-३॥
translation: Indeed, Sita is to be taken by me to the hermitage of the virtuous great sages by the king's command, so let the chariot be brought quickly.

raw: राक्षसानां च निनदैर्हरीणां चापि निस्वनैः । सा बभूव निशा घोरा भूयो घोरतरा तदा ॥६-४४-२५॥
translation: The night which was fierce appeared more dreadful with the loud noise of Rakshasas and Vanaras.

raw: प्रापणे चास्य मन्त्रस्य निवृत्ताः सर्वमन्त्रिणः । अवश्यम् च मया वाच्यम् यद्दृष्टमथवा श्रुतम् ॥६-१०-२५॥
translation: All your ministers have abstained from telling you out of fear of you. I must necessarily tell you (as brother) this which is seen and heard. You may determine that which is justifiable by determining the propriety. It is proper for me to submit to you.

raw: महर्षीन्समनुप्राप्तानभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । मन्त्रिणो नैगमांश्चैव यथार्हमनुकूलतः ॥७-७४-५॥
translation: With folded hands, Rama respectfully saluted the arrived great sages, as well as the ministers and citizens, each according to their due.

raw: भव स्व दार निरतः स्व कुलम् रक्ष राक्षस । मानम् वृद्धिम् च राज्यम् च जीवितम् च इष्टम् आत्मनः ॥३-३८-३१॥
translation: Enjoy with your wives. Protect your race, prestige, kingdom, prosperity and your own dear life.

raw: दृश्यन्ते वणिजोऽप्यद्य न यथापूर्वमत्रवै । ध्यानसम्विग्नहृदयाः नष्टव्यापारयन्त्रिताः ॥२-७१-४२॥
translation: Even traders seem restrained by the loss of business. They are not seen as before concentrating on their trade.

raw: काले काले तु मां वीर अयोध्यामवलोकितुम् । आगच्छ त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गन्तासि च पुरं तव ॥७-७२-१५॥
translation: O brave one, O best among men, you should come to Ayodhya from time to time to see me, and you will also return to your own city.

raw: एवं समाधिना युक्तस्तेजसा ऽप्रतिमेन च । शीक्षास्वरसमायुक्तं तपसा चाब्रवीन्मुनि: ॥२-९१-२२॥
translation: The valiant ascetic of incomparable lustre and power of penance in profound meditation said this in an accent in conformity with Vedic instruction.

raw: ततः क्रुद्धस्तु वेगेन गदां तां बहुकण्टकाम् । पातयामास धूम्राक्षो मस्तके तु हनूमतः ॥६-५२-३४॥
translation: And then lifting his mace fixed with many nails, Dhumraksha enraged lighted on Hanuman.

raw: तम् तथा परिताप आर्तम् लक्ष्मणो रामम् अब्रवीत् । इदम् एव जनस्थानम् त्वम् अन्वेषितुम् अर्हसि ॥३-६७-४॥
translation: Lakshmana said to Rama, afflicted with grief, It is proper for you to (first) search in this Janasthana, covered with different kinds of trees and creepers, and teeming with demons.

raw: श्रुत्वातांमैथिलींरामस्त्वाशशंसे च जीवितम् जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तःपीत्वामृतमिवातुरः ॥६-१२९-४७॥
translation: "Just as an ailing man at the end of life regains hope on drinking nectar, Sri Rama also gains hope on hearing about Mythili."

raw: कश्चिन् न दुष्टः तत्र आसीत् पर दार रतिर् नरः । प्रशांतम् सर्वम् एव असीत् राष्ट्रम् पुरवरम् च तत् ॥१-७-१५॥
translation: In that kingdom no one was wicked or enamoured of others' wives. Serenity prevailed over the entire kingdom including the city of excellence.

raw: विकल स कृतो बाणैः खरो रामेण संयुगे । मत्तो रुधिर गन्धेन तम् एव अभ्यद्रवत् द्रुतम् ॥३-३०-२२॥
translation: Completely struck by Rama's arrows, Khara, intoxicated with the smell of blood, ran speedily charging towards Rama.

raw: दीर्घाभिर्द्रुमयुक्ताभिः सरद्भिश्च समन्ततः । अमृतोपमतोयाभिश्शिवाभिरुपसंस्कृताः ॥५-१४-२५॥
translation: He observed ponds of different shapes filled with clear water with steps paved with rich gems, with sands of pearls and corals and bottoms of crystal, which contained beds of lotuses in bloom, adorned with chakravaka birds and resonant with cacklings of swans and sarasas and vatyuhas rubbing their beaks. There were golden platforms built on banks and platforms built of crystals. There were trees on the bank of streams, and nectarlike sacred waters flowing in them surrounded by hundreds of creepers, and Ashoka blossoms scattered everywhere, with thickly grown bushes of different kinds, with lilies in bloom in tanks.

raw: न स संकुचितः पंथा येन वाली हतो गतः । समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः ॥४-३०-८०॥
translation: 'The route by which Vali departed, killed by me has not been closed. O Sugriva you ought to abide by the pledge given. Do not follow the path of Vali.

raw: निजघ्नुः शैलशूलास्त्रैर्बिभिदुश्च परस्परम् । सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः ॥६-६९-६०॥
translation: In the battlefield both Vanaras and Rakshasas struck at one another with their head, rocks and swords and emitted lion roar.

raw: प्रतीक्षमाणः तम् मासम् यः सीता अधिगमे कृतः । उत्तराम् तु दिशम् रम्याम् गिरि राज समावृताम् ॥४-४५-४॥
एतेषाम् गिरि दुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च । मार्गध्वम् सहिताः सर्वे राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम् ॥४-४०-३२॥
translation: 'Go beyond Java island filled with precious gems. It has seven kingdoms. It is adorned with gold and silver mines in abundance. There is a mountain Sisira (abode of Garuda) beyond Java Island. It touches the sky with its lofty cliffs. Gods and demons visit this mountain. You may look for illustrious Rama's consort in these inaccessible mountains, waterfalls and forests.

raw: शुद्ध आत्मानौ यदि एतौ जानीहि त्वम् प्लवंगम । व्याभाषितैः वा रूपैः वा विज्ञेया दुष्टता अनयोः ॥४-२-२७॥
translation: 'O best of monkeys find out whether they are noble in their intentions or evil in their design through your conversation with them.'

raw: भग्न दण्डम् इदम् कस्य भूमौ सौम्य निपातितम् । कान्चन उरः छदाः च इमे पिशाच वदनाः खराः ॥३-६४-४६॥
भरतस्य तु तस्य आज्ञाम् प्रतिगृह्य प्रहर्षितः । रथम् गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तम् परम वाजिभिः ॥२-८२-२८॥
translation: He (Sumantra) received the command of Bharata in great delight and set out with a chariot harnessed with excellent horses.

raw: किष्किन्धा हि अथ शून्या च स्वर् गते वानरेश्वरे । उद्यानानि च शून्यानि पर्वताः कानानि च ॥४-२२-२६॥
वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृत वैरः च राघव । वालिनो मे महाभाग भय आर्तस्य अभयम् कुरु ॥४-५-२३॥
स चचालाचलश्चापि मुहूर्तं कपिपीडितः । तरूणां पुष्पिताग्राणां सर्वं पुष्पमशातयत् ॥५-१-१२॥
translation: Pressed firmly by Hanuman, the mountain was shaken for a moment which caused the flowers to drop down from the tree tops.

raw: अथवा ऽहं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भिन्नगात्रं महारणे । भवद्भिः श्वो निहन्तास्मि रामं लोकस्य पश्यतः ॥६-९४-५॥
translation: "I shall kill him with huge sharp arrows as the world looks at Rama, once his limbs are struck by you."

raw: अन्योन्यम् संपरिष्वज्य जग्मुर् योजनम् अंतरम् । ते नष्ट संज्ञाः तृषिताः संभ्रांताः सलिल अर्थिनः ॥४-५०-२२॥
सीताम् तु मोहिताम् दृष्ट्वा सरमा नाम राक्षसी । आससाद आशु वैदेहीम् प्रियाम् प्रणयिनी सखी ॥६-३३-१॥
translation: Then seeing Sita in distraught, a Rakshasi by name Saarana who was very dear and friendly with Vaidehi approached her.

raw: इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्भोगांश्चावाप्य पुष्कलान् । उत्तमं चायुरासाद्य स्वर्गत: पृथिवीपति: ॥२-१०५-३५॥
translation: King Dasaratha, lord of the earth, having performed various kinds of sacrifices and securing a long life, enjoyed abundance of pleasures and attained heaven.

raw: नृपश्चोवाच ताम् देवीम् देवि शम्सामि ते यदि । ततो मे मरणम् सद्यो भविष्यति न सम्शयः ॥२-३५-२२॥
translation: 'O queen if I disclose it, then I will undoubtedly die that very movement' replied the king to his wife.

raw: आपगाः कृत पुण्याः ताः पद्मिन्यः च सराम्सि च । येषु स्नास्यति काकुत्स्थो विगाह्य सलिलम् शुचि ॥२-४८-९॥
translation: The rivers and the lotuspools have done some meritorious acts in the past as a result of which Rama having plunged into their holy waters will make his ablution.

raw: अंबरीषः तु राजर्षी रथम् आरोप्य सत्वरः । शुनःशेपम् महातेजा जगाम आशु महायशाः ॥१-६१-२४॥
श्रुत्वा अंगदस्य अपि वचो अनुकूलम्ऊचुः च सर्वे हरयः प्रतीताः । यथा न हन्येम तथा विधानम्असक्तम् अद्य एव विधीयताम् नः ॥४-५३-२७॥
इहागच्छत गच्छामो वानरान् बलदर्पितान् । बलेन वारयिष्यामो मधु भक्षयतो वयम् ॥५-६२-१९॥
translation: "Come, we will all go there to Madhuvanam and prevent forcibly the vanaras who have consumed honey proud of their power.

raw: तस्मात् काल प्रतीक्षो अहम् स्थितो अस्मि शुभ लक्षण । सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अभिकांक्षयन् ॥४-२८-६३॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana of auspicious qualities I will wait for the proper time to appease Sugriva as well as the rivers.

raw: सुरम्यम् आसाद्य तु चित्र कूटम् । नदीम् च ताम् माल्यवतीम् सुतीर्थाम् । ननन्द हृष्टः मृग पक्षि जुष्टाम् । जहौ च दुह्खम् पुर विप्रवासात् ॥२-५६-३८॥
translation: Having reached the marvellous mount Chitrakuta and river Malyavati with excellent holy places and full of animals and birds, Rama shed the sorrow of his banishment from the city (of Ayodhya) and rejoiced with a gladdened heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तस्य देवसमानस्य पार्थिवस्य महात्मन: । नैतदौपयिकं मन्ये भुक्तभोगस्य भोजनम् ॥२-१०३-११॥
translation: I do not think that this is an appropriate food for that godlike and great lord of the earth who enjoyed all luxury.

raw: एवमुत्सृज्य सुश्रोणि त्वय्यहं वरवर्णिनि । कृतकामो भविष्यामि यदि नेच्छसि सङ्गमम् ॥७-५६-१८॥
translation: O beautiful-hipped lady of excellent complexion, if you do not desire union, I shall thus abandon my desire for you and consider my wish fulfilled.

raw: न लुब्धो बुध्यते दोषान् किम् पाकम् इव भक्षयन् । कुब्जा निमित्तम् कैकेय्या राघवाणान् कुलम् हतम् ॥२-६६-६॥
translation: Like a greedy man who eats the (poisonous) kimpaka fruit without realising the defects of the fruit, Kaikeyi has destroyed the Raghu race on account of the hunchback (Manthara).

raw: अदृष्टपूर्वाम् पश्यन्ती रामम् पप्रच्छ साऽबला । रमणीयान् बहुविधान् पादपान् कुसुमोत्कटान् ॥२-५५-३१॥
ततः कुमुदषण्डाभो निर्मलम् निर्मलोदयः । प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम् ॥ ५-१७- १ ॥५-१७-१॥
translation: Then the Moon shining like a bed of lilies rose stainless, ascended the clear sky and looked like a swan swimming through blue water.

raw: सा ऽहं तस्याग्रतस्तूर्णं प्रस्थिता वनचारिणी । न हि मे तेन हीनाया वासः स्वर्गे ऽपि रोचते ॥५-३३-२८॥
translation: "I, however resolved to live in the forest, marched ahead of him quickly as I did not prefer even heaven without him.

raw: ततोऽब्रवीत् द्विजान् वृद्धान् यज्ञ कर्मसु निष्ठितान् । स्थापत्ये निष्ठिताम् च एव वृद्धान् परम धार्मिकान् ॥१-१३-६॥
translation: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

raw: सा तु वेदश्रुतिं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा वै तपसो निधिम् । अभवत्पाण्डुदेहा सा सुव्यञ्जितशरीरजा ॥७-२-१७॥
translation: But she, having heard the sound of the Vedas and indeed having seen the repository of penance, became pale-bodied with clearly manifested bodily signs.

raw: स च प्रमाणं धर्मात्मा राजा लोकगुरुस्तव । पित्रा दत्तं यथाभागमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-२५॥
translation: The proclamation of that righteous king revered by the world shall be your guide. You should enjoy that portion bestowed by father.

raw: पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवम् दारुणम् वपुः । भिद्येरन् दर्शनात् अस्या भीरूणाम् हृदयानि च ॥१-२६-१०॥
translation: "O Lakshmana, behold, the sight of the dreadful hideous body of this yakshini will break timid hearts.

raw: मृदिताश्चापविद्धाश्च दृश्यन्ते कमलस्रज: । कामिभिर्वनिते पश्य फलानि विविधानि च ॥२-९४-२५॥
translation: O Lady, behold those lotus garlands crushed and cast aside by lovers and also many fruits (tasted by them and) lying there.

raw: दिष्ट्या विजयिनं त्वाद्य पश्यामः सह सीतया । लक्ष्मणेन च धर्मात्मन्भ्रात्रा त्वद्धितकारिणा ॥७-१-२०॥
translation: O righteous one, it is fortunate that today we see you victorious, accompanied by Sita and by Lakshmana, your brother who always acts for your welfare.

raw: सा हृष्टा तस्य तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामस्य कैकयी । प्रस्थानं श्रद्धधाना हि त्वरयामास राघवम् ॥२-१९-१२॥
translation: Kaikeyi, happy to hear the words of the son of the Raghus as she was convinced that his departure (to the forest) was certain, hastened him (to set out).

raw: यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयम् । तस्मात्त्वं समरे राजञ्छत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि ॥७-३०-३३॥
translation: Because my wife was fearlessly violated by you, O Vasava, therefore, O king, you will fall into the hands of your enemies in battle.

raw: तस्मिन् सहस्राक्ष सम प्रभावेरामे स्थिते कार्मुक बाण पाणौ । हृता अपि ते अहम् न जराम् गमिष्येवज्रम् यथा मक्षिकया अवगीर्णम् ॥३-४७-४८॥
translation: So long Rama, equal in prowess to the thousandeyed Indra stands with bow and arrows in hand, I will not, although abducted, wither away like a diamond gulped by an insect (fly).

raw: तस्माद्राजगृहादेव वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः । एतद्धि रोचते मह्यं भृशं चापि हितं तव ॥२-८-३३॥
translation: Therefore let your son go to the forest straight from his uncle's palace only. That alone will please me. For you also this is highly beneficial.

raw: हत्वा इव ब्राह्मणम् कामात् स्पृष्ट्वा अग्निम् इव पाणिना । अन्वतप्यत धर्म आत्मा पुत्रम् सम्चिन्त्य तापसम् ॥२-४२-११॥
translation: That virtuous Dasaratha, recalling (the sight of) his son with the robes of an ascetic, burned with remorse as if he had intentionally slain a brahmin or placed his hand in fire.

raw: पतिव्रतात्वमास्थाय रामं कृत्वा सदा हृदि । श्रेयस्ते परमं देवि तथा कृत्वा भविष्यति ॥७-४७-१८॥
translation: O goddess, by adopting the state of a devoted wife and always keeping Rama in your heart, your supreme welfare will be achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 47 ।। Thus ends the forty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: रूप सम्ल्लाप शीलेन युक्त गीत अर्थ भाषिणा । देश काल अभियुक्तेन युक्त वाक्य अभिधायिना ॥५-११-७॥
translation: The monkey leader saw thousands of beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.

raw: ततस्तु वेगवांस्तस्य गिरेर्गिरिनिभः कपिः । निपपात महेन्द्रस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले ॥५-५७-३०॥
translation: Thereafter the vanara, who resembled a mountain, descended with great speed on the summit of mount Mahendra full of trees.

raw: यश्च त्वामभियुञ्जीत युद्धाय विगतज्वरः । तं शूलो भस्मसात्कृत्वा पुनरेष्यति ते करम् ॥७-६१-१०॥
translation: Whoever fearlessly challenges you to battle, the spear will reduce him to ashes and then return to your hand.

raw: लक्ष्मणस्त्वङ्गदीयायां संवत्सरमथोषितः । पुत्रे स्थिते दुराधर्षे अयोध्यां पुनरागमत् ॥७-१०२-१३॥
translation: Lakshmana, having resided for a year in Angada's territory until his unconquerable son was established, then returned to Ayodhya.

raw: नदीमिव घनापाये हंससारससेविताम् । राक्षसाः कपिमुख्याश्च तेरुस्तां दुस्तरां नदीम् ॥६-५८-३२॥
translation: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

raw: अभिवाद्य च वैदेही तापसीं तामनिन्दिताम् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम् ॥२-११७-१८॥
translation: Sita offered her obeisance to the blameless ascetic, Anasuya, folding her palms and enquired of her wellbeing in delight.

raw: तम् दृष्ट्वा भीम संकाशम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम् । वसिष्ठ प्रमुखा विप्रा जप होम परायणाः ॥१-७४-२०॥
translation: At the sight of the fearful appearance of Parasurama looking like flaming fire, Vasishta and all other saints who were in the habit of chanting mantras and offering oblations to the fire whispered among themselves:

raw: समासाद्य च लक्ष्मीवन् लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् । परिखाभिः सपद्माभिः सोत्पलाभिरलंकृताम् ॥५-२-१४॥
translation: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

raw: परिदेवयमानां तां राक्षसी त्रिजटा ऽब्रवीत् ॥६-४८-२२॥
तात राजा दशरथः स्वर् गतः धर्मम् आचरन् । धन धान्यवतीम् स्फीताम् प्रदाय पृथिवीम् तव ॥२-८२-५॥
translation: O dear child following the righteous path king Dasaratha conferred on you this vast kingdom abounding in wealth and grains before attaining heaven.

raw: अहं पौलस्त्यतनयो दशग्रीवश्च नामतः । मुनेर्विश्रवसो यस्तु तृतीयो ब्रह्मणो ऽभवत् ॥७-१२-१५॥
translation: "I am the son of Pulastya, named Dashagriva, and I am the son of Sage Vishrava, who was the third (generation) from Brahma."

raw: असत्यसन्धस्य सतश्चलस्यास्थिरचेतस: । नैव देवा न पितर: प्रतीच्छन्तीति न: श्रुतम् ॥२-१०९-१८॥
translation: We have heard that the offerings of a man inclined to untruth, of an unstable and unsteady mind are accepted neither by the gods nor by the ancestors.

raw: छेत्स्यते समरे बाहू तदा स्वर्गम् गमिष्यसि । अनेन वपुषा तात वने अस्मिन् राजसत्तम ॥३-७१-१६॥
लङ्कां चेयं पुरी रम्या सवाजिरथकुञ्जरा । सागरे पतिता दृष्टा भग्नगोपुरतोरणा ॥५-२७-३५॥
translation: "I saw this delightful Lanka teeming with horses, chariots and elephants, archways and towers crumbling and falling into the ocean.

raw: दन्तैः भुजाभ्यां पद्मां च शक्तितोमरसायकैः । येन केनैव संरब्धस्ताडयामास वै सुरान् ॥७-२८-३५॥
translation: Enraged, he indeed struck the gods with teeth, with two arms, a lotus, and with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, by whatever means possible.

raw: पंच रूपाणि राजानो धारयन्ति अमित ओजसः । अग्नेः इन्द्रस्य सोमस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च ॥३-४०-१२॥
translation: Very powerful kings assume five forms like fire, Indra, Moon, Varuna and Yama.

raw: यथा ऽस्तं गत आदित्ये नावतिष्ठन्ति रश्मयः । तथा तस्मिन्निपतिते राक्षसास्ते गता दिशः ॥६-९१-८४॥
translation: Just as Sun rays go away as soon as the Sun sets in the evening, the Rakshasas also went in all directions seeing Indrajith fallen.

raw: दृढम् हि हृदये बुधिः मम संप्रतिवर्तते । न अलम् वर्तयितुम् सीता साध्वी मत् विरहम् गता ॥४-१-५१॥
translation: 'My mind makes me feel certain that Sita with her chastity might not be able to live separated from me.

raw: तंशैलमिवशैलाभाःसर्वेतुप्लवगर्षभाः । समारुह्यसमुत्पत्यददंशुश्चमहाबलाः ॥६-६७-३२॥
translation: The bulls among Vanaras themselves looking like mountains endowed with great strength climbed up Kumbhakarna and bit him.

raw: अन्योन्यं च समाश्लिष्य कपयो हृष्टमानसाः । चक्रुरुच्चावचगुणा राघवाश्रयजाः कथाः ॥६-९१-९७॥
translation: The monkeys feeling very happy embraced one another singing in praise of Lakshmana saying" Lakshmana has won"and stories related to Lakshmana

raw: विमर्दं द्रष्टुमनयोर्यमराक्षसयोः स्वयम् ॥७-२०-३२॥
translation: He himself wished to witness the conflict between Yama and the Rakshasa. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे विंशः सर्गः ।। 20 ।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: नदन्ति कावम् मुदिताः शकुना सङ्घशः कलम् । आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् काम उन्मादकरा मम ॥४-१-४६॥
translation: The joyful birds, calling sweetly in flocks as though inviting one another, madden me with longing.

raw: निश्चित्य सचिवैः सार्धं युवराजममन्यत । दिव्यन्तरिक्षे भूमौ च घोरमुत्पातजं भयम् ॥२-१-४२॥
जामदग्न्यो गतो रामः प्रयातु चतुर् अन्गिणी । अयोध्या अभिमुखी सेना त्वया नाथेन पालिता ॥१-७७-३॥
translation: "Parasurama, son of Jamadagni, has gone. Let the four divisions of the army of which you are the commander proceed towards Ayodhya.

raw: अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः । सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान् पुरा ॥५-५९-१९॥
translation: "Earlier Brahma, the grandsire of all worlds has given the Aswini sons immeasurable invulnerability to honour them.

raw: तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गत्वा लघुविक्रमाः । निहतं च महत्सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे ॥५-५८-११५॥
translation: "Those who were left behind, the less powerful ones went and reported to Ravana that the great army has been killed.

raw: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् इह अद्य एव कश्चित् राजा विधीयताम् । अराजकम् हि नो राष्ट्रम् न विनाशम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥२-६७-८॥
