translation: Therefore, let someone from the race of Ikshvakus be appointed king right now. since without a king, the country will be destroyed.

raw: उक्तश्च दुर्गमः पारः कार्याणां राक्षस त्वया । कार्याणां कर्मणा पारं यो गच्छति स बुद्धिमान् ॥६-८८-१३॥
translation: "Rakshasa! You have proclaimed that you will send me to Yama's abode and about the success in your undertakings even though it is not possible. He who is intelligent will succeed in his tasks (not in words alone).

raw: स तस्यबाहुर्गिरिशृङ्गकल्पःसमुद्गरोराघवबाणकृत्तः । पपाततस्मिन् हरिराजसैन्येजघानतांवानरवाहिनीं ॥६-६७-१५८॥
translation: Kumbhakarna's arm severed by Rama's arrow was like a mountain peak. It fell on Vanara army too and killed the monkey king's army.

raw: जलोदम् सागरम् शीघ्रम् सर्व भूत भयावहम् । तत्र तत् कोपजम् तेजः कृतम् हयमुखम् महत् ॥४-४०-४८॥
प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः । तदा तस्मिन् स काकुत्स्थः श्रीमति आश्रम मण्डले ॥३-११-२२॥
रावणो नाम दुर्वृत्तो राक्षसो राक्षस ईश्वरः । तस्य अहम् अनुजो भ्राता विभीषण इति श्रुतः ॥६-१७-१२॥
translation: "I am called Vibheeshana, the younger brother of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas and of evil conduct."

raw: हयस्य यानि च अंगानि तानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणाः । अग्नौ प्रास्यन्ति विधिवत् समस्ताः षोडश ऋत्विजः ॥१-१४-३८॥
translation: The sixteen officiating priests (brahmins) offered all the horse's limbs with prayers as per the customs.

raw: तिष्ठत एव अत्र संतुष्टा न उपवरितितुम् अर्हथ । यदि प्राणैः इह अर्थो वो निवर्तध्वम् निशा चराः ॥३-२०-१०॥
translation: If you care for your life, you may return, or else, if you please you may remain (die) here, O demons.

raw: वीर सौम्य प्रबुध्यस्व कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन । जगद्धि सर्वं स्वपिति त्वयि सुप्ते नराधिप ॥७-३७-४॥
translation: O heroic and gentle king, who increases Kausalya's joy, please awaken, for indeed, when you sleep, the entire world sleeps.

raw: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शो द्विविदो ऽप्यशनिप्रभम् । जघान गिरिशृङ्गेण मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥६-४३-३२॥
translation: Dwivida whose body was like a thunderbolt to feel, moved about on the mountain peak as Rakshasas were watching.

raw: विवदन्तौ ततो ऽन्योन्यं दातारमभिजग्मतुः । तौ राजभवनद्वारि न प्राप्तौ नृगशासनम् ॥७-५३-१६॥
translation: Then, disputing with each other, they approached the giver (King Nṛga), but those two did not meet King Nṛga at the palace gate.

raw: आश्रमं तु तयोः शून्यं प्रविश्य नरसिंहयोः । गोचरं गतयोर्भ्रात्रोरपनीता त्वयाधम ॥५-१९-२६॥
निर्दग्धम् तत् बलम् सर्वम् प्रदीप्तैः इव पावकैः । ततो अस्त्राणि महातेजा विश्वामित्रो मुमोच ह । तैः तैः यवन कांभोजा बर्बराः च अकुली कृताः ॥१-५४-२३॥
यन्मेरुशिखराकारं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा । बहुभिर्भूषितं हर्म्यैर्मुक्तारजतसन्निभैः ॥६-१२४-२६॥
translation: Rama having spoken that way, Vibheeshana the king of Rakshasas, hurriedly ordered for the aerial car. The aerial car Pushpaka's parts were decorated with golden pictures, its altars were made of cat's eye gems, its squares were fixed with pillars and shone like silver. It was surrounded on all sides with yellow pennons. It had posts and flags all over, decorated with golden lotuses. The mansions in Pushpak had networks scattered with eyeholes set with pearls like windows. It had rows of bells, surrounded on all sides which had sweet sound. The Pushpak constructed by Viswakarma was huge like mountain Meru's peak and decorated with silver and pearls. Its pavements were fixed with crystals and encrusted with cat's eye gems. The seats were excellent and had rich coverings.

raw: अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पसन्दिग्धभाषिणी । ममोत्पतनसम्भ्रान्ता शोकवेगसमाहता ॥५-६७-३४॥
प्रवृत्ते सङ्कुले तस्मिन् घोरे वीरजनक्षये । अङ्गदः कम्पनं वीरमाससाद रणोत्सुकः ॥६-७६-१॥
translation: While the fierce fight brought destruction of heroes in the ongoing combat, Angada eager to fight, assailed gallant Kampana.

raw: दर्शनीयां हि रक्षः स कन्यां स्त्रीं वापि पश्यति । हत्वा बन्धुजनं तस्या विमाने तां रुरोध ह ॥७-२४-२॥
translation: Whenever that demon saw a beautiful maiden or woman, he would kill her relatives and then confine her in his aerial car.

raw: अब्रवीच्च हरिश्रेष्ठः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम् । किं नु चिन्तयसे देवि किं नु मां नाभिभाषसे ॥६-११६-१६॥
translation: Then seeing Sita not answering him, the monkey chief asked her" Why are you not replying. What are you thinking?"

raw: क्वचित् प्रभिन्नैः करकैः क्वचिद् आलोडितैर् घटैः । क्वचित् सम्पृक्त माल्यानि जलानि च फलानि च ॥५-११-२७॥
translation: At some places he saw broken pots, at other places rolling pots and elsewhere flower garlands strewn and mixed up with water and fruits.

raw: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु देवसंघः सहर्षिभिः । भूतानि च भयं जग्मुस्तेषां पतनशङ्कया ॥५-१-१२४॥
translation: "When they moved about, even hosts of sages, gods and creatures panicked for fear of falling down (and destroying all worlds).

raw: प्रसुप्तम् इव च अन्यत्र क्रीडन्तम् इव च अन्यतः । क्वचित् पर्वत मात्रैः च जल राशिभिः आवृतम् ॥४-६४-५॥
translation: The ocean was of terrifying form filled with various violent species of grotesque creatures of huge bodies playing in the water. Full of violent tides, it appeared asleep at one place and apparently sporting in another. In some places it was rising as high as a mountain with huge volumes of water. It was as if roaring with the demon chiefs residing in the underworld. The great monkeys were worried seeing the huge ocean which created horripilation in them.

raw: आपतन्तं महावीर्यं तदनीकं वनौकसाम् । रक्षसां भीमवेगानामनीकं तु न्यवारयत् ॥६-८१-२६॥
translation: Rakshasa army troops of mighty prowess, terribly angry, were advancing towards wood dwellers (Vanara troops) and were intercepted by the Vanara troops.

raw: बहवस्सारवन्तश्च वनेषु विविधा द्रुमाः । वालिना तरसा भग्ना बलं प्रथयताऽत्मनः ॥४-११-६॥
translation: 'Vali would break several sturdy trees in the forest with his vigour and speed, exhibiting his strength.

raw: आचक्ष्व मे महान् को ऽसौ रक्षो वा यदि वा ऽसुरः । न मयैवंविधं भूतं दृष्टपूर्वं कदाचन ॥६-६१-७॥
translation: "Who is he, that gigantic Rakshasa? Is he a demon or perhaps a colossus? No such being was seen by me earlier."

raw: अब्रवीद् राक्षसान् सर्वान् ह्रिया किम्चिद् अवान् मुखः । धर्षिता च प्रविष्टा च लंका दुष्प्रसहा पुरी ॥६-६-२॥
शापिता असि मम प्राणैः निवर्तस्व जनेन च । अलम् जित्वा निवर्तिष्ये तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् रणे ॥४-१६-१०॥
translation: 'I make a vow even on my life and my victory. Pray return with the retinue. I will be back only after winning the encounter with my brother.

raw: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् न तम् पश्यामि शोभने । विक्रमेण नयेत् यः त्वाम् मत् बाहु परिपालिताम् ॥३-५५-२५॥
translation: O lovely lady, I do not see any one in these three worlds who can, by his valour, take you away from me guarded by my arms.

raw: इयं लङ्का पुरी राजन्राक्षसानां महात्मनाम् । त्वया निवेशिता सौम्य नैतद्युक्तं तवानघ ॥७-११-२४॥
translation: "O King, O gentle one, O sinless one, this city of Lanka, belonging to the great-souled Rakshasas, was established by you, but this is not proper for you."

raw: अन्तरिक्षात् पपातोल्का निर्घातसमनिस्वना । विनेदुरशिवा गृध्रा वायसैरनुनादिताः ॥६-९६-३९॥
translation: A meteor had fallen from the sky resembling thunder, coupled with inauspicious eagle cries.

raw: वाङ्मात्रेण तदा राजा कैकेय्या स्ववशे कृतः । प्रच्स्कन्द विनाशाय पाशं वृग इवात्मनः ॥२-११-२२॥
translation: The king now came under the control of Kaikeyi by his own words like a deer that jumps into the trap for its own destruction.

raw: न च संकुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः । समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः ॥४-३४-१८॥
translation: 'O Sugriva the path by which Vali went is not closed.I wish you do not follow him. You stand by the promise made.

raw: तस्याप्रदानाद्ब्रह्मर्षे युद्धमासीन्मया सह । स हतोऽभिमुखो राजा सुधन्वा तु मया रणे ॥१-७१-१८॥
translation: O Brahmarshi when I refused, a great conflict broke out between him and me. In the encounter king Sudhanva was killed by me.

raw: न हि तम् वेद्मि वै राम यत्र सा तनु मध्यमा । लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीनः संताप मोहितः ॥३-६४-५॥
एवं स राजा तद्राज्यमकरोत्सपुरोहितः । प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराजं यथा वृषा ॥७-७९-१९॥
translation: Thus, that king (Shatrughna), with his priest, ruled that kingdom, which was filled with joyful people, just as Indra rules the kingdom of the gods.

raw: तस्यासनानि प्रासादान्वेदिकास्तोरणानि च । पुष्पकस्य बभञ्जुस्ते शीघ्रं मधुकरा इव ॥७-२१-२७॥
translation: They quickly shattered the seats, palaces, platforms, and archways of the Pushpaka chariot, just like bees.

raw: त्यज्यताम् मानुषो भावो मयि भावः प्रणीयताम् । राज्यात् च्युतम् असिद्ध अर्थम् रामम् परिमित आयुषम् ॥३-४९-१३॥
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन राम सालकटङ्कटा । विद्युत्केशाद्गर्भमाप घनराजिरिवार्णवात् ॥७-४-२३॥
translation: O Rama, after some time, Salakatankata conceived from Vidhyutkesha, just as a line of clouds obtains moisture from the ocean.

raw: तमुवाचततोधीमान् विभीषणइदंवचः विमृश्यबुद्ध्याधर्मज्ञोधर्मार्थसहितंहितम् ॥६-११४-९२॥
translation: Then the wise and righteous Vibheeshana thinking made a wholesome and righteous submission in the following words.

raw: हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तं पौरुषेण विवर्जितम् । भीरुं लघुमिवासत्त्वं विहीनमिव तेजसा ॥६-१०६-२॥
translation: "You dullard! Disdaining me as not capable, lacking manliness, powerless, deficient in valour, timid, incapable, petty, devoid of energy, not knowing conjuring tricks, abandoned weapons, driven out, you act not knowing me in your own way foolishly using your discretion."

raw: गतो हि लक्ष्मणः पूर्वं भरतश्च महायशाः । श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य शत्रुघ्नः परमासनात् ॥७-४४-१०॥
translation: The doorkeeper also informed Shatrughna that Lakshmana had already gone, and the greatly renowned Bharata too, and upon hearing these words, Shatrughna rose from his excellent seat.

raw: लंकायाम् अथ गुप्तायाम् सागरेण समंततः । संप्राप्य सागरस्य अंतम् संपूर्णम् शत योजनम् ॥४-५८-२४॥
translation: 'O monkeys traverse a hundred yojanas across the sea. On reaching the southern coast you will be able to see Ravana's Lanka defended and surrounded by the sea. Now proceed swiftly and prove your strength.

raw: इक्ष्वकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयता ऽनघ । सा मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता ॥५-६५-१५॥
translation: "O sinless one O tiger among men To inspire confidence in her I praised the glory of your Ikshvaku dynasty.

raw: ईहामृगसमायुक्त्तै: कार्तस्वरहिरमण्मयैः । सुकृतैराचितं स्तम्भैः प्रदीप्तमिव च श्रिया ॥५-९-१३॥
translation: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.

raw: एवम् उक्तः तु सम्हृष्टः नर सिम्हो महा द्युतिः । ततः सम्मानयाम् आस सीताम् इदम् उवाच ह ॥२-१६-१४॥
translation: Highly lustrous Rama ,the lion among men, when thus spoken to, was immensely pleased and extending due honour to him said to Sita:

raw: प्रहृउष्टमुदितैः पौरैरुच्च्रि तद्वजमालिनीम् । अयोध्यां वन्थरा तस्मात्प्रासादादन्ववैक्षत ॥२-७-६॥
translation: The city of Ayodhya was decorated with costly banners and pennants. The labyrinthine roads were crowded with people who had (finished) their headbath and were wandering at will. The temples with their doors painted white were reverberating with the chanting from the Vedas by the best of brahmins holding garlands and sweetmeats in their hands and with sounds of all kinds of musical instruments. The city was filled with spirited horses and elephants. The bulls were bellowing and the cows were lowing. The citizens with great joy raised the penants encircling the city of Ayodhya. All this left Manthara astonished.

raw: काञ्चनैरपि भृङ्गारैर्जह्रुः सलिलमग्रतः । मण्डलागान् ब्रुसींश्चापि गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः ॥५-१८-१२॥
translation: Some moved ahead of him carrying water in golden pitchers. Others followed him carrying circular couches (to be used as seats).

raw: क्षान्तम् क्षमावताम् पुत्र्यः कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् कृतम् । ऐकमत्यम् उपागम्य कुलम् च आवेक्षितम् मम ॥१-३३-६॥
translation: "O daughters you have done a great act of forgiveness of which only the tolerant are capable. By taking a united stand, you have protected the honour of my dynasty.

raw: तेषामायाचितं देव त्वत्प्रसादा त्समृद्ध्यताम् । राममिन्दीवरश्यामं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् ॥२-२-५३॥
translation: O Lord let the peoples' prayer be fulfilled by your blessings. We would like to see your son Rama of the complexion of a bluelotus and destroyer of enemies as prince regent.

raw: ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम् । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः ॥६-५९-८०॥
translation: Then, when Ravana was unable to release the arrow from the bow on Neela, who was shifting from the top of the post to the crown. Seeing that Lakshmana, Rama and Hanuman were amazed.

raw: तनुमध्या पृथुश्रोणी शरदिन्दुनिभानना । हेमबिम्बनिभा सौम्यामायेव मयनिर्मिता ॥६-१२-१४॥
translation: "She is a woman of slender waist, plump hips, whose face is like an autumnal full moon. She is gentle and like a golden image. She is like a magical one constructed by Maya."

raw: निहत्य तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुधन्वानं नराधिपम् । साङ्काश्ये भ्रातरं वीरमभ्यषिञ्चं कुशध्वजम् ॥१-७१-१९॥
translation: O Best of ascetics having killed king Sudhanva, I have crowned my heroic brother Kusadhwaja in Sankasya.

raw: खात् पपात अवनिम् हृष्टो भक्तैर् अनुचरैः सह । स तु रामस्य धर्म आत्मा निपपात विभीषणः ॥६-१८-२॥
तेषामधिष्ठितानां तैर्वानरैः पर्वतोपमैः । मुखेभ्यो रुधिरं रक्तं हयानां समवर्तत ॥६-९०-५१॥
translation: Those Vanaras of huge mountain forms getting on top of those horses (of Indrajith),

raw: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ । यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्वं सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम् ॥७-९४-१॥
translation: When the night dawned, after bathing and performing their fire oblations, the two boys sang the entire Ramayana as previously narrated by the sage Valmiki in that assembly.

raw: ततः कपीनाम् ऋषभेण चोदितःप्रतीत वेगः पवन आत्मजः कपिः । प्रहर्षयन् ताम् हरि वीर वाहिनीम्चकार रूपम् महत् आत्मनः तदा ॥४-६६-३८॥
यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्धमनिन्दिते । अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि तत् ॥५-३८-१०॥
translation: "O blameless lady If you wish not to accompany me you may give me a token of identification to let Rama know about my coming here and seeing you".

raw: उपद्रुतमिदम् सर्वमनालम्बमनायकम् । कैकेय्या हि कृते सर्वम् विनाशमुपयास्यति ॥२-४८-२५॥
translation: The entire kingdom, for the sake of Kaikeyi, is under a great calamity. With no support or leader it will definitely go to ruin.

raw: कृतानि वेश्मानि च पाण्डुराणि । तथा सुपुष्पा अपि पुष्करिण्यः । पुनः च पद्मानि सकेसराणि । धन्यानि चित्राणि तथा वनानि ॥५-७-१०॥
translation: There were pictures of mansions white in colour and pools of crystalclear water filled with lovely flowers. There were pictures of beautiful lotuses drawn on it.

raw: यथा च मन्ये दुर्जीवम् एवम् न सुकरम् ध्रुवम् । आच्चिद्य पुत्रे निर्याते कौसल्या यत्र जीवति ॥२-५७-२२॥
translation: I think it is indeed difficult for Kausalya to live wherever and whichever way she tries as she has been separated from her son. (the queens said).

raw: विस्तीर्ण विपुल उरस्काः परिघायत बाहवः । शोणांशु वसनाः सर्वे व्याघ्र इव दुरासदाः ॥३-५-१६॥
translation: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

raw: जनस्थाने हत स्थाने तव राक्षस मत् शरैः । निर्भया विचरिष्यन्ति सर्वतो मुनयो वने ॥३-३०-९॥
translation: O demon, when my arrows destroy your hold over Janasthana the sages will move freely without fear all over this forest.

raw: विध्वंसयन्तं तरसा दृष्ट्वैव पवनात्मजम् । राक्षसानां सहस्राणि हनुमन्तमवाकिरन् ॥६-८६-२०॥
translation: Seeing the wind god's son destroying, thousands of Rakshasas got together surrounding him.

raw: तरुण आदित्य वर्णाः च पर्वते ये महाअरुणे । पिबंतो मधु मैरेयम् भीम वेगाः प्लवंगमाः ॥४-३७-७॥
translation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

raw: श्रुत्वागस्त्येरितं वाक्यं रामो विस्मयमागतः । कथमासीत्तु लङ्कायां सम्भवो रक्षसां पुरा ॥७-४-१॥
translation: Having heard the words spoken by Agastya, Rama was filled with astonishment, wondering how the Rakshasas could have originated in Lanka in ancient times.

raw: न जानाति पुरा वीर्यम् मम युद्धे स राघवः । मम चापमयीम् वीणाम् शरकोणैः प्रवादिताम् ॥६-२४-४३॥
translation: "He has not known my valour in war. Entering the enemy's army holding my formidable Veena, making challenging sounds with the sharp heads of arrows, causing tumultuous noise like the sound of cry of destitute and frightened ones with iron arrows, I will play the Veena of my bow in hand."

raw: सा स्नापयन्ती विपुलौ स्तनौ नेत्रजलस्रवैः । चिन्तयन्ती न शोकस्य तदा ऽन्तमधिगच्छति ॥५-२५-७॥
translation: Her large breasts bathed with the flow of tears, she continued to brood over her plight and found no end to it.

raw: सत्यम् अस्त्रम् महाबाहो तथा मायामयम् परम् । सौरम् तेजःप्रभम् नाम पर तेजो अपकर्षणम् ॥१-२७-१९॥
कश्चेतयान: पुरुष: कार्याकार्यविचक्षण: । बहुमंस्यति मां लोके दुर्वृत्तं लोकदूषणम् ॥२-१०९-७॥
translation: If like a man who appears noble, though ignoble, clean, though unclean or dishonest, auspicious, though inauspicious, a man of character, though depraved, I forsake auspicious ways for unrighteousness, abandon pious acts and scriptural practices and indulge, under the cloak of dharma, in acts of wickedness by causing harm and confusion to the world, will any sensible man with a sense of discrimination between should and should not hold me in high esteem?

raw: तदिच्छामि त्वया ऽ ऽज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम् । रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्वं नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम् ॥५-५८-९८॥
translation: 'O venerable lady I seek your order. What should I do? Should I take you to Rama and Lakshmana? What do you say?

raw: अमात्यांस्तांस्तु सन्त्यज्य यमयोधा महाबलाः । तमेव चाभ्यधावन्त शूलवर्षैर्दशाननम् ॥७-२१-३३॥
translation: The mighty warriors of Yama, abandoning those ministers, rushed directly towards Dashanana (Ravana) with showers of spears.

raw: तत् पूर्वम् ऐक्ष्वाक सुतः महात्मा । रामः गमिष्यन् वनम् आर्त रूपम् । व्यतिष्ठत प्रेक्ष्य तदा सुमन्त्रम् । पितुर् महात्मा प्रतिहारण अर्थम् ॥२-३३-३०॥
translation: Seeing Sumantra stricken with grief for the first time the magnanimous Rama, scion of the Ikshvaku dynasty, on the way to the forest waited there for his father to be informed of his arrival.

raw: अग्निम् शुश्रूषमाणस्य पितरम् च यशस्विनम् । एतस्मिन् एव काले तु रोमपादः प्रतापवान् ॥१-९-७॥
दक्षिणं तीरमुदधेर्लङ्का यत्र च सा पुरी । अस्तं दिनकरे याते रक्षसां निलयं पुरम् । प्रविष्टो ऽहमविज्ञातो रक्षोभि र्भीमविक्रमैः ॥५-५८-४६॥
translation: After the sun had set, I, of fierce valour, entered unnoticed the guarded city, the abode of the demons.

raw: अस्माकमपि तावत्त्वं गृहं कुरु महामते । हिमवन्तमपाश्रित्य मेरुमन्दरमेव वा । महेश्वरगृहप्रख्यं गृहं नः क्रियतां महत् ॥७-५-२१॥
translation: O great-minded one, therefore, please build a grand dwelling for us also, resembling the abode of Maheswara, either by resorting to the Himalayas or Mount Meru or Mandara.

raw: शरनिर्दग्धतोयस्य परिशुष्कस्य सागर । मया निहतसत्त्वस्य पाम्सुरुत्पद्यते महान् ॥६-२२-२॥
translation: "O Ocean When your water is dried up to the core by my arrows, huge sand will appear."

raw: एवंप्रभावो लवणः शूलं चैव तथाविधम् । श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं काकुत्स्थ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः ॥७-६१-२२॥
translation: Having heard of Lavana's power and the nature of his trident, O Rama, you are our ultimate refuge and authority.

raw: तरुणम् दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणम् वाम भाषिणी । न्याय वृत्तम् सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियम् अप्रिय दर्शना ॥३-१७-११॥
translation: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large, hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust. (This) demoness said to Rama :

raw: उत्पतंतम् अनूत्पेतू रुमा प्रभृतयः स्त्रियः । सुग्रीवम् गगने पूर्णम् चंद्रम् तारा गणा इव ॥४-३४-४॥
translation: As soon as Sugriva jumped up ,Ruma and other womenfolk rose to their feet like the clusters of stars around the fullMoon in the sky.

raw: दुर्वृत्तमपि कः पुत्रम् त्यजेद्भुवि विचक्षणः । कश्च प्रव्राज्यमानो वा नासूयेत्पितरम् सुतः ॥२-६४-६४॥
translation: Which clearsighted man in this world, will abandon his son even if he is of evil conduct? Which son will not get angry with his father when he is banished?

raw: आजगाम ततो वाली हत्वा तम् दानवर्षभः । ततो अहम् अददाम् राज्यम् गौरवात् भय यंत्रितः ॥४-४६-१०॥
translation: Then Vali, having slain that bull among danavas, returned; and I, constrained by fear yet out of respect, gave the kingdom back to him.

raw: प्रसूतम् कलमक्षेत्रे वर्षेण इव शतक्रतुः । तद् आह्वान निमित्तम् च वालिनो हेममालिनः ॥४-१४-१६॥
सो अहम् अभ्यवहार अर्थम् तौ दृष्ट्वा कृत निश्चयः । तेन साम्ना विनीतेन पन्थानम् अनुयाचितः ॥४-५९-१५॥
translation: 'Since I was looking for food I resolved to seize both of them. (But) he asked me in a gentle and courteous manner to make way (since I was blocking the aerial path).

raw: तस्य च व्यसनाभावाद् व्यसनं च गते त्वयि । धर्मो भवत्यधर्मश्च परस्परविरोधिनौ ॥६-८३-१८॥
translation: " As Ravana has no sorrow and you have experienced agony the contraries of each other have changed the roles of righteousness and unrighteousness."

raw: एवमुक्तो धनुर्भीमं परामृश्य महाबलः । ससर्ज निशितान् बाणानिन्द्रजित् समितिञ्जयः ॥६-८८-१७॥
translation: After Lakshmana had spoken that way, Indrajith, endowed with mighty prowess, and victorious in combat seized a terrific bow and released pointed arrows.

raw: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । अतिकायश्च तेजस्वी बभूवुर्युद्धहर्षिताः ॥६-६९-९॥
translation: Hearing Trisira's words both Devanthaka and Naranthaka and glorious Atikaya became enthusiastic for combat.

raw: त्वत्सत्सकाशाद्धशग्रीवस्संस्कारंविधिपूर्वकम् क्षिप्रमर्हतिधर्मेणत्वंयशोभाग्भविष्यसि ॥६-११४-१०१॥
translation: "Ten headed Ravana being so (knower of righteousness), he deserves your performance of his last rites as per tradition and righteously You will attain fame by doing this deed."

raw: अथ शक्तिं समादाय कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः । चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ॥६-७०-३८॥
translation: In the same manner, Trisira, the son of Ravana sprung up and seized a javelin, just as God of death in dark night and hurled at the son of wind god and shattered.

raw: उवाच देवदेवेशं वरदं प्रपितामहम् । देवानां भयसंमोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ॥७-६९-२२॥
translation: The gods addressed Brahma, the great-grandfather and bestower of boons, regarding the fear and bewilderment among the gods and the impending destruction of the worlds.

raw: तदाचक्ष्व यथा तत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम् । अपि चक्रसहायस्त्वं योत्स्यसे रावणं प्रभो ॥७-२७-१३॥
translation: Indra implores the Lord of gods to reveal truly how He, even with the aid of His discus, intends to fight Ravana.

raw: ते तानि वेश्मानि महाधनानि । दुःखेन दुःखोपहता विशन्तः । नैव प्रजज्ञुः स्वजनम् जनम् वा । निरीक्षमाणाः प्रविणष्टहर्षाः ॥२-४७-१९॥
translation: Those people devoid of delight entered their rich mansions with great difficulty. Even though they, stricken with sorrow, looked at men and their own kinsmen they could not recognise them. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: स चाभिषिक्तः क्षणदाचरैस्तदा निवेशयामास पुरीं दशाननः । निकामपूर्णा च बभूव सा पुरी निशाचरैर्नीलबलाहकोपमैः ॥७-११-५१॥
translation: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.

raw: वृत्र नाशे समभवत् तत् ते भवतु मन्गलम् । यन् मन्गलम् सुपर्णस्य विनता अकल्पयत् पुरा ॥२-२५-३३॥
संगृह्य पादौ पितुः उग्रतेजाजग्राह मातुः पुनर् एव पादौ । पादौ रुमायाः च निपीडयित्वानिवेदयामास ततः तत् अर्थम् ॥४-३१-३७॥
translation: Highly brilliant Angada holding his father's feet first, then mother's and thereafter Ruma's, reported the matter to Sugriva.

raw: चक्रवाकी इव भर्तारम् पृष्टतो अनुगता वनम् । विषमम् दण्डकारण्यम् उद्यान वनम् इव च अंगना ॥४-३०-६४॥
translation: 'Just as a female chakravaka follows the male, Sita followed her husband into this dense Dandaka forest as though it is a pleasuregarden.

raw: धनुषीन्द्रजितस्तुल्यः प्रतापे रावणस्य च । त्वमद्य रक्षसां लोके श्रेष्ठो ऽसि बलवीर्यतः ॥६-७६-७६॥
परिवार्य अभिवर्तन्ते लंकाम् मर्दितुम् ओजसा । भ्रमर आचरिता यत्र सर्व काम फल द्रुमाः ॥६-२७-३४॥
पुण्डरीकावतम्साभिः परिखाभिरलम्कृतम् । प्राकार आवृतम् अत्यन्तम् ददर्श स महा कपिः ॥५-४-२५॥
translation: The great monkey observed the huge archway of the demon king's palace made of gold situated on top of the mountain as if scraping the sky, circled by moats full of white lotuses appearing as though the moats were decorated with earornaments. The whole city was encircled by a boundary wall.

raw: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत । नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥५-३८-२७॥
translation: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.

raw: रामोऽपिदारयेदेषां बाणेनैकेन च द्रुमम् । वालिनं निहतं मन्ये दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम् ॥४-११-७१॥
translation: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.

raw: तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन् । गत्वा चाहं महाध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम् ॥५-५८-४५॥
translation: "Having slained Simhika, I thought of the huge feat that I have done. I remembered the big mission before me and went to the southern shore of the ocean and saw Lanka full of trees.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु वाक्यं काकुत्स्थः सर्वेषां समुदीरितम् । विसर्जयामास तदा वयस्याञ्छत्रुसूदनः ॥७-४३-२३॥
translation: Having heard the words uttered by all, Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 43 ।। Thus ends the forty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: यदि भर्तुः प्रियम् कार्यम् लोकस्य भरतस्य च । वृशम्से पापसम्कल्पे क्षुद्रे दुष्कृतकारिणि ॥२-१२-६०॥
मातरं माम् च सम्पश्यन् वसेमामद्य शर्वरीम् । तर्पितः सर्वकामैस्त्वम् स्वः काले साधयिष्यसि ॥२-३४-३४॥
translation: Stay tonight in the company of your mother and me. With all our desire satisfied, you can set out tomorrow at the appropriate time.

raw: वहन्ति वर्षन्ति नदन्ति भान्तिध्यायन्ति नृत्यन्ति समाश्वसन्ति । नद्यो घना मत्त गजा वन अन्ताःप्रिया विहीनाः शिखिनः प्लवंगाः ॥४-२८-२७॥
translation: 'The clouds are raining. The rivers are flowing. Proud elephants are trumpeting. Those separated from their loved ones are brooding. The monkeys are quiet and the peacocks are dancing.

raw: शुशुभे सुभगः श्रीमान् स्वाती पथ इव अम्बरे । ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः ॥६-२२-७३॥
सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणम् राक्षस अधिपम् । बलम् आलोकयन् सर्वम् शुको वाक्यम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-२८-१॥
translation: Then Ravana the king of Rakshasas having heard Saarana's words and described the strength (of Vanaras) Suka spoke these words.

raw: आरोप्य शिबिकां दीप्तां परार्ध्याम्बरसंवृताम् । रक्षोभिर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः ॥६-११७-१४॥
translation: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

raw: नृशम्सवृत्ते व्यसनप्रहारिणि । प्रसह्य वाक्यम् यदिहाद्य भाषसे । न नाम ते केन मुखात्पतन्त्यधो । विशीर्यमाणा दशना स्सहस्रधा ॥२-१२-१०९॥
translation: O cruelhearted woman, you strike one in adversity. Why are your teeth with which you are now speaking (such harsh words) do not fall to the ground, broken into a thousand fragments?

raw: भगवन्रामपत्नी सा प्रसूता दारकद्वयम् । ततो रक्षां महातेजः कुरु भूतविनाशिनीम् ॥७-६६-३॥
translation: They informed him, "O revered and greatly effulgent one, Rama's wife has given birth to two sons, so please perform the protective rituals that destroy evil spirits."

raw: माणिक्यकृतसोपानाः स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः । फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः ॥७-४२-११॥
translation: The place featured steps crafted from rubies, inner floors paved with crystal, abundant groves of blooming lotuses and water lilies, and was graced by the presence of chakravaka birds.

raw: मनसा अपि दुरारोहम् किम् पुनः कर्मणा जनैः । निविष्टा तत्र शिखरे लन्का रावण पालिता ॥६-३९-२०॥
विभ्राजमानो वपुषा राम वाक्य समाहितः । जगाम सह रामेण किष्किंधाम् पुनराप सः ॥४-१२-४२॥
translation: Radiant Sugriva intent on carrying out Rama's words again went to Kishkinda ruled by Vali. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: त्रिशन्कुर् लोहित अन्गः च बृहस्पति बुधाव् अपि । दारुणाः सोमम् अभ्येत्य ग्रहाः सर्वे व्यवस्थिताः ॥२-४१-११॥
translation: The constellation Trishanku, the planets Mars, Jupiter, Mercury and other fierce planets took their position near the Moon.

raw: सो ऽब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं धृतिमन्तं यशश्विनम् । मां निवेदय रामाय सम्प्राप्तं कार्यगौरवात् ॥७-१०३-२॥
translation: He spoke to the resolute and glorious Lakshmana, saying, "Announce my arrival to Rama, as I have come due to the grave importance of my mission."

raw: राघवैः सह संबंधात् वीर्य श्रेष्ठैः महात्मभिः । श्वः प्रभाते नरेन्द्र त्वम् सम्वर्तयितुम् अर्हसि ॥१-६९-१२॥
ताम् मृत्यु पाश प्रतिमाम् आपतंतीम् महाबलः । विगृह्य रामः कुपितः ततो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-१८-१८॥
translation: Mighty Rama in a rage restrained her who was falling upon Sita like the noose of death, and said to Lakshmana:

raw: निदधे रावणः सीताम् मयो मायाम् इव आसुरीम् । अब्रवीत् च दशग्रीवः पिशाचीः घोर दर्शनाः ॥३-५४-१४॥
क्षत्रियाणाम् तु वीराणाम् वनेषु नियतात्मनाम् । धनुषा कार्यम् एतावत् आर्तानाम् अभिरक्षणम् ॥३-९-२६॥
translation: It is the duty of a kshatriya, a warrior to protect with his bow those who practise selfcontrol (penance) in the forest in a state of panic.

raw: पश्यतां वानरेन्द्राणाम् राघवस्यापि पश्यतः । दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवः सहसोत्थितः ॥६-४०-७॥
translation: Looking at the sight of Raghava seeing Rakshasa king, Sugriva the king of Vanaras got up instantly rashly.

raw: योजनानि महावेगैः कृतानि त्वरितैस्ततः । पञ्चमेन तथा चाह्ना प्लवगैः क्षिप्रकारिभिः ॥६-२२-७०॥
ततो ऽभिषिक्तं शत्रुघ्नमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तेजस्तस्याभिपूरयन् ॥७-६३-१८॥
translation: Then, Rama, having placed the consecrated Shatrughna on his lap, spoke sweet words, thereby enhancing his splendor and might.

raw: हरणं चापि वैदेह्या रावणेन बलीयसा ॥६-१२८-७॥
translation: "O powerful Hanuman! you may tell him of the abduction of Vaidehi by Ravana, my friendship with Sugriva and killing of Vali in combat."

raw: स राजा सुमहान् आसीत् अंशुमान् रघुनंदन । तस्य पुत्रो महान् आसीत् दिलीप इति विश्रुतः ॥१-४२-२॥
translation: O descendnt of the Raghus that Anshuman became a very great monarch. He had a great son, Dilipa who became famous.

raw: इह स्थः अहम् प्रपश्यामि रावणम् जानकीम् तथा । अस्माकम् अपि सौपर्णम् दिव्यम् चक्षुर् बलम् तथा ॥४-५८-३१॥
translation: 'From here I see Ravana and Janaki. We (vultures) have a divine golden vision and great power.

raw: तत्र केचिद्द्रुतं जग्मुरुत्पेतुश्च तथापरे । केचित्किलकिलां चक्रुर्वानरा वनगोचराः ॥६-४-६५॥
translation: Being vanaras some went swiftly, some jumped, and some others made sound 'kila kila'(the usual sounds of monkeys) while they went.

raw: रक्षसां रवतां रावं श्रुत्वा हरिहयानुजः ॥७-७-४१॥
translation: Having heard the roaring sound of the Rākṣasas, Vishnu, the younger brother of Indra, reacted.

raw: अनन्तभोगेन सहस्रमूर्ध्ना । वागेन भीमेन महाबलेन । बलात्परिक्षिप्तमिमम् भवन्तो । राजानमुत्क्षिप्य विमोचयन्तु ॥६-१४-१८॥
translation: "This king is entwined by a fearsome and extremely strong thousand hooded snake endowed with extraordinary energy at present. Lift him up and relieve him."

raw: पुत्रो दशरथस्येष सिम्हसम्हननो युवा । दूषणो निहतो येन खरश्च त्रिशिरास्तथा ॥६-३०-२८॥
translation: "That young one whose build is like a lion is Dasaratha's son who slayed Dushana, even Khara, like wise Trisira."

raw: धृष्टश्च जितकाशीं च नृशंस: पुरुषादक: । अवलिप्तश्च पापश्च त्वां च तात न मृष्यते ॥२-११६-१२॥
translation: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics from Janasthana. He will not tolerate even you.

raw: तमुवाच ततो रामः स्वागतं ते महामुने । प्रापयास्य च वाक्यानि यतो दूतस्त्वमागतः ॥७-१०३-११॥
translation: Then Rama said to him, "Welcome to you, O great sage; please deliver the messages of him from whom you have come as a messenger."

raw: कर्म कुर्वंति विधिवत् याजका वेदपारगाः । यथा विधि यथा न्यायं परिक्रामन्ति शास्त्रतः ॥१-१४-३॥
translation: The chief priests, masters of the Vedas, conducted the rituals in consonance with traditions and scriptures. They officiated in conformity with duties laid down in the Vedas and according to law.

raw: सीता स्नेह प्रवृत्तेन स तु बाष्पेण दूषितः । हा प्रिये इति रुदन् धैर्यम् उत्सृज्य न्यपतत् क्षितौ ॥४-६-१७॥
translation: On account of his deep attachment for Sita, he shed profuse tears. Unable to maintain his natural composure, he sank down to the ground, saying 'O my darling Sita' and cried inconsolably

raw: राक्षसस्त्वं मया जातः पुत्ररूपो दुरासदः । प्रतिहंसि ममाज्ञां यत् प्रजार्थे विफलो भव ॥७-५९-१४॥
translation: You are a wicked demon born by me in the form of a son, because you reject my command, you shall become fruitless in terms of progeny.

raw: शिला पिधाना काकुत्स्थ दुःखम् च अस्याः प्रवेशनम् । तस्या गुहायाः प्राक् द्वारे महान् शीत उदको ह्रदः ॥३-७३-४०॥
कामं न त्वं समाधेयः पुरन्दररथोचितः । युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रः स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये ॥६-१०८-१२॥
translation: "You are a driver of great Indra's chariot. You are not required to be told. Wishing to fight with rapt attention, I will remind you now and then not instruct you", said Rama to Matali."

raw: स भग्नबाहूरुभुजो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः । मुमोह सहसा वीरो मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-६२-२८॥
translation: The heroic Dadhimukha, an elephant among monkeys, with his shoulders and arms broken, and body drenched in blood lost his consciousness instantly.

raw: नाम्ना च इयम् भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक् प्रदक्षिणा । प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूर कर्मभिः ॥३-११-८४॥
translation: The southern side favourable to the people was famous by the name Agastya in the three worlds and stood unassailable to the demons.

raw: तस्य ज्या विप्रमुक्ताः ते शराः कांचन भूषणाः । शरीरम् विधमिष्यन्ति गंगा कूलम् इव ऊर्मयः ॥३-५६-७॥
translation: The goldtipped arrows released from his bowstring will shatter your body like the waves erode the banks of river Ganga.

raw: राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसन्तापकर्शिता । मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा । अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम् ॥५-५९-२६॥
translation: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.

raw: रावणाद् विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया । कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता ॥५-५९-३२॥
हरि चन्दन सम्पृक्तम् उदकम् कान्चनैः घटैः । आनिन्युः स्नान शिक्षा आज्ञा यथा कालम् यथा विधि ॥२-६५-८॥
translation: The bathattendants brought water mixed with yellow sandal paste in golden vessels at appropriate times in accordance with tradition.

raw: अश्मवर्षेण महता भृत्यास्ते विनिपातिताः । त्वं चाश्रमपदे सुप्तो वातवर्षभयार्दितः ॥७-८९-१३॥
translation: Your servants were killed by a great shower of stones, and you were sleeping in the hermitage, afflicted by the fear of wind and rain.

raw: एतेन चात्यद्भुतदर्शनानि शरैर्जनस्थानकृतालयानि । चतुर्दशान्यात्तवरायुधानि रक्षस्सहस्राणि निषूदितानि ॥६-५९-१३३॥
translation: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."

raw: मयेयमसहायेन चरता कामरूपिणा । दक्षिणा दिगनुक्रान्ता त्वन्मार्गविचयैषिणा ॥५-३५-७६॥
translation: "I can assume any form at my will. I searched for you without any help moving in the southern direction and reached this place .

raw: अथवा मृग शाव अक्षी वनस्य अस्य विचक्षणा । वनम् एष्यति सा च इह राम चिन्ता अनुकर्शिता ॥५-१४-४६॥
translation: "Or may be that doeeyed noble lady brooding over Rama will come to this garden she is familiar with.

raw: वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः । शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्यो ऽपि लघुत्वमगमत् कपेः ॥६-५९-११९॥
translation: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.

raw: भ्रातुरर्थे महाबाहो कुरु कर्म सुदुष्करम् । मयैवं नोक्तपूर्वो हि कच्चिद् भ्रातः परन्तप ॥६-६२-२०॥
translation: "O broad shouldered brother! Do this task which is difficult for others. O Scourge of enemies! I have not asked you before for such a task."

raw: कच्चित् ते कुशलम् राजन् कच्चित् धर्मेण रंजयन् । प्रजाः पालयसे राजन् राज वृत्तेन धार्मिक ॥१-५२-७॥
translation: "O King, is it all well with you? O righteous one O heroic one are you ruling (your subjects) in accordance with the duties enjoined upon the king? Do you rule them in conformity with the code of moralit in order to make them happy.

raw: ते द्रुमांश्च महावीर्या गिरिशृङ्गाणि चोद्यताः । क्षिपन्तीन्द्रजितः सङ्ख्ये वानरा भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-८२-१४॥
अग्निम् कुशान् काष्ठम् अपः फलम् मूलम् तथैव च । न्यवेदयत् सहस्राक्षो यच् च अन्यत् अपि कान्क्षितम् ॥१-४६-१०॥
translation: The thousandeyed Indra served her by providing fire, Kusha grass, sticks for burning, water, fruits, roots and all other things desired by her.

raw: पुष्प ओघैः समभिच्छन्नाम् पद्म मालाभिः एव च । तरुण आदित्य वर्णाभिः भ्राजमानभिः आवृताम् ॥४-२५-२६॥
translation: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

raw: अरजा ऽपि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः । प्रतीक्षन्ति सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसन्निभम् ॥७-८०-१८॥
translation: Arajā, greatly terrified and weeping, waited for her god-like father not far from the hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 80 ।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: केवलम् हि सहाया मे हनुमत् प्रमुखास्त्विमे । अतः अहम् धारयामि अद्य प्राणान् कृच्छ्र गतः अपि सन् ॥४-८-३६॥
translation: 'Only Hanuman and other chiefs are helping me. Therefore, I am surviving in spite of all difficulties.

raw: बुद्द्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यो वीर्येणापि शचीपतेः । तथा सर्वप्रजाकान्तैः प्रीतिसंजननैः पितुः ॥२-१-३२॥
ते सर्वे वानरा हृष्टा राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः । यथासुखमसम्बाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन् ॥६-१२५-२९॥
नूनं ममैव शोकेन स वीरो लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । देवलोकमितो यातस्त्यक्त्वा देहं महीतले ॥५-२४-३८॥
शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम् । ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे ॥२-६-३॥
translation: The son of the king (Rama) partook the remainder of the havis seeking his own welfare. With a restrained mind and a vow of silence, he meditated upon Lord Narayana and slept along with Vaidehi on a wellspread bed of kusha grass in the auspicious temple of lord Visnu.

raw: यावन्मातरमाप्नच्छे सीतां चानुनयाम्यहम् । ततोऽद्यैव गमिष्यामि दण्डकानां महद्वनम् ॥२-१९-२५॥
translation: After taking leave of my mother and consoling Sita, today itself I shall go to that wild Dandaka forest.

raw: आर्य्यं तात: परित्यज्य कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् । गत: स्वर्गं महाबाहु: पुत्रशोकाभिपीडित: ॥२-१०४-५॥
translation: O my revered sire our mighty father, having performed an impossible task of banishing you to the forest, and tortured by grief due to separation from his son, went to heaven.

raw: न रावणो नाइबलस्त्रीशीर्षो । न कुम्भकर्णस्य सुतो निकुभः । न चेन्द्रजिद्दाशरथिम् प्रसोढुम् । त्वम् वा रणे शक्रसमम् समर्थः ॥६-१४-१५॥
translation: "Either Ravana or exceptionally strong Trisirsha, or even Nikumbha son of Kumbahakarna, or Indrajith are not capable of opposing Rama who is equal to Indra in war. How can you?"

raw: तत् आज्ञापय कः किम् ते कुतो वा अपि व्यवस्यतु । हरयो हि अप्रधृष्याः ते सन्ति कोटि अग्रतो अनघ ॥४-२९-२७॥
translation: O sinless hero therefore issue your command. There are more than a crore of invincible monkeys. Determine now who should do and what and in which place. We are at your service'.

raw: कुम्भकर्णबलाभिज्ञो जानंस्तस्य पराक्रमम् । बभूव मुदितो राजा शशाङ्क इव निर्मलः ॥६-६५-१६॥
translation: The king who knew the valour and mighty strength of Kumbhakarna remained happy like the moon.

raw: प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्स्थे महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः । अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम् ॥६-१२३-१॥
translation: Mahendra, the tamer of demon Paka, spoke very affectionately to Rama, who stood with joined palms before Dasharatha who had returned.

raw: द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां सङ्गृह्य भ्रामयित्वा च वेगवान् । महापार्श्वस्य चिक्षेप वधार्थं वालिनः सुतः ॥६-९९-१४॥
translation: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

raw: यावदावर्ततेचक्रंयावती च वसुन्धरा । तावत्त्वमिहलोकस्यस्वामित्वमनुवर्तय ॥६-१३१-११॥
translation: As long as the stellar sphere goes round, and as long as the earth revolves around that long you enjoy the rulership of the world."

raw: मया त्वम् समनुज्ञातो गच्छ लोकान् अनुत्तमान् । गृध्र राज महा सत्त्व संस्कृतः च मया व्रज ॥३-६८-३०॥
translation: O mighty lord of the birds by my grace attain the state of those who perform sacrifices, who kindle and maintain sacrificial fires, who beat no retreat from the battlefield and who offer land in charity. Purified by my offering of fire, you may depart for the best of the worlds.

raw: भगीरथः तु राजर्षिः धार्मिको रघुनंदन । अनपत्यो महारजाः प्रजा कामः स च प्रजाः ॥१-४२-११॥
translation: O delight of the Raghus righteous Bhagiratha who was highly lustrous rajarshi was without sons. He was desirous of progeny but did not beget children.

raw: सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमतः । न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः ॥७-३५-१५॥
translation: O best of Raghus, what you say about Hanuman is true: there is no one equal to him in strength, speed, or intellect.

raw: किमागमनकार्यं वः किं करोमि समाहितः । आज्ञाप्यो ऽहं महर्षीणां सर्वकामकरः सुखम् ॥७-६०-१३॥
translation: He asked what the purpose of their visit was and what he could do for them attentively, declaring himself to be at the command of the great sages, ready to fulfill all their desires easily.

raw: कौसल्या अपि तदा देवी रात्रिम् स्थित्वा समाहिता । प्रभाते तु अकरोत् पूजाम् विष्णोह् पुत्र हित एषिणी ॥२-२०-१४॥
translation: Having spent the night with a composed mind (abosorbed in meditation), Kausalya was worshipping lord Visnu in the early morning to secure her son's welfare.

raw: तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तीं रसातलम् । पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत् ॥७-९७-२१॥
translation: As Sita, seated on the throne, was seen entering the netherworld, an uninterrupted divine shower of flowers fell upon her.

raw: त्वय्येतत्पुरुषव्याघ्र युक्तं राघववंशजे । गुरुवृत्तिर्दमश्चैव साधूनां चानुयायिता ॥२-९०-२०॥
translation: O best of men (Bharata) your conduct towards the preceptors, your selfrestraint and devotion to the virtuous are all in keeping with those born in the race of Raghu.

raw: ते कृताञ्जलयः सर्वे रथस्थम् पृथिवीस्थिताः । राक्ष्सा राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् शिरोभिस्तम् ववन्दिरे ॥६-११-१३॥
translation: Standing on the ground, all the Rakshasas bowing their heads down and with folded palms offered their salutations to the foremost of the Rakshasas seated in the chariot.

raw: उपपन्नं मनोज्ञं च वचनं तव मैथिलि । प्रीता चास्म्युचितं किं ते करवाणि ब्रवीहि मे ॥२-११८-१५॥
translation: O Sita, I am glad to hear your befitting and pleasing words. Tell me what appropriate thing you desire and I shall give you.

raw: स हि देशो दुरन्वेष्यो गुहा गहनवान् महान् । तत्र वायु सुतः सर्वम् विचिनोति स्म पर्वतम् ॥४-५०-४॥
translation: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, searched all over the mountains and caves and woods difficult to access in that southwestern region of the mountain.

raw: अनुशिष्टा अस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविध आश्रयम् । न अस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यम् यथा मया ॥२-२७-९॥
translation: I have been so instructed by my parents about diverse duties in all stages of life that I need not be told anything (about my duties) now.

raw: निमित्तानि च घोराणि दृश्यन्ते अद्य बहूनि च । इति एवम् चिंतयन् रामः श्रुत्वा गोमायु निःस्वनम् ॥३-५७-१०॥
राज्ञो विलपमानस्य न व्यभासत शर्वरी । तथैव उष्णम् विनिह्श्वस्य वृद्धो दशरथो नृपः ॥२-१३-१६॥
प्रतिलोम अनुलोमाः च रुचिरा रोम राजयः । शोभन्ते मृगम् आश्रित्य चित्राः कनक बिन्दुभिः ॥३-४३-२७॥
translation: The stretches of hair on the deer's body bent both in the natural order and in the opposite direction look beautiful. The spots of gold on the skin are wonderful.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवङ्गमः । गृहीतप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ॥६-११६-२२॥
translation: Spoken in that way by Vaidehi, Hanuman stood with folded palms in front of Sita and replied in delight.

raw: सुमन्त्रम् अभियान्तम् तम् शतशो अथ सहस्रशः । क्व रामैति पृच्चन्तः सूतम् अभ्यद्रवन् नराः ॥२-५७-९॥
translation: Meanwhile as the charioteer was moving towards the city, hundreds and thousands of men came pouring towards him enquiring, 'Where is Rama?'

raw: पावकात्मजमालोक्य ध्वजाग्रे समुपस्थितम् । जज्वाल रावणः क्रोधात्ततो नीलो ननाद च ॥६-५९-७९॥
translation: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.

raw: इति शीघ्रं ततो गत्वा वानरास्ते महाबलाः । आगतास्तज्जलं गृह्य समुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः ॥६-११५-१३॥
translation: Then the foremost of the Vanaras, endowed with the speed of mind, with all speed went and got water from the ocean.

raw: सीता हि विमला साध्वी तव पूर्वपरायणा । नागलोकं सुखं प्रायात्त्वदाश्रयतपोबलात् ॥७-९८-१४॥
translation: Indeed, Sita, pure, virtuous, and solely devoted to you from the beginning, happily went to the Naga world by the power of her penance and devotion to you.

raw: जटायुषो वधं श्रुत्वा दुःखितः सो ऽरुणात्मजः । त्वां शशंस वरारोहे वसन्तीं रावणालये ॥५-३५-६६॥
translation: "Having heard about the death of Jatayu, O charming lady that Sampati Aruna's son felt sad and told us that you are at Ravana's palace.

raw: न बलम् क्षत्रियस्य आहुः ब्राह्मणो बलवत्तरः । ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्म बलम् दिव्यम् क्षत्रात् तु बलवत्तरम् ॥१-५४-१४॥
translation: "O Best of brahmins it is held that the strength of a kshatriya is no greater than a brahmin's. A brahmin possesses great strength his strength is divine. It is greater than that of a kshatriya.

raw: हस्त प्राप्तम् अहम् मन्ये स्वर्गम् तव नरेश्वर । यः त्वम् कौशिकम् आगम्य शरण्यम् शरणागतः ॥१-५९-५॥
translation: O King since you have taken refuge in Viswamitra who is the protector of those who resort to him, I think heaven is already within your reach".

raw: तस्मात्त्वमपि चात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर । तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः ॥२-३-४६॥
ततो विष्णुं महाबाहुं प्रपतन्तं रणाजिरे । हृते सुमालेरश्वैश्च रथे विष्णुरथं प्रति ॥७-७-३१॥
translation: Then, as Vishnu's chariot was carried away by Sumali's horses, the mighty-armed Vishnu was seen falling down in the battlefield.

raw: शशबिन्दुश्च राजर्षिर्बाह्लिं पुरपुरञ्जयः । प्रतिष्ठाने इलो राजा प्रजापतिसुतो बली ॥७-९०-२२॥
translation: The royal sage Shashabindu, a conqueror of cities, ruled Bahli, while the powerful King Ila, son of Prajapati, ruled in Pratishthana.

raw: यथान्ये विविधै रोगै; पीड्यन्ते प्राणिनो मया । ते न ते प्रभविष्यन्ति मयि प्रीते न संशयः ॥७-१८-२७॥
translation: Just as other living beings are tormented by various diseases through me, those diseases will not affect you when I am pleased, of this there is no doubt.

raw: स सुहृद् यो विपन्नार्थं दीनमभ्यवपद्यते । स बन्धुर्यो ऽपनीतेषु साहाय्यायोपकल्पते ॥६-६३-२७॥
translation: " A friend is one who helps when one's fortune is lost and is desperate. Deviating from morals the one who is prepared to help is a relation."

raw: कैकेय्याम् मुक्त लज्जायाम् वदन्त्याम् अतिदारुणम् । राजा दशरथो वाक्यम् उवाच आयत लोचनाम् ॥२-३६-१३॥
translation: King Dasaratha heard the terribly cruel and shameless words of that largeeyed Kaikeyi, and said:

raw: अनन्यहृदयां भक्तां मच्चित्तपरिवर्तिनीम् । अहमप्यवगच्छामि मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम् ॥६-१२१-१६॥
translation: "I also know that Mythili is ever coming around me with undivided love and is devoted to me."

raw: अर्चितम् सर्व लोकस्य सपताकम् सवेदिकम् । नाग हेतोः सुपर्णेन चैत्यम् उन्मथितम् यथा ॥४-१९-२४॥
translation: Vali looked like a chaitya (a tree of worship) having a banner and altar and reverentially worshipped by the entire world, but destroyed by Garuda on account of a serpent (hidden in it). (Here Rama is Garuda, Sugriva, serpent and Vali a sacred Chaitya)

raw: अथ वा न्यस्तशस्त्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशनौ । भ्रातरौ हि नर श्रेष्ठौ चरन्तौ वनगोचरौ ॥५-२४-४४॥
ततः प्राप्तम् ऋषिम् ज्ञात्वा तानि सत्त्वानि वै ययुः । प्रविष्टे राजनि यथा सर्वम् स अमात्यकम् बलम् ॥४-६०-१६॥
translation: 'Just as the army including feudatories recede, when the king comes, all those creatures repaired to their dens when they knew the arrival of the sage at the hermitage.

raw: आर्तस्य अथ बिला द्वारि स्थितः संवत्सरम् नृप । दृष्ट्वा च शोणितम् द्वारि बिलात् च अपि समुत्थितम् ॥४-१०-४॥
translation: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

raw: मुमोच तम् शरम् दीप्तम् परम् सागरदर्शनात् । तेन तन्मरुकान्तारम् पृथिव्याम् किल विश्रुतम् ॥६-२२-३५॥
तत् अस्त्रम् तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्ग मार्ग प्रभावनम् । राम बाणासन क्षिप्तम् आवहत् परमाम् गतिम् ॥४-१७-८॥
translation: Rama's arrow released paved the way to heaven which was that hero's supreme destination.

raw: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता धर्मे व्यवस्थिता । अब्रवीत् परमप्रीता हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ॥६-११६-१७॥
translation: When Hanuman spoke in that way virtuous Sita was overwhelmed with joy and spoke with a voice choked with tears.

raw: न हीदृशं भयं किञ्चित्कुलस्त्रीणामिहोच्यते । भयानामपि सर्वेषां वैधव्यं व्यसनं महत् ॥७-२५-४२॥
translation: Indeed, no such fear is spoken of for noble women in this world, for among all fears, widowhood is the greatest calamity.

raw: जानामि वारुणान् लोकान् विष्णोः त्रैविक्रमान् अपि । देव असुर विमर्दाम् च हि अमृतस्य च मंथनम् ॥४-५८-१३॥
translation: 'I know Varuna's worlds(seas and oceans) and all the three worlds measured by three strides by Vamana. Indeed I also know about the friction between the great gods and demons and the churning of the ocean for nectar.

raw: महेन्द्राय पुनः प्रादात् नियम्य बलिम् ओजसा । त्रैलोक्यम् स महातेजाः चक्रे शक्र वशम् पुनः ॥१-२९-२१॥
translation: Thereafter, Visnu, soul of the universe who restores respect (for the righeous), and renders the welfare of all living beings, having begged from Bali, and been granted three places to put his footsteps on occupied the (three) worlds and by restraining Bali with his energy, gave (it) back to Mahendra. In this manner the highly lustrous Visnu, gave possession of the three worlds to Mahendra.

raw: अप्रमत्तः बले कोशे दुर्गे जन पदे तथा । भवेथा गुह राज्यम् हि दुरारक्षतमम् मतम् ॥२-५२-७२॥
translation: O Guha you must be vigilant about your army, treasury, forts and provinces. A kingdom, it is (rightly) said, is protected with great difficulty.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली भर्तृदेवता । भर्तृभक्तिव्रता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत ॥६-११७-१२॥
translation: Noble Mythili (on hearing Vibheeshana), who looked upon her husband as God, said in reply, 'Alright'.

raw: अत्र दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः । तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि रावणो निहतो मया कुम्भकर्णो ऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः । धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता ॥६-१२६-५॥
स दूरे च आश्रमम् गत्वा ताटकेयम् उपागतम् । मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा भक्ष्य भोज्यैः अमानुषैः ॥३-३१-३६॥
translation: Ravana reached the hermitage of Maricha and met him who was the son of Tataka. The demon king was treated with food that can be chewed and food that can be eaten.

raw: त्यक्तधर्मव्रतंशूरंनृशंसमनृतंतथा नाहमर्होऽस्मिसंस्कर्तुंपरदाराभिमर्शिनम् ॥६-११४-९३॥
translation: "This Ravana had given up righteous conduct, was cruel, merciless, untrue, and had laid hands on others' wives. I do not deserve to perform obsequies to him.

raw: कुरुष्व मे प्रियहितमेतदुत्तमं यथाप्रियं प्रियरणबान्धवप्रिय । स्वतेजसा विधम सपत्नवाहिनीं शरद्घनं पवन इवोद्यतो महान् ॥६-६२-२३॥
translation: "You are a lover of wars. You are a lover of relations. You are always my dear well wisher. O self glorious one! Do this task of throwing out the torrent army just like wind throws rainy clouds." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: शोकस्सम्धार्यताम् मातर्हृदये साधु मा शुचः । वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः ॥२-२१-४७॥
translation: Do not grieve, O mother Be prudent enough to subdue your sorrow in your heart. Having fulfilled father's words, I shall come back from my sojourn in the forest.

raw: राज्येन नास्ति मे कार्यं किं करिष्यामि सीतया । कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य जीविते नास्ति मे रतिः ॥६-६८-१७॥
translation: "I have no purpose with the kingdom. What will I do with Sita? I have lost my life and mind with Kumbhakarna's death."

raw: न द्वेष्टा विद्यते तस्य स तु द्वेष्टि न कंचन । स तु सर्वेषु भूतेषु पितामह इव अपरः ॥४-४-७॥
translation: 'He never hated any one nor did any one ever hate him. To all his subjects, he was like another father, the Creator Brahma. And he was generous in giving gifts while performing yajnas (rituals with fire) like Agnistoma.

raw: पश्यन्ती सिद्धयात्रम् त्वाम् पित्र्यम् राज्यमुपस्थितम् । सर्वसीमन्तिनीभ्यश्च सीताम् सीमन्तिनीम् वराम् ॥२-१६-४०॥
असौ हि राक्षसः शेते शरेण अभिहतो मया । मृग रूपेण येन अहम् आश्रमात् अपवाहितः ॥३-५९-२५॥
translation: This demon who misled me in the guise of a deer and took me away from the hermitage, lies dead, killed by my arrow.

raw: कोकिलाकुल सीमान्तः दयिताया मम अनघः । मन्मध आयास संभूतो वसन्त गुण वर्धितः ॥४-१-३२॥
बभूव राघवस्य अपि मनो विस्मयम् आगतम् । एवम् सीता वचः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च मृगम् अद्भुतम् ॥३-४३-२३॥
तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः । कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेषं प्रचक्रमे ॥७-८६-१॥
translation: Then, Lakshmana, the best among men, having completely narrated the entire story of Vritra's slaying, proceeded to tell the rest of the tale.

raw: तत्र त्वम् चैव मे न अस्ति रामः च वनम् आश्रितः । न वनम् गन्तुम् इच्चामि सर्वथा हि हता त्वया ॥२-६१-२५॥
स हविर्लाजसंस्कारैर्माल्यगन्धपुरस्कृतैः । जुहुवे पावकं तत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-७३-१८॥
translation: The heroic Rakshasa king worshipped according to tradition with flowers and fragrance followed by parched grain and fire god.

raw: ते मुक्तकेशाः सम्भ्रान्ता भग्नमानाः पराजिताः । स्रवच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैः श्वसन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-५६-३३॥
translation: Perplexed, broken hearted, defeated, hair loosened the Rakshasas sweating all over their limbs, sighing heavily ran away very fast.

raw: सा वेपमाना पतिता प्रवाते कदली यथा । राक्षसीनां भयत्रस्ता विवर्णवदना ऽभवत् ॥५-२५-८॥
translation: Trembling like a banana tree uprooted by the stormy wind, Sita who was seized with fear of the ogresses looked pale and desperate.

raw: ददौ खड्गं महादीप्तं चन्द्रहासमिति श्रुतम् । आयुषश्चावशेषं च स्थित्वा भूतपतिस्तदा ॥७-१६-४५॥
translation: Then, Lord Shiva, the lord of beings, granted him the greatly radiant sword known as Chandrahāsa, and also the remainder of his life.

raw: तस्याग्रे तु विशाला सा महेन्द्रस्य पुरी यथा । लङ्का नाम पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा ॥७-३-२६॥
translation: On the top of that mountain, there is a vast and beautiful city named Lanka, constructed by Vishwakarma, resembling the city of Mahendra (Indra).

raw: मातामहस्य यो भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः । माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धः प्राज्ञो निशाचरः ॥७-२५-२२॥
translation: Malyavan, the elder brother of Sumali, who is our maternal grandfather's brother, is a renowned, old, and wise Rakshasa.

raw: ततः ते ददृशुः घोरम् सागरम् वरुण आलयम् । अपारम् अभिगर्जन्तम् घोरैः ऊर्मिभिः आकुलम् ॥४-५३-१॥
ततस्तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं यशस्विनमरिन्दमम् । आसीनं स्थण्डिले रामं ददर्श सहसा जन: ॥२-१०२-४५॥
translation: All at once the people saw the illustrious Rama, the best of men, and the subduer of enemies squatting on the bare earth.

raw: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चिता ऽपि न शोभते । घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः ॥५-३०-३८॥
translation: "Swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity is not proper. Messengers who assume that they are scholars (blinded by ego) destroy their mission.

raw: आससाद विशालाक्षी गङ्गां पापविनाशिनीम् । अथार्धदिवसं गत्वा भागीरथ्या जलाशयम् ॥७-४६-२३॥
translation: After traveling for half a day, the wide-eyed Sita reached the sacred waters of the Ganga, the destroyer of sins.

raw: राक्षसानां निवासार्थं यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती । तत्र त्वं वस भद्रं ते लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः ॥७-३-२७॥
translation: That city is meant for the residence of Rakshasas, just as Amaravati is for Indra; you should dwell there in Lanka, and there is no doubt that it will bring you good fortune.

raw: प्रासादैश् च विमानैश् च लन्का परम भूषिता । घनैर् इव आतप अपाये मध्यमम् वैष्णवम् पदम् ॥६-३९-२२॥
translation: The tall buildings decorated beautifully resembled air planes and were shining like heavy rainy clouds exposed to the sun. The building in the centre resembled the abode of Vishnu.

raw: किं करिष्याम्ययोध्यायां ताते दिष्टां गतिं गते । कस्तां राजवराद्धीनामयोध्यां पालयिष्यति ॥२-१०२-८॥
translation: What shall I do in Ayodhya now that my father has followed the path ordained by the gods? Who will rule that Ayodhya deprived of that best of kings?

raw: नृत्तेन च अपराः क्लान्ताः पान विप्रहताः तथा । मुरजेषु मृदन्गेषु पीठिकासु च सम्स्थिताः ॥५-११-५॥
कारण्डैस्सारसैर्हम्सैर्वञ्जुलैर्जलकुक्कुटैः । चक्रवाकैस्थाचान्यैश्शकुनैर्प्रतिनादितान् । यद्वा -कारण्डैः सारसैः हंसैः वंजुलैः जल कुक्कुटैः । चक्रवाकैः तथा च अन्यैः शकुनैः प्रतिनादितान् ॥४-१३-८॥
भक्षयंतम् महा घोरान् ऋक्ष सिम्ह मृग द्विपान् । घोरौ भुजौ विकुर्वाणम् उभौ योजनम् आयतौ ॥३-६९-३१॥
translation: The terrific demon kept eating bears, lions, deer and elephants, catching with both his arms stretching up to one yojana.

raw: सर्वथा तु लघुत्वम् ते कत्थनेन विदर्शितम् । सुवर्ण प्रतिरूपेण तप्तेन इव कुश अग्निना ॥३-२९-२०॥
translation: All your meanness is exhibited by your boasting just as the kusa grass caught by fire appears like gold.

raw: सह रामेण निर्यातः विना रामम् इह आगतः । सूतः किम् नाम कौसल्याम् शोचन्तीम् प्रति वक्ष्यति ॥२-५७-२१॥
translation: The charioteer left with Rama and returned without him. What can he say to the wailing Kausalya?

raw: गवयःपश्चिमात्तोयमाजहारमहार्णवात् । रत्नकुम्भेनमहताशीतंमारुतविक्रमः ॥६-१३१-५६॥
translation: Gavaya, an expert like WindGod brought cold water from the abode of Varuna in the west, in a pot encrusted with gems.

raw: शुभं पुनर्हेमसमानवर्णमीषद्रजोध्वस्तमिवामलाक्ष्याः । वासः स्थितायाः शिखराग्रदत्याः किंचित् परिस्रंसत चारुगात्र्याः ॥५-२९-५॥
translation: Her eyes were pristine, teeth wellshaped. The goldhued auspicious sari on her charming limbs was now a little soiled on account of dust. It slipped slightly as she stood up. This augured well for her.

raw: अथ घोषः सुतुमुलो हरीणां समजायत । वृक्षानारुजतां चैव गुर्वीरागृह्णतां शिलाः ॥६-५७-४३॥
translation: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.

raw: भूतान्याकाशचारीणी तमूचुः प्लवगोत्तमम् । भीममद्य कृतं कर्म महत्सत्त्वं त्वया हतम् ॥५-१-१९७॥
स तं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति । ततस्तं वायसं दर्भः सो ऽम्बरे ऽनुजगाम ह ॥५-३८-३१॥
translation: 'Then you threw the burning darbha grass at the crow and it chased him in the sky.

raw: न ब्राह्मण धनम् किम्चिद्द् हृतम् रामेण कस्यचित् । कश्चिन् न आढ्यो दरिद्रः वा तेन अपापो विहिम्सितः ॥२-७२-४८॥
translation: Rama did not rob any brahmin of even a little wealth nor did he harm any innocent man, whether rich or poor. He never casts his eyes on another's wife.

raw: रामस्य अस्य महाघोरम् पुनः तेषाम् च रक्षसाम् । ते समन्तात् अभिक्रुद्धा राघवम् पुनर् आर्दयन् ॥३-२५-३५॥
प्रीतश्चास्मि महाबाहो शासनस्य प्रतिग्रहात् । त्वां चाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि प्रीतियुक्तो नराधिपम् ॥७-५९-१२॥
translation: O mighty-armed one, I am pleased by your acceptance of my command, and I will affectionately anoint you as the king of men.

raw: पितुः समीपं गच्छन्तं प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् । स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुङ्गवः ॥२-३-३१॥
अग्निहोत्रमिवाभाति सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् । दशग्रीववशं प्राप्तास्तास्तु शोकाकुलाः स्त्रियः ॥७-२४-१०॥
translation: Those women, having fallen under the sway of Daśagrīva, appeared like an Agnihotra ritual whose fire and flowers have been extinguished, overwhelmed by sorrow.

raw: विनेदुश्च महानादान् सर्वतो जलदोपमाः । हतो राम इति ज्ञात्वा रावणिं समपूजयन् ॥६-४६-२७॥
translation: The Rakshasas thundering like rain clouds, roaring aloud thinking 'Rama is killed' by Ravana's son offered prayers.

raw: सुख दुह्खे भय क्रोधौ लाभ अलाभौ भव अभवौ । यस्य किम्चित् तथा भूतम् ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत् ॥२-२२-२२॥
translation: Happiness or misery, fear or anger, gain or loss, birth or death, and all such things are surely the acts of destiny.

raw: राजधर्मविरुद्धं च लोकवृत्तेश्च गर्हितम् । तव चासदृशं वीर कपेरस्य प्रमापणम् ॥५-५२-६॥
translation: "Mighty king killing this Hanuman is contrary to righteousness of kings. This is deplorable diplomacy and also unbecoming of you.

raw: गृध्रौ द्वौ दृष्ट पूर्वौ मे मातरिश्व समौ जवे । गृध्राणाम् चैव राजानौ भ्रातरौ काम रूपिणौ ॥४-६०-१९॥
translation: 'You are the king among vultures equal to wind in speed.I had seen both the brothers earlier and both of you could change your form at will.

raw: ततस्प भयसम्विग्न स्तदा राज्ञाभिचोदितः । वचनम् प्रत्युवाचेदम् राक्षसाधिपमुत्तमम् ॥६-२४-२७॥
translation: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."

raw: येनाहं सहसा स्पृष्टश्शोणितेन दुरात्मना । कोऽयं दुरात्मा दुर्भुदि्घरकृतात्मा च बालिशः ॥४-११-५०॥
translation: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?

raw: रावणम् सगणम् हत्वा परितोष्य आत्म पौरुषम् । तथा अस्मि कर्ता नचिराद् यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि ॥४-७-४॥
translation: 'With all my capability I will kill Ravana and his clan. Thus I will be able to satisfy you soon with my efforts.

raw: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम् । असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान् ॥४-११-८४॥
translation: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

raw: इदम् वचो बन्धु हित अर्थिना मयायथा उच्यमानम् यदि न अभिपत्स्यसे । स बान्धवः त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितम् रणेहतो अद्य रामेण शरैः जिह्मगैः ॥३-३९-२५॥
translation: If you do not follow my advice given for the welfare of our kith and kin, O Ravana, you are killed today. With your relations you will succumb to his straightmoving arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: शोषणम् दारणम् चैव वज्रम् अस्त्रम् सुदुर्जयम् । ब्रह्म पाशम् काल पाशम् वारुणम् पाशम् एव च ॥१-५६-८॥
translation: "O Descendent of Raghu Viswamitra employed weapons like manava, mohana, gandharva, swapana, jrimbhana, madana, santapana, vilapana, shoshana, darana, vajra weapons, Brahma, kala and varuna pasas, the favourite painaka, daita, shushka, ardra vajras, danda, paisacha, krauncha, weapons, dharmachakra, kalachakra, vishnuchakras, vayavya, mathana, hayasira weapons, kanakala, musala powers, vaidyadhara, kalatrishula, kapala, kankana weapons discharged against Vasishta the best of ascetics. All this became aweful.

raw: गणिकाः तत्र गच्छन्तु रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः । प्रलोभ्य विविध उपायैः आनेष्यन्ति इह सत्कृताः ॥१-१०-५॥
translation: Beautiful and welladorned courtesans, may be sent there. They will allure him by various means and honourably bring him here.

raw: भासकर्णश्च संक्रुद्धः शूलमादाय वीर्यवान् । एकतः कपिशार्दूलं यशस्विनमवस्थितम् ॥५-४६-३२॥
लोकम् सुवृष्ट्या परितोषयित्वनदीः तटाकानि च पूरयित्वा । निष्पन्न सस्याम् वसुधाम् च कृत्वात्यक्त्वा नभः तोय धराः प्रणष्टाः ॥४-३०-५६॥
translation: 'Having showered heavy rains, and filling tanks and rivers, and producing bumper crops on the earth the clouds have disapeared.

raw: त्वन्निमित्तमनेनाहं बहुमानात्प्रचोदितः । योजनानां शतं चापि कपिरेष समाप्लुतः ॥५-१-११५॥
translation: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.

raw: तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणः सुतम् । व्यादिदेश सुसंक्रुद्धो बलिनं युद्धदुर्मदम् ॥५-५८-१२५॥
translation: "When Aksha was done to death, the tenfaced Ravana was enraged and gave instruction to the second son, called Indrajit who was thirsting for war.

raw: सुतीक्ष्णेन उपदिष्टेन गत्वा तेन पथा सुखम् । इदम् परम संहृष्टो वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-११-४६॥
translation: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the way, and following the directions given by Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said to Lakshmana:

raw: उत्तरन्त्यां च सेनायां स्सततं बहुयोजनम् । नदीस्रोतांसि सर्वाणि सस्यन्दुर्विपरीतवत् ॥६-४-६०॥
translation: When the army was continuously crossing the river, later (after they crossed) the water flowed excessively like flood.

raw: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य लङ्का वसति निर्भया । तनयं धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमं विदुः ॥६-७१-३०॥
translation: "He is known as Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini. Lanka remains fearless on his shoulders, you may know."

raw: यथा न एनाम् पुमान् स्त्री वा सीताम् पश्यति असम्मतः । मुक्ता मणि सुवर्णानि वस्त्राणि आभरणानि च ॥३-५४-१५॥
विशुद्धभावस्य सुदुष्टभावा ताम्रेक्षणस्याश्रुकलस्य राज्ञः । श्रुत्वा विचित्रं करुणं विलापं भर्तुर्नृशंसा न चकार वाक्यम् ॥२-१३-२४॥
translation: The king with a clean heart, whose eyes had been rendered red with weeping wailed piteously. Even after hearing it, that malicious woman full of wicked thoughts did not act upon his word.

raw: विधूतवर्मा नाराचैर्बभूव स कृतव्रणः । इन्द्रजित् समरे वीरः प्ररूढ इव सानुमान् ॥६-८९-१९॥
translation: Indrajith's shield shattered by the iron arrows, (of Lakshmana) in the combat, he seemed (bathed in blood) like the morning Sun.

raw: त्रातुम् अर्हसि नः सर्वान् सुग्रीव भय शन्कितान् । महत् च कार्यम् अस्माभिः कर्तव्यम् धर्मचारिणि ॥४-५२-२४॥
सर्व लोक प्रियम् त्यक्त्वा सर्व लोक हिते रतम् । सर्व लोको अनुरज्येत कथम् त्वा अनेन कर्मणा ॥२-५८-३२॥
translation: 'How can anyone in this world be pleased with you for deserting Rama, the beloved of all, and ever devoted to their welfare?

raw: शुक्लानंशुमतश्चापि दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् । शुक्लांश्चन्दनकल्कांश्च समुद्गेष्ववतिष्ठत: ॥२-९१-७४॥
भिद्यतां भक्ष्यतां वापि शरीरं विसृजाम्यहम् । न चाप्यहं चिरं दुःखं सहेयं प्रियवर्जिता ॥५-२४-८॥
यथा अर्हम् ऋषिभिः सर्वैः समागच्छत् प्रहृष्टवत् । अथ राजा मुनि श्रेष्ठम् कृत अंजलिः अभाषत ॥१-५०-१०॥
कुंजर्स्य इव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्य अस्य लक्ष्मण! । वने अस्मिन् सुमहद् श्वभ्रम् खन्यताम् रौद्रवर्चसः ॥३-४-११॥
translation: Dig a deep pit to bury this demon, dreadful like an elephant and emitting a fearful glow.

raw: इति सीताञ्जलिम् कृत्वा पर्यगच्छद्वनस्पतिम् । अवलोक्य ततः सीतामायाचन्तीमनिन्दिताम् ॥२-५५-२६॥
इतीदमुक्त्वा विदितं महाबलैः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा । समेत्य रामः प्रियया महाबलः सुखं सुखार्हो ऽनुबभूव राघवः ॥६-१२१-२३॥
कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्म चारिणि । शृणु जानकि येन इदम् क्रमेण अभ्यागतम् मम ॥२-२६-२०॥
translation: You were born in a noble family. You know and practise dharma. I shall tell you how this banishment has come about. Do listen.

raw: नचिराद्रावणं सङ्ख्ये यो वधिष्यति वीर्यवान् । रोषप्रमुक्तैरिषुभिर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः ॥५-३४-३३॥
translation: "Heroic Rama will soon release many scorching, fiery arrows in anger and kill Ravana. I seek your permission as an envoy of Rama. Filled with grief by your separation, he has made inquiries about your welfare.

raw: इति उक्त्वा लक्ष्मणम् च अशु लाघवम् दर्शयन् इव । संगृह्य सुमहत् च अस्त्रम् आग्नेयम् रघुनंदनः । सुबाहु उरसि चिक्षेप स विद्धः प्रापतत् भुवि ॥१-३०-२२॥
कुतूहलितया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः । आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान् ॥७-७६-५०॥
translation: O greatly renowned Brahmana, I ask you out of curiosity, for you are indeed a supreme treasure of many wonders.

raw: तं तु दृष्ट्वा बलात्तेन नीयमानं महारणात् । महेन्द्रममराः सर्वे किं नु स्यादित्यचिन्तयन् ॥७-२९-३०॥
translation: Having seen the great Indra being led away by force from the great battle by him, all the gods wondered what would happen next.

raw: विररामैव मुक्त्वा ऽसौ वाचं वानरपुङ्गवः । जानकी चापि तच्छृत्वा विस्मयं परमं गता ॥५-३१-१६॥
translation: Having spoken thus, the great vanara stopped speaking after that. Janaki was wonderstruck by the words of the vanara.

raw: सा वस्त्रसंरुद्धमुखी लज्जया जनसंसदि । रुरोदासाद्य भर्तारमार्यपुत्रेति भाषिणी ॥६-११७-३४॥
तमापतन्तं धूम्राक्षो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । विनर्दमानः सहसा हनुमन्तमभिद्रवत् ॥६-५२-३३॥
translation: Lifting his mace on seeing Hanuman, heroic and brave Dhumraksha darted on Hanuman, roaring like a lion.

raw: साप्येवम् ब्रुवतीम् सीताम् सरमा वल्गु भाषिणी । उवाच वचनम् तस्याः स्पृशन्ती बाष्प विक्लवम् ॥६-३४-१२॥
translation: Saarana who speaks sweetly, kept wiping Sita's face covered with tears gently and replied in this manner.

raw: कृतम् हि प्रियम् अस्माकम् राघवेण महात्मना । तस्य चेत् प्रतिकारो अस्ति सफलम् जीवितम् भवेत् ॥४-४३-६॥
translation: 'Highsouled Rama has done a great service to us earlier. We will be blessed if we are successful in helping Rama in return.

raw: तवनाशं च वैदेहि वालिनश्च वधं तथा । प्रायोववेशमस्माकं मरणं च जटायुषः ॥५-३५-६१॥
translation: Seeing all the vanara leaders resolved to die, Angada, plunged in a sea of sorrow, grieved aloud over your disappearance, the slaying of Vali, the death of Jatayu, and our own resolve to fast unto death.

raw: यथा देवेश्वरो नित्यमृषिभिः समुपास्यते । अधिकस्तेन रूपेण सहस्राक्षाद्विरोचते ॥७-३७-२३॥
translation: Just as the lord of gods, Indra, is always served by sages, Rama shines with a splendor superior to that of the thousand-eyed Indra.

raw: अन्योन्यमापीड्य विलग्नदेहौ । तौ पेतुतुः पालनिखातमध्ये । उत्पेततुर्भूमितलम् स्पृशन्तौ । स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं त्वभिनिःश्वसन्तौ ॥६-४०-१७॥
translation: Squeezing their bodies of each other they dropped down between the boundary of the peak and the moat. They were gasping heavily for a moment and clung their body to each other jumping.

raw: कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव । वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते ॥२-२९-१५॥
translation: Since then I have been counting time for this forest life. It pleases me to follow my valiant hero as he lives in the forest. Rama, prosperity to you

raw: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः । अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ॥६-५९-५५॥
translation: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."

raw: इमे द्वे धनुषी श्रेष्ठे दिव्ये लोक अभिपूजिते । दृढे बलवती मुख्ये सुकृते विश्वकर्मणा ॥१-७५-११॥
translation: "These two excellent celestial bows are wellknown throughout the worlds. They are stout and strong. They are the best of all, wellmade by Visvakarma.

raw: ध्वम्सयित्वा तु तद्वाक्यम् प्रमादात्पर्युपस्थितम् । ह्लदनम् वचनम् सूतो देव्या मधुरमब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-१५॥
translation: Diverting the context of what he uttered inadvertently relating to Kaikeyi, the charioteer said pleasing words of consolation to Kausalya.

raw: कुलस्य हेतुः स्फीतस्य दीर्घ बन्धुः च राघवः । अप्रमेय प्रभावः च स्वयम् च अप्रतिमो गुणैः ॥४-२९-१७॥
translation: 'Rama is responsible in lending stability to you and to your wellknown family. He will continue to be your ally for a long time. Let it be known that his power is boundless and his virtues peerless.

raw: मध्ये वानर वीराणाम् सुराणाम् इव वासवः । भेरीणाम् इव सम्नादो यस्य एष श्रूयते महान् ॥६-२६-३९॥
translation: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

raw: सागरौघनिभा सेना भरतस्य महात्मन: । महीं सञ्छादयामास प्रावृषि द्यामिवाम्बुद: ॥२-९३-४॥
translation: The army of the magnanimous Bharata, resembling the waves of the ocean, covered the earth as the clouds cover the sky during the rainy season.

raw: पराङ्मुखे कृते देवे मालिना गरुडेन वै । उदतिष्ठन्महाञ्छब्दो रक्षसामभिनर्दताम् ॥७-७-४०॥
translation: When the god was indeed made to turn away by Mali (through Garuda), a great roaring sound arose from the exultant demons.

raw: दण्डकाष्ठमवष्टभ्य बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः । अवाक्छिरा दीनमना रामो ह्यासीत्सुदुःखितः ॥७-९८-२॥
translation: Leaning upon a staff, with his eyes agitated by tears, his head bowed down, and his mind filled with sorrow, Rama was indeed extremely distressed.

raw: अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कोविदम् । प्रत्याख्यातो अस्मि गुरुणा गुरु पुत्रैः तथा एव च ॥१-५७-१७॥
भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितः । कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ॥६-६०-९५॥
translation: Kumbhakarna surrounded by Rakshasas going to his brother's abode happily looked like the Lord of death bent on destroying the creation. He took strides which shook the earth.

raw: काम क्रोध समुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः । प्रभंजन इव अप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणः तदा ॥४-३१-१३॥
translation: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

raw: विगर्हितम् च नीचम् च कथम् आर्यो अभिधास्यति । त्राहि इति वचनम् सीते यः त्रायेत् त्रिदशान् अपि ॥३-५९-११॥
translation: 'How can Rama who is capable of saving even gods speak such unworthy, demeaning words, 'Save me, O Sita'

raw: ते चास्य हयमुख्येषु तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वानराः । चतुर्षु समहावीर्या निपेतुर्भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-९०-५०॥
translation: The four Vanaras of remarkable valour and of terrific courage getting up immediately fell on the best of the horses (of Indrajith).

raw: दीप्तम् अग्निम् अरण्यम् वा यदि रामः प्रवेक्ष्यते । प्रविष्टम् तत्र माम् देवि त्वम् पूर्वम् अवधारय ॥२-२१-१७॥
translation: O mother rest assured should Rama enter a blazing fire or a forest I must have already entered it.

raw: असत्यशीला विकृता दुर्र्गाह्याहृदयास्तथा । युवत्यः पापसम्कल्पाः क्षणमात्राद्विरागिणः ॥२-३९-२२॥
translation: Evilminded young ladies are infidels. They are of perverted nature. They are inscrutable. In an instant they lose their love (for their husbands).

raw: अप्रियामिवोपसंगृह्यकिंशेषेरणमेदिनीम् अप्रियामिवकस्माच्छमांनेच्छस्यभिभाषितुम् ॥६-११४-८४॥
translation: "You are lying in the battlefield embracing it as if it is a loved one. Why are you not willing to answer me?"

raw: वाली विनिहतो यावद् वने पांसुषु चेष्टते । यदि दृष्टि पथम् प्राप्तो जीवन् स विनिवर्तते ॥४-१४-१२॥
किम् एतत् ज्ञातुम् इच्छामि सखे कौतूहलम् मम । कौतूहल अपनयनम् कर्तुम् इच्छामि अहम् त्वया ॥४-१३-१५॥
translation: 'O friend I wish to know what this is? Could you answer my curiosity?'

raw: आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनं राक्षसोत्तमम् । यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रुता दिशः ॥६-७१-२५॥
translation: "Oh! Vibheeshana, a mighty armed one! Show me that foremost of Rakshasas, whom all Vanaras feared and fled in all directions."

raw: सत्येनाहं शपे राजन्स्वर्गलोके न चैव हि । न कामये यथा राज्यं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन ॥७-१०७-६॥
translation: O King, I swear by truth, and indeed by the heavenly world, that I do not desire kingship without you, O delight of the Raghus.

raw: अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमान: सुखोचितौ । वनवासमनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति ॥२-९७-२२॥
translation: Or rather having thought of the adversities of dwelling in a forest and also by realising that both of us are accustomed to comforts, I think he has certainly come to take us back home.

raw: साचिव्यमिव कुर्वन् स प्रभया निर्मलप्रभः । चन्द्रमा रश्मभिः शीतैः सिषेवे पवनात्मजम् ॥५-१७-२॥
translation: The Moon shed clear lightas if with his brightness and his cool rays he wished to refresh the son of the Windgod.

raw: धनुषा ज्या गुणवता सप्त बाणान् मुमोच ह । रुक्म पुंखान् महावेगान् सुपर्ण अनिल तुल्य गान् ॥३-३-११॥
translation: From his bow strung tight, Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda and the Windgod in speed.

raw: नावज्ञा रिपवे कार्या यैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः । सूदितः सैन्यपालो मे सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ॥६-५९-४॥
translation: "No low opinion to be entertained with regard to an enemy by whom my commander in chief of the army was killed, who is capable of killing the army of Indra with his followers and elephants."

raw: गङ्गीतीरे मया देवि ऋषीणामाश्रमाञ्छुभान् । शीघ्रं गत्वा तु वैदेहि शासनात्पार्थिवस्य नः । अरण्ये मुनिभिर्जुष्टे अपनेया भविष्यसि ॥७-४६-८॥
translation: Lakshmana tells Sita that by the command of their king, he will quickly take her to the auspicious hermitages of sages on the bank of the Ganga, where she will be left in a forest frequented by ascetics.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ खड्गमुत्पलसन्निभम् । मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः ॥६-७६-२४॥
translation: Seeing the pestle shaped sword fallen on the ground, mighty Prajaghna clenched his fist, which was as hard as the thunderbolt.

raw: वायुः सर्वात्मको राजन् प्रधर्षयितुम् इच्छति । अशुभम् मार्गम् आस्थाय न धर्मम् प्रत्यवेक्षते ॥१-३३-२॥
translation: "O king, the allpervading Windgod, having taken recourse to foul means intended to outrage our modesty without and moral compunction.

raw: ततः सुदर्शनं नाम नीलजीमूतसन्निभम् । ऐरावतकुले जातमारुरोह महोदरः ॥६-६९-२०॥
translation: Thereafter Mahodara mounted on an elephant born of Airavata (Indra 's elephant) family, by name Sudarsana went.

raw: तस्याऽपि हि भवेदस्मिन्कर्मण्यप्रतिसंहृते । सत्यं नेति मनस्तापस्तस्य तापस्तपेच्च माम् ॥२-२२-१०॥
translation: If the preparations for the consecration are not withdrawn, my father will suffer mental agony for the fear that his word has not come true and his agony will torment me.

raw: शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः । शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्नृत्तगीतैरलङ्कृतः ॥५-२७-३२॥
हरिभिर् वध्यमानः च याचमानः कृत अन्जलिः । राघवेण परित्रातो जीवामि ह यदृच्चया ॥६-३०-१०॥
translation: "While smitten by the monkeys, offering salutation with folded hands, and pleading for protection from Raghava, luckily, I am alive."

raw: स त्वं बलमतः शीघ्रमादाय परिगृह्य च । विजयायाभिनिर्याहि यत्र सर्वे वनौकसः ॥६-५७-७॥
translation: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."

raw: अन्वेषमाणाः ते सर्वे वानराः सर्वतो दिशम् । न सीताम् ददृशुर् वीरा मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम् ॥४-४८-४॥
