translation: 'In a little more than half a moment of this great war Rama had accomplished the terrific task of killing with sharp darts fourteen thousand demons, led by Khara and Dusana.

raw: स गृध्र राजः कृतवान् यशस्करम्सु दुष्करम् कर्म रणे निपातितः । महर्षि कल्पेन च संस्कृतः तदाजगाम पुण्याम् गतिम् आत्मनः शुभाम् ॥३-६८-३७॥
translation: The king of vultures had performed a very difficult and glorious feat by laying down his life fighting. Sanctified by Rama's offering as laid down in scriptures by the seers, he attained a holy, auspicious and divine state of the self.

raw: स तु तीरम् समासाद्य तमसाया मुनिः तदा । शिष्यम् आह स्थितम् पार्श्वे दृष्ट्वा तीर्थम् अकर्दमम् ॥१-२-४॥
translation: The eminent sage Valmiki reached the bank of Tamasa and seen a descent into the river with pellucid waters, spoke to the disciple standing by the side.

raw: ऋतधामा वसुः पूर्वं वसूनां त्वं प्रजापतिः । त्रयाणां त्वं हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयम्प्रभुः । रुद्राणामष्टमो रुद्रः साध्यानामसि पञ्चमः ॥६-१२०-८॥
translation: " Among the Vasus, you are the Rtadhama and the creator of the three worlds and the first creator and selfconstituted ruler."

raw: हरता मैथिलीम् येन माम् च रोषयता ध्रुवम् । आत्मनो जीवित अन्ताय मृत्यु द्वारम् अपावृतम् ॥४-६-२६॥
translation: 'By abducting Maithili he has stirred my fierce anger and has opened the door of his death.

raw: यथा बाणपथं प्राप्य स्थितो ऽहं तव राक्षस । दर्शयस्वाद्य तत्तेजो वाचा त्वं किं विकत्थसे ॥६-८८-१६॥
translation: "Rakshasa! I have reached your range of arrows and stand before you. Show that power now about which you boasted."

raw: उपगम्य अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् राक्षसी भय विह्वला । रावणम् शत्रु हन्तारम् मंत्रिभिः परिवारितम् ॥३-३२-२४॥
नाप्येवं वेगवान्वायुर्गरुडो वा मनस्तथा । यथा ऽयं वायुपुत्रस्तु क्रमते ऽम्बरमुत्तमम् ॥७-३५-२६॥
translation: Neither the wind, nor Garuda, nor even the mind is as swift as this son of Vayu, who indeed traverses the high sky.

raw: स उवाच च महाप्राज्ञः स्वरेण महता महान् । सुग्रीवम् तामः च सम्प्रेक्ष्य खस्थ एव विभीषणः ॥६-१७-११॥
translation: Great and very wise Vibheeshana, gazing at Sugriva and the Vanaras, addressed them in a loud tone.

raw: ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभो ऽबवत् । मही चकम्पे न हि मारुतो ववौ स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः ॥६-१११-३१॥
translation: Then the host of gods attained tranquil, quarters brightened, sky became clear, earth no longer shook, wind blew and even the Sun became steady and radiant.

raw: रथस्थ: स हि धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल: । नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तूर्णं शिरस्याधाय पादुके ॥२-११५-१२॥
translation: Righteous Bharata who was deeply attached to his brother proceeded speedily towards Nandigrama on the chariot bearing the sandals of Rama on his head.

raw: स पुष्पिताग्रां रुचिरां तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवाम् । तामारुह्य महाबाहुश्शिंशुपां पर्णसंवृताम् ॥५-१४-४१॥
translation: Strongarmed Hanuman climbed up the simsupa tree shining with flowers on its top and surrounded by tender sprouts and leaves. (He said to himself):

raw: निपपात तदा चोल्का ज्वलन्ती भीमनिस्वना । आदित्यो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्न प्रवाति सुखो ऽनिलः ॥६-६५-५२॥
translation: Then a burning meteor fell from the sky making a terrible sound. The sun lost his glow and the wind lost its delight।।

raw: दिवम् तु तस्याम् यातायाम् शबर्याम् स्वेन तेजसा । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चिन्तयामास राघवः ॥३-७५-१॥
translation: When Sabari departed for heaven with her brilliance, Rama contemplated (about the power of sages)with Lakshmana.

raw: रामम् दाशरथिम् रामो जामदग्न्यः प्रशस्य च । ततः प्रदक्षिणी कृत्य जगाम आत्म गतिम् प्रभुः ॥१-७६-२४॥
translation: Parasurama, the competent son of Jamadagni, having praised Rama, the son of Dasaratha circumbulated him and left for his abode. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventysixth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सम्पन्नं राज्यमिच्छंस्तु व्यक्तं प्राप्याभिषेचनम् । आवां हन्तुं समभ्येति कैकेय्या भरत: सुत: ॥२-९६-१७॥
translation: It is evident that Kaikeyi's son Bharata, who has been consecrated, is coming to slay both of us desiring the prosperous kingdom (to be without obstacles).

raw: भिषणो अयम् महाकायो राक्षसो भुज विक्रमः । लोकम् हि अति जितम् कृत्वा हि अवाम् हन्तुम् इह इच्छति ॥३-७०-५॥
translation: This huge, horrible demon with the strength of his arms has conquered the world, and now intends to kill us here.

raw: अर्चितम् सततम् यत्नाद् गन्ध माल्यैर् मया तव । इदम् ते मत् प्रियम् वीर धनुः कान्चन भूषितम् ॥६-३२-१७॥
translation: "O Hero! This bow that was decorated with gold was always worshipped with sandal and flowers diligently by you and me with utmost devotion."

raw: सूत्राण्यन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति ह्यायतम् शतयोजनम् । नलः चक्रे महासेतुम् मध्ये नद नदी पतेः ॥६-२२-६१॥
सर्वम् च तत् विचेतव्यम् मार्गयद्भिः ततः ततः । रामस्य दयिताम् भार्याम् सीताम् दशरथः स्नुषाम् ॥४-४०-२४॥
translation: 'Search all over the place looking carefully here and there for Sita the beloved consort of Rama, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha.

raw: तस्यास्तु शीलवृत्ताभ्यां तुतोष मुनिपुङ्गवः । प्रीतः स तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ॥७-२-२९॥
translation: The excellent sage Pulastya was greatly pleased by her character and conduct, and being delighted, the greatly effulgent one spoke these words.

raw: अबन्धुर् भक्षिता सीता रावणेन तपस्विनी । अथवा राक्षस इन्द्रस्य पत्नीभिर् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१३-१२॥
वेदिस्थलविधानानि चैत्यान्यायतनानि च । आश्रमस्यानुरूपाणि स्थापयामास राघवः ॥२-५६-३३॥
translation: Rama, son of the Raghus, made altars in all the quarters, places of worship and sacred spots for fire befitting a hermitage.

raw: यथाप्रत्यूषसमयेचतुर्णांसागराम्बसाम् पूर्णघटैःप्रतीक्षध्वंतथाकुरुतवानराः ॥६-१३१-५०॥
translation: Sugriva gave four pots to the four of the Vanaras to get them filled with the water of the four oceans and get them by early morning and said to await for him.

raw: स अमात्यो मंत्रि सहितः स भृत्यः पूजितः तदा । युक्तः परम हर्षेण वसिष्ठम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५३-७॥
translation: Having received the hospitality along with his counsellors, ministers and attendants, Viswamitra, filled with great delight, said to Vasishta":

raw: युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी । प्रतिसन्दिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः ॥६-११६-४७॥
translation: "Devi! you are the righteous wife of Rama and earned fame. Give me the right message to Rama in return. I will go."

raw: अज्ञानाद्द् हि कृतम् यस्मात् इदम् तेन एव जीवसि । अपि हि अद्य कुलम् नस्यात् राघवाणाम् कुतः भवान् ॥२-६४-२६॥
translation: 'Since you have done this unwittingly you are still alive. If it had been otherwise, your Ikshvaku race itself would have been exterminated, what to speak of you

raw: बिभीषणमथोवाच राक्षसेन्द्रं महायशाः । यावत्प्रजा धरिष्यन्ति तावत्त्वं वै बिभीषण । राक्षसेन्द्र महावीर्य लङ्कास्थस्त्वं धरिष्यसि ॥७-१०८-२७॥
translation: The greatly renowned Rama then spoke to Vibhishana, the king of Rakshasas, declaring that as long as people exist, Vibhishana, the greatly valorous king of Rakshasas residing in Lanka, would indeed endure and rule.

raw: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा । पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी ॥७-२६-४४॥
translation: Her hair was disheveled and scattered, and her hands trembled like sprouts, resembling a flower-laden creeper shaken by the wind.

raw: लन्काम् च आलोकयिष्यामो निलयम् तस्य रक्षसह् । येन मे मरण अन्ताय हृता भार्या दुरात्मना ॥६-३८-४॥
translation: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."

raw: कद्रूर् नाग सहस्रम् तु विजज्ञे धरणीधरन् । द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायाः तु गरुडो अरुण एव च ॥३-१४-३२॥
translation: Kadhru produced a thousandhooded serpent(Adisesha) who held the whole earth on his head and Vinata, two sons, Garuda and Aruna.

raw: एतैः च अन्यैः च बहुभी राजपुत्रैः महात्मभिः । अधर्म सहिता नार्यो हताः पुरुषसत्तमैः । तस्माद् एनाम् घृणाम् त्यक्त्वा जहि मत् शासनान् नृप ॥१-२५-२२॥
बलवान् हि मम अमर्षः श्रुत्वा त्वाम् अवमानितम् । वर्धते हृदय उत्कम्पी प्रावृड् वेग इव अंभसः ॥४-८-४३॥
translation: 'On hearing about your humiliation I feel highly agitated at heart. I feel very much angry and restless like the water in rainy season.

raw: स तु दृष्ट्वा बलं सर्वं रावणो निहतं क्षणात् । क्रोधमभ्यगमत्तीव्रं महानादं च मुक्तवान् ॥७-२९-५॥
translation: Seeing his entire army destroyed in an instant, Rāvaṇa indeed became intensely angry and let out a great roar.

raw: ललाटे स महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम् । आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्तं चचाल ह ॥६-७६-२५॥
translation: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.

raw: तेन वीर्येण तपसा वरदानात् स्वयम्भुवः । अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरः प्राप्तं कामगाश्च तुरङ्गमाः ॥६-८५-१३॥
translation: "Lakshmana, being heroic received Brahmasira weapon from the creator by austerity and also horses which can course according to his will."

raw: पश्यतस्तानि रुदतस्ताम्यतश्च पुनः पुनः । प्रादीपयन् दाशरथेस्तानि शोकहुताशनम् ॥५-३५-४१॥
translation: "Rama looked at them and wept clasping them again and again in grief which inflamed like fire.

raw: यथा सुखम् पर्वत निर्झरेषुवनेषु सर्वेषु च वानरेन्द्राः । निवेशयित्वा विधिवत् बलानिबलम् बलज्ञः प्रतिपत्तुम् ईष्टे ॥४-३९-४४॥
translation: Sugriva told the chiefs to station the forces by the side of swift mountain streams, in forests, and hills and ascertain their exact number. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: प्रतिज्ञातः च रामेण वधः संयति रक्षसाम् । ऋषीणाम् अग्नि कल्पानाम् दंडकारण्य वासीनाम् ॥१-१-४५॥
translation: Rama promised those ascetics, who resembled flaming fire in lustre living in Dandakaranya inhabited by rakshasas to slay them.

raw: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ह्यगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः । उवाच रामं प्रहसन्पितामह इवेश्वरम् ॥७-३१-५॥
translation: Having heard the words of Rama, the revered sage Agastya, laughing, spoke to Rama as Brahma would speak to the Lord.

raw: यन्निमित्तो ऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां च फलोदयः । तां देवीं शोकसन्तप्तां मैथिलीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ॥६-११७-२॥
translation: "You ought to see that noble lady Mythili, who was immersed in grief, for whose sake these actions were started and has borne fruit."

raw: वानरेन्द्रो महावीर्यः तेजोवान् अमित प्रभः । सत्य संधो विनीतः च धृतिमान् मतिमान् महान् ॥३-७२-१३॥
translation: This king of monkeys is energetic with great strength and limitless lustre. He is humble and truthful, valiant, patient and intelligent. He is great.

raw: व्याचुक्रोश महात्मानम् रामम् दशरथात्मजम् । लुप्येते मे बलात्पक्षौ भिद्येते मे तथाक्षिणी ॥६-२०-३४॥
भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः । अभिवाद्य महर्षींस्तान् विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ॥७-७५-८॥
translation: Having heard the pleasing words of Pushpaka, the king (Rama) saluted those great sages and then ascended the aerial chariot.

raw: ततस्ते संवृताकारं सत्त्ववन्तं महाकपिम् । परिगृह्य ययुर्हृष्टा राक्षसाः कपिकुञ्जरम् ॥५-५३-१७॥
translation: Then the ogres set forth joyfully capturing the very powerful elephant among the monkeys, the great vanara who had contracted his body.

raw: स तस्या विवृते वक्त्रे वज्रसंहननः कपिः । संक्षिप्य मुहुरात्मानं निष्पपात महाबलः ॥५-१-१९२॥
translation: Hanuman, the vanara whose physique was as hard as thunderbolt suddenly contracted once again and entered her opened mouth.

raw: ताम् दृष्ट्वा राघवः श्रीमान् आगताम् ताम् च राक्षसीम् । अब्रवीत् भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-२०-३॥
translation: Seeing the demons along with Surpanakha arrive, said the handsome Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty to his brother Lakshmana, who was blazing like fire :

raw: कैकेय्यै च अवशिष्ट अर्धम् ददौ पुत्रार्थ कारणात् । प्रददौ च अवशिष्ट अर्धम् पायसस्य अमृत उपमम् ॥१-१६-२८॥
translation: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

raw: ततो वासमुपागम्य गोमतीतीर आश्रमे । प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय सौमित्रिः सूतमब्रवीत् ॥७-४६-१९॥
translation: Then, having stayed in a hermitage on the bank of the Gomati, Lakshmana rose again in the morning and spoke to the charioteer.

raw: एतद्वचो नेच्छ्सि पापवृत्ते । हितम् न जानासि ममात्मनो वा । आस्थाय मार्गम् कृपणम् कुचेष्टा । चेष्टा हि ते साधुपदादपेता ॥२-३६-३२॥
translation: O Kaikeyi of vicious behaviour, you do not aceept even the words of Siddhartha. You woman of wicked acts, having adopted vile ways, and abjured the right path cannot know what is good either for you or for me.

raw: प्रति उज्जगाम सहसा विनयेन समन्वितः । ऋत्विजो अपि महात्मानः तु अर्घ्यम् आदाय स त्वरम् ॥१-५०-७॥
न अध्यगच्छत् विशिष्टम् वा तुल्यम् वा शत्रुम् आत्मनः । मित्रवान् नत सामन्तः प्रताप हत कण्टकः । स शशास जगत् राजा दिवि देव पतिर् यथा ॥१-७-२३॥
translation: The king (Dasaratha) had many friends. All the tributary kings were obedient to him. He killed his enemies with his might. There was no foe who was either superior to or equal to him. He ruled the world as Indra ruled the heaven.

raw: विचचार ततः तत्र दीपयन् इव तत् वनम् । अदृष्ट पूर्वम् दृष्ट्वा तम् नाना रत्नमयम् मृगम् । विस्मयम् परमम् सीता जगाम जनक आत्मजा ॥३-४२-३५॥
translation: Seeing such an unprecedented deer decorated with different gems, Sita, daughter of Janaka, stood amazed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ईश्वरस्येश्वरः कोऽस्ति तव शत्रुनिबर्हण । रमस्व सह वैदेह्या शत्रूनाक्रम्य मूर्धसु ॥६-१३-३॥
translation: "O Destroyer of foes Who is there to question Lord since you are Lord? Setting your foot on the head of enemy you may sport with Sita."

raw: ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम् । प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समतिष्ठत ॥६-१०९-२॥
translation: Then, both Rakshasa army and huge Vanara army, stood motionless holding their weapons ready.

raw: त्वम् तार शिबिकाम् शीघ्रम् आदाय आगच्छ संभ्रमात् । त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता हि अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः ॥४-२५-१७॥
translation: 'O Tara quickly get a swiftmoving litter fastened with ropes specially suitable for this occasion.

raw: अहं वै लोकपालानां चतुर्थं स्रष्टुमुद्यतः ॥७-३-१७॥
translation: Brahma declared, "Indeed, I was about to create the fourth among the world-protectors."

raw: दत्त्वा स तु यथान्यायं स्वमाश्रमपदं गतः । सापि तत्रावसत्कन्या तोषयन्ती पतिं गुणैः ॥७-२-२८॥
translation: Having properly given his daughter, King Trasabindu returned to his own hermitage, and the daughter also lived there, pleasing her husband with her virtues.

raw: भवान्हि गतिरव्यग्रा भवता पालिता वयम् । भवतस्तेजसोग्रेण रावणो निहतो मया ॥७-३८-३॥
translation: You are indeed our steadfast refuge, and we have been protected by you; it was by your fierce might that Ravana was killed by me.

raw: कच्चिन्निद्रावशं नैषी: कच्चित्काले प्रबुध्यसे । कच्चिच्चापररात्रेषु चिन्तयस्यर्थनैपुणम् ॥२-१००-१८॥
translation: I trust you are not under the grip of sleep but wake up at appropriate times, I hope you always think of the means of judicious statecraft during the last part of the night.

raw: अपक्षिपन्ति स्रुग्भाण्डानग्नीन् सिञ्चन्ति वारिणा । कलशांश्च प्रमृद्नन्ति हवने समुपस्थिते ॥२-११६-१७॥
translation: When sacrifices are about to start, they throw away the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials and sprinkle water on sacrificial fire. They also break down the earthen vessels used in the sacrifice.

raw: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः । वाक्यम् वाक्यविदाम् श्रेष्ठो रामम् पुनर् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-३-६॥
translation: Hanuman the son of Maruti, the foremost among those who are good at speech, having heard Rama's words again said to Rama.

raw: लक्षणज्ञांश्च गान्धर्वान्नैगमांश्च विशेषतः । पादाक्षरसमासज्ञांश्छन्दःसु परिनिष्ठितान् ॥७-९४-६॥
translation: He gathered those who were knowledgeable in characteristics, skilled in music, especially proficient in the Vedas, and well-versed in the intricacies of prosody, including feet, syllables, and compounds.

raw: तस्य विस्फारघोषेण धनुषो महता दिशः । प्रदिशश्च नभश्चैव सहसा समपूर्यत ॥५-४४-४॥
translation: All directions including the intermediate directions and the sky were filled with that loud sound produced by his twang.

raw: पित्र्याणि ब्रह्मरत्नानि यज्ञान्परमदुस्तरान् । चकार रामो धर्मात्मा पितऽन्देवान्विवर्धयन् ॥७-९९-१९॥
translation: The righteous-souled Rama performed ancestral rites, excellent Vedic rituals, and extremely difficult sacrifices, thereby causing his ancestors and the gods to prosper.

raw: ततो मुहूर्ताद्गरुडं वैनतेयं महाबलम् ॥६-५०-३५॥
निराशा निहते पुत्रे दत्त्वा श्राद्धमचेतना । अग्निमारोक्ष्यते नूनमपो वा ऽपि प्रवेक्ष्यति ॥६-९३-५८॥
translation: 'Son killed, Kausalya will be disappointed, lost sentience will be offering obsequies, surely and enter fire or water and drown'.

raw: भरतः च महा बाहुर् अयोध्याम् पालयिष्यति । सर्व कामैः पुनः श्रीमान् रामः सम्साध्यताम् इति ॥२-३६-९॥
translation: (While) mightyarmed Bharata will rule Ayodhya, Rama be furnished with all objects of enjoyment.

raw: स विह्वलित सर्व अंगो गत बुद्धिः विचेतनः । निषसाद आतुरो दीनो निःश्वस्य अशीतम् आयतम् ॥३-६१-२८॥
translation: By grief tormented, limbs enervated, intellect atrophied, senses switched off, he felt anxious and depressed and sighed long and hot.

raw: तथा ब्रुवति तारे तु तारा अधिपति वर्चसि । अथ मेने हृतम् राज्यम् हनुमान् अंगदेन तत् ॥४-५४-१॥
translation: Hanuman listened to the proposal of Tara, whose face was like the Moon, lord of the stars. (After listening to Tara) he thought Angada might take over the kingdom from Sugriva.

raw: एवमेव नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण । वृत्रघातमशेषेण वाजिमेधफलं च यत् ॥७-८७-२॥
translation: Rama affirmed to Lakshmana, "O best among men, what you say is exactly true, regarding the complete slaying of Vritra and the fruit of the Ashwamedha sacrifice."

raw: तं शैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभिर्वृक्षैस्तलैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च । सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्णं रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः ॥६-६०-४०॥
translation: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.

raw: तवामरसुतप्रख्य तर्तुम् सागरगाम् नदीम् । नौरियम् पुरुषव्याग्र! ताम् त्वमारोह सुव्रत! ॥२-५२-९॥
translation: O best among men, renowned like a god's son and constantly engaged in vows, here is the boat for you to cross the Ganga flowing into the sea. Do board it.

raw: अनुज्ञातश्च भवता पूर्वमेव यदस्म्यहम् । किमिदानीम् पुनरिदम् क्रियते मे निवारणम् ॥२-३१-७॥
translation: You have granted permission to me earlier.Why are you now preventing me?

raw: गते तस्मिन् नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परम हर्षिता । कुशप्लवम् सामासाद्य तपः तेपे सुदारुणम् ॥१-४६-८॥
translation: "O foremost among men after Kasyapa had left, Diti exceedingly delighted (at the prospect of having sons) reached Kushaplavana, and practised intense mortifications.

raw: रम्ये मार्दवयुक्तश्च वनदावैर्विपर्जितः । इति पन्थानमावेद्य महर्षः स न्यवर्तत ॥२-५५-१०॥
कौसल्या शुशुभे पुत्रेणामिततेजसा । यथा वरेण देवानामदितिर्वज्रपाणिना ॥२-१-८॥
translation: Kausalya looked splendid with her son, Rama of boundless energy, as did Aditi with the chief of the gods Indra, wielder of thunder.

raw: यो न देव असुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुम् युधि । तम् पश्य गुह सम्विष्टम् तृणेषु सह सीतया ॥२-८६-११॥
translation: O Guha behold Rama, whom gods and demons combined cannot withstand in a battle now lying on a bed of grass with Sita.

raw: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनः । अभिगम्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं क्व मे स्थानं विधास्यथ ॥७-८६-१०॥
translation: When the sacrifice was completed, the personified sin of brahmin-slaughter that clung to the great-souled Indra approached and asked, 'Where will you appoint a dwelling place for me?'

raw: सर्वात्मनापर्यनुनीयमानोयदा न सौमित्रिरुपैतियोगम् । नियुज्यमानोऽपि च यौवराज्येततोऽभ्यषिञ्चद्भरतंमहात्मा ॥६-१३१-९४॥
translation: When Saumithri was compelled repeatedly to accept the position of Prince Regent by the high soul great Rama, he had not accepted. Rama consecrated Bharata as Prince Regent.

raw: जंबू प्रियाल पनसाः प्लक्ष न्यग्रोध तिंदुकाः । अश्वत्थाः कर्णिकाराः च चूताः च अन्ये च पादपाः ॥३-७३-३॥
translation: O Rama the delightful path going westward is auspicious for you. It is shining with trees in bloom. There are jambu (rose apple) trees, priyala trees, jackfruit trees, banyan trees, plaksha trees (a tree from which milky latex oozes out), tinduka trees, holy fig trees, karnikaras (of red and white flowers), mango trees and other trees like dryland, thorny trees, tilaka trees, trees that bloom at night, agnimukhya and asoka trees of blue flowers, kadamba trees, karavira trees, red ashoka trees, and paribhadraka trees.

raw: कृता सुसंस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण यथा पुरा । अद्य तैः वानरैः सर्वैः आगंतव्यम् महाबलैः ॥४-३५-२१॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana since Sugriva has already promulgated an ordinance to all the mighty vanaras, they should be all arriving by now.

raw: लोचने कोपसम्रक्ते वर्णम् पूर्वोचितम् जहत् । कोपाभिभूतः सहसा सम्तापमशुभम् गतः ॥२-३५-२॥
translation: Overcome with anger, charioteer Sumantra started shaking his head and sighing off and on, crushing his palms and grinding his teeth. His eyes turned red due to anger. Overcome with a sudden, ominous grief, the complexion of his face turned red. Sumantra understood the mind of Dasaratha. With sharp arrows of words as if piercing the heart of Kaikeyi, he denounced her in exceptionally harsh words which, like thunderbolt, cut her to the quick:

raw: इति एवम् उक्त्वा संरब्धा राक्षसाः ते चतुर्दश । उद्यत आयुध निस्त्रिंशा रामम् एव अभिदुद्रुवुः ॥३-२०-१६॥
इति उक्त्वा प्राक्षिपत् राजा मंत्र पूतम् जलम् तदा । साधु साधु इति देवानाम् ऋषीणाम् वदताम् तदा ॥१-७३-२८॥
अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः । स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम् गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः । मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव सुषेणो जाम्बवां स्तथा ॥४-६५-१॥
translation: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after the other their capability for leaping.

raw: अयुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र पश्चिम द्वारम् आश्रितम् । शूल हस्ता दुराधर्षाः सर्वे खड्ग अग्र योधिनः ॥६-३-२४॥
translation: "There(in Lanka) ten thousand warriors are garrisoned at the eastern gate way holding tridents, and those who are unassailable in war stand in front with swords."

raw: स तस्य रथनिर्घोषं ज्यास्वनं कार्मुकस्य च । निशम्य हरिवीरो ऽसौ संप्रहृष्टतरो ऽभवत् ॥५-४८-२१॥
translation: The leader of the monkey also became happier on hearing the rumbling (of the chariot) and the twang of Indrajit's bowstring.

raw: वार्यमाणः सुसङ्क्रुद्धः सुहृद्भिर्हितबुद्धिभिः । अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धः खे ग्रहो रोहिणीमिव ॥६-९३-४६॥
translation: Highly enraged Ravana, darted just as planet Mars rushed to Rohini in the sky, even while his wellwishers were obstructing.

raw: गच्चन्तु इति ततः सर्वे वसिष्ठम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् । तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६८-४॥
translation: Let the messengers go, said all of them to Vasistha. On hearing this, Vasistha replied again.

raw: उपतस्थे च वैदेहीम् भिक्षु रूपेण रावणः । अभव्यो भव्य रूपेण भर्तारम् अनुशोचतीम् ॥३-४६-९॥
दृश्यमानो वसन्तः च स्वेद संसर्ग दूषकः । माम् हि सा मृगशाबाक्षी चिन्ता शोक बलात्कृतम् ॥४-१-३५॥
स भूतलेभीमबलाभिपिष्टस्सुरारिभिस्स्सैरभिहन्यमानः । जगामखंवेगवदभ्युपेत्यपुनश्चरामेणसमाजगाम ॥६-६७-८९॥
translation: Dropped on the ground by Kumbhakarna of dreadful strength, pressed against the ground surface, Sugriva bounced to the sky to get reunited with Rama.

raw: ये योधा निर्गताः शूरा राक्षसा मम शासनात् । ते सर्वे निहता युद्धे वानरैः सुमहाबलैः ॥६-७२-८॥
translation: " All those heroes who have gone by my order for combat, have been killed in the battle by mighty Vanaras."

raw: अथवा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम् । आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते ॥५-१-१५६॥
translation: Or else, after seeing Maithili and the ever-untroubled Rama, I shall return into your mouth—this I truly promise you.

raw: आरुरोह ततः श्रीमान् प्रासादम् हिम पाण्डुरम् । बहु ताल समुत्सेधम् रावणो अथ दिदृक्षया ॥६-२६-५॥
translation: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).

raw: अग्रतः प्रययौ रामः सीता मध्ये सुशोभना । पृष्ठतः तु धनुष्पाणिः लक्ष्मणः अनुजगाम ह ॥३-११-१॥
translation: Rama walked in front, Sita with a beautiful waist, in the middle and Lakshmana holding the bow, behind them৷৷

raw: प्रविश्य वेश्मातिभृशं मुदाऽन्वितं समीक्ष्य तां चार्थविपत्तिमागताम् । न चैव रामोऽत्रजगामविक्रियां सुहृज्जनस्यात्मविपत्तिशङ्कया ॥२-१९-४०॥
translation: Rama entered the palace which was full of great rejoicing. He did not disclose the obstruction that had come on the way of achieving his objective for fear of causing distress to his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: प्रासैः प्रमथिताः केचिद्वानराः शोणितस्रवाः । मुद्गरैराहताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले ॥६-५२-१९॥
translation: Few Vanaras mutilated by barbed darts, some struck with mallets, blood oozing dropped down.

raw: त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारीं जानीषे मनसा प्रभो । स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरन्दर ॥७-३०-२७॥
translation: O Shakra, O Lord, O Purandara, you then mentally considered that woman to be your wife due to your superior position.

raw: प्रत्याख्यातं न जानाति नात्मानं नात्मनः कुलम् । यो नृशंस स्वभावेन मां प्रार्थयितुमिच्छति ॥५-२४-१०॥
पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वकाशमरिन्दम । स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ॥५-६७-१५॥
राम लक्ष्मणयोः च अपि दर्शयिष्यामि सुव्रत । यदि अस्य धनुषो रामः कुर्यात् आरोपणम् मुने । सुताम् अयोनिजाम् सीताम् दद्याम् दाशरथेः अहम् ॥१-६६-२६॥
translation: O Sage if Rama could lift and string this bow I shall give my daughter Sita, not born from a woman, to him (son of Dasaratha)". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: उत्तिष्ठ तावत् आख्याहि प्रमोहम् जहि संभ्रमम् । व्यक्तम् आख्याहि केन त्वम् एवम् रूपा विरूपिता ॥३-१९-२॥
translation: Get up, give up your confusion and stupefaction. Tell me clearly by whom you have been disfigured like this ?

raw: मया ह्यलब्धनिद्रेण दृढेन तव निर्जये । प्रतिज्ञैषा विनिस्तीर्णा बद्ध्वा सेतुं महोदधौ ॥६-११६-१२॥
translation: 'Ravana has been killed, Lanka is under our side vanquished completely. Without any sleep, with forbearance, building an extensive bridge on the great ocean, the vow has been redeemed', is Rama's message to you, said Hanuman.

raw: भूमिशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पझिनीव हिमागमे । रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया । कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी तूर्णमासादिता मया ॥५-५८-६०॥
translation: After much searching I at last beheld her amid the demonesses, repeatedly intimidated—wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thought of her husband, pale from lying on the bare ground like a lotus at winter's onset, turned away from Ravana and resolved to die.

raw: नायं मया शरः पूर्वं रावणस्य वधार्थिना । मुक्तः शत्रुघ्न भूतानां महांस्त्रासो भवेदिति ॥७-६३-२४॥
translation: O Shatrughna, I did not release this arrow previously, even when desiring Ravana's death, thinking that it would cause great terror to all beings.

raw: स च तान् राघवो ज्ञात्वा विश्वामित्रम् महामुनिम् । गच्छन् एव अथ मधुरम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-२८-१६॥
translation: After having acquired the knowledge of the weapons Rama addressed maharshi Viswamitra in gentle and soft words while walking along with him.

raw: एवम् स विलपन् रामः सीता हरण कर्शितः । दीनः शोक समाविष्टो मुहूर्तम् विह्वलो अभवत् ॥३-६१-२७॥
translation: Thus tormented by the abduction of Sita, Rama felt dejected and cried.Overpowered by grief he lost his consciousness for a moment.

raw: वधार्थम् राक्षसाम् यानि ददामि एतानि सर्वशः । वैद्याधरम् महा अस्त्रम् च नन्दनम् नाम नामतः ॥१-२७-१३॥
महात्मानाम् सुदुष्प्रापम् प्राप्तम् राज्यम् इदम् प्रभो । भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रविश्य नगरम् शुभम् ॥४-२६-५॥
तेनास्त्रेण हतं रक्षः काकुत्स्थेन तदा रणे । सञ्छिन्नहृदयं तत्र पपात च ममार च ॥६-७९-३८॥
translation: Then struck in the battlefield by that missile of Kakuthsa, the Rakshasa fell down with his heart split open and died.

raw: सहितौ मधुरम् रक्तम् संपन्नम् स्वर संपदा । एवम् प्रशस्यमानौ तौ तपः श्लाघ्यैः महर्षिभिः ॥१-४-१९॥
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवो रामं रक्तान्तलोचनम् । ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं काकुत्स्थं पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥४-११-७३॥
translation: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.

raw: तान् तान् त्वम् आनय क्षिप्रम् पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान् । साम दान आदिभिः कल्पैः वानरैः वेगवत्तरैः ॥४-३७-९॥
translation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

raw: त्यक्त्वा ज्ञातिजनं सीते मानमृद्धिं च भामिनि । अवरुद्धं वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमनुगच्छसि ॥२-११७-२०॥
translation: O noble Sita, by the grace of heaven you are following Rama, forsaking your kinsmen and wealth and confining yourself to the forest.

raw: रामं कमलपत्राक्षं शरबन्धपरिक्षतम् । शुशोच भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा पतितं घरणीतले ॥६-४५-२६॥
translation: Lakshmana grieved seeing his elder brother Rama pierced by arrows, pained, and fallen on the ground.

raw: संप्रति अनेक आश्रय चित्र शोभालक्ष्मीः शरत् काल गुण उपपन्ना । सूर्य अग्र हस्त प्रतिबोधितेषुपद्माकरेषु अभ्यधिकम् विभाति ॥४-३०-२८॥
translation: 'From the beauty of autumn manifested in a variety of ways on the clusters of lotuses, touched by the Sun, it seems the goddess of wealth shines and shines effulgently. (The lotus is goddess Laxmi's favourite flower)

raw: इति ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणो अधः शिरा मुहुः । श्रुत्वा मध्यम् जगाम इव मनसा दुह्ख हर्षयोह् ॥२-२३-१॥
translation: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana listened to him with his head down, experiencing both grief and joy.

raw: अथ यानप्रवेकैस्तु कौसल्याप्रमुखा: स्त्रिय: । रामदर्शनकांक्षिण्य: प्रययुर्मुदितास्तदा ॥२-९२-३५॥
translation: The women headed by Kausalya, eager to see Rama, proceeded delightfully in distinguished carriages.

raw: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता । प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२९-१॥
translation: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:

raw: सुधा मणि विचित्राणि भूमि भागानि सर्वशः । दशग्रीवः स्व भवने प्रादर्शयत मैथिलीम् ॥३-५५-११॥
translation: The tenheaded Ravana showed Sita, the princess from Mithila the floors with wonderful crystals.

raw: त्वया राज्यमयोध्यायां प्राप्तव्यं लोकसत्कृतम् । वस्तव्यं दण्डकारण्ये मया वल्कलवाससा ॥२-१०४-२३॥
translation: You shall rule the kingdom wellhonoured by the people in Ayodhya and I shall live in Dandaka forest wearing bark as garments.

raw: स्वबलं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातऽंश्च निहतान् दृष्ट्वा शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ॥६-७१-१॥
translation: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

raw: हाराजन् सुकुमारंतेसुभ्रुसुत्वक्समुन्नसम् कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः । किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितंताम्रास्यंदीप्तकुण्डलम् मदव्याकुललोलाक्षंभूत्वायत्पानभूमिषु । विविधस्रग्धरंचारुवल्गुस्मितकथंशुभम् तदेवाद्यतवैवंहिवक्त्रं न भ्राजतेप्रभो । रामसायकनिर्भिन्नंरक्तंरुधिरविस्रवैः वीशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कंरूक्षस्यन्दनरेणुभिः ॥६-११४-३४॥
translation: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो महाबलः । देशकालहितं वाक्यं भ्रातुरुत्तरमब्रवीत् ॥५-५३-१॥
translation: The tenheaded Ravana heard his brother, the greatsoul Vibhishana's timely advice which was in keeping with the laws of the land and replied.

raw: ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिर्दीप्तां दींप्ताशनीमिव । विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-१०१-१९॥
translation: Then, endowed with extraordinary energy, the powerful leader of Rakshasas hurled a flaming thunderbolt like javelin at Vibheeshana.

raw: स अन्तःपुरः सह अमात्यः प्रययौ यत्र स द्विजः । वनानि सरितः च एव व्यतिक्रम्य शनैः शनैः ॥१-११-१४॥
लक्षणीयान्न रेम्द्राणाम् ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादितान् । रथेन पुरुषव्याघ्रः कोसलानत्यवर्तत ॥२-५०-१०॥
translation: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was rich with herds of cattle, wealth and foodgrains. It was inhabited by charitable, contented and wellnourished people free from fear from any quarter. And it reverberated with the sounds of Vedic recitations.

raw: अत्यन्कुशम् इव उद्दामम् गजम् मद बल उद्धतम् । प्रधावितम् अहम् दैवम् पौरुषेण निवर्तये ॥२-२३-२०॥
translation: I will make destiny, the elephant, running wild on the strength of the rut, unmanageable (even) by the goad, turn back with my valour.

raw: तमसा संवृतं सर्वमासीद्भीमतरं महत् । अस्तं गते सहस्रांशौ संवृतं तमसेव हि ॥६-९०-३५॥
translation: As the sun sank down, darkness enveloped, everything was dark and dreadful in appearance. Streams of blood of thousands flowed.

raw: यो राजा पर्वत इन्द्राणाम् बहु किम्नर सेविनाम् । विहार सुखदो नित्यम् भ्रातुस् ते राक्षस अधिप ॥६-२७-२२॥
translation: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."

raw: यमेन्द्रवरुणानां च पदं यत्तव चेप्सितम् । तद्गच्छ त्वं हि धर्मज्ञ निधीशत्वमवाप्नुहि । शक्राम्बुपयमानां च चतुर्थस्त्वं भविष्यसि ॥७-३-१८॥
translation: Brahma continued, "O righteous one, attain that desired position alongside Yama, Indra, and Varuna; indeed, obtain the lordship of treasures, and you shall be the fourth among Indra, Varuna, and Yama."

raw: हरिश्शतवलिर्वीरः कोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । सर्वामेको ह्यावष्टभ्य ररक्ष हरिवाहिनीम् ॥६-४-३२॥
translation: Sathavali alone encircled by hundred crore vanara heroes was protecting the army of vanaras.

raw: या गतिः यज्ञ शीलानाम् आहित अग्नेः च या गतिः । अ पर आवर्तिनाम् या च या च भूमि प्रदायिनाम् ॥३-६८-२९॥
translation: O mighty lord of the birds by my grace attain the state of those who perform sacrifices, who kindle and maintain sacrificial fires, who beat no retreat from the battlefield and who offer land in charity. Purified by my offering of fire, you may depart for the best of the worlds.

raw: स्वयं रक्षोधिपश्चापि पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः । मृतेति संयुगे मुक्तो रामेणादित्यतेजसा ॥६-६०-७७॥
translation: "Rakshasa king, scion of sage Paulastya, an enemy of Devatas, was let off from death by Rama who has the splendour of Sun."

raw: दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायाः सीताया रावणस्य च । तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे हनुमद्वदनोन्मुखाः ॥५-५७-४९॥
translation: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.

raw: स महाईश्वर सख्येन श्लाघमानस् त्वया विभो । निर्जितः समरे रोषाल् लोक पालो महाबलः ॥६-७-५॥
translation: "O King Proud of his friendship with Lord Maheshwara (Siva), that mighty ruler of the world Kubera was subdued by you in the conflict."

raw: अद्य यज्ञ फलम् प्राप्तम् भगवद् दर्शनात् मया । धन्यो अस्मि अनुगृहीतो अस्मि यस्य मे मुनि पुंगव ॥१-५०-१४॥
स्पर्शानिवप्रहारांस्तान्वेद्वयानो न विव्यथे ऋषभंतुमहावेगंबाहुभ्यांपरिषस्वजे ॥६-६७-२६॥
translation: Their attacks were like soft touches to Kumbhakarna, and no pain was experienced by him, and he encircled Rshaba by the shoulders with great impetuosity.

raw: तत्त्वतो हि नरश्रेष्ठ बुद्ध्या समनुचिंतय । बुद्ध्या युक्ता महाप्राज्ञा विजानन्ति शुभ अशुभे ॥३-६६-१६॥
translation: O best among men judge the facts rightly with your intellect. The wise apply their minds and know what is right and what is wrong.

raw: वित्रस्तां परमोद्विग्नां वीक्षमाणां ततस्ततः । त्राणं किंचिदपश्यन्तीं वेपमानां तपस्विनीम् ॥५-५८-६६॥
translation: "Sita was full of fear and worry, looked here and there without any protector to pacify. She was trembling in fear. To that Sita, the tenheaded Ravana bent his head down and said, 'trust me and respect me'.

raw: आदर्श तल संकाशा ततो वै पृथिवी मया । अलात चक्र प्रतिमा दृष्टा गोष्पदवत् तदा - कृता ॥४-४६-१३॥
translation: Then I saw the earth as though it were the surface of a mirror, like a whirling firebrand, appearing as small as a cow's hoof-print.

raw: पश्य आश्रम पदम् रम्यम् दण्डकारण्य वासिनाम् । एषाम् तपस्विनाम् वीर तपसा भावित आत्मनाम् ॥३-८-१२॥
translation: O valient Rama the sages, living in the Dandaka forest, are self realised souls. See how delightful is the location of their hermitages.

raw: अभिवर्षति कामैः यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीम् इव । स काम पाश पर्यस्तः महा तेजा मही पतिः ॥२-३१-१२॥
translation: Dasaratha, the mighty king like Parjanya (the raingod), lord of the earth used to shower favours on earth. But now he is bound by the noose of passion.

raw: ततो भुक्तवताम् तेषाम् विप्राणाम् इल्वलो अब्रवीत् । वातापे निष्क्रमस्व इति स्वरेण महता वदन् ॥३-११-५८॥
translation: Then when the brahmins finished eating, Ilvala would call aloud, 'O Vatapi come out'.

raw: देशस्य रमणीयत्वात्पुलस्त्यो यत्र स द्विजः । गायन्त्यो वादयन्त्यश्च लासयन्त्यस्तथैव च । मुनेस्तपस्विनस्तस्य विघ्नं चक्रुरनिन्दिताः ॥७-२-११॥
translation: Due to the beauty of the place where the brahmin Pulastya resided, the blameless maidens, by singing, playing instruments, and dancing, caused an obstruction to that ascetic sage.

raw: क्रीडितः तु एष नः पुत्रान् बालान् उद्भ्रान्त चेतनः । सरय्वाम् प्रक्षिपन् मौर्ख्यात् अतुलाम् प्रीतिम् अश्नुते ॥२-३६-२२॥
translation: That insane (Asamanjasa) while throwing our children who were playing around into Sarayu river in his insanity derived incomparable pleasure'.

raw: गुरूणाम् गुरु कार्याणि काले काले अन्ववैक्षत । एवम् दशरथः प्रीतो ब्राह्मणा नैगमाः तथा ॥१-७७-२३॥
शिंशुपामलकीजम्ब्वो याश्चान्या: काननेषु ता: । मालती मल्लिका जातिर्याश्चान्या: कानने लता: ॥२-९१-५०॥
translation: Asohka, emblic myrobalan and all other trees found in the forest malati, mallika and jati creepers assumed the form of women, came over to the hermitage of Bharadwaja and said:

raw: इदम् हि सहितुम् शोकम् मुहूर्तम् अपि न उत्सहे । किम् पुनर् दश वर्षाणि त्रीणि च एकम् च दुह्खिता ॥२-३०-२१॥
translation: I cannot bear this grief even for a moment, what to speak of fourteen (ten and three and one) years of grieving.

raw: न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ ॥५-५९-६॥
translation: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.

raw: विवेष्टमाना पतिता समुद्रे जनक आत्मजा । आहो क्षुद्रेण च अनेन रक्षन्ती शीलम् आत्मनः ॥५-१३-११॥
क्रोधलोभे विमोक्तव्यौ कर्तव्या तपसे मतिः । न भेतव्यम् च भेतव्ये नित्यम् दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-२४॥
translation: Anger and greed have to be given up, with the mind preoccupied with ascetic practices. One should not be afraid of fearful situations. Hence forest (life) always very hard.

raw: कः स्थितः प्रतिहारो मे कस्य आज्ञा संप्रतीक्ष्यते । स्व गृहे को विचारो अस्ति यथा राज्यम् इदम् तव ॥१-७३-१४॥
translation: "Did any guard prevent you? Whose command are you waiting for? Why do you hesitate to enter into your own house? This kingdom is like your kingdom".

raw: स तं प्रमुच्य त्रिदशारिमर्जुनः प्रपूज्य दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः । अहिंसकं सख्यमुपेत्य साग्निकं प्रणम्य तं ब्रह्मसुतं गृहं ययौ ॥७-३३-१८॥
translation: Having released Ravana, the enemy of the gods, Arjuna honored him with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, then, having established a non-violent friendship witnessed by fire and bowed to Pulastya, the son of Brahma, he returned home.

raw: शोकात् भ्रष्ट स्वरम् अपि श्रुत्वा ते हरि यूथपाः । श्रद्दधुः न एव तत् वाक्यम् कर्मणा तस्य शन्किताः ॥४-५७-१॥
शीघ्रगस्य मरु: पुत्रो मरो: पुत्र: प्रशुश्रुक: । प्रशुश्रुकस्य पुत्रो ऽभूदम्बरीषो महाद्युति: ॥२-११०-२९॥
लताकण्टकसम्पूर्णाः कृकवाकूपनादिताः । निरपाश्च सुदुर्गाश्च मार्गा दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१०॥
translation: . The paths full of thorny creepers, echoing with the noise of wild fowls, and with no water (to drink) are difficult to tread. So forest is a source of suffering.

raw: स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव घोरैर्नागमयैः शरैः । बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राक्षसः ॥६-४४-३८॥
translation: The angry Rakshasa (remaining invisible) pierced arrows full of serpents all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.

raw: तपसा भावित आत्मानो धर्मस्य अनुग्रहे रताः । मुख्यैर् यज्नैर् यजन्त्य् एते नित्यम् तैस् तैर् द्विजातयः ॥६-३५-१९॥
translation: "Their power is difficult to overcome as they are pure souls and blazing like fire by their austerity. They follow virtues faithfully intending to acquire merit like brahmanas. They are standing firmly curbing their senses doing sacrifices offering oblations into sacrificial fires following tradition. Having subdued the Rakshasas, they are continuing to recite Vedas and on hearing Vedas the Rakshasas are running away in different directions like the rain cloud is scattered in the hot season."

raw: विभीषण त्वया वत्स धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना । परितुष्टो ऽस्मि धर्मात्मन्वरं वरय सुव्रत ॥७-१०-२८॥
translation: O Vibhishana, O dear child, I am greatly pleased by you, O righteous-souled one, whose intellect is aligned with dharma; therefore, O virtuous one, choose a boon.

raw: तम् दृष्ट्वा गिरि शृंग आभम् तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्रम् महा भुजम् । प्राद्रवन् मृत्यु संकाशम् भय आर्ता वन देवताः ॥३-४९-१८॥
translation: The sylvan deities fled out of fear on seeing the dreadful appearance of Ravana who had sharp teeth and mighty arms. He looked like a mountain, a veritable god of death.

raw: प्रहस्तवाक्यम् त्वहितम् निशम्य । विभीषणो राजहितानुकाङिक्षी । ततो महार्थम् वचनम् बभाषे । धर्मार्थकामेषु निविष्टबुद्धिः ॥६-१४-९॥
translation: Then Vibheeshana, wishing the welfare of the king, intent upon Dharma, artha and kama, thinking rightly and deeply, spoke these words on hearing Prahastha's words that were not good.

raw: सुग्रीवस्तु ततः प्राह रामम् सत्यपराक्रमम् । हनुमन्तम् त्वमारोह अङ्गदम् त्वथ लक्ष्मणः ॥६-२२-८०॥
translation: Sugriva addressed Rama of truthful valour and said, "You mount on heroic Hanuman, let Lakshmana climb on Angada. These Vanaras will hold you up in the sky and assist you to cross the ocean."

raw: किम् पुनर् मनुज इन्द्रेण स्वयम् पित्रा प्रचोदितः । तव च प्रिय काम अर्थम् प्रतिज्ञाम् अनुपालयन् ॥२-१९-८॥
translation: In order to keep the promise I shall do everything to fulfil your desire. Needless to say that my father has ordered this.

raw: बाष्प पर्याकुल मुखो राज मार्ग गतः जनः । न हृष्टः लक्ष्यते कश्चित् सर्वः शोक परायणः ॥२-४१-१७॥
translation: The faces of the people on the highway were turbid with tears. None looked happy. All were plunged in sorrow.

raw: तम् देशम् अहम् आगम्य दीन सत्त्वः सुदुर्मनाः । अपश्यम् इषुणा तीरे सरय्वाः तापसम् हतम् ॥२-६३-३८॥
translation: With dissipated energy and intensely troubled mind, I reached the bank of river Sarayu and there I saw the ascetic lying struck by the arrow and with scattered locks of hair. The water pitcher was thrown away and his body smeared with blood and dust as he lay on the ground.

raw: युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः । विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च ॥५-५४-१३॥
translation: The brilliant monkey leader bypassed Vibhishanas's house and avoiding it that way set fire to the mansions of other ogres, Rasmiketu, Suryasatru, Hrasvakarna, Vajradamshtra, Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhwajagriva, Vidyujjihva, Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha, Sonitaksha, Kumbhakarna, Makaraksha, Yagnasatru, Brahmasatru, Naranthaka, Kumbha, and wicked Nikumbha.

raw: राज पुत्रः पितुर् वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन् । स कक्ष्या धन्विभिर्गुप्तास्तिस्रोऽतिक्रम्य वाजिभिः ॥२-१७-२०॥
तस्मिन् सन्धीयमाने तु राघवेण शरोत्तमे । सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुश्चचाल च वसुन्धरा स रावणाय सङ्क्रुद्धो भृशमायम्य कार्मुकम् । चिक्षेप परमायत्तस्तं शरं मर्मघातिनम् ॥६-१११-१५॥
दक्षिणो दक्षिणम् बाहुम् असक्तम् असिना ततः । चिच्छेद रामो वेगेन सव्यम् वीरः तु लक्ष्मणः ॥३-७०-९॥
translation: While standing on the right, Rama cut off his right arm and the brave Lakshmana cut off the left.

raw: अङ्गदस्तु रणे शत्रुं निहन्तुं समुपस्थितः । रावणिं निजघानाशु सारथिं च हयानपि ॥६-४४-२८॥
translation: Angada who was determined to kill the enemies, in no time wounded Ravana's charioteer and also the horses.

raw: सम्पृक्तं नभसाप्यम्भस्सम्पृक्तं च नभोऽम्भसा । तादृग्रूपेच दृश्यते तारारत्नसमाकुले ॥६-४-११९॥
translation: The ocean and the sky filled with gems and stars respectively appeared alike.

raw: ब्रवीहि कोऽद्यैव मया वियुज्यताम् तवा सुहृत्प्राणयशस्सुहृज्जनैः । यथा तवेयं वसुधा वशे भवे त्तथैव मां शाधि तवास्मि किङ्करः ॥२-२३-४०॥
translation: Tell me your enemy who should be deprived of his life, fame and friends. Command me as to how this earth shall come under your control. Now itself I shall do that. I am your servant.

raw: ततः तदा बहु विध भावित आत्मनः । कृत आत्मनो जनक सुताम् सुवर्त्मनः । अपश्यतो अभवद् अतिदुह्खितम् मनः । सुचक्षुषः प्रविचरतो महात्मनः ॥५-७-१७॥
translation: Unable to find Sita, the disciplined and foresighted Hanuman, who always kept the righteous path, felt distressed while moving about, his mind oppressed by all kinds of thought. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: इच्चामि सरितः शैलान् पल्वलानि वनानि च । द्रष्टुम् सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता ॥२-२७-१६॥
translation: Living with you sans fear, O my sagacious husband, I wish to see the rivers, mountains, lakes and forests here and there.

raw: स शरैरतिविद्धाङ्गो रुधिरेण समुक्षितः । शुशुभे लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् विधूम इव पावकः ॥६-८८-२०॥
translation: With shafts pierced all over, glorious Lakshmana was bathed in blood and shone like smokeless fire.

raw: अयोध्यां च ततो दृष्ट्वा पित्रा भ्रात्रा विवर्जिताम् । भरतो दु:खसन्तप्त: सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-११३-२४॥
translation: On seeing the city of Ayodhya bereft of his father and brothers, Bharata, consumed with grief, said to the charioteer:

raw: अहो निश्चेतनो राजा जीव लोकस्य सम्प्रियम् । धर्म्यम् सत्य व्रतम् रामम् वन वासो प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-४१-६॥
translation: Alas, the king must be devoid of any sense as he is sending away Rama, who is dear to the world, is righteous and truthful, to dwell in the forest.

raw: पितृव्यौ चापि सन्दृश्य समरे सन्निषूदितौ । युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौ राक्षसर्षभौ ॥६-७१-२॥
translation: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

raw: उच्यन्तां वानराः सर्वे यन्त्रमेतत् समुच्छ्रितम् । इति विज्ञाय हरयो भविष्यन्तीह निर्भयाः ॥६-६१-३३॥
translation: "Let all the Vanaras be told, that this one standing high is a machine then the Vanaras will not be scared of victory."

raw: मैथिली रक्ष्यमाणा तु राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता । ददर्श राक्षसं क्रुद्धं निस्त्रिंशवरधारिणम् ॥६-९३-४७॥
कुमारानागताञ्छ्रुत्वा चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः । अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना द्वाःस्थं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥७-४४-१२॥
translation: Having heard that the princes had arrived, Rama, with his senses agitated by worry, a downcast face, and a distressed mind, spoke to the doorkeeper.

raw: मयि भावो हि वैदेह्याः तत्त्वतो विनिवेशितः । मम अपि भावः सीतायाम् सर्वधा विनिवेशितः ॥४-१-५२॥
translation: 'Sita has her love truly fixed in me. My love for her is equally steadfast.

raw: सीतायास्तेजसा दग्धां रामकोपप्रपीडिताम् । दह्यमानामिमां पश्य पुरीं साट्टप्रतोलिकाम् ॥५-५१-३६॥
translation: "Visualize this city of Lanka including its marketplaces and main streets as burnt by Sita's power of chastity and Rama's anger.

raw: स सुहृज् जनम् आमन्त्र्य वन वासाय निश्चितः । इष्क्वाकु गुरुम् आमन्त्र्य जग्राह आयुधम् उत्तमम् ॥२-३१-३०॥
translation: Lakshmana, who was resolved to go to the forest, took leave of his friends, and collected from the house of Vasistha, preceptor of the Ikshvaku race, the powerful weapons deposited with him.

raw: एकेनसहसङ्गम्यरामेणरणमूर्धनि अह्नश्चतुर्थभागेननिःशेषाराक्षसाःकृताः ॥६-१२९-१८॥
translation: "Rama alone in a day finished fourteen thousand Rakshasas standing alone in the forefront of the combat".

raw: निवृत्तवनवासम् तम् द्रष्टासि पुनरागतम् । जहिशोकम् च मोहम् च देवि सत्यम् ब्रवीमि ते ॥२-४४-२१॥
translation: I tell you the truth, Kausalya, that you will see Rama's return when the period of exile is complete. Hence give up your sorrow and delusion.

raw: अशोकोविजयश्चैवसिद्धार्थश्चसमाहिताः । मन्त्रयन्रामवृध्यर्थंबुध्यर्थंनगरस्य च ॥६-१३१-२४॥
translation: Ashoka, Vijaya, Siddhartha, collected together and started consulting with each other for the growth of Rama and the City.

raw: स त्वमस्मद्धितार्थाय जहि तान्मधुसूदन । शरणं त्वां वयं प्राप्ता गतिर्भव सुरेश्वर ॥७-६-१५॥
translation: O Madhusudana, for our welfare, you must destroy them; we have sought refuge in you, so be our protector, O Lord of gods.

raw: औत्सुक्यं परमं चापि अधृतिश्च परा मम । शून्यामेव च पश्यामि पृथिवीं पृथुलोचन ॥७-४६-१५॥
translation: I also have extreme anxiety and great restlessness, and indeed, O broad-eyed one, I see the earth as empty.

raw: ज्वालामाली स तु शरः क्रव्यादानुगतो रणे । मुक्तो गुल्मान्द्रुमांश्चापि भस्म कृत्वा प्रधावति ॥७-२१-४४॥
translation: That arrow, wreathed in flames and followed by flesh-eating demons, once released in battle, rushed forward, turning bushes and even trees into ashes.

raw: कान्ता देव मनुष्याणाम् यस्याम् लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता । एताम् च मालाम् ताराम् च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम् ॥६-२८-३२॥
translation: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

raw: विशेषेण तु सुग्रीवो हनूमति अर्थम् उक्तवान् । स हि तस्मिन् हरि श्रेष्ठे निश्चितार्थो अर्थ साधने ॥४-४४-१॥
translation: Sugriva mentioned about the capacity of Hanuman, the best of monkeys as he knew he would surely succeed in accomplishing the task.

raw: पाणिप्रदानकाले च यत्पुरा त्वग्निसन्निधौ । अनुशिष्टा जनन्या ऽस्मि वाक्यं तदपि मे धृतम् ॥२-११८-८॥
translation: When I have been taught by my mother earlier, at the time of bestowal of my hand to Rama in the presence of the sacrificial fire (as witness) is etched in my mind.

raw: सुप्यते पर्ण शय्यासु स्वयम् भग्नासु भू तले । रात्रिषु श्रम खिन्नेन तस्मात् दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-११॥
translation: Exhausted with struggles one has to sleep at night on a bed of leaves fallen on their own on the ground. Therefore, forest life is extremely painful.

raw: शतक्रतुमुखैर्वीरैःश्रूयते न पराजितः महात्माबलसम्पन्नोरावणोलोकरावणः ॥६-११४-९९॥
translation: "Though he is richly endowed with prowess, he is a tyranny to the world, who has performed a hundred sacrifices (like Indra) and never got defeated, I heard."

raw: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्पर: । पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं जनको विस्मितो ऽभवत् ॥२-११८-२९॥
translation: Engaged in sowing fistfuls of seeds, king Janaka found me covered with dust and was astonished.

raw: भस्मना च आवृतम् सर्वम् सम्मूढम् इव तत् बलम् । वसिष्ठ ऋषयः च अन्ये राजा च ससुतः तदा ॥१-७४-१५॥
अंजनाया वचः श्रुत्वा मारुतः प्रत्यभाषत । न त्वाम् हिंसामि सुश्रोणि मा भूत् ते मनसोइ भयम् ॥४-६६-१७॥
translation: 'On hearing Anjana's words, the Windgod replied, ' O auspicious lady, I do you no harm, O lady of beautiful hips. I reached (enjoyed) you in mind, not body. You need not fear.'

raw: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता । यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति ॥६-११७-९॥
translation: "Vaidehi! Anointed with a wonderful fragrance, decked with beautiful ornaments, auspicious and ascending the palanquin, your husband desires to see you."

raw: न तेषु अहस्सु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वा न दृश्यते । न अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन् न अशत अनुचरः तथा ॥१-१४-११॥
translation: During the days (of sacrifice) none felt tired or hungry. There was no brahmin who was not learned or had less than a hundred followers (or disciples).

raw: यदि गच्छति पतालम् ततो अभ्यऽधिकम् एव वा । सर्वधा रावणः तात न भविष्यति राघव ॥४-१-११७॥
translation: 'Even if Ravana escapes into the nether world or into a world still lower, he cannot save himself by any means, O Rama

raw: सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः । अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ॥७-९१-२१॥
translation: Bharata should go forth at the head, having placed many crores of gold and hundreds more of other gold wealth, with careful arrangement.

raw: पूर्वंतुभरतेस्नातेलक्ष्मणे च महाबले । सुग्रीवेवानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रेविभीषणे विशोधितजटस्स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः । महार्हवसनोपेतस्तस्थौतत्रश्रियाज्वलन् ॥६-१३१-१४॥
translation: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

raw: एते तिष्ठन्तु गच्छामो भर्ता नो यत्र वानरः । सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सह रामेण तिष्ठति ॥५-६२-३१॥
translation: "Let them stay here. Our broadnecked king Sugriva will be there with Rama. Let us go to him.

raw: चण्डाल रूपिणम् राम मुनिः कारुण्यम् आगतः । कारुण्यात् स महातेजा वाक्यम् परम धार्मिकः ॥१-५७-१४॥
ततः अहम् तैः समागम्य समेतैः अभिषेचितः । राज्यम् प्रशासतः तस्य न्यायतो मम राघव ॥४-९-२१॥
translation: 'Then all the ministers assembled together and consecrated me. While I was ruling the kingdom lawfully, Vali, the monkey came back after killing the enemy demon.

raw: पश्यामि त्वाम् सुखम् वत्स सुस्थितम् राज वेश्मनि । प्रणष्टकुःखसम्कल्पा हर्षविद्योतितानना ॥२-२५-४२॥
तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धाम् प्राविशम् पुनः । विषादात् इह माम् दृष्ट्वा पोउरैः मंत्रिभिर् एव च ॥४-१०-६॥
न मे गर्वितम् आयस्तम् सहिष्यति दुरात्मवान् । कृतम् तारे सहायत्वम् दर्शितम् सौहृदम् मयि ॥४-१६-९॥
translation: 'That evilminded Sugriva cannot bear my mighty, hard blows. Tara you could shower your affection on me and extend help (in passing secret information obtained through Angada)

raw: पूर्वकाले महाबाहो ये प्रजापतयो अभवन् । तान् मे निगदतः सर्वान् आदितः शृणु राघव ॥३-१४-६॥
translation: O mightyarmed Rama hear from me while I am telling you about the lords of creation from the very beginning.

raw: पुत्रैः अनुगतः श्रीमान् श्रीमद्भिः च महायशाः । प्रविवेश गृहम् राजा हिमवत् सदृशम् प्रियम् ॥१-७७-९॥
translation: Prosperous king Dasaratha of great fame followed by his elegant sons entered the city of Ayodhya while the citizens and brahmins came forward from a long distance to welcome him who reentered his palace looking like the Himalayan mountain.

raw: स तत्र मणि भूमीः च राजतीः च मनो रमाः । तथा कान्चन भूमीः च विचरन् ददृशे कपिः ॥५-१४-२१॥
translation: Roaming there the monkey noticed the beautiful floors paved with gems, gold and silver৷৷

raw: न ह्येष राम सुग्रीवो भ्राम्यमाणो ऽपि वालिना ॥७-३६-४२॥
translation: O Rama, indeed, this Sugriva, even when being tossed about by Vali, is not the one (who is unaware of his own strength).

raw: वज्रम् अस्त्रम् नरश्रेष्ठ शैवम् शूलवरम् तथा । अस्त्रम् ब्रह्मशिरः च एव ऐषीकम् अपि राघव ॥१-२७-६॥
translation: Mighty armed, heroic Rama I shall grant you the great celestial dandachakra. O best among men I shall grant you dharmachakra, kalachakra, visnuchakra, indraastra, vajraastra and the great, trident of Siva, brahmashirastra, ishika astra and highly superior brahmaastra.

raw: ते तु रामेण बाणौघैः सर्वे मर्मसु ताडिताः । युद्धादपसृतास्तत्र सावशेषायुषो ऽभवन् ॥६-४४-२१॥
translation: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

raw: स ददर्श ततः श्रीमान् सुग्रीवम् हेम पिङ्गलम् । सुसंवीतम् अवष्टब्धम् दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम् ॥४-१६-१५॥
translation: There Vali saw Sugriva in lustrous, red gold complexion standing ready for a combat steady like glowing fire.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महापार्श्वो ऽब्रवीद्वचः । बलाध्यक्षान् स्थितांस्तत्र बलं सन्त्वर्यतामिति ॥६-९६-२२॥
translation: On hearing the speech of Ravana, Mahaparsva enjoined the mighty leaders of the army standing there and spoke as follows.

raw: असौ तु सागरो भीमः सेतुकर्मदिदृक्षया । ददौ दण्डभयाद्गाधम् राघवाय महोदधिः ॥६-२२-४८॥
translation: This fearsome ocean of mighty Sagara (dug by Sagara) then allowed a passage for Rama, out of fear of punishment and also to witness the building of a bridge.

raw: भुजश्च चार्वञ्चितपीनवृत्तः परार्ध्यकालागरुचन्दनार्हः । अनुत्तमेनाध्युषितः प्रियेण चिरेण वामः समवेपताशु ॥५-२९-३॥
translation: Her stout left arm curved beautifully, fit for excellent agaru and sandal paste once the pillow by her beloved lord for long, throbbed suddenly.

raw: अङ्कोलांश्च करञ्चांश्च प्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्दुकान् । जम्बुकामलकान्नापान्भजन्ति स्म प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-४-७५॥
translation: Vanaras went adoring the Ankola, Karanja, Plaksa, Nyagrodha, Jambu,Amla and neepa trees.

raw: शत्रुघ्नस्त्वब्रवीत्सर्वान्कौतूहलसमन्वितान् । सैनिका न क्षमो ऽस्माकं परिप्रष्टुमिहेदृशः ॥७-७१-२२॥
translation: But Shatrughna said to all the curious soldiers, "O soldiers, it is not proper for us to make such inquiries here."

raw: कान्ता इव युवती कान्तम् समुद्रम् अवगाहते । ततो हेममयम् दिव्यम् मुक्ता मणि विभूषितम् ॥४-४१-१८॥
ताम् कथाम् कौशिको रामे निवेद्य मधुर अक्षरम् । पुनः एव अपरम् वाक्यम् काकुत्स्थम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३८-१॥
translation: Viswamitra, an offspring of Kusika having related the story (of Karthikeya) to the son of the Kakusthas (Rama) said again.

raw: अत्र यात्राम् समीहन्तम् शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः । भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-७८-१॥
translation: As the griefstricken Bharata was intending to proceed to Rama, Lakshmana's younger brother Satrughna said to him:

raw: प्रनष्टे तु शरीरे ऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा । तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं सुखम् ॥७-७८-२९॥
translation: Indeed, when his body perished, that royal sage, the king, filled with supreme joy, satisfied and greatly delighted, happily ascended to heaven.

raw: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम् । यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम् ॥७-८८-१०॥
translation: He was performing intense and formidable penance in the midst of water, established in compassion, bestowing fame and fulfilling desires.

raw: अभिवाद्य च काकुत्स्थः सर्वांस्तांस्त्रिदशोत्तमान् । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा ॥६-१२३-२३॥
translation: Then greeting all the jewels among gods present there, accompanied by brother Lakshmana, Kakuthsa Rama ordered all Vanaras to go home and rest.

raw: भार्या मम इयम् वैदेही कल्याणी जनक आत्मजा । माम् च अनुयाता विजनम् तपो वनम् अनिन्दिता ॥२-५४-१४॥
translation: This blessed one is my consort, Sita, daughter of Janaka. Irreproachable she has followed me to the desolate grove of penance (hermitage).

raw: स मुष्टिनिष्पष्टविभिन्नवक्षा ज्वालावमच्छोणितदिग्धगात्रः । नरान्तको भूमितले पपात यथा ऽचलो वज्रनिपातभग्नः ॥६-६९-९८॥
translation: Naranthaka's chest having been split by a blow on his chest, vomiting flaming blood from his throat was as if shattered by the stroke of lightning fell down like a mountain.

raw: कृतम् चेत् न अभिजानीषे राघवस्य महात्मनः । सद्यः त्वम् निशितैर् बाणैर् हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम् ॥४-३४-१७॥
translation: 'If you do not recognise the help of Rama who can accomplish any deed with ease, you will be killed with my sharp arrows and meet Vali (in heaven).

raw: शोकाभितप्ता बहुधा विचिन्त्य सीता ऽथ वेण्युद्ग्रथनं गृहीत्वा । उद्बध्य वेण्युद्ग्रथनेन शीघ्रमहं गमिष्यामि यमस्य मूलम् ॥५-२८-१८॥
translation: "Burning in grief, worrying in many ways, Sita took hold of her braid and said", by tying myself with this braid I shall quickly reach the presence of the lord of death".

raw: तपो बल हतान् ज्ञात्वा वासिष्ठान् स महोदयान् । ऋषि मध्ये महातेजा विह्वामित्रो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-६०-१॥
translation: The most brilliant Viswamitra, having destroyed the sons of Vasishta including Mahodaya by his ascetic power, said this in the midst of saints:

raw: न हि मे अविदितम् किम्चिद् वने अस्मिमः चरतः सदा । चतुर् अन्गम् ह्य् अपि बलम् प्रसहेम वयम् युधि ॥२-८६-८॥
translation: Nothing is unknown to me in this forest in which I range about continually. We can withstand an army of four divisions in a battle.

raw: धातुभिर्मण्डितः शैलो विविधैर्हमवानिव । एकावलीमध्यगतम् तरलम् पाण्डरप्रभम् ॥६-२२-२१॥
translation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

raw: शक्तस्त्वमात्मना ऽ ऽत्मानं विनेतुं मनसैव हि । लोकान्सर्वांश्च काकुत्स्थ किं पुनः शोकमात्मनः ॥७-५२-१३॥
translation: O Kakutstha, you are surely capable of controlling your own self and indeed all worlds by your mind, so how much more easily can you control your own sorrow?

raw: तथा विलपताम् तेषामतृप्तानाम् च राघवः । अचक्षुरिषयम् प्रायाद्यथार्कः क्षणदामुखे ॥२-५०-७॥
translation: Not yet satisfied (they wanted to linger longer), they stood weeping, while Rama went out of sight just as the Sun disappears at nightfall.

raw: ऐङ्गुदं बदरीमिश्रं पिण्याकं दर्भसंस्तरे । न्यस्य राम: सुदु:खार्त्तो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०२-२९॥
translation: Placing the balls of ingudi pulp mixed with badari fruit on a spread of darbha grass, Rama, was overcome with grief and weeping, said:

raw: वीर्य हीनम् इव अशक्तम् क्षत्र धर्मेण भार्गव । अवजानासि मे तेजः पश्य मे अद्य पराक्रमम् ॥१-७६-३॥
translation: You underrate me O Bhargava as though I am devoid of valour and incompetent to perform the duties of a Kshatriya. Now witness my energy and valour.

raw: कीदृशो वै प्रभावो ऽस्य किं बलं कः पराक्रमः । केन वा कारणेनैष रावणादतिरिच्यते ॥७-१-४०॥
translation: The speaker asks about Indrajit's power, strength, and prowess, and by what reason he is considered superior to Ravana himself.

raw: जीवितं त्यक्तुमिच्छामि शोकेन महता वृता । राक्षसीभिश्च रक्षन्त्या रामो नासाद्यते मया ॥५-२३-१९॥
शोधयित्वा जनस्थानं प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च । तीर्त्वा सागरमक्षोभ्यं भ्रातरौ गोष्पदे हतौ ॥६-४८-१५॥
translation: "Having gained Janasthana and crossing the ocean which is impossible knowing about my whereabouts and getting me is impossible since the brothers have been killed by the maya of Indrajith whose footprints are like a cow's hoof."

raw: अत्र ब्रूहि यथा तत्त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः । यस्य त्वम् लोक नाथस्य हृत्वा भार्याम् गमिष्यसि ॥३-५०-१५॥
translation: On account of Surpanakha, Khara trespassed into Janasthana and got killed by Rama, without much effort. Tell me truly, what transgression (of dharma) did he commit for which you are stealing away the wife of Rama who is the lord of this world?.

raw: क्रुद्धः परिलिहन् वक्त्रम् जिह्वया वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । स्वैरम् कुर्वन्तु कार्याणि भवन्तो विगत ज्वराः ॥६-८-२२॥
अतिबल बलम् आश्रितः तव अहम्हरि वर विक्रम विक्रमैः अनल्पैः । पवन सुत यथा अधिगम्यते साजनक सुता हनुमन् तथा कुरुष्व ॥४-४४-१७॥
translation: O Hanuman son of the Windgod, O valiant among the Vanaras, I bank on your strength. Do whatever you can with your mighty valour so that the daughter of Janaka can be found. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे देवेश शैलराजसुतां हरः । रमयामास दुर्धर्षः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह ॥७-८७-११॥
translation: In that region, the unassailable Hara, the lord of gods, sported with Parvati, the daughter of the king of mountains, accompanied by all his attendants.

raw: वीर्योत्सेकेन दुष्टात्मा वरदानाच्च मोहितः । जगाम सुमहाकाय स्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम् ॥४-११-८॥
translation: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.

raw: अथवा मृग शाब अक्षीम् मृग जानासि मैथिलीम् । मृग विप्रेक्षणी कांता मृगीभिः सहिता भवेत् ॥३-६०-२३॥
translation: Or, O deer do you know about Maithili who has the eyes of a fawn? My beloved who has the restless eyes of a doe may be found in their company.

raw: तया परुषम् उक्तः तु कुपितो राघव अनुजः । स विकांक्षन् भृशम् रामम् प्रतस्थे न चिरात् इव ॥३-४६-१॥
translation: Lakshmana, brother of Rama, hurt by the harsh words of Sita, hastened with Rama's wellbeing in mind.

raw: स मामुपागतः क्रुद्धो वज्रमुद्यम्य देवराट् । ततोऽहं सहसा क्षिप्तः स्वसनेन महात्मना ॥५-१-१२६॥
translation: "Angry Indra held the thunderbolt and came towards me chasing. At that time the great Wind-god tossed me into the air and dropped me down at once.

raw: गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः । मन्त्रयुत्वा ततश्चक्रे निश्चयज्ञः स निश्चयम् ॥२-४-१॥
translation: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.

raw: आनुद्धतमना विद्वान् धर्मात्मा भ्रातृवत्सलः । यधा च भ्रातृषु स्निग्धस्तथास्मास्वपि राघवः ॥२-६-२३॥
translation: This scion of the Raghus (Rama) is free from arrogance, is learned, righteous and affectionate towards his brothers as much as towards us.

raw: आगतस्तु पथा येन तेनैव विनिवृत्य सः । लङ्कामभिमुखो रक्षो नभस्तलगतो ययौ ॥७-२३-५४॥
translation: Having arrived by a certain path, the demon Ravana returned by that very path, flying through the sky towards Lanka. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोविंशः सर्गः ।। 23 ।। Thus ends the twenty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः । देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनःपुनः ॥६-१०४-८॥
translation: Firmly established the Asuras uttered 'Victory to the Ten headed Ravana', and Devas for their part pronounced 'Rama be victorious' again and again.

raw: स्वयम् गत्वा दशरथम् नरेन्द्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । अयम् रक्षतु माम् रामः पर्व काले समाहितः ॥३-३८-४॥
कृत्वाभिषेकं सुतयोर्द्वयो राघवनन्दन । तवानुगमने राजन्विद्धि मां कृतनिश्चयम् ॥७-१०८-१४॥
translation: O delight of the Raghus, O King, know that I am resolute in following you, having performed the consecration of both my sons.

raw: स्थितम् आवृत्य पन्थानम् तयोः भ्रात्रोः प्रपन्नयोः । अथ तम् समतिक्रम्य क्रोश मात्रम् ददर्शतुः ॥३-६९-३३॥
छत्रंतस्य च जग्राहशत्रघ्नःपाण्डुरंशुभम् श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंसुग्रीवोवानरेश्वरः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ॥६-१३१-६८॥
translation: Shatrughna held white auspicious parasol, Sugriva the Vanara Lord held a white whisk, Vibheeshana the Lord of Rakshasas held a white whisk shining like the moon.

raw: अथ सङ्क्षीयमाणेषु राक्षसेषु समन्ततः । सुग्रीवेण प्रभग्नेषु पतत्सु निनदत्सु च ॥६-९७-१३॥
translation: And thereafter, all the Rakshasas shattered by Sugriva, tormented, fallen on the ground were shouting. Seeing that Virupaksha, himself, who is difficult to encounter, holding his bow, announcing his name, jumped from the chariot onto an elephant in a rut.

raw: तम् जाग्रतम् गुणैर् युक्तम् वर चाप इषु धारिणम् । भ्रातृ गुप्त्य् अर्थम् अत्यन्तम् अहम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवम् ॥२-८६-२॥
translation: I spoke to the virtuous Lakshmana, who was holding arrows, bow and sword in his hand and keeping awake completely for the protection of his brother.

raw: नदी निलयनाः सर्पा नदी कुटिल गामिनः । तिष्ठन्ति आवृत्य पन्थानम् अतः दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-२०॥
translation: The serpents that live in and move like meandering rivers always obstruct the paths. Therefore, living in the forest is tremendously difficult.

raw: काले धर्मार्थकामान् यः सम्मन्त्र्य सचिवैः सह । निषेवेतात्मवान् लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ॥६-६३-१२॥
translation: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."

raw: सुतौ दशरथस्येमौ धनुर्दर्शनकांक्षिणौ । धनुर्दर्शय रामाय राजपुत्राय दैविकम् ॥२-११८-४६॥
translation: 'Both these sons of king Dasaratha wish to see the bow. Show the divine bow to prince Rama'.

raw: सागरः च मया क्रान्तः श्रीमान् नद नदी पतिः । अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्याः पुरी च इयम् निरीक्षिता ॥५-१६-१२॥
translation: "On account of the largeeyed Sita I ventured to cross the lord of rivers, the sea, and came to this city.

raw: तस्मात् प्राणान् धरिष्यामि ध्रुवो जीवति सम्गमः । एवम् बहु विधम् दुह्खम् मनसा धारयन् मुहुः ॥५-१३-४८॥
यस्य यस्य यथा कामम् षड् रसेषु अभिपूजितम् । तत् सर्वम् काम धुक् दिव्ये अभिवर्ष कृते मम ॥१-५२-२२॥
translation: O Kamadhenu quickly entertain them for my sake with the food of six kinds of tastes (varieties of rich dishes) as desired by each.

raw: सत्यनामानि पद्मानि स्त्रीणामुक्तानि लक्षणैः । तान्यद्य निहते रामे वितथानि भवन्ति मे ॥६-४८-८॥
translation: "Characteristic marks of lotuses, unfailing in their effect (truthful) predicted are all false if Rama is killed."

raw: अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च । मासे पूर्णे निवर्तध्वम् उदयम् प्राप्य पर्वतम् ॥४-४०-६९॥
translation: 'Reaching the mountain behind which the sun rises, look for Vaidehi and the home of Ravana and return by the month's end.

raw: स यथा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न विदर्शयेत् । स तां नानुभवेत्प्रीतिं यस्य हेतो: प्ररोपित: ॥२-१०५-९॥
translation: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)

raw: बहवः पार्थिवाः सौम्य हताः सबलवाहनाः । लवणेन महाबाहो युध्यमाना महाबलाः ॥७-७१-७॥
translation: O gentle and mighty-armed one, many very powerful kings, along with their armies and vehicles, were killed by Lavana while fighting him.

raw: उपासाम् चक्रतुर् वीरौ यत्तौ परम धन्विनौ । ररक्षतुर् मुनिवरम् विश्वामित्रम् अरिंदमौ ॥१-३०-६॥
translation: The two mighty, heroic archers (Rama and Lakshmana), destroyers of enemies attended upon the sacrifice in order to protect sage Viswamitra.

raw: तथा शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः शरा नारायणेरिताः । निर्धावन्तीषवस्तूर्णं शतशोथ सहस्रशः ॥७-७-१९॥
translation: Similarly, arrows released from the Śārṅga bow and propelled by Nārāyaṇa rushed forth swiftly by hundreds and thousands.

raw: उत्तरम् तीरम् आसाद्य संपूज्य ऋषि गणम् ततः । गंगा कूले निविष्टाः ते विशालाम् ददृशुः पुरीम् ॥१-४५-९॥
translation: Having reached the northern bank, they paid homage to the sages encamped on the bank of Ganga and beheld the city of Vishala.

raw: मणि रत्नम् सुवर्णम् वा गावो यद् वा समुद्यतम् । तत् प्रयच्छ नरश्रेष्ट धरण्या न प्रयोजनम् ॥१-१४-४९॥
translation: O best of men give us gems or gold or cows or whichever is readily available. We have no use with this earth".

raw: नाम्ना सुदर्शनम् नाम राजहंसैः समाकुलम् । विबुधाः चारणा यक्षाः किन्नराः स अप्सरो गणाः ॥४-४०-४६॥
ते नयंति परम् तीरम् सिद्धान् प्रत्यानयन्ति च । उत्तराः कुरवः तत्र कृत पुण्य प्रतिश्रियाः ॥४-४३-३८॥
राहुशत्रो: प्रियां पत्नीं श्रिया प्रज्वलितप्रभाम् । ग्रहेणाभ्युत्थिते नैकां रोहिणीमिव पीडिताम् ॥२-११४-३॥
translation: (The city looked) like Rohini, the beloved consort of the Moon, the star which was majesticlly radiating flaming brilliance and now, tormented by the exalted Rahu which has eclipsed the Moon, shines alone.

raw: मुक्ता मणि समायुक्तैर् भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम् । विभूषयन्तीम् इव च स्व श्रिया भवन उत्तमम् ॥५-१०-५१॥
translation: Then the vanara saw a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

raw: स्थली प्राय वनोद्देशे पिप्पली वन शोभिते । बहु पुष्प फले रम्ये नाना विहग नादिते ॥३-११-३८॥
translation: This plain land in the beautiful forest tract is adorned with fig trees,filled with flowers, fruits, and delightful sounds of different birds.

raw: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् । वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्र द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ॥५-३९-४९॥
translation: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.

raw: पर दार अभिमर्षात् तु न अनयत् पाप तरम् महत् । प्रमदानाम् सहस्राणि तव राजन् परिग्रहे ॥३-३८-३०॥
translation: O king there is no sin greater than violating the chastity of others wives, when you have married a thousand lovely women.

raw: पाद प्रहारैः तु मया बहुभिः परिपातितम् । ततः अहम् तेन निष्क्रम्य पथा पुरम् उपागतः ॥४-१०-२४॥
translation: 'I kicked the boulder again and again till it yielded. I came out that way and arrived at the city.

raw: बभूव हृष्टा वैदेही भर्तारम् परिष्वजे । मुदा परमया युक्ता दृष्ट्वा रक्षो गणान् हतान् । रामम् च एव अव्ययम् दृष्टा तुतोष जनक आत्मजा ॥३-३०-४०॥
translation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, was happy to see the demons killed by Rama who himself was unhurt.

raw: चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैव पुरस्तादभिसेवितम् ॥६-२१-४॥
translation: The very charming shoulders, smeared with sandal paste and Agaru fragrance emitting the brilliance of the rising Sun.

raw: क्षिप्रं वनमिदं सौम्य नरसङ्घै: समन्तत: । लुब्धैश्च सहितैरेभिस्त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि ॥२-९८-३॥
translation: O dear Satrughna, you should explore this forest quickly along with groups of our people and hunters as well.

raw: शनैः विसृज्यते संध्या नभो नेत्रैः इव आवृतम् । नक्षत्र तारा गहनम् ज्योतिर्भिः अवभासते ॥१-३४-१६॥
translation: Evening has gradually disappeared. The sky is littered with stars and planets gleaming points of light as though they are the eyes of the skies.

raw: पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात् । इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः ॥२-१४-४३॥
तान् आनय यथा क्षिप्रम् स अनुगान् सह बान्धवान् । एतान् दूतैः महाभागैः आनयस्व नृप आज्ञ्या ॥१-१३-२९॥
ततो ऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं कृतवांस्तत्र रावणः । निवातकवचैः सार्धं प्रीतिमानभवत्तदा ॥७-२३-१४॥
translation: Then, Ravana established a friendship with the Nivātakavachas, with fire as witness, and became delighted at that time.

raw: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता । तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति ॥७-२६-५६॥
translation: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.

raw: मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति च न भाति च । मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम् ॥५-१७-२६॥
मैथिलीं सान्त्वयस्वैनामनुरक्तां तपस्विनीम् । शत्रुघ्नं च महात्मानं मातऽः सर्वाः परन्तप ॥६-१२३-२०॥
यदि रामः समुद्रान्ताम् मेदिनीम् परिवर्तयेत् । अस्याः कृते जगत् च अपि युक्तम् इति एव मे मतिः ॥५-१६-१३॥
translation: "Even if Rama turns this land stretching to the ocean upside down or even the entire world on account of her, it is justifiable, according to me.

raw: धर्षयित्वा च काकुत्स्थौ न शक्यं जीवितुं त्वया । युद्ध्यस्व नरदेवेन लक्ष्मणेन रणे सह । हतस्त्वं देवताकार्यं करिष्यसि यमक्षये ॥६-८७-२९॥
translation: "Clashing with Lakshmana of Kakuthsa clan is not possible for you. By waging war with Lakshmana, you will be killed and reaching the abode of the Lord of death. You will be doing tasks of deities of Devatas."

raw: एवम् स न्यवसत् तत्र सर्व कामैः सुपूजितः । ऋष्यशृङ्गो महातेजा शन्ताया सह भार्यया ॥१-१०-३३॥
ततः सर्वाण्यनीकानि स्थापयित्वा विभीषणः । आजगाम गदापाणिस्त्वरितो यत्र राघवः ॥६-४९-३२॥
translation: Thereafter, Vibheeshana, settling all the army, hastened to reach Raghava with a mace.

raw: ततः खड्गेन महता हत्वा तामिन्द्रिजित् स्वयम् । हृष्टः स रथमास्थाय विननाद महास्वनम् ॥६-८१-३४॥
translation: Indrajith himself with his long sword killed her, then rejoiced, he ascended the chariot and roared in a loud tone.

raw: साहं कथं करिष्यामि तं विना प्रियदर्शनम् । रामं रक्तान्तनयनमपश्यन्ती सुदुःखिता ॥५-२४-३५॥
इह वा किम् निमित्तम् त्वम् आगता ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः । सा अब्रवीत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदन अर्दिता ॥३-१७-१९॥
translation: Tell me truly what you have come here for. Having heard the words of Rama and overtaken by passion, the demoness said:

raw: सिद्धा वैखानसाः तत्र वालखिल्याः च तापसाः । वन्दितव्याः ततः सिद्धाः तापसा वीत कल्मषाः ॥४-४३-३२॥
ते प्राप्य विशिखा नीलं विनिर्भिद्य समाहिताः । महीं जग्मुर्महावेगा रुषिता इव पन्नगाः ॥६-५८-३७॥
translation: The arrows discharged by Prahastha, penetrated piercing into Nila's body at great speed like infuriated serpents and went straight into the earth.

raw: स हि देवै रुदीर्णस्य रावणस्य वधार्थिभिः । अर्थितो मानुषे लोके जज्ञे विष्णुः सनातनः ॥२-१-७॥
translation: Entreated by the devatas desirous of slaying arrogant Ravana, the eternal Visnu was indeed born in the mortal world as Rama.

raw: हरींश्चापि हनिष्यामि संयुगे समवस्थितान् । असाधारणमिच्छामि तव दातुं महद्यशः ॥६-६३-५०॥
translation: "I will remain steady in the battlefield and devour monkeys also. I wish to confer an unusual and great glory on you."

raw: रुधिराक्तः स वेगेन जीवितान्तकरः शरः । रावणस्य हरन् प्राणान् विवेश धरणीतलम् ॥६-१११-१८॥
translation: That arrow which was capable of putting an end to the body took out Ravana's life and smeared with blood, it entered the earth.

raw: तान् भूमौ पतितान् दृष्ट्वा क्षणेन एव महाजवान् । रामस्य च महत् कर्म महान् त्रासो अभवन् मम ॥३-२१-१०॥
translation: Seeing the powerful demons collapse on the ground in a moment's time through Rama's action, I was frightened.
