raw: मकराक्षं हतं श्रुत्वा रावणः समितिञ्जयः । क्रोधेन महता ऽ ऽविष्टो दन्तान् कटकटापयन् ॥६-८०-१॥
translation: Ravana, who was always victorious in warhearing that Maka raksha had been killed, became highly enraged and grinding his teeth in anger was engrossed in thinking. He commanded his son Indrajith to go to battle.

raw: स राक्षसस्तत्र सहानुजस्तदा तपश्चकारातुलमुग्रविक्रमः । अतोषयच्चापि पितामहं विभुं ददौ स तुष्टश्च वराञ्जयावहान् ॥७-९-४८॥
translation: That demon of fierce prowess, along with his younger brothers, then performed incomparable penance there, and he also pleased the lord Brahma, who, being pleased, granted him boons that brought victory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवमः सर्गः ।। 9 ।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: मेघ प्रतिम नादेन स तेन धनद अनुजः । राक्षसाधिपतिः श्रीमान् ययौ नद नदी पतिम् ॥३-३५-७॥
translation: The younger brother of Kubera (Ravana), the prosperous lord of the demons ascended the chariot which could go where he desired. Embellished with gold, studded with gems, harnessed with demonfaced donkeys, the chariot rolled towards the ocean, rumbling like a cloud.

raw: असुराः तेन दैतेयाः सुराः तेन अदितेः सुताः । हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः च आसन् वारुणी ग्रहणात् सुराः ॥१-४५-३८॥
translation: For that reason, sons of Diti were called asuras. Aditi's sons were known as suras. Devatas grew exceedingly glad for having Varuni.

raw: तं ततः प्रीतिसंहृष्टः प्रीतिमन्तं महाकपिम् । जाम्बवान् कार्यवृत्तान्तमष्टच्छदनिलात्मजम् ॥५-५८-२॥
translation: Thereafter, very delighted Jambavan inquired Hanuman most affectionately of all that happened.

raw: प्रष्टव्यो मेरुसावर्णिः महर्षिः सूर्य संनिभः । प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रवृत्तिम् मैथिलीम् प्रति ॥४-४२-४९॥
translation: 'Bow down, touch the feet of the seer Merusavarna, who glows like the Sun and then enquire from him about Sita.

raw: एवम् तु मत्वा हनुमान् महात्मा । प्रतीक्षमाणो मनुज इन्द्र पत्नीम् । अवेक्षमाणः च ददर्श सर्वम् । सुपुष्पिते पर्ण घने निलीनः ॥५-१४-५२॥
translation: Pondering thus, the highsouled Hanuman remained concealed on the tree loaded with flowers and leaves and waited, looking eagerly for the wife of the lord of the people. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: न ह्यन्यः कर्मणो हेतुः साधने ऽस्य हनूमतः । हनूमति हि सिद्धिश्च मतिश्च मतिसत्तम । व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च सूर्य तेज इव ध्रुवम् ॥५-६४-३०॥
translation: "O Rama, the best among the wise just like the luminosity that abides in the Sun, capacity to succeed, energy, intelligence, even courage and steadfastness reside in Hanuman.

raw: अयंक्रीडासहायस्तेऽनाथेलालप्यतेजनः न चैवमाश्वासयसिकिंवा न बहुमन्यसे ॥६-११४-६३॥
translation: "These people who were with you are always sporting my Lord. Why do you not call them, why are you not consoling them, or inviting them?"

raw: ताम् तथा गर्हयित्वा तु मातरम् भरतः तदा । रोषेण महता आविष्टः पुनर् एव अब्रवीद् वचः ॥२-७४-१॥
translation: Overtaken by great wrath, Bharata reproached his mother and then said to her again:

raw: अधर्म चारिणौ पापौ कौ युवाम् मुनि दूषकौ । अहम् वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् विराघो नाम राक्षसः ॥३-२-१२॥
कुम्भकर्णः सहास्माभिरिन्द्रजिच्च महाबलः । प्रतिषेधयितुम् शक्तौ सवज्रमपि वज्रिणम् ॥६-१३-६॥
translation: "Kumbhakarna accompanied by Indrajith of extraordinary strength have the power to ward off even if Indra, armed with thunderbolt comes."

raw: शबर्या पूजितः सम्यक् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः । पंपा तीरे हनुमता संगतो वानरेण ह ॥१-१-५८॥
प्रचारं स तु सङ्गृह्य प्रजास्वन्तर्गतः प्रभुः । गुहां प्रविष्टः स्वसुतं शिशुमादाय मारुतः ॥७-३५-४९॥
translation: The lord Vayu, having withdrawn his circulation from among all creatures, took his child and entered a cave.

raw: अभिकालम् ततः प्राप्यते बोधिभवनाच्च्युताम् । पितृपैतामहीम् पुण्याम् तेरुरिक्षुमतीम् नदीम् ॥२-६८-१७॥
translation: From there they reached a village known as Abhikala and crossed the sacred Ikshumati flowing from Bodhibhavana mountain. This region was enjoyed by fathers and forefathers of Dasaratha.

raw: स्वम् स्वम् निलयम् आगम्य पुत्र दारैः समावृताः । अश्रूणि मुमुचुः सर्वे बाष्पेण पिहित आननाः ॥२-४८-३॥
translation: The subjects reached their respective homes and surrounded by their sons and wives broke down their faces flooded with tears.

raw: कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तार जाम्बवतोः तथा । दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटल सुनेत्रयोः ॥४-३३-११॥
translation: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

raw: इमे हि सर्वे विष्णो त्वां निरीक्षन्ते दिवौकसः । वृत्रघातेन महता तेषां साह्यं कुरुष्व ह ॥७-८४-१७॥
translation: O Vishnu, all these gods indeed await you; therefore, render them great help by slaying Vritra.

raw: यथा विजृंभते सिंहो विवृते गिरि गह्वरे । मारुतस्य औरसः पुत्रः तथा संप्रति जृंभते ॥४-६७-६॥
translation: Just as a lion grown in a mountain cave stretches its body, the Windgod's son stretched (his limbs) at that time.

raw: काल्यम् एतेन संग्रामम् करिष्यसि च वानर । वीर ते शत्रु बाहुल्यम् फल्गुता वा न विद्यते ॥४-१५-८॥
translation: 'O monkey fight him only tomorrow morning. By this you are not going to prove your weakness or increase your respect for the enemy.

raw: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट् ॥६-४१-७२॥
translation: Rama having spoken that way, Tara's son, Angada, who was like fire god, who was unwearied in action flew to the sky.

raw: अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किञ्चिन्निश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि । निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमान इवांशुमान् ॥७-१०९-५॥
translation: Not speaking anything, motionless, and devoid of joy on the path, he departed from that house, shining like the sun.

raw: अद्य ते मच्छरैश्छिन्नं शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । क्रव्यादा व्यपकर्षन्तु विकीर्णं रणपांसुषु ॥६-१०५-२०॥
translation: "Now, let your head severed by my shafts lying in dust in the battlefield with the shining earrings be dragged by the carnivorous animals."

raw: सुमालिनो ऽपि भार्यासीत्पूर्णचद्रनिभानना । नाम्ना केतुमती राम प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयसी ॥७-५-३८॥
translation: O Rama, Sumali also had a wife named Ketumati, whose face was like the full moon and who was dearer to him than his own life.

raw: स चित्रकूटे तु गिरौ निशम्य रामाश्रमं पुण्यजनोपपन्नम् । गुहेन सार्द्धं त्वरितो जगाम पुनर्निवेश्यैव चमूं महात्मा ॥२-९८-१८॥
translation: Having heard of Rama's hermitage on the Chitrakuta mountain inhabited by pious men, magnanimous Bharata, commanded his army to stay at a distance, and quickly proceeded with Guha. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सम्रक्त नेत्रः शिथिल अम्बरः तदा । विधूत सर्व आभरणः परम्तपः । बभूव भूमौ पतितः नृप आत्मजः । शची पतेः केतुर् इव उत्सव क्षये ॥२-७४-३६॥
translation: Prince Bharata, the scorcher of enemies, with bloodshot eyes, raiment in disarray, ornaments tossed about lay fallen on the ground like the banner of Indra (husband of Sachi) at the close of the festival of flaghoisting. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अथ वर्षसहस्रे तु दशमे दशमं शिरः । छेत्तुकामे दशग्रीवे प्राप्तस्तत्र पितामहः ॥७-१०-१२॥
translation: Then, in the tenth thousand-year period, as Dashagriva (Ravana) was about to cut off his tenth head, Lord Brahma arrived there.

raw: अद्य तु इदानीम् रजनीम् पुत्र मा गच्च सर्वथा । मातरम् माम् च सम्पश्यन् वस इमाम् अद्य शर्वरीम् ॥२-३४-३३॥
एवं विदेहराजश्च जनकः पूर्वको ऽभवत् । मिथिर्नाम महातेजास्तेनायं मैथिलो ऽभवत् ॥७-५७-२०॥
translation: Thus, the ancestor of Janaka, the king of Videha, was the greatly effulgent Mithi, from whom this region became known as Maithila. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 57 ।। Thus ends the fifty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: एवम् सम्भाषमाणस्य गुहस्य भरतम् तदा । बभौ नष्ट प्रभः सूर्यो रजनी च अभ्यवर्तत ॥२-८५-१४॥
translation: As Guha was thus conversing with Bharata, the rays of the Sun diminished and the night set in.

raw: अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव भगिन्यौ सहिते हि ते । भार्ये परमरूपिण्यौ कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः ॥७-११-१५॥
translation: Aditi and Diti, two sisters of supreme beauty, were indeed the wives of Prajapati Kashyapa.

raw: चित्रकूटम् अनुप्राप्य भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् । रम्यम् आवसथम् कृत्वा रममाणा वने त्रयः ॥१-१-३१॥
translation: Moving from one forest to another and crossing deep and wide rivers with plenty of waters, reached the Chitrakuta mountain by the command of sage Bharadwaja. They raised a hut made of leaves in the forest located in Chitrakuta mountain. and dwelt there happily resembling devas and gandharvas.

raw: दिष्ट्या ते विजयो वत्स दिष्ट्या लवणराक्षसः । हतः पुरुषशार्दूल वरं वरय सुव्रत ॥७-७०-२॥
translation: O dear and virtuous tiger among men, it is by good fortune that you have achieved victory and the demon Lavana has been killed; now, ask for a boon.

raw: क्षत्र बन्धो स्थितो अस्मि एष यद् बलम् तद् विदर्शय । नाशयामि अद्य ते दर्पम् शस्त्रस्य तव गाधिज ॥१-५६-३॥
translation: "O wicked kshatriya O son of Gadhi here I stand. Show me your strength and the pride of your arms. I will destroy them now.

raw: महोदरस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । चिच्छेद पाणिपादोरून् वानराणां महाहवे ॥६-९८-९॥
translation: In that great war, enraged Mahodara with arrows decked in gold shattered the Vanaras by attacking on hands, legs, and thighs.

raw: न नूनम् दैवतम् किम्चित् कालेन बलवत्तरम् । यत्र दाशरथी रामो भूमाउ एवम् शयीत सः ॥२-८८-११॥
translation: Dasaratha's son, Rama had to rest on the ground would admittedly mean that no divine power is mightier than Time (Destiny).

raw: सुकुमारी च बाला च नित्यम् च अदुःख दर्शिनी । मत् वियोगेन वैदेही व्यक्तम् शोचति दुर्मनाः ॥३-५८-१२॥
translation: Vaidehi is delicate, young and she has never faced any sorrow.She will be certainly disheartened due to separation from me.

raw: लोकेषु प्रथितम् राजन् विप्रैः च कथितम् सदा । तस्य एवम् वर्तमानस्य कालः समभिवर्तत ॥१-९-६॥
परुषाणि हि वाक्यानि यानि यानि ब्रवीषि माम् । तेषु तेषु वधो युक्तस्तव मैथिलि दारुणः ॥५-२०-६॥
समावृत्य महीं कृत्स्नां जगाम महती चमूः । तेहृष्टवदना स्सर्वे जग्मुर्मारुतरंहसः ॥६-४-६२॥
translation: The great vanara army spread all over the land went with the swiftness of wind with cheerful faces.

raw: पुनः प्रकृतिमापेदे वीतमोह इवात्मवान् । तद्रूपमतिसंक्षिप्य हनुमान् प्रकृतौ स्थितः ॥५-१-२०६॥
कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथा एव जननी मम । न आशम्से यदि ते सर्वे जीवेयुः शर्वरीम् इमाम् ॥२-८६-१५॥
translation: I doubt whether the king, Kausalya and my mother Sumitra and the rest of them will outlive this night.

raw: अदग्धस्य हि विज्ञातुम् शक्तिः अस्ति न मे प्रभो । राक्षसम् तम् महावीर्यम् सीता येन हृता तव ॥३-७१-२९॥
translation: O lord before I am cremated, I do not have the ability to know about that powerful demon by whom Sita has been abducted.

raw: यद् अंतरम् सिंह शृगालयोः वनेयद् अंतरम् स्यन्दनिका समुद्रयोः । सुर अग्र्य सौवीरकयोः यद् अंतरम्तद् अंतरम् दाशरथेः तव एव च ॥३-४७-४५॥
translation: The difference between you and Rama is the difference between a jackal and a lion in the forest, between a ditch and the sea, and between sour gruel and the best of wines.

raw: इति नरपति जल्पनात् द्विजेन्द्रम्कुशिक सुतम् सुमहान् विवेश मन्युः । सु हुत इव मखे अग्निः आज्य सिक्तःसमभवत् उज्वलितो महर्षि वह्निः ॥१-२०-२८॥
translation: Having heard the statements of the king the son of Kusika, Viswamitra who was like Indra among the ascetics was seized by great anger. As though fire in the form of maharshi blazed like the sacrificial fire into which oblations of clarified butter have been poured. ।। iऋफफछफौ चफळउफp८फउफफऋफhफॊ खफफऔउफळE१ळऋफ फबn८E१फखऋफॊ अफफऔफE१फhbॊ६ भखफघफजजफMफऩ ityढऍ डrंmadraचऍ vmंkंya ikyऍ bakङऍ viनडassargaध৷৷ Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: विश्वकर्मा च दृष्ट्वैनं बालसूर्योपमं शिशुम् । शिल्पिनां प्रवरः प्रादाद्वरमस्य महामतिः ॥७-३६-२०॥
translation: And Vishwakarma, the great-minded and foremost of artisans, having seen the child who resembled the rising sun, granted him a boon.

raw: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आतिथ्यं परमं प्राप्य निषसाद नराधिपः ॥७-७६-२४॥
translation: Having saluted the great-souled Agastya, who shone as if with brilliance, and having received excellent hospitality, the king of men, Rama, then sat down.

raw: निष्क्रान्ते राक्षसेन्द्रे तु पुनरन्तःपुरं गते । राक्षस्यो भीमरूपास्ताः सीतां समभिदुद्रुवुः ॥५-२१-२॥
स कुम्भकर्णं कुपितो महेन्द्रो जघान वज्रेण शितेन वज्री । स शक्रवज्राभिहतो महात्मा चचाल कोपाच्च भृशं ननाद ॥६-६१-१५॥
translation: "Mahendra who was armed with thunderbolt got enraged and hurt Kumbhakarna with thunderbolt. He reeled and roared with the strike."

raw: सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यदेभिरभिवारितः । अज्ञानाद्रक्षिभिः क्रोधाद्भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः ॥५-६४-६॥
translation: "O handsome one, do not react harshly at these guards who have obstructed your companions out of ignorance and fury.

raw: भास्कर उदय कालो अयम् गता भगवती निशा । असौ सुकृष्णो विहगः कोकिलः तात कूजति ॥२-५२-२॥
translation: O dear Lakshmana the holy night is over and it is time for sunrise. The deep dark bird, the cuckoo is singing.

raw: मातृभिर्भ्रातृसहितं पश्यामो ऽद्य वयं नृप । दिष्ट्या प्रहस्तो विकटो विरूपाक्षो महोदरः । अकम्पनश्च दुर्धर्षो निहतास्ते निशाचराः ॥७-१-२१॥
translation: O King, we are fortunate to see you today with our mothers and brothers, and it is by good fortune that those demons Prahasta, Vikata, Virupaksha, Mahodara, Akampana, and Durdharsha have been killed.

raw: ऋतु कालम् प्रतीक्षन्ते न अर्थिनः सुसमाहिते । संगमम् तु अहम् इच्छामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे ॥१-४८-१९॥
translation: 'O most beautiful one those overtaken by passion would not await the completion of the menstrual period (favourable for copulation). O woman of fine waist I desire union with you.'

raw: ततस् तस्या हितम् सख्याश् चिकीर्षन्ती सखी वचः । उवाच काले कालज्ना स्मित पूर्व अभिभाषिणी ॥६-३४-२॥
translation: Then Saarana who knew the right time to do so, wishing the welfare of her dear friend Sita and desirous of doing anything for her smiled before she started speaking.

raw: महतीमुत्थितामेनां राक्षसानां बिभीषिकाम् । विक्रमाद्विधमिष्यामो निवर्तध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-६६-७॥
translation: "O Vanaras! We will dispel this huge rakshasa, a nightmare with our power. Come back."

raw: प्रतिजाने च देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपे शतक्रतो । भविता ऽस्मि यथा ऽस्याहं रक्षसो मृत्युकारणम् ॥७-२७-१९॥
translation: And O king of gods, O Shatakratu, I promise in your presence that I shall indeed be the cause of this demon's death.

raw: ततस्त्वजामुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् । विशस्येमां ततः सर्वान्समान्कुरुत पीलुकान् ॥५-२२-३८॥
पराङ्मुखवधं पापं यः करोत्यसुरेतरः । स हन्ता न गतः स्वर्गं लभते पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥७-८-४॥
translation: Whoever, not being a demon, commits the sin of killing those who have turned their back, that killer does not attain the heaven of those who perform meritorious deeds.

raw: पूर्वम् कृतार्थो मित्राणाम् न तत् प्रति करोति यः । कृतघ्नः सर्व भूतानाम् स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर ॥४-३४-१०॥
translation: 'O lord of monkeys he who, having accomplished his task first with the help of his friend, does not return the help is ungrateful. Such a person deserves to be killed.It applies to all beings.

raw: ततो अहम् तत्र निक्षिप्तो गुहा द्वारि विनीतवत् । न च निष्क्रमते वाली तदा संवत्सरे गते ॥४-४६-५॥
translation: 'Then I waited at the entrance of the cave with due loyalty. A year passed. Yet Vali did not return.

raw: स राजा तादृशो ह्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः । बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकेशो महायशाः ॥७-८७-७॥
translation: That king, the lord of Bahlika, was indeed such a one, firmly established in righteousness and valor, supremely noble in intellect, and greatly renowned.

raw: तम् मुक्त कण्ठम् उत्क्षिप्य शङ्कु कर्णम् महास्वनम् । विराधम् प्राक्षिपत् श्वभ्रे नदन्तम् भैरव स्वनम् ॥३-४-२८॥
translation: Rama took his foot off Viradha's neck and dropped his body with pointed ears into the pit while Viradha was groaning fearfully৷৷

raw: कामदर्पमदैर्युक्तं जिह्मताम्रायतेक्षणम् । समक्षमिव कन्दर्पमपविद्धशरासनम् ॥५-१८-२३॥
translation: Hanuman saw him, who was possessed of lust, arrogance and intoxication. He appeared like Cupid setting aside his quiver and arrows with his curved, big, red eyes.

raw: यत् तु मे हृद् गतम् वाक्यम् तस्य कार्यस्य निश्चयम् । कुरुष्व राज शार्दूल भव सत्य प्रतिश्रवः ॥१-१९-३॥
translation: O Tiger among kings I shall unfold the purpose conceived in my mind. Take a decision and be truthful to your promise.

raw: अन्नम् उच्च अवचम् भक्ष्याः फलानि विविधानि च । रामाय अभ्यवहार अर्थम् बहु च उपहृतम् मया ॥२-८७-१५॥
translation: I offered Rama rice including a variety of eatables like fruits in great quantity for his food.

raw: अधर्म भय भीतः च पर लोकस्य च अनघ । तेन लक्ष्मण न अद्य अहम् आत्मानम् अभिषेचये ॥२-५३-२६॥
translation: O sinless one, I did not get myself coronated owing to fear of unrighteous conduct and fear of the other world.

raw: यद् यद् या अपि मम एव आज्ञा निवर्तयतु राघवम् । न शक्ष्यामि विना राम मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम् ॥२-५९-२२॥
translation: If my command prevails today, Rama may be brought back. Without Rama I cannot live for a moment even.

raw: इदम् धनुर् वरम् राजन् पूजितम् सर्व राजभिः । मिथिला अधिप राज इन्द्र दर्शनीयम् यत् इच्छसि ॥१-६७-६॥
translation: 'O Indra among kings O lord of Mithila here is the great bow, worshipped by all kings, which you intend to show (to Rama)'.

raw: निष्कूजमाना शकुनि झिल्लिका गण नादितम् । लक्ष्मण अनुचरोओ रामो वन मध्यम् ददर्श ह ॥३-२-३॥
translation: With Lakshmana following, Rama went through the forest, filled with herds of animals and inhabited by bears and tigers. It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was difficult to locate a water source. And it resounded with the chirping of various birds and insects (crickets).

raw: भर्तृपिण्डस्य कालो ऽयं निर्देष्टुं साधु युध्यताम् ॥६-९८-५॥
translation: "O heroic Mahodara! Today, exhibit your valour by destroying the enemy army. Having received my subsistence, this is the time to repay. Fight well in war."

raw: पूर्वे जात्यन्तरे वत्स मा विषादं कुरुष्व ह ॥७-५४-१७॥
translation: O son, do not grieve over what happened in a former birth.

raw: तथा लान्गूल हस्तैः च चरणाभ्याम् च मर्दिता । बभूव अशोक वनिका प्रभग्न वर पादपा ॥५-१४-१९॥
translation: The garden of Ashoka with trees shattered and crushed by Hanuman's tail, hands and feet, appeared like a woman with dishevelled hair, with her vermilion mark effaced, her bright teeth and lips faded for being kissed and wounded with nails and bitten with teeth (by her lover).

raw: प्रत्याख्यातं न जानाति नात्मानं नात्मनः कुलम् । यो नृशंसस्वभावेन मां प्रार्थयितुमिच्छति ॥५-२६-११॥
translation: 'As Ravana has no heart, he pleads to gain me. He is aware of neither his own self nor his family.

raw: तद्भवन्तः क्षताः शस्त्रैर्नृपैरिन्द्रसमैर्युधि । चन्दनस्य रसेनेव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ॥७-३१-३१॥
translation: Therefore, you, who were wounded in battle by kings equal to Indra, are drenched in blood as if with sandalwood paste.

raw: क्षीणपुण्याम् च्युताम् भूमौ ताराम् निपतितामिव । चारित्रव्यपदेशाड्यां भर्तृदर्शनदुर्गताम् ॥५-१७-२०॥
यो ऽपि पालयते विप्रः सो ऽपि गामन्वगाद्द्रुतम् । गत्वा तमृषिमाचष्ट मम गौरिति सत्वरम् ॥७-५३-१४॥
translation: The brahmin who was tending the cow also quickly followed it, and having gone, swiftly told that sage, "This is my cow."

raw: शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं वीरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम् । दूषणो ऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः ॥७-२४-३८॥
translation: Let this hero quickly go to protect the Dandaka forest, and the very powerful Dushana will be his commander of forces.

raw: इत्युक्त्वा तां नमस्कृत्य पुनर्नावमुपारुहत् । आरुह्य च पुनर्नावं नाविकं चाभ्यचोदयत् ॥७-४८-२२॥
translation: Having spoken thus and saluted her, he boarded the boat again, and having re-boarded the boat, he urged the boatman to proceed.

raw: अंजन अंबुद संकाशाः कुंजर प्रतिम ओजसः । अंजने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवंगमाः ॥४-३७-५॥
translation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

raw: तस्मिम्स्तत्राहमेकान्ते रात्रौ विवृतकार्मुकः । तत्राहम् सम्वृतम् वन्यम् हतवाम्स्तीरमागतम् ॥२-६३-२३॥
नियम्य पृष्ठे तु तल अन्गुलित्रवान् । शरैः सुपूर्णाउ इषुधी परम् तपः । महद् धनुः सज्यम् उपोह्य लक्ष्मणो । निशाम् अतिष्ठत् परितो अस्य केवलम् ॥२-८७-२३॥
translation: Lakshmana, the scorcher of enemies, wearing protective covering for his palms and fingers (made of gohaskin), strapping on his back two quivers filled with arrows, holding a great bow, strung ready, stood sentinel throughout the night guarding the surrounding.

raw: सङ्ग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्वा रावणं तलताडितम् । ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुरैः ॥६-५९-६३॥
translation: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.

raw: ते वाहनान्यवस्थाप्य यानानि विविधानि च । सभाम् पद्भिः प्रविविशुः सिम्हा गिरिगुहामिव ॥६-११-२३॥
translation: Parking those vehicles of several kinds at the entrance they entered the royal court by foot like the lions entering the cave of a mountain.

raw: प्रभाकराद्यै: सुस्निग्धै: प्रज्वलद्भिरिवोत्तमै: । वियुक्तां मणिभिर्जात्यैर्नवां मुक्तावलीमिव ॥२-११४-१०॥
translation: It was like a new pearl necklace from which the finest, glossy, radiant gems and rubies had been detached.

raw: इदं श्रेष्ठमभिज्ञानं ब्रूयास्त्वं तु मम प्रियम् । शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा ॥५-३८-१२॥
अज्ञानात्तु हतो यस्मात् क्षत्रियेण त्वया मुनिः । तस्मात्त्वाम् नाविशत्याशु ब्रह्महत्या नराधिप ॥२-६४-५६॥
translation: 'Since you, O lord of men, you have killed an ascetic unaware, as kshatriya the sin of slaying a brahmin will not accrue to you immediately.

raw: त्वम् प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालम् कलविदाम् वर । फुल्ल सप्त च्छद श्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरत् शिवा ॥४-३२-१३॥
translation: 'You knows best the passage of time (changing seasons). But you are not aware out of inattention that the auspicious autumn has set in, making the garden lush green with blossoms of Saptachada flowers.

raw: अन्ग प्रत्यन्गजः पुत्रः हृदयाच् च अपि जायते । तस्मात् प्रियतरः मातुः प्रियत्वान् न तु बान्धवः ॥२-७४-१४॥
translation: A son born from every limb, big or small, and from the heart is the most beloved of all for his mother while the other relatives are only loving ones.

raw: इष्टकाः च यथा न्यायम् कारिताः च प्रमाणतः । चितोऽग्निः ब्राह्मणैः तत्र कुशलैः शिप्लकर्मणि ॥१-१४-२८॥
translation: The sacrificial fireplace was constructed with bricks with standard measurement by brahmins who were experts in the art of measuring land with a string or single strand.

raw: अहिसारतिरक्षुद्रौ घृणी सत्यपराक्रमः । मुख्यश्चेक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य लक्ष्मीवाँल्लक्ष्मिवर्धनः ॥५-३१-४॥
translation: "He was committed to nonviolence, magnanimous, compassionate and one whose strength was truth. He was not only a prosperous king of Ikshvaku family but also a promoter of prosperity of others too.

raw: बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुम् वा पुरुषर्षभ । दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्य राज्यम् स्थितमिदम् तव ॥२-२१-१४॥
translation: O best of men, under what authority or reason this king wants to confer on Kaikeyi the kingdom that rightfully belongs to you?

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः । युद्धार्थं समवर्तन्त सचिवा रावणस्य ते ॥७-२७-२७॥
translation: In the meantime, Ravana's valiant ministers, the rakshasas of terrible appearance, assembled for battle.

raw: निहतैः कुञ्जरैर्मत्तैस्तथा वानरराक्षसैः । चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्च भग्नैर्धरणिसंश्रितैः । बभूवायोधनं घोरं गोमायुगणसङ्कुलम् ॥६-४३-४३॥
translation: The battlefield was dreadful and, frequented by jackals with spears, javelins, maces, and swords, strewn all over, similarly with broken chariots, horses, elephants, and monkeys fit for war. Broken wheels and axles of chariots were found all over.

raw: ऋषिपुत्रम् ददर्श अथो दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम् । ततो राजा यथा योग्यम् पूजाम् चक्रे विशेषतः ॥१-११-१६॥
स तु सर्वम् समर्थ्य एव मन्त्रिभिः क्ऱ्त्यम् आत्मनः । सभाम् प्रविश्य विदधे विदित्वा राम विक्रमम् ॥६-३२-३९॥
translation: Having known all about Rama's prowess, Ravana and ministers entered the assembly to think carefully about the task to be carried out and how to do it.

raw: अनेन दत्तानि सुपूजितानि भुक्ताश्च भोगा निभृताश्च भृत्याः । धनानि मित्रेषु समर्पितानि वैराण्यमित्रेषु च यापितानि ॥६-११२-२३॥
translation: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."

raw: सागरस्य च पत्नीनां मुखान्यपि विलोकयन् । स महामेघसंकाशं समीक्ष्यात्मानमात्मवान् ॥५-१-२०३॥
स तानि शर जालानि गृध्रः पत्ररथ ईश्वरः । जटायुः प्रतिजग्राह रावण अस्त्राणि संयुगे ॥३-५१-५॥
translation: Jatayu, lord of the birds, faced the arrows and other weapons showered by Ravana.

raw: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे नवमः सर्गः ॥४-९-२७॥
सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वाररान् । ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम् ॥५-३९-८॥
translation: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

raw: ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महतावृतः । प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम् ॥६-४१-२५॥
translation: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.

raw: तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमध्ये महात्मनः । विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च ॥७-९२-११॥
translation: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.

raw: ताडितः तेन तम् क्रुद्धः समभिक्रम्य वेगतः । अभवत् शोणित उद्गारी सापीड इव पर्वतः ॥४-१६-२२॥
translation: Struck by Vali, enraged Sugriva encountered Vali more aggresively. His body drenched in blood seemed a mountain with rivulets of blood flowing.

raw: जहि वीर दुरात्मानं मायापरमधार्मिकम् । रावणिं क्रूरकर्माणं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ॥६-८६-५॥
translation: "Hero, wicked minded, conjurer, unrighteous and cruel one who is a terror for all worlds is Ravana's son. Destroy him."

raw: सुपर्ण वचनम् श्रुत्वा सः अंशुमान् अतिवीर्यवान् । त्वरितम् हयम् आदाय पुनर् आयात् महायशाः ॥१-४१-२२॥
translation: Exceedingly powerful and highly renowned Anshuman, on hearing the words of Garuda returned quickly to the capital with the horse৷৷

raw: औपवाह्यस्य नागस्य विषाणम् शकलीकृतम् । सहसा चापि सम्शान्तम् ज्वलितम् जातवेदसम् ॥२-६९-१२॥
translation: In that dream I beheld the sea being dried up and the Moon fallen onto the ground. I saw the earth as though enveloped by darkness and obscured, the tusk of an elephant worthy of a ride by the monarch broken into pieces, a blazing fire extinguished suddenly, the earth split open, various trees dried up and mountains crumbled and covered with smoke.

raw: छायां ते दिनकरभा: प्रबाधमानं वर्षत्रं भरत करोतु मूर्ध्नि शीताम् । एतेषामहमपि काननद्रुमाणां छायां तामति शयिनीं सुखी श्रयिष्ये ॥२-१०७-१८॥
translation: Let an umbrella protect you against (scorching) sunshine and provide its cool shade over your head, O Bharata As for me, I shall happily seek the shade of these dense woodland trees.

raw: वेगवन्तः प्लवन्तो ये प्लवगा मारुतात्मज । तेषां मुख्यतमं मन्ये त्वामहं कपिकुञ्जर ॥५-१-११९॥
translation: "O son of the Windgod you are an elephant among monkeys, the foremost among them who move at a high speed.

raw: हेम जालैर् अविच्चिन्नाः तरुण आदित्य सम्निभाः । ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-६-३५॥
translation: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.

raw: तं भूमौ देवसङ्काशं पतितं प्रेक्ष्य राघवम् । अभिपेतुः समुत्पत्य सर्वतः कपिसत्तमाः ॥६-८३-११॥
translation: Seeing Raghava who is equal to god fallen on the ground, and the best of monkeys lifting him, the Vanaras from all over came jumping.

raw: काचिच् च वस्त्रम् अन्यस्या अपहृत्य उपगुह्य च । उपगम्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता ॥५-११-२९॥
translation: Overcome with sleep some women pulled clothes of other women and covered their bodies with them.

raw: एष कोटिमहौघेन समुद्रसदृशेन च । विभीषणेन वीरेण सचिवैः परिवारितः ॥६-२८-४२॥
translation: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

raw: प्रजाभिः सह शक्रश्च ययौ स्थानं स्वयम्भुवः । कुम्भकर्णस्य दौरात्म्यं शशंसुस्ते प्रजापतेः ॥६-६१-१९॥
प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे मृत्यु पाश अवपाशिता । समेयुः च महात्मानो युद्ध दर्शन कांक्षिणः ॥३-२३-२६॥
शार्दूलो ग्राहितस्त्वेकः पापोऽयमिति राक्षसः । मोक्षितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-२९-२८॥
मा च तम् प्यूढबाह्वम्सम् चन्द्रार्कसम्तेजनम् । द्राक्षीद्राज्यस्थमासीनम् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२९॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be highly unfortunate like me in not being able to behold that longarmed and broadshoulderd one seated on the throne and resembling both the Sun and the Moon in radiance

raw: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु लोकास्तिष्ठन्तु शाश्वताः । जयतां राघवः सङ्ख्ये रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ॥६-११०-२१॥
translation: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

raw: वैदूर्य विमलैः तोयैः पद्मैः च आकोश कुड्मलैः । शोभितान् सजलान् मार्गे तटाकान् च अवलोकयन् ॥४-१३-७॥
translation: Observing on the way delightful lotus buds with leaves like Vaidurya, clear water and full tanks (They moved on).

raw: सहस्राण्यपि मूर्खाणां यद्युपास्ते महीपति: । अथवाप्ययुतान्येव नास्ति तेषु सहायता ॥२-१००-२४॥
translation: Even if the king seeks the assistance from thousands or tens of thousands of fools, they cannot render any help to him.

raw: सुसम्प्रहृष्टौ नरराक्षसोत्तमौ जयैषिणौ मार्गणचापधारिणौ । परस्परं तौ प्रववर्षतुर्भृशं शरौघवर्षेण बलाहकाविव ॥६-८८-३९॥
ततः कपिस्तं विचरन्तमम्बरे पतत्त्रिराजानिलसिद्धसेविते । समेत्य तं मारुततुल्यविक्रमः क्रमेण जग्राह स पादयोर्दृढम् ॥५-४७-३४॥
translation: Thereupon Hanuman with the prowess that was equal to wind, approaching the sky firmly caught hold of the legs of Aksha flying into the abode of Garuda, the Windgod and the Siddhas.

raw: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा राजानम् गंगाम् च आभाष्य लोककृत् । जगाम त्रिदिवम् देवैः सर्वैः सह मरुत् गणैः ॥१-४२-२५॥
translation: The Creator of the worlds having thus addressed the king and conversing with Ganga went towards heaven along with devatas and maruts". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैः सूर्य सन्निभैः । त्यक्त्वा देहान् नवैर् देहैः स्वर् याताः परम ऋषयः ॥३-११-९२॥
translation: Here great souls like sages and siddhas gave up the ghost and with renewed bodies left for heaven on aerochariot resembling the Sun (in brightness).

raw: गतिम् मृगयमाणानाम् भवान् नः परमा गतिः । कामम् तपः प्रभावेण शक्ता हन्तुम् निशाचरान् ॥३-१०-१३॥
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि तिर्यक् योनि गतानि अपि । प्रियम् कुर्वन्ति रामस्य त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् यथा वयम् ॥४-५६-१०॥
translation: In that way all creatures, even those born as animals, do what is dear to Rama by risking their lives, just as we do.

raw: राक्षसो ऽसीति हरयो हरिश्चासीति राक्षसाः । अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ॥६-४४-३॥
translation: In the fierce darkness that prevailed, monkeys hit monkeys thinking to be Rakshasas and Rakshasas hit Rakshasas thinking to be Vanaras (not knowing in darkness) hit each other.

raw: स वनम् प्रव्रजेत्युक्तो बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति । यदि मे राघवः कुर्याद्वनम् गच्चेति चोदितः ॥२-१२-८५॥
ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते प्रविवेश महारथः । अयोध्यां रत्नसम्पूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् ॥७-५२-२॥
translation: Then, at midday, the great warrior Lakshmana entered Ayodhya, which was full of jewels and teeming with happy and well-nourished people.

raw: तं यान्तमनुयान्ती सा महती हरिवाहिनी । दृप्ता: प्रमुदितास्सर्वे सुग्रीवेणाभिपालिताः ॥६-४-२५॥
translation: While Rama was walking the great army of vanaras controlled by Sugriva followed him with great delight.

raw: तौ हत्वा जनभोगार्थं कैटभं तु मधुं तथा । अनेन शरमुख्येन ततो लोकांश्चकार सः ॥७-६३-२३॥
translation: Having killed Kaitabha and Madhu for the benefit of mankind, he (Vishnu) then created the worlds with this excellent arrow.

raw: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशो बभौ दीप्तानलप्रभः । अग्रतो व्यवतस्थे च सीताया वानरोत्तमः ॥५-३७-३४॥
translation: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras resembling mount Meru or Mandara stood there glowing like blazing fire in front of Sita.

raw: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः सौमित्रे मैथिलीं प्रति । दृष्टमेतत्पुरा विप्रैः पितुस्ते लक्ष्मणाग्रतः ॥७-५०-१०॥
translation: O Lakshmana, you should not feel sorrow regarding Sita, for this very event was foretold long ago by sages in the presence of your father.

raw: अथ आश्रमात् उपावृत्तम् अंतरा रघुनंदनः । परिपप्रच्छ सौमित्रिम् रामो दुःख अर्दितः पुनः ॥३-५९-१॥
translation: Rama, the delight of the Raghus, once again questioned Lakshmana who had come out of the hermitage, deeply hurt:

raw: चापम् आनय सौमित्रे शरामः च आशी विष उपमान् । समुद्रम् शोषयिष्यामि पद्भ्याम् यान्तु प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-२१-२२॥
translation: "The ocean has not shown his own form to me. O Lakshmana Get the bow and venomous snake like arrows, I will dry up the ocean and the Vanaras can walk by foot and go."

raw: अस्मिन् हि शिखरे जातामोषधीं तां सुखावहाम् । प्रतर्केणावगच्छामि सुषेणो ऽप्येवमब्रवीत् ॥६-१०२-२३॥
translation: By reasoning it is known that the herb which is good for him is grown in this peak, for Sushena said so.

raw: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः प्राप्तौ प्रियौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ । परिष्वज्य तदा रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ॥७-८३-२॥
translation: And when Raghava saw his dear Bharata and Lakshmana arrive, Rama embraced them and then spoke these words.

raw: यथा मे हृदयं नित्यं नापसर्पति राघवात् । तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः ॥६-११९-२४॥
translation: "If it is true that my heart has never slid from Raghava at all, may the fire god protect me always and so also the world witness."

raw: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम् । वस वा वीर भद्रं त एवमाह पितामहः ॥७-१०४-१४॥
translation: The grandfather (Brahma) said, "O great king, if you desire to rule your subjects again, or if you wish to stay, O hero, may good fortune be upon you."

raw: तान् सर्वान् धनुर् आदाय समाश्वास्य च दूषणः । अभ्यधावत सुसंक्रुद्धः क्रुद्धः [रुद्रम्] क्रुद्ध इव अन्तकः ॥३-२५-३१॥
translation: Pacifying them all, Dusana regathered them again and ran towards Rama like an angry Yama rushing towards Rudra.

raw: तद्युवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समास्थितौ । गायेथां मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् ॥७-९३-१६॥
translation: Therefore, you two, with joyful minds, should take your seats tomorrow morning and sing the sweet song, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.

raw: महावेगैः सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैर्गृध्रपत्रैः सुवाजितैः । शरान्धकारं तौ भीमं चक्रुतुः समरं तदा । गते ऽस्तं तपने चापि महामेघाविवोत्थितौ ॥६-१००-३०॥
पाणिभिर्निहताः केचित् केचिज्जानुभिराहताः । प्रकृष्टाश्च यथाकामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः ॥५-६३-९॥
translation: "Some were struck with hands, some beaten on their knees and were dragged as they liked and showed up their private parts.

raw: कुशनाभः तु राजर्षिः कन्या शतम् अनुत्तमम् । जनयामास धर्मात्मा घृताच्याम् रघु नंदन ॥१-३२-११॥
translation: O scion of the Raghu family, the virtuous rajarshi Kusanabha begot one hundred beautiful daughters through a nymph named Ghritachi.

raw: नर्मदाजलशीतश्च सुगन्धिः श्रमनाशनः । मद्भयादनिलो ऽप्यत्र वात्येष सुसमाहितः ॥७-३१-२९॥
translation: Even this wind, cool with the Narmada's water, fragrant, and a destroyer of fatigue, blows here very carefully out of fear of me.

raw: ननु तु आर्यो अपि धर्म आत्मा त्वयि वृत्तिम् अनुत्तमाम् । वर्तते गुरु वृत्तिज्ञो यथा मातरि वर्तते ॥२-७३-९॥
translation: My noble and righteous brother (Rama), who is well aware of his duties to the elders conducted himself before you as he would before his own mother.

raw: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः । किञ्चिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ॥६-५७-१॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.

raw: कलशीम् अपविद्ध्य अन्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी । वसन्ते पुष्प शबला माला इव परिमार्जिता ॥५-१०-४६॥
translation: Another lovely lady was fast asleep, having turned a goblet of water aside, yet another lay like a garland of variegated flowers in spring season.

raw: बाल इन्द्रगोप्ता अंतर चित्रितेनविभाति भूमिः नव शाद्वलेन । गात्र अनुपृक्तेन शुक प्रभेणनारी इव लाक्ष उक्षित कंबलेन ॥४-२८-२४॥
translation: 'The earth shines with freshgrown, tender grass speckled here and there with small Indragopa insects. It appears like a woman wearing a parrotgreen veil sprinkled with red lac dye.

raw: सदृशं यत्तु काले ऽस्मिन् कर्तुं स्निग्धेन बन्धुना । शत्रूणां कदनं पश्य क्रियमाणं मया रणे ॥६-६३-३३॥
translation: " At this time, you will see a relation doing that which is right out of affection. All enemies will be destroyed."

raw: तत्त्रिकालहितं वाक्यं धर्म्यमर्थानुबन्धि च । मन्यस्व नरदेवाय जानकी प्रतिदीयताम् ॥५-५१-२१॥
translation: "Think that my advice is beneficial to you for you present, past and future. It is righteous. It will provide you material wealth too. Hence return Sita to the lord of the people.

raw: समुद्रं राघवो राजा शरणं गन्तुमर्हति ॥६-१९-३२॥
translation: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."

raw: शिला गृहैर् अवततम् नाना वृक्षैः समावृतम् । ददर्श कपि शार्दूलो रम्यम् जगति पर्वतम् ॥५-१४-२८॥
translation: The tiger among monkeys beheld a delightingful mountain, resembling the raincloud with tall, pleasing peaks, wonderful peaks spread all over the mountain. There were caves built of stone, with a variety of trees.

raw: त्वया हि अनुगृहीतेन शक्यम् राज्यम् उपासितुम् । त्वत् वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्त अनुवर्तिना ॥४-१८-५६॥
translation: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.

raw: यां वृत्तिं वर्त्तते राम: कौसल्यायां महाबल: । तामेव नृपनारीणामन्यासामपि वर्त्तते ॥२-११८-५॥
translation: Mighty Rama shows the same behaviour and treatment towards the other consorts of the king as he does towards his own mother Kausalya.

raw: आनयेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं चीरमाहर चोत्तरम् । जलक्रियार्थं तातस्य गमिष्यामि महात्मन: ॥२-१०२-२०॥
translation: I shall go and offer libations to my magnanimous father. Go and fetch the dried pulp of ingudi fruit and an upper garment made of bark.

raw: प्रत्युवाच ततः सर्वान् इदम् वानर यूथपान् । सर्वेषाम् परितुष्टा अस्मि वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् ॥४-५२-१९॥
देवासुरमनुष्याणां सर्वास्त्रेषु विशारदः । सम्यग्विद्याव्रतस्नातो यथवत्साङ्गवेदवित् ॥२-२-३४॥
translation: He is an expert in wielding all kinds of weapons available to devas, asuras and men. He has achieved mastery over all sciences and has appropriately acquired knowledge of the Vedas and its ancillary sciences.

raw: वासम् कृत्वा सर्व तीर्थे तीर्त्वा च उत्तानकाम् नदीम् । अन्या नदीः च विविधाः पार्वतीयैअः तुरम् गमैः ॥२-७१-१४॥
translation: That tiger among men, Bharata halted at a place known as Sarvatirtha and crossed the Uttanika and various other rivers with the help of hillborn horses. He crossed the Kutika river on an elephant the river Kapivati at a place known as Lauhitya.

raw: पृच्छतः शंस मे सर्वं कस्य हेतोः परिश्रमः । एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या रावणेन यशस्विनी ॥७-१७-६॥
translation: Tell me everything, who am asking, for what reason is this exertion; thus spoken to by Ravana, that glorious maiden then replied.

raw: ततः तु आश्रमम् आसाद्य मुनेर् दर्शन कान्क्षिणौ । सीतया अनुगतौ वीरौ दूरात् एव अवतस्थतुः ॥२-५४-१०॥
translation: Thereafter the two heroes followed by Sita arrived at the hermitage and, wishing to see the sage, waited at a distance.

raw: सोढुम् न च समर्थो अहम् युद्ध कामस्य संयुगे । सुग्रीवस्य च संरंभम् हीन ग्रीवस्य गर्जतम् ॥४-१६-४॥
translation: 'When the weaknecked Sugriva roars eager to join a duel it is not right on my part to tolerate his arrogance,much less his warcry.

raw: नये युद्धे च कुशलः सर्व शास्त्रभृताम् वरः । अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली ॥६-२८-२४॥
तत् भवान् दण्ड सम्योगात् अस्मात् विगत कल्मषः । गतः स्वाम् प्रकृतिम् धर्म्याम् धर्म दिष्टेन वर्त्मना ॥४-१८-६२॥
translation: 'You have been purged of your sin through punishment from the point of view of righteousness. You have regained your spiritual nature on the path of dharma.

raw: एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता । स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः ॥२-२९-२३॥
translation: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.

raw: अध्रुवे हि शरीरे यो न करोति तपोर्जनम् । स पश्चात्तप्यते मूढो मृतो दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽत्मनो गतिम् ॥७-१५-२२॥
translation: Indeed, the foolish person who does not accumulate merit through penance in this impermanent body will repent later, after death, upon seeing their own ultimate destination.

raw: दिशम् हि उदीचीम् विक्रान्त हिम शैल अवतंसिकाम् । सर्वतः परिमार्गध्वम् राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम् ॥४-४३-४॥
translation: 'Look all over the northern direction adorned with mighty Himavan as its earring, for the spouse of blameless Rama

raw: स तं गृह्य महाबाहुः कालायसपरिष्कृतम् । रक्षिणस्तान् पुनः सर्वान् सूदयामास मारुतिः ॥५-५३-४४॥
translation: Seizing the black Iron club again, the strongarmed Hanuman killed all the demon guards.

raw: तप्त आभरण वर्ण अन्गी पीत कौशेय वासनी । रराज राज पुत्री तु विद्युत् सौदामनी यथा ॥३-५२-१४॥
translation: SIta who had put on pure gold ornaments on her body and who was clad in yellow silk shone like lightning.

raw: स तदा क्रियते सेतुर्वानरै र्घोरकर्मभिः । दण्डनन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति विचिन्वन्ति तथापरे ॥६-२२-६२॥
स अमात्य परिषत् क्रीडन् पानम् एव उपसेवते । शोक दीनेषु न अस्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम् ॥४-३०-७८॥
translation: 'Sporting with the council of ministers surrounding him, resorting to drinking, he shows no compassion to us feeling wretched with grief.

raw: ते तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा दिशा पालम् महागजम् । मानयन्तो हि ते राम जग्मुर् भित्त्वा रसातलम् ॥१-४०-१६॥
translation: O Rama having circumabulated and honoured that mighty elephant, the protector of the quarter they reached the Rasatala by riving the earth.

raw: अंगदेन यथा मह्यम् पुरस्तात् प्रतिवेदितम् । सुव्यक्तम् एष संप्रप्तः सौमित्रिः भ्रातृ वत्सलः ॥४-३३-२९॥
translation: 'Truly Saumitri, the loving brother of Rama has arrived as announced by Angada earlier'.

raw: एको हि अहम् अयोध्याम् च पृथिवीम् च अपि लक्ष्मण । तरेयम् इषुभिः क्रुद्धो ननु वीर्यम् अकारणम् ॥२-५३-२५॥
translation: Once enraged, O Lakshmana I can overpower Ayodhya, even the whole world all by myself with my arrows. But exhibition of prowess without any reason is not desirable.

raw: राजा तु रजसा सूतम् ध्वस्त अङ्गम् समुपस्थितम् । अश्रु पूर्ण मुखम् दीनम् उवाच परम आर्तवत् ॥२-५८-४॥
translation: Seeing the dejected charioteer standing before him, the desolate king covered all over with dust and his face bathed in tears, said to him in extreme grief:

raw: स्यन्दनैर्वारणैश्चैव हयैश्च गिरिसन्निभैः । खरैर्गोभी रथोष्ट्रैश्च शिंशुमारैर्भुजङ्गमैः ॥७-६-४७॥
translation: They set out with chariots, elephants, mountain-like horses, donkeys, cows, camel-drawn chariots, porpoises, and serpents.

raw: पूर्वं राजर्षिवृत्त्या हि वनवासो विधीयते । प्रजा निक्षिप्य पुत्रेषु पुत्रवत्परिपालने ॥२-२३-२६॥
translation: Leaving their sons to look after the subjects as their own children, the rajarsis in ancient times used to retire into the forest as per practice.

raw: असाध्यः कुपितो रामो विक्रमेण महायशाः । आप गायाः तु पूर्णाया वेगम् परिहरेत् शरैः ॥३-३१-२३॥
translation: Rama is of great fame. When outraged, he is irrepressible. He can arrest with his arrows even the speed of a river (in spate).

raw: यः स्थितम् योजने शैलम् गच्चन् पार्श्वेन सेवते । ऊर्ध्वम् तथैव कायेन गतः प्राप्नोति योजनम् ॥६-२७-१७॥
translation: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."

raw: घनानाम् वारणानाम् च मयूराणाम् च लक्ष्मण । नादः प्रस्रवणानाम् च प्रशान्तः सहसा अनघ ॥४-३०-२५॥
translation: 'O sinless Lakshmana the rumblings of heavy clouds, the trumpeting of elephants, the cry of peacocks and the sound of waterfalls have become suddenly stilled.

raw: सारसान् चक्रवाकां च नदी पुलिन चारिणः । सरांसि च सपद्मानि युतानि जलजैः खगैः ॥३-११-३॥
translation: (Watching) the swans and ruddy geese on river banks and lakes full of lotuses, and birds on water and in the sky.

raw: सीतया प्युपवस्तव्या रजनीयं मया सह । एवमृत्विगुपाध्यायैस्सह मामुक्तवान् पिता ॥२-४-३६॥
गोमतीम् च अपि अतिक्रम्य राघवः शीघ्रगैः हयैः । मयूर हम्स अभिरुताम् ततार स्यन्दिकाम् नदीम् ॥२-४९-१२॥
translation: Gomati gone, Rama with the swiftmoving horses crossed the river Syandika echoing with the cries of peacocks and swans.

raw: दान मानादि सत्कर्रैः कुरुष्व प्रत्यनन्तरम् । वैरम् एतत् सम् उत्स्रृज्य तव पार्श्वे स तिष्ठतु ॥४-१५-२७॥
translation: 'Indeed I do not see any of your relatives comparable to him on earth. Give up enmity with him. Give him wealth. Give him respect. Keep him by your side.

raw: नख दंष्ट्र आयुधा सर्वे वीराः विकृत दर्शनाः । सर्वे शार्दूल दर्पाः च सर्वे च विकृत आननाः ॥४-३१-२४॥
translation: The monkeys, their faces, deformed, their nails and teeth like weapons were dreadful and horrifying in appearance, proud as tigers

raw: ततः प्रभात समये दिवसे अथ चतुर्दशे । समेत्य राज कर्तारः भरतम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् ॥२-७९-१॥
translation: Then, at the hour of dawn on the fourteenth day, all those who were empowered to proclaim the king, assembled and addressed Bharata:

raw: भवत्वधर्मो धर्मो वा सत्यम् वा यदि वानृतम् । यत्त्वया सम्श्रुतम् मह्यम् तस्य नास्ति व्यतिक्रमः ॥२-१२-४६॥
translation: Whether righteous or unrighteous, true or false, there is no deviation from what you have promised to me.

raw: नित्यपुष्पानित्यफलान्तरवस्तत्रनिर्व्रणाः । कामवर्षी च पर्जन्यस्सुखस्पर्शश्चमारुतः ॥६-१३१-१०४॥
translation: The trees were always in bloom, and always bore fruits. Clouds sent rain when desired. People lived with delightful feelings.

raw: शराभिघातसंरब्धः सो ऽपि जग्राह सायकान् । काकुत्स्थः सुमहातेजा युगान्तादित्यतेजसः ॥६-१०५-८॥
translation: Endowed with extraordinary energy, Kakuthsa, angered by the impact of arrows resembled the Sun at the end of universal dissolution, took up arrows.

raw: धर्मम् अर्थञ्च कामञ्च समयञ्च अपि लौकिकम् । अविज्ञाय कथम् बाल्यात् माम् इह अद्य विगर्हसे ॥४-१८-४॥
translation: 'Without correct knowledge of dharma, artha, kama and worldly ways, how do you reproach me bitterly now in total ignorance?

raw: तेषाम् वचः सर्व गुण उपपन्नम् । प्रस्विन्न गात्रः प्रविषण्ण रूपः । निशम्य राजा कृपणः सभार्यो । व्यवस्थितः तम् सुतम् ईक्षमाणः ॥२-४०-५१॥
translation: Dasaratha and his wives, overcome with grief, heard their words steeped in virtue (wisdom). The king stood there with his perspiring body and melancholic appearance, fixing his gaze on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: असिञ्चन् सलिलैश्चैनं पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिभिः । प्रदहन्तमनासाद्यं सहसा ऽग्निमिवोच्छिखम् ॥६-८३-१२॥
translation: Reaching Rama, who was like a burning fire that has risen up and suddenly fallen, the Vanaras sprinkled water with fragrance of lotuses and lilies on Rama just as sprinkling water on an inextinguishable fire that has flared up suddenly.

raw: नियमैर्विविधैराप्तं तपो हि महदस्ति मे । तत्संश्रित्य बलं सीते छन्दये त्वां शुचिस्मिते ॥२-११८-१४॥
translation: O Sita of pure conduct, I have great ascetic power obtained through practising various austerities. With its strength I shall give what you want for your enjoyment.

raw: नहुषस्य सुतो राजा ययातिः पौरवर्धनः । तस्य भार्याद्वयं सौम्य रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि ॥७-५८-७॥
translation: O gentle one, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha and augmenter of the Paurava lineage, had two wives whose beauty was unequalled on earth.

raw: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव । सन्ध्यामुपासितुं वीर समयो ह्यतिवर्तते ॥७-८१-२०॥
translation: O Raghava, I have told you all that you asked me, but O hero, the time for performing the twilight prayer is indeed passing.

raw: यानि रामस्य लिङ्गानि लक्ष्मणस्य च वानर । तानि भूयः समाचक्ष्व न मां शोकः समाविशेत् ॥५-३५-३॥
translation: "O vanara tell me all about the identification marks of Rama and Lakshmana again so that grief does not enter my mind.

raw: सर्व वानर मुख्येषु बुद्धिमान् बलवान् अपि । ते सृष्टा बहु साहस्रा दशग्रीव वधे उद्यताः ॥१-१७-१७॥
स प्रविश्य महात्मानमृषिम् शिष्यगणैर्वऋतम् । सम्शितव्रतमेकाग्रम् तपसा लब्धचक्षुषम् ॥२-५४-११॥
translation: Rama entered the hermitage and saw that highsouled Bharadwaja surrounded by his disciples. He was a distinguished sage who (himself) kindled sacrficial fires and acquired spiritual insight by practising rigid austerities with concentration of mind and ascetic powers. Rama, Lakshmana and Sita paid their obeisance to that great sage.

raw: धीर्मिकेणानृशंसेन नरेण गुरुवर्त्तिना । भवितव्यं नरव्याघ्र परलोकं जिगीषता ॥२-१०५-४४॥
translation: O best of men, if a man aspires to conquer the higher world, he should remain virtuous, compassionate and obedient to his preceptors.

raw: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान् वा स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशङ्करान् वा । गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो ऽथवा तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ॥६-५९-१३१॥
translation: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."

raw: सीताम् प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम् । सहाय मात्रेण मया राघवः स्वेन तेजसा ॥४-३६-७॥
translation: 'Righteous Rama can merely restore Sita with my assistance. By his own fiery energy he will kill Ravana.

raw: तत: स्स्सैलप्रदीपांश्चपर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च गृहीत्वाविविशुःक्षिप्रंशत्रुघ्नेप्रचोदिताः ॥६-१३१-४७॥
translation: Then as commanded by Shatrughna, people taking glowing oil lamps and coverlets for the couches quickly entered the palace.

raw: प्रफुल्ल बाण आसन चित्रितेषुप्रहृष्ट षट्पदानि कूजितेषु । गृहीत चापः उद्यत दण्ड चण्डःप्रचण्ड चारो अद्य वनेषु कामः ॥४-३०-५५॥
translation: 'Now Cupid is moving unobstructed showing his power by holding his bow indicating strict punishment to those separated from their beloveds in the forests with bana and asana flowers in bloom and bees humming happily.

raw: प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो । गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया ॥२-२९-१४॥
translation: Pleased with my long entreaties in the past to dwell with you in the forest, O lord, you had granted my desire.

raw: दितिम् यत्र तपः सिद्धाम् एवम् परिचचार सः । इक्ष्वाकोस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्रः परम धार्मिकः ॥१-४७-११॥
तामनुव्याहरच्छक्तिमापतन्तीं स राघवः । स्वस्त्यस्तु लक्ष्मणायेति मोघा भव हतोद्यमा ॥६-१०१-३३॥
translation: Seeing the javelin coming towards Lakshmana, Raghava said 'May Lakshmana be auspicious. May he be well. May your attempt to kill Lakshmana be ineffective and wasted'.

raw: आतोद्यानि विचित्राणि परिष्वज्य वर स्त्रियः । निपीड्य च कुचैः सुप्ताः कामिन्यः कामुकान् इव ॥५-१०-४९॥
translation: Some charming maidens held wonderful musical instruments pressing against their bosom and slept like passionate women embracing their loved ones.

raw: आश्रमस्याविदूरे मे तापस्यस्तपसि स्थिताः । तास्त्वां वत्से यथा वत्सं पालयिष्यन्ति नित्यशः ॥७-४९-१५॥
translation: Not far from my hermitage, there are female ascetics engaged in penance, and they, O dear child, will always protect you as a mother protects her calf.

raw: एवम् उक्ता महाभागैः तदा अहम् पुरुषर्षभ । मया तु विविधम् वन्यम् संचितम् पुरुषर्षभ ॥३-७४-१७॥
कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथा अयम् मारुतात्मजः । कृत्यवान् सोऽपि संप्राप्तः कृत कृत्योऽसि राघव ॥४-४-३१॥
translation: 'O Raghava this monkey, son of the Windgod appears pleased as evident from his words. As he is a man of action, take your work as accomplished now.

raw: तस्य ते देवदेवस्य निशम्य वचनं सुराः । आजग्मुर्यत्र युध्येते शत्रुघ्नलवणावुभौ ॥७-६९-३०॥
translation: Having heard the words of that God of gods, the deities arrived at the place where both Shatrughna and Lavana were engaged in battle.

raw: एवम् ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीर् उपतिष्ठताम् । यः त्वम् ज्येष्ठे नृप सुते पृथिवीम् दातुम् इच्चसि ॥२-७९-१५॥
translation: May Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, abide in you for having expressed your desire to bestow the kingdom upon the king's eldest son.

raw: उपस्पृश्य यथान्यायं स स्वर्गी रघुपुङ्गव । आरोढुमुपचक्राम विमानवरमुत्तमम् ॥७-७७-१७॥
translation: Having performed ablutions properly, O foremost of the Raghus, that celestial being then began to ascend his excellent and best celestial chariot.

raw: विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञातस्सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभि: एष वक्ष्यति धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठो मे यथाक्रमम् ॥१-७०-१७॥
translation: "Having been permitted by Viswamitra, along with all maharshis virtuous Vasishta will tell you in detail about my race".

raw: अवंतीम् अंगलेपाम् च तथा च अलक्षितम् वनम् । राष्ट्राणि च विशालानि पत्तनानि ततः ततः ॥४-४२-१४॥
translation: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

raw: गन्धान् उच्च अवचामः च अन्याम्स् तत्र दत्त्वा अथ भूमिपम् । ततः सम्वेशयाम् आसुः चिता मध्ये तम् ऋत्विजः ॥२-७६-१७॥
translation: In this way others brought sandal, agaru and fragrant gum gugul, the resin of balsa tree and woods of sarala, padmaka and devadaru and built a pyre and strew many kinds of fragrant substances on it. Thereafter the priests laid the mortal remains of the king in the centre of the pyre.

raw: प्रहस्तस्तु समाश्वस्तो दृष्ट्वा बद्धं दशाननम् । सह तै राक्षसैः क्रुद्धश्चाभिदुद्राव पार्थिवम् ॥७-३२-६७॥
translation: But Prahasta, having recovered from his shock upon seeing Daśānana bound, became enraged and, along with those Rākṣasas, rushed towards the king.

raw: प्राप्तम् आवेदयामासुः नृपायैः इक्ष्वाकवे तदा । तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सपुरोधाः समाहितः ॥१-१८-४२॥
क्षमा ते पृथिवीतुल्या तेजसा भास्करोपमः । वेगस्ते वायुना तुल्यो गाम्भीर्यमुदधेरिव ॥७-३७-६॥
translation: Your patience is like that of the earth, your splendor is comparable to the sun, your speed is equal to the wind, and your depth is like that of the ocean.

raw: नाहं स्वप्नमिमं मन्ये स्वप्ने दृष्ट्वा हि वानरम् । न शक्यो ऽभ्युदयः प्राप्तुं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयो मम ॥५-३४-२२॥
translation: "I do not think it is a dream. Pleasure cannot be experienced by seeing a vanara in a dream. I experience pleasure now (seeing a monkey in a dream is a bad omen).

raw: ये च तत्र महात्मान ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः । ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता न्यवर्तन्त महौजसः । उत्तरं श्रोतुमनसो भविष्यं यच्च राघवे ॥७-९८-२४॥
translation: And those great-souled, greatly powerful sages from Brahma's world, who were desirous to hear the Uttara Kanda and the future events concerning Rama, returned after being permitted by Brahma.

raw: इति प्रशस्यमाना सा कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् । शयानां शयने शुभ्रे वेद्यामग्निशिखामिव ॥२-९-५३॥
translation: Flattered in this manner, Manthara addressed Kaikeyi who was lying on a white couch and looking like a flaming fire on the sacrificial altar:

raw: अहोरात्राण्यनेकानि वसन्तौ क्रोधमीयतुः । ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ तावुभौ द्विजसत्तमौ ॥क्रुद्धौ परमसम्प्राप्तौ वाक्यं घोराभिसंहितम् ॥७-५३-१७॥
translation: After staying for many days and nights, those two great-souled and best among brahmins became exceedingly angry and spoke terrible words filled with a curse.

raw: तस्य वाक्यस्य वाक्यान्ते वानराः कामरूपिणः । ऋक्षराक्षससङ्घाश्च समापेतुरनेकशः ॥७-१०८-१७॥
translation: At the conclusion of his speech, numerous monkeys capable of changing their forms at will, along with groups of bears and rakshasas, gathered in great numbers.

raw: विभीषणेन यत् तु उक्तम् अस्मिन् काले सुख आवहम् । अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुम् घोरे अस्मिन् वरुण आलये ॥६-१८-३९॥
प्रयत्नात् निर्मिताम् धात्रा दिव्याम् मायामयीम् इव । धूमेन अभिपरीत अंगीम् दीप्ताअम् अग्नि सिखाम् इव ॥१-४९-१४॥
स पादुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत् । चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्यहम् ॥२-११२-२३॥
translation: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'

raw: मुक्ताहाराऽवृताश्चान्याः काश्चिद्विस्रस्तवाससः । व्याविद्धरशनादामाः किशोर्य इव वाहिताः ॥५-९-४७॥
translation: Some had their strings of pearl broken, others had their clothes slipped off, and some had their waist belts snapped. They were like young mares fallen to rest after carrying heavy loads.

raw: त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुराणे विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः । महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा महासुरम् ॥६-१२०-२८॥
translation: "Before you took the form of Trivikrama, and took three strides, occupied the three worlds and bound the dreadful king Bali you made Mahendra as king of heaven."

raw: अदन् बुभुक्षितो मांसं शोणितं तृषितः पिबन् । मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यं च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा ॥६-६०-६४॥
translation: After eating the meat and feeling thirsty, the enemy of Indra drank blood, pails of fat and wine.

raw: रामा रम्ये वनोद् देशे मया विरहिता त्वया । क्रुद्धो अब्रवीत् गिरिम् तत्र सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा ॥३-६४-३०॥
दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यः च नाना पुष्प समावृताः । रावणो दर्शयामास सीताम् शोक परायणाम् ॥३-५५-१२॥
translation: Ravana showed Sita who was overwhelmed with sorrow, stepwells surrrounded by various trees and tanks.

raw: अथ अहम् गत बुद्धिः तु सुव्यक्तम् निहतो गुरुः । शिला पर्वत संकाशा बिल द्वारि मया कृता ॥४-४६-७॥
translation: 'Thereafter, convinced that my brother was killed, I placed a mountainsize rock at the entrance of the cave so that Dundubhi will be destroyed, unable to come out of the cave.

raw: स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्धूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् । तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृद्धं द्वारस्था राजसम्मतम् ॥२-१४-४४॥
रामः अपि रात्रि शेषेण तेन एव महद् अन्तरम् । जगाम पुरुष व्याघ्रः पितुर् आज्ञाम् अनुस्मरन् ॥२-४९-१॥
translation: Recollecting his father's command, Rama, the foremost among men, covered a long distance during the remaining part of the night.

raw: नैव लोभान्न मोहाद्वा न ह्यज्ञानात्तमोन्वित: । सेतुं सत्यस्य भेत्स्यामि गुरो: सत्यप्रतिश्रव: ॥२-१०९-१७॥
translation: I am always true to my promise. I will not break the bridge of truth of my father out of either greed or delusion or ignorance or illusion.

raw: एवम् अस्माभिर् उक्तेन लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । अनुनीता वयम् सर्वे धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता ॥२-८६-९॥
translation: The magnanimous Lakshmana, established in dharma, replied:

raw: चकार रक्षाम् कौसल्या मन्त्रैः अभिजजाप च । उवाचातिप्रहृष्टेव सा दुःखवशर्तिनी ॥२-२५-३९॥
चर्म च अस्थि च मे राजन् न स्पृशन्ति मनीषिणः । अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सो अहम् पंच नखो हतः ॥४-१७-४०॥
translation: 'O king the learned do not even touch my skin or bone. They do not eat my flesh. While it is so, you have unnecessarily killed me, a fivenailed animal.

raw: बह्वीनाम् उत्तम स्त्रीणाम् मम यो असौ परिग्रहः । तासाम् त्वम् ईश्वरी सीते मम भार्या भव प्रिये ॥३-५५-१७॥
translation: O Sita dear be my chief queen among the many thousands of women I have married.

raw: विलपन्तीम् तथा दीनाम् कौसल्याम् जननीम् ततः । उवाच रामः धर्म अत्मा वचनम् धर्म सम्हितम् ॥२-२१-२८॥
translation: Thereafter, virtuous Rama addressed these words consistent with righteousness to his miserable mother Kausalya who was thus lamenting:

raw: आमंत्रये जनस्थानम् कर्णिकारान् च पुष्पितान् । क्षिप्रम् रामाय शंसध्वम् सीताम् हरति रावणः ॥३-४९-३०॥
translation: O karnikar trees in full bloom in Janasthana, tell Rama quickly that Ravana is kidnapping Sita.

raw: सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान् । चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम् । तमक्षमागतं भग्नं निशम्य स दशाननः ॥५-५८-१२४॥
translation: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

raw: ऋश्यमूकात् तु हनुमान् गत्वा तम् मलयम् गिरिम् । आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपि राजाय राघवौ ॥४-५-१॥
translation: Leaving Rishyamuka, Hanuman reached the Malaya mountain. Seeing the chief of monkeys there, he announced the arrival of the heroic Raghavas.

raw: ऋषिं वसिष्ठं सन्दिश्य मातऽर्मे शीघ्रमानय । इति त्वरितमग्रे स जगाम गुरुवत्सल: ॥२-९९-२॥
translation: Bharata, deeply devoted towards elders, indicated to sage Vasistha to bring along the mothers, and proceeded ahead quickly.

raw: निपत्योरसि गृध्रास्ते क्षितौ क्षिप्तस्य रावण । पिबन्तु रुधिरं तर्षाच्छरशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ॥६-१०५-२१॥
translation: "Ravana! After your body is caused to destroy and scattered on the ground, let the vultures drink the blood oozing from your chest pierced by the heads of my arrows."

raw: कुम्भकर्णस्ततो यत्तो नित्यं धर्मपथे स्थितः । तताप ग्रीष्मकाले तु पञ्चाग्नीन्परितः स्थितः ॥७-१०-३॥
translation: Then, Kumbhakarna, always diligent and situated on the path of righteousness, performed penance by standing amidst five fires during the summer season.

raw: भाषमाणम् महात्मानम् राज पुत्र्यौ प्रसाद्य तम् । ऊचतुः परम प्रीते कृतांजलि पुटे तदा ॥१-३८-९॥
translation: Thereafter, both the daughters of the king were exceedingly delighted. Having propitiated that magnanimous asectic both of them with folded hands in supplication, said:

raw: श्रुत्वा न भेतव्यमिति स्त्रीजनं तं ततो ऽर्जुनः । उत्ततार जलात्तस्माद्गङ्गातोयादिवाञ्जनः ॥७-३२-३८॥
translation: Having heard the news, Arjuna then reassured the womenfolk not to fear, and emerged from the water like the Anjana mountain rising from the waters of the Ganga.

raw: पुनः आकाशम् आविश्य स्वान् लोकान् प्रतिपेदिरे । मुमुदे मुदितो लोकः तेन तोयेन भास्वता ॥१-४३-२८॥
पश्य मत्तविहङ्गनि प्रलीनभ्रमराणि च । कोकिलाकुलखण्डानि दोधवीति शिवोऽविलः ॥६-२४-१२॥
translation: "You may see the trees shaking violently by the pleasant breeze, inhabited by proud birds, drunken honeybees and crowded with cuckoos and other birds (Rama said to Lakshmana)."

raw: ऋषभोदक्षिणात्तूर्णंसमुद्राज्जलमानयत् । रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिस्सम्वृतंकाञ्चनंघटम् ॥६-१३१-५५॥
translation: Rshaba quickly brought water from the southern sea in a golden pot covered with sandal paste.

raw: वज्रेण अभिहतः कालम् सु दीर्घम् अपि जीवितुम् । स एवम् उक्तः मे शक्रो बाहू योजनम् आयतौ ॥३-७१-१३॥
ईदृग्विधैस्तु हरिभिर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः । शतैः शतसहस्रैश्च कोटीभिरयुतैरपि । आगमिष्यति सुग्रीवः सर्वेषां वो निषूदनः ॥५-४३-२३॥
translation: "Sugriva will come here with hundreds of thousands of crores of vanaras who would be fighting with their teeth and nails as weapons.

raw: तस्य राक्षस सिम्हस्य निश्चक्राम मुखान् महान् । शयानस्य विनिह्श्वासः पूरयन्न् इव तद् ग्र्हम् ॥५-१०-२४॥
translation: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.

raw: अभिलक्षेण तीव्रेण कुम्भेन निशितैः शरैः । आचितास्ते द्रुमा रेजुर्यथा घोराः शतघ्नयः ॥६-७६-६७॥
translation: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.

raw: तदा सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह । सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः ॥२-१४-६२॥
पाप स्वभावः चपलः कथम् त्वम् रक्षसाम् वर । ऐश्वर्यम् अभिसंप्राप्तो विमानम् इव दुष्कृती ॥३-५०-११॥
translation: O best of demons by nature you are sinful, and fickleminded. You do all forbidden acts. Otherwise,how could you get this wealth, like the celestial chariot?

raw: एवम् उक्ता प्रियम् पुत्रम् बाष्प पूर्ण आनना तदा । उवाच परम आर्ता तु कौसल्या पुत्र वत्सला ॥२-२४-१७॥
translation: Thus addressed by Rama, the affectionate Kausalya, deeply distressed, her eyes filled with tears, said to her beloved son:

raw: प्रविविक्ताम् नदीम् रात्राव् उदाहारः अहम् आगतः । इषुणा अभिहतः केन कस्य वा किम् कृतम् मया ॥२-६३-२९॥
translation: 'I have come to this lonely spot of the river to take water. Who has hit me with this arrow? What (harm) have I done to any one?'

raw: ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कम् देशम् ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया । रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणप्रिया प्रिया ॥४-६-२४॥
translation: Then Rama said to Sugriva,.'Tell me, O Sugriva, to which region that fiercelooking demon has carried away my Sita, who is dearer than my life.

raw: ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् गते अर्ध दिवसे तदा । जाह्नवीम् सरिताम् श्रेष्ठाम् ददृशुर् मुनि सेविताम् ॥१-३५-७॥
translation: After travelling a long distance for half a day, they saw Jahnavi, the best among rivers haunted or worshipped by ascetics.

raw: अतिमात्रमयं देशो मनोज्ञ: प्रतिभाति मा । तापसानां निवासो ऽयं व्यक्तं स्वर्गपथो यथा ॥२-९३-१८॥
translation: Being the abode of ascetics, this region looks very charming like the pathway to heaven.

raw: त्वाम् हि माया मयम् दृष्ट्वा कांचनम् जात विस्मया । आनय एनम् इति क्षिप्रम् रामम् वक्ष्यति मैथिली ॥३-४०-१९॥
translation: Seeing the illusory golden deer, Sita, wonderstruck, will at once ask Rama to get the deer.

raw: पितुरानृण्यताम् प्राप्तेत्वयि लप्स्ये परम् सुखम् । कृतान्तस्य गतिः पुत्र दुर्विभाव्या सदा भुवि ॥२-२४-३४॥
योजनानि त्रयोविम्शत्सुवेलमधिकृत्य वै । स वानरवरः श्रीमान् विश्वकर्मात्मजो बली ॥६-२२-७१॥
उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् मुनि पत्न्याम् तथैव च । शुनःशेपः स्वयम् राम मध्यमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६१-२०॥
translation: O Rama the sage and his wife having spoken thus, their middle son Sunassepha said on his own:

raw: यथोक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिरात् तु वानर । शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः ॥४-२७-४७॥
translation: 'O lord of men, your desire will be fulfilled soon. Be determined to fight the enemy while waiting for autumn. Forgive this rainy season (and its water that obstructs).

raw: अहमप्यवनिम् प्राप्ते रामे सत्यपराक्रमे । कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि विप्रवासितकल्मषः ॥२-७४-३४॥
translation: When Rama who has truth as his prowess accepts the kingdom, I shall have accomplished my purpose at last and I shall be free from all blemishes.

raw: अथ वा न हि तस्यार्थे धर्मकामस्य धीमतः । मया रामस्य राजर्षेर्भार्यया परमात्मनः ॥५-२४-४०॥
साहाय्यार्थं तु तस्यैव निविष्टः प्रघसो हरिः । पनसश्च महाबाहुर्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ॥६-४२-२४॥
translation: Praghasa the broad shouldered Vanara, was surrounded by Panasa for assisting him who encamped surrounded by many.

raw: शरभङ्गे दिवम् प्राप्ते मुनि संघाः समागताः । अभ्यगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थम् रामम् ज्वलित तेजसम् ॥३-६-१॥
translation: When Sarabhanga attained the heaven, all the sages collected together and came to Rama whose radiance was like fire.

raw: समुद्रम् लन्घयित्वा तु घोरम् नद नदी पतिम् । कृतम् हनुमता कर्म दुष्करम् तर्कयेत कः ॥६-९-११॥
translation: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"

raw: तानि दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्दर्शयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः । राघवः सहसौमित्रिः सुग्रीवे संन्यवेदयत् ॥५-३५-४३॥
translation: "Longarmed Rama along with Lakshmana looked at them again and again and gave them to the care of Sugriva.

raw: करालान् भुग्न वक्त्रामः च विकटान् वामनामः तथा । धन्विनः खड्गिनः चैव शतघ्नी मुसल आयुधान् ॥५-४-१७॥
translation: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

raw: अहम् तु मन्ये तव न क्षमम् रणेसमागमम् कोसल राज सूनुना । इदम् हि भूयः शृणु वाक्यम् उत्तमम्क्षमम् च युक्तम् च निशाचर अधिप ॥३-३७-२५॥
translation: O Ravana I think it is not good on your part to confront the prince of Kosala in a war. Listen to my words and consider what is good for you. इत्यार्षे श्री मद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyseventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तस्मात्सुदृष्टं कुरु जीवलोकं शरैः शितैस्त्वां विविधैर्नयामि । यमस्य गेहाभिमुखं हि पापं रिपुं त्रिलोकस्य च राघवस्य ॥७-६८-२०॥
translation: Therefore, take a good look at the world of the living, for I shall lead you, a sinful enemy of the three worlds and of Rama, towards Yama's abode with various sharp arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 68 ।। Thus ends the sixty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: उवाच तारा पिंगाक्षम् पुत्रम् अंगदम् अंगना । अवस्थाम् पश्चिमाम् पश्य पितुः पुत्र सुदारुणाम् ॥४-२३-२२॥
क्षिप्रं प्रहर निश्शङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि । ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ॥६-५९-५८॥
translation: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."

raw: हतारयः प्रनष्टेन्द्रा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः । विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेशानं मुहुर्मुहुरपूजयन् ॥७-८५-१७॥
translation: The gods, whose enemies were slain but whose Indra had disappeared, with Agni as their leader, repeatedly worshipped Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds.

raw: अयम् सिद्ध आश्रमो नाम प्रसादात् ते भविष्यति । सिद्धे कर्मणि देवेश उत्तिष्ठ भगवन् इतः ॥१-२९-१८॥
translation: O Lord of the celestials, with my penance accomplished (here) this place will be known as siddhaashrama by your grace. O Lord arise from here".

raw: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयामास पौरान् जानपदान् अपि । उददद् ब्राह्मणानाम् च रत्नौघम् अमलम् बहु ॥१-१८-२३॥
translation: Brahmins as well as inhabitants of the city and rural areas were feasted. (Dasaratha) bestowed on brahmins unlimited and abundant jewels in charity. The rites at the time of birth and all other rites (associated with the newborn) were duly performed.

raw: शक्रायुधनिकाशैश्च कार्मुकैर्भारसाधनै: । रुक्मपृष्टष्ठैर्महासारै: शोभितां शत्रुबाधकै: ॥२-९९-२०॥
translation: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.

raw: तावन्योन्यं जिघृक्षन्तौ हरिराक्षसपार्थिवौ । प्रयत्नवन्तौ तत्कर्म ईहतुर्बलदर्पितौ ॥७-३४-१९॥
translation: Those two kings, Vali and Ravana, both proud of their strength and desiring to seize each other, engaged in that struggle with great effort.

raw: जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ । शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे ॥७-९७-५॥
translation: I know that these two, Kusha and Lava, are my twin sons, and I desire that my affection for Maithili, who is pure in the eyes of the world, be restored.

raw: तम् न देवा न गंधर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः । मया अपकृष्टम् कृपणम् शक्ताः त्रातुम् इह आहवे ॥३-१९-११॥
translation: Neither gods nor devils nor gandharvas nor even demons will have the power to rescue that hapless creature dragged by me ruthlessly in the battle.

raw: तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस । स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम् ॥७-२५-४८॥
translation: Therefore, O Rakshasa, you should go with your relatives to help him, for it is proper to provide assistance to an affectionate one who seeks it.

raw: सहैभिरजिता लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर । हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः ॥६-१२५-५॥
translation: "This Lanka could be won with the help of these heroes who never turned back and fought in comb at without fear of life, O Lord of Rakshasas."

raw: दुर्जयेन अप्रमेयेण रामेण रण कर्मसु । शूर वक्ष्यामि ते किंचिन् न च इच्छामि अभ्यसूयितुम् ॥४-१५-२२॥
तत् कर्म रामस्य महारथस्यसमेत्य देवाः च महर्षयः च । अपूजयन् प्रांजलयः प्रहृष्टाःतदा विमान अग्र गताः समेताः ॥३-२८-३३॥
translation: Then the gods, along with great sages came down in aerial chariots and assembled there. Delighted, they adored Rama, the great warrior, with folded hands for the work done. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकिय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeigth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: भरतः प्रविवेशाशु पुरीमिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम् । द्वारेण वैजयन्तेन प्राविशत् श्रान्त वाहनः ॥२-७१-३३॥
तमेव कालं मित्रो ऽपि वरुणत्वमकारयत् । क्षीरोदेन सहोपेतः पूज्यमानः सुरोत्तमैः ॥७-५६-१२॥
translation: At that very time, Mitra also performed the role of Varuna, accompanied by the Ocean of Milk and being worshipped by the best of gods.

raw: बाष्प संरुद्ध कण्ठः तु वाली स आर्त रवः शनैः । उवाच रामम् संप्रेक्ष्य पंकलग्न इव द्विपः ॥४-१८-४९॥
राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा सीता पद्मनिभेक्षणा । नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-२२-५॥
परिवार्य महाकाया महाकायं खरात्मजम् । अभिजग्मुस्ततो हृष्टाश्चालयन्तो वसुन्धराम् ॥६-७८-१५॥
translation: Those who could change their form at will, cruel, with protruding teeth, yellow eyes, dishevelled hair, of frightful appearance, huge like elephants surrounding the son of Khara went joyously forward shaking the earth.

raw: इहाहं यदि तिष्ठामि स्वेन रूपेण संवृतः । विनाशमुपयास्यामि भर्तुरर्थश्च हीयते ॥५-२-४५॥
translation: 'I will surely meet with death if I hide here in my original form and my master's mission also will be spoilt.

raw: एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकीर्तितम् । कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप ॥४-११-६८॥
translation: 'O Rama Vali's strength and fame related by me is unequalled. O king how is it possible for you to kill him in a combat?'

raw: शीलवृद्धै र्ज्ञानवृद्धैर्वयोवृद्धैश्च सज्जनैः । कथयन्नास्त वैनित्य मस्त्रयोग्यान्तरेष्वपि ॥२-१-१२॥
translation: Even during intervals of his practice of weapons he never failed to interact with saintly persons and with people advanced in age, virtue and wisdom.

raw: अप्राप्तयौवनं बालं पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् । अकाले कालमापन्नं मम दुःखाय पुत्रक ॥७-७३-५॥
translation: The child, though five thousand years old, had not yet reached youth and met an untimely death, causing great sorrow to the speaker.

raw: स्वाम् च पात्नीम् अभिप्रेताम् ताराम् च अपि समीप्सिताम् । विहरंतम् अहो रात्रम् कृतार्थम् विगत ज्वरम् ॥४-२९-४॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taking care of the kingdom. He was engrossed in sensual pleasures. Having accomplished the desired object, he was engaged in enjoyment of the company of women, his own wives and Tara, whom he coveted. He was strolling (in the pleasant garden) night and day without caring for the kingdom, entrusting it to the ministers whose movements he did not watch. He was sporting with women like Indra sports with apsaras in the Nandana garden.Hanuman, who was conscious of his duties and responsibilities, who was aware of the importance of action in time and who was skilful in speech approached Sugriva, king of the monkeys. Having decided to take him into confidence, Hanuman spoke in a convincing, wellmeaning, sweet, pleasing manner words truthful and helpful, conciliatory and just, full of love and affection:

raw: स वीरशोभामभजन्महाकपिः समेत्य रक्षांसि निहत्य मारुतिः । महासुरं भीमममित्रनाशनं यथैव विष्णुर्बलिनं चमूमुखे ॥६-५६-३८॥
translation: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).

raw: यदि ग्रहणम् अभ्येति जीवन् एव मृगः तव । आश्चर्य भूतम् भवति विस्मयम् जनयिष्यति ॥३-४३-१६॥
translation: If this deer can be caught alive, it will be thrilling, it will work wonders.

raw: कैलासम् इव दुर्धर्षम् काल अग्निम् इव दुःसहम् । ज्वलंतम् इव तेजोभिः दुर् निरीक्ष्यम् पृथक् जनैः ॥१-७४-१८॥
translation: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.

raw: ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे परिवार्य शचीसुतम् । रावणस्य सुतं युद्धे समासाद्य प्रजघ्निरे ॥७-२८-८॥
translation: Then all the gods, surrounding Shachi's son Jayanta, approached Ravana's son in battle and attacked him.

raw: खम् उत्पतन्तम् तम् दृष्ट्वा मैथिली जनक आत्मजा । दुःखिता परम उद्विग्ना भये महति वर्तिनी ॥३-५३-१॥
translation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, princess of Mithila felt miserable, looking at Ravana taking off and got very much agitated out of fear.

raw: प्रगृहीताः प्रकाशन्ते सूर्यस्य इव मरीचयः । पृथिव्याम् च अनुकृष्यन्ते हरो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-३॥
translation: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."

raw: बलेन गुप्तः भरतः महात्मा । सह आर्यकस्य आत्म समैः अमात्यैः । आदाय शत्रुघ्नम् अपेत शत्रुर् । गृहात् ययौ सिद्धैव इन्द्र लोकात् ॥२-७०-३०॥
translation: Under the protection of the army, the illustrious Bharata who was devoid of enemies, accompanied by ministers who were comparable to him and Satrughna, departed from his venerable grandfather's house like a siddha leaving the regions of Indra. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: कृत अभिषेको रामः तु सीता सौमित्रिर् एव च । तस्मात् गोदावरी तीरात् ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आश्रमम् ॥३-१७-१॥
translation: Ablution over, Rama, accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana, went back from the bank of the river Godabari to their hermitage.

raw: कपयो विहरिष्यन्ति नारिकेल वनेषु च । तत्र सीताम् च मार्गध्वम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ॥४-४२-१२॥
