raw: त्वम् गतिस् तु अगतीनाम् च चक्षुस् त्वम् हीन चक्षुषाम् । समासक्ताः त्वयि प्राणाः किम्चिन् नौ न अभिभाषसे ॥२-६४-१०॥
translation: 'You are a support to the supportless, eyes to the blind, you are our very vital life. Why don't you speak to us'?

raw: ततो माहिष्मतीं नाम पुरीं स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम् । सम्प्राप्तो यत्र सान्निध्यं सदासीद्वसुरेतसः ॥७-३१-७॥
translation: Then he reached the city named Mahishmati, which shone like a celestial city, and where the presence of Vasuretasa (Agni) always resided.

raw: अब्रवीच्च हनूमांश्च सुग्रीवश्च विभीषणम् ॥६-१९-२९॥
इमानि मुनिपत्नीनां दास्याम्याभरणान्हम् । वस्त्राणि च महार्हाणि धनानि विविधानि च ॥७-४६-११॥
translation: I shall give these ornaments, very valuable clothes, and various riches to the wives of the sages.

raw: गृहाण पाणिम् माण्डव्याः पाणिना रघुनंदन । शत्रुघ्नम् च अपि धर्माअत्मा अब्रवीत् मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७३-३२॥
विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मपरः शुचिः । पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि पादेनैकेन तस्थिवान् ॥७-१०-६॥
translation: But Vibhishana, righteous-souled, always devoted to righteousness, and pure, stood on one foot for five thousand years.

raw: पुत्रान् चिर गतान् ज्ञात्वा सगरो रघुनंदन । नप्तारम् अब्रवीत् राजा दीप्यमानम् स्व तेजसा ॥१-४१-१॥
translation: "O Delight of the Raghus, king Sagara, realising that his sons had left long ago said to his grandson Anshuman resplendent with his own lustre:

raw: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा वैदेही च यशस्विनी । सीता समग्रा रामेण महेन्द्रेण यथा शची ॥६-१२८-३८॥
translation: "Lakshmana who is endowed with extraordinary energy, and illustrious Sita accompanied by Rama will be coming as Sachi with Mahendra."

raw: वामः कामो मनुष्याणां यस्मिन्किल निबध्यते । जने तस्मिंस्त्वनुक्रोशः स्नेहश्च किल जायते ॥५-२०-४॥
स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः । पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ॥६-५८-५५॥
translation: Life, splendour, strength, and senses departed Prahastha fell instantly on the ground like a tree cut at the bottom.

raw: हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसी । सुहृदः च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते ॥४-८-३३॥
translation: 'I was robbed of my wife who is dearer than my own life. All my friends were rounded up and imprisoned.

raw: अस्य आहुः तन् महावेगम् ओदनम् स चराचरम् । तत्र विक्रोशताम् नादो भूतानाम् सागर ओकसाम् । श्रूयते च असमर्थानाम् दृष्ट्वा तत् वडवा मुखम् ॥४-४०-४९॥
translation: 'You can hear the sounds of helpless oceanic creatures crying loudly on seeing the burning face of Vadava.

raw: एतद् राघव विस्तीर्णम् आश्रमम् श्रम नाशनम् । उद्यान वन संपन्नम् स्वादु मूल फल उदकम् ॥४-१३-१७॥
translation: 'O Raghava this is a hermitage, enchanting with vast gardens and trees bearing sweet fruits, full of tasty roots and water that relieves tiresomeness (of travellers).

raw: इति रामो धृतिम् कृत्वा महाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्ये च विधिवत्प्रयतोऽत्र स्थितो मुनिः ॥६-२१-९॥
translation: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.

raw: राघवेणयथामातासुमित्रालक्ष्मणेन च भरतेन च कैकेयीजीवपुत्रास्तथास्त्रियः । भविष्यन्तिसदानन्दाःपुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः ॥६-१३१-११०॥
translation: Women listening to Ramayana will have Kausalya's Rama, Sumitra's Lakshmana, Kaikeyi's Bharata as living sons and will be always happy and blessed with sons and grandsons.

raw: विविधैर् मृग सम्घैः च विचित्राम् चित्र काननाम् । प्रासादैः सुमहद्भिः च निर्मितैर् विश्व कर्मणा ॥५-१४-३४॥
translation: Hanuman saw an oblong pond, full of cool water provided with steps, embellished with gems and beautified with pearl dust as sand on its bank. Thronged with many kinds of animals, it looked colourful with large mansions constructed by Visvakarma in the artificial woodlands decorated all over.

raw: शूरस्त्वं कृतविद्यश्च समर्थश्च निवेशने ॥७-६२-१७॥
translation: You are brave, learned, and capable in establishing a kingdom.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु तेनायं श्रीमान् क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः । उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् ॥७-५८-४॥
translation: Thus addressed by him (Lakshmana), the glorious Rama, the best among Kshatriyas, spoke words to Lakshmana, who was skilled in all scriptures.

raw: अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठम् च न्यायतः प्रतिपूज्य च । अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् प्रसवार्थम् द्विजोत्तमम् ॥१-१३-२॥
translation: After offering humble salutations and worshipping sage Vasishta in accordance with prescribed ordinance for begetting children, he obediently said:

raw: चन्दनागुरुचूतैश्च तुङ्गकालेयकैरपि । देवदारुवनैश्चापि समन्तादुपशोभिताम् ॥७-४२-२॥
translation: The grove was beautified all around by sandalwood, aloe wood, and mango trees, as well as tall Kāleyaka trees and forests of Deodar.

raw: ते रुक्म पुंखा विशिखाः स धूमा इव पावकाः । निजघ्नुः तानि रक्षांसि वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान् ॥३-२६-३०॥
translation: The goldtipped arrows which resembled fire covered with smoke shattered the army of demons like huge trees knocked down by thunder.

raw: पुरोहितस्याग्निसमस्य वै तदा बृहस्पतेरिन्द्र इवामराधिप: । प्रगृह्य पादौ सुसमृद्धतेजस: सहैव तेनोपविवेश राघव: ॥२-१०३-२८॥
translation: Rama touched the feet of the family priest Vasistha, a man equivalent to effulgent fire like Indra, the lord of the gods, does to Brihaspati and sat down along with him.

raw: उतरस्यांपुरद्वारिव्यादिश्यशुकसारणौ । स्वयंचात्रगमिष्यामिमन्त्रिणस्तानुवाचह ॥६-३६-१९॥
translation: Ravana posted Suka and Sarana at the north gate of Lanka and himself reached there and told the ministers that he would be there.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो राक्षसेन्द्रेण धीमता । कृत्वा प्रणामं संहृष्टो निर्जगाम नृपालयात् ॥६-५१-१९॥
translation: Commanded by the Intelligent king of Rakshasas in that manner, Dhumraksha offered prayers and went from there joyfully.

raw: यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् प्रभिन्नम् इव कुन्जरम् । यो बलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धः समुद्रम् अपि वानरः ॥६-२८-८॥
translation: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

raw: वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञश्शक्रतुल्य पराक्रमः । अध्यास्ते वानरश्श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम् ॥४-११-२१॥
translation: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.

raw: राज्ञा सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे । कैकेय्यै प्रीत मनसा पुरा दत्तौ महा वरौ ॥२-२६-२१॥
translation: My father, king Dasaratha, true to his promise, had earlier granted two great boons to my mother Kaikeyi.

raw: दह्यमाने च लाङ्गूले चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-५३-३४॥
translation: When the tail was burning, the vanara wondered how the fire ablaze on every side was not burning him:

raw: मत्तन् गिरि तट उद्घुष्टान् पर्वतान् इव जंगमान् । वानरान् द्विरद प्रख्यान् मही रेणु समुक्षितान् ॥४-१३-११॥
translation: (Observing) intoxicated elephants knocking the edges of mountain slopes, elephants resembling (dark) rainbearing clouds, elephants like moving mountains, elephants with dust covered all over the body.

raw: सरः प्रवृत्ता सरयूः पुण्या ब्रह्म सरः च्युता । तस्य अयम् अतुलः शब्दो जाह्नवीम् अभिवर्तते ॥१-२४-१०॥
अथो पुनस्तां महिषीं महीक्षितो । वचोभिरत्यर्थ महापराक्रमैः । उवाच कुब्जा भरतस्य मातरं । हितं वचो राममुपेत्य चाहितम् ॥२-९-६०॥
translation: Addressing queen Kaikeyi, the mother of Bharata, with extremely powerful words, that hunchback again made these utterances beneficial to Bharata and detrimental to Rama:

raw: किं शेषमिव लोकस्य हतवीरस्य साम्प्रतम् । रणे राक्षसशार्दूले प्रसुप्त इव पांसुषु ॥६-११२-९॥
translation: "With the tiger among the Rakshasas fallen asleep like this in the dust in the battlefield, strength of the people departed. What is left in this world?"

raw: स निर्जत्य पुरीम् लण्का श्रेष्ठाम् ताम् कामरूपिणीम् । विक्रमेण महातेजा हनुमान् कपिसत्तमः ॥५-४-१॥
translation: Hanuman, the strongshouldered, mighty monkey chief having defeated the (presiding) deity of Lanka who could assume any form at her will, leaped over the boundary wall of the rear entrance of the excellent city by his prowess.

raw: सुखार्हम् सुख संवृद्धम् बालम् एनम् अबालिशम् । बाष्प पूर्ण मुखम् पश्य भूमौ पतितम् अंगदम् ॥४-२२-८॥
translation: 'Look at this young Angada fallen on the ground, face flooded with tears. Raised with comfort, he deserves to be kept happy.

raw: कपालपाणिः पृथिवीमटताम् चीरसम्वृतः । भिक्समाणो यथोन्मत्तो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतह् ॥२-७५-४०॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, wander this earth, begging alms, holding a human skull like an insane man dressed in rags

raw: विवत्सां वेपमानां च क्रोशन्तीं कुररीमिव । कथमाश्वासयिष्यामि यदा यास्यामि तं विना ॥६-४९-९॥
translation: "If I go to Ayodhya without him, how can I console Sumithra crying aloud like a female osprey?"

raw: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः । ध्वजवर्मरथानश्वान्नानाप्रहरणानि च । आप्लुत्याप्लुत्य समरे राक्षसानां बभञ्जिरे ॥६-९४-१३॥
translation: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.

raw: गमिष्याम्यहमेकाकी तिष्ठत्विह बलं मम । अद्य तान् क्षुभितान् क्रुद्धो भक्षयिष्यामि वानरान् । कुम्भकर्णवचः श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६५-२२॥
translation: Enraged and angry Kumbhakarna said, "I will proceed now. Let my army remain here. I will consume them on keys today."

raw: तपः चरण योगार्थम् उवास सु महातपाः । एष पूर्व आश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मनः ॥१-२९-३॥
ते गदामुसलप्रासैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः । अभिघ्नन्तस्तदा यक्षा राक्षसान्समुपाद्रवन् ॥७-१५-४॥
translation: Then, the Yakshas, striking with maces, pestles, spears, lances, javelins, and hammers, rushed towards the Rakshasas.

raw: अथवा चारुसर्वाङ्गी रक्षिता स्वेन तेजसा । न नशिष्यति कल्याणी नाग्निरग्नौ प्रवर्तते ॥५-५५-२३॥
translation: 'On the other hand a beautiful and auspicious lady like Sita will be protected by her own splendour and will not perish as fire cannot extinguish fire. (Sita is pure like fire. Here the great sage Valmiki is suggesting the future incident in which Sita emerged safe from 'Agnipariksha' or fireordeal.)

raw: सस्कन्धविटपैः सालैः शिलाभिश्च महाबलः । हनुमान् कदनं चक्रे रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् ॥६-८२-२०॥
translation: Hanuman, who was endowed with great strength, killed Rakshasas capable of terrific tasks with trees having large trunks and branches and stones also.

raw: शृणु राजन्यथा पौराः कथयन्ति शुभाशुभम् । चत्वरापणरथ्यासु वनेषूपवनेषु च ॥७-४३-१३॥
translation: O King, listen to how the citizens speak of good and bad things in the squares, markets, streets, forests, and gardens.

raw: चरणात् नूपुरम् भ्रष्टम् वैदेह्या रत्न भूषितम् । विद्युत् मण्डल संकाशम् पपात धरणी तले ॥३-५२-२९॥
translation: The gemstudded anklet of Sita, looking like an orb of lightning, dropped with a gentle sound.

raw: राक्षसा वानराश्चापि न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात् । हनुमांस्तु विवृत्योरस्तस्थौ प्रमुखतो बली ॥६-७७-११॥
translation: The Rakshasas and even Vanaras were not able to move out of fear. Only mighty Hanuman stood there showing his chest.

raw: प्रविश्याश्वास्य चापि त्वं सीतां रहसि सान्त्वय । धनधान्यैश्च कामैश्च रत्नैश्चैनां प्रलोभय ॥६-६४-३१॥
translation: Thereafter, when the scandal that Rama and Lakshmana with all his friends have been devoured is widely spread everywhere, approaching Sita privately, restoring confidence and consoling her, tempt her with offering wealth, grain and gems and conciliate.

raw: मरुद्रोधाद्विनिर्मुक्तास्ताः प्रजा मुदिता ऽभवन् । शीतदाहविनिर्मुक्ताः पद्मिन्य इव साम्बुजाः ॥७-३६-६॥
translation: Released from the obstruction of Vayu, all creatures became joyful, just like lotus plants in ponds are revived when freed from extreme cold and heat.

raw: तडित् पताकाभिः अलंकृतानाम्उदीर्ण गंभीर महा रवाणाम् । विभान्ति रूपाणि बलाहकानाम्रण उत्सुकानाम् इव वारणानाम् ॥४-२८-३१॥
translation: 'The rainclouds decorated with banners of lightning and giving out peals of thunder shine like elephants in rut trumpeting, eager to fight in battle.

raw: यत् च ते सुकृतो धर्मः तस्य इह फलम् आप्नुहि । इह सर्वाणि माल्यानि दिव्य गंधानि मैथिलि ॥३-५५-२८॥
जीवितम् वात्मनो रामम् न त्वेव पितृवत्सलम् । परा भवति मे प्रीतिर्धृष्ट्वा तनयमग्रजम् ॥२-१२-१२॥
अर्जुनो विदधे मृत्युम् प्राकृताम् बुद्धिम् आस्थितः । वधम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु पितुः श्रुत्वा सु दारुणम् । क्षत्रम् उत्सादयन् रोषात् जातम् जातम् अनेकशः ॥१-७५-२४॥
ताम् भुजाभ्याम् परिष्वज्य श्वश्रूर् वचनम् अब्रवीत् । अनाचरन्तीम् कृपणम् मूध्नि उपाघ्राय मैथिलीम् ॥२-३९-१९॥
translation: Kausalya, Sita's motherinlaw, took her in her arms, embraced her, kissed her on the forehead, and said to her who conducted herself without evoking any pity.

raw: स बद्धो वाग्भिः अग्र्याभिः अभितुष्टाव वै सुरौ । इन्द्रम् इन्द्र अनुजम् चैव यथावत् मुनि पुत्रकः ॥१-६२-२५॥
translation: Thus bound, the son of the sage praised the two devatas, Indra and Upendra with moving words.

raw: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा सर्वे दिशो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः । प्रच्छादयामास रविप्रकाशैर्विषादयामास च वानरेन्द्रान् ॥६-७३-५२॥
translation: Thereafter the mighty Lord of Rakshasas despatched volley of sharp tipped arrows bright like the Sun, at Vanara leaders on all sides and eradicated.

raw: स तं प्रति विगाह्याशु प्रवृद्धं सैन्यसागरम् । त्रिदशान्समरे निघ्नञ्छक्रमेवाभ्यवर्तत ॥७-२८-४५॥
translation: He quickly plunged into that swollen ocean of the enemy army, striking down the gods in battle, and advanced directly towards Indra.

raw: विद्धमन्योन्यगात्रेषु द्विगुणं वर्धते परम् । कृतप्रतिकृतान्योन्यं कुरुतां तौ रणाजिरे ॥६-७९-२६॥
translation: Even though they were piercing one another with limbs, their strength remained doubled in the battlefield. Each of them was countering the other and inflicting and hitting each other.

raw: अयं ह्युत्सहते क्रुद्धः कर्तुमेकार्णवं जगत् । इति चिन्तां बहुविधामकरोन्मतिमान् हरिः । दृष्ट्वा राक्षसराजस्य प्रभावममितौजसः ॥५-४९-२०॥
translation: Many such thoughts crossed Hanuman's intelligent mind on seeing Ravana's brilliance and power. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: चाराणाम् रावणः श्रुत्वा प्राप्तम् रामम् महाबलम् । जात उद्वेगो अभवत् किम्चित् शार्दूलम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥६-३०-२॥
translation: On hearing from the spies that Rama has camped with a great army, Ravana got a little panicky and said these words to Saardula.

raw: अस्मद् व्यपेक्षान् सौमित्रे निरपेक्षान् गृहेष्व् अपि । वृक्ष मूलेषु सम्सुप्तान् पश्य लक्ष्मण साम्प्रतम् ॥२-४६-१९॥
translation: O Lakshmana, son of Sumitra look at these people, fast alseep under the trees. Out of affection for us, they are even indifferent to their home.

raw: शैल अग्रेभ्यः पतिष्यन्ति समेत्य विषमेषु च । विषम् उद्बन्धनम् वा अपि प्रवेशम् ज्वलनस्य वा ॥५-१३-३६॥
उचितम् च महाबाहुर्न जहौ हर्षमात्मनः । शारदः समुदीर्णाम्शुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम् ॥२-१९-३७॥
translation: The mightyarmed (Rama) did not leave his habitual cheerfulness like the autumnal Moon his own brightness.

raw: आत्मानमनुशोच त्वं किमन्यमनुशोचसि । आयुस्ते हीयते यस्य स्थितस्य च गतस्य च ॥२-१०५-२१॥
translation: Whether you are static or moving, your lifespan decreases. Therefore, you should only grieve about yourself and not for any one else.

raw: भुजाभ्याम् पीन वृताभ्याम् अंगदो अहम् इति ब्रुवन् । अभिवादयमानम् त्वाम् अंगदम् त्वम् यथा पुरा ॥४-२३-२५॥
न मे स्वर्गो बहुमतः सम्मानश्च सुरर्षिभिः । त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते ॥६-१२२-१३॥
translation: "Rama separated from you, even the suras and sages honouring me in heaven does not give me happiness. It is true and I promise."

raw: स ता दृष्ट्वा महाबाहूर्महासत्त्वो महाबलः । चकार सुमहद्रूपं राक्षसीनां भयावहम् ॥५-४२-४॥
translation: When the powerful, mighty and strongarmed Hanuman saw the ogresses he assumed a very huge form in order to strike terror in them.

raw: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा भक्ष लुब्धस्य पक्षिणः । अंगदः परम् आयस्तो हनूमंतम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥४-५६-६॥
translation: Hearing the words of the vulture greedily waiting for food, deeply dejected Angada spoke to Hanuman:

raw: इत्येवमुक्त्वा धन्वी स रामः सम्ग्रामधर्षणः । प्रतस्थे पुरतो रामो लङ्कामभिमुखो विभुः ॥६-२३-१४॥
translation: Rama, the subduer of enemies in war, a celebrated one having spoken this way proceeded towards Lanka going in front wielding a bow.

raw: अद्भिर् एव तु सौमित्रे वत्स्याम्य् अद्य निशाम् इमाम् । एतद्द् हि रोचते मह्यम् वन्ये अपि विविधे सति ॥२-४६-१०॥
translation: O Lakshmana, I shall live this night on water alone. I prefer it, though various kinds of forest products are available.

raw: स तु कोपेन चाविष्टः शोकेन च महाकपिः । हनुमान् रावणिरथे ऽपातयन्महतीं शिलाम् ॥६-८२-९॥
translation: Hanuman, overtaken by anger, filled with great sorrow hurled a huge rock at the chariot of Ravana's son.

raw: रक्ष नः त्वम् सह भ्रात्रा त्वम् नाथा हि वयम् वने । मया च एतत् वचः श्रुत्वा कार्त्स्न्येन परिपालनम् ॥३-१०-१६॥
अपश्यन् नगरम् श्रीमान् नाना जन समाकुलम् । स गृहैः अभ्र सम्काशैः पाण्डुरैः उपशोभितम् ॥२-१७-२॥
इति शप्तो महातेजा भृगुणा पूर्वजन्मनि । इहागतो हि पुत्रत्वं तव पार्थिवसत्तम ॥७-५१-२०॥
translation: The greatly effulgent one, who was cursed by Bhrigu in a previous birth, has indeed come here to be your son, O best among kings.

raw: राज्ये पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठाप्यः स गुणो निर्गुणो अपि वा । कथम् शत्रु कुलीनम् माम् सुग्रीवो जीवयिष्यति ॥४-५५-८॥
translation: 'If I am the king's son, virtuous or otherwise, I will be installed in the kingdom (as successor). How can Sugriva suffer me to live when I am his enemy's descendant?

raw: रोचते यदि मे सख्यम् बाहुः एष प्रसारितः । गृह्यताम् पाणिना पाणिः मर्यादा बध्यताम् ध्रुवा ॥४-५-११॥
translation: 'If you are desirous of my friendship, here is my arm (palm) stretched out to you. With due regard, establish our bond firmly, holding my palm in yours.'

raw: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीमभ्यवादयत् ॥५-५६-८॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having consoled Vaidehi, saluted her respectfully and decided to depart.

raw: राक्षाभ्याम् अहम् द्वाभ्याम् अनिर्विण्णः तथा कृतः । सहितो मृग रूपाभ्याम् प्रविष्टो दंडका वने ॥३-३९-२॥
translation: Having done so, I picked up courage and entered Dandaka forest, accompanied by the two other demons in the form of deer .

raw: सप्तधा तु कृते गर्भे दितिः परम दुःखिता । सहस्राक्षम् दुराधर्षम् वाक्यम् स अनुनया अब्रवीत् ॥१-४७-१॥
translation: Deeply distressed Diti, having come to know that the embryo had been severed into seven pieces, humbly spoke to the unassailable Indra.

raw: राजा वा राजमात्रो वा किं तदा नात्र कश्चन । धर्षणं यत्र न प्राप्तो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥७-३१-३॥
translation: Or was there no king or king's equal then, where Ravana, the lord of demons, did not meet with defeat or humiliation?

raw: स्नानानि चाङ्गरागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च । चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि माल्यानि विविधानि च ॥६-१२४-२॥
translation: These lotus petal eyed women well versed in decoration are at your service. They are willing to assist you in bath. There are cosmetics for anointing your body, and clothes as well as ornaments, sandal paste etc. for you. There are garlands of several types here.

raw: तस्मै तु दत्तं परमास्त्रमेतत् स्वयम्भुवा ब्राह्मममोघवेगम् । तन्मानयन्तौ युधि राजपुत्रौ निपातितौ को ऽत्र विषादकालः ॥६-७४-४॥
translation: To him (Indrajith), the creator has conferred this weapon of Brahma endowed with terrific speed. To respect the missile both the princes have fallen. Why do you grieve?

raw: दह्यन्ते भृशमङ्गानि दुरात्मन् मम राघव । यन्मया ऽसि न दृष्टस्त्वं तस्मिन् काले महावने ॥६-७९-१२॥
translation: "O Evil minded Raghava! at that time, I did not see you in D and aka forest. My limbs are burning in anger."

raw: न कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु संयुगे नगतश्रमः । भुजवीर्याभिगुप्तश्च तपसा चाभिरक्षितः । देशकालविभागज्ञस्त्वमेव मतिसत्तमः ॥५-४८-४॥
translation: "Excepting you there is none who has not experienced fatigue in war in the three worlds. You alone are intelligent in fighting. You are protected by the strength of your arms and power of austerity. You are aware of the proper place and time of action.

raw: तैः सायकैर्महावेगै रावणस्य महाद्युतिः । ध्वजं मनुष्यशीर्षं तु तस्य चिच्छेद नैकधा ॥६-१०१-१४॥
translation: Lakshmana, who was endowed with extraordinary splendour, for his part, with his shafts which had great force, shattered the device of man's head on the flag post of Ravana.

raw: पुत्र शोक अर्दितम् पापा विसम्ज्ञम् पतितम् भुवि । विवेष्टमानम् उदीक्ष्य सा ऐक्ष्वाकम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-१॥
translation: The evil woman (Kaikeyi) said to the king of the Ikshvaku race who lay unconscious on the floor writhing and tormented with grief on account of his son.

raw: प्रदातुम् तव काकुत्थ्स सदृअशः त्वम् हि पार्थिव । कामम् बहुगुणाः सर्वे त्वयि एते न अत्र संशयः ॥१-२२-१९॥
विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा मम पित्रा सुपूजित: । प्रोवाच पितरं तत्र भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥२-११८-४५॥
translation: Having accepted the honour extended by my father, righteous Viswamitra spoke to him about those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana.

raw: नैतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं मयि जीवति पार्थिव । तमहं नाशयिष्यामि यत्कृते परितप्यसे ॥६-६३-३१॥
translation: "While I am (my body is) with life you need not entertain despondency. I will exterminate him, by whose account you are agitated."

raw: आवृतः स गिरिः सर्वैस्तैः समन्तात् प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-४१-५१॥
व्यक्तम् सा भक्षिता बाला राक्षसैः पिशित अशनैः । विभज्य अंगानि सर्वाणि मया विरहिता प्रिया ॥३-६०-३०॥
translation: It is clear that separated from me, the body of my young beloved is torn off and eaten away by carnivorous demons.

raw: कुले यद्यप्यहं जातो रक्षसां क्रूरकर्मणाम् । गुणो ऽयं प्रथमो नृणां तन्मे शीलमराक्षसम् ॥६-८७-२०॥
translation: "Impious son of Rakshasa king! Though born in the Rakshasa clan I renounced cruel deeds and followed respectfully manliness as my primary quality. My nature is not like that of Rakshasas."

raw: भोगामः च पश्य नागानाम् मया भिन्नानि लक्ष्मण ॥६-२१-१८॥
translation: "Lakshmana See here the coils of serpents, huge snakes, fish and large sea elephants cut into pieces by me."

raw: निजघ्नुः संयुगे क्रुद्धाः कवचाभरणावृतान् । केचिद्रथगतान् वीरान् गजवाजिगतानपि ॥६-६९-५१॥
translation: In the combat, the enraged Vanaras killed Rakshasas decked with shields and ornaments. Some killed the ones mounted on chariots, elephants, and horses.

raw: पृच्छन्तं राघवं वाक्यमूचतुर्मुनिदारकौ ॥७-९४-२४॥
translation: The sons of the sage then spoke words to Rama, who was questioning them.

raw: ततः तयोः अपाये तु शून्ये सीताम् यथा सुखम् । निराबाधो हरिष्यामि राहुः चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव ॥३-३६-२०॥
translation: Then during their absence it will be easy for me to abduct Sita in an isolated place without obstruction, like Rahu eclipsing the light of the moon.

raw: सा पपात त्रिधा च्छिन्ना शक्तिः काञ्चनमालिनी । सविस्फुलिङ्गा ज्वलिता महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता ॥६-१०१-२१॥
translation: The javelin, which was covered with gold, broke into three parts, and fell down like a huge meteor emitting fire sparks from the heavens.

raw: दुःखान्यसहती देवी मामेवानुमरिष्यति । कौसल्याम् च सुमित्राम् च माम् च पुत्रैस्त्रिभिः सह ॥२-१२-९१॥
यस्तु कुम्भो रघुश्रेष्ठ तेजःपूर्णो महात्मनोः । तस्मिंस्तेजोमयौ विप्रौ सम्भूतावृषिसत्तमौ ॥७-५७-४॥
translation: O best of Raghu's lineage, in that pot, which was filled with the radiant semen of the two great souls (Mitra and Varuna), two radiant Brahmins, who were excellent sages, were born.

raw: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् ज्येष्ठा पुत्रम् व्यजायत । असमंज इति ख्यातम् केशिनी सगरात्मजम् ॥१-३८-१६॥
translation: After lapse of some time, the eldest wife Kesini gave birth to a son wellknown by name Asamanjasa.

raw: एकः सत् पुरुषो लोके लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया । यो अनुगच्चति काकुत्स्थम् रामम् परिचरन् वने ॥२-४८-८॥
translation: Lakshmana is the only fortunate person in the world who has followed Rama of the Kakutstha race along with Sita to serve them.

raw: क्षत्रियाश्च महात्मानो नानाजनपदेश्वराः । रामस्योपाविशन्पार्श्वे शक्रस्येव यथा ऽमराः ॥७-३७-१६॥
translation: Great-souled Kshatriyas and rulers from various regions sat by Rama's side, just as the immortals sit by Indra.

raw: तस्यैते निशितास्तीक्ष्णाः पत्रिपत्राङ्गवाजिनः । पतत्रिण इवासौम्याः शराः पास्यन्ति शोणितम् ॥६-८४-१९॥
शीलातलम् प्राप्य यथा मृगेन्द्रो । महारणम् प्राप्य यथा गजेन्द्रह् । राज्यम् समासाद्य यथा नरेन्द्र । स्तथाप्रकाशो विरराज चन्द्रः ॥५-५-७॥
translation: The Moon shone bright like a lion mounted on a rock, like a lordly elephant in a deep forest, like a king on attaining the kingdom.

raw: इदं हि दृष्ट्वा मतिमन्महद्बलं कपेः प्रभावं च पराक्रमं च । त्वमात्मनश्चापि समीक्ष्य सारं कुरुष्व वेगं स्वबलानुरूपम् ॥५-४८-१०॥
translation: "O intelligent warrior measure the strength, power and valour of the monkey and your own strength carefully. Exercise your own strength and speed accordingly.

raw: ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमान् ववौ न वायुः प्रचचाल चाचलः । कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य संयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे ॥५-४७-१३॥
translation: Witnessing the fight between Hanuman and Prince Aksha, even the earth shrieked in agony, the Sun became dim, the wind stopped blowing, mountains were shaken, the sky thundered and even the ocean was agitated.

raw: अर्जुनस्य गदा सा तु पात्यमाना ऽहितोरसि । काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा ॥७-३२-५६॥
translation: Arjuna's mace, when struck upon the enemy's (Ravana's) chest, made the sky appear golden-hued, just like a flash of lightning.

raw: मानुषे चिन्तयामास जन्मभूमिम् अथ आत्मनः । ततः पद्म पलाशाक्षः कृत्वा आत्मानम् चतुर्विधम् ॥१-१५-३१॥
एष शापवशादेव न वेद बलमात्मनः । वालिसुग्रीवयोर्वैरं यदा राम समुत्थितम् ॥७-३६-४१॥
translation: O Rama, it was due to a curse that Sugriva did not know his own strength when the enmity between Vali and Sugriva arose.

raw: उत्संगेन एव भुजगीम् तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्राम् महाविषाम् । वनानि सरितः शैलान् सराम्सि च विहायसा ॥३-५४-७॥
इति प्रव्याहृतं भद्रे मयैतत् कृतबुद्धिना । लक्ष्मणे भरते वा त्वं कुरु बुद्धिं यथासुखम् ॥६-११८-२२॥
translation: " Auspicious one! This utterance has been thought over well today. You may go wherever you find happiness, either to Lakshmana or else to Bharata. Think well and do."

raw: ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् लंबमाने दिवाकरे । ददृशुः सहिता रंयम् तटाकम् योजन आयुतम् ॥३-११-५॥
translation: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

raw: ततः स्त्वम् प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयम् लोक विश्रुतम् । ब्रह्म हत्याम् इव अधर्मात् समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः ॥२-२१-२७॥
translation: O son you will then fall into hell. As wellknown in the world, the ocean, the lord of rivers, incurred the guilt of slaying a brahmin through unrighteous conduct.

raw: कुशान्तर्धानदत्तेषु मृगचर्मयुतेषु च । यथार्हमुपविष्टास्ते आसनेष्वृषिपुङ्गवाः ॥७-१-१५॥
translation: The foremost among sages then sat appropriately on those seats, which were provided with kusha grass underneath and furnished with deer skins.

raw: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा कथान्ते रघुनंदन । उवाच परम प्रीतो मुनिम् दीप्तम् इव अनलम् ॥१-३९-१॥
translation: Immensely pleased with the words of Viswamitra, to the ascetic flaming bright like fire, Rama spoke towards the end of the narration:

raw: जनन्या राक्षस इन्द्रो वै त्वन् मोक्ष अर्थम् बृहद् वचः । अविद्धेन च वैदेहि मन्त्रि वृद्धेन बोधितः ॥६-३४-२०॥
translation: "O Vaidehi! Ravana's mother Kaikasi and the aged minister Aviddha advised the Lord of Rakshasas to release you."

raw: तव अहम् चक्षुषा सौम्य पूता सौम्येन मानद । गमिष्याम्यक्षयांलोकांस्वत्प्रसादादरिन्दम - यद्वा -गमिष्यामि अक्षयान् लोकान् त्वत् प्रसादात् अरिंदम ॥३-७४-१३॥
परिपालयमानस्य राज्ञो भूतानि पुत्रवत् । ततः तु द्रुह्यताम् पापम् यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२४॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a man acting treacherously against a king who rules like a father and protects his subjects like his own children, acquires.

raw: प्रसादिते च पवने ब्रह्मा तुभ्यम् वरम् ददौ । अशस्त्र वध्यताम् तात समरे सत्य विक्रम ॥४-६६-२७॥
translation: 'O dear when the Windgod was pleased, Brahma gave a boon to you, to appease his anger. The boon made you truly valiant so that you cannot be struck by any weapon and killed.

raw: गृहाणि नाना वसु राजितानि । देव असुरैः च अपि सुपूजितानि । सर्वैः च दोषैः परिवर्जितानि । कपिर् ददर्श स्व बल अर्जितानि ॥५-७-३॥
translation: The monkey saw numerous kinds of treasures, cherished by gods and demons, which were won by Ravana's might.

raw: शलभा इव केदारं मशका इव पर्वतम् । यथामृतघटं दंशा मकरा इव चार्णवम् ॥७-७-३॥
translation: Just as locusts swarm a field, mosquitoes a mountain, flies a pot of nectar, and crocodiles the ocean, so too did the arrows approach Hari.

raw: अथोवाच पुनः सीतामसम्भ्रान्तो विनीतवत् । प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्हर्षात् सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ॥६-११६-३०॥
translation: Now with folded palms offering prayers to Sita, Hanuman stood without perturbation, with all humility and again spoke to Sita.

raw: मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वृता । इयं पर्वतसम्बाधा मेदिनी चाभवन्मही ॥७-१०४-६॥
translation: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.

raw: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः । पिपासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ति वाक्यवारिणा ॥५-६६-८॥
translation: "O handsome Hanuman Sita is like water for a thirsty person. Tell me again and again what Sita said to you. Sprinkle on me (lifegiving) water of her words in the form of message.

raw: निष्पतन्तं महाकायं महानादं महाबलम् । तमाशीर्भिः प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास रावणः ॥६-६५-३३॥
translation: Kumbhakarna, of huge body, of loud voice and highly capable having been dismissed by Ravana, went with the great army after benediction and started observing.

raw: प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया । श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम् ॥२-२९-१७॥
translation: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

raw: अथ ते अग्निम् सुराम् च एव वैदेही राम लक्ष्मणौ । काल्यम् विधिवत् अभ्यर्च्य तपस्वि शरणे वने ॥३-८-३॥
translation: And as per routine, sinless Sita, Rama and Lakshmana offered prayers to the fire and other gods of the forest which was the refuge of the ascetics. Seeing the rising Sun, they worshipped him, and approaching Sutikshna, said these soothing words:

raw: समं सम्प्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् ॥७-२६-७॥
translation: Where they sang together in unison, their songs greatly increased the satisfaction of the mind.

raw: कुटुम्बवृद्धिंधनधान्यवृद्धिंस्त्रियश्चमुख्यास्सुखमुत्तमं च । श्रुत्वाशुभंकाव्यमिदंमहार्थंप्राप्नोतिसर्वांभुविचार्थसिद्धम् ॥६-१३१-१२४॥
translation: Listening to this great auspicious epic will result in the growth of the family, excellent women, augmentation of wealth and grains and comfort on the earth and accomplishment of one's objectives.

raw: प्रत्याख्यातो अस्मि भद्रम् वो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना । यष्टु कामो महायज्ञम् तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्थथ ॥१-५८-१८॥
अर्धचन्द्रेण वदने शिरस्येकेन कर्णिना । बाह्वोर्विव्याध नाराचैर्दशभिस्तं कपीश्वरम् ॥५-४४-७॥
translation: Jambumali released a crescentshaped arrow on the face, one earshaped (barbed) arrow on the head and ten iron arrows into the arms of the lord of monkeys.

raw: ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेन राहुणा ऽभिविराजते । सूर्यरश्मिनिभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन् ॥६-७१-१७॥
translation: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."

raw: ततः शूर्पणखा वाक्यात् उद्युक्तान् सर्व राक्षसान् । खरम् त्रिशिरसम् च एव दूषणम् च एव राक्षसम् ॥१-१-४७॥
translation: Thereafter Rama killed in the fight all the rakshasas, Khara, Trisira, and Dushana with their followers in a battle who were instigated by Surpanakha's words.

raw: आविश्य लङ्काम् वेगेन राजानमिदमब्रवीत् । एष वै वानरर्क्षघो लङ्काम् समभिवर्तते ॥६-२०-३॥
विदुषः क्षत्रचारित्रे प्राज्ञस्य प्राप्तकारिणः । भयात्प्रवेपे रामस्य चिन्तयन्ती तवात्मजम् ॥२-८-८॥
translation: Rama is learned in the duties of a kshatriya. He is wise enough to do what he should at the appropriate time. While reflecting the fate of your son, I am trembling with fear.

raw: दिव्य आभरण माल्याभिः दिव्य रूपाभिः आवृतम् । क्रीडा रति विधिज्ञाभिः अप्सरोभिः सहस्रशः ॥३-३५-१६॥
translation: (The place was) full of apsaras in their thousands and paragons of beauty adorned with divine ornaments and garlands, and experts in lovesports.

raw: सुखोषितो ऽस्मि भगवन् समग्रबलवाहन: । तर्पित: सर्वकामैश्च सामात्यो बलवत्त्वया ॥२-९२-५॥
translation: O holy one, I with my ministers and the entire army of men and animals passed the night happily. All our desires have been gratified by you.

raw: तेन पादतलाक्रान्ता रम्येषु गिरिसानुषु । सघोषाः समशीर्यन्त शिलाश्चूर्णीकृतास्ततः ॥५-५६-२२॥
translation: Crushed under Hanuman's feet the rocks making a loud noise on the beautiful mountain ranges rolled down, reduced to powder.

raw: लाघवेन तु संयुक्तो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । अपक्रम्य रथात्तूर्णं गदापाणिः क्षितौ स्थितः ॥६-४३-३७॥
translation: Vidyunmali seeing Sushena, the monkey leader got a huge rock, and hit him on his chest with the mace.

raw: प्रयच्छ नो हि लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुङ्गवम् । यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि । न वसामो विना राज्ञा एष नो निश्चयः परः ॥७-७६-३९॥
translation: The people implored Brahma, the Lord of the worlds, to grant them an earthly king, a best among men, whom they could worship to cleanse their sins and under whose rule they could live, as they declared their supreme resolve not to live without a king.

raw: कच्चित् सुकुशली राजा पिता दशरथो मम । कच्चिच् च अरागता रामे लक्ष्मणे वा महात्मनि ॥२-७०-७॥
translation: I hope my father, Dasaratha is doing well and revered Rama and Lakshmana are in good health

raw: ततः स सान्त्वयामास सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । स्त्रीहेतोर्वालिना भ्रात्रा निरस्तमुरुतेजसा ॥५-३५-३४॥
translation: "Then Rama, consoled Sugriva who was dethroned and abandoned on acount of a woman by his brother Vali, endowed with great prowess.

raw: कृतास्त्रम् अकृतास्त्रम् वा न एवम् शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसाः । गुप्तम् कुइशिक पुत्रेण ज्वलनेन अमृतम् यथा ॥१-२१-९॥
translation: Trained or not in the use of arms, as long as Rama is protected by Viswamitra, just as nectar is protected by the flaming firegod rakshasas will not be able to compete with him.

raw: तस्त्वद्भुतसङ्काशास्स्थिताःपर्वतमूर्धनि सीतांगृहीत्वागच्छन्तंवानराःपर्वतोपमाः । ददृशुर्मिस्मिताकारारावणंराक्षसाधिपम् ॥६-१२९-२७॥
translation: "Standing on the mountain top, the Vanaras who were like mountains in size watched the wonderful feat of the king of Rakshasas of wonderful form taking Sita."

raw: पङ्कदिग्धस्तु भरतो जटिलस्त्वां प्रतीक्षते । पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्वं च कुशलं गृहे ॥६-१२७-४॥
translation: "Bharata is without attention to his body, wearing matted locks, placing your wooden sandals in front expecting you in the house. All is well at Ayodhya."

raw: न तत्र कश्चिदुद्देशो यस्तेन न विनाशितः । यत्र सा जानकी सीता स तेन न विनाशितः ॥५-४२-१७॥
translation: There is not a single place that has not been ruined by him there. Only the place where Janaka's daughter, Sita is resting has not been touched.

raw: अवध्यताम् प्रेक्ष्य महासुरस्य तौशितेन शस्त्रेण तदा नरर्षभौ । समर्थ्य च अत्यर्थ विशारदौ उभौबिले विरधस्य वधम् प्रचक्रतुः ॥३-४-३०॥
translation: The two princes, bulls among men, who were adept in archery saw that the great demon could not be killed by any other means. They reflected over the issue and undertook the task of killing him with sharp weapons and buried him in a pit.

raw: तामशोकस्य शाखां सा विमुक्ता शोककर्शिता । तस्यामेवानवद्याङ्गी धरण्यां समुपाविशत् ॥५-३४-११॥
translation: So saying Sita of flawless limbs, emaciated with grief, left the branch of Ashoka tree held by her and squatted on the ground.

raw: यद्वा ऽमृतरसः पीतस्त्वया रावण राक्षस । तदा वालिनमासाद्य तदन्तं तव जीवितम् ॥७-३४-८॥
translation: O demon Ravana, even if you have drunk the nectar of immortality, your life will surely end once you encounter Valin.

raw: सुकेशतनयैर्देव त्रिभिस्त्रेताग्निसन्निभैः । आक्रम्य वरदानेन स्थानान्यपहृतानि नः ॥७-६-१३॥
translation: O Lord, our abodes have been seized and taken away by the three sons of Sukesha, who resemble the three sacred fires, by virtue of a boon.

raw: ततः खड्गं समुद्यम्य त्रिशिरा राक्षसोत्तमः । निजघान तदा व्यूढे वायुपुत्रस्य वक्षसि ॥६-७०-४१॥
translation: Trisira, the foremost of Rakshasas then lifted his sword, placed it on the chest of Hanuman and dug into it.

raw: इति सम्चिन्त्य तद्राजा नाध्यगच्छ त्तदा सुखम् । प्रतिलभ्य चिरात्सम्ज्ञाम् कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः ॥२-१२-३॥
translation: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed by sorrow fell into a stupor again.

raw: भ्राजमानं महार्हेण काञ्चनेन विराजता । मुक्ताजालावृतेनाथ मुकुटेन महाद्युतिम् ॥५-४९-२॥
translation: (Hanuman looked at Ravana) of innate splendour, who shone with a glittering crown of gold glowing, encircled with strings of pearls.

raw: द्वा त्रिंशत् सहस्राम् वर्षाणि सुमहा यशाः । तपोवन गतो राजा स्वर्गम् लेभे तपोधनः ॥१-४२-४॥
translation: O Rama highly renowned Anshuman, having lived for thirtytwo thousand years in the tapovana, turned an ascetic and attained heaven (without accomplishing his objective).

raw: विज्ञाय इह आत्म शक्तिम् च क्रियताम् च महाबल । सीता तव अनवद्यांगी भार्यत्वे राक्षसेश्वर ॥३-३४-२६॥
translation: Assess your own strength, O Lord of the demons, before you forcefully abduct that delicate Sita who is charming in all respects and make her your wife.

raw: वर्तते च उत्तमाम् वृत्तिम् लक्ष्मणो अस्मिन् सदा अनघः । दयावान् सर्व भूतेषु लाभः तस्य महात्मनः ॥२-४४-५॥
translation: Blameless Lakshmana, compassionate to all beings, has acted most nobly in this matter for the benefit of his great soul.

raw: स वाली गाढ संवीतो मुष्टिम् उद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । सुग्रीवम् एव अभिमुखो ययौ योद्धुम् कृत क्षणः ॥४-१६-१७॥
translation: Vali tied up his cloth tightly, raised his fist and advanced towards Sugriva, ready for the encounter.

raw: किं त्वमन्तःपुरे सीते सर्वभूतमनोहरे । महार्हशयनोपेते न वासमनुमन्यसे ॥५-२२-२॥
मनसा सम्तताप अथ तत् श्रुत्वा राक्षस अधिपः । शार्दूलस्य महद् वाक्यम् अथ उवाच स रावणः ॥६-३०-१४॥
translation: "Having heard what has been said by Saardula, Rakshasa king reviewed in his mind and made a good statement before Saardula."

raw: अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामंयन्मृगच्छद्मनात्वया आनीतारामपनतीसातत्तेकातर्यलक्षणम् ॥६-११४-६८॥
translation: "By your cowardly action of creating an illusory deer, you have brought Rama's consort from the hermitage."

raw: दश क्रोशैतः तात गिरिर् यस्मिन् निवत्स्यसि । महर्षि सेवितः पुण्यः सर्वतः सुख दर्शनः ॥२-५४-२८॥
translation: O my son ten krosas (about twenty miles) from here is a mountain wellknown as Chitrakuta, resembling 'Gandhamadana'. That mountain frequented by maharshis is sacred. It looks pleasant from all sides. Monkeys, apes and bears wander there and it is an appropriate place for you to live in.

raw: कुम्भकर्णे महाराज निद्रामनुभवत्यथ । निहत्य राक्षसश्रेष्ठानमात्यानिह सम्मतान् ॥७-२५-२६॥
translation: O great king, at that time, while Kumbhakarna was experiencing his long sleep, Madhu killed the best and most respected demon ministers here.

raw: कबन्धानि समुत्पेतुर्दिक्षु वानररक्षसाम् । विमर्दे तुमुले तस्मिन् देवासुररणोपमे ॥६-४३-४४॥
translation: It was like the war between Devatas and demons, with the trunks of the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas rubbing together lying scattered in all directions.

raw: आरोप्य शिबिकाम् चैव वालिनम् गत जीवितम् । अलंकारैः च विविधैः माल्यैः वस्त्रैः च भूषितम् ॥४-२५-२९॥
translation: Vali's deadbody was placed on the palanquin, decorated with many ornaments, garlands and clothes

raw: न मानुषी राक्षसस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हति । कामं खादत मां सर्वा न करिष्यामि वो वचः ॥५-२३-३॥
परिघान् पट्टसान् प्रासान् शक्ति शूल परश्वधान् । चापानि च सबाणानि खड्गामः च विपुलान् शितान् ॥६-९-४॥
translation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

raw: एतान्निहन्तुमिच्छामि समरश्लाघिनो ह्यहम् । एतैः प्रमथितं सर्वं दृश्यते राक्षसं बलम् ॥६-५६-५॥
translation: "I wish to see the end of Vanaras who boast of their warfare. The entire Rakshasa army is destroyed by them."

raw: प्रवेशं चापि रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह । विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च ॥६-१२६-२९॥
translation: "We shall see with all the citizens, Rama's entry into Ayodhya, Dasharatha's women and the glory of Ayodhya, everything."

raw: ददृशुः भीम कर्माणम् असुरम् सुर निर्भयम् । तम् दृष्ट्वा वनरा घोरम् स्थितम् शैलम् इव असुरम् ॥४-४८-१८॥
एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । भूयः समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम् ॥५-५९-१॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷

raw: उपालक्ष्य निमित्तानि सो अशुभानि मुहुर् मुहुः । अपि क्षेमम् तु सीताया इति वै व्याजहार ह ॥३-६०-२॥
translation: As inauspicious omens appeared again and again, doubting if all is well with Sita, he said to himself, Can Sita be safe?

raw: बलमिच्छामहे ज्ञातुं भूयश्चास्य पराक्रमम् । त्वां विजेष्यत्युपायेन विषादं वा गमिष्यति ॥५-१-१४८॥
translation: "We want to assess his strength, valour and intelligence once again. We wish to know whether he will win or give way to despondency".

raw: लक्षयस्व तयोः भावम् प्रहृष्ट मनसौ यदि । विश्वासयन् प्रशंसाभिः इङ्गितैः च पुनः पुनः ॥४-२-२५॥
translation: 'O best of monkeys ascertain their purpose by praising them and studying their honest intentions. Gain the confidence of the wielders of bows and if you find them agreeable, enquire the purpose of their entering this forest.

raw: यान शालाम् ततो गत्वा प्रच्छन्नम् राक्षस अधिपः । सूतम् संचोदयामास रथः संयुज्यताम् इति ॥३-३५-४॥
translation: Ravana went covertly to the coachshed and to the charioteer to get a chariot harnessed.

raw: खड्गचापधराः शूरा जग्मुराशम्सवो जनाः । ततो वादित्रशब्दाश्च स्तुतिशब्दाश्च वन्दिनाम् ॥२-१६-३६॥
एवमस्त्विति रामेण पूजयित्वा विसर्जितम् । अभिप्रेतां दिशं तस्मात्प्रायात्तत्पुष्पकं तदा ॥७-४१-१५॥
translation: Having been worshipped and dismissed by Rama with the words "So be it," the Pushpaka then departed from there towards its desired direction.

raw: रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुर् नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः । न हि एष राघवस्य अर्थे जीवितम् परिरक्षति ॥६-२८-२५॥
चत्वारः तु सुरश्रेष्ठ दिशो वै तव शासनात् । संचरिष्यन्ति भद्रम् ते कलेन हि मम आत्मजाः ॥१-४७-६॥
translation: O best of devatas by your command the other four sons will remain celestial, and will range about in four directions.

raw: तां प्रविश्य महाद्वारां सर्वतो योजनायताम् । कुम्भकर्णगुहां रम्यां सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् ॥६-६०-२४॥
प्रजालङ्कारभूतं च जनस्यानन्दवर्धनम् । उत्सुकोऽभूज्जनो द्रष्टुं तमयोध्यामहोत्सवम् ॥२-५-२०॥
translation: People were anxious to witness that great festival of Ayodhya which was to them (precious) like an ornament and a source of immense joy.

raw: अवज्ञया च राजर्षिः परिभूय च भार्गव । मय्यवज्ञां प्रयुङ्क्ते हि न च मां बहु मन्यते ॥७-५८-२१॥
translation: Indrani further complains to Chyavana, stating that the royal sage Nahusha, having insulted her, indeed shows disrespect towards her and does not regard her highly.

raw: घनान्धकारे तिमिरे शरवर्षमिवाद्भुतम् । स ववर्ष महाबाहुर्नाराचशरवृष्टिभिः ॥६-८०-२७॥
translation: The mighty armed Indrajith showered rocks and hails of steel arrows in that pitch darkness like the darkness of clouds.

raw: सुपत्रमनुवृत्ताङ्गं सुपर्वाणं सुसंस्थितम् । सुवर्णविकृतं वीरः शरीरान्तकरं शरम् ॥६-९१-६६॥
दर्शयन् शब्द वेधित्वम् ताम् रुरोध स सायकैः । सा रुद्धा बाण जालेन माया बल समन्विता ॥१-२६-२४॥
न बुद्धि पूर्वम् न अबुद्धम् स्मरामि इह कदाचन । मातृणाम् वा पितुर् वाहम् कृतम् अल्पम् च विप्रियम् ॥२-२२-८॥
translation: I do not remember to have done anything any time with a motive or without understanding which might have caused even a little displeasure to father or mothers.

raw: आराम उद्यान सम्पन्नाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनीम् । सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राज धानीम् पितुर् मम ॥२-५१-२३॥
translation: They will roam about happily in the capital city of my father with its lovely squares, wellaligned broad highways, its mansions and palaces, full of chariots, elephants, horses. It will be echoing with the sound of trumpets. It will be full of the welfare of all. It will be graced by the fairest of courtesans. Filled with wellnourished and contented people, the city dotted with several pleasuregardens and parks, will look splendid with community festivals and fairs.

raw: न अराजके जनपदे शरान् सम्ततमस्यताम् । श्रूयते तलनिर्घोष इष्वस्त्राणामुपासने ॥२-६७-२१॥
translation: In a country without a king, the sounds of the ceaseless discharge of arrows and practice of weapons, the clappings of the cord on the skin shield of shooters throwing the arrows are no longer heard.

raw: सूतस्तु रथनेता ऽस्य तदवस्थं समीक्ष्य तम् । शनैर्युद्धादसम्भ्रान्तो रथं तस्यापवाहयत् ॥६-१०५-३०॥
translation: Observing his (Ravana's) condition, the charioteer quietly, slowly withdrew his chariot from the battlefield.

raw: रामस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे सपद्मा श्रीरपाश्रिता । सव्ये तु ह्रीर्महादेवी व्यवसायस्तथाग्रतः ॥७-१०९-६॥
translation: On Rama's right side was Sri, the goddess of prosperity, holding a lotus; on his left was the great goddess Hri (Modesty); and in front of him was Determination.

raw: अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च । प्राप्त कालम् विधास्यामि तस्मिन् काले सह त्वया ॥४-४०-१२॥
translation: 'On locating Vaidehi in the kingdom of Ravana I shall take up proper course of action in conjunction with you.

raw: उपाध्याय वचः श्रुत्वा स राजा पुरुषर्षभ । अन्वियेष महाबुद्धिः पशुम् गोभिः सहस्रशः ॥१-६१-९॥
translation: "O Best of men (Rama) hearing the words of the high priest, the highly intellectual king searched for a human victim in exchange for thousands of cows.

raw: सुमन्त्रस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा युक्तं परमवाजिभिः । रथं सुरुचिरप्रख्यं स्वास्तीर्णं सुखशय्यया ॥७-४६-४॥
translation: But Sumantra, having said "so be it," brought the chariot, harnessed with excellent horses, appearing very beautiful, and well-cushioned with a comfortable seat.

raw: यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने । प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा ॥२-९१-४७॥
translation: The garlands of the gods available in Chitraratha's (Kubera's) garden could not match those obtained under the orders of Bharadwaja.

raw: स तैस्तु सहितो राजा लोकपालानयोधयत् । सह देवैस्तु ते भग्ना रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥६-१८-१६॥
तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्या वानरौघसमावृतः । आशिर्तो दक्षिणम् पार्श्वमृषभो नाम वानरः ॥६-२४-१५॥
translation: Let Rshaba the bull among Vanaras approach the south side of the army accompanied by his troop of Vanara contingent and remain there.

raw: परमापद्गतस्यापि धर्मे मम मतिर्भवेत् । अशिक्षितं च ब्रह्मास्त्रं भगवन्प्रतिभातु मे ॥७-१०-३१॥
translation: O Lord, may my mind always remain fixed on righteousness even in the greatest calamity, and may the Brahmastra manifest to me even without formal instruction.

raw: स त्वं जीवति सुग्रीवे लक्ष्मणे च सराघवे । मम शल्यमनुद्धृत्य क्व गतो ऽसि विहाय नः ॥६-९३-१५॥
translation: 'While Sugriva is living, Lakshmana and Raghava also, deserting me, you have gone. Where have you gone'?

raw: सम सौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्य् आयतानि च । दृष्टि रम्याणि ते दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर् जात विस्मयाः ॥६-३९-२॥
translation: They were amazed to see the even terrain, beautiful and expansive, long, and continuous sanctuary lovely to look at being a feast to the eyes.

raw: कुरु राघव सत्येन वयस्यम् वन चारिणम् । स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपि कुंजरः ॥३-७२-२२॥
तावुत्थाप्य महावीर्यौ गरुडो वासवोपमौ । उभौ तौ सस्वजे हृष्टौ रामश्चैनमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-४१॥
translation: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.

raw: सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्यका पितृगौरवात् । तत्रोपागम्य सा तस्थौ विश्रवा यत्र तप्यते ॥७-९-१३॥
translation: Having heard that instruction, the maiden, out of respect for her father, approached the place where Vishravas was performing penance and stood there.

raw: ततस्तु तस्मिन् विजने वने तदा । महाबलौ राघववम्शवर्धनौ । न तौ भयम् सम्भ्रममभ्युपेयतु । र्यथैव सिम्हौ गिरिसानुगोचरौ ॥२-५३-३५॥
translation: Then the two mighty perpetuators of the Raghu race, who were like two lions dwelling on the slopes of mountains, lived in that lonely forest without fear or hesitation. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftythird sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् ताव् उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ । पर्यन्के सीतया सार्धम् रुदन्तः समवेशयन् ॥२-३४-२०॥
translation: Thereafter Rama and Lakshmana assisted by Sita, lifted him wailing in their arms and laid him on a couch.

raw: अवतिष्ठत युध्यामो निवर्तध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः । भग्नानां वो न पश्यामि परिगम्य महीमिमाम् । स्थानं सर्वे निवर्तध्वं किं प्राणान् परिरक्षथ ॥६-६६-१९॥
translation: "I do not see any refuge for you even if you go round the globe. All of you return back. Why do you preserve life?"

raw: ऋषेः पुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यम् आश्रम वासिनः । पितुः स नित्य संतुष्टो न अतिचक्राम च आश्रमात् ॥१-१०-८॥
यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम । कस्मिंश्चित् संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ॥५-३९-२०॥
translation: "O destroyer of enemies if you think of halting for a day you may do so in a solitary location and leave tomorrow.

raw: यत्तु मां त्वमभाषिष्ठ युद्ध्यस्वेति सुरेश्वर । नाहं तं प्रतियोत्स्यामि रावणं राक्षसं युधि ॥७-२७-१७॥
translation: O lord of gods, regarding what you told me to fight, I will not fight against that demon Ravana in battle.

raw: कारयिष्यामि ते कुब्जे शुभान्यभरणानि च । परिधाय शुभे वस्त्रे देवतेव चरिष्यसि ॥२-९-५०॥
पूर्वाभिभाषी मधुरः सत्यवादी महाबलः । सौम्यः सर्वस्य लोकस्य चन्द्रवत्प्रियदर्शनः ॥२-४८-३०॥
translation: Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana is a tiger among men, a subduer of enemies, powerful like an intoxicated elephant, and a great charioteer. Blue in complexion, he has a face like the full Moon. He has lotuslike eyes, kneelong arms and fleshy clavicles. Endowed with a sweet nature, he always speaks the truth and the first to speak to others. When he roams the forest, charming like the Moon and pleasing to the whole world, he will surely make it look graceful.

raw: ऐणेयम् माम्सम् आहृत्य शालाम् यक्ष्यामहे वयम् । कर्त्व्यम् वास्तुशमनम् सौमित्रे चिरजीवभिः ॥२-५६-२२॥
translation: O Lakshmana those who intend to live for long (in this hut), should pacify the deity presiding over here. Therefore, we shall bring the venison of a black antelope and make necessary offerings.

raw: ददृशुस्तं महावीर्यं महाकायं महाद्युतिम् । रावणं निहतं भूमौ नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् ॥६-११३-६॥
translation: They looked at the gigantic body of Ravana of extraordinary valour, full of splendor, killed and lying like a heap of dark mountain on the ground.

raw: क्षतज आर्द्र सवर्णाभा संध्या कालम् विना बभौ । खरम् च अभिमुखम् नेदुः तदा घोरा मृगाः खगाः ॥३-२३-९॥
translation: Even before Sunset the twilight looked like a fresh wound. Then wild animals, birds, kankas, jackals and vultures facing towards Khara screeched, indicating danger.

raw: दैवेन आक्रम्यते सर्वम् दैवम् हि परमा गतिः । तस्य मे परम आर्तस्य प्रसादम् अभिकांक्षतः । कर्तुम् अर्हसि भद्रम् ते दैव उपहत कर्मणः ॥१-५७-२३॥
गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलः । आजघान गदाग्रेण वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः ॥६-७६-२९॥
translation: Then seeing the brother caught, mighty Sonitaksha struck Dwivida in the bosom by a mace.

raw: तत्तु श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णस्य भाषितम् । भ्रुकुटिं चैव सञ्चक्रे क्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत ॥६-६३-२२॥
translation: Kumbhakarna having spoken that way, the ten headed Ravana frowned, shaking his eyebrows in anger and spoke this way.

raw: सर्वथा निश्चित अर्थो अयम् हनूमति हरि ईश्वरः । निश्चित अर्थतरः च अपि हनूमान् कार्य साधने ॥४-४४-९॥
translation: 'This monkey king, Sugriva has confidence in Hanuman that he will by all means accomplish the task.'

raw: न्यस्ताम् सागर तोये वा पाताले वा अपि मैथिलीम् । आनयेयम् तव आदेशात् श्वेताम् अश्वतरीम् इव ॥४-१७-५१॥
translation: 'Even if she were hidden in the waters of the ocean or in the underworld, I would have brought her by your order like Sweta to Aswatari or Hayagriva. (Hayagriva, an incarnation of Visnu brought Vedas stolen by demons, Madhu and Kaitabha from Patala or the netherworld)

raw: पश्यताम् नृ सहस्राणाम् बहूनाम् रघुनंदनः । आरोपयत् स धर्मात्मा स लीलम् इव तत् धनुः ॥१-६७-१६॥
translation: Virtuous Rama, the delight of the Raghus, in the presence of several thousands of men fixed the string to the bow and drew it as though with ease.

raw: अन्याम् गतिम् गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वो अस्तु तपो धनाः । ऋषि पुत्राः तु तत् श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् घोर अभिसंहितम् ॥१-५७-८॥
तव प्रसादात् भवतु देवदेव मम ईप्सितम् । एवम् अस्तु इति देवेशो वाक्यम् उक्त्वा गतः तदा ॥१-५५-१८॥
translation: O Lord of the gods by your favour let my desire be fulfilled. Lord Mahadeva having said: 'Be it so' vanished.

raw: तत्र निद्रां समाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि शयानो न प्रबुद्ध्यते ॥७-१३-७॥
translation: There, the greatly powerful Kumbhakarna, overcome by sleep, remained sleeping for many thousands of years without awakening.

raw: ऋष्यमूको गिरिः यत्र न अति दूरे प्रकाशते । यस्मिन् वसति धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवो अंशुमतः सुतः ॥३-७५-७॥
translation: Come, let us go to Pampa, which is pleasing to look at. Sugriva, the rigteous self, the son of the Sun has been staying for fear of Vali at the shining Rishyamuka, not far from here.

raw: इत्यादिबहुभिर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सम्भर्स्तितोऽनघः । विव्यथे भरतस्तीव्रम् व्रणे तुद्येव सूचिना ॥२-७५-१७॥
translation: Thus reproached by many a harsh word, like needle pricking a wound, the sinless Bharata was intensely pained.

raw: अशोभत तदा रामो धनुर्विष्फारयन् महत् । भगवानिव सङ्क्रुद्धो भवो वेदमयं धनुः ॥६-७५-३५॥
translation: Then, great Rama stretching his bow in great fury shone as though the divine Lord Siva was stretching his bow with imprints of Vedas.

raw: देवता मानुषा यक्षा ये चान्ये जगतीतले । एवं त्वामभिधास्यन्ति रावणं लोकरावणम् ॥७-१६-३९॥
translation: Gods, humans, yakshas, and all others on earth will thus call you Ravana, the one who makes the worlds cry.

raw: पुराणे सुमहत् कार्यम् भविष्यम् हि मया श्रुतम् । दृष्टम् मे तपसा चैव श्रुत्वा च विदितम् मम ॥४-६२-३॥
translation: 'I have foreseen with the power of my penance that a great task will be done by you. I have also heard about it in the Puranas and came to know of it.

raw: उच्छिन्न राज्य संदेहम् काम वृत्तम् इव स्थितम् । निश्चित अर्थो अर्थ तत्त्वज्ञः काल धर्म विशेष वित् ॥४-२९-६॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taking care of the kingdom. He was engrossed in sensual pleasures. Having accomplished the desired object, he was engaged in enjoyment of the company of women, his own wives and Tara, whom he coveted. He was strolling (in the pleasant garden) night and day without caring for the kingdom, entrusting it to the ministers whose movements he did not watch. He was sporting with women like Indra sports with apsaras in the Nandana garden.Hanuman, who was conscious of his duties and responsibilities, who was aware of the importance of action in time and who was skilful in speech approached Sugriva, king of the monkeys. Having decided to take him into confidence, Hanuman spoke in a convincing, wellmeaning, sweet, pleasing manner words truthful and helpful, conciliatory and just, full of love and affection:

raw: ततः समीक्ष्य शयने सन्नम् शोकेन पार्थिवम् । कौसल्या पुत्र शोक आर्ता तम् उवाच मही पतिम् ॥२-४३-१॥
translation: Struck by the grief of her son's departure, Kausalya looked at the king who lay on the couch completely exhausted and said to him.

raw: अर्थ धर्मौ परित्यज्य यः कामम् अनुवर्तते । एवम् आपद्यते क्षिप्रम् राजा दशरथो यथा ॥२-५३-१३॥
translation: Any king who abandons dharma and artha and adopts a life of pleasure will very soon reach this state as Dasaratha has attained.

raw: तत्तिष्ठद्वसुधां रक्षः शूलं जग्राह पाणिना । त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभम् ॥६-७९-३१॥
translation: Standing on the ground that Rakshasa who created fear among all beings shone like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe, seized his pike in hand.

raw: प्रकाशचन्द्रोदयनष्टदोषः । प्रवृत्तरक्षः पिशिताशदोषः । रामाभिरामेरितचित्तदोषः । स्वर्गप्रकाशो भगवान् प्रदोषः ॥५-५-८॥
translation: At the time of moonrise, the darkness of dusk is dispelled, the dark deeds of cannibals disappear, the natural instinct for love returns to women as the radiance of the Moon spreads everywhere like in heaven.

raw: अथवा त्वरसे मर्तुं गच्छ दक्षिणसागरम् । वालिनं द्रक्ष्यसे तत्र भूमिस्थमिव पावकम् ॥७-३४-१०॥
translation: Alternatively, if you are eager to die, go to the southern ocean, where you will see Valin, who is like a fire standing on the earth.

raw: अस्मिन् तु पुरुषव्याघ्र काले दुःख समन्वितः । तपश्चरति धर्मात्मा त्वत् भक्त्या भरतः पुरे ॥३-१६-२७॥
translation: At this time, righteous Bharata, the best among men, with his devotion to you must be sadly performing penance at his residence.

raw: नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यं हारेणोरसि राजता । पूर्णचन्द्राभवक्रेण सबलाकमिवाम्बुदम् ॥५-४९-७॥
translation: He was like a black mountain of collyrium, and with a face like the fullmoon. With a pearl necklace illumining his chest he appeared like a cloud lit up by the fullmoon with white cranes flying across. (The white pearlnecklace moving on his chest appeared like a row of cranes flying through the black cloud.)

raw: तौ त्वया प्राकृतेन एव गत्वा ज्ञेयौ प्लवंगम । इङ्गितानाम् प्रकारैः च रूपव्या भाषणेन च ॥४-२-२४॥
translation: 'O Hanuman assume an ordinary form and approach them. Try to read them through their gestures, traits, forms and conversations.

raw: पतद्भिः पतितैः च एव व्यरोचत वसुंधरा । ततो देव ऋषि गंधर्वा यक्ष सिद्ध गणाः तथा ॥१-४३-१७॥
ग्रहीतुकामं तं गृह्य रक्षसामीश्वरं हरिः । खमुत्पपात वेगेन कृत्वा कक्षावलम्बिनम् ॥७-३४-२१॥
translation: The monkey king Vali, having seized Ravana, the lord of demons, who had intended to capture him, swiftly flew up into the sky, holding Ravana hanging from his armpit.

raw: सो ऽभिवाद्य गुरोः पादौ कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् । निकुम्भिलामभिययौ चैत्यं रावणिपालितम् ॥६-८५-२९॥
translation: Saluting the feet of the eldest brother and going round him, Laksmana proceeded to Nikumbhila sanctuary ruled by Ravana.

raw: निमित्तानि च पश्यामि यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति च । निहत्य रावणं सीतामानयिष्यामि जानकीम् ॥६-४-६॥
translation: I also see manifestations of good omens to start (the journey). I shall get Janaka's daughter Sita on killing Ravana.

raw: तिष्ठ मा मा गमः पुत्र यमस्य सदनम् प्रति । श्वो मया सह गन्ता असि जनन्या च समेधितः ॥२-६४-३७॥
translation: 'My dear son, stay with me, do not go (now) to the abode of Yama, (lord of death). Tomorrow accompanied by me and your mother you may

raw: द्वौ पुत्रौ तु भविष्येते सीतायां राघवस्य तु । अन्यत्र न त्वयोध्यायां सत्यमेतन्नसंशयः ॥७-५१-२५॥
translation: Two sons will indeed be born to Rama through Sita, but they will be born elsewhere and not in Ayodhya; this is the truth, without a doubt.

raw: येनसूदयसेशत्रून् समरेसूर्यवर्चसा वज्रंवज्रधरस्येवसोऽयंतेसततार्चितः । रणेबहुप्रहरणोहेमजापरिष्कृतः परिघोव्यवकीर्णस्तेबाणैश्चिन्नैःसहस्रधा ॥६-११४-८२॥
translation: "The iron bar of yours which is effulgent like the Sun and closely resembles the thunderbolt of Indra, with which you have terminated your enemies in the combat, which is regularly worshipped by you, which is adorned with a network of gold, is broken into thousand pieces and lies scattered."

raw: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना । गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम् ॥५-३८-९॥
translation: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.

raw: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्राघवो वचः ॥७-८७-१॥
translation: Having heard the words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama, who was greatly effulgent and an expert in speech, replied with a smile.

raw: पाप्मानम् इन्द्रस्य मही जलम् च वृक्षाः च कामम् जगृहुः स्त्रियः च । को नाम पाप्मानम् इमम् सहेत शाखा मृगस्य प्रतिपत्तुम् इच्छेत् ॥४-२४-१४॥
translation: 'Trees owned the sin of Indra and it was shared by the earth, water and women voluntarily.But who is there to pardon a monkey and own the sin?

raw: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः । प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम् ॥७-८०-१३॥
translation: Having thus gone under the sway of desire, Danda, intoxicated with passion, replied to Araja, placing his folded hands on his head.

raw: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा श्वोभूत इति राघवः । विसर्जयामास तदा सर्वांस्ताञ्छत्रुसूदनः ॥७-९५-१५॥
translation: Having thus made the decision for "tomorrow," Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed all of them.

raw: इति उक्तः क्रोध ताम्राक्षः तप्त कांचन कुण्डलः । राक्षसेन्द्रो अभिदुद्राव पतगेन्द्रम् अमर्षणः ॥३-५१-१॥
translation: As the bright gold earrings of the intolerant king of demons glittered, his eyes turned red in rage and he pounced upon Jatayu, the lord of birds.

raw: निजघ्नुश्चास्य गात्राणि महाकाष्ठकटङ्करैः । मुद्गरैर्मुसलैश्चैव सर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः ॥६-६०-४७॥
translation: The city of Lanka including the woods was filled with that noise. They pushed him with mallets with all their strength, but he did not wake up.

raw: रामो दाशरथिर्नाम प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम् । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया ॥५-१-१५३॥
translation: "Dasaratha's son called Rama accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and his wife Vaidehi entered Dandaka forest.

raw: स्निग्ध पल्लव संकाशाम् पीत कौशेय वासिनीम् । शंसस्व यदि सा दृष्टा बिल्व बिल्व उपम स्तनी ॥३-६०-१३॥
translation: O Bilva tree, tell me if you have seen a lady delicate like your tender leaf, dressed in yellow silk, a lady whose breasts are round like Bilva fruits.

raw: यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि मुनयः सर्व एव ते । राजानश्च नरव्याघ्रा विस्मयान्नोपरेमिरे ॥७-९७-२४॥
translation: All those sages and kings, who were like tigers among men, present in the sacrificial enclosure, did not cease their astonishment.

raw: तथा हुत अशनम् हुत्वा जेपुस् तस्य तदा ऋत्विजः । जगुः च ते यथा शास्त्रम् तत्र सामानि सामगाः ॥२-७६-१८॥
translation: Then the priests offering oblations to the king's fire, intoned prayers. The reciters of Sama Veda sang the hymns in accordance with the sacred scriptures.

raw: स तेन तु प्रहर्षेण द्विगुणी कृत विक्रमः । अमृत आनयनार्थम् वै चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ॥३-३५-३४॥
translation: Quite happy, his energy redoubled, wise Garuda made up his mind to obtain nectar.

raw: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सो ऽब्रवीत् । ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् । दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः ॥५-३८-३७॥
translation: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

raw: करेण तु करं तस्या ग्राहयित्वा मयस्तदा । प्रहसन्प्राह दैत्येन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रमिदं वचः ॥७-१२-१७॥
translation: Then, Maya, the king of Daityas, having made the king of Rakshasas grasp his daughter's hand with his own, laughed and spoke these words to him.

raw: स राजा पुत्रशोकार्तः स्मरन् दुष्कृतमात्मनः । कौसल्याम् पुत्र शोक आर्ताम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६३-५॥
translation: King Dasaratha distressed by the separation from his son, pondered over his past misdeed, and said to helpless Kausalya, who was equally grieving over the separation from Rama:

raw: तम् सान्त्वयामास ततो लक्ष्मणः प्रिय बान्धवम् । बहु प्रकारम् शोक आर्तः प्रश्रितः प्रश्रित अंजलिः ॥३-६१-३०॥
translation: Then Lakshmana, the knower of dharma and a dear friend offered obeisance most humbly with folded palms and consoled Rama in many ways.

raw: न्यास भूतम् इदम् राज्यम् तव निर्यातयामि अहम् । मा च रोषम् कृथाः सौम्य मम शत्रु निषूदन ॥४-१०-९॥
translation: 'I am handing over this kingdom which was in trust. O slayer of enemies, O good natured one, give up your anger against me.

raw: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः । स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधार्तः सन्न्यवर्तत ॥७-८१-१॥
translation: After a short while, the divine sage of immeasurable splendor, surrounded by his disciples and afflicted by hunger, returned to his hermitage, having heard (something amiss).

raw: त्वम् हि सत्य व्रतः शूरो धार्मिको दृढ विक्रमः । परीक्ष्य कारा स्मृतिमान् निसृष्ट आत्मा सुहृत्सु च ॥६-१७-३६॥
translation: "You are a truthful follower of vows, a heroic and righteous one. You are firm in your resolve, capable of good judgment, have a good memory of the past traditions and committed in heart to your friends."

raw: ध्रुवम् अद्य पुरी रामायोध्या युधिनाम् वर । निष्प्रभा त्वयि निष्क्रान्ते गत चन्द्रा इव शर्वरी ॥२-५३-२९॥
translation: O Rama, foremost of warriors, it is certain that since your departure, the city of Ayodhya must be lustreless like night without the Moon.

raw: शर आहतेन एव तदा आर्तया गिरास्वरम् मम आलंब्य सु दूर सु श्रवम् । उदाहृतम् तत् वचनम् सु दारुणम्त्वम् आगतो येन विहाय मैथिलीम् ॥३-५९-२७॥
translation: Hit by the arrow, the demon imitating my voice cried out in desperation which could be clearly audible even from a distance. On hearing the dreadful words you deserted Sita and came here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अनेन वनवासेन मया प्राप्तं फलद्वयम् । पितुश्चानृणता धर्मे भरतस्य प्रियं तथा ॥२-९४-१७॥
translation: By living in the forest I have achieved a twofold benefitdischarge of debt of my father with regard to righteousness and causing happiness to Bharata.

raw: रावणेन हृता भार्या बभूवेयमनिन्दिता । मारीचदर्शनं चैव सीतोन्मथनमेव च ॥६-१२७-११॥
हृद्गतं मे महच्छल्यं यस्मादार्येण धीमता । अस्मिन्निमित्ते वैदेहि लोकस्य वचनीकृतः ॥७-४७-४॥
translation: O Vaidehi, a great thorn resides in my heart because of which the wise and noble Rama has been made an object of public reproach in this matter.

raw: लोकाः तु अप्रतिमा राम निर्जिताः तपसा मया । जहि तान् शर मुख्येन मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ॥१-७६-१६॥
translation: Strike with the, principal arrow the unrivalled worlds conquered by my asceticism. Do not delay, O Rama

raw: वर्णेषु अग्र्य चतुर्थेषु देवता अतिथि पूजकाः । कृतज्ञाः च वदान्यः च शूरा विक्रम संयुताः ॥१-६-१७॥
translation: There in Ayodhya the best of cities, the first of the four castes (brahmins) used to worship gods and guests. They had the sense of gratitude. They were munificient, heroic and possessed prowess. They lived long. They were righteous and truthful. And they lived together with their sons, grandsons and wives.

raw: पृथिवीम् च अखिलाम् प्राप्य काश्यपाय महात्मने । यज्ञस्य अन्ते तदा राम दक्षिणाम् पुण्य कर्मणे ॥१-७५-२५॥
translation: O Rama Having heard the slaying of my father incomparable in extreme ruthlessness, I decimated the Kshatriya race again and again out of fury as they were born and reborn. I conquered the entire earth. At the conclusion of the sacrifice I conferred it on the great soul Kasyapa of meritorious acts. Gifted with ascetic energy I have (now) made the Mahendra mountain my abode.

raw: एष मे प्रथमः कल्पो यद् अम्बा मे यवीयसी । भरत आरक्षितम् स्फीतम् पुत्र राज्यम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥२-५२-६३॥
translation: My prime resolve is that my younger mother should enjoy this prosperous and vast kingdom ruled by her son Bharata.

raw: ते भूमिम् आगान् विविधान् देशामः च अपि मनो रमान् । अदृष्ट पूर्वान् पश्यन्तः तत्र तत्र यशस्विनः ॥२-५४-३॥
translation: Illustrious Rama, Sita and Lakshmana entered the deep forest and saw the different regions of the land and other enchanting places which they had never seen before and proceeded towards the region where the river Yamuna merged with Bhagirathi Ganga.

raw: दृष्टएव हि नः शोकम् अपनेष्यति राघवः । तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्न् इव भास्करः ॥२-८३-९॥
translation: At his sight alone our sorrows will be dispelled, the way the darkness of the entire world is dispelled by the rising Sun.

raw: एतन्मुहूर्तमेवाहं तस्यैकस्य तु वै कृते । चतुरो लोकपालांस्तान्नयिष्यामि यमक्षयम् ॥७-१३-४०॥
translation: Indeed, for the sake of that one (Kubera) alone, I shall, in this very moment, lead those four world-protectors to Yama's abode.

raw: अहो लक्ष्मण सिद्ध अर्थः सतताम् प्रिय वादिनम् । भ्रातरम् देव सम्काशम् यः त्वम् परिचरिष्यसि ॥२-४०-२५॥
translation: With your desires fulfilled, O Lakshmana, you will attend to your godlike brother who always speaks pleasant words.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु ऱागवस्यैतद्वचः परममद्भुतम् । दूताः सम्प्रययुर्बाटं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥७-९५-६॥
translation: Having heard this most wonderful speech of Rama, the messengers went forth to the hermitage where the foremost among sages, Valmiki, resided.

raw: तत् श्लक्ष्ण सु व्यक्त मृदु प्रलापम्तस्या मुखम् कुंचित केश भारम् । रक्षो वशम् नूनम् उपगतायान भ्राजते राहु मुखे यथा इंदुः ॥३-६३-९॥
translation: Her face with her clear, sweet and gentle words and her curly hair falling will no more look bright coming under the grip of demons like the moon eclipsed by Rahu.

raw: संरब्धश्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव । विभीषणं महाप्राज्ञं सोपालम्भमिदं वचः ॥६-११७-२४॥
translation: Exhibiting anger with his gaze at the uproar, Rama addressed the highly intelligent Vibheeshana resenting their action.

raw: महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः । विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत् पितुः ॥६-१२२-९॥
जीवन्नद्य विपन्नो ऽस्मि नष्टराज्यमनोरथः । प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञश्च रिपुः सकामो रावणः कृतः ॥६-५०-१९॥
translation: "Having lost my life ambition for the kingdom, frustrated I am. My enemy Ravana, having succeeded in his vow, did this deed."

raw: आस्यैः सनेत्रश्रवणैर्ववाम रुधिरं बहु ॥६-५९-११५॥
अहत्वा रावणम् सम्ख्ये सपुत्रजनबान्धवम् । अयोध्याम् न प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्रिभिस्तैर्भ्रतृभिः शपेः ॥६-१८-२१॥
वानराश्च महासत्त्वाः प्रगृह्य विपुलाः शिलाः । प्रविश्यारिबलं भीमं जघ्नुस्ते रजनीचरान् ॥६-९८-८॥
translation: The mighty Vanaras also seizing huge rocks entered into the frightening enemy army of the Rakshasas.

raw: त्वम् तु को वा किम् अर्थम् वा कबन्ध सदृशो वने । आस्येन उरसि दीप्तेन भग्न जन्घो विचेष्टसे ॥३-७०-१६॥
translation: Who are you with only the trunk of the body, and a glittering mouth in the chest with your calf muscles broken rolling down in the forest?

raw: राक्षसाश्च शितैर्बाणैरसिभिः शक्तितोमरैः । उद्यतैः समवर्तन्त कपिसैन्यजिघांसवः ॥६-८६-८॥
translation: The Rakshasas also launched attacks in the battle with sharp swords, javelins, and lances.

raw: प्राञ्जलिः सा तु पार्श्वस्था प्राह वाक्यं सरस्वती । इयमस्म्यागता देव किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम् ॥७-१०-४२॥
translation: Standing by his side with folded hands, Saraswati spoke these words: "Here I am, O god, arrived; what task shall I perform?"

raw: न अषडङ्ग वित् अत्र आसीत् न अव्रतो न अबहुश्रुतः । सदस्यः तस्य वै राज्ञो न अवाद कुशला द्विजाः ॥१-१४-२१॥
translation: Here (in this sacrificial pavillion), there was none who was not versed in six Vedangas, not true to vows, not learned in many sastras nor adept in discussions (on sastras).

raw: ते तु इदानीम् जनस्थाने वसमाना महाबलाः । संगताः परम आयत्ता रामेण सह संयुगे ॥३-३६-६॥
translation: These mighty demons, living in Janasthana, eqipped with different kinds of weapons, supported and led by Khara, met Rama in an encounter.

raw: विचित्य तु वयम् सर्वे समग्रम् - समुद्रम् - दक्षिणाम् दिशम् । वयम् बुभुक्षिताः सर्वे वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रिताः ॥४-५२-९॥
translation: Having searched the whole southern region, all of us, exhausted and hungry, took shelter at the foot of a tree.

raw: कस्यचित् तु अथ कालस्य यक्षी पुत्रम् व्यजायत । मारीचम् नाम दुर्धर्षम् यः शापात् राक्षसोऽभवत् ॥१-२५-९॥
translation: After some time that yakshini gave birth to an unassailable son by name Maricha. Because of a curse, he became a rakshasa (though born of yaksha parentage).

raw: दुह्खाद् दुह्कःअम् प्रपन्नाया मग्नायाः शोक सागरे । यो हि माम् उद्यतस् त्रातुम् सो अपि त्वम् विनिपातितः ॥६-३२-१०॥
translation: "I am in grief and filled with an ocean of sorrow. You who have come to save me and are also killed."

raw: तव भक्त्या समायुक्तो लक्ष्मणः संप्रदास्यति । भृशम् तान् खादतो मत्स्यान् पंपायाः पुष्प संचये ॥३-७३-१६॥
सतुदत्तवरःप्रीत्यावानरैश्चसमागतः पुष्पकेनविमानेनकिष्किनष्धामभ्युपागमत् ॥६-१२९-५३॥
translation: "Having received boons, Rama with the Vanaras collected together reached Kishkinda by Pushpaka aerial car."

raw: युद्धे स्वल्पेन यत्नेन समासाद्य निरस्यते । चारास् तु ते तथा इति उक्त्वा प्रहृष्टा राक्षस ईश्वरम् ॥६-२९-२३॥
यः शृणोति निरीक्षेद्वा स वध्यो भविता तव । भवेद्वै मुनिमुख्यस्य वचनं यद्यपेक्षसे ॥७-१०३-१३॥
translation: Whoever listens or looks will be punishable by death by you, if you truly desire to heed the words of the chief of sages.

raw: प्राकर अन्तर रथ्याः च वेदिकः चैत्य सम्श्रयाः । श्वभ्राः च पुष्करिण्यः च सर्वम् तेन अवलोकितम् ॥५-१२-१८॥
translation: He moved in the lanes inside the boundary walls, around the shrines, altars, wells and tanks whereever it was possible to look for.

raw: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथा वृत्तं तवान्तिके । चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव ॥५-६५-१९॥
translation: "O wise one, with your ring given her, she told me an anecdote of a crow that took place at Chitrakuta.

raw: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यम् उत्तमम् । पूजयामास ब्रह्मर्षिम् वसिष्ठम् जपताम् वरम् ॥१-६५-२७॥
translation: Virtuous Viswamitra also, having attained excellent brahminhood, worshipped Brahmrshi Vasishta who was the best of those who recite hymns".

raw: माम् अनाथाम् विहाय एकाम् गतः त्वम् असि मानद । शूराय न प्रदातव्या कन्या खलु विपश्चिता ॥४-२३-८॥
तं प्रयान्तं मुनिं सीता प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात् ॥७-४९-१८॥
translation: Sita, with folded hands, followed the departing sage from behind.

raw: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना ॥६-१२६-६॥
translation: "There lies Vidyunmali killed by great Sushena and Ravana's son Indrajith killed by Lakshmana in the battlefield."

raw: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं तज्जलं प्राप्य निर्मलम् । कूलोपहारं कुर्वाणं प्रतिस्रोतः प्रधावति ॥७-३२-५॥
translation: That pure water, held back by Kartavirya's arms, then rushed upstream, overflowing and making an offering to the river banks.

raw: गुहम् एव ब्रुवाणम् तम् राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥२-५०-४०॥
रामप्रव्राजनं चैव देवि याचस्व तं वरम् । एवं सिद्ध्यन्ति पुत्रस्य सर्वार्थास्तव भामिनि ॥२-९-३२॥
translation: O Devi demand Rama's exile as a boon. O lovely queen this way all the interests of your son will be fulfilled (protected).

raw: देव दानव दुर्धर्षम् तपो बल समन्वितम् । तीर्थ उदक परिक्लिन्नम् दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम् ॥१-४८-२५॥
translation: Subsequently, Indra beheld the great ascetic Gautama, unassailable by devatas and danavas, endowed with the power of ascetism, drenched with sacrifical waters, shining like flaming fire, carrying sacrificial firewood and Kusha grass and preeminent among sages, entering that leaf hut.

raw: यद् इदम् ते क्षमम् राजन् गमिष्यामि यथा आगतम् । मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखी भव सु हृद् वृतः ॥१-२१-३॥
translation: O king, if this act of yours is appropriate to you, I will go back (to the places) where from I came. O scion of the race of kakutstha, you have proved false to your promise. Live happily with your relatives".

raw: बद्ध अंजलि पुटाः सर्वे ये स्युः स्त्री दर्शन क्षमाः । तान् उवाच ततः प्राप्तान् राजा अर्क सदृश प्रभः ॥४-३८-८॥
स्वास्थ्यम् भद्रम् भजस्व आर्यः त्यजताम् कृपणा मतिः । अर्थो हि नष्ट कार्यार्थैः न अयत्ने न अधिगम्यते ॥४-१-१२०॥
translation: 'O noble prince be blessed. maintain composure. Without making any effort it is not possible to achieve the objective and recoup loss.

raw: स तां बाणसहस्रेण विक्षोभ्य हरिवाहिनीम् । हरिश्रेष्ठं हनूमन्तमिन्द्रजित् प्रत्युवाच ह ॥६-८१-२७॥
translation: Indrajith shattered the army of monkeys with a thousand arrows. Hanuman the foremost Vanara replied to them as follows.

raw: पाण्डुरम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा विमलम् चन्द्र मण्डलम् । शारदीम् रजनीम् चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्न अनुलेपनाम् ॥४-३०-२॥
translation: While Sugriva was in his residence, Rama was (in Prasravana mountain) spending his rainy nights tormented by passion (for Sita). Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. When the sky became clear of clouds after the rainy season, Rama sat gazing at the clear autumnal Moon's orb. He was besmeared with moonlight and felt perturbed as time was running out. And then fell into a swoon. (only a few months remained for the completion of the exile and Bharata will put an end to himself if Rama does not return to Ayodhya on the stipulated day. This worried Rama.)

raw: कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम् । द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि ॥७-९०-११॥
translation: Kardama then spoke words that were supremely beneficial for the sake of a son, saying, "O brahmins, listen to my words which are indeed for the welfare of the king."

raw: संरक्त नयनः श्रीमान् तप्त कांचन भूषणः । क्रोधेन महता आविष्टो नील जीमूत सन्निभः ॥३-४९-७॥
translation: Overcome by intense anger, Ravana's eyes reddened. The nightranger, stood armed with bow and arrows and shining with glittering gold ornaments, appeared like a black cloud.

raw: कदंब सर्जा अर्जुन कंदल आढ्यावनान्त भूमि मधु वारि पूर्णा । मयूर मत्ता अभिरुत प्रवृत्तैःअपान भूमि प्रतिमा विभाति ॥४-२८-३४॥
translation: 'The forest region with its various types of trees like kadamba, sarja and arjuna trees and full of fresh water shines like a tavern where girls in the form of peahens dance in excitement.

raw: नेमं मोक्षयितुं शक्ताः शरबन्धं सुदारुणम् । मायाबलादिन्द्रजिता निर्मितं क्रूरकर्मणा ॥६-५०-४८॥
translation: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."

raw: यदि दोषो महाम्स् तस्मिम्स् त्यज्यताम् अविशन्कितम् । गुणान् वा अपि बहून् ज्ञात्वा सम्ग्रहः क्रियताम् नृप ॥६-१७-४२॥
translation: "If there are great bad qualities (in Vibheeshana) no doubt he has to be rejected. If there are many virtues let us take him knowing them also."

raw: सदृशम् खलु वः वाक्यम् अंगदो यत् उवाच ह । हितम् च एव अनुकूलम् च क्रियताम् अस्य भाषितम् ॥४-४९-१२॥
translation: 'What Angada says is appropriate, beneficial and also favourable. Carry out his command.

raw: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः । ते ऽपि गत्वा हि पितरं वरणं रोचयन्ति मे ॥७-१७-९॥
translation: Then, gods along with Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, all went to my father and sought my hand in marriage.

raw: ततः कदाचित्किष्किन्धां नगरीं वालिपालिताम् । गत्वा ह्वयति युद्धाय वालिनं हेममालिनम् ॥७-३४-३॥
translation: Then, once, having gone to the city of Kishkindha, which was protected by Vali, he challenged Vali, who was adorned with a golden garland, for battle.

raw: सर्वंमुदितमेवासीत्सर्वोधर्मपरोऽभवत् । राममेवानुपश्यन्तोनाभ्यहिंसन् परस्परम् ॥६-१३१-१०१॥
translation: All were happy, and followed the righteous path, looking at Rama alone and no one hit another.

raw: एवम् अङ्गाधिपेन एव गणिकाभिः ऋषेः सुतः । आनीतोऽवर्षयत् देव शान्ता च अस्मै प्रदीयते ॥१-९-१८॥
translation: Thus with the help of courtesans of the king of Anga, when the son of the sage (Rsyasringa) was brought rains followed. The king offered his daughter Santa (in marriage to the sage).

raw: मनोज्ञाम् काञ्चनवतीम् सर्वतैरुपशोभिताम् । नानाधातुविचित्रैश्च उद्यानैरुपशोभिताम् ॥६-३९-२५॥
translation: Prosperous Rama, brother of Lakshmana along with Vanaras saw different kinds of forests, mountains filled with different kinds of minerals, delightful gardens endowed with different varieties of flowers, charming birds singing happily, frequented by a variety of deer, attended by Rakshasas. The city was blooming with prosperity.

raw: एवंविधानि कर्माणि प्रावर्तत महाबलः । सर्वेषां ब्रह्मदण्डानामवध्यः शम्भुना कृतः ॥७-३६-३१॥
translation: The mighty Hanuman engaged in such deeds because he had been made immune to all curses of Brahmins by Lord Shiva.

raw: यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला । तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात् ॥५-६६-३॥
translation: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.
