raw: वैदेहि दृश्यते चात्र शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान् । उपयातः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरन्दरः ॥६-१२६-४०॥
तदेकदेशेन बलस्य तावत् केचित्तवादेशकृतो ऽभियान्तु । तौ राजपुत्रौ विनिगृह्य मूढौ परेषु ते भावयितुं प्रभावम् ॥५-५२-२५॥
translation: By your order let some strong soldiers from one contingency go and capture the two sons of the king, to exhibit your power over the enemy.

raw: अन्तःपुराणिसर्वाणिरुदमानानिसत्वरम् पृष्ठतोऽनुययुस्तानिप्लवमानानिसर्वतः ॥६-११४-१११॥
translation: All the women from the gynaeceum weeping aloud from all sides hastened at quick paces and followed sobbing.

raw: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः । ऊर्ध्व रेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मम् तप उपागमत् ॥१-३३-११॥
translation: At that time a great and virtuous ascetic named Chuli living in celebacy was performing austerities in pursuit of the knowledge of Brahman.

raw: स्त्री चेति मन्यमानेन नातिक्रोधः स्वयम् कृतः । सा तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलाङ्गी नीशाचरी ॥५-३-४१॥
स मे प्रसादं काकुत्स्थ कुरुष्वामितविक्रम । मातृहीनो यथा वत्सो न चिरं प्रवसाम्यहम् ॥७-७२-१२॥
translation: Therefore, O Rama of immeasurable valor, grant me this favor, for I cannot stay away much longer, just like a motherless calf.

raw: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिस्तपसो मम । सो ऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ॥७-१०५-१३॥
translation: O sinless one, today marks the completion of my thousand-year penance, and so I desire whatever food is ready to break my fast.

raw: ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रघ्नो रामपालिताम् । अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः ॥७-७१-१॥
translation: Then, in the twelfth year, Shatrughna, accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army, desired to go to Ayodhya, which was protected by Rama.

raw: प्रस्थितौ त्वम् व्रजस्व इति वाक्यम् ऊचतुः अन्तिके । गम्यताम् कार्य सिद्धि अर्थम् इति तौ अब्रवीत् च सः ॥३-७३-४४॥
त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः । अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः ॥६-१२६-२५॥
तस्य बाणगणान् घोरान् राक्षसस्य महाबलः । अपारयन् वारयितुं प्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः ॥६-५८-४१॥
translation: Not able to check the volley of arrows released by the Rakshasa, Nila received them with closed eyes.

raw: स्वयम्भुवा पुरा दत्तम् वरदानम् यथा मम । यदा त्वाम् वानरः कश्चिद्विक्रमाद्वशमानयेत् ॥५-३-४७॥
जनस्थान स्थिता राजन् रक्षसा बहवो हताः । खरः च निहतः संख्ये क्थम्चित् अहम् आगतः ॥३-३१-२॥
translation: O king many demons dwelling at Janasthana including Khara have been killed. I manged to escape with much difficulty.

raw: तं धर्मे ऽग्निषु पुत्रेषु शिवं पृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम् । पुलस्त्योवाच राजानं हैहयानां तथा ऽर्जुनम् ॥७-३३-१३॥
translation: Having inquired about the welfare of that king, Kartavirya Arjuna, regarding his dharma, sacred fires, and sons, sage Pulastya then spoke to him.

raw: प्राणश्यत तदा सर्वं हव्यं हुतमिवानले । युद्ध्वा च सुचिरं कालं कृत्वा विक्रममुत्तमम् ॥७-१९-१४॥
translation: Then, all (the army) perished like an oblation offered into fire, even after fighting for a very long time and displaying excellent valor.

raw: प्रत्याख्यातो असि दुर्बुद्धे गुरुणा सत्य वादिना । तम् कथम् समतिक्रम्य शाखा अन्तरम् उपेयिवान् ॥१-५७-२॥
सुप्राज्य फल मूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च । प्रशस्त मृग यूथानि शान्त पक्षि गणानि च ॥३-८-१३॥
translation: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

raw: दृष्टवा न खल्वभिक्रुद्धोमामिहानवकुण्ठिताम् निर्गतांनगरद्वारात्पद्भ्यामेवागतांप्रभो ॥६-११४-६१॥
translation: "Lord! How is it that you are not angry seeing me coming forth walking through the city gate?"

raw: पितामहं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः ॥७-९७-७॥
translation: All of them, indeed, assembled, making Grandfather Brahma their leader.

raw: ततः सूक्ष्माम्बरधरो ब्रह्ममावर्तयन्परम् । कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ ॥७-१०९-४॥
translation: Then, wearing fine garments, meditating upon the supreme Brahman, and holding Kusa grass in his hands, he went forth.

raw: शालिशूकनिभाभासं प्रासूतामुं तदा ऽञ्जना । फलान्याहर्तुकामा वै निष्क्रान्ता गहनेचरा ॥७-३५-२१॥
translation: Anjana, who moved in the forest, then gave birth to him (Hanuman), who had a luster like a ripe paddy grain, and she had gone out desiring to gather fruits.

raw: यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रव: । हैहयास्तालजंघाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दव: ॥१-७०-२८॥
translation: Valiant kings belonging to the races of the Haihayas, Talaiangha, and Sasibindus became the enemies to Asita.

raw: इत्येवंवादिनं तं तु शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् । वाल्मीकिः सम्परिष्वज्य विससर्ज च राघवम् ॥७-७२-५॥
translation: Having embraced Shatrughna, the tormentor of foes, who was speaking thus, Valmiki sent him off to Rama.

raw: पौराणां दृढभक्तिं च बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् । स्वकृतान्तं चान्ववेक्ष्य तस्मिन्नहनि राघवः ॥७-१०७-१६॥
translation: Having observed the firm devotion of the citizens and considering his own destined end, Rama said, "Certainly, yes," on that very day.

raw: अतिसृज्य ददानीति वरम् मम विशाम्पतिः । स निरर्थं गतजले सेतुम् बन्धितुमिच्छति ॥२-१८-२३॥
translation: The king bestowed on me boons saying, 'I shall grant you two boons'. But now he wishes in vain to build a dam when the water has run down.

raw: ऋष्यमूके गिरि वरे पंपा पर्यन्त शोभिते । निवसति आत्मवान् वीरः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः ॥३-७२-१२॥
translation: A hero of great selfrespect, he lives with four monkeys on a beautiful mountain Rishyamuka extending up to lake Pampa.

raw: तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य सन्ध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् । आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः ॥७-८२-२॥
translation: There, having performed ablutions and completed the evening twilight prayers, Rama entered the hermitage of the great-souled Agastya.

raw: तत्र तां रजनीमुष्य केशिन्यां रघुनन्दनः । प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय लक्ष्मणः प्रययौ तदा ॥७-५२-१॥
translation: Having stayed that night in Keshini, Lakshmana, the delight of the Raghus, rose again in the morning and then departed.

raw: गुहेन सार्धम् भरतः समागतः । महा अनुभावः सजनः समाहितः । सुदुर्मनाः तम् भरतम् तदा पुनर् । गुहः समाश्वासयद् अग्रजम् प्रति ॥२-८५-२२॥
translation: Bharata, a man of great magnanimity, joined Guha together with his people with composed mind. Then Guha, greatly distraught, again consoled Bharata regarding his elder brother Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfifth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: रामस्य सह सौमित्रे राक्षसानाम् च सर्वशः । वैदेह्याः च एव यद् वृत्तम् प्रकाशम् यदि वा रहः ॥१-२-३४॥
translation: The incidents pertaining to sagacious Rama together with Lakshmana, Sita, Bharata, etc. and the rakshasas their deeds, thoughts, unknown or known to everybody and even not known to you, will be revealed to you by my grace.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा फलैर् मूलैः पुष्पैर् अन्यैः च राघवम् । वन्यैः च विविध आहारैः स लक्ष्मणम् अपूजयन् ॥३-१-२२॥
translation: Having said so, the ascetics offered with reverence fruits, roots, flowers and other forest products to Rama and Lakshmana.

raw: मम अस्त्र बाण संपूर्णम् आकाशम् पश्य लक्ष्मण । असंपातम् करिष्यामि हि अद्य त्रैलोक्य चारिणाम् ॥३-६४-५९॥
translation: O Lakshmana, just see, I will fill the sky with all my weapons and arrows and make all movements impossible in the three worlds.

raw: तेजसा सम्प्रदीप्ताग्रां रक्तमाल्याविभूषिताम् । ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ॥६-७०-५३॥
translation: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

raw: हृष्टा प्रतीता कैकेयी मन्थरामिदमब्रवीत् । सा हि वाक्येन कुब्जायाः किशोरीवोत्पथं गता । कैकेयी विस्मयं प्राप्ता परं परमदर्शना ॥२-९-३७॥
translation: That Kaikeyi, even though endowed with sound foresight, expressed her sense of wonder at the words of the hunchback and chose a wrong path like a young (immature) girl.

raw: न हि कम्पयितुं शक्यः सुरैरपि महामृधे । अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्य इव तेजसा ॥६-५५-८॥
translation: Akampana who, possibly could not be shaken in war by suras shone like the sun in that manner.

raw: सृजन्तो बाणवृष्टिं ते रथगर्जितनिःस्वनाः । वृष्टिमन्त इवाम्भोदा विचेरुर्नैर्ऋताम्बुदाः ॥५-४५-७॥
translation: They went roaring with their chariots rattling, sending forth torrents of arrows like the stormy clouds thundering.

raw: त्वं तु लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः । त्वया राक्षसवंशो ऽयं निमग्नो ऽपि समुद्धृतः । सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल ॥७-११-९॥
translation: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.

raw: इदम् व्यसनम् आलोक्य राज्ञः च मति विभ्रमम् । कामएव अर्ध धर्माभ्याम् गरीयान् इति मे मतिः ॥२-५३-९॥
translation: Reflecting on the calamity and mental aberration of the king, I think passion is stronger than wealth and righteousness.

raw: एवम् उक्तः तु जनकः प्रत्युवाच महामुनिम् । श्रूयताम् अस्य धनुषो यत् अर्थम् इह तिष्ठति ॥१-६६-७॥
translation: Thus addressed by the mighty ascetic Janaka replied, "I shall tell you how this bow came to be deposited here".

raw: स तु देशो विसूर्यो अपि तस्य भासा प्रकाशते । सूर्य लक्ष्म्या अभिविज्ञेयः तपता इव विवस्वता ॥४-४३-५५॥
translation: 'That place gets light and heat even though there is no Sun.

raw: क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ताह् शून्ये महामृगाः । दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-८॥
translation: Big, wild animals, moving about freely and sporting in the deserted forest, attack on seeing a human. Thus forest is full of danger.

raw: स गत्वा विप्रियाण्याह बहूनि मधुनः सुतम् । वदन्तमेवं तं दूतं भक्षयामास राक्षसः ॥७-६७-१८॥
translation: Having gone and spoken many unpleasant things to Madhu's son, the demon Lavaṇa devoured that messenger who was speaking thus.

raw: पीन उन्नत मुखौ कान्तौ स्निग्ध ताल फल उपमौ । मणि प्रवेक आभरणौ रुचिरौ ते पयो धरौ ॥३-४६-२०॥
translation: Your big hips are stout and strong, Your smooth thighs are like the trunk of an elephant, your breasts adorned with gems, are round and robust like palm fruits and drooping with heaviness with projected stiff nipples, shining and delightful, adding beauty.

raw: महाबलो महाबाहुः वाली विपुल विक्रमः । जुगोप भुज वीर्येण ऋक्ष गोपुच्छ वानरान् ॥१-१७-३५॥
translation: Mighty armed leader Vali endowed with immense prowess protected, with his strong arms all those bears, gopuchhas(cowtailed) and monkeys.

raw: अंगद प्रमुखान् वीरान् वीरः कपि गण ईश्वरः । वेग विक्रम संपन्नान् संदिदेश विशेषवित् ॥४-४१-५॥
translation: The extraordinary Sugriva commanded Nila, son of the firegod, Hanuman, the formidable, Jambavan, son of Brahma, Suhotra, Sarari, Saragulma, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sushena, Vrishabam, Mainda, Dvivida, Vijaya, Gandhamadana, the two sons of Firegod, Ulkamuka and Asanga including Angada, leader of the group, to proceed. All of them were endowed with speed and valour.

raw: अलं त्रासेन सुग्रीव बाष्पवेगो निगृह्यताम् । एवं प्रायाणि युद्धानि विजयो नास्ति नैष्ठिकः ॥६-४६-३२॥
ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः । इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि ॥५-१-१॥
translation: Hanuman, crusher of enemies resolved to find the whereabouts of Sita, carried away by Ravana. He followed the path of the Charanas, celestial bards.

raw: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम् । सन्निधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ॥७-८६-१२॥
translation: Having heard the words of the great gods, the personified sin of Brahman-killing, named Durvasa, chose a different dwelling place in their presence.

raw: ऊचुः संश्रवणे ये मां द्विजाः कार्तान्तिकाः शुभाम् । ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ॥६-४८-४॥
translation: "The astrologers, brahmins who have promised me to be auspicious and all the wise who have spoken are liars if Rama is killed."

raw: द्विविधं त्रिविधोपायमुपायमपि सेवते । विजिगीषुः सुहृत् कच्चिन्मित्रेषु च परन्तपः ॥५-३६-१७॥
translation: "Tell me if Rama, scorcher of enemies, desirous of victory is following a two-fold policy (confrontation and conciliation) A tough enemy cannot be defeated by following this method. A three-fold strategy has to be adopted in this case (confrontation, conciliation and creation of dissension among his foes) to be victorious. I hope he is well-disposed to his friends and has a good team!

raw: वचसा सान्त्वयित्वैनम् लोचनाभ्याम् पिबन्निव । आख्याहि मम तत्वेन राक्षसानाम् बलाबलम् ॥६-१८-७॥
शिवः सर्वेषु कालेषु काननेभ्यो विनिह्सृतः । राघवम् युक्त शीत उष्णः सेविष्यति सुखो अनिलः ॥२-४४-९॥
translation: A pleasant yet moderately hot and cold breeze blowing through the woodlands will serve Rama at all seasons.

raw: वसिष्ठो वामदेवः च जाबालिः अथ काश्यपः । मार्कण्डेयः च दीर्घायुः ऋषिः कात्यायनः तथा ॥१-६९-४॥
translation: Let brahmins like Vasishta, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Markandeya endowed with long life, and rishi Katyayana depart in advance. My chariot be yoked and kept ready. Let there be no delay. The messengers (from Janaka) are hastening me up".

raw: तमापतन्तमुत्प्लुत्य हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । आजघान तदा मूर्ध्नि वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ॥६-७०-२४॥
translation: Then the son of wind god, Hanuman observing Devanthaka coming towards him, got up and hit him on the forehead with his thunderbolt like fist.

raw: प्राप्य राज्यमयोध्यायां नन्दयित्वा सुहृज्जनम् । इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले वंशं स्थापयित्वा महाबल ॥६-१२२-५॥
translation: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.

raw: तमेवमुक्त्वा काकुत्स्थो हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत् । जीविते कृतबुद्धिस्त्वं मा प्रतिज्ञां विलोपय ॥७-१०८-३३॥
translation: Having thus spoken to Vibhishana, Rama then addressed Hanuman, saying, "You who have resolved to live, do not violate your vow."

raw: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च सिंदुवारैः शिरीषकैः । कदंब अर्जुन सर्जैः च पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम् ॥४-२७-१०॥
translation: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.

raw: असह्यानि न दुःखानि वाचश्च हृदयच्छिदः । राक्षसीनां सुघोराणां त्वत्कृते मर्षयाम्यहम् ॥५-४०-९॥
translation: "I am tolerating this unbearable grief, and the words of the dreadful ogresses piercing my heart. Only for you.

raw: स तस्या गन्धमाघ्राय विशल्यः समपद्यत । तथा निर्वेदनश्चैव संरूढव्रण एव च ॥६-९२-२४॥
translation: He then inhaled the fragrance and got freed from arrows, the pain of wounds and restored to normal state.

raw: साध्वेनमधिरोहस्तुसर्वतोवानरर्षभाः यूथपाश्चयथामुख्यास्तिष्ठन्त्वस ॥६-६७-१३०॥
translation: Let the bulls among Vanaras climb upon him and the foremost of Vanaras and the troops stand all over.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा गौतमो दुष्ट चारिणीम् । इमम् आश्रमम् उत्सृज्य सिद्ध चारण सेविते । हिमवत् शिखरे रम्ये तपः तेपे महातपाः ॥१-४८-३४॥
translation: "Highly powerful Gautama who had performed rigid austerities thus cursed the wicked Ahalya and left this hermitage, for the peaks of Himavat mountain served by siddhas and charanas. Here he performed austerities"(said Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: वानीरैः तिमिदैः चैव वकुलैः केतकैः अपि । हिन्तालैः तिनिशैः नीपैः वेतसैः कृतमालकैः ॥४-२७-१८॥
translation: 'See the different kinds of trees like canes timida, vakula, ketaka, hintala, tinisa, kadamba, dhava, krutamalaka, betasa grown here and there on the bank (of the river), which looks beautiful like a woman decorated with clothes and ornaments.

raw: प्रहृष्ट रूपौ इव राम लक्ष्मणौविराधम् उर्व्याम् प्रदरे निपात्य तम् । ननन्दतुः वीत भयौ महावनेशिलाभिः अन्तर् दधतुः च राक्षसम् ॥३-४-३३॥
translation: Rama and Lakshmana were happy to consign Viradha's body to the pit after killing him. They filled the pit with rocks in the great forest without fear.

raw: भरतेन महाबाहो लक्ष्मणेन यवीयसा । शत्रुघ्नेन च शत्रुघ्न स्वशरीरेण वा पुनः पुनःपुनः ॥६-४१-५॥
translation: "O broad shouldered hero, tamer of foes! Do not do this kind of action. Even if you were harmed a bit, O destroyer of foes, of what use is it to me or even to Sita, Bharata, Satrughna or to Lakshmana or even to my body?"

raw: यच्च तस्य महच्छूलं त्र्यम्बकेण महात्मना । दत्तं शत्रुविनाशाय मधोरायुधमुत्तमम् ॥७-६३-२५॥
translation: And that great trident, Madhu's excellent weapon, was given to him by the great-souled Tryambaka (Shiva) for the destruction of enemies.

raw: इक्षून् मधून् तथा लाजान् मैरेयान् च वर आसवान् । पानानि च महाअर्हाणि भक्ष्यान् च उच्च अवचान् तथा ॥१-५३-२॥
translation: Sugarcane, honey and fried grain, invigorating liquors in good containers, excellent drinks and varieties of food (were served).

raw: वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम् । किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वा वचनमब्रवीत् ॥७-१०७-११॥
translation: And by the words of Vasishtha, Rama, having raised up the people, spoke to all, asking, "What shall I do?"

raw: वधस्तु रामस्य मया त्वया च । प्रहस्त सर्वैरपि राक्षसैर्वा । कथम् भवेदर्थविशारदस्य । महार्णवम् तर्तु मिवाप्लवस्य ॥६-१४-११॥
translation: "Prahastha How can you or me or all Rakshasas kill Rama who is knowledgeable of everything, just as one who is not swimming can cross the great ocean."

raw: राज्य प्रणाशः स्व जनैः वियोगःपितुर् विनाशो जननी वियोगः । सर्वानि मे लक्ष्मण शोक वेगम्आपूरयन्ति प्रविचिन्तितानि ॥३-६३-५॥
translation: O Lakshmana, loss of kingdom, separation from kith and kin, death of father, separation from mother--all these thoughts augment my sorrow faster and in greater measure.

raw: कच्चिन्न तर्कैर्युक्त्या वा ये चाप्यपरिकीर्तिता: । त्वया वा वा ऽमात्यैर्बुध्यते तात मन्त्रितम् ॥२-१००-२२॥
translation: Dear brother, I hope others are not able to understand your determination or those of your ministers, either by conjecture or by inference or through other means without being revealed either by you or by your ministers.

raw: ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः । आजघ्नुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं शरैश्चादित्यसन्निभैः ॥५-४२-२८॥
translation: They assailed Hanuman with iron maces, crowbars edged with gold and shining arrows resembling the Sun.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १२६ ॥६-१२६-५२॥
अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः । हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया ॥५-५९-२४॥
translation: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.

raw: अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां गोसवैश्च महाधनैः । ईजे क्रतुभिरन्यैश्च स श्रीमानाप्तदक्षिणैः ॥७-९९-१०॥
translation: The glorious Rama performed other sacrifices like Agnishtoma, Atiratra, and Gosava, which were accompanied by great wealth and ample gifts.

raw: हन्तारंदानवेन्द्राणांयक्षाणां च सहस्रशः निवातकवचानां च सङ्ग्रहीतारमाहवे ॥६-११४-५१॥
translation: "He who killed thousands of chiefs of Danavas, Yakshas, and subdued Nivatakavachas in combat"

raw: गम्यतामिति चोवाच आगच्छ त्वं स्मरे यदा । सिद्धानां च गतौ सौम्य मा विषादेन योजय । प्रतिघातश्च ते मा भूद्यथेष्टं गच्छतो दिशः ॥७-४१-१४॥
translation: Rama then told the Pushpaka, "Depart now, and remember to return whenever I recall you; O gentle one, do not be afflicted with sorrow, and may there be no obstruction to your desired flight in any direction, like that of the Siddhas."

raw: साधु क्रोधम् इमम् वीर नदी वेगम् इव आगतम् । शयनाद् उत्थितः काल्यम् त्यज भुक्ताम् इव स्रजम् ॥४-१५-७॥
translation: 'O valiant Vali anger has overtaken you like the flood of a river. It is natural for you to be angry at this time, but shake off your anger just as the wise discard a flower garland already used up.

raw: अथोत्तरमुदारार्थमब्रवीदङ्गदस्तदा । अनुमान्य तथा प्राज्ञो जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिम् ॥४-६५-१८॥
translation: 'Then the wise Angada said to great Jambavan, in a gentle manner about his own strength.

raw: मुष्टिभिर् बाहुभिर् पद्भिः सूदयन्तौ तु राक्षसम् । उद्यम्योद्यम्य च अपि एनम् स्थण्डिले निष्पिपेषतुः ॥३-४-७॥
translation: Striking the demon with fists, knees and feet, both of them smit him on the bare ground and pulverized him.

raw: तथाहि रामो भरतेन ताम्यता प्रसाद्यमान: शिरसा महीपति: । न चैव चक्रे गमनाय सत्त्ववान् मतिं पितुस्तद्वचने व्यवस्थित: ॥२-१०६-३३॥
translation: Thus besought and propitiated by Bharata with his head bowed low and distressed, the virtuous lord of the world, Rama, firmly established in the words of his father, resolved not to go back to Ayodhya.

raw: निश्चिता एव हि मे बुद्धिः वन वासे दृढ व्रता । भरत स्नेह संतप्ता बालिशी क्रियते पुनः ॥३-१६-३८॥
translation: Even though I have made up my mind to dwell in the forest and keep my vow, my love for Bharata makes me waver like a child (Rama does not want Bharata to suffer on his account).

raw: कर्णिकार वनम् भद्रे हसंती देवि सेवसे । अलम् ते परिहासेन मम बाधावहेन वै ॥३-६२-५॥
translation: O gentle one you are wandering in the karnikara garden, laughing and making fun. Enough of this , that causes my pain.

raw: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः ॥७-८२-८॥
translation: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.

raw: इति एवम् उक्तः तु विभुः महात्मा ताराम् समाश्वास्य हितम् बभाषे । मा वीर भार्ये विमतिम् कुरुष्व लोको हि सर्वो विहितो विधात्रा ॥४-२४-४१॥
शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा च तत्रासीद्युद्धमेदिनी । दुर्ज्ञेया दुर्निवेशा च शोणितास्रावकर्दमा ॥६-४४-१५॥
translation: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.

raw: कल्याणीबतगाथेयंलौकिकीप्रतिभातिमे । एतिजीवन्तमानन्दोनरंवर्षशतादपि ॥६-१२९-२॥
translation: The saying that "If a human being lives (long), for a hundred years, he will experience joy" is true and auspicious.

raw: कृत्स्नम् वनम् इदम् दृष्टम् श्रोतव्यम् च श्रुतम् त्वया । तत् इच्छामि अभ्यनुज्ञाता त्यक्ष्यामि एतत् कलेवरम् ॥३-७४-२८॥
translation: You have seen the entire garden and have listened what is to be heard. With your permission I would like to give up this body.

raw: महाऋषि यः वसिष्ठः तु यः पितुः नः पुरोहितः । अह्ना पुत्र शतम् जज्ञे तथैव अस्य पुनर् हतम् ॥३-६६-९॥
translation: To sage Vasistha, our father's priest, were born a hundred sons in a day.But all of them were killed in one day the same way.

raw: निर्बिभेद ततो बाणैर्हयानस्य महाजवान् । रामस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्वज्रकल्पैः शितैः शरैः ॥६-१०४-२९॥
translation: Rama then released arrows endowed with great speed, shower of multitude of arrows straight into the horses of Ravana and shattered them.

raw: भरतम् कैकेयी पुत्रम् अब्रवीत् रघुनंदन । अयम् केकय राजस्य पुत्रो वसति पुत्रक ॥१-७७-१६॥
तस्मात् गृहीत्वा वैदेहीम् शर पाणिः धनुर् धरः । गुहाम् आश्रय शैलस्य दुर्गाम् पादप संकुलाम् ॥३-२४-१२॥
translation: Therefore, take shelter along with Sita in the inaccessible mountain cave, overgrown with trees, ready with your bow and arrows.

raw: तावद् एताम् पुरीम् लन्काम् विचिनोमि पुनः पुनः । सम्पाति वचनाच् च अपि रामम् यदि आनयामि अहम् ॥५-१३-५३॥
राघवस्त्वथ यातेषु तपस्विषु विचिन्तयन् । न तत्रारोचयद्वासं कारणैर्बहुभिस्तदा ॥२-११७-१॥
translation: When the ascetics had departed, Rama thought over the matter well and did not like to reside there for many reasons.

raw: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः काननम् शुभ दर्शनम् । यत्र राजन्ति शैला वा द्रुमाः स शिखरा इव ॥४-१-४॥
translation: 'O Saumitri look at the pleasant forest around Pampa where trees stand splendid like mountainpeaks.

raw: रश्मि केतोः च भवनम् सूर्य शत्रोः तथैव च । वज्रकायस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः ॥५-६-२२॥
translation: The noble vanara jumped from Jambumali's to Sumali's and from Rashmiketu's, Suryaketu's and to Vajrakaya's residence.

raw: एकेन अहम् प्रमोक्ष्यामि बाण मोक्षेण संयुगे । मम दर्शय सुग्रीव वैरिणम् भ्रातृ रूपिणम् ॥४-१४-११॥
अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा यमुनातीरशोभिता । शोभिता गृहमुख्यैश्च चत्वरापणवीथिकैः । चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता नानावाणिज्यशोभिता ॥७-७०-११॥
translation: The city, resembling a half-moon and beautified by the Yamuna's banks, was adorned with grand houses, squares, shops, and streets, inhabited by people of all four varnas, and bustling with diverse commerce.

raw: तं भूमौ पितुरार्तेन न्यस्तं रामेण वीक्ष्य सा । उवाच देवी कौसल्या सर्वा दशरथस्त्रिय: ॥२-१०३-९॥
translation: Seeing the pinda (edible offering made to the departed soul) placed on the ground for his father by the distressed Rama, queen Kausalya, addressing all the wives of Dasaratha, said:

raw: एतैः ब्रह्मर्षिभिर् नित्यम् ऋत्विजः तस्य पौर्वकाः । विद्या विनीता ह्रीमंतः कुशला नियतेन्द्रियाः ॥१-७-६॥
इक्ष्वाकुवंशे धर्मिष्ठे गते नाशमसंशयम् । भविष्यन्ति प्रजाः सर्वाः शोकसन्तापपीडिताः ॥५-५५-२०॥
translation: 'When the righteous Ikshvaku race perishes the people would be tormented by grief and remorse. There is no doubt.

raw: वृक्षस्थांश्च तलस्थांश्च वानरान् बलदर्पितान् । अभ्यक्रामंस्ततो वीराः पालास्तत्र सहस्रशः ॥५-६२-२४॥
translation: Then the heroic guards in their thousands fell on the vanaras proud of their power on and under the tala trees.

raw: अपि लक्ष्मण सीतायाः सामग्र्यम् प्राप्नुयावहे । जीवन्त्याः पुरुषव्याघ्र सुताया जनक्स्य वै ॥३-५७-२०॥
translation: O Lakshmana, a tiger among men, will we be able to see the daughter of Janaka, living in a state of total wellbeing? Will we be able to get her back ?

raw: स कपिर्वारयामास तं व्योम्नि शरवर्षिणम् । वृष्टिमन्तं पयोदान्ते पयोदमिव मारुतः ॥५-४६-२३॥
translation: The great monkey kept away the showering arrows like the wind prevents raincloud from showering rain drops at the end of monsoon.

raw: त्रैलोक्ये नास्ति यो द्वन्द्वं मम दद्यान्नराधिप । शङ्के प्रसक्तो भोगेषु न शृणोषि बलं मम ॥७-१९-२४॥
translation: O king of men, there is no one in the three worlds who can challenge me; I suspect you are too engrossed in pleasures to know my strength.

raw: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यो विद्रुता दिशः । स्थिताः काश्चिद्गताः काश्चिद्रावणाय निवेदितुम् ॥५-४२-११॥
translation: LIstening to Vaidehi's words the ogresses divided themselves and fled in all directions. While some stood there, others went to report to Ravana.

raw: वसिष्ठस्य आश्रमपदम् शून्यम् आसीत् महात्मनः । मुहूर्तम् इव निःशब्दम् आसीत् ईरिण संनिभम् ॥१-५५-२४॥
translation: The greatsoul Vasishta's hermitage became deserted and silent in an instant like a barren field.

raw: वानरा यदि वः खेदः प्रनष्टः फल भक्षणात् । यदि च एतत् मया श्राव्यम् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि कथताम् ॥४-५२-२॥
translation: 'O monkeys if you have been relieved of your fatigue after eating fruits, now tell me about yourself, if you think it can be told. I want to hear.

raw: अयम् च अत्र मया दृष्टः पर दार परिग्रहः । तस्य प्रादुर् अभूच् चिन्ता पुनर् अन्या मनस्विनः ॥५-११-३९॥
प्रविविक्तम् अहम् मन्ये तम् वासम् भवतः सुखम् । इह वा वन वासाय वस राम मया सह ॥२-५४-३२॥
translation: O Rama, I think you will enjoy your stay there in a solitary place. Or else, you may live with me here during the period of banishment.

raw: रावणिश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धो रणे वानरयूथपान् । पातयामास बाणौघैः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ॥६-९१-१४॥
translation: Indrajith, highly enraged, struck Vanara leaders with a volley of hundreds and thousands of arrows.

raw: धनूंषि कृत्वा सज्जानि विनिर्भिद्य महोदरम् । रावणं समरे क्रुद्धाः सहिताः समभिद्रवन् ॥७-२३-४१॥
translation: Enraged, they made their bows ready, pierced Mahodara, and together attacked Ravana in battle.

raw: ऋषेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मामाह पुरुषर्षभः । सूत न क्वचिदेवं ते वक्तव्यं जनसन्निधौ ॥७-५०-१५॥
translation: Having heard the sage's words, the best among men (Rama) said to me, "O charioteer, you should never speak thus in the presence of people."

raw: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ॥७-९७-१६॥
translation: Sita prayed, "Just as I worship Rama with my mind, actions, and speech, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

raw: कृत्वा तत्र अभिषेकम् ते बभूवुः गत कल्मषाः । धूत पापाः पुनः तेन तोयेन अथ शुभ अन्विता ॥१-४३-२७॥
गतानाम् तु ततः पूजाम् ऋषि पुत्रः चकार ह । इदम् अर्घ्यम् इदम् पाद्यम् इदम् मूलम् फलम् च नः ॥१-१०-१७॥
translation: Thereafter the son of ascetic respectfully received the the strangers saying, "(Accept) our offerings, here is water for washing feet and here are roots and fruits".

raw: यथा प्रतिज्ञातम् इदम् नरेन्द्र कृतम् त्वया दृउष्ट फलम् च कर्म । मम अद्य भोगेषु नरेन्द्र सूनो मनो निवृत्तम् हत जिवितेन ॥४-२४-४॥
translation: 'Your majesty you have struck down Vali as promised and the consequences of your action are seen now. O prince, however, my mind is not interested in the enjoyment of pleasures. I have no interest in life.

raw: आपतन्तीं शिलां दृष्ट्वा गदामुद्यम्य सम्भ्रमात् । रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन वसुधायां व्यतिष्ठत ॥६-५२-२८॥
translation: Beholding the rock descending upon him, Dhumraksha rushed instantly on the ground from the chariot and stood.

raw: उत्तरीयम् इह आसक्तम् सुव्यक्तम् सीतया तदा । तथा ह्य् एते प्रकाशन्ते सक्ताः कौशेय तन्तवः ॥२-८८-१५॥
translation: That the upper garment of Sita might have been caught here is well evident from the shining silken threads stuck.

raw: निवेशयत मे सैन्यम् अभिप्रायेण सर्वशः । विश्रान्तः प्रतरिष्यामः श्वैदानीम् महा नदीम् ॥२-८३-२३॥
translation: You may, according to your convenience, halt the army anywhere here and, after taking rest (for the night), we shall cross the river Ganga tomorrow.

raw: वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः । ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः ॥७-१०७-१०॥
translation: Vasishtha said, "Dear Rama, behold these subjects fallen to the ground; understanding their desire, do not cause them any displeasure."

raw: सद्रव्यं च शिरो नित्यं भविष्यति तवाक्षयम् । एष काञ्चनको वर्णो मत्प्रीत्या ते भविष्यति ॥७-१८-३५॥
translation: Your head will always be rich and inexhaustible, and this golden color will be yours by my favor.

raw: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तम् तु वानराम्स् तान् उवाच ह । हनूमत् प्रमुखान् सर्वान् इदम् वचनम् उत्तमम् ॥६-१७-६॥
translation: Reflecting for a while he addressed Hanuman and the other Vanara leaders in this way.

raw: एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी दैवतैरभिसत्कृता । समुद्रमध्ये सुरसा बिभ्रती राक्षसं वपुः ॥५-१-१४९॥
translation: Thus honoured by the gods, Surasa assumed a terrific ugly form frightening to all and stood in the midst of the ocean. Putting up a distorted appearance and encompassing Hanuman who was crossing the ocean, she spoke to him:

raw: हनुमानङ्गदो नीलः सुषेणः कुमुदो नलः । गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः । जाम्बवानृषभः स्कन्धो रम्भः शतवलिः पृथुः ॥६-४७-२॥
translation: Having arranged the army in place, Hanuman, Angada, Nila, Kumuda, Nala, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Sanuprastha, Jambavan, Rshaba, Rambha, Satavali, Pruthu, who are always alert were holding trees and looking above, on either side and in all directions and guarded Rama. Whenever there was movement of even a blade of grass, they thought that it might be Rakshasa.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १२७ ॥६-१२७-२३॥
राज्य कामे मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह । तम् विराधे विमोक्ष्यामि वज्री वज्रम् इव अचले ॥३-२-२५॥
translation: Like Indra who hits the mountain with his thunderbolt, I shall release on Viradha the anger I felt against Bharata for his passion for the kingdom.

raw: उद्विग्ना शन्किता च अस्मि न च स्वस्थम् मनो मम । तद् भयाच् च अहम् उद्विग्ना;अशोक वनिकाम् गताः ॥६-३४-१०॥
translation: "I am perturbed and doubtful (of my life). My mind is not at ease. Even though I am in Ashoka Grove I am disturbed."

raw: इति ब्रुवन्न् आत्म समम् सुमन्त्रः सारथिस् तदा । दृष्ट्वा दुर गतम् रामम् दुह्ख आर्तः रुरुदे चिरम् ॥२-५२-२०॥
translation: Rama was like his (Sumantra's) own self. When Sumantra, the charioteer, saw that Rama was preparing to go afar for a long time, he started weeping aloud in deep distress.

raw: यदि धर्मो भवेद्भूतो अधर्मो वा परन्तप । न स्म हत्वा मुनिं वज्री कुर्यादिज्यां शतक्रतुः ॥६-८३-२९॥
translation: "Indra killed an ascetic (Viswarupa) and did fire sacrifice. If dharma alone is his duty, he could have done hundreds of fire sacrifices and not have killed the ascetic. If adharma is duty he would have killed the ascetic and not done fire sacrifice."

raw: न कथंचन गंतव्यम् कुरूणाम् उत्तरेण वः । अन्येषाम् अपि भूतानाम् न अनुक्रामति वै गतिः ॥४-४३-५७॥
translation: 'You should not go beyond the north of Kuru. No living being can trespass it.

raw: इत्युक्तः सारथिस्तेन ययौ यत्र स मारुतिः । वहन् परमदुर्धर्षं स्थितमिन्द्रजितं रथे ॥६-८६-२६॥
translation: On hearing Indrajith who is highly difficult to encounter speaking in that way his charioteer drove Indrajith, to that place, where Maruthi was.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या समुत्क्षिप्तस्ततो बली । ज्वलद्भास्करवर्णाभं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् ॥५-२०-३९॥
पशुः अभ्याहृतः राजन् प्रणष्टः तव दुर्नयात् । अरक्षितारम् राजानम् घ्नन्ति दोषा नरेश्वर ॥१-६१-७॥
translation: "O King the animal has been stolen away and because of your inability to enforce law, it could not be traced. O Lord of men the king who fails to protect (his dependents) perishes by his own faults.

raw: क्रोशन्तीम् राम राम इति रामेण रहिताम् वने । जीवित अन्ताय केशेषु जग्राह अन्तक संनिभः ॥३-५२-८॥
translation: Separated from Rama in the forest, Sita hugged huge trees, running round and round like a creeper coiled, crying loudly, 'Rama, O Rama' . The king of the demons, like Yama, caught hold of her hair only to invite his death, all the time saying, Leave it, Leave it (Leave the tree).

raw: उद्धृत्य गुणसम्पन्नं विमलाम्बरवर्चसम् । निष्पपात स वेगेन सभार्यः सचिवैर्वृतः ॥६-९३-३९॥
translation: In a totally confused state on account of the death of his son, he went to Mythili taking the excellent sword, which was shining resembling pure sky, feeling enraged, accompanied by his wife, and surrounded by the ministers.

raw: विचेतनम् विघूर्णन्तम् शीतेषु बल पीडितम् । निरस्तम् दृश्य मारीचम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३०-१९॥
translation: Having seen Maricha beaten by the power of that coolarrowed astra, thrown to a distance, reeling and lying unconscious, Rama spoke to Lakshmana:

raw: उपवासम् अथो शस्त्रम् प्रचरिष्यन्ति वानराः । घोरम् आरोदनम् मन्ये गते मयि भविष्यति ॥५-१३-३७॥
पूर्वाम् दिशम् वज्रधरो दक्षिणाम् पातु ते यमः । वरुणः पश्चिमामाशाम् धनेशस्तूत्तराम् दिशम् ॥२-१६-२४॥
translation: May Indra protect you on the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west and Kubera in the north.

raw: तेनास्य राज्ञस्तौ पादौ तदा कल्माषतां गतौ । तदाप्रभृति राजा ऽसौ सौदासः सुमहायशाः । कल्माषपादः संवृत्तः ख्यातश्चैव तथा नृपः ॥७-६५-३२॥
translation: By that water, the king's feet then became spotted, and from that time onwards, the greatly renowned King Saudasa became known as Kalmashapada, the spotted-footed king.

raw: त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । महोदरमहापार्श्वो निर्जग्मुः कालचोदिताः ॥६-६९-१९॥
translation: Trisira, also Atikaya, Devanthaka, Naranthaka, Mahodara and Mahaparsva impelled by destiny went.

raw: अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु प्रीतः परमया मुदा । उमापतिर्द्विजान्सर्वानुवाच इलसन्निधौ ॥७-९०-१६॥
translation: Then, when the sacrifice was concluded, the lord of Uma, pleased and filled with supreme joy, addressed all the brahmins there in Ila's presence.

raw: दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रदुद्राव वानराणां महाचमूः ॥६-६१-३॥
translation: Seeing the Rakshasa who was like a rainy cloud with water, decked with gold ornaments, the commander in chief of Vanaras ran.

raw: कन्या हि द्वे कुले नित्यं संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति । पुत्रद्वयं ममाप्यस्यां भार्यायां सम्बभूव ह ॥७-१२-१२॥
translation: Indeed, a daughter always keeps two families in a state of uncertainty; also, two sons were born to me from this wife.

raw: कर्मान्तरे तदा विप्रा हेतुवादान् बहूनपि । प्राहुः सुवाग्मिनो धीराः परस्पर जिगीषया ॥१-१४-१९॥
translation: In the interval between ceremonies, eloquent and sagacious brahmins were engaged in various disputations, desirous of victory.

raw: अद्य वानरसैन्यानि रथेन पवनौजसा । धनुःसमुद्रादुद्भूतैर्मथिष्यामि शरोर्मिभिः ॥६-९६-१४॥
translation: "Seated on the chariot I shall knock out the Vanara army by the waves in the form of arrows released from the ocean of my bow."

raw: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्नाराचैर्बलवन्तौ कृतव्रणौ । प्रसुस्रुवाते रुधिरं कीर्तिमन्तौ जये धृतौ ॥६-८९-३१॥
translation: Glorious and powerful heroes, determined to win over each other, wounded by the gold covered iron arrows were bleeding profusely.

raw: अब्रवीत् राक्षसान् सर्वान् प्रहसन् स खरः तदा । महा उत्पातान् इमान् सर्वान् उत्थितान् घोर दर्शनान् ॥३-२३-१९॥
इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः । अब्रवीत्रिदशश्रेष्ठान् रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ॥६-१२०-११॥
translation: Rama the upholder of dharma and foremost and supreme god spoke after the ruler of the world had spoken to him.

raw: तमुक्तवन्तं वैदेहं विश्वामित्रो महामुनि: । उवाच वचनं वीरं वसिष्ठसहितो नृपम् ॥१-७२-१॥
translation: When Janaka the valiant king of Videha thus spoke (on the genealogy of his family) the mighty ascetic Viswamitra accompanied by Vasishta said to Janaka:

raw: अतो दु:खतरं लोके न किञ्चित् प्रतिभाति मा । यत्र राम: पितुर्दद्यादिङ्गुदीक्षोदमृद्धिमान् ॥२-१०३-१३॥
translation: Rama (who was once) highly prosperous, had to offer the cake of ingudi pulp to his father. Nothing appears more painful to me than this in this world.

raw: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले देवि सम्प्राप्तः सुमहानयम् । अनयो नयसम्पन्ने यत्र ते विकृता मतिः ॥२-१२-१९॥
translation: O queen, till now you had a moral sense. With your mind debased (now), a very great immorality has infected the Ikshvaku race.

raw: हरादवाप्य ते मन्त्रं कामारिमभिवाद्य च । नारायणालयं प्राप्य तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् ॥७-६-३०॥
translation: Having obtained the mantra from Hara and saluted Shiva, they reached the abode of Narayana and submitted everything to him.

raw: प्रधावन्नूरुवेगेन प्रभञ्जंस्तरसा द्रुमान् । हनुमान् परमक्रुद्धश्चरणैर्दारयत् क्षितिम् ॥६-५६-२२॥
translation: Highly enraged Hanuman was running at high speed that his feet were seen breaking the trees and cleaving the earth.

raw: स वाजिभिश्चतुर्भिश्च बाणैश्च निशितैर्युतः । आरोपितमहाचापः शुशुभे स्यन्दनोत्तमः ॥६-८०-१२॥
translation: Drawn by horses, fitted with sharp mighty bows, the chariot was shining exquisitely and looked charming.

raw: पद्मोत्पलयुता भान्ति पूर्णाः परमवारिणा । क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः ॥२-१५-८॥
समाक्षरैः चतुर्भिः यः पादैः गीतो महर्षिणा । सः अनुव्याहरणात् भूयः शोकः श्लोकत्वम् आगतः ॥१-२-४०॥
translation: This sloka of four lines, each consisting of equal number of syllables, was recited by the maharshi. Constant recitation (by others) elicited admiration (from the listeners).

raw: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने । पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः ॥५-५६-३॥
translation: "O destroyer of foes, you are capable of rescuing me singlehanded. Your success will raise your strength and bring glory.

raw: न तु एव अनागते काले देहाच् च्यवति जीवितम् । कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानस्य मृत्युर् मम न विद्यते ॥२-३९-५॥
translation: Unless the destined hour arrives, life does not leave the body. Therefore, even though I am tormented by Kaikeyi and even after seeing my son, standing before me, (bright) like fire, taking off his fine clothes and wearing the robes of an ascetic my end does not come.

raw: ततो माम् बुद्धि संपन्नो हनुमान् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । इदानीम् मे स्मृतम् राजन् यथा वाली हरीश्वरः ॥४-४६-२१॥
शोक जालेन महता विततेन न राजतीम् । सम्सक्ताम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-३२॥
स्मर राज्न् पुरा वृत्तं तस्मिन् दैवासुरे रणे । तत्र चाच्यावयच्छत्रुस्तव जीवतमन्तरा ॥२-११-१८॥
translation: O king, recall the event that happened long ago in the war between gods and asuras where the enemy destroyed all your forces except your life.

raw: स तत्तदा वानरसैन्यमेवं रामं च सङ्ख्ये सह लक्ष्मणेन । विषादयित्वा सहसा विवेश पुरीं दशग्रीवभुजाभिगुप्ताम् ॥६-७३-६९॥
translation: Thereafter Vanara army withdrew from the battle along with Rama and Lakshmana. Indrajith for his part moved to the abode protected by Ravana's arms, while being praised. He at once entered the city happily and related everything to the father. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिसप्ततितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the Seventy third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by Sage Valmiki.

raw: वारितान् राक्षसान् दृष्ट्वा मकराक्षो निशाचरः । क्रोधानलसमाविष्टो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-७९-९॥
translation: Seeing the intercepted Rakshasas, the night ranger Maka raksha was overtaken by fire of anger spoke these words.

raw: निष्प्रधानामनेकाग्रां नरेन्द्रेण विना कृताम् । निवृत्तवनवासोपि नायोध्यां गन्तुमुत्सहे ॥२-१०२-११॥
translation: Even after the completion of my exile I do not wish to return to Ayodhya which is directionless, bereft of its chief, the king.

raw: स तान् बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव । प्रासादं शैलसङ्कासमुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा ॥६-४१-८५॥
translation: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.

raw: त्रातुम् अर्हसि माम् सौम्य धर्मेण मुनिपुंगव । त्राता त्वम् हि नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषाम् त्वम् हि भावनः ॥१-६२-५॥
यदि मामिह जानीयाद्वर्तमानां स राघवः । अद्य बाणैरभिक्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसं ॥५-२४-२१॥
बाहु वेग प्रणुन्नेन सागरेण अहम् उत्सहे । समाप्लावयितुम् लोकम् स पर्वत नदी ह्रदम् ॥४-६७-१२॥
translation: 'I can submerge this world including its mountains rivers and lakes. I can push back the sea waters quickly with my arms.

raw: एवम् एक आयन गताः प्लवमाना गिरेः गिरिम् । प्रकंपयन्तो वेगेन गिरीणाम् शिखराणि च ॥४-२-९॥
translation: Jumping from one mountain to another swiftly and shaking the mountain tops, the monkeys reached one spot.

raw: तस्य दीप्ताग्निसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी । ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ ॥६-६०-६२॥
translation: His huge eyes were like blazing fire dazzling like lightning glowing like two huge planets.

raw: तुष्टेन तेन दत्तौ ते द्वौ वरौ शुभदर्शने । सत्वयोक्तः पतिर्देवि यदेच्छेयं तदा वरौ ॥२-९-१७॥
translation: O auspiciouslooking one out of gratitude he had granted two boons to you (for saving him on two occasions). O queen then you told your husband that whenever you desire, you will ask for those boons. The magnanimous king said, 'So be it'.

raw: यथा केसरिणा त्वेष वायुना सो ऽञ्जनासुतः । प्रतिषिद्धो ऽपि मर्यादां लङ्घयत्येव वानरः ॥७-३६-३३॥
translation: Just as this son of Anjana, though forbidden by Kesari and Vayu, indeed transgresses all limits.

raw: कथयस्व च विस्रब्धो निर्भयं विगतज्वरः । कथयन्ति यथा पौराः पापा जनपदेषु च ॥७-४३-११॥
translation: Speak confidently, fearlessly, and without anxiety, just as the citizens and people in the districts speak, even about wicked things.

raw: इमौ राज्ये ऽभिषेक्ष्यामि देशः साधु विधीयताम् । रमणीयो ह्यसम्बाधो रमेतां यत्र धन्विनौ ॥७-१०२-३॥
translation: I shall enthrone these two in a kingdom, so let a suitable, charming, and unobstructed region be prepared where these two archers can happily reside.

raw: तं निशाम्य सनिस्त्रिंशं व्यथिता जनकात्मजा । निवार्यमाणं बहुशः सुहृद्भिरनुवर्तिनम् । सीता दुःखसमाविष्टा विलपन्तीदमब्रवीत् ॥६-९३-४८॥
translation: While irreproachable Mythili was being guarded by rakshasi women, she saw him bearing an excellent sword and crossing. When he was repeatedly stopped by friends and obstructed, he was not receding and reaching Janaka's daughter.

raw: किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा । मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम् ॥२-१०-२५॥
translation: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.

raw: दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये तस्य तु राक्षसी । अंगारक इति विख्याता चायाम् आक्षिप्य भोजिनी ॥४-४१-२६॥
translation: 'In the midst of the southern sea is a famous ogress, Angaraka (also Simhika) by name who swallows humans by capturing them even by their shadows.

raw: आयत्तम् अत्र राज ऋषे सर्वम् एतन् न संशयः । सर्वस्वम् एतत् सत्येन मम तुष्टि करी तथा ॥१-५३-१५॥
आज्ञप्तास्तु नरेन्द्रेण कुमाराः शक्रतेजसः । प्रह्वाः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा विविशुस्ते समाहिताः ॥७-४४-१४॥
translation: Commanded by the king, the princes, who possessed the splendor of Indra, entered composedly, having bowed down with folded hands.

raw: नृशंसम् अनृशंसम् वा प्रजा रक्षण कारणात् । पातकम् वा सदोषम् वा कर्तव्यम् रक्षता सदा ॥१-२५-१८॥
translation: Whether cruel or kind, sinful or wrong whatever contributes to the protection of the subjects, should be done by the righteous (king).

raw: प्रहृष्ट मुदिता सेना सान्वयात् कैकयी सुतम् । भ्रातुरानयने यान्तम् भरतम् भ्रातृवत्सलम् ॥२-८३-१८॥
translation: The army, overwhelmed with joy and cheer followed the devoted brother Bharata who had set out to bring back Rama.

raw: रामेत्युक्त्वा तु वचनं बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः । शशाक नृपतिर्दीनो नेक्षितुं नाभिभाषितुम् ॥२-१८-३॥
translation: Dasaratha uttered the word 'Rama', but thereafter could neither say any more in distress nor look at him becuase his eyes were brimming with tears.

raw: भूयिष्ठम् लोडिता लन्का रामस्य चरता प्रियम् । न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् सीताम् सर्व अन्ग शोभनाम् ॥५-१३-३॥
translation: "I have thoroughly surveyed the entire city of Lanka to please Rama, but I am unable to find Sita of flawless beauty.

raw: नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादि तत् । कैकेय्या वदनम् द्रष्टुम् पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता ॥२-२०-४४॥
translation: Fallen into an unfortunate state how can I look at Kaikeyi's face who is always harsh and in temper?

raw: एताः सममिदानीं ते वयमात्मा च पातिताः । ब्रुवाणो ऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विबीषणः । धृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वया ऽ ऽत्मवधकाङ्क्षिणा ॥६-११३-१९॥
translation: "Even though good advice was given by your dear brother Vibheeshana, in your delusion evidently you sought your own destruction."

raw: अस्तःपुरस्य द्वाराणि सर्वस्य नगरस्य च । चन्दनस्रग्भिरर्च्यन्तां धूपैश्च घ्राणहारिभिः ॥२-३-१३॥
translation: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.

raw: तत् तु शीघ्रम् अतिक्रम्य कांतारम् रोम हर्षणम् । कैलासम् पाण्डुरम् प्राप्य हृष्टा यूयम् भविष्यथ ॥४-४३-२०॥
translation: 'Crossing that horripilating, desolate place quickly, you will be happy to reach the snowy Kailasa mountain.

raw: पृच्छते च यथावृत्तं पित्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् । यथा तौ शरबन्धेन निश्चेष्टौ निष्प्रभौ कृतौ ॥६-४६-४९॥
translation: Delighted Ravana kissed his son on the forehead and enquired of him of the details. Indrajith presented details saying that both Rama and Lakshmana were stunned in the network of arrows, and lost splendour.

raw: ताभ्याम् स परिपूर्णाभ्याम् भुजाभ्याम् राक्षस अधिपः । शुशुभे अचल सम्काशः श्र्न्गाभ्याम् इव मन्दरः ॥५-१०-२२॥
translation: The lord of demons looked splendid like a mountain with his long, fully developed arms. He appeared like Mandara mountain with two lofty peaks.

raw: मनः समीक्षमाणश्च सूतो दशरथस्य सः । कम्पयन्निव कैकेय्या हृदयम् वाक्छरैश्शितैः ॥२-३५-३॥
translation: Overcome with anger, charioteer Sumantra started shaking his head and sighing off and on, crushing his palms and grinding his teeth. His eyes turned red due to anger. Overcome with a sudden, ominous grief, the complexion of his face turned red. Sumantra understood the mind of Dasaratha. With sharp arrows of words as if piercing the heart of Kaikeyi, he denounced her in exceptionally harsh words which, like thunderbolt, cut her to the quick:

raw: तदद्य विपुलं वीर दुःखमिन्द्रजिता कृतम् । कर्मणा व्यपनेष्यामि तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ राघव ॥६-८३-४२॥
translation: "Get up, heroic Raghava! I will get rid of the agony caused to you by Indrajith, by the action."

raw: सततम् राजवृत्ते हि ज्येष्ठो राज्येऽभिषिच्यते । राज्ञामेतत्समम् तत्स्यादिक्ष्वाकूणाम् विशेषतः ॥२-७३-२२॥
translation: According to the established law of royalty, the eldest son is invariably crowned in the kingdom. This is true of all kings. This is a special tradition of the kings of the Ikshvaku race.

raw: देवानाम् मध्यतः स्थित्वा ममन्थ पुरुषोत्तमः । अथ वर्ष सहस्रेण आयुर्वेदमयः पुमान् ॥१-४५-३१॥
ततो विनेदुः संहृष्टा वानरा जितकाशिनः । वदन्तो राघवजयं रावणस्य च तद्वधम् ॥६-१११-२५॥
translation: Then the Vanaras, feeling triumphant, got highly excited over Rama's victory and the death of Ravana, and shouted aloud in joy.

raw: सुपुष्पिताग्रैर्बहुभिः पादपैरन्वितः कपिः । हनुमान् पर्वताकारो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः ॥५-१-४९॥
translation: With numerous trees laden with flowers following him, Hanuman who looked like a mountain, presented a queer spectable.

raw: अजीवनार्हेण मया नृशम्सा । कृता प्रतिज्ञा नियमेन तावत् । त्वया हि बाल्यात् प्रतिपन्नमेतत् । त्न्माम् दहेद् वेणुमिवात्मपुष्पम् ॥२-३८-७॥
translation: By giving this cruel promise through importunity, I have rendered myself unfit to live. This promise was made as a child's play and it (now) destroys me like a bamboo destroyed by its own flowers.

raw: कांचनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः । आविष्टा तेजसा संध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते ॥४-४०-६३॥
translation: 'The early morning twilight appears bright red because of the glow of the golden mountain as well as of the great Sungod.

raw: चन्द्रहीनमिवाकाशम् तोयहीनमिवार्णवम् । अपश्यन्निहतानन्दम् नगरम् ते विचेतसः ॥२-४७-१८॥
translation: Plunged in grief, they saw the city deprived of all joy, looking like a sky without the Moon and an ocean without water.

raw: असमञ्जस्तु पुत्रोभूत् सगरस्येति न: श्रुतम् । जीवन्नेव स पित्रा तु निरस्त: पापकर्मकृत् ॥२-११०-२३॥
translation: We have heard that a son, Asamanja by name, was born to Sagara. For his sinful deeds he was banished by his father while he was still alive.

raw: निहतानाममात्यानां रुद्धस्य नगरस्य च । दुःखमेषो ऽपनेष्यामि हत्वा तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-१००-३॥
translation: "On killing both Rama and Lakshmana, I will relieve the sorrow of ministers killed and of Lanka from suffering.

raw: पुरस्तात् कुम्भकर्णस्य चकुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः । लिलिपुश्च परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम् ॥६-६०-३४॥
त्वाम् तु निःसंशयम् सीता दृष्ट्वा तु मृग रूपिणम् । गृह्यताम् इति भर्तारम् लक्ष्मणम् च अभिधास्यति ॥३-३६-१९॥
translation: Seeing you in the form of a deer, Sita will undoubtedly ask her husband and Lakshmana to capture you.

raw: किं तु पूर्वं गतास्म्येका महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः । पुलस्त्यस्याश्रमं दिव्यमन्वेष्टुं स्वसखीजनम् ॥७-२-२१॥
translation: However, she continued, previously she had gone alone to the divine hermitage of the great sage Pulastya, whose soul was purified, to search for her female companions.

raw: बुधस्तु पुरुषीभूतं स वै संवत्सरान्तरम् । कथाभी रमयामास धर्मयुक्ताभिरात्मवान् ॥७-८९-२५॥
translation: But the wise Budha, after a year, entertained Ila, who had become a man again, with righteous stories. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोननवतितमः सर्गः ।। 89 ।। Thus ends the eighty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तथा प्रवर्त्यताम् यज्ञो भवद्भिः च मया सह । विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा सर्व एव महर्षयः ॥१-६०-४॥
मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम् । कर्माद्यो मां हरत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते ॥५-३८-३९॥
translation: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?

raw: व्यतिवेष्टित सुस्कन्थम् अन्योन्य भ्रमर आकुलम् । आसीद् वनम् इव उद्धूतम् स्त्री वनम् रावणस्य तत् ॥५-९-६५॥
translation: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.

raw: धन्यंयशस्यमायुष्यंराज्ञां च वियावहम् आदिकाव्यमिदंचार्षंपुरावाल्मीकिनाकृतम् । पठेध्यःशृणुयाल्लोकेनरःपापात्प्रमुच्यते ॥६-१३१-१०७॥
translation: He who reads, listens to this first epic, a noble text composed by Valmiki will be blessed, attain fame, enjoy long life and victory in this world and will be rid of sins.

raw: खन्यमाने ततः तस्मिन् ददृशुः पर्वत उपमम् । दिशा गजम् विरूपाक्षम् धारयंतम् महीतलम् ॥१-४०-१३॥
translation: Then while they were excavating the region they beheld the elephant of the quarter named Virupaksha equal in size to a mountain, supporting the earth.

raw: तं पुरस्तात् स्थितं दृष्ट्वा वानरं पर्वतोपमम् । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो गदया वज्रकल्पया ॥६-७०-५६॥
translation: Again, seeing Rshaba standing in front like a mountain, enraged Mahaparsva hit him on the chest with the mace that was like a thunderbolt.

raw: तं तत्रोत्तमपर्यङ्के वरास्तरणशोभिते । उपविष्टं दशग्रीवं दूतो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥७-१३-१६॥
translation: The messenger then spoke words to Dashagriva, who was seated there on an excellent couch adorned with fine coverings.

raw: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृत आह्निकम् अरिन्दमौ । विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य नद्याः तीरम् उपागतौ ॥१-२४-१॥
translation: Thereafter the destroyers of foes, Rama and Lakshmana offering their morning oblations on that bright dawn arrived at the bank of the river (Ganga) with Viswamitra ahead of them.

raw: तस्य बुद्धिरियं जाता चिन्तयानस्य सन्ततम् । स्वयं वरं तनूजाया: करिष्यामीति धीमत: ॥२-११८-३८॥
translation: After constantly pondering over the matter, the wise king arrived at the decision to perform a swayamvara for his daughter.

raw: ततस्तयोर्महायुद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम् ॥७-२७-४४॥
translation: Then, a great and hair-raising battle occurred between those two.

raw: अस्मिन्नेवाभिसम्प्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते । विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः । दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्धूतस्तप्ताम्भ इव सागरः ॥७-२५-२९॥
translation: Let it be known to you that upon hearing Vibhishana's words, that king of demons Ravana was agitated by his own wickedness, like an ocean stirred by hot water.

raw: उत्तरोत्तरयुक्तौ च वक्ता वाचस्पतिर्यथा । सुभ्रूरायतताम्राक्ष्हस्साक्ष्हाद्विष्णुरिव स्वयम् ॥२-२-४३॥
तस्य पार्श्वेषु निच्छिद्राः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः स्थितो मूर्तश्च मुद्गरः ॥७-२२-५॥
मनस्वी तद् गतमानस्य तस्या हृदि समर्पितः । प्रिया तु सीता रामस्य दाराः पितृ कृता इति ॥१-७७-२६॥
यदि चेत्त्वं तु दर्पान्मां नाभिनन्दसि गर्विते । द्वौ मासावन्तरं सीते पास्यामि रुधिरं तव ॥५-५८-६८॥
translation: 'O Sita if in your pride, you do not respect me, I will see (drink) your blood in two months.

raw: न कालस्य अस्ति बंधुत्वम् न हेतुर् न पराक्रमः । न मित्र ज्ञाति संबन्धः कारणम् न आत्मनो वशः ॥४-२५-७॥
translation: 'Time has no consideration for relationship, friendship, or kinship or valour. Time itself is the cause. It is never under one's control.

raw: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च भण्डीरैः निचुलैः तथा । अशोकैः सप्त पर्णैः च केतकैः अतिमुक्तकैः ॥३-७५-२४॥
translation: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.

raw: यातु वानरवाहिन्या वानरः प्लवतां वरः । पालयन्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमृषभो वानरर्षभः ॥६-४-१६॥
translation: "Let the vanara called Rshaba the foremost among the leaping vanaras, take charge of the right side of the army".

raw: रामः तु अनेन वाक्येन सुप्रीतः प्रत्युवाच तम् । व्रज आपृच्चस्व सौमित्रे सर्वम् एव सुहृज् जनम् ॥२-३१-२६॥
translation: Pleased with his words Rama said, O Lakshmana go and take leave of all your friends.

raw: प्रच्छादनार्थम् भावस्य न भक्षयति संस्पृशन् । तस्मिन् एव ततः काले वैदेही शुभलोचना ॥३-४२-३०॥
translation: The demon who was interested in killing wild deer touched and felt them but did not kill or feed on them in order to hide his intention.

raw: ततस्ते प्रीतमनसः सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः । हनूमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे । परिवार्य च ते सर्वे परां प्रीतिमुपागताः ॥५-५७-३२॥
translation: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They stood motionless with extreme happiness.

raw: इत्येवंविलपन्तिसाबाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा स्नेहोपस्कन्नहृदया तदा मोहामुपागमत् ॥६-११४-८६॥
translation: Wailing in this way, eyes filled with tears, heart filled with extreme love, (Mandodari) she was in delusion.

raw: तत्र त्वम् वस हे सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह । न स्मरिष्यसि नारीणाम् मानुषीणाम् मनस्विनि ॥३-४८-१३॥
translation: O highminded princess, O Sita while living with me, you will not even think of other women.

raw: कथैषा तव तु स्नेहान्मनसा धार्यते मया । रामाभिषेकसंभारान्निगृह्य विनिवर्तय ॥२-९-१९॥
translation: O queen I did not know this indeed. Only you had related it to me earlier. Because of my affection towards you, I have retained it in my memory. (Now) prevent preparations for Rama's consecration by force.

raw: प्रहस्त राजा च महोदरश्च । त्वम् कुम्भकर्णश्च यथार्थजातम् । ब्रवीत रामम् प्रति तन्न शक्यम् । यथा गतिः स्वर्गमधर्मबुद्धेः ॥६-१४-१०॥
translation: "That which you intend to accomplish against Rama is not possible either for you or the king and even for Kumbhakarna and Mahodara, just as heaven is not obtained by the unrighteous people," said Vibheeshana.

raw: वत्स राम चिरं जीव हतास्ते परिपन्थिनः । ज्ञातीन्मे त्वं श्रियायुक्तः सुमित्रायाश्च नन्दय ॥२-४-३९॥
धर्म दोष प्रसन्गेन लोकस्य अनतिशन्कया । कथम् हि एतत् असम्भ्रान्तः त्वद् विधो वक्तुम् अर्हति ॥२-२३-६॥
translation: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehension about people's verdict (in favour of exile). How do you, of all persons, speak about destiny as allpowerful in these circumstances when it is powerless?

raw: जटायो पश्य मम आर्य ह्रियमाणम् अनाथ वत् । अनेन राक्षसेद्रेण करुणम् पाप कर्मणा ॥३-४९-३८॥
translation: O Jatayu, see me now being carried away by the sinful king of demons in this pitiable condition as though I am an orphan.

raw: वयम् वनचरा राम मृगा मूल फल अशनाः । एषा प्रकृतिर् अस्माकम् पुरुषः त्वम् नरेश्वरः ॥४-१७-३०॥
translation: 'O Rama we are mere animals wandering in the forest and living on roots and fruits. This is our nature. (But) you are a lord of men.

raw: तेषांनोविप्रनष्टानांविन्ध्येपर्वतसत्तमो । भृशंशोकानितप्तानांमहान्कालो त्यवर्तत ॥६-१२९-४१॥
translation: "Monkeys that went to the foremost of mountains Vindhya lost their way and a lot of time and returned with intense grief."

raw: दृष्ट्वा श्रेयस्करीं बुद्धिं धनाध्यक्षो भविष्यति । नाम तस्याकरोत्प्रीतः सार्धं देवर्षिभिस्तदा ॥७-३-७॥
translation: Having perceived his auspicious intention to become the lord of wealth, the pleased grandfather (Brahma), together with the divine sages, then gave him a name.

raw: निपेतुः च नराः सर्वे तेन शब्देन मोहिताः । व्रजयित्वा मुनि वरम् राजानम् तौ च राघवौ ॥१-६७-१९॥
translation: On hearing the sound, except Janaka, Viswamitra and the two raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) the rest of the people around fell down and fainted.

raw: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तां मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् । विराजमानां वपुषा शत्रुशोणितरञ्जिताम् ॥६-७०-५२॥
translation: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

raw: अमी पवन विक्षिप्ता विनन्दन्ती इव पादपाः । षट्पदैः अनुकूजद्भिः वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु ॥४-१-१८॥
translation: As if the trees are singing, swayed by the wind, while the bees in the forest, fragrant with honey, hum in tune.

raw: अयात्राम् चैव दृष्ट्वा इमाम् मार्गाम् च भृश दुर्गमान् । प्रणते चैव सुग्रीवे न मया किंचित् ईरितम् ॥४-२८-६०॥
translation: Seeing this suspension of the expedition and the very difficult roads, and since Sugriva is faithful to me, I said nothing.

raw: कस्य स्यादीदृशो भाव आहारो देवसम्मतः । आश्चर्यं वर्तते सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥७-७७-२०॥
translation: Whose nature would be such, and what kind of food is this that is approved by gods; O gentle one, this is a wonder, and I truly wish to hear about it.

raw: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि यो हन्याच्छक्रस्यापि महात्मनः । सो ऽयमुर्व्यां हतः शेते महार्हशयनोचितः ॥६-४९-२२॥
translation: "He, who could destroy Indra's arrows also deserves to be on Indra's bed, is lying on the ground, killed."

raw: ततस्तु रुधिरौघेण सिक्तं व्यपगतं रजः । शरीरशवसङ्कीर्णा बभूव च वसुन्धरा ॥६-५५-२४॥
translation: Then moistened with blood, the dust settled on the ground was seen covered with bodies and limbs.

raw: निशम्य तद्वाक्यमुपस्थितज्वरः । प्रसज्~गवानुत्तरमेत दब्रवीत् ॥६-१०-२९॥
translation: Foregoing the beneficial, meaningful, and gentle words of counsel of significance in the past, present and future also (given by Vibheeshana), Ravana seized with anger replied in this manner.

raw: तथा भुक्त्वा यथाकामं मांसं बहु सुपीवरम् । अवतीर्य सरः स्वर्गी संस्प्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ॥७-७७-१६॥
translation: After thus eating a large quantity of very plump meat to his heart's content, the celestial being descended into a lake and began to perform ablutions.

raw: तेषु लङ्कां प्रविष्टेषु राक्षसेषु महाबलाः । समेत्य हरयः सर्वे हनुमन्तमपूजयन् ॥६-५६-३५॥
translation: Those Rakshasas, endowed with prowess, on entering Lanka got together and paid respects to Hanuman.

raw: शतं शतसहस्राणां पृथगृक्षवनौकसाम् । लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धुं समन्ततः ॥६-४१-५०॥
translation: A hundred thousand bars and monkeys and several others already gathered at the gates of Lanka to fight proceeded.

raw: सीतामदृष्ट्वा ह्यनवाप्य पौरुषं विहृत्य कालं सह वानरैश्चिरम् । न मेऽस्ति सुग्रीवसमीपगा गतिः सुतीक्ष्णदण्डो बलवांश्च वानरः ॥५-१२-५॥
translation: 'I have spent a long time with vanaras. I have not succeded in my efforts to find Sita. I dare not see Sugriva now without finding Sita and without fulfilling my task. Sugriva will punish me severely. There is no way out.'

raw: फलमूलाशनैर्दान्तैर्जितदोषैर्जितेन्द्रियैः - यद्वा -फल मूल अशनैः दान्तैः जित दोषैः जित इन्द्रियैः । ऋषिभिः वालखिल्यैः च जप होम परायणैः ॥१-५१-२७॥
अगस्त्येन अन्तरे तत्र सागरे विनिवेशितः । चित्र सानु नगः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पर्वतोत्तमः ॥४-४१-२०॥
translation: 'Then on reaching the sea shore, decide the course of action. Sage Agastya has set up (between the moat of the city and and the sea) a glorious golden mountain Mahendra. Filled with colourful trees, it stretches into the sea.

raw: हुताग्निरर्चिःसम्काशामेनाम् सौरीमिव प्रभाम् । उन्नसम् विमलम् वल्गु वदनम् चारुलोचनम् ॥६-१२-१६॥
translation: "On beholding the sacrificial firelike face of Sita glowing like the radiance of the Sun, seeing her prominent nose, her large attractive countenance with beautiful eyes surely, I am overtaken by love and have become a slave to her."

raw: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः । देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा ॥७-१०६-१६॥
translation: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.

raw: स च्छिन्नो नैकाधा शूलो दिव्यहाटकमण्डितः । व्यशीर्यत महोल्केव रामबाणार्दितो भुवि ॥६-७९-३४॥
translation: That pike, which was decorated with gold, broke into pieces, and fell down like fire sticks by the many supreme arrows of Rama.

raw: लब्ध्वा पुनस्त्वं वैदेहीं किमर्थं सम्प्रजल्पसि । यदीच्छसि तदा सीता वशगा ते भविष्यति ॥६-६४-२०॥
translation: "Having got Vaidehi, why are you talking like that? Sita will submit to you if you desire."

raw: सर्वौषधीभिर्गन्धैश्च समालभ्य महाबलाः । निर्जग्मुर्नैर्ऋतश्रेष्ठाः षडेते युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ॥६-६९-१८॥
translation: The six leaders endowed with great strength, anointing themselves with fragrance, which can ward off injury went to fight.

raw: विधनुस्तु कृतस्तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः । प्रगृह्य मुसलं घोरं स्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे ॥६-५८-४५॥
translation: Deprived of bow and chariot, Prahastha, the CommanderinChief seizing a terrific mallet jumped down from the chariot.

raw: तं तोरणविटङ्कस्थं हनुमन्तं महाकिपम् । जम्बुमाली महाबाहुर्विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ॥५-४४-६॥
translation: Strongarmed Jambumali with his sharp arrows hit great Hanuman who stood on top of the exit archway.

raw: इमं श्रुत्वा तु वृत्तान्तं त्वरमाणो ऽहमागतः । सहसा युवयोः स्नेहात् सखित्वमनुपालयन् ॥६-५०-५१॥
translation: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."

raw: श्रुत्वा तु राजा कैकेय्या वृतम् परमशोभनम् । रामस्य च वने वासमैश्वर्यम् भरतस्य च ॥२-१२-५१॥
translation: Having heard of the highly unfair demands by Kaikeyi for Rama's exile to the forest and Bharata's prosperity (enthronement), the king was dumbstruck for a while with his senses agitated. He did not speak to Kaikeyi.

raw: नभःस्थाने दुन्दुभयो देवानां प्राणदंस्तदा । वाक्यं चैवान्तरिक्षे च साधु साध्विति तत्तदा ॥७-९-३६॥
translation: Then, drums of the gods sounded in the sky, and a voice from the heavens exclaimed, "Excellent! Excellent!"

raw: न न्व् अहम् ते प्रियः पुत्र मातरम् पश्य धार्मिक । किम् नु न आलिन्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद ॥२-६४-३१॥
तत्राम्बरादग्निरतिप्रवृद्धो रूक्षप्रभः किंशुकपुष्पचूडः । निर्वाणधूमाकुलराजयश्च नीलोत्पलाभाः प्रचकाशिरे ऽभ्राः ॥५-५४-३५॥
translation: The dazzling flames of fire red like kimsuka flowers shot up violently into the sky. The clouds engulfed by the smoke rising from the subsiding fire was shining like the lustre of blue lotuses .

raw: भर्तुः प्रिय अर्थम् कुल रक्षण अर्थम् । भर्तुः च वम्शस्य परिग्रह अर्थम् । अहेडमानाः त्वरया स्म दूता । रात्र्याम् तु ते तत् पुरम् एव याताः ॥२-६८-२२॥
translation: To please their master (sage Vasistha) and to preserve the royal dynasty and also to protect the honour of the (race and people), the messengers soon reached their destination by night without any negligence of their duty. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे त्रस्ता: शब्देन महता तत: । अर्दिता यूथपा मत्ता: सयूथा दुद्रुवुर्दिश: ॥२-९६-४॥
translation: Meanwhile, the mighty leaders of the elephantherds were agitated, and frightened by the loud noise, fled away from there in different directions.

raw: अनुज्ञातः सुमन्त्रः अथ योजयित्वा हय उत्तमान् । अयोध्याम् एव नगरीम् प्रययौ गाढ दुर्मनाः ॥२-५७-३॥
translation: Permitted by Rama to leave, Sumantra harnessed the best of horses and set out for the city of Ayodhya with a heavy heart.

raw: मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र कालस्य गतिरीदृशी । त्वद्विधा न हि शोचन्ति बुद्धिमन्तो मनस्विनः ॥७-५२-१०॥
translation: O tiger among men, do not grieve, for such is the course of time, and intelligent, high-minded individuals like you certainly do not lament.

raw: कृत उद्वाहे गते तस्मिन् ब्रह्मदत्ते च राघव । अपुत्रः पुत्र लाभाय पौत्रीम् इष्टिम् अकल्पयत् ॥१-३४-१॥
translation: "O son of Raghu's dynasty (Rama) Brahmadatta got married and left for his kingdom. Now a putreshti was performed by king Kusanabha in order to beget a son.

raw: रक्तोत्पल वनैः च अत्र मण्डिताः च हिरण्मयैः । तरुण आदित्य संकाशा भान्ति तत्र जलाशयाः ॥४-४३-४०॥
अथ उपकार्याम् जग्मुः ते स दारा रघुनंदनाः । राजा अपि अनुययौ पश्यन् स ऋषि संघः स बान्धवः ॥१-७३-४०॥
तत् तथा इति अब्रवीत् रामः सुग्रीवम् प्रिय दर्शनम् । लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रतः लक्ष्म्या वासवस्य इव धीमतः ॥४-८-१०॥
translation: As wise Lakshmana, brilliant like Indra stood witness, Rama said, 'it is true as you say' to Sugriva who spoke pleasing words.

raw: मरणानान्तिवैराणिनिर्वृत्तंनःप्रयोजनम् क्रियतामस्यसंस्कारोममाप्येषयथातव ॥६-११४-१००॥
translation: "There is no hostility after death for heroes. Let us perform his obsequies. I am also like that in this regard.

raw: प्रवेश्यमानम् सत्कृत्य नरेन्द्रेण इन्द्र कर्मणा । यथा दिवि सुरेन्द्रेण सहस्राक्षेण काश्यपम् ॥१-११-२८॥
रामस्य तु विशालाक्षी पूर्णेन्दु सदृश आनना । धर्म पत्नी प्रिया नित्यम् भर्तृः प्रिय हिते रता ॥३-३४-१५॥
translation: Rama's beloved consort is a largeeyed lady. Her face is like the full moon. She is engaged in the wellbeing of her husband.

raw: स तान् प्रवृद्धान् विनिहत्य राक्षसान् महाबलश्चण्डपराक्रमः कपिः । युयुत्सुरन्यैः पुनरेव राक्षसैस्तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणम् ॥५-४५-१७॥
translation: Having killed the ogres who were old and strong, the valiant and mighty Hanuman, wishing to slay the other ogres advanced towards the archway. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः । प्रेषितो न्यपतद्यक्षो नाम्ना संयोधकण्टकः ॥७-१४-२१॥
translation: O Rama, at that very moment, a Yaksha named Samyodhakantaka, sent with a vast army and chariots, attacked.

raw: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदन्तरिक्षात्सुभास्वरा । दिव्यदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः । यद्वा -पुष्प वृष्टिः महति आसीत् अंतरिक्षात् सु भास्वरा । दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषैः गीत वादित्र निःस्वनैः ॥१-७३-३७॥
लङ्काद्वीपस्यगोप्तारंकर्तारंभीमकर्मणाम् अस्माकंकामभोगानांदातारंरथिनांवरम् ॥६-११४-५४॥
translation: "In the island of Lanka, he provided for his own sexual pleasures in a concealing manner. He was the foremost among those providers of sensual pleasures."

raw: बहवः पार्थिवा राजन्नतिक्रान्ता महाबलाः । कार्यस्य गौरवं मत्वा प्रतिज्ञां नाभ्यरोचयन् ॥७-६०-१७॥
translation: Many powerful kings who came before you, O King, considered the gravity of this task and did not undertake the vow.

raw: अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय रामस्य सुरसत्तमाः । सीतायाः शपथे तस्मिन् महेन्द्राद्या महौजसः ॥७-९७-६॥
translation: Having understood Rama's intention regarding Sita's oath, the greatly powerful best among gods, led by Mahendra (Indra), prepared to act.

raw: एवं तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य राक्षसाः । नादं चक्रुर्महाघोरं कम्पयन्त इवार्णवम् ॥६-६५-४७॥
translation: When Kumbhakarna had spoken that way the Rakshasas made noise that was like the sound of an agitated ocean.

raw: वैनतेयसमाः केचित् केचित्तत्रानिलोपमाः । असङ्गगतयः शीघ्रा हरिवीरा महाबलाः ॥५-५१-१४॥
translation: "Some of the very powerful heroes equal to Garuda, equal to the Windgod (in swiftness) have gone (in quest of Sita) without touching the earth.

raw: बहूनि रक्षसाम् वासे वर्षाणि वसता सुखम् । अनेन दण्डकारण्ये विशीर्णम् इह पक्षिणा ॥३-६८-२०॥
translation: Dwelling for many years happily in Dandaka forest, the abode of demons, the bird lost his life (on our account).

raw: पितरम् देव संकाशम् पूजयामासतुः तदा । पितुः आज्ञाम् पुरस्कृत्य पौर कार्याणि सर्वशः ॥१-७७-२१॥
शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः । पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धो ऽहं कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया ॥६-१०६-६॥
translation: "While my adversary's valour is widely known, you brought me back like a timid one, while I love war, while I am to be praised in the presence of my enemy."

raw: अन्तर्हितैश्चापि तथान्तरिक्षे । ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव सुरर्षिभिश्च । शब्दः कृतः कष्टमिति ब्रुवद्भि । र्मा मेति चोक्त्वा महता स्वरेण ॥६-२१-३५॥
समुद्रम् अवगाढान् च पर्वतान् पत्तनानि च । मंदरस्य च ये कोटिम् संश्रिताः केचित् आलयाः ॥४-४०-२५॥
translation: 'There are people who have taken shelter in the deep pits in the midst of the sea, in deep valleys, mountains, cities and broad peaks of Mandara mountain and forests.All those regions should be thoroughly searched. There are innumerable inhabitants,such as strong cannibals, some who cover their ears, some who have ears extended up to the lips, some with dreadful metallic faces, some swiftmoving, onefooted indestructible beings. There are Kirata tribes of golden complexion and handsome looks whose tuft of hair is set to the sides so that it touches their ears. These Kiratas are Islanddwellers and they eat uncooked fish.They move in waters and are fierce, known as tigerlike men (Naravyagras because half of their body is human and other half is tiger in form). All the shelters of these forestdwellers should be searched well.Those who can be sent by crossing mountains, those who can leap (in air) and those who can swim through waters may be also dispatched.

raw: तथा अपि सूतेन सुयुक्त वादिना । निवार्यमाणा सुत शोक कर्शिता । न चैव देवी विरराम कूजितात् । प्रिय इति पुत्र इति च राघव इति च ॥२-६०-२३॥
translation: Though Sumantra was speaking with befitting words to prevent Kausalya from weeping over her son which had enfeebled her, she did not stop crying, 'O my beloved', 'O my son', 'O Rama'. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे लक्ष्मण च यथा सुखम् । आहरिष्यामि वैदेहीम् सहस्राक्षः शचीम् इव ॥३-४०-२२॥
translation: When Rama and Lakshmana are away I will comfortably abduct Vaidehi like the thousandeyed Indra brought Sachi.

raw: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ । त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ॥५-६८-२४॥
translation: 'O noble lady the lions among men, Rama and Lakshmana who resemble Sun and Moon will ascend on my back and reach here.

raw: कच्चित् सुमित्रा धर्मज्ञा जननी लक्ष्मणस्य या । शत्रुघ्नस्य च वीरस्य सारोगा च अपि मध्यमा ॥२-७०-९॥
translation: I hope my mother Sumitra (the middle one) who is familiar with the ways of righteousness, the mother of valiant Lakshmana and Satrughna, is enjoying good health.

raw: उवाच मा वधिस्टेति घ्नतः शाखामृगर्षभान् । स च पत्रलघुद्भूत्वा हरिभिर्दर्शितेऽभये ॥६-२०-२०॥
काचिदङ्के शिरः कृत्वा रुरोद मुखमीक्षती । स्नापयन्ती मुखं बाष्पैस्तुषारैरिव पङ्कजम् ॥६-११३-१०॥
translation: One held his head on her lap, and one held his face and looking at it shed tears, like nature covers lotus with dew and roared.

raw: आकाराः तान् अहम् सर्वान् इह पश्यामि सारथे । सम्मार्जनविहीनानि परुषाण्युपलक्षये ॥२-७१-३७॥
प्रहृष्टा मुदिता लंका मत्त द्विप समाकुला । महती रथ सम्पूर्णा रक्षो गण समाकुला ॥६-३-१०॥
translation: "The people in the vast island of Lanka are very delighted. Lanka is filled with chariots and innumerable rakshasas."

raw: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य धर्मचारी महारथः । पूजनीयः च मान्यः च भवान् प्राप्तः प्रिय अतिथिः ॥३-१२-३०॥
translation: You are king of all the worlds, a follower of dharma, a great warrior worthy of worship and an esteemed self. O Rama you are such a dear guest come to me.

raw: काम रूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाणि अनेकशः । अन्तर्धानम् गता यक्षी मोहयन्ति स्व मायया ॥१-२६-१९॥
translation: Capable of assuming forms at will, that yakshini intending to delude the princes through her power of magic, vanished from the sight. She then assumed various forms and released a rain of rocks. And started moving about frightfully.

raw: स स्ववेश्माभ्यतिक्रम्य नरनागश्वसम्वृतम् । प्रपेदे सुमहच्छ्रीमान् राजमार्गमनुत्तमम् ॥२-७०-२६॥
translation: Prosperous Bharata on leaving his residence, passed through incomparable royal highway thronged with men, elephants and horses.

raw: तथैव रामः अश्रु मुखः कृत अन्जलिः । स्थितः अभवल् लक्ष्मण बाहु पालितः स्थितः । तथैव सीता रुदती तपस्विनी । निरीक्षते राज रथम् तथैव माम् ॥२-५८-३७॥
translation: Supported by Lakshmana's arms, Rama stood, his face streaming with tears and palms folded, while the wretched Sita, glaring at me and the royal chariot, weeping. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: किं तु मां विद्धि ब्रह्मर्षे शासनात्पितुरागताम् । कैकसी नाम नाम्नाहं शेषं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥७-९-१९॥
translation: "But know me, O Brahmarshi, as one who has come by the command of my father; I am named Kaikasi by name, and you are capable of knowing the rest."

raw: महाब्रह्मर्षिसृष्टा वा ज्वलन्तो भीमदर्शना । धिग्वाग्दण्डणा न हिम्सन्ति रामप्रव्राजने स्थिताम् ॥२-३५-१५॥
translation: It is a wonder that while bent upon banishing Rama, you are not destroyed by frightening fire created by great brahmarsis, crying, 'Shame, shame'

raw: इत्युक्त्वा स तदा राम मुपवासं यतव्रतम् । मन्त्रवत् कारयामास वैदेह्या सहितं मुनिः ॥२-५-११॥
translation: The ascetic (Vasistha) having thus spoken to Rama made him undertake fast along with Sita in accompaniment with sacred hymns.

raw: हतानां स्तनमानानां राक्षसानां च निस्वनः । शस्तानां वानराणां च सम्बभूवातिदारुणः ॥६-४४-१३॥
translation: There from the battlefield arose the roaring sounds of wounded and appeased Rakshasas and Vanaras.

raw: अपश्यम्स् तु ततः तत्र पितरम् पितुर् आलये । जगाम भरतः द्रष्टुम् मातरम् मातुर् आलये ॥२-७२-१॥
translation: Not finding his father in his abode, Bharata went to see his mother in her apartment.

raw: राजर्षीणाम् हि लोकेऽस्मिन् रत्यर्थम् मृगया वने । काले कृताम् ताम् मनुजैर्धन्विनामभिकाङ्क्षिताम् ॥२-४९-१७॥
translation: In this world, hunting in the woods is a pleasure for royal sages and is greatly sought after by bowmen. This was later resorted to by others.

raw: रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः । रामाभिषेके संप्रप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च ॥२-६-१५॥
translation: As the time for Rama's coronation was approaching, men in public squares and in private houses talked with one another about the consecration of Rama.

raw: आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल । सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा ॥२-२९-१०॥
translation: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.

raw: अभीक्ष्णं निश्वसन्तौ तौ युद्ध्येतां तुमुलं युधि । शरसङ्कृत्तसर्वाङ्गौ सर्वतो रुधिरोक्षितौ ॥६-८९-२२॥
translation: Wounded all over the body in war and bathed in blood, breathing heavily again and again both of them fought vehemently.

raw: यावत्तव कथा लोके विचरिष्यति पावनी । तावत्स्थास्यामि मेदिन्यां तवाज्ञामनुपालयन् ॥७-१०८-३६॥
translation: As long as your purifying story spreads throughout the world, I shall remain on earth, obeying your command.

raw: सूत मद्वचनात् तस्य तातस्य विदित आत्मनः । शिरसा वन्दनीयस्य वन्द्यौ पादौ महात्मनः ॥२-५८-१५॥
translation: 'Convey on my behalf, O charioteer to my illustrious father who is known for his selfknowledge, and is worthy of homage, that I am saluting his feet with my head bowed.

raw: तलप्रहारं तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम् । नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरस्यताडयत् ॥६-९७-२८॥
translation: Virupaksha, escaping the slap of Sugriva with great skill, hit him (Sugriva) on the chest with his fist.

raw: भगवन्नीदृशान्पुत्रांस्त्वत्तो ऽहं ब्रह्मवादिनः । नेच्छामि सुदुराचारान्प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥७-९-२४॥
translation: O venerable one, O speaker of Brahman, I do not desire such extremely ill-behaved sons from you; please show me your grace.

raw: यत्तदा दण्डकारण्ये पितरं हतवान् मम । मदग्रतः स्वकर्मस्थं दृष्ट्वा रोषो ऽभिवर्धते ॥६-७९-११॥
translation: "Then in Dandakaranya my father was killed. Now for the samereason you are in front of me. Seeing you my anger is increasing."

raw: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शूरमानी खरात्मजः । बाढमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टो मकाराक्षो निशाचरः ॥६-७८-४॥
translation: Rejoicing to hear the words of Ravana, proclaiming himself to be a hero, Maka raksha, the son of Khara said 'good'.

raw: अथो पुनः इदम् वाक्यम् प्राजापत्यो नरोऽब्रवीत् । राजन् अर्चयता देवान् अद्य प्राप्तम् इदम् त्वया ॥१-१६-१८॥
translation: Thereafter the one who came from Prajapati answered, "O King you have obtained this payasam today in return for the worship offered to the devatas".

raw: एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा वदति राघवः । तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियाः ॥७-९५-९॥
translation: Let it be so, good fortune to you, as Rama speaks, so will Sita do, for indeed, a husband is the deity of a woman.

raw: प्रस्वापनम् प्रशमनम् दद्मि सौम्यम् च राघव । वर्षणम् शोषणम् चैव संतापन विलापने ॥१-२७-१५॥
अथ दृष्ट्वा दधिमुखं क्रुद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः । अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन हनुमत्प्रमुखास्तदा ॥५-६२-२५॥
