translation: Having seen the fury of Dadhimukha, Hanuman the leader of the vanaras went to him swiftly.

raw: ततः कदाचित् तम् देशम् आजगाम यदृच्छया । विभाण्डक सुतः तत्र ताः च अपश्यत् वरांगनाः ॥१-१०-१०॥
translation: One day this son of Vibhandaka (Rsyasringa) accidentally came to the place where he saw the beautiful women.

raw: असिचर्मधरा योधाः सर्वायुधधरास्ततः । राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥६-११-५॥
translation: Then soldiers wielding swords and different kinds of weapons stood in front of the Lord of Rakshasas.

raw: अथ पुत्रः पुलस्त्यस्य विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । अचिरेणैव कालेन पितेव तपसि स्थितः ॥७-३-१॥
translation: Then, Vishrava, the son of Pulastya and foremost among sages, soon became engaged in penance just like his father.

raw: स ते मोक्षयिता राजंस्तस्माच्छापाद्भविष्यसि । कृता च तेन कालेन निष्कृतिस्ते भविष्यति ॥७-५३-२१॥
translation: O King, he will be your liberator from that curse, and by him, your expiation will be accomplished in due course.

raw: यदुक्तमिह ते पूर्वं क्रियतामनुजेन च । तदेव नो हितं कार्यं यदिच्छसि च तत् कुरु ॥६-६३-२१॥
translation: "The advice given to you in the past by your brother alone is good. That is good for you. Or you may do what you wish."

raw: इतो द्रक्ष्यामि वैदेहीं रामदर्शनलालसाम् । इतश्चेतश्च दुःखार्तां सम्पतन्तीं यदृच्छया ॥५-१४-४२॥
translation: "I may see by chance( from this point) Vaidehi tormented with grief anxiously waiting to see Rama while moving about here and there casually.

raw: त्वं हि देववरिष्ठस्य मारुतस्य महात्मनः । पुत्रस्तस्यैव वेगेन सदृशः कपिकुञ्जर ॥५-१-१२१॥
translation: "O foremost among the vanaras you are the son of the highsouled Windgod's, preeminent among the gods, you are also equal to him in speed.

raw: यां वृत्तिं वर्त्तते तातो यां च न: प्रपितामहा: । तां वृत्तिं वर्त्तसे कच्चिद्या च सत्पथगा शुभा ॥२-१००-७५॥
translation: I trust, you walk the auspicious path of truth (virtue) followed by our father and forefathers.

raw: तत् आगच्छ महाबाहो चारित्रम् रक्षितम् त्वया । अच्छलम् मित्र भावेन सताम् दरा अवलोकनम् ॥४-३३-६१॥
translation: 'O longarmed one come in. You have been standing out guarding your character. It is not a mistake to see the wife of a pious person with a friendly feeling.

raw: तथा तु विलपन्तीम् ताम् कौसल्याम् राम मातरम् । उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनः तत् काल सदृशम् वचः ॥२-२१-१॥
translation: While Rama's mother, Kausalya was lamenting, miserable Lakshmana said to her these words appropriate to the occasion:

raw: एतान् राम महाबाहो काम रूपान् महाबलान् । गृहाण परमोदारान् क्षिप्रम् एव नृपात्मज ॥१-२७-२१॥
translation: O Rama mightyarmed prince, receive these mighty and highly exalted astras capable of assuming at once any form at will".

raw: रुद्धा चान्तःपुरे गुप्ता त्वच्चित्ता त्वत्परायणा । रक्षिता राक्षसीसङ्घैर्विकृतैर्घोरदर्शनैः ॥६-१२१-९॥
translation: "She was separated from you yet fully absorbed in you. She was kept in the gynaeceum secretly and guarded by frightful and ruthless Rakshasa women."

raw: विसञ्ज्ञं रावणं दृष्ट्वा समरे भीमविक्रमम् । ऋषयो वानराः सर्वे नेदुर्देवाः सवासवाः ॥६-५९-११७॥
translation: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.

raw: एष सेतुम् महाउत्साहः करोतु मयि वानरः । तम् अहम् धारयिष्यामि तथा हि एष यथा पिता ॥६-२२-४५॥
translation: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."

raw: जीवितम् च सुखम् चैव राज्यम् चैव सुदुर्लभम् । यत् इच्छसि चिरम् भोक्तुम् मा कृथा राम विप्रियम् ॥३-३७-२२॥
translation: If you want to enjoy your life, happiness and even the kingdom which is not easily attainable for long, do not incur the displeasure of Rama.

raw: एवम् दत्त्वा प्रहृष्टो अभूत् श्रीमान् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दन । ऋत्विजः तु अब्रुवन् सर्वे राजानम् गत किल्बिषम् ॥१-१४-४६॥
स्वशरीरं त्वया पुष्टं कुर्वता तप उत्तमम् । अनुप्तं रोहते श्वेत न कदाचिन्महामते ॥७-७८-१५॥
translation: O great-minded and white one, your body, which you nourished through excellent penance, will not grow back once consumed, just as something unsown never sprouts.

raw: रूपेण अप्रतिमा लोके वरा विद्या धर स्त्रियः । दृटा हनूमता तत्र न तु राघव नन्दिनी ॥५-१२-२०॥
translation: Hanuman could see even the women of vidyadharas who were matchless in beauty among women in the world but not Janaki the beloved of Raghava.

raw: ते तु शोणितदिग्धाङ्गाः सर्वशस्त्रसमाहताः । अमात्या राक्षसेन्द्रस्य चक्रुरायोधनं महत् ॥७-२१-३१॥
translation: Though their limbs were smeared with blood and they were struck by all sorts of weapons, those ministers of the Rakshasa king waged a great battle.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ॥ ९६ ॥६-९६-४७॥
तं भीमवेगा हरयो नाराचैः क्षतविग्रहाः । अन्धकारे न ददृशुर्मेघैः सूर्यमिवावृतम् ॥६-४५-६॥
translation: The Vanaras were mangled with iron arrows, however endowed with high speed they could not make out Indrajith in utter darkness just as the sun covered by clouds.

raw: यत्तुवीर्यबलोत्साहैस्तोषितोऽहंरणेत्वया । राममेवैकमिच्छामिहन्तुंयस्मिन् हतेहतम् ॥६-६७-१११॥
translation: "I am gratified by your valour, strength and enthusiasm which has been exhibited by you in the battle. However, I wish to kill Rama alone."

raw: एवं राम समुद्भूतो रावणो लोककण्टकः । सपुत्रो येन सङ्ग्रामे जितः शक्रः सुरेश्वरः ॥७-३०-५५॥
translation: O Rama, thus was born Ravana, a tormentor of the world, by whom, along with his son, Shakra, the lord of gods, was conquered in battle. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 30 ।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: गन्धर्व राज प्रतिमौ पार्थिव व्यन्जन अन्वितौ । देवौ वा दानवौ - मानुषौ - वा तौ न तर्कयितुम् उत्सहे ॥३-१९-१६॥
translation: They are kings of the gandharvas with all royal insignia. I was not able to discern whether they are gods or humans.

raw: निर्गच्छति महाबाहौ रामे पौरजनाश्रुभिः । पतितैरभ्यवहितम् प्रशशाम महीरजः ॥२-४०-३३॥
translation: As the mightyarmed Rama was going away, the dust raised from the earth subsided with the tears falling from the citizens' (eyes).

raw: पुनरुत्पत्य वेगेन तस्थुर्लक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः । स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्मथितसारथेः । शरवर्षेण सौमित्रिमभ्यधावत रावणिः ॥६-९०-५३॥
translation: Charioteer dead, horses killed that Indrajith leapt down and assailed Lakshmana by raining arrows.

raw: आर्यपुत्र अभिरामो असौ मृगो हरति मे मनः । आनय एनम् महाबाहो क्रीडार्थम् नः भविष्यति ॥३-४३-१०॥
translation: O prince O longarmed one, this deer has captivated my mind. Fetch him for me.This will be our playmate.

raw: प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने । पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्त्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे ॥६-११९-३२॥
translation: All the women who stood there fled, screaming on seeing Sita falling into fire, like the flow of ghee poured continuously into sacrificial fire reciting sacred verses by priests.

raw: स पुनः तु अपरान् सप्त शरान् आदाय वर्मणि । निजघान रणे क्रुद्धः शक्र अशनि सम प्रभान् ॥३-२८-१६॥
translation: The influriated Khara this time took up seven arrows blazing like Indra's thunderbolt and hit his armour.

raw: तेषाम् अपि विशेषेण पूजा कार्या यथा क्रमम् । ये स्युः संपूजिता सर्वे वसुभिः भोजनेन च ॥१-१३-१६॥
translation: The people deeply immersed in performing sacrificerelated activities and sculptors be specially honoured according to their nature of work. All of them should be satisfied with money and food.

raw: प्रजापतिस्तुं तां प्राप्तां प्राह वाक्यं सरस्वतीम् । वाणि त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भव या देवतेप्सिता ॥७-१०-४३॥
translation: The lord of creation then spoke these words to Saraswati, who had arrived: "O Saraswati, you become the desired deity of the king of demons."

raw: इत्युक्त्वा सहसोत्पत्य प्लुप्लुवे तस्य चोपरि । आकृष्य मुकुटं चित्रं पातयामास तद्भुवि ॥६-४०-११॥
translation: Having spoken thus, Sugriva got up speedily and flew to the top of the tower (here Ravana was located) held the diadem and pushed it on the ground.

raw: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसीगणः । नानाप्रहरणो घोरः समेयादन्तकोपमः ॥५-३०-२२॥
translation: "If Sita screams, the horde of terrific ogresses will at once gather, armed with dreadful weapons like Yama, the god of death.

raw: अद्य अपि इदम् वनम् दुर्गम् विचिन्वन्तु वन ओकसः । खेदम् त्यक्त्वा पुनः सर्वम् वनम् एतत् विचिन्वताम् ॥४-४९-७॥
translation: 'Search this impenetrable forest even now, O you denizens of this forest Give up grief, let us all once again ransack this forest.

raw: अपि त्वाम् ईश्वरम् प्राप्य काम वृत्तम् निरंकुशम् । न विनश्येत् पुरी लंका त्वया सह स राक्षसा ॥३-३७-६॥
translation: I hope the city of Lanka along with the (entire) race of demons will not be destroyed, with a dictator like you who is a slave to sensual pleasure.

raw: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः प्रजापतिः । शतक्रतो किमु पुरा करोति स्म सुदुष्कृतम् ॥७-३०-२०॥
translation: Indeed, having seen him in such a state, the god Prajapati (Brahma) asked, 'O Shatakratu, what great evil deed did you commit formerly?'

raw: ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः विकर्णिभिः । भीमम् आर्त स्वरम् चक्रुः छिद्यमाना निशाचराः ॥३-२५-२५॥
translation: The bodies of the demons torn into pieces by the very sharp iron arrows and by the arrows called vikarni, they cried and shouted aloud in pitiable voices.

raw: मन्थरा तु वचः श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या मधुराक्षरम् । उवाच क्रोधसंयुक्ता वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा ॥२-७-१८॥
translation: Hearing the words of Kaikeyi uttered in a gentle voice, wrathful Manthara skilled in speech, said:

raw: अधर्ममूलं बहुरोषयुक्तमनार्यजुष्टं वचनं निशम्य । उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थतत्त्वं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः ॥५-५२-१२॥
translation: On hearing his brother's harsh words spoken in tremendous anger, which were not acceptable to noble souls, wise Vibhishana again spoke these words of supreme truth:

raw: गजो गव अक्षो कुमुदो नलो अथ पनसस् तथा । अमित्र विषयम् प्राप्ताः समवेताः समर्थयन् ॥६-३७-३॥
translation: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.

raw: कथम् प्रकृति सम्पन्ना राज पुत्री तथा अगुणा । ब्रूयात् सा प्राकृता इव स्त्री मत् पीडाम् भर्तृ सम्निधौ ॥२-२२-१९॥
translation: If destiny is not the cause behind this, how could Kaikeyi who is gifted with virtues and a noble nature speak such painful words to me before her husband, like an ordinary woman?

raw: स सागरमनाधृष्यमभ्येत्य वरुणालयम् । जगामाकाशमाविश्य वेगेन गरुडोपमः ॥५-१-१७३॥
translation: Rising above the invincible ocean, the abode of lord Varuna, Hanuman coursed through the sky speedily like Garuda.

raw: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च । यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-४८-२४॥
translation: "O Devi! Rama and Lakshmana are alive. I see great reasons for this."

raw: अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेन एव कर्मणा । आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्त श्रम अपहः ॥३-११-७९॥
translation: Here is the hermitage of Agastya, wellknown in the world for his deeds a place of rest for those tired with hard work.

raw: स तेन सह संयुक्तः पावकेन अनिलो यथा । श्रीमान् राज वरः तेन जनस्थानम् निपातितम् ॥३-३१-१७॥
translation: Rama is prosperous. He is the best among kings. Lakshmana with him is like wind with fire. Rama has pulled down Janasthana.

raw: अब्रवीत् च हनूमंतम् विक्रंतम् अनिल आत्मजम् । सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः प्रभुः सर्व वन ओकसाम् ॥४-४४-२॥
translation: Sugriva, king of the monkeys, spoke, highly pleased, to Hanuman, the warrior son of the Windgod advancing towards him:

raw: न शेकुर्धावितुं वीरा न स्थातुं स्पन्दितुं भयात् । उत्पतन्तं स्थितं यान्तं सर्वान् विव्याध वीर्यवान् ॥६-६९-७७॥
translation: The gallant monkeys got terrified and could not flee, nor stand, nor move. The audacious Naranthaka marching ahead pierced the Vanaras either marching or jumping or stationary.

raw: दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः । सम्घातमिव शोकानाम् दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोथिताम् ॥५-१७-२९॥
translation: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.

raw: उभावपि सुविक्रान्तौ सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदौ । उभौ परमदुर्जेयावतुल्यबलतेजसौ ॥६-८८-३५॥
गन्गा यमुनयोह् पुण्यात् सम्गमात् आहृतम् जलम् । अयं पृच्छामि वचनात् सुखमायुष्मतामहम् ॥२-१५-१८॥
क्व च यक्षार्जवं युद्धं क्व च मायाबलाश्रयम् । रक्षसां पुरुषव्याघ्र तेन ते ऽभ्यधिका युधि ॥७-१५-९॥
translation: O tiger among men, how can the straightforward battle of the Yakshas compare with the Rakshasas' reliance on magical power, which is why the Rakshasas are superior in war.

raw: शक्र बाणासन प्रख्यम् धनुः कालांतक उपमः । प्रगृह्य गिरि शृंगाभम् मन्दरः सानुमान् इव ॥४-३१-११॥
translation: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

raw: न वासवेनापि सहस्रचक्षुषा । युधास्मि शक्यो वरुणेन वा पुनः । मया त्वियम् बाहुबलेन निर्जिता । पुरा पुरी वैश्रवणेन पालिता ॥६-१३-२१॥
translation: "Even for the thousand eyed Indra or Lord Varuna it is not possible to withstand me in combat. In the past I have won this city ruled by Kubera with huge strength." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the thirteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: पुत्रः केकय राजस्य साक्षात् भरत मातुलः । दृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा च कुशलम् राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७३-२॥
translation: Yudhajit, son of king Kekaya, Bharata's own maternal uncle met the king (Dasaratha) and enquiring about his wellbeing said:

raw: स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः । राक्षसानामभावाय भर्तुरस्या भवाय च ॥५-२७-६॥
translation: "Tonight I had a terrific, horriplating nightmare in which I saw the annihilation of all demons and the triumph of Sita's husband".

raw: ऋषीम् च तान् यथा न्यायम् महाभाग उवाच ह । ते सर्वे हृष्ट मनसः तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम् ॥१-१८-४८॥
याम् ओषधिम् इव आयुष्मन् अन्वेषसि महा वने । सा देवी मम च प्राणा रावणेन उभयम् हृतम् ॥३-६७-१५॥
translation: O Longlived one she who you are searching in the forest like herbal medicine has been carried away by Ravana along with my life.

raw: अथ पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मैथिलीम् अनुचिन्तयन् । उवाच लक्ष्मणम् रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता ॥४-३०-२०॥
translation: Then falling back on the memory of Maithili, the lady with eyes like lotus petals, he said to Lakshmana with parched lips:

raw: न अमृष्ट भोजी न अदाता न अपि अनङ्दनिष्कधृक् । न अहस्ताभरणो वा अपि दृश्यते न अपि अनात्मवान् ॥१-६-११॥
translation: (In the city of Ayodhya) there was no one who did not eat food to full satisfaction and was not charitable. None was found without wearing ornaments on the hands and bracelets on the upper arms and around the neck. Also no one could be seen who had not restrained his passions and emotions.

raw: सर्पाः पंचानना भूत्वा भक्षयन्ति स्म राक्षसान् । येन येन च गच्छन्ति राक्षसा भय कर्शिताः ॥३-३१-१९॥
कपीनां किल लाङ्गूलमिष्टं भवति भूषणम् । तदस्य दीप्यतां शीघ्रं तेन दग्धेन गच्छतु ॥५-५३-३॥
translation: "The tail is dear to the monkeys and it is an ornament for them. Set fire to it at once and let him go with his burning tail.

raw: तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितांस्तस्य मुनिश्शोणितविप्रुषः । क्रुद्धस्तत्र महाभागश्चिन्तयामास कोन्वयम् ॥४-११-४९॥
translation: 'The venerable sage became furious to see drops of blood fallen there. He started thinking who could he be?

raw: उवाच प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् दितिम् बलसूदनः । सर्वम् एतत् यथा उक्तम् ते भविष्यति न संशयः ॥१-४७-८॥
तस्माद्गच्छ महाबाहो कैलासं धरणीधरम् । निवेशय निवासार्थं त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां सहानुगः ॥७-११-४१॥
translation: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain Kailasa, abandon Lanka, and establish your residence there with your followers.

raw: उभे सम्ध्ये शयानस्य यत् पापम् परिकल्प्यते । तच् च पापम् भवेत् तस्य यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४४॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the extent of demerit fixed for a person, who sleeps at the hour of twilight of dawn and dusk

raw: प्रहृष्ट मनुजे कले मृग पक्षि समाकुले । मत्त बर्हिण सम्घुष्टाम् नाना द्विज गण आयुताम् ॥५-१४-८॥
translation: Entering deep into the grove, Hanuman saw clusters of trees pleasing to look at, herds of animals and flocks of colourful birds singing melodious notes.The grove was surrounded on all sides by silvery and golden trees which looked colourful with flocks of birds and herds of deer. It was full of lovely thickets looking like the rising sun. It was fringed with various trees bearing abundance of fruits and flowers. It was inhabited by intoxicated cuckoos, bees, proud peacocks and numerous lovely birds.

raw: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् । कर्त्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम् ॥२-११२-१०॥
translation: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.

raw: उदासीनेषु यो अस्मासु विक्रमो अयम् प्रकाशितः । अपकारिषु ते राम न एवम् पश्यामि विक्रमम् ॥४-१७-४६॥
translation: 'O king you have exhibited your valour against one who has done you no harm. Why have you not shown such valour on those who have offended you?

raw: इतो गच्छत पश्यध्वं वध्यमानं महात्मना । रामानुजेन वीरेण लवणं राक्षसोत्तमम् ॥७-६९-२९॥
translation: Go from here and witness Lavana, the chief of Rakshasas, being killed by the great-souled hero, Rama's younger brother.

raw: रथस्थं रावणं सङ्ख्ये ददर्श मनुजाधिपः ॥६-५९-१२६॥
translation: On hearing the sub mission of Hanuman, Sri Rama, the Lord of humans climbed on the great monkey and saw Ravana on the chariot.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । स्मितपूर्वमथो रामः प्रत्युवाच हरिं प्रभुः ॥४-११-८२॥
translation: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:

raw: सुग्रीवस्य त्वया भार्या हृता स च विवासितः । यत् तत् तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्ता इयम् प्लवगाधिप ॥४-२०-११॥
translation: 'O king of monkeys you have banished Sugriva. You have usurped his wife. This is the fruit of your action.

raw: अथवा किम् ममैतेन राजद्रव्यमयेन तु । उद्धृतम् मे स्वयम् तो यम् व्रतादेशम् करिष्यति ॥२-२२-२८॥
translation: Or else, for me what is the use of these pots of holy water which are the king's property? The water drawn with my own hands will be made use of for my religious bath.

raw: अहं द्विजिह्वः संह्रादी कुम्भकर्णो वितर्दनः । पञ्च रामवधायैते निर्यान्तीत्यवघोषय ॥६-६४-२२॥
translation: "You pronounce that I, Dwijihva, Samhradri, Kumbhakarna and Vitardana, five of us will go forth to kill Rama."

raw: अधर्मो ग्रसते धर्मम् ततस् तिष्यः प्रवर्तते । तत् त्वया चरता लोकान् धर्मो विनिहतो महान् ॥६-३५-१५॥
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानंभद्रमस्तुवः प्रव्याहरतविस्रब्धंबलंविष्णोःप्रवर्थताम् ॥६-१३१-१२१॥
translation: This way Ramayana is the ancient narration. Read it daily with trust and devotion. You be auspicious and let the strength of Vishnu grow in you.

raw: मन्मथस्य शराणाम् च त्वम् विधेयो भविष्यसि । यदि तस्याम् अभिप्रायो भार्या अर्थे तव जायते । शीघ्रम् उद् ध्रियताम् पादो जयार्थम् इह दक्षिणः ॥३-३४-२४॥
translation: If you intend her to be your wife, raise your right foot now and proceed to win her over.

raw: हतप्रवीरा रामेण निराशा जीविते वयम् । अपश्यन्तो भयस्यान्तमनाथा विलपामहे ॥६-९५-२४॥
translation: "Eminent heroes killed by Rama, hopes of life lost, not able to see the end of fear, we are like orphans weeping."

raw: चकम्पे मेदिनी कृत्स्ना सशैलवनकानना । भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्न ववौ चापि मारुतः ॥६-११०-१९॥
translation: The entire globe with its mountains, gardens and forests shook, the Sun lost his radiance, even the wind did not blow.

raw: विंध्य पर्वतजैः मत्तैः पूर्णा हैमवतैः अपि । मदान्वितैः अतिबलैः मातङ्गैः पर्वतोउपमैः ॥१-६-२३॥
translation: It was full of intoxicated elephants born in Vindhya mountains, elephants of enormous strength looking like mountains and born in the Himalayas. Elephants of good breed hailing from the family of Airavata (Indra's vehicle), Mahapadma, Anjana and Vamana.

raw: कदनं तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम् । आससाद ततो युद्धे राघवं त्वरितस्तदा ॥६-९७-५॥
translation: The Rakshasa king, having destroyed the forest rangers, thereafter, went to Raghava hurriedly.

raw: अन्तर् दाहेन दहनः सम्तापयति राघवम् । वन दाह अभिसम्तप्तम् गूढो अग्निर् इव पादपम् ॥२-८५-१७॥
translation: Just like a concealed forestfire scorching the dried up forest, the fire of sorrow kindled in his mind scorched Bharata.

raw: न तावदेष दुष्टात्मा शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः । हन्तुं चापि समासाद्य वरदानेन दुर्जयः ॥७-२७-१५॥
translation: The Lord explained that this evil-souled Ravana is currently unconquerable by gods or asuras, and cannot be killed even if approached, due to the boon he has received.

raw: विशेषेण भवान् एव विश्वामित्र महायशः । कौशिकी सरिताम् श्रेष्ठः कुल उद्योतकरी तव ॥१-३४-२१॥
translation: "Highly illustrious Viswamitra, you are similar to Brahma. Among the rivers, Kausiki is the best, refurbishing the image of your dynasty".

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवम् सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनः । तस्थौ भ्रातृ समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः पर वीरहा ॥४-२५-१९॥
translation: Having thus spoken to Sugriva, Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, slayer of enemies, stood by his brother

raw: क्षत्रिया ये च शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्चैव सहस्रशः । नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः ॥७-९६-८॥
translation: Thousands of Kshatriyas, Shudras, and Vaishyas, along with Brahmins of firm vows from various countries, also gathered.

raw: श्वश्रूणामविशेषेण प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण च । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य चरणौ कुशलं ब्रूहि पार्थिवम् ॥७-४८-१०॥
translation: Convey my respects to all mothers-in-law without distinction, and bowing down to the king's feet with folded hands and reverence, tell him of my well-being.

raw: क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत् । लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥४-११-८६॥
translation: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:

raw: प्रमत्त संनाददित बर्हिणानिस शक्रगोप अकुल शाद्वलानि । चरन्ति नीप अर्जुन वासितानिगजाः सुरम्याणि वन अन्तराणि ॥४-२८-४१॥
translation: 'Elephants roam the forestland inhabited by peacocks making noise out of joy, where the grassy land is filled with crawling Indragopa insects and the fragrance of kadamba and arjuna blossoms.

raw: न पित्र्यम् अनुवर्न्तन्ते मातृकम् द्विपदा इति । ख्यातो लोक प्रवादो अयम् भरतेन अन्यथा कृतः ॥३-१६-३४॥
translation: The saying that men follow mother's path but not the path of the father, has been disproved by Bharata.

raw: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् । पुनरप्यहमार्यां तामिदं वचनमब्रुवम् ॥५-६७-२५॥
यज्ञ विघ्न करौ तौ ते न एव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् । मारीचः च सुबाहुः च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ ॥१-२०-२६॥
परितुष्टम् मुनिम् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुर स्वरम् । उवाच परम प्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्य कोविदम् ॥१-३३-१५॥
translation: Having perceived that the sage was satisfied, the gandharva who was skilled in speech said exceedingly delighted to the sage in a sweet voice.

raw: तस्य कल्माषपादस्य यज्ञस्यायतनं शुभम् । आश्रमस्य समीपे ऽस्य यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव ॥७-६५-३८॥
translation: O Raghava, the auspicious place of sacrifice belonging to Kalmashapada, which you ask me about, is near this hermitage.

raw: इमं हि सालं सहित स्त्वया शरो न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति । अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं कुरुष्व राजात्मज शापितो मया ॥४-११-९२॥
translation: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.

raw: आरुरोह तदा तस्माद्धरिर्मलयपर्वतम् । मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशं नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् ॥६-७४-४२॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

raw: अथ सा हरिशार्दूलम् प्रविशन्तिम् महाबलम् । नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम् ॥५-३-२०॥
translation: Assuming her real form the presiding deity of Lanka noticed the son of the Windgod, the tiger among vanaras of great prowess entering the city.

raw: इदम् ममापरम् वाक्यम् शृणु राजन्यदीच्चसि । उपायकुशलो ह्येव जयेच्चत्रुनतन्द्रितः ॥६-८-१२॥
translation: "O King If you like, listen to my other statement: One who is cunning and is vigilant would win over an enemy."

raw: एष शैलैः शिलाभिः च पूरयित्वा महाअर्णवम् । द्वारम् आश्रित्य लंकाया रामस् तिष्ठति सायुधः ॥६-३०-११॥
translation: "Having filled the great ocean with rocks and stones in that way, taking position at the entrance of Lanka Rama stands equipped with arms."

raw: महोदरमाहपार्श्वौ विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम् । शीघ्रं वदत सैन्यानि निर्यातेति ममाज्ञया ॥६-९६-५॥
translation: Thus spoke the Lord of Rakshasas indistinctly in anger with his eyes burning as though it would consume them (Rakshasas). He commanded Mahodara, Mahaparsva and Virupaksha who stood nearby saying" quickly instruct the army to go."

raw: कामं लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः ससुरासुरमानवाः । भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे ॥५-४६-१३॥
translation: "Even Indra, suras, asuras and humans and the three worlds together are incompetent to stand before you in a battlefield.

raw: कच्चित् सर्वे ऽनुरक्तास्त्वां कुलपुत्रा: प्रधानत: । कच्चित्प्राणांस्तवार्थेषु सन्त्यजन्ति समाहिता: ॥२-१००-३५॥
translation: I hope all men of a good family, especially those who belong to our race, are loyal to you and are ready to sacrifice their lives for your cause.

raw: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं नि:श्वसन्तं पुन:पुन: । भ्रातरं भरतं राम: परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०४-१५॥
translation: Rama embraced his brother Bharata who repeatedly heaved sighs and resembled an elephant in rut, and said:

raw: स मन्दराग्रस्थ इवांशुमालिको विवृद्धकोपो बलवीर्यसंयुतः । कुमारमक्षं सबलं सवाहनं ददाह नेत्राग्निमरीचिभिस्तदा ॥५-४७-१७॥
translation: Huge Hanuman, endowed with strength and valour looked like the rising Sun on the peak of mount Mandara. He looked at prince Aksha and his army as well as his vehicles as though he was burning them with the rays emerging from his fiery eyes.

raw: कातरत्वम् प्रकाशम् हि सीता अपनयनेन मे । निवृत्त वन वासः च जनकम् मिथिल अधिपम् ॥३-६२-१२॥
का च मे जीविते श्रद्धा सुखे वा तं प्रियं विना । भर्तारं सागरान्ताया वसुधायाः प्रियंवदम् ॥५-२६-८॥
translation: "How can I have interest in any kind of pleasure without my sweettongued husband, the lord of the whole earth extending up to the ocean.

raw: नन्दनं वानरेन्द्राणां रक्षसामवसादनम् । वाजितं विविधैर्वाजैश्चारुचित्रैर्गरुत्मतः ॥६-१११-१२॥
translation: Provides delight for Vanara chiefs, causes destruction of Rakshasas, provides picturesque plumes of eagles to arrows.

raw: दृढप्राकारपरिखां हैमैर्गृहशतैर्वृताम् । लङ्कामवाप्य ते हृष्टा न्यवसन्रजनीचराः ॥७-५-३०॥
translation: Having obtained Lanka, which was surrounded by strong walls and moats and hundreds of golden houses, those delighted night-wanderers (Rakshasas) took up residence there.

raw: एतत् श्रुत्वा प्रियम् वाक्यम् ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम् । देवा महर्षयः सर्वे प्रहृष्टाः ते अभवन् तदा ॥१-१५-१५॥
translation: Having heard these pleasing words uttered by Brahma, all the devatas and maharshis were overwhelmed with joy.

raw: कश्च प्रत्यक्षमुत्सृज्य संशयस्थमलक्षणम् । आयतिस्थं चरेद्धर्मं क्षत्ऺत्रबन्धुरनिश्चितम् ॥२-१०६-२०॥
translation: Will any kshatriya, setting aside his first duty, follow an uncertain course of piety which is contrary to his dharma and whose impact may be felt in a remote future.

raw: यद् उक्तवन्तो रामस्य भवन्तस् तन् मया श्रुतम् । भवतश्चाप्यहम् वेद्मि युद्धे सत्यपराक्रमान् ॥६-३५-५॥
ततः कांचन शैल आभः तरुण अर्क निभ आननः । अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिर् वाक्यम् हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥४-२६-३॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, glowing like a golden mountain, whose face resembled the rising Sun addressed Rama with folded hands:

raw: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च मङ्गलं केकयी तथा । चक्रुस्ता राजभवने याश्चान्या राजयोषितः ॥७-६३-१६॥
translation: Kausalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi, along with other royal ladies, performed auspicious rites in the royal palace.

raw: देवान्तकः समादाय परिघं वज्रभूषणम् । परिगृह्य गिरीं दोर्भ्यां वपुर्विष्णोर्विडम्बयन् ॥६-६९-३१॥
translation: Devanthaka, holding a bar encrusted with diamonds in both hands, seemed like Vishnu in disguise with a mountain (to churn the milky ocean).

raw: सर्वान्समागतान्दृष्ट्वा सीता काषायवासिनी । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमधोदृष्टिरवाङ्मुखी ॥७-९७-१४॥
translation: Having seen all the assembled people, Sita, clad in ochre robes, spoke with folded hands, her eyes and face cast downwards.

raw: न मे परं किञ्चि दितस्त्वयापि न । प्रियं प्रियार्हे सुवचं वचो वरम् । तथा ह्यवोचस्त्वमतः प्रियोत्तरं । वरं वरं ते प्रददामि तं वृणु ॥२-७-३६॥
translation: O woman worthy of affection for me there is nothing greater and dearer than this news. I will grant you another reward better than this. Just ask for it. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संस्कारालङ्कृतं शुभम् । ईषद्विस्मयमानस्तमगस्त्यः प्राह राघवम् ॥७-४-८॥
translation: Having heard Rāghava's auspicious words, adorned with refinement, Agastya, slightly surprised, spoke to Rāghava.

raw: अथ पश्यमि दूरस्थम् ऋषिम् ज्वलित तेजसम् । कृत अभिषेकम् दुर्धर्षम् उपावृत्तम् उदन् मुखम् ॥४-६०-१४॥
translation: Then nearby I beheld a sage blazing with ascetic splendour, unassailable, facing north, having just bathed and returned.

raw: अतः तु किम् दुह्खतरम् यद् अहम् जीवित क्षये । न हि पश्यामि धर्मज्ञम् रामम् सत्य पराक्यमम् ॥२-६४-६७॥
translation: Can there be a greater sorrow than that at the last moment of my life I am unable to see my righteous and truthful son, Rama?

raw: तस्मादन्यत्र गच्छाम इति सञ्चिन्त्य राघव: । प्रातिष्ठत स वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च सङ्गत: ॥२-११७-४॥
translation: We shall, therefore, go to some other place, having resolved thus, Rama accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana set forth.

raw: कोसलानां च नक्षत्रं व्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम् । आक्रम्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौ विशाखामपि चाम्बरे ॥६-१०३-३३॥
translation: In the sky, the planet Mars too stood in constellation with Visakha star presided over by gods Indra and Agni in heaven, which was propitious for the kosala kings.

raw: नील उत्पल दल श्यामः श्यामी कृत्वा दिशो दश । विमदा इव मातंगाः शान्त वेगाः पयो धराः ॥४-३०-२३॥
translation: 'The clouds, which were dark till now like the blue lotus petals darkening all the ten directions are like elephants free from all intoxication as their fury is abated৷৷

raw: एक पुत्रा च साध्वी च विवत्सा इयम् त्वया कृता । तस्मात् त्वम् सततम् दुह्खम् प्रेत्य च इह च लप्स्यसे ॥२-७४-२९॥
translation: This pious lady is blessed with only one son and (now) has been rendered childless by you. Therefore, you shall experience grief in this world and hereafter.

raw: सूदयित्वा तु तम् शत्रुम् विक्रान्तम् तम् अहम् सुखम् । निष्क्रामम् न एव पश्यामि बिलस्य पिहितम् मुखम् ॥४-१०-२२॥
translation: After vanquishing that valiant enemy, the son of Dundubhi, as I came out I found the mouth of the cave closed.

raw: इति उक्ता राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः । ऊचुः प्रान्जलयः सर्वे रावणम् राक्षस ईश्वरम् ॥६-७-१॥
translation: All the Rakshasas of mighty strength, having heard the Lord of Rakshasas, thus spoke to their leader, greeting with folded hands.

raw: बलेन महता युक्तो रक्षसां भीमविक्रम । त्वं वधायाभिनिर्याहि रामस्य सह वानरैः ॥६-५१-१८॥
translation: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."

raw: कृत अन्तः तु एव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत् प्रवासने । राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनर् एव निवर्तने ॥२-२२-१५॥
translation: If the award of the kingdom to me is revoked, O Lakshmana, and if I am banished in this manner, see, it is destiny.

raw: ताराया च अभ्यनुज्ञात त्वरया चा अपि चोदितः । प्रविवेश महाबाहुः अभ्यंतरम् अरिन्दमः ॥४-३३-६२॥
translation: Strongarmed Lakshmana, a subduer of enemies, permitted by Tara entered the harem immediately (thinking of the urgency of the task).

raw: ततः पुष्पकमादाय राक्षस्यो रावणाज्ञया । अशोकवनिकास्थां तां मैथिलीं समुपानयन् ॥६-४७-१२॥
translation: Thereafter, by Ravana's order the Rakshasas went with the aerial car to Mythili in the Ashoka Garden.

raw: वेदाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च । यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ॥६-१०७-२४॥
translation: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.

raw: स च पावक संकाशः कुमारः समपद्यत । उत्थाय अग्निचयात् तस्मात् शरभंगो व्यरोचत ॥३-५-४१॥
translation: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

raw: उवाच नर शार्दूलम् अंबरीषम् इदम् वचः । अविक्रेयम् सुतम् ज्येष्ठम् भगवान् आह भार्गवः ॥१-६१-१७॥
ततः क्रोद्धात् दशग्रीवः सीताम् उत्सृज्य वीर्यवान् । मुष्टिभ्याम् चरणाभ्याम् च गृध्र राजम् अपोथयत् ॥३-५१-४०॥
translation: Then the tenheaded Ravana left Sita and attacked Jatayu with his fists and feet out of anger.

raw: ग्रहनक्षत्रवक्त्रांश्च महोल्कामुखसंस्थितान् । विद्युज्जिह्वोपमांश्चान्यान् ससर्ज निशितान् शरान् ॥६-१००-४७॥
translation: There Rama produced missiles glowing like fire, like Sun 's face, like moon's face, crescent moon face, face like Dhumakethu, missiles like planets, and star faced, with fire sticks like face resembling flashes and lightning and several others and let loose.

raw: भंगम् धनुः च तूणी च विकीर्णाम् बहुधा रथम् । संभ्रांत हृदयो रामः शशंस भ्रातरम् प्रियम् ॥३-६४-३८॥
translation: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:

raw: प्रतिज्ञातम् मया तावत् त्वयोक्तम् देवि शृण्वता । रामम् यदभिषेकाय त्वमिहाअत मब्रवीः ॥२-३८-११॥
translation: I have heard you, O Devi speaking to Rama when he came here in connection with the coronation. I promised you to that extent only.

raw: अकाले पुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश्च पादपाः । भविष्यन्ति महेष्वास नद्यश्च सलिलायुताः ॥६-१२३-१४॥
translation: The trees will be with blossoms and fruits even though it is unseasonal. The rivers will remain with waters.

raw: विश्रुतः त्रिषु लोकेषु वदान्यः सत्य संगरः । स तत्र पुरुषव्याघ्रः शशास पृथ्वीम् इमाम् ॥१-७-२२॥
translation: In the three worlds he (Dasaratha) was acclaimed in the three words as munificient and upholder of truth, a tiger among men, who ruled protecting and guarding the people through spies. He. ruled the kingdom with righteousness by deserting irreligious and keeping the subjects happy.

raw: तेषाम् बाणैः महाबाहुः शस्त्राणि आवार्य वीर्यवान् । जहार समरे प्राणान् चिच्छेद च शिरो धरान् ॥३-२५-२८॥
translation: Strongarmed Rama attacked them with his arrows and cut off their heads and took their lives.

raw: अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रो न कम्पते । शिलापादपवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि ववर्ष ह ॥६-७६-४९॥
translation: Vali's son was not shaken by the strike, showered rain of rocks and trees on his (Kumbha) forehead.

raw: अरोचयत् तद् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः । चिंतयित्वा महाबाहुः अकंपनम् उवाच ॥३-३१-३२॥
translation: Ravana, the strongarmed king of demons, relished the words of Akampana and pondering over the matter, said to him :

raw: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे भग्नः सुग्रीवः तेन वालिना । अपश्यन् राघवम् नाथम् ऋश्यमूकम् प्रदुद्रुवे ॥४-१२-२१॥
translation: Discomfited by Vali, and not seeing Rama around, Sugriva ran towards Rishyamuka mountain.

raw: ब्राह्मणाःक्षत्रियावैश्याश्शूद्रालोभविवर्जिताः । स्वकर्मसुप्रवर्तन्तेतुष्टास्स्वैरेवकर्मभिः आसन्प्रजाधर्मपरारामेशासतिनानृताः ॥६-१३१-१०५॥
translation: While Rama ruled brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas and sudras were free from avarice, were engaged in their own avocations and delighted. People remained righteous, pious, and never told lies.

raw: युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने । सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च ॥५-३८-२॥
translation: "O queen O lady of auspicious appearance your words are most appropriate to and characteristic of a modest virtuous woman.

raw: यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्वा सबान्धवम् । मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ॥५-३७-६१॥
translation: "It will be proper if Rama comes here, kills Ravana along with all his relations and takes me away.

raw: सुराणाम् असुराणाम् च धर्म अधर्मौ तद् आश्रयौ । धर्मो हि श्रूयते पक्षः सुराणाम् च महात्मनाम् ॥६-३५-१३॥
तटाक वैरिणः च अपि शुक्ल दन्त विभूषितान् । घोरान् एकचरान् वन्यान् द्विरदान् कूल घातिनः ॥४-१३-१०॥
translation: Observing terrific elephants adorned with white tusks wandering alone destroying the tanks, shattering the banks.

raw: याम् एव रात्रिम् ते दूताः प्रविशन्ति स्म ताम् पुरीम् । भरतेन अपि ताम् रात्रिम् स्वप्नो दृष्टः अयम् अप्रियः ॥२-६९-१॥
translation: On the very night the messengers were entering the city, Bharata had a distressing dream.

raw: फलमूलाशनो वीर भवेयं रघुनन्दन । तवागमनमाकांक्षन् वसन् वै नगराद्बहि: ॥२-११२-२४॥
translation: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'

raw: प्लवङ्गप्रवरैर्दृष्टः प्लवने कृतनिश्चयः । ववृधे रामवृद्ध्यर्थम् समुद्र इव पर्वसु ॥५-१-१०॥
translation: Having made up his mind to leap for the cause of Rama, Hanuman began to grow in size just as the sea grows during the fullmoon and newmoon days, while the monkey troops were watching.

raw: दुःखं बतेदं मम दुःखिताया मासौ चिरायाधिगमिष्यतो द्वौ । बद्धस्य वध्यस्य तथा निशान्ते राजापराधादिव तस्करस्य ॥५-२८-७॥
translation: "Alas, two months is too long a time to wait in grief. I am like a thief captured for offending a king and waiting overnight for execution at day-break.

raw: हावयामास विधिना राममङ्गलकारणात् । घृतम् श्वेतानि माल्यानि समिधः श्वेतसर्षपान् ॥२-२५-२८॥
निर्भिद्यमानः सहसा सहमानश्च तान् शरान् । कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् ॥६-७६-६९॥
translation: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.

raw: अयम् मेषः सवृषणः शक्रो हि अवृषणः कृतः । मेषस्य वृषणौ गृह्य शक्राय आशु प्रयच्छत ॥१-४९-६॥
translation: 'This ram (which has received the share of your sacrificial offerings) has testicles. As Indra has been deprived of his own take these testicles immediately and graft them on to Indra'.

raw: काञ्चनेनावृतां रम्यां प्राकारेण महापुरीम् । गृहैश्च ग्रहसंकाशैः शारदाम्बुदसन्निभैः ॥५-२-१६॥
translation: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

raw: नागैरश्वैः खरैरुष्ट्रैः संयुक्तः सुसामाहितः । पताकाध्वजचित्रैश्च रथैश्च समलङ्कृतः ॥६-५३-५॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

raw: ततो मन्दोदरी पुत्रं मेघनादमजीजनत् । स एष इन्द्रजिन्नाम युष्माभिरभिधीयते ॥७-१२-२८॥
translation: Mandodari then gave birth to a son named Meghanada, who is known to you all as Indrajit.

raw: प्रस्रुतः सर्व गात्रेभ्यः स्वेदः शोक अग्नि सम्भवः । यथा सूर्य अम्शु सम्तप्तः हिमवान् प्रस्रुतः हिमम् ॥२-८५-१८॥
translation: Like the ice melted by the heat of the Sun's rays flows down the Himalayas, sweat poured from all parts of his body caused by the fire of grief.

raw: धर्म बन्धेन बद्धो अस्मि नष्टा च मम चेतना । ज्येष्ठम् पुत्रम् प्रियम् रामम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि धार्मिकम् ॥२-१४-२४॥
translation: I am bound by bond of righteousness. My intellect is destroyed. I wish to see my beloved, virtuous firstborn, Rama.

raw: सुषेणो जाम्बवांश्चैव ऋक्षैर्बहुभिरावृतौ । सुग्रीवं पुरतः कृत्वा जघनं सम्ररक्षतुः ॥६-४-३४॥
translation: Sushena, and Jambavan surrounded by the army of Rshaba were guarding by placing on the western side.

raw: रक्षसाम् नर्दताम् घोरः श्रूयते अयम् महाध्वनिः । आहतानाम् च भेरीणाम् राक्षसैः क्रूर कर्मभिः ॥३-२४-१०॥
translation: A dreadful roar of demons and the loud sound of wardrums beaten by the wicked demons are heard.

raw: इति बहुविधमाकुलान्तरात्मा कृपणमतीव विलप्य कुम्भकर्णम् । न्यपतदथ दशाननो भृशार्तस्तमनुजमिन्द्ररिपुं हतं विदित्वा ॥६-६८-२४॥
तपसा पुरुषव्याघ्र राक्षसोऽयम् न शक्यते । शस्त्रेण युधि निर्जेतुम् राक्षसम् निखनावहे ॥३-४-१०॥
translation: O Lakshmana, best among men, this demon by virtue of his penance cannot be killed with any weapon in war. Therefore, let us bury him.

raw: सप्त रात्रे कृत आहारा वायुना अचल वासिनः । दिवम् वर्ष शतैः याताः सप्तभिः सकलेवराः ॥४-१३-१९॥
translation: 'These seven sages used to live on air and that too once in seven nights. They lived for seven hundred years performing penance with motionlessness and attained heaven along with their bodies.

raw: अनागत विधानम् तु कर्तव्यम् शुभम् इच्छता । आपदम् शंकमानेन पुरुषेण विपश्चिता ॥३-२४-११॥
translation: A wise man who apprehends danger or one who desires his own good should plan his defence even before the onset of danger.

raw: मम दयित तमा हृता वनात् रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा । कथय मम रिपुम् तम् अद्य वै प्लवगपते यम सन्निधिम् नयामि ॥४-६-२७॥
translation: 'O lord of monkeys tell me the whereabouts of that nightranger who has carried off my darling from the heart of the forest and has harassed her. I will send him now to the abode of Death. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः Thus ends the sixth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: न पश्यति रजो अपि अस्य यदा रामस्य भूमिपः । तदा आर्तः च विषण्णः च पपात धरणी तले ॥२-४२-३॥
translation: When the king could no longer see even the dust, he fell on the ground, despondent and grief stricken.

raw: सुपर्णः पर्ण बहुलाम् बभंज अथ महाबलः । तत्र वैखानसा माषा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः ॥३-३५-३०॥
यथा वा दीपिता लङ्का प्रहृष्टैर्हरियूथपैः । सपुत्रबान्धवामात्यः सबलः सहवाहनः ॥६-१२७-१४॥
translation: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."

raw: विमले च प्रकाशेते विशाखे निरुपप्लुवे । नक्षत्र वरमस्माकमिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम् ॥६-४-५१॥
translation: The best of stars, Visakha of the highsouled Ikshvakus which is unconnected shines brightly.

raw: तस्मिन्नार्जवसम्पन्ने देवि देवोपमे कथम् । पापमाशम्ससे रामे महर्षिसमतेजसि ॥२-१२-३१॥
translation: How do you, O Devi, wish to harm Rama who is endowed with uprightness, who resembles the gods and in lustre to great ascetics?

raw: चालयन्तं महानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान् । ददृशुस्ते न वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा ॥६-९४-२१॥
translation: They could not see Rama while he was moving and breaking huge chariots as one would not be able to see the trees in the forest when the wind blew fast.

raw: तामापतन्तीं दृष्ट्वैव रथः सारथिना तदा । विधेयाश्वसमायुक्तः सुदूरमपवाहितः ॥६-८२-१०॥
translation: Then seeing that rock coming towards the chariot yoked to obedient horses, the chariot rider drove it to a long distance.

raw: उत्थिता मेदिनीम् भित्त्वा क्षेत्रे हल मुख क्षते । पद्म रेणु निभैः कीर्णा शुभैः केदार पाम्सुभिः ॥५-१६-१६॥
translation: She had risen from the land when tilled by the plough and was covered with auspicious paddy dust resembling the pollen grains of lotuses, this daughter of Janaka, the great righteous ruler of Mithila, This lady with unswerving devotion to her husband.

raw: विभीषणम् च धर्मज्नम् अनुरक्तम् निज़ा चरम् । मन्त्रज्नम् च विधिज्नम् च ज़्लक्ष्णया परया गिरा ॥६-३८-२॥
translation: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.

raw: यथावयो हि राज्यानि प्राप्नुवन्ति नृपक्षये । इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथेऽस्मिम्स्तल्लोपयितुमिच्छसि ॥२-३५-९॥
translation: After the death of the king, the princes will obtain the kingdom according to seniority. Why do you want to break this tradition in the case of Rama, the lord of the Ikshvaku dynasty?

raw: महा गिरिम् इव अकंप्यम् महेन्द्र सदृशम् पतिम् । महा उदधिम् इव अक्षोभ्यम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३३॥
translation: I am devoted to Rama, my husband, who is unshakeable like a huge mountain, is comparable to lord Indra and is imperturbable like the mighty ocean.

raw: ताम् दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीताम् विराध अङ्कगताम् शुभाम् । अब्रवीत् लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता ॥३-२-१६॥
translation: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

raw: मुमुहू राक्षसाः सर्वे धूम्राक्षस्य पुरस्सराः ॥६-५१-३५॥
translation: Then Rakshasa feared seeing the dreadful manifestation and got worried. All the Rakshasas walking in front of Dhumraksha lost consciousness.

raw: तत् श्रुत्वा राज शार्दूलो विश्वामित्रस्य भाषितम् । मुहूर्तम् इव निस्सज्ञः सज्ञावान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-२०-१॥
translation: On hearing Viswamitra, words the tiger among kings (Dasaratha) lost his senses for a moment and on regaining his consciousness spoke this way.

raw: यमशत्रुश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाकायस्तौ चोभौ शुकसारणौ ॥६-४४-२०॥
translation: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

raw: तस्य बाहूरुवेगं च निनादं च महात्मनः । निशम्य हरयो हृष्टाः समुत्पेतुस्ततस्ततः ॥५-५७-२५॥
translation: Hearing the sound of his dashing movements of arms and thighs the vanaras jumped about in joy, then and there.

raw: ततः शोकेन सम्वीतः पितुर् मरण दुह्खितः । विललाप महा तेजा भ्रान्त आकुलित चेतनः ॥२-७२-१८॥
translation: Overwhelmed with grief, radiant Bharata reeling with delusion due to sorrow, lamented over the death of his father.

raw: न सीतायाः परां भार्यां वव्रे स रघुनन्दनः । यज्ञे यज्ञे च पत्न्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनी भवत् ॥७-९९-८॥
translation: That Rama, the delight of Raghu, did not choose another wife besides Sita, and in every sacrifice, a golden image of Janaki served as his wife.

raw: तथा पौर जनस्य अपि कर्तव्याः च सुविस्तराः । आगतानाम् सुदूरात् च पार्थिवानाम् पृथक् पृथक् ॥१-१३-११॥
प्रविशन् निष्पतमः च अपि प्रपतन्न् उत्पतन्न् अपि । सर्वम् अपि अवकाशम् स विचचार महा कपिः ॥५-१२-१६॥
translation: The great vanara searched all over again and again jumping up and down, stopping for a while and moving, opening and closing doors, by crossing, entering and exiting, jumping up and down. Thus he moved about and searched whereever there was scope to search

raw: मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः । सर्वे सहानुगा राममन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत् ॥७-१०९-१३॥
translation: All the ministers and groups of servants, along with their sons, animals, relatives, and followers, joyfully followed Rama.

raw: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण पर्वतो मैथिलीम् प्रति । दर्शयन् इव ताम् सीताम् न दर्शयत राघवे ॥३-६४-३२॥
translation: Thus addressed by Rama, the mountain echoed as if it was telling about Sita but did not show her to Rama.

raw: पाण्डुरा रक्त पादासः च विहगाः काल चोदिताः । राक्षसानाम् विनाशाय कपोता विचरन्ति च ॥६-३५-३२॥
translation: "The white and redfooted doves are moving about impelled by time spirit boding destruction of Rakshasas."

raw: कः क्षत्रिय कुलेजातः श्रुतवान् नष्टसंशयः । धर्म लिंग प्रतिच्छन्नः क्रूरम् कर्म समाचरेत् ॥४-१७-२७॥
translation: 'Who, born in a kshatriya family, versed in the Vedas and free from doubt will commit such a cruel act under the guise of righteousness?

raw: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ । इहोपयातं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम् ॥५-६४-८॥
translation: "O blameless prince I have already told your father's elder brother and all the forestdwellers about your arrival here.

raw: तत् एतत् न भवेत् रक्षो वातापिः इव लक्ष्मण । मत् विधम् यो अतिमन्येत धर्म नित्यम् जितेन्द्रियम् ॥३-४३-४५॥
translation: O Lakshmana just like Vatapi, this demon will not live. Whoever violates a person of my kind who is ever righteous and selfcontrolled will be killed

raw: सा विषण्णा च सम्त्रस्ता कैकेयी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । राजानमेवाभिमुखी कैकेयी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-३६-११॥
translation: The dejected and frightened Kaikeyi with a dry countenance, looked at the king and said:

raw: यज्ञ उपसदनम् ब्रह्मन् प्राप्तो असि मुनिभिः सह । द्वादश अहम् तु ब्रह्मर्षे दीक्षाम् आहुः मनीषिणः ॥१-५०-१५॥
गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे । रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणे ऽद्भुतपराक्रमः । त्रैलोक्येनापि सङ्क्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः ॥६-५९-४९॥
translation: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."

raw: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा जगाम लघुविक्रमः । भस्म राशी कृता यत्र पितरः तस्य सागराः ॥१-४१-१२॥
translation: Hearing their words with a quick pace where he reached the place his uncles, sons of Sagara were reduced to heaps of ashes.

raw: कूटैश्च बहुधाकीर्णैः शोभितं बहुकन्दरैः । सालतालाश्वकर्णैश्च वंशैश्च बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥५-५६-१७॥
translation: With many kinds of caves and peaks scattered all over, the mountain looked delightful. It was canopied with numerous trees like Sal, palms, Aswakarnas and bamboos.

raw: मैन्दः च द्विविधः च उभौ तत्र वानर पुम्गवौ । विचेरतुः च ताम् सेनाम् रक्षा अर्थम् सर्वतो दिशम् ॥६-५-२॥
translation: Dwivida and Mainda, the best of the vanaras, went about in all directions for safeguarding the army.

raw: विपञ्चैइम् परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी । निद्रा वशम् अनुप्राप्ता सह कान्ता इव भामिनी ॥५-१०-४१॥
translation: Another selfpossessed lady, graceful in dance, holding a sevenstringed lute was as though lying asleep with her beloved.

raw: ये तु अंतपालाः प्लवगाः शीघ्रगा व्यवसायिनः । समानयंतु ते शीघ्रम् त्वरिताः शासनात् मम । स्वयम् च अनंतरम् सैन्यम् भवान् एव अनुपश्यतु ॥४-२९-३१॥
translation: 'Let the swiftfooted monkeys, guardians of frontiers, army chiefs muster soon in obedience to my command. You (Nila) alone should personally supervise the work to be done next.

raw: मेरुमन्दरसंकाशानुद्धतान् स महार्णवे । अत्यक्रामन्महावेगस्तरङ्गान् गणयन्निव ॥५-१-७२॥
translation: Hanuman moving along in high speed looked as if he was counting the mighty waves risen ike Meru and Mandara mountains.

raw: सर्वे च ते बाष्पकलाः साश्रुनेत्रा विचेतसः । सम्मूढा इव दुःखेन त्यजन्तो राघवं तदा ॥७-४०-२७॥
translation: At that time, all of them, full of tears and with tearful eyes, were bewildered and stupefied by sorrow as they were leaving Rama.

raw: इह एकदा किल क्रूरो वातापिः अपि च इल्वलः । भ्रातरौ सहितौ आस्ताम् ब्राह्मणघ्नौ महा असुरौ ॥३-११-५५॥
तद्वाक्यमव्यक्तपदं तासां स्त्रीणां निशम्य च । विद्यामावर्तनीं पुण्यामावर्तयत स द्विजः ॥७-८८-२०॥
translation: Having heard that speech with indistinct words from those women, that brahmin recited the sacred spell that causes return.

raw: दैवतानि च सर्वाणिचैत्यानिनगरस्य च । सुगन्धमाल्यैर्यादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः ॥६-१३०-२॥
translation: "Let all gods in the temples of the capital be worshiped by people purifying themselves, duly adorned with fragrance and garlands."

raw: गरुड व्यूहम् आस्थाय सर्वतो हरिभिर् वृतः । माम् विसृज्य महातेजा लंकाम् एव अभिवर्तते ॥६-३०-१२॥
translation: "O glorious King! After releasing me, Rama is advancing into Lanka surrounded by mountains like a monkey army in the form of Garuda."

raw: अनरण्येन ते ऽमात्या मारीचशुकसारणाः । प्रहस्तसहिता भग्ना व्यद्रवन्त मृगा इव ॥७-१९-१८॥
translation: Those ministers of Ravana, namely Maricha, Shuka, Sarana, along with Prahasta, were defeated by Anaranya and fled like deer.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु रावणं प्राप्तमिन्द्रश्चलित आसनात् । अब्रवीत्तत्र तान् देवान् सर्वानेव समागतान् ॥७-२७-३॥
translation: Having heard that Ravana had arrived, Indra moved from his seat and spoke to all the assembled gods there.

raw: ततः कार्ष्णायसं शूलं कण्टकैर्बहुभिर्वतम् । प्रगृह्याभ्यहनद्देवं स्तनयोरन्तरे दृढम् ॥७-८-१५॥
translation: Then, seizing a black iron spear covered with many spikes, Malyavan firmly struck the god between his breasts.

raw: विक्षिपन् विविधाः शाखा नगानाम् कुसुमोत्कटाः । मारुतः चलित स्थानैः षट्पदैः अनुगीयते ॥४-१-१४॥
translation: "As the wind shakes the flowers off the branches of various trees the bees bumble in tune with the (whistling) wind.

raw: विनद्य सुमहा नादम् श्रमेण उपरताः स्त्रियः । निर्घोष उपरतम् नूनम् अद्य राज निवेशनम् ॥२-८६-१४॥
translation: The women of the inner apartment who lamented loudly, must have stopped weeping out of weariness. By now, the clamour in the king's palace would have surely subsided.

raw: ऊरुवेगोत्थिता वृक्षा मुहूर्तं कपिमन्वयुः । प्रस्थितं दीर्घमध्वानं स्वबन्धमिव बान्धवाः ॥५-१-४७॥
translation: Swept away by the force of his thighs, the trees bent forward following him for a while just as relatives accompany their kith and kin on long travel.

raw: आययौ यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितः । विमानशतकोटीभिर्दिव्याभिरभिसंवृतः ॥७-११०-४॥
translation: Brahma came to where Rama was ready to ascend to heaven, surrounded by hundreds of crores of divine celestial chariots.

raw: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः । समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थं वालिनो मया ॥६-१२६-३३॥
translation: "Here is the place I met the Vanara king Sugriva and made an agreement to put an end to Vali."

raw: सर्वे भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु कपिराजेन सङ्गताः ॥६-४४-३५॥
पुरोहितं च काकुत्स्थं नैगमानृत्विजस्तथा । मन्त्रिणश्चैव तान्सर्वानानयध्वं ममाज्ञया ॥७-६३-११॥
translation: Rama further instructed them to bring the chief priest, the citizens, the ritual priests, and all the ministers by his command.

raw: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मवान् । बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा ॥६-४१-८४॥
translation: Then Angada, the son of Tara, on his own wanting to exhibit his strength in the presence of the Rakshasa army allowed himself to be caught.

raw: नहि कोपपरीतानि हर्षपर्युत्सुकानि च । भवन्ति युधि योधानां मुखानि निहते पतौ ॥६-४८-२५॥
translation: "If a husband ceases life in war, their face will not have an angry look or happy appearance."

raw: सा त्वाम् सुप्तम् हतम् श्रुत्वा माम् च रक्षो गृहम् गताम् । हृदयेन विदीर्णेन न भविष्यति राघव ॥६-३२-२७॥
translation: "Raghava! Hearing that you were killed while asleep and I was taken to the home of Rakshasas, Kausalya will not be able to survive with a broken heart."

raw: अपि नौ वशमागच्छेत् कोविदारध्वजो दणे ॥२-९६-२१॥
यं दृष्ट्वा राघवो नैव वृत्तमार्यमनुस्मरेत् । स ममार्थाय कुशलं वक्तव्यो वचनान्मम । मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः ॥५-३८-६४॥
translation: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.

raw: तद्द्वितीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् । प्रश्शंसुः सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ॥५-१-१३७॥
translation: Gods, siddhas as well as the great sages praised him for the second great achievment of Hanuman, which is impossible for others to accomplish.

raw: उत्सृज्यार्कमिमं राम प्रधावन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् । अवेक्ष्यैवं परावृत्त्य मुखशेषः पराङ्मुखः ॥७-३५-४१॥
translation: O Rama, having left the sun, Rahu, who has only a head remaining, turned away, averting his face after seeing this monkey (Hanuman) running swiftly.

raw: मोहनार्थं तु सर्वेषां बुद्धिं कृत्वा सुदुर्मतिः । हन्तुं सीतां व्यवसितो वानराभिमुखो ययौ ॥६-८१-६॥
translation: Evil minded Indrajith, made up his mind to hoodwink every one who decided to kill Sita and went towards the Vanaras.

raw: युष्माकम् राघवो अरण्ये योग क्षेमम् विधास्यति । सीता नारी जनस्य अस्य योग क्षेमम् करिष्यति ॥२-४८-१९॥
translation: In the forest, Rama will look after your wellbeing and Sita will ensure our, women folk's security.

raw: अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम् । पावनस्तव दुर्धर्षो रोचतां रघुनन्दन ॥७-८४-२॥
translation: O delight of the Raghus, may the Ashwamedha, a great sacrifice and purifier of all sins, which is a purifier for you, the unconquerable one, be pleasing to you.

raw: अगृह्य यदि गच्छामि विशल्यकरणीमहम् । कालात्ययेन दोषः स्याद्वैक्लव्यं च महद्भवेत् ॥६-१०२-२४॥
translation: 'If I go without taking Visalakarani, through the passage of time huge mistakes will happen and perplexity will arise'.

raw: ततः प्रबुद्धो भरतः तम् घोषम् सम्निवर्त्य च । न अहम् राजा इति च अपि उक्त्वा शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-८१-४॥
translation: Then Bharata waking up, exclaimed, I am not the king, ordered the pipers to stop and said to Satrughna:

raw: स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः । अभवद्वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः ॥५-४६-३४॥
translation: Attacked by both the generals, the fur on the vanara's body was smeared with blood from his wounded limbs, shining like the rising Sun smeared with blood became furious.

raw: लोक विद्विष्टम् आरब्धम् त्वद् अन्यस्य अभिषेचनम् । नोत्सहे सहितुम् वीर तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥२-२३-१०॥
translation: The consecration of any one other than you, O valiant one is universally detested. I do not want to tolerate (this act). You should pardon me in this matter.

raw: एतदाख्यानमायुष्यं सभविष्यं सहोत्तरम् । कृतवान्प्रचेतसः पुत्रस्तद्ब्रह्माप्यन्वमन्यत ॥७-१११-१०॥
translation: The son of Prachetas (Valmiki) composed this life-giving narrative, including its future events and the Uttara Kanda, and even Brahma himself approved of it.

raw: तैः वाक्यैः परुषैः दुह्खैः कैकेयी भृश दुह्हिता । शत्रुघ्न भय सम्त्रस्ता पुत्रम् शरणम् आगता ॥२-७८-२०॥
translation: Kaikeyi, deeply distressed at those harsh and grievous words was afraid of Satrughna and sought the protection of her son Bharata.

raw: जघान मूर्ध्नि धनदं व्याविद्ध्य महतीं गदाम् । एवं स तेनाभिहतो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः ॥७-१५-३५॥
translation: Having whirled a great mace, Ravana struck Kubera on the head, and thus Kubera, bewildered and drenched in blood, was struck by him.

raw: आभाष्य च महावीर्यान्राघवो यूथपर्षभान् । नीलं नलं केसरिणं कुमुदं गन्धमादनम् ॥७-३९-२०॥
translation: And Rama then addressed the very powerful best of the troop leaders: Nila, Nala, Kesarin, Kumuda, and Gandhamadana.

raw: शिव उदकम् च पंपायाम् दृष्ट्वा शोकम् विहास्यसि । सु मनोभिः चितान् तत्र तिलकान् नक्त मालकान् ॥३-७३-२१॥
पश्चार्धमिव लोकस्य प्रचेतास्तेजपा वृतः । सुविभक्तमहाव्यूहा महावानररक्षिता ॥६-२४-१९॥
ततो निपतिताम् ताराम् च्युताम् ताराम् इव अंबरात् । शनैः आश्वासयामास हनूमान् हरि यूथपः ॥४-२१-१॥
translation: Thereafter Hanuman, leader of the monkey clan, slowly consoled Tara who was (standing before her husband) like a star fallen from the sky.

raw: पराक्रमोत्साहविजृम्भितार्चिर्निश्वासधूमः स्वबलप्रतापः । प्रतापवान् संयति राक्षसाग्निर्निर्वापितो रामपयोधरेण ॥६-११२-१२॥
translation: "The prowess and exceeding energy of Ravana as flames, his sighs as smoke, his own strength as heat, endowed with might, that fire of Rakshasa has been extinguished by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama in the battlefield."

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्रिरभ्याषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् । मध्येवानरमुख्यानां राजानं राजशासनात् ॥६-१९-२७॥
translation: (Rama) having spoken that way, Saumithri crowned Vibheeshana as crowned king on the command of Rama amid Vanara army chiefs.

raw: नियुज्यमानाः च गजाः सुहस्ताः । सकेसराः च उत्पल पत्र हस्ताः । बभूव देवी च कृता सुहस्ता । लक्ष्मीः तथा पद्मिनि पद्म हस्ता ॥५-७-१४॥
translation: He saw on it lotus ponds, artificial elephants with shapely trunks, offering to Laxmi who herself was a lotus, holding in her beautiful hands blue lotuses shining with filaments.

raw: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । अभवत् लक्ष्मणः प्रीतः प्रेम्णा च इदम् उवाच ह ॥४-३६-१२॥
translation: Lakshmana who was happy to hear great Sugriva replied affectionately:

raw: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणान् शरवृष्टिबिरर्दितान् । अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः ॥६-७६-६३॥
translation: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

raw: शुष्क काष्ठैः भवेत् कार्यम् लोष्टैः अपि च पांसुभिः । न तु स्थानात् परिभ्रष्टैः कार्यम् स्यात् वसुधाधिपैः ॥३-३३-१८॥
translation: Even dried up logs, or clods of earth, or a handful of dust may have some value but not a king who is dethroned.

raw: अभ्यपद्यन्त संहृष्टाः तेजोवन्तो महाबलाः । नाना सत्त्व समाकीर्णाम् दैत्य इन्द्र निलय उपमम् ॥४-५०-१२॥
किं त्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं प्राणपरिक्षये । नह्यहं विमुखी रक्षो युध्यमानस्त्वया हतः ॥७-१९-२७॥
translation: What can I possibly do now, with my life force depleted? O demon, I was not killed by you while turning away, but while fighting.

raw: अचिरेणैव कालेनासूत विश्रवसं सुतम् । त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं यशोधर्मसमन्वितम् ॥७-२-३३॥
translation: In a short time, she gave birth to a son named Vishravas, who became renowned in the three worlds and was endowed with fame and righteousness.

raw: अस्य मायाविदो माया मृग रूपम् इदम् कृतम् । भानुमत् पुरुषव्याघ्र गन्धर्व पुर संनिभम् ॥३-४३-७॥
translation: O tiger among men, this deceitful demon (Maricha) has been transformed into the illusory form of a radiant deer which does not exist.

raw: मृगम् हत्वाऽऽनय क्षिप्रम् लक्ष्मणेह शुभेक्षणकर्तव्यः शास्त्रदृष्टो हि विधिर्दर्ममनुस्मर ॥२-५६-२३॥
translation: Slay an antelope and bring it here quickly. O Lakshmana The rites as prescribed by the scriptures will have to be carried out. You may recollect that tradition.

raw: सर्वान्लोकान् सुसंहृत्य सभूतान् सचराचरान् । पुनरेव तथा स्रष्टुं शक्तो रामो महायशाः ॥५-५१-३९॥
translation: "Illustrious Rama can put an end to and dissolve all creatures including both movable and immovables of all worlds. He can recreate all of them in the same way. He has such superhuman powers.

raw: सा प्रमथ्य रथं तस्य निपपात शिला भुवि । सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं सध्वजं सशरासनम् ॥६-५२-२९॥
translation: That rock fell on the chariot and got crushed along with its wheel and axle and with arrows.

raw: ततो गतायां निद्रायां राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः । तद्वनं ददृशुर्भग्नं तं च वीरं महाकपिम् ॥५-४२-३॥
translation: Hideouslooking ogresses, awakened from sleep, saw the garden devastated by the heroic Vanara.

raw: शान्तयः च अपि वर्धन्ताम् यथा कल्पम् यथा विधि । शक्यः प्राप्तुम् अयम् यज्ञः सर्वेण अपि महीक्षिता ॥१-८-१६॥
रक्षाम् चैव विधास्यामि वानराद् रजनी चर । न आगमिष्यति ते दुह्खम् किम्चिद् आत्म अपराधजम् ॥६-८-५॥
translation: "O night ranger (Ravana) I will arrange the protection (of this Lanka) from these Vanaras. For your own wrong action (of abducting Sita) you cannot undergo suffering."

raw: पर्वताग्र नदी दुर्गान् सरांसि विपुल द्रुमान् । वृक्ष खण्डान् च विविधान् पर्वतान् वन पादपान् ॥४-४८-३॥
translation: He went a long distance with other heroic monkeys, searching in the impenetrable caves of Vindhya mountain. They combed interior places, mountain peaks, fortresses surrounded by rivers, lakes, extensive groves of trees, bushes and thickets.

raw: मांसानि च समृष्टानि फलानि विविधानि च । रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं किङ्करास्तूर्णमाहरन् ॥७-४२-१९॥
राक्षसास्त्वपि सङ्क्रुद्धाः प्रासतोमरपाणयः । कपीन्निजघ्निरे तत्र शस्त्रैः परमदारुणैः ॥६-५५-२७॥
translation: There, the highly furious Rakshasas also exterminated the Vanaras with their weapons and darts.

raw: हृत दारान् स दारान् च दश विद्रवतो दिशः । हत शेषान् अशरणान् द्रक्ष्यसि त्वम् निशाचरान् ॥३-३८-२८॥
translation: You will see the rest of the demons with their wives gone or fleeing in all directions helplessly with none to take care of them.

raw: जनस्थाने हतस्थाने निहते रक्षसां बले । अशक्तेन त्वया रक्षः कृतमेतदसाधु वै ॥५-१९-२५॥
सुसंरब्धस्तु सौमित्रिरस्त्रं वारुणमाददे ॥६-९१-५५॥
translation: Enraged Saumithri, seizing the weapon of Varuna, skilled in warfare loosened on Indrajith (Mahendra's enemy), which was presided over by Rudra.

raw: ततश्शत्रुघ्नवचनान्निपुणाःश्मश्रुवर्धनाः । सुखहस्ताःसुशीघ्राश्चराघवंपर्यवारयन् ॥६-१३१-१३॥
translation: Then at the command of Shatrughna's words, experts with hand work (barbers) who had soft skills quickly surrounded Raghava.

raw: इति ब्रुवन्तम् राजान मनयन् द्वार्दर्शिनः । कौसल्याया गृहम् तत्र न्यवेश्यत विनीतवत् ॥२-४२-२७॥
translation: Having heard the king, the doorkeepers took him to the apartment of Kausalya and there respectfully made him rest.

raw: अथसौम्य दशग्रीवोमृगंयातेतुराघवे । लक्ष्मणेचापिनिष्क्रान्तेप्रविवेशाश्रमंतदा ॥६-१२९-२५॥
translation: "When gentle Raghava went after the deer and Lakshmana also went from there, the ten headed Ravana entered the hermitage."

raw: रामहस्ताद्दशग्रीवः शूरो दत्तमहावरः । इदं भयं महाघोरमुत्पन्नं नावबुध्यते ॥६-९५-२५॥
translation: "Graced with the boon of arrows the tenheaded Ravana has not realised the appalling danger to him from Rama."

raw: नास्तिक्यमनृतं क्रोधं प्रमादं दीर्घसूत्रताम् । अदर्शनं ज्ञानवतामालस्यं पञ्चवृत्तिताम् ॥२-१००-६६॥
translation: I trust you eschew the fourteen faults of kings, like atheism, falsehood, anger, inattention, procrastination, evading the wise, indolence, gratification of all five senses, planning alone in the affairs of the kingdom, consultation with people who are proficient in worthless acts, failure to implement decisious, inability to keep the counsel secret and omission of auspicious practices and setting out against all the enemies at a time.

raw: ततस्सराक्षसोभीमस्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनम् । सावज्ञमेवप्रोवाचवाक्यंमेघौघनिस्स्वनः ॥६-६७-१०६॥
translation: Thereupon the Rakshasa sounding like the rumblings of clouds disdainfully spoke these words to Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra.

raw: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् कांचनान् अन्तर दर्शनम् । पर्वतः सर्व सौवर्णो धारा प्रस्रवण आयुतः ॥४-४२-३३॥
translation: Beyond that lord of mountains lies an all-golden mountain, its caves gilded within and abounding in cascading waterfalls.

raw: तेन तस्य निपातेन राक्षसस्य महामृधे । पफाल हृदयं चाशु स पपात हतो भुवि ॥६-९९-२२॥
translation: In that great conflict, struck by the fist, the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva's) heart broke and killed and fell on the ground.

raw: जपम् च न्यायतः कृत्वा स्नात्वा नद्याम् यथाविधि । पाप सम्शमनम् रामः चकार बलिम् उत्तमम् ॥२-५६-३२॥
translation: Rama, offered oblations to Visvadevas, Rudra and Visnu, performed the auspices for the appeasement of the household deity. And having muttered japa silently in conformity with tradition, he took his ablution in the river as enjoined (by the sastras) and offered his final oblations for the expiation of his sins.

raw: एवमुक्ता तु सा सीता तां ततो धर्मचारिणीम् । श्रूयतामिति चोक्त्वा वै कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥२-११८-२६॥
translation: 'Listen' said Sita, thus addressed, and began relating the story to Anasuya, a performer of austerities.

raw: सो ऽबिवाद्य दशग्रीवं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् । निर्जगाम गृहाच्छुभ्राद्रावणस्याज्ञया बली ॥६-७८-५॥
translation: Greeting the tenheaded Rakshasa and going round him according to tradition, the mighty warrior went out from the abode early morning by the command of Ravana.

raw: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं किङ्किणीजालकं तथा । दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् ॥७-१३-५॥
translation: The structure featured steps made of lapis lazuli, a network of small bells, ivory archways, and platforms of diamond and crystal.

raw: भूम्यामहं सर्वकालमेकेनांशेन सर्वदा । वसिष्यामि न सन्देहः सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीमि वः ॥७-८६-१४॥
translation: She further stated that with another part, she would always dwell on the earth at all times, declaring this truth to them without a doubt.

raw: ततो ऽर्जुनेन क्रुद्धेन सर्वप्राणेन सा गदा । स्तनयोरन्तरे मुक्ता रावणस्य महोरसि ॥७-३२-६०॥
translation: Then, the enraged Arjuna, with all his might, hurled that mace at Ravana's broad chest, between his breasts.

raw: तत्र काषायिणो वृद्धान् वेत्र पाणीन् स्वलम्कृतान् । ददर्श विष्ठितान् द्वारि स्त्र्य् अध्यक्षान् सुसमाहितान् ॥२-१६-३॥
translation: He saw aged people appointed as security staff for women's apartments. They were welladorned, dressed in orange robes and with rapt attention stood holding staff in their hands.

raw: कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजेथा व्यसनानि च । परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा ॥२-३-४३॥
इमे शूराः समर्थाश्च सर्वतो हरियूथपाः । त्वत्प्रियार्थम् कृतोत्साहाः प्रवेष्टुमपि पावकम् ॥६-२-७॥
translation: All these vanara leaders and heroes are highly capable and for your happiness they are even ready to enter fire. I know this from their joy and I even infer that it is certain (to happen).

raw: अस्य यज्ञस्य जातो ऽन्तः सामिषं भोजनं मम । दीयतामिह शीघ्रं वै नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥७-६५-२१॥
translation: The demon, disguised as Vasiṣṭha, demanded that since the sacrifice had concluded, meat-laden food should be given to him quickly without any further deliberation.

raw: प्लवमानाः खमाप्लुत्य ततस्ते काननौकसः । नन्दनोपममासेदुर्वनं द्रुमलतायुतम् ॥५-६१-७॥
translation: "The monkeys leaped into the sky and entered the garden that resembled the garden of Indra filled with trees and creepers.

raw: पिता ह्येनं जनयति पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ । प्रज्ञां ददाति चाचार्यस्तस्मात्स गुरुरुच्यते ॥२-१११-३॥
translation: O best of men, the father brings forth a son. The teacher imparts him wisdom. Therefore, the teacher is considered superior.

raw: निश्चेष्ट आहार सम्चारा वृक्ष एक स्थान विष्ठिताः । पक्षिणो अपि प्रयाचन्ते सर्व भूत अनुकम्पिनम् ॥२-४५-३१॥
translation: Even the birds instead of foraging for food are sitting motionless on the trees at one place. They are imploring you, you who are compassionate to all creatures, to return to Ayodhya.

raw: इह आश्रम पदोऽस्माकम् समीपे शुभ दर्शनाः । करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजाम् वै सर्वेषाम् विधि पूर्वकम् ॥१-१०-१५॥
translation: 'O auspiciouslooking women, our hermitage is nearby. I will extend to you due hospitality'.

raw: इति एवम् उक्त्वा वचनम् महार्थम्सा वानरी लक्ष्मणम् अप्रमेयम् । पुनः स खेदम् मद विह्वलाक्षीभर्तुर् हितम् वाक्यम् इदम् बभाषे ॥४-३३-५८॥
translation: Overcome by drunkenness, Tara once again spoke to Lakshmana of unfathomable prowess, in a meaningful way keeping in view the welfare of her playful and drunken lord:

raw: तैः पृषत्कैर्ललाटस्थैः शुशुभे रघुनन्दनः । रणाग्रे समरश्लाघी त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ॥६-९१-३४॥
translation: Lakshmana, the delight of Raghus, who loved to fight, looked charming in the battlefield with three arrows stuck on his forehead looking like three mountain peaks.

raw: स जीर्णं मानुषं देहं परित्यज्य पिता हि न: । दैवीमृद्धिमनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम् ॥२-१०५-३७॥
translation: Our father, king Dasaratha, abandoned the wornout mortal body, and obtained divine prosperity of wandering in the world of Brahma.

raw: स प्रविश्य आश्रम पदम् लक्ष्मणो राघव अनुजः । अगस्त्य शिष्यम् आसाद्य वाक्यम् एतद् उवाच ह ॥३-१२-१॥
translation: Lakshmana, the younger brother of Rama, entered the hermitage of Agastya and met one of his disciples and said to him these words :

raw: स त्वमिक्ष्वाकुनाथं वै क्षिपन्निह न लज्जसे । चक्षुषो विषयं तस्य न तावदुपगच्छसि ॥५-२०-१७॥
यानि रामस्य चिह्नानि लक्ष्मणस्य च यानि वै । लक्षितानि विशालाक्षि वदतः शृणु तानि मे ॥५-३५-७॥
translation: "O largeeyed lady I will describe those distinguishing marks of Rama and Lakshmana Listen.

raw: अद्यैव तं गमिष्यामि देशं यत्रानुजो मम । नहि भ्रातऽन् समुत्सृज्य क्षणं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥६-६८-१९॥
translation: "This very day, this very minute I shall reach the region where my brother died, I have no interest in life."

raw: अक्षया तु भवेत् प्रीतिः श्वश्रू श्वशुरयोः मम । यदि राज्यम् हि संन्यस्य भवेत् त्वम् निरतो मुनिः ॥३-९-२९॥
translation: You would have been on unlimited source of joy to my fatherinlaw and motherinlaw had you permanently renounced the kingdom for the life of an ascetic.

raw: ते वलाहक संकाशा महाकाया महाबलाः । अभ्यधावन्त काकुत्स्थम् रथैः वाजिभिः एव च ॥३-२५-९॥
translation: Very powerful demons like huge clouds roared, eager to kill Rama in war. They ran forward on chariots, horses and tall elephants, looking like mountain tops.

raw: स हि रूपोपपन्नश्च वीर्यवाननसूयकः । भूमावनुपमः सूनुर्गणैर्धशरथोपमः ॥२-१-९॥
translation: Endowed with beauty and strengh, free from envy, and in virtues equal to Dasaratha, Rama was verily an incomparable son on earth.

raw: भगवन् शब्दम् आलक्ष्य मया गज जिघाम्सुना । विसृष्टः अम्भसि नाराचः तेन ते निहतः सुतः ॥२-६४-१७॥
translation: O venerable one I released an arrow towards the water aiming at the sound intending to kill an elephant but it hit your son.

raw: अभ्यवर्तत काकुत्स्थमवतीर्य त्रिविष्टपात् ॥६-१०३-९॥
translation: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

raw: इह हैमवते पार्श्वे गर्भो अयम् संनिवेश्यताम् । श्रुत्वा तु अग्नि वचो गंगा तम् गर्भम् अतिभास्वरम् ॥१-३७-१७॥
पान भाजन विक्षिप्तैः फलैः च विविधैर् अपि । कृत पुष्प उपहारा भूर् अधिकम् पुष्यति श्रियम् ॥५-११-१७॥
translation: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.

raw: क्रुद्धम् निःश्वसमानम् तम् प्रदीप्तम् इव तेजसा । भ्रातुर् व्यसन संतप्तम् दृष्ट्वा दशरथ आत्मजम् ॥४-३४-२॥
translation: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

raw: लोकपीडाकरं कर्म न कर्तव्यं विचक्षणैः । बालानां तु शुभं वाक्यं ग्राह्य लक्ष्मणपूर्वज । तस्माच्छृणोमि ते वाक्यं साधु युक्तं महामते ॥७-८३-२०॥
translation: Wise people should not perform actions that cause distress to others, and indeed, O elder brother of Lakshmana, even the auspicious words of younger ones should be accepted; therefore, O great-minded one, I listen to your good and appropriate speech. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 83 ।। Thus ends the eighty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ऋषीणाम् दण्डकारण्ये संश्रुतम् जनकाअत्मजे । संश्रुत्य न च शक्ष्यामि जीवमानः प्रतिश्रवम् ॥३-१०-१७॥
स तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलो भृशताडितः । निपपात तदा कुम्भो गतार्चिरिव पावकः ॥६-७६-९०॥
translation: By the blow of Sugriva, that Kumbha was pained severely and overcome by fear he fell like fire which has lost its glow.

raw: उत्तमं जवमास्थाय शेषं पन्थानमास्थितः । ततो ऽहं सुचिरं कालं वेगेनाभ्यगमं पथि ॥५-५८-२०॥
translation: "Then with great speed I proceeded on my path. It took a long time to cross the ocean.

raw: नापि शूलं प्रजग्राह तं दृष्ट्वा भुवि पातितम् । ततो हत इति ज्ञात्वा तान्भक्षान्समुदावहत् ॥७-६९-१५॥
translation: Even after seeing Shatrughna fallen on the ground, Lavana did not pick up his trident; instead, thinking him dead, he carried away his prey.

raw: अन्योन्यैराहता स्सक्ता स्सस्वनुर्भीमनिस्स्वनाः । ऊर्मयस्सिन्धुराजस्य महाभेर्य इवाहवे ॥६-४-१२१॥
translation: The waves of the ocean striking each other making frightening sounds like the blowing of war horns seemed as if challenging each other.

raw: रथैरश्वैर्ध्वजैश्चित्रैः शरीरैर्हरिरक्षसाम् । रुधिरेण च सञ्छन्ना भूमिर्भयकरी तदा ॥६-५३-३०॥
translation: Then the wonderful chariots, flags, horses, Vanaras and Rakshasas bodies bathed in blood fell on the ground looked fearful.

raw: तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी । गर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम् ॥५-५८-८०॥
translation: "Janaki did not care for their words of threat, as though they were a blade of grass and of no use to her.

raw: तम् समीक्ष्य तु अवहितम् पितुर् निर्देश पालने । कौसल्या बाष्प सम्रुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२४-१॥
translation: Having perceived that Rama was determined to carry out his father's command, Kausalya with her throat choked with tears said these words of piety:

raw: श्रुत्वैव वचनं यन्मे राघवं पतिमिच्छथ । राजानः संशयोऽयं मे तदिदं ब्रूत तत्त्वतः ॥२-२-२४॥
translation: O kings, soon after listening to my words, all of you wish Rama to be king. (But) I doubt (in my mind) whether you have said it from your heart৷৷

raw: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः । न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ॥५-६८-२२॥
translation: 'When I could come here, what to speak of the mightier monkeys?, People do not send the superior ones on errand, but send only the juniors.

raw: प्रधानम् साधकम् वैद्यम् धर्म शीलम् च राक्षस । ज्ञातयो ह्यनमन्यन्ते शूरम् परिभवन्ति च ॥६-१६-४॥
translation: "O Rakshasa Relatives will insult and disapprove their chief even if he is an accomplished one, a virtuous one or a heroic one and does his duty (as a ruler)."

raw: सारवन्तोऽथ ये वृक्षा न्यमज्जन् लवणाम्भसि । भयादिव महेन्द्रस्य पर्वता वरुणालये ॥५-१-५०॥
translation: Then the huge trees sank into the ocean of salt water even as mountains did, afraid of Indra's (thunderbolt).

raw: सुषुवे यममित्रघ्नं कौसल्या नन्दवर्द्धनम् । भ्रात्रा सह सभार्यो यश्चिरं प्रव्राजितो वनम् ॥२-९०-११॥
translation: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?

raw: कथम् प्रमाणाः के च एतान् रक्षन्ति मुनिपुंगव । कथम् च प्रति कर्तव्यम् तेषाम् रामेण रक्षसाम् ॥१-२०-१३॥
श्रुत्वा नगानां चरितं महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः । चिच्छेद भगवान् पक्षान् वज्रेणैषां सहस्रशः ॥५-५८-१५॥
translation: 'Mahendra, the killer of ogre Paka, heard the story (of the cruel deeds) of mountains and cut off their wings into a thousand pieces with his thunderbolt.

raw: मार्गमाणो वने सीताम् राक्षसम् संददर्श ह । कबंधम् नाम रूपेण विकृतम् घोर दर्शनम् ॥१-१-५५॥
translation: Then he performed in the midst of tears the funeral rites of the vulture Jatayu. Wandering in search of Sita, he beheld a rakshasa named Kabandha who was dreadful, in deformed in appearance.

raw: अन्वीयमानस्तैर्वाली भ्राजते ऽम्बरमध्यगः । अन्वीयमानो मेघौघैरम्बरस्थ इवांशुमान् ॥७-३४-२४॥
translation: Vali, being followed by those Rakshasas in the middle of the sky, shone like the sun in the sky being followed by masses of clouds.

raw: एवम् उक्ता ततः तुष्टा जननी ते महाकपेः । गुहायाम् त्वाम् महाबाहो प्रजज्ञे प्लवगर्षभ ॥४-६६-२०॥
translation: 'O great monkey O strongshouldered one having been assured that way, your mother was pleased and delivered you, a bull among monkeys, in a cave.

raw: कच्चिच्च लक्ष्मणः शूरः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः । अस्त्रविच्छरजालेन राक्षसान् विधमिष्यति ॥५-३६-२६॥
translation: "Hope heroic Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra, who has mastered the use of weapons will blow away the demons through a network of arrows.

raw: नैव रात्रं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न च क्षणम् । रामरावणयोर्युद्धं विराममुपगच्छति ॥६-११०-३७॥
translation: The fight between Rama and Ravana continued all day and night, without stopping for a moment.

raw: न चैतदाश्चर्यतमम् यत्तज्ज्येष्ठस्सुतो मम । अपानृतकथम् पुत्र पितरम् कर्तुमिच्छ्सि ॥२-३४-३८॥
translation: It is not a great surprise that you, O my son, being the eldest, want to make your father free from a false promise.

raw: एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी । अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम ॥५-५८-२८॥
