translation: Thus addressed by me, that Surasa, who could take any form at will, said: None can pass me—this is my boon.

raw: ततः पादपसम्भाधं नानामृगसमायुताम । सह्यपर्वतमासेदुर्मलयञ्च महीधरम् ॥६-४-७२॥
translation: Thereafter having reached the dense forest filled with trees surrounded by the Malaya and Sahaya Mountain inhabited by different kinds of animals, the vanaras assembled.

raw: पुरस्य सुकृतं नाम वैजयन्तमिति श्रुतम् । निवेशं यत्र राजर्षिर्निमिश्चक्रे महायशाः ॥७-५५-६॥
translation: The city was known as Sukrita, or Vaijayanta, where the greatly renowned royal sage Nimi established his settlement.

raw: इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्मचारिणी । रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना ॥५-६५-२५॥
translation: "With her limbs emaciated through austerities detained in Ravana's inner palace, eyes wide open in fear, Sita said this to me:

raw: किमिदम् भाषसे राम वाक्यम् लघुतया ध्रुवम् । त्वया यदपहास्यम् मे श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज ॥२-२७-२॥
translation: O Rama why are you speaking so lightly? O prince if you hear these very same words (spoken to you), you will ridicule me.

raw: स पर्यदेवन्विधवा न च व्यालकृतंभयम् । न व्याधिजंभयंचासीद्रामेराज्यंप्रशासति ॥६-१३१-९९॥
translation: While Rama was ruling there was no lamentation of widows (over their loss), fear of cruel animals, or fear of disease.

raw: देव कल्पम् ऋजुम् दान्तम् रिपूणाम् अपि वत्सलम् । अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मम् त्यजेत् पुत्रम् अकारणात् ॥२-२१-६॥
translation: With no cause nor concern for righteousness, will any one abandon his son who is nearly equal to god, upright, selfrestrained and loved even by his enemies ?

raw: इति बृवन्तं मुदिताः प्रत्यनन्दन् नृपा नृपम् । वृष्तिमन्तं महामेघं नर्दन्त इव बर्हिणः ॥२-२-१७॥
translation: Having thus heard king Dasaratha speak, the kings acclaimed him with delight, like peacocks crying (in joy) to see thick clouds.

raw: अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनुमाञ्शिंशपाद्रुमे । सीतां सन्तर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्षसीरशृणोत्कपिः ॥५-२२-९॥
गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै । प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ॥५-६८-५॥
translation: 'O courageous tiger among monkeys when you depart (abruptly) I doubt if I would be alive by your return.

raw: अन्न कूटाः च दृश्यन्ते बहवः पर्वत उपमाः । दिवसे दिवसे तत्र सिद्धस्य विधिवत् तदा ॥१-१४-१५॥
translation: There, could be seen day after day heaps of nicely cooked food, looking like mountains.

raw: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया । स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते संध्या कालो अतिवर्तते ॥१-४४-२०॥
translation: O Rama I have related you the story of Ganga in detail. Evening time is passing by (and we shall perform the ablutions) farewell.

raw: केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रो ऽस्य निलीनो दक्षिणामुखः । तुदन्नुभयतः पार्श्वं समग्रामहरत् प्रभाम् ॥६-५७-३९॥
translation: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.

raw: दुर्ग गंभीर परिखाम् दुर्गाम् अन्यैः दुरासदम् । वाजीवारण संपूर्णाम् गोभिः उष्ट्रैः खरैः तथा ॥१-५-१३॥
translation: It was enclosed by strong fortifications and a deep moat. No enemy can ever enter and occupy that city. It abounded with several elephants and horses, cattle, camels and mules.

raw: बहुशः सेविते वीरैर्विद्याधरगणैर्वरैः । जगाम वायुमार्गे तु गरुत्मानिव मारुतिः ॥५-१-१८०॥
translation: Hanuman passed through the path of wind like Garuda. The region was refreshed with clouds that released torrents of rain and frequented by birds. The great masters of music (Tumburu, Narada and Gandharvas) trained in Kasika moved there driven by lions, elephants, tigers, birds and serpents and were moving in different aerial vehicles. It was splendid with god at fire who strikes fiercely like thunderbolt. It was inhabited by great sages who had acquired merit. The region was traversed by firegod who carried havis in large quantities earnestly. It was decorated with planets, constellations, Moon, Sun and clusters of stars. It was filled with groups of greal sages, gandharvas, nagas and yakshas. It was isolated part of the universe traversed by the king of gandharvas like Vishvavasu. It was an auspicious path for Moon and Sun, a sporting ground for Airavata, the vehicle of lord Indra. It was an extensive world of living beings created by Brahma. It was frequented by many heroes ascending to heaven and blocked by vidyadharas.

raw: तेन त्वद्भुतरूपेण यत्तत्तव मनोहरम् । नानामृगगणाकीर्णं प्रमृष्टं प्रमदावनम् ॥५-४२-१६॥
translation: "Your beautiful pleasure garden filled with a variety of beasts has been ruined by this wonderful figure.

raw: यथा ने भरतो मान्यस्तथा भूयोऽपि राघावः । कौसल्यातोऽरिक्तं च सो हि शुश्रूषते हि माम् ॥२-८-१८॥
translation: For me, if Bharata is worthy of consideration Rama is worthier. He serves me even more (scrupulously) than he does Kausalya.

raw: सगरस्य नरश्रेष्ठ यजेयम् इति निश्चिता । स कृत्वा निश्चयम् राजा स उपाध्याय गणः तदा । यज्ञ कर्मणि वेदज्ञो यष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे ॥१-३८-२४॥
translation: O Rama having determined to perform a sacrifice, he (Sagara) versed in the Vedas, started the initiatory rites for the sacrifice in the company of high priests". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टात्रिंशस्सर्ग: 2 Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गो ऽहं लोकयात्रां प्रवर्त्तये । अकुह: श्रद्दधानस्सन् कार्य्याकार्य्यविचक्षण: ॥२-१०९-२७॥
translation: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented and with a mind that discriminates between what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

raw: तरसा सेतु बन्धेन सागर उच्चोषणेन वा । सर्वथा सुसमर्थो अस्मि सागरस्य अस्य लन्घने ॥६-३-२॥
translation: "By austerity or by drying up the ocean or by any other means, I am capable of crossing the ocean."

raw: वज्रदंष्ट्रं हतं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रेण रावणः । बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिमवस्थितम् ॥६-५५-१॥
translation: On hearing about Vajradamshtra being killed by Vali's son, Ravana spoke to the chief of the army who stood with folded hands.

raw: गन्ध आढ्यान्य् अभिरम्याणि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च । धारयन्त्य् अगमास् तत्र भूषणानि इव मानवाः ॥६-३९-७॥
translation: Having reached there where trees bore fragrance, very beautiful flowers and fruits seemed as though humans were wearing ornaments.

raw: तत् ब्रूहि वचनम् देवि राज्ञो यद् अभिकान्क्षितम् । करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामः द्विर् न अभिभाषते ॥२-१८-३०॥
translation: Hence tell me, O Devi Whatever be the desire of the king: I promise I shall carry out, Rama does not say two things (does not go back on his word).

raw: तमब्रवीन्महतेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ॥६-५९-४८॥
translation: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."

raw: स त्रिरात्रोषितस्तत्र नयज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः । उपासत तदा रामः सागरम् सरिताम् पतिम् ॥६-२१-११॥
translation: Rama, a lover of dharma, who had political foresight, spent three nights waiting upon the ocean, the Lord of rivers.

raw: यदि त्वभिहितं राज्ञा त्वयि तन्न विपत्स्यते । ततोऽहमभिधास्यामि न ह्येष त्वयि वक्ष्यति ॥२-१८-२६॥
translation: If you do not transgress the word given by the king I shall tell you everything. The king on his own will not tell you.

raw: सूर्येणोदयता काले नक्षत्राणीव नाशिताः । अहो सुबलवद्रक्षो वधोपायेषु युज्यते ॥७-२४-१८॥
translation: Just as stars are destroyed by the rising sun, so too are our husbands, and alas, the very strong demon Ravana is engaged in means of killing.

raw: मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलम् शुभलक्षम्ण । अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च ॥२-२१-३९॥
translation: O Lakshamana of auspicious qualities, since my mother is not aware of the significance of truth and selfrestraint, she is overcome with grief, great and incomparable.

raw: स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी च धर्मं सर्वात्मना श्रितः । सम्यग्योक्ता श्रेयसां च न विगृह्य कथारुचिः ॥२-२-४२॥
इति सम्चिन्त्य भूयो अपि विचेतुम् उपचक्रमे । भूमी गृहामः चैत्य गृहान् गृह अतिगृहकान् अपि ॥५-१२-१४॥
translation: Thinking thus, he started searching once again the basement cells, temples, homes within homes.

raw: क्रोशन्ती राम राम इति लक्ष्मण इति च भामिनी । भूषणानि अपविध्यन्ती गात्राणि च विधुन्वती ॥४-५८-१६॥
translation: 'I saw a young lady of beautiful appearance, adorned with all kinds of ornaments borne away by the evilminded Ravana. That dainty lady was calling out, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana' and was crying aloud. She was throwing away her ornaments and was wriggling to get out of Ravana's grip.

raw: ऋषीणाम् च द्विजातीनाम् साधूनाम् च समागमे । यथा उपदेशम् तत्त्वज्ञौ जगतुः तौ समाहितौ ॥१-४-१३॥
translation: These two princes blameless, disciplined and wellversed, committed to memory the whole epic and chanted as instructed in the assembly of rishis, brahmins and saints.

raw: स तया मालया वीरो हैमया हरियूथपः । संध्यानुगत पर्यन्तः पयोधर इव अभवत् ॥४-१७-६॥
translation: Vali, the chief hero of the monkeys, with his golden necklace appeared like the raincloud hallowed by the glowing twilight.

raw: उत्पात वात अभिहता नाना द्विज गण आयुताः । मा भैः इति विधूत अग्रा व्याजह्रुः इव पादपाः ॥३-५२-३४॥
translation: The trees filled with birds of all kinds, shaken at the top by stormy winds seemed to be saying to Sita, 'Be not afraid'.

raw: न इदम् अत्र त्वया ग्राह्यम् साधु वृत्तेन लक्ष्मण । ताम् प्रीतिम् अनुवर्तस्व पूर्व वृत्तम् च संगतम् ॥४-३१-७॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana with your good conduct you should not do so. Keeping in view the affectionate friendship extended (by Sugriva) earlier, be friendly.

raw: पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः । तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलनन्दनः ॥७-७९-५॥
translation: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful lord named Manu, the wielder of the scepter, and his great son, Ikshvaku, was the delight of his family.

raw: तत् च अपि न कृतम् कार्यम् अस्माभिः इह वासिभिः । एवम् उक्ता हनुमता तापसी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५२-२५॥
ततः शरशतेनैव सुप्रयुक्तेन वीर्यवान् । क्रोधाद्द्विगुणसंरब्धो निर्बिभेद विभीषणम् ॥६-८९-१४॥
translation: Then valiant Rakshasa, doubly angry pierced well targeted hundred arrows at Vibheeshana.

raw: लक्ष्मणश्चापि रामश्च शरैराशीविषोपमैः । दृश्यादृश्यानि रक्षांसि प्रवराणि निजघ्नतुः ॥६-४४-९॥
translation: Then Rama as well as Lakshmana with their venomous snakelike arrows killed both visible and invisible principal Rakshasas.

raw: यद् अग्नि दायके पापम् यत् पापम् गुरु तल्पगे । मित्र द्रोहे च यत् पापम् तत् पापम् प्रतिपद्यताम् ॥२-७५-४५॥
translation: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person who sets fire to human settlements, violates the preceptors's bed and betrays his friend

raw: विमलम् प्राम्शु भावत्वाद् उल्लिखन्तम् इव अम्बरम् । ततो मलिन सम्वीताम् राक्षसीभिः समावृताम् ॥५-१५-१८॥
प्रांजलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच पितामहम् । ब्रह्मर्षि शब्दम् अतुलम् स्व अर्जितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः ॥१-६३-२०॥
विप्रलम्बितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचायुधम् । समुद्यतमहाप्रासं यष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम् । प्रावर्तत महारौद्रं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् ॥६-७५-६८॥
translation: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.

raw: ततः सलिलमादाय विद्यया परिजप्य च । सुग्रीवनेत्रे धर्मात्मा स ममार्ज विभीषणः ॥६-४६-३६॥
translation: Thereafter the dutiful Vibheeshana taking water as per tradition consecrated chanting sacred text and wiped Sugriva's eyes.

raw: एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना । अब्रवीद्रावणं सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः ॥६-१०६-१०॥
translation: When the insensitive Ravana spoke harshly in that manner, to the charioteer who was wishing his benefit, he spoke in friendly language to Ravana.

raw: न एव देवा महत्मनो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा । शरा रामेण तु उत्सृष्टा रुक्मपुंखाः पतत्रिणः ॥३-३१-१८॥
translation: Indeed, they are great men. No god came there (to lend him a hand). There is no need to investigate further about it. The goldenfeathered arrows released by Rama turned into fivehooded serpents and consumed the demons.

raw: तद्धि तेजस्तु मित्रस्य उर्वस्याः पूर्वमाहितम् । तस्मिन्समभवत्कुम्भे तत्तेजो यत्र वारुणम् ॥७-५७-६॥
translation: That semen of Mitra, which had previously been placed in Urvashi, was born in that pot where the semen of Varuna was also present.

raw: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे । नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य साहाय्यं कार्यसाधने ॥५-३०-३२॥
translation: "If I am killed in the combat or captured by the demons, I do not see another person who can help in accomplishing this task.

raw: सर्वमद्यैव यूपाक्ष हरिसैन्यं सलक्ष्मणम् । राघवं च रणे हत्वा पश्चाद्द्रक्ष्यामि रावणम् ॥६-६०-८०॥
translation: "I will conquer now the Vanara army along with Lakshmana and Raghava in war and see Ravana."

raw: अनुचिन्त्य सुमित्रायै पुनः एव महीपतिः । एवम् तासाम् ददौ राजा भार्याणाम् पायसम् पृथक् ॥१-१६-२९॥
translation: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

raw: क्षिति क्षमा पुष्कर सम्निभ अक्षी । या रक्षिता राघव लक्ष्मणाभ्याम् । सा राक्षसीभिर् विकृत ईक्षणाभिः । सम्रक्ष्यते सम्प्रति वृक्ष मूले ॥५-१६-२९॥
translation: She who has beautiful eyes like lotus petals, was protected by the arms of both Rama and Lakshmna, who is tolerant like the earth and is guarded by the female demons of hideous appearance under a tree.

raw: सुस्राव नयनैः स्त्रीणामस्रमायाससम्भवम् । मीनसम्क्षोभचलितैः सलिलम् पङ्कजैरिव ॥२-४०-३५॥
translation: Tears born of anguish fell from the eyes of women just as waterdrops fall from lotuses shaken by the movements of fishes.

raw: रुक्मपुङ्खैः प्रसन्नाग्रैरधोगतिभिराशुगैः । नाराचैरर्धनाराचैर्भल्लैरञ्जलिकैरपि । विव्याध वत्सदन्तैश्च सिंहदंष्ट्रैः क्षुरैस्तथा ॥६-४५-२३॥
translation: Indrajith pierced Rama with arrows coated with gold and gold tipped arrows, which had even and circular heads, with halfmoon arrows, with axe like heads, heads like joined palms, heads resembling teeth of calf and lion teeth arrows as well as razor sharp arrows which descended quickly unobstructed like dust.

raw: बहुरूपाः सुमधुराः कथास्तत्र सहस्रशः । कथयामास स मुनिः शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने ॥७-७१-५॥
translation: That sage narrated thousands of stories, varied in form and very sweet, to the great-souled Shatrughna.

raw: प्रासादश्पङ्गैर्विविधैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः । आवारयद्भि र्गनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरैः ॥२-१७-१८॥
translation: That prince (Rama) arrived at the excellent palace of the king, which looked like the abode of Indra on earth, blazing with splendour. The various towers of the palace touching the sky resembled clusters of white clouds, like auspicious peaks of Kailasa, and like white aerial chariots decorated with gems.

raw: अयं व्याघ्रसमीपे तु पुराणो धर्मसंस्थितः । ऋक्षेण गीतः श्लोको मे तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम ॥६-११६-४२॥
translation: "O Monkey! In olden days a bear had uttered a verse which conforms to righteousness. I shall tell you now."

raw: न हि प्रतिज्ञां कुर्वन्ति वितथां साधवो ऽनघ । लक्षणं हि महत्त्वस्य प्रतिज्ञापरिपालनम् ॥६-१०२-४०॥
translation: 'Those who speak truth never fail their vows futile for fulfilment of the vows is a mark of greatness for them'.

raw: तस्यां सक्तमनास्तात पञ्चवर्षशतान्यहम् । सा च दैवतकार्येण त्रयोदश समा गताः ॥७-१२-७॥
translation: O dear one, I was devoted to her for five hundred years, and she has now been gone for thirteen years for a divine purpose.

raw: कामं शतं सहस्रं वा न ह्येष विधिरुच्यते । योजनानां भवान् शक्तो गन्तुं प्रतिनिवर्तितुम् ॥४-६५-२१॥
translation: 'You can go upto even a hundred thousand yojanas and have the required energy to return also. But it is not proper to send you (because you are the heir apparent).

raw: एवम् उक्तो नरपतिः ब्राह्मणैः वेद पारगैः । गवाम् शत सहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृपः ॥१-१४-५०॥
translation: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.

raw: न खल्वियं मतिः श्रेष्ठा यत्त्वां संप्रेषयाम्यहम् । इयं च राजधर्माणां क्षत्रस्य च मतिर्मता ॥५-४८-१४॥
translation: "I am reluctant to send you to war in the circumstances. But you are the best choice for me. However, certainly this is the duty of a kshatriya who follows the science of polity. Hence I am sending you.

raw: पुरा वृत्र वधे वृत्ते स च अहम् च जय एषिणौ । आदित्यम् उपयातौ स्वो ज्वलंतम् रश्मि मालिनम् ॥४-५८-४॥
translation: 'In olden days, when Indra killed Vrutra we (Jatayu and I) seeking to challenge him reached the Sun blazing with a garland of beams.

raw: अयम् इक्ष्वाकु दायादो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः । तस्य एव अवरजम् विद्धि भ्रातरम् माम् च लक्ष्मणम् ॥३-७०-१३॥
translation: Here is Rama, an heir of the Ikshvaku family, known to the people and I am his younger brother Lakshmana for your information.

raw: ततः सचिव संदिष्टा हरयो रोमहर्षणाः । गिरि कुंजर मेघ आभा नगर्या निर्ययुः तदा ॥४-३१-२३॥
translation: Commanded by the ministers, the monkeys who looked like fierce mountains, elephants and clouds that caused horripilation, left the place at once.

raw: विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा । भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ॥७-१०५-७॥
translation: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.

raw: ब्रह्मन् नप्रतिजानीमो नास्तिको जायते जनः । सम्मूढम् इव त्रैलोक्यम् संप्रक्षुभित मानसम् ॥१-६५-१५॥
ततस्तुवातोद्धतमेघकल्पंभुजङ्गराजोत्तमभोगबाहुम् । तमापतन्तंधरणीराभमुवाचरामोकुम्भकर्णम् ॥६-६७-१४५॥
translation: Thereafter Rama spoke to Kumbhakarna, whose hands were like Vasuki's body, coming towards him to attack on the battlefield like a cloud chased by wind.

raw: न मोक्ष्यसे रावण राघवस्य । सर्वैः सहेन्द्रैदपि मूढ गुप्तः । अन्तर्हतः सूर्यपथम् गतोऽपि । तथैव पातालमनुप्रविष्टः ॥६-२०-२५॥
translation: "O Foolish Ravana Even if you go to a secret place, or rendered invisible by your interposition, or go into the orbit of the Sun, or go underground to Patala or go to the feet of Lord Siva for protection, you cannot escape from Rama. You along with your brother will be slain."

raw: हिताश्च शूराश्च समाहिताश्च कुलेषु जाताश्च महागुणेषु । मनस्विनः शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठाः कोट्यग्रतस्ते सुभृताश्च योधाः ॥५-५२-२४॥
translation: "You have with you wellwishers, courageous ones, who have good qualities born in a good race, who are noble, sensible people, wielders of weapons and wellpaid warriors in crores.

raw: तथा विधानम् क्रियताम् समर्थाः साधनेषु इति । तथा इति च अब्रुवन् सर्वे मंत्रिणः प्रतिपूजिता ॥१-८-१९॥
राक्षसानां जनस्थाने सहस्राणि चतुर्दश । येनैकेन निरस्तानि स मां किं नाभिपद्यते ॥५-२४-१३॥
अथ वर्ष शते पूर्णे तपसा आराधितो मुनिः । सगराय वरम् प्रादाद् भृगुः सत्यवताम् वरः ॥१-३८-६॥
translation: When Sagara completed a hundred years in austerities, highly pleased by his performance, ascetic Bhrugu, the best among the truthful granted him a boon.

raw: यद् आचरति कल्याणि शुभम् वा यदि वा अशुभम् । तत् एव लभते भद्रे कर्ता कर्मजम् आत्मनः ॥२-६३-६॥
translation: O gentle auspicious lady a man has to reap the fruit of his action, good or evil.

raw: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः । तस्मृगद्विजसम्घष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम् ॥५-१८-२७॥
translation: Surrounded by beauties, the glorious king entered the grove meant for women, reverberating with the sounds of beasts and birds.

raw: वेष्टयन्ति स्म लाङ्गूलं जीर्णैः कार्पासकैः पटैः ॥५-५३-६॥
translation: "Obeying the orders of the king, the brutally angry demons wrapped his tail with tatters of cotton.

raw: प्रस्थाप्य चीर वसनम् पुत्रम् मे वन वासिनम् । कैकेयी कम् गुणम् तत्र पश्यति क्रूर दर्शिनी ॥२-७५-१२॥
translation: What advantage did cruel Kaikeyi visualize in sending away my son to dwell in the forest wearing robes of bark?

raw: कच्चिदेषैव ते बुद्धिर्यथोक्ता मम राघव । आयुष्या च यशस्या च धर्मकामार्थसंहिता ॥२-१००-७४॥
translation: O Bharata, I trust your intellect is in conformity with what I said conducive to long life, and fame in accordance with righteousness, (legitimate) pleasure and prosperity.

raw: पूजयन्ति महत्मनम् जह्नुम् पुरुष सत्तमम् । गंगम् च अपि नयन्ति स्म दुहितृत्वे महात्मनः ॥१-४३-३६॥
translation: Devatas, rishis and gandharvas stood amazed (at this act). They worshipped the magnanimous Jahnu, noblest among men. The devatas entreated the illustrious Jahnu to treat Ganga as his daughter.

raw: एवम् विधो यस्य दूतो न भवेत् पार्थिवस्य तु । सिद्ध्यन्ति हि कथम् तस्य कार्याणाम् गतयोऽनघ ॥४-३-३४॥
translation: 'O sinless one, how can a king, whoever he be, not accomplish his goal in the past with such an ambassador?

raw: उद्विग्न हृदयः सर्वा दिशः समवलोकयन् । न व्यतिष्ठत कस्मिन् चित् देशे वानर पुङ्गवः ॥४-२-२॥
translation: Agitated at heart, the best of vanaras started in all directions and could not settle down at one spot.

raw: उत्पपाताथ वेगेन वेगवानविचारयन् । सुपर्णमिव चात्मानं मेने स कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-१-४४॥
translation: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.

raw: तौ तदा युद्ध्यमानौ तु समरे रामरावणौ । ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि विस्मितेनान्तरात्मना ॥६-११०-१॥
translation: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.

raw: राम सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो यदि वा श्रुतः । कैलासे येन सङ्ग्रामे मणिभद्रः पराजितः ॥६-१९-११॥
translation: "Rama You might have heard of Prahastha who the commander in chief of his (Ravana's) army is by whom Manibhadra (Kubera's Commander of Army) was defeated in a comb at in Kailas (the abode of Siva)."

raw: अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम । अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वांश्चामन्त्रयामि वः ॥६-१२५-१९॥
translation: "I shall proceed to my father's capital, Ayodhya. You may permit me. Be auspicious. I take leave of you."

raw: नरः यानेन यः स्वप्ने खर युक्तेन याति हि । अचिरात् तस्य धूम अग्रम् चितायाम् सम्प्रदृश्यते ॥२-६९-१८॥
translation: If one beholds in a dream a person setting out on a carriage yoked to asses, the wreath of smoke ascending from his funeral pyre will be seen soon.

raw: सृष्टः क्रोधाभिभूतेन विनाशार्थं दुरात्मनोः । मधुकैटभयोर्वीर विघाते वर्तमानयोः । स्रष्टुकामेन लोकांस्त्रींस्तौ चानेन हतौ युधि ॥७-६३-२२॥
translation: O hero, this arrow was created by the angry (Vishnu) for the destruction of the two wicked demons, Madhu and Kaitabha, who were obstructing the creation of the three worlds, and indeed, those two were killed in battle by this very arrow.

raw: यो हि नः सुमहान्नाथः सोऽपि प्रव्राजितो वनम् । अनया धर्ममुत्सृज्य मात्रा मे राघवः स्वयम् ॥२-८१-७॥
translation: Even Rama, a great protector for all of us, has been banished to the forest by my mother bereft of virtuous conduct.

raw: प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः । हविस्तत् प्रतिजग्राह पावकः स्वयमास्थितः ॥६-७३-२२॥
translation: The fire god himself, decked in polished gold ornaments turned round and accepted the offerings.

raw: एष दाशरथी रामः सुग्रीवसहितो बली । समुद्रं सबलस्तीर्त्वा मूलं नः परिकृन्तति ॥६-६२-१४॥
translation: "Rama, the son of Dasaratha accompanied by Sugriva, crossed the ocean with an army that was cutting our roots."

raw: संप्रहारः तु सुमहान् भविष्यति न संशयः । अयम् आख्याति मे बाहुः स्फुरमाणो मुहुर् मुहुः ॥३-२४-७॥
translation: A mass destruction of life is going to take place. There is no doubt about it. O brave Lakshmana my right shoulder trembles again and again, indicating the defeat of the enemy. Your beaming visage presages victory.

raw: ततो हलहलाशब्दं काञ्चीनूपुरमिश्रितम् । शृणोम्यधिकगम्भीरं रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-५८-६२॥
translation: "Then I heard a deep sound mixed with jingling golden girdles and anklets coming from Ravana's residence.

raw: नारायणो बाणवराशनीभिर्विदारयामास धनुर्विमुक्तैः । नक्तञ्चरान्मुक्तविधूतकेशान्यथा ऽशनीभिः सतडिन्महाभ्राः ॥७-७-५०॥
translation: Narayana, with excellent arrows released from his bow like thunderbolts, tore apart the night-wandering Rakshasas whose hair was loose and disheveled, just as thunderbolts tear apart great clouds accompanied by lightning.

raw: ततो निक्षिप्तभारो ऽहं राघवेण समागत: । निवेद्य गुरवे राज्यं भजिष्ये गुरुवृत्तिताम् ॥२-११५-१९॥
translation: The burden of this kingdom has been cast on me. On reunion with Rama, I shall hand it over to my brother, my guru and shall be engaged in his service.

raw: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे । रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ॥५-४०-१३॥
translation: "O irreproachable lady I swear by you that Rama has grown averse to everything out of grief of separation from you. When Rama is in grief even Lakshmana gets immersed in sorrow.

raw: विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य शतानंदम् च धार्मिकम् । प्रपा मध्ये तु विधिवत् वेदीम् कृत्वा महातपाः ॥१-७३-२०॥
translation: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.

raw: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनं प्रतस्थे लक्ष्मणोऽग्रतः । अनन्तरं च सीताया राघवो रघुनन्दनः ॥२-५२-९९॥
translation: Having heard the words of Rama, Lakshmana went ahead and Rama, delight of the Raghus, walked behind Sita.

raw: अद्य लोकास्त्रयः कृत्स्ना पृथिवी च सकानना । एकेनेन्द्रजिता हीना शून्येव प्रतिभाति मे ॥६-९३-११॥
translation: Today without Indrajith alone the three worlds (earth, heaven, and underworld) including forests are desolate, dark, and lustreless to me.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा तु तान् दूतान् भरतः पार्थिव आत्मजः । दूतैः सम्चोदितः वाक्यम् मातामहम् उवाच ह ॥२-७०-१४॥
translation: Having addressed the messengers who were pressing him to leave (for Ayodhya) Bharata said to his maternal grandfather:

raw: समा द्वादश तत्राहं राघवस्य निवेशने । भुञ्जाना मानुषान् भोगान् सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी ॥५-३३-१८॥
translation: "I enjoyed worldly pleasures in abundance for twelve years at Rama's abode.

raw: बाणौघैर्वितताः सर्वा दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा । सञ्छन्ना वसुधा चैव समन्तान्न प्रकाशते ॥६-७९-२८॥
translation: All quarters were covered by the arrows in that manner all over and even the intermediate point, the earth could not be seen.

raw: ते रक्तकण्ठिनः सर्वे किन्नरा इव शिक्षिताः । तुष्टुवुर्नपतिं वीरं यथावत् सम्प्रहर्षिणः ॥७-३७-३॥
translation: All of them, with melodious voices, trained like Kinnaras, greatly rejoicing, duly praised the heroic king.

raw: चापवेगविनिर्मुक्तबाणजालैः समन्ततः । अन्तरिक्षे हि सञ्छन्ने न रूपाणि चकाशिरे ॥६-९०-३१॥
translation: As they were discharging arrows from the bow swiftly, the arrows formed a net covering all over the sky and no object could be visible.

raw: देशस्य पूजाम् ताम् दृष्ट्वा कृताम् शक्रेण धीमता । एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घ कालम् अरिन्दम ॥१-२४-२४॥
translation: Having seen the honour bestowed on that land by the wise Indra, the gods said to him, 'Well done, Well done'.

raw: विनष्टम् माम् इह श्रुत्वा व्यक्तम् हास्यति जीवितम् । एतावत् उक्त्वा वचनम् वृद्धान् तान् अभिवाद्य च ॥४-५५-१६॥
ते तु ताम् रजनीम् उष्य ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः । उपतस्थुर् उपस्थानम् सह राज पुरोहिताः ॥२-१५-१॥
translation: The brahmins wellversed in the Vedas stayed waiting all night and assembled at the pavilion (for the consecration ceremony) along with royal priests.

raw: स हि शूरः महा बाहुः पुत्रः दशरथस्य च । पुरा भवति नो दूरात् अनुगच्चाम राघवम् ॥२-४८-१६॥
translation: Before that valiant, strongarmed son of Dasaratha goes too far away (from us), we should follow him.

raw: स विद्धो बहुभिर् बाणैः खड्गाभ्याम् च परिक्षतः । निष्पिष्टो बहुधा भूमौ न ममार स राक्षसः ॥३-४-८॥
translation: Although pierced by arrows, and wounded by the two swords, and pulverized on the ground, the demon did not die.

raw: तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादिभिः । ह्रियमाणा तदा तेन रक्षसा काम रूपिणा ॥५-१५-२७॥
नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुर्नैर्ऋतर्षभाः । देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः ॥६-७०-१॥
translation: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.

raw: अथ अस्य चपला माता तत् स्व कर्म यथा तथम् । तेन एव स्त्री स्वभावेन व्याहर्तुम् उपचक्रमे ॥२-७२-४६॥
translation: Then the capricious mother, with the same feminine disposition which she had displayed earlier, started giving a faithful account of all her deeds.

raw: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य कृतार्था रघुनन्दन । प्रणिपत्य सुराः सर्वे पितामहम् अपूजयन् ॥१-३७-९॥
translation: "O son of the Raghus having heard Brahma's words all the devatas considered themselves successful in their mission. They saluted him with folded hands and offered their worship.

raw: रावणस्यापनीतेन दुर्विनीतस्य दुर्मतेः । अयं निष्ठानको घोरः शोकेन समभिप्लुतः ॥६-९५-३६॥
translation: "Because of the misconduct of the evilminded Ravana's immoral action, terrific destruction attended by grief stares at us."

raw: कः त्वया सुखिना राजन् न अभिनन्दति पापकृत् । केन इदम् उपदिष्टम् ते मृत्यु द्वारम् उपायतः ॥३-४१-३॥
translation: Which sinner is not able to see you happy? O king by whom is this gate of death shown to you cunningly?

raw: उपदिष्टम् सुसूक्ष्म अर्थम् शास्त्रम् यत्नेन धीमता । स नाशयतु दुष्ट आत्मा यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२८॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire demerit in the same way as an evilhearted person who forever destroys the subtle meaning of the scriptures imparted carefully by a sagacious preceptor

raw: स तस्य दृष्ट्यर्पणसंप्रचोदितः प्रतापवान् काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः । समुत्पपाताथ सदस्युदीरितो द्विजातिमुख्यैर्हविषेव पावकः ॥५-४७-२॥
translation: Spurred by the mere glance of Ravana, the glorious Aksha with his wonderful bow inlaid with gold sprang up from the royal assembly just as flame rises from firesanctuary when oblations are poured in by reputed brahmins.

raw: रजनीचरसत्त्वानि प्रचरन्ति समन्तत: । तपोवनमृगा ह्येते वेदितीर्थेषु शेरते ॥२-११९-७॥
translation: The night rangers have started moving everywhere and the deer in the penance grove are beginning to sleep around the sacred altars.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमः सर्गः ॥ ९७ ॥६-९७-३७॥
श्रूयताम् वत्स काकुत्स्थ यस्य एतत् दारुणम् वनम् । एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ पूर्वम् आस्ताम् नरोउत्तम ॥१-२४-१७॥
पार्श्वतः पृष्टतश्चास्य सर्वे यूथपाधिपाः स्वयम् । अनुजह्रुर्महाशैलान् विविधांश्च महाद्रुमान् ॥६-९७-८॥
translation: All the leaders of the army themselves seizing hold of huge mountains and trees of several kinds followed his side.

raw: व्याहृताः पुण्य्शब्दाश्च वीणानाम् चापि निस्स्वनाः । आशीर्गेयम् च गाथानाम् पूरयामास वेश्म तत ॥२-६५-६॥
translation: The sacred songs of bards and panegyrists, notes of veena, chantings of metrical hymns and benedictory verses filled the palace.

raw: उपसम्पादयामास कौसल्या पमाङ्गना । उपाध्यायः स विधिना हुत्व शान्तिमनामयम् ॥२-२५-२९॥
मुख्यो वानर मुख्यानाम् केसरी नाम यूथपः । षष्टिर् गिरि सहस्राणाम् रम्याः कान्चन पर्वताः ॥६-२७-३८॥
विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनो ऽन्ये च राक्षसाः ॥६-१२६-८॥
translation: "There is the Rakshasa by name Vikata killed by Angada, and Virupaksha (killed by Sugriva), Mahaparsva (killed by Rshaba), Mahodara (killed by Neela), Akampana and other Rakshasas, like Trisira killed by the mighty Hanuman and Atikaya by Lakshmana and Devanthaka (by Hanuman), and Naranthaka (by Angada)."

raw: एतत् च वन मध्यस्थम् कृष्ण अभ्र शिखर उपमम् । पावकस्य आश्रमस्थस्य धूमाग्रम् संप्रदृश्यते ॥३-११-५१॥
translation: In the middle of the forest can be seen like the tip of the dark clouds columns of smoke coming out of the top of hermitages.

raw: मया खलु तदेवेदं रोषदोषात् प्रदर्शितम् । प्रथितं त्रिषु लोकेषु कपित्वमनवस्थितम् ॥५-५५-१६॥
translation: 'On account of my mistake of yielding to anger, I have exhibited the unstable monkeynature and made it well established in the three worlds.

raw: वात अयन गतानाम् च स्त्रीणाम् अन्वन्तर आपणम् । राम शोक अभितप्तानाम् शुश्राव परिदेवनम् ॥२-५७-१५॥
translation: (He) heard wailings of women looking through the window and of the people in marketplaces burning with sorrow over Rama's exile.

raw: भाषाज्ञानिङ्गितज्ञांश्च नैगमांश्चाप्यशेषतः । हेतूपचारकुशलान् वचने चापि हैतुकान् ॥७-९४-८॥
translation: He assembled those who were proficient in languages, understood gestures, were completely knowledgeable in the Vedas, skilled in reasoning and its application, and adept logicians in speech.

raw: स वृक्षषण्डांस्तरसा जहार शैलान् शिलाः प्राकृतवानरांश्च । बाहूरुवेगोद्धतसम्प्रणुन्नास्ते क्षीणवेगाः सलिले निपेतुः ॥६-७४-५०॥
translation: By the speed of his arms and thighs clusters of branches of trees, mountains, rocks, and common monkeys were attracted, and with reduction of speed along the way the rocks fell.

raw: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः । नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ॥६-१०७-१८॥
translation: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.

raw: रामोऽप्युत्थाप्य राजानं कैकेय्याभिप्रचोदितः । कशयेवाहतो वाजी वनं गन्तुं कृतत्वरः ॥२-१९-१८॥
translation: Rama lifted up the king and, urged by Kaikeyi, hastened to depart for the forest like a horse flogged by a whip.

raw: ततः वैखानसम् मार्गम् आस्थितः सह लक्ष्मणः । व्रतम् आदिष्टवान् रामः सहायम् गुहम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-७१॥
translation: Having adopted the path of ascetics along with Lakshmana, Rama said to his friend Guha:

raw: शतश्शतसहस्रैश्च कोटिभिश्च सहस्रशः । वानराणां सुघोराणां श्रीमत्परिवृता मही ॥६-४-६९॥
translation: Formidable vanaras in hundreds, thousands, lakhs and crores spread in a splendid manner around the land.

raw: नाशयन्ति बलम् सर्वम् विश्वामित्रस्य पश्यतः । स राजा परम क्रुद्धः क्रोध विस्फारित ईक्षणः ॥१-५४-१९॥
जुह्वतश्चापि तत्राग्निं रक्तोष्णीषधराः स्त्रियः । आजग्मुस्तत्र सम्भ्रान्ता राक्षस्यो यत्र रावणिः ॥६-८०-६॥
translation: Thereafter, as he went to the place of fire sacrifice, Rakshasa women brought red coloured head dresses to wear (for the priests).

raw: शङ्के श्रुतो ऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः । तत्क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परन्तपाः ॥५-६४-१२॥
translation: "O scorcher of enemies I presume Rama has already heard the news of our arrival on accomplishment of the task. Hence it is not proper for us to tarry here.

raw: महा वात समुद्धूतम् यन् माम् अवकरिष्यति । रजो रमण तन् मन्ये पर अर्ध्यम् इव चन्दनम् ॥२-३०-१३॥
translation: I shall regard, O charming Rama, the harmful dust raised by the stormy wind and settled on me as the most excellent sandal powder.

raw: धूम्राक्षं निहतं दृष्टवा हतशेषा निशाचराः । त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर्लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-५२-३८॥
translation: Those Rakshasas who survived the onslaught, seeing Dhumraksha killed, reentered Lanka out of fear of being killed by Vanaras.

raw: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा । उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम् ॥५-३८-११॥
translation: Having heard Hanuman, Sita, a child of god, said these words in a low tone. Choked with tears, 'Carry this token of identity to my dear husband':

raw: अद्येमं संयतं क्रोधमसत्कारं च मानद । मोक्ष्यामि शत्रुसैन्येषु कक्षेष्विव हुताशनम् ॥२-९६-२८॥
translation: O protector of honour, today I shall vent my suppressed anger and dishonour on the enemy's army like a fire on the thicket.

raw: पश्यम्स्तदवशस्तस्याः कामस्य वशमेयिवान् । क्रोधहर्षसमानेन दुर्वर्णकरणेन च ॥६-१२-१७॥
निद्राविश ऽदनेत्रस्तु कलुषीकृतलोचनः । चारयन् सर्वतो दृष्टिं तान् ददर्श निशाचरान् ॥६-६०-६६॥
translation: With sleepy eyes casting his glance at the night rangers looked at all of them.

raw: यच्च किञ्चन तत्सर्वं नारीसञ्ज्ञं बभूव ह । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा स इलः कर्दमात्मजः । निघ्नन्मृगसहस्राणि तं देशमुपचक्रमे ॥७-८७-१४॥
translation: Indeed, everything there became female, and in the meantime, King Ila, the son of Kardama, entered that region while hunting thousands of deer.

raw: संध्या राग उत्थितैः ताम्रैः अंतेषु अधिक पाण्डुरैः । स्निग्धैः अभ्र पट च्छेदैः बद्ध व्रणम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-५॥
translation: 'The sky looks as though its wounds are dressed with pale white moistureladen bandage cloths of clouds, red in the border, tinged as they are with the glow of twilight.

raw: अशोकवनिकामध्ये शिंशुपापादपो महान् । तमारुह्य च पश्यामि काञ्चनं कदलीवनम् ॥५-५८-५५॥
translation: "I crossed that boundary wall and saw many kinds of trees and in the midst of that Ashoka garden, a huge Simsupa tree. I ascended it and saw rows of banana plants.

raw: अहं तु रावणं हत्वा सपुत्रं सहबान्धवम् । मैथिलीमानयिष्यामि शक्रो नष्टामिव श्रियम् । श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्य सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५०-२५॥
translation: "On killing Ravana and his sons along with his kin, I will on my part also bring Mythili just as Indra recovered his prosperity."

raw: तपस्यता महाबाहो लोकाः वृत्रेण निर्जिताः । बलवान्स हि धर्मात्मा नैनं शक्ष्यामि शासितुम् ॥७-८४-१२॥
translation: O mighty-armed one, Vritra, who is performing penance, has conquered the worlds; he is indeed powerful and righteous, and I am unable to control him.

raw: चीराण्यसास्या जनकस्य कन्या । नेयम् प्रतिज्ञा मम दत्तपूर्वा । यथासुखम् गच्छतु राजपुत्री । वनम् सम्ग्रा सह सर्वर्त्नैः ॥२-३८-६॥
translation: Let the daughter of Janaka take off her bark garments. This is not the promise I had made to you earlier. Let the princess happily go to the forest adorned with all jewels and with all other necessities.

raw: एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम् । न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना ॥२-२९-१९॥
translation: Why don't you want to take to the forest your own wife who is loyal and devoted, and is of good conduct.

raw: हृता सीता विशालाक्षि याम् त्वम् गृह्य न बुध्यसे । महाबलम् महात्मानम् दुराधर्षम् सुरैरपि ॥६-२०-२९॥
न च मां साधु बुबुधे मम वा निकृतं कृतम् ॥५-५८-४१॥
translation: "She opened her huge mouth to eat me as she did not know that I had already assumed a huge ugly form on my own.

raw: देवाः स ऋषि गणाः सर्वे न अस्ति मन्ये तपः फलम् । एवम् निश्चित्य मनसा भूय एव महातपाः ॥१-५८-९॥
स शिष्यावब्रवीद्धृष्टौ युवां गत्वा समाहितौ । कृत्स्नं रामायणं काव्यं गायेथां परया मुदा ॥७-९३-५॥
translation: Valmiki, delighted, instructed his two disciples to go and sing the entire epic poem of Ramayana with utmost concentration and joy.

raw: अश्रु पूर्ण मुखीम् दीनाम् शोक भार अवपीडिताम् । वायु वेगैः इव आक्रांताम् मज्जन्तीम् नावम् अर्णवे ॥३-५५-४॥
translation: The demon Ravana forcibly took Sita, her face full of tears, to show her his heavenlike home. Inflicted with grief she looked wretched. She resembled a female deer hounded out of the herd. With her head bent in grief, she looked pathetic like one not under her control, like a boat sinking under the sea driven by the wind.

raw: आश्वसिहि नरश्रेष्ठ प्राणिनः कस्य न आपद । संस्पृशन्ति अग्निवत् राजन् क्षणेन व्यपयान्ति च ॥३-६६-६॥
निशम्य रामेण शरैः अजिह्मगैःहतान् जनस्थान गतान् निशाचरान् । खरम् च दृष्ट्वा निहतम् च दूषणम्त्वम् अद्य कृत्यम् प्रतिपत्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-३४-२७॥
translation: On hearing about the death of the demons including Khara and Dusana who fell to the straight and swift arrows of Rama, you should decide your course of action. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtytfourth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अन्ये च बलिनस्तस्य कूटमुद्गरपाणयः । मूर्ध्नि वक्षसि गात्रेषु पातयन् कूटमुद्गरान् ॥६-६०-५४॥
translation: Some had their nails fixed with mallets, letting their mallets fall on the forehead, on the chest and throw at of Kumbhakarna.

raw: अद्य वैवस्वतो राजा भूयो बहुमतो मम । येनाद्य त्वं महाबाहो संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा ॥६-९३-८॥
translation: 'O mighty armed! Today by virtue of time you have joined Yama and become esteemed King'.

raw: हा महार्हः महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम् । जनम् न पश्यसि इमम् त्वम् कस्मात् शोक अभिपीडितम् ॥४-२५-४१॥
translation: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

raw: सो ऽहं विगतवेगस्तु दिशो दश विलोकयन् । न किंचित्तत्र पश्यामि येन मे ऽपहृता गतिः ॥५-५८-३५॥
translation: "Then I was captured by a shadow of some one. I could not see and I reduced my speed and looked around in all the ten directions. I could not see the one who seized me.

raw: प्रसन्न सलिलाः सौम्य कुरराभिः विनादिताः । चक्रवाक गण आकीर्णा विभांति सलिल आशयाः ॥४-३०-५८॥
translation: 'O gentle Lakshmana the pure water in the tanks and sweet sounds of flocks of female kurari birds and chakravakas there are splendid.

raw: तदेत्कथितं सर्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । हनूमतो बालभावे कर्मैतत्कथितं मया ॥७-३६-५१॥
translation: All that you asked me has been told, and this deed of Hanuman in his childhood has been recounted by me.

raw: सर्वा पूर्वम् इयम् येषाम् आसीत् कृत्स्ना वसुंधरा । प्रजपतिम् उपादाय नृपाणम् जय शालिनाम् ॥१-५-१॥
translation: Formerly, this entire earth belonged to those victorious kings starting from Prajapati (Manu).

raw: सप्त ऋषयो नारदः च ते त्वाम् रक्षन्तु सर्वतः । याश्चापि सर्वतः सिद्दा दिश्श्च सदिगीश्वराः ॥२-२५-१२॥
सह राघव वैदेह्या भ्रात्रा चैव वने वसन् । त्वम् गतिम् प्राप्स्यसे वीर त्रीम्ल् लोकाम्स् तु जयन्न् इव ॥२-५२-१८॥
translation: Valiant scion of the Raghus dwelling in the forest along with Vaidehi (Sita) and brother Lakshmana you will attain the status as if you have won the three worlds.

raw: न च कान्चन चित्रम् ते पश्यामि प्रिय दर्शन । भद्र आसनम् पुरः कृत्य यान्तम् वीर पुरह्सरम् ॥२-२६-१७॥
translation: O heroic one O handsome one how is it that I do not see your attendants proceeding in front with the throne carved in gold?

raw: कक्ष्यां द्वितीयामासाद्य तिष्ठन्तु नृपवेश्मनः । देवायतनचैत्येषु सान्नभक्षाः सदक्षिणाः ॥२-३-१८॥
एतया किल सङ्ग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर । प्रयुक्तया गतिः शक्या नहि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः ॥७-२५-११॥
translation: O Lord of Rakshasas, it is said that when this illusion is employed in battle, its movement cannot indeed be ascertained by even gods and asuras.

raw: स्यन्दनैः चंदनैः नीपैः पर्णासैः लकुचैः अपि । धव अश्वकर्ण खदिरैः शमी किंशुक पाटलैः ॥३-१५-१८॥
translation: The place is covered with sal and palmyrah trees including mango, jackfruit, dates, kadamba, punnaga, ashoka, champak, tilaka, ketaka, sandalwood, spandan, dhava, asvakarna parnasha, khadira, sami, kimsuka and patala trees. It is full of wild paddy, flowering bushes and creepers that run on the ground.

raw: प्रागुदक्प्रवणां वेदिं विशालां दीप्तपावकाम् । ददर्श भरतस्तत्र पुण्यां रामनिवेशने ॥२-९९-२४॥
translation: Bharata beheld at Rama's residence a sacred and spacious altar sloping to the northeast, with a burning fire upon it.

raw: यत् यत् इच्छेत् तत् एव अस्या देयम् मत् च्छंदतो यथा । या च वक्ष्यति वैदेहीम् वचनम् किंचित् अप्रियम् ॥३-५४-१६॥
प्रयाता रजनी देवि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति । अभिषेकं गुरुजन्स्त्वरयीष्यति मां ध्रुवम् ॥२-१४-१५॥
translation: O queen the night has departed and the Sun is about to rise. The preceptors now will definitely ask me to hasten for the consecration.

raw: इति उक्त्वा मृगशावाक्षीम् अलात सदृश ईक्षणा । अभ्यधावत् सुसंक्रुद्धा महा उल्का रोहिणीम् इव ॥३-१८-१७॥
translation: While speaking this, Surpanakha, with eyes like flaming amber ran to the fawneyed Sita in great anger like a giant meteor hurtling towards the constellation of Rohini :

raw: करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे । यावदावर्त ते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा ॥२-१०-३६॥
न साम रक्षस्सु गुणाय कल्पते न दानमर्थोपचितेषु युज्यते । न भेदसाध्या बलदर्पिता जनाः पराक्रमस्त्वेव ममेह रोचते ॥५-४१-३॥
translation: 'With demons, negotiation is of no use. They are wealthy, they need no gifts. Proud of their stregth, the demons will not yield to dissension. I think only by using power it can be done.

raw: सम्मतश्चासि वृद्धानां तांश्च पृच्छसि संशयान् ॥२-१०६-३॥
translation: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.

raw: अहं संपातिवचनाच्छतयोजनमायतम् । अस्या हेतोर्विशालाक्ष्याः सागरं वेगवान् प्लुतः ॥५-३१-१४॥
translation: "On hearing the words of Sampati I leaped the wide ocean swiftly crossing a hundred yojanas in quest of the largeeyed Sita.

raw: सर्वो हि तपसा देव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान् । विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम् ॥७-३०-१७॥
translation: O god, while every man indeed obtains immortality through penance, I have established this immortality through my valor.

raw: निवेदेअयत माम् क्षिप्रम् राघवाय महात्मने । सर्व लोक शरण्याय विभीषणम् उपस्थितम् ॥६-१७-१७॥
लब्धकामस्य ते पश्चादागमिष्यति किम् भयम् । प्राप्तमप्राप्तकालम् वा सर्वम् प्रतिविधास्यते ॥६-१३-५॥
translation: "When you have fulfilled your desire, why fear? Let it happen. Let that which is yet to come, happen. You will be able to face."

raw: रामस्स्वबाहुवीर्येणस्वराज्यंप्रत्यपादयत् । वालिनंसमरेहत्वामहाकायंमहाबलम् ॥६-१२९-३८॥
translation: "Rama of mighty arms killed Vali of gigantic body and mighty prowess and restored Sugriva's own kingdom to him."

raw: वेगितानां समर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् । परस्परं चाह्वयतां निनादः श्रूयते महान् ॥६-५७-४५॥
translation: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

raw: निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषं पवनो ववौ । भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्महोल्काश्च प्रपेदिरे ॥७-२८-२८॥
translation: However, as Shakra departed, a harsh wind blew, the sun became dim, and large meteors fell, indicating ill omens.

raw: केचिद्विभिन्नशिरसः केचिच्चक्षुर्विवर्जिताः ॥६-९६-४५॥
translation: A few were made lifeless, some had their flanks split, some had their heads smashed and few were deprived of their eyes.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु सिद्ध अर्थ वचो राजा श्रान्ततर स्वनः । शोक उपहतया वाचा कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३६-३१॥
translation: Having heard Siddhartha, the king, stricken with grief, said to Kaikeyi in a gradually feeble voice.

raw: त्वया विरहिता देवी लक्ष्मणेन च राघव । ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन बलीयसा ॥३-६७-१६॥
translation: I have seen her snatched from you and from Lakshmana and carried off by powerful Ravana.

raw: असङ्ख्या सुमहत्यासीत्तस्य सेना महात्मनः । शूराणामग्रयातऽणां सहस्राणि शतानि च ॥७-२१-२९॥
translation: The army of that great-souled Yama was immeasurably vast, comprising hundreds and thousands of brave warriors leading the charge.

raw: तं श्रुत्वा समनुप्राप्तं रामं दशरथो नृपः । प्रवेश्यामास गृहं विवक्षुः प्रियमुत्तमम् ॥२-४-९॥
translation: Having heard of Rama's arrival, king Dasaratha got him admitted into his apartment to tell him something very pleasant.

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामं सुग्रीवो ऽपि महाबलः । प्रणम्य विधिवद्वीरं विज्ञापयितुमुद्यतः ॥७-१०८-२३॥
translation: Meanwhile, the mighty Sugriva also, having properly bowed to the hero Rama, prepared to make a submission.

raw: अरोगप्रसवा नार्यो वपुष्मन्तो हि मानवाः । हर्षश्चाभ्यधिको राजञ्जनस्य पुरवासिनः ॥७-४१-१९॥
translation: Women give birth without illness, humans are healthy, and O King, the joy of the city dwellers is exceedingly great.

raw: पताकिन्यस्तु ता नाव: स्वयं दाशैरधिष्ठिता: । वहन्त्यो जनमारूढं तदा सम्पेतुराशुगा: ॥२-८९-१५॥
translation: Those boats adorned with flags were propelled by the fishermen occupying them. They sailed with men rowing on board fast.

raw: धिक् त्वां पापसमाचारं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी ॥६-८१-२०॥
सर्वेषां समतिक्रम्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वीर्यवान् । आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् रावणस्य निवेशनम् ॥५-५४-१८॥
translation: Heroic and illustrious Hanuman, having crossed all the residences of the ogres finally reached the palace of Ravana, the king.

raw: प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् राम कीर्तिम् स बहु वार्षिकीम् । ब्रह्मणः स्थानम् आसाद्य तत्र च अपि महीयते ॥३-६-१३॥
translation: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.

raw: कस्माद्विषण्णवदना विद्रवध्वे प्लवङ्गमाः । त्यक्तयुद्धसमुत्साहाः शूरत्वं क्वनु वो गतम् ॥६-८२-३॥
translation: "O monkeys! Why have you lost enthusiasm to fight, looking sad and running away? Where has your valour gone?"

raw: तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोत्थितमरिन्दमम् । अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयं पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः ॥६-१२४-१॥
translation: Rising in the morning after comfortable rest that night, Vibheeshana saw Rama the subduer of enemies, offered salutations and asked him of the victory and spoke.

raw: सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धि: प्रसेनजित् । यशस्वी ध्रुवसन्धेस्तु भरतो रिपुसूदन: ॥२-११०-१४॥
translation: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.

raw: कामं त्विदानीमपि मां व्यादिश त्वं परन्तप । न परः प्रेषणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम ॥६-६३-४१॥
translation: "Command me to wage war at this moment, O Scorcher of enemies. There is no one better than me to be sought for O hero endowed with extraordinary strength."

raw: विस्मितास्तु बभूवुस्ते रणे वानरराक्षसाः । दृष्ट्वा हनुमतः कर्म सुरैरपि सुदुष्करम् ॥६-१०२-३१॥
translation: It is a difficult task even for Suras. Seeing Hanuman doing it all the Vanara leaders were amazed.

raw: समुद्रम् इव गम्भीरम् समुद्रम् इव निह्स्वनम् । महात्मानो महद् वेश्म महा रत्न परिच्चदम् ॥५-६-१३॥
translation: The place produced deep sounds like the sea. Those mighty ogres wore gemstudded ornaments. The great vanara saw the residence of the great self, Ravana rich with precious gems.

raw: स यात्वा दूरमध्वानं सुपरिश्रान्तवाहन: । उवाच भरत: श्रीमान् वसिष्ठं मन्त्रिणां वरम् ॥२-९३-६॥
translation: With his draught animals extremely wearied by covering a great distance, the majestic Bharata said to Vasistha, the best of counsellors:

raw: हनुमत् प्रमुखाः ते तु प्रस्थिताः प्लवग ऋषभाः । विंध्यम् एव आदितः कृत्वा विचेरुः ते समंततः ॥४-४९-२२॥
translation: The bulls among vanaras and Hanuman, the chief of the group again started exploring everywhere in the Vindhya range starting from the beginning. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: प्रियान्न संभवेद्दुःखमप्रियादधिकं भयम् । ताभ्यां हि ये वियुज्यन्ते नमस्तेषां महात्मनाम् ॥५-२६-५०॥
translation: "Salutations to those exalted souls who have distanced themselves from pleasure and displeasure. Pleasures may not lead to suffering or displeasure to excessive, meaningless fear for such great souls.

raw: अभिवाद्य मुनेः पादौ मुनिपुत्रा महर्षये । सर्वं निवेदयामासुस्तस्यास्तु रुदितस्वनम् ॥७-४९-२॥
translation: Having saluted the feet of the great sage, the hermit boys reported to him everything about her crying.

raw: वानरैश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धै राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः । पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च सम्पिष्टा वसुधातले ॥६-५८-१५॥
translation: Then the highly enraged Vanaras completely crushed Rakshasas in groups by crushing them on the earth's surface with trees and mountain peaks.

raw: कीदृशं तु मया पापं पुरा देहान्तरे कृतम् । येनेदं प्राप्यते दुःखं मया घोरं सुदारुणम् ॥५-२३-१८॥
उत्थाय बहवो अनेन मृगयायाम् जनाधिपाः । निहताः परम इष्वासाः तस्मात् वध्यः तु अयम् मृगः ॥३-४३-४०॥
translation: Many kings who were great archers who set out on hunting expedition were killed by him. Therefore, this animal deserves to be killed.

raw: स इदानीम् अहम् वृद्धः परिहीन पराक्रमः । साम्प्रतम् कालम् अस्माकम् भवान् सर्व गुण अन्वितः ॥४-६६-३४॥
translation: 'I have become old and my valour is depleted. At this time you are the sole resort for us. You have all the necessary qualities.

raw: न मे दशरथ स्नेहात् पुत्रेण उत्पादितम् प्रियम् । तस्य तु एवम् ब्रुवाणस्य संहतैः वानरैः सह ॥४-६३-८॥
अभिषिच्याङ्गदं वीरमागतो ऽस्मि नरेश्वर । तवानुगमने राजन्विद्धि मां कृतनिश्चयम् ॥७-१०८-२४॥
translation: O lord of men, I have come after consecrating the heroic Angada; O king, know me to be resolute in following you.

raw: अथ वर्ष सहस्रेण योक्त्र सर्प शिरांसि च । वमन्तो अति विषम् तत्र ददंशुर् दशनैः शिलाः ॥१-४५-१९॥
translation: After a thousand years, the hoods of the snake made as rope vomitted venom and started biting the rocks of the Mandara mountain with their teeth.

raw: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव महाबल ॥६-६३-४२॥
त्रीन् पादान् अथ भिक्षित्वा प्रतिगृह्य च मेदिनीम् । आक्रम्य लोकान् लोकार्थो सर्व लोक हिते रतः ॥१-२९-२०॥
translation: Thereafter, Visnu, soul of the universe who restores respect (for the righeous), and renders the welfare of all living beings, having begged from Bali, and been granted three places to put his footsteps on occupied the (three) worlds and by restraining Bali with his energy, gave (it) back to Mahendra. In this manner the highly lustrous Visnu, gave possession of the three worlds to Mahendra.

raw: इदानीं खल्वहं नास्मि यस्य मे दक्षिणो भुजः । पतितो यं समाश्रित्य न बिभेमि सुरासुरात् ॥६-६८-१२॥
translation: "I who depended on you like my right arm did not fear Devatas or Danavas and I am destroyed now."

raw: प्रत्यवेक्ष्य तु ताम्राक्षः सुघोरो घोरदर्शनः । दीनो दीनस्वरान् सर्वांस्तानुवाच निशाचरान् ॥६-९३-३५॥
translation: Redeyed Ravana, looking dreadful with a frightening face, desperate, spoke in a low voice to all Rakshasas as follows.

raw: प्राद्रवत् भय संत्रस्तो वीक्ष्य आवाम् समुपागतौ । अभिद्रुतः तु वेगेन विवेश स महाबिलम् ॥४-१०-१६॥
translation: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

raw: चिंतयामास धर्मात्मा सह उपाध्यायः स बान्धवः । तस्य चिंतयमानस्य मंत्रि मध्ये महात्मनः ॥१-१८-३८॥
असम्यतकवाटानि श्रीविहीनानि सर्वशः । बलिकर्मविहीनानि धूपसम्मेदनेन च ॥२-७१-३८॥
translation: I see the unswept homes of householders standing dirty with doors not closed. There is no beauty anywhere. No one offers oblations (at the time of worship). There is no fragrance of burning incense. The families have no food to eat. The people look cheerless. I see inauspiciousness everywhere.

raw: वाप्यो मैरेयपूर्णाश्च मृष्टमांसचयैर्वृता: । प्रतप्तपिठरैश्चापि मार्गमायूरकौक्कुटै: ॥२-९१-६९॥
translation: The wells were found filled with datepalm liquor and surrounded by pots of well cooked meat of peacocks, chicken and other animals.

raw: एकांशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु । तृतीयो भूतलं शक्रस्तदा वृत्रं वधिष्यति ॥७-८५-७॥
translation: Let one part of me go into Indra, the second into his thunderbolt, and the third into the earth; then Indra will be able to kill Vritra.

raw: समादिशन्तु नियमम् प्रायश्चित्तम् यथा भवेत् । इति उक्ताः ते ततो राज्ञा सर्वे ब्राह्मण सत्तमाः ॥१-९-११॥
रुदन्नाह प्रियम् पुत्रं सत्यपाशेन संयतः । कैकेय्या चोद्यमान्स्तु मिथो राजा तमब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-३०॥
translation: The king who was bound by the cord of truth and instigated by Kaikeyi said, wailing in distress:

raw: ततो द्यां पृथिवीं चैव वीक्षमाणा वनौकसः । ददृशुः सन्ततौ बाणैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-४६-१॥
translation: Thereafter looking at the sky and the ground for Rama and Lakshmana, the Vanara leaders saw the two brothers, lying on the ground hurt by arrows.

raw: सीताम् पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मन्मथस्य रतिम् यथा । इष्टाम् सर्वस्य जगतः पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव ॥५-१५-३०॥
ततः शूलानि निश्चेरुर्गदाश्च मुसलानि च । कार्मुकाद्दीप्यमानानि वज्रसाराणि सर्वशः ॥६-१०१-३॥
translation: Then from his bow issued forth all over flaming tridents, maces, and iron bars like thunderbolt.

raw: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम् । क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ॥६-११२-२६॥
यत्नात् मृगयमाणः तु न आससाद वने प्रियाम् । शोक रक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते ॥३-६०-१०॥
translation: He ransacked the forest, yet did not find his beloved. He appeared like a mad man, his eyes turned red with tears of sorrow.

raw: सो अपश्यत् शात कुम्भानि शीधोर् मणिमयानि च । राजतानि च पूर्णानि भाजनानि महा कपिः ॥५-११-२४॥
translation: The great monkey saw the wine jars made of gold and silver studded with crystals and gems.

raw: ततस्तांस्त्रीन् हतान् ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना । अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम् ॥५-४६-३१॥
translation: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war

raw: पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज । पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम् ॥५-६७-४॥
translation: "O Bharata's brother, when Sita awoke from sleep you slept on her lap. The same crow again hurt her.

raw: किं कृतं श्रेय इत्येवं वर्धेमहि कथं वयम् । अथाब्रवीत्सुतां रक्षः कैकसीं नाम नामतः ॥७-९-६॥
translation: The Rakshasa then spoke to his daughter, Kaikasi by name, pondering how they might prosper and what good they should do.

raw: अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्याम् रामः सम्प्रस्थितः वनम् । कृत स्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः ॥२-२६-१॥
translation: After the benedictory rites were performed by his mother Kausalya, Rama paid obeisance to her and staying on the righteous path decided to depart to the forest. He entered the highway thronged with people and illumining it with his lustre and stirred their hearts with (remembrances of) his excellent virtues.

raw: मा मां स्पृश बलाद्राजन्कन्या पितृवशा ह्यहम् । गुरुः पिता मे राजेन्द्र त्वं च शिष्यो महात्मनः । व्यसनं सुमहत्क्रुद्धः स ते दद्यान्महातपाः ॥७-८०-९॥
translation: O king, do not touch me by force, for I am a maiden dependent on my father; O king of kings, my father is your preceptor, and you are the disciple of that great-souled one, and if enraged, that sage of great penance would inflict a very great calamity upon you.

raw: मेघाः समुद् भूत समुद्र नादामहाजल ओघैः गगन अवलंबाः । नदीः तटाकानि सरांसि वापिःमहीम् च कृत्स्नाम् अपवाहयन्ति ॥४-२८-४४॥
translation: 'With their big torrents, clouds hanging over the sky, drowning the roar of the sea, make the rivers, ponds, lakes and tanks overflow and flood the entire earth.

raw: स निह्श्वस्य उष्णम् ऐक्ष्वाकः ताम् भार्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । कैकेयि कुश चीरेण न सीता गन्तुम् अर्हति ॥२-३८-३॥
translation: The descendant of the Ikshvakus (Dasaratha), heaving hot sighs, said to his wife O Kaikeyi, Sita does not deserve to go (to the forest) in garment of kusa grass.

raw: एवमुक्तवतो वाक्यं कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः । प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं प्रहसन् राक्षसाधिपः ॥६-६५-९॥
translation: Wise Kumbhakarna having spoken in that way, the Rakshasa king, Ravana laughed and replied in this way.

raw: बह्व् एतत् कामयानस्य शक्यम् एतेन जीवितुम् । यद् अहम् सा च वाम ऊरुर् एकाम् धरणिम् आश्रितौ ॥६-५-१०॥
translation: Me and Sita are seeking refuge on the same land indeed. Because of that only survival is possible for me, who is desiring for her very much.

raw: ततो नानाप्रहरणा भीमाक्षा भीमदर्शनाः । निष्पेतू रक्षसां मुख्या बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः ॥६-५५-६॥
translation: Thereafter taking different weapons, Rakshasas of fearful eyes and terrific appearance rushed forward ordered by CommanderinChief of the army.

raw: रामलक्ष्मणसीतार्थम् स्रवन्तीम् वारि नेत्रजम् । असकृत् प्रैक्षत तदा नृत्यन्तीम् इव मातरम् ॥२-४०-४५॥
translation: While Kausalya was weeping and running after the chariot, crying O 'Rama, O Sita, O Lakshmana, shedding tears for them, Rama repeatedly glanced at her who was twisting and bending as if in a dancing pose.

raw: एष वानर राजेन सुर्ग्रीवेण अभिषेचितः । यौवराज्ये अन्गदो नाम त्वाम् आह्वयति सम्युगे ॥६-२६-१७॥
translation: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."

raw: कति दुर्गाणि दुर्गाया लंकायास् तद् ब्रवीहि मे । ज्ञातुम् इच्चामि तत् सर्वम् दर्शनाद् इव वानर ॥६-३-३॥
translation: "O Vanara How many forts are in Lanka? You may tell me whatever you have seen. I wish to know all that."

raw: तमुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठं जाम्बवान्वाक्यकोविदः । ज्ञायते गमने शक्तिस्तव हर्यृक्षसत्तम ॥४-६५-२०॥
translation: Jambavan who was skilful in speech spoke to that great Angada, 'O leader among monkeys and bears your energy to cover this distance is wellknown to us'.

raw: ब्रवीमि सत्येन न तेऽस्ति यन्त्रणा । धनम् हि यद्यन्मम विप्रकारणात् । भवत्सु सम्यक्र्पतिपादनेन त । न्मयार्जितम् प्रीतियश्स्करम् भवेत् ॥२-३२-४१॥
translation: Truly speaking, there is no limit to seeking wealth. My wealth is specifically meant for brahmins. By distributing all the wealth earned by me, I get pleasure and renown.

raw: यदि भर्तृहितार्थाय चरन्तं भर्तृशासनात् । बध्नन्त्येते दुरात्मानो न तु मे निष्कृतिः कृता ॥५-५३-१२॥
translation: 'These evilminded demons bind me, ordered by their lord. When I am moving here for the welfare of my master, I will not let them escape৷৷

raw: सा ऽभिवीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा वेण्युद्ग्रथनमुत्तमम् । मुक्त्वा वस्त्राद्ददौ मह्यं मणिमेतं महाबल ॥५-६७-३१॥
ततः शरेण अभिहतो रामेण रण कर्कशः । पपात सहसा वाली निकृत्तैव पादपः ॥४-१७-१॥
translation: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.

raw: अनुरूपाव् इमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः । अभिषेचन विघ्नस्य कर्तृउणाम् ते निवारणे ॥२-२३-३९॥
translation: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecration.

raw: इन्द्रजित्तु तदा तेन निर्जितो भीमकर्मणा । संयुगे वालिपुत्रेण क्रोधं चक्रे सुदारुणम् ॥६-४४-३३॥
translation: Then Indrajith of terrible deeds defeated by Angada in the comb at became terribly angry.

raw: सन्दिश्य रामं नृपतिः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने । पुरोहितं समाहूय वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-५-१॥
translation: The king having instructed Rama summoned Vasistha, the priest and spoke to him about the coronation that was to take place on the following day

raw: सितमेघनिभं चापि राजवेश्मसु तोरणम् । दिव्यमाल्यकृताकारं दिव्यगन्धसमुक्षितम् ॥२-९१-३३॥
translation: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.

raw: राज्यम् द्विजातिभिर्जुष्टम् राजसूयाभिषेचनम् । कर्तुमर्हति ते राजा वासवस्येव लोककृत् ॥२-१६-२२॥
translation: The king will bestow upon you, like the creator of the world (Brahma) bestowing on Indra, the kingdom served by brahmins who are fit to perform 'Rajasuya' sacrifice at the time of consecration.

raw: तवैतद्वचनं सौम्ये सारवत् स्निग्धमेव च । रत्नौघाद्विविधाच्चापि देवराज्याद्विशिष्यते ॥६-११६-२४॥
translation: "O gentle one! Your meaningful words full of affection are more valuable than clusters of gems or Indra, the Lord of gods."

raw: भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धि देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम् ॥७-८०-८॥
translation: O king of kings, know me to be Araja by name, the eldest daughter of the divine sage Bhrigu, whose deeds are pure, and who dwells in the hermitage.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चनवतितमः सर्गः ॥ ९५ ॥६-९५-४१॥
कृतबुद्धिं निवासाय तत्रैव स मुनिस्तदा । भरतं कैकयीपुत्रमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत् ॥२-९१-१॥
translation: With the decision of Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, to stay there for the night, sage Bharadwaja extended to him all hospitality.

raw: यथावत् पूजितः तेन देवर्षिः नारदः तथा । आपृच्छैव अभ्यनुज्ञातः स जगाम विहायसम् ॥१-२-२॥
translation: The divine sage Narada after having been worshipped by Valmiki in a befitting manner sought his leave and went to heaven.

raw: पुनश्च सोऽचिन्तयादात्तरूपो ध्रुवं विशिष्टा गुणतो हि सीता । अथायमस्यां कृतवान्महात्मा लङ्केश्वरः कष्टमनार्यकर्म ॥५-९-७३॥
translation: Hanuman once again assuming his true form said to himself, 'Sita is surely a virtuous lady superior to and more distinguished than them all. Alas, this lord of Lanka committed an ignoble, act (by abducting her). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषम् तप्त कांचन भूषणम् । सोपानम् कांचनम् चित्रम् आरुरोह तया सह ॥३-५५-९॥
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि सारोहाणां च वाजिनाम् । पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे राक्षसानां पदातिनाम् ॥६-९४-३२॥
translation: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.

raw: स जित्वा धनदं राम भ्रातरं राक्षसाधिपः । महासेनप्रसूतिं तद्ययौ शरवणं महत् ॥७-१६-१॥
translation: O Rama, having conquered his brother Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas then went to that great thicket of reeds, the birthplace of Kartikeya.

raw: रथानां तु सहस्राणि नागानामयुतानि च । दशायुतानि चाश्वानामेकैकस्य धनं ददौ ॥७-१०७-१९॥
translation: He gave to each of his sons thousands of chariots, ten thousands of elephants, and one hundred thousand horses as wealth.

raw: निर्मलेन सुधौतेन खड्गेनास्य महच्छिरः । जघान वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य वालिसूनुर्महाबलः ॥६-५४-३५॥
translation: Mighty son of Vali lopped off the great head of Vajradamshtra's with a sharpened stainless sword.

raw: इदम् हि तेजस्तव यद्धुरत्ययम् । तदेव जिज्ञासितु मिच्छता मया । इमम् भवानर्थमभिप्रचोदितो । वृणीष्व किम्चेदपरम् व्यवस्यति ॥२-३२-४०॥
translation: Your power is unsurpassable and to ascertain this, I incited you to do this act. If there is anything else, ask for it.

raw: तत: पप्रच्छ भरतं भरद्वाजो दृढव्रत: । विशेषं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि मातऽणां तव राघव ॥२-९२-१८॥
translation: Then Bharadwaja, firm in his vows, said to Bharata, I want to know about your mothers individually.

raw: कुरुष्व हितवादिन्या वचनं मम मैथिलि । अलमश्रुप्रपातेन त्यज शोकमनर्थकम् ॥५-२२-२७॥
तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि । कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि ॥२-३-४१॥
आत्म अनुमानात् पश्यामि मग्नः त्वाम् शोक सागरे । त्वाम् अहम् तारयिष्यामि बाढम् प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम् ॥४-१०-३४॥
translation: 'Inferring from my own experience, I see that you are immersed in an ocean of sorrow.I will help you cross over and fulfil your desire.'

raw: ते ऽन्योन्यमभिसर्पन्तो निनदन्तश्च विस्वरम् । राक्षसेन्द्रास्त्रनिर्भिन्ना निपेतुर्वानरर्षभाः ॥६-७३-५५॥
translation: Hit by the Rakshasa king, the bulls among Vanaras gliding towards one another roared in discordant tones and fell down.

raw: राक्षसेन अनुवृत्तया वैदेह्या च पादानि तु । स समीक्ष्य परिक्रान्तम् सीताया राक्षसस्य च ॥३-६४-३७॥
नाना द्रुम विकीर्णेषु धातु निष्पन्द शोभिषु । एतानि मम वेगम् हि शिखराणि महान्ति च ॥४-६७-३८॥
पुलस्त्याज्ञां प्रगृह्योचे न किञ्चन वचो ऽर्जुनः । मुमोच वै पार्थिवेन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रं प्रहृष्टवत् ॥७-३३-१७॥
translation: Having accepted Pulastya's command, Arjuna spoke not a word, and indeed, the king of kings joyfully released the lord of Rakshasas.

raw: वक्तुम् न शक्तो रामस्य गुणान् कश्चिन्नरः क्षितौ । जनस्थानगता येन तावन्तो राक्षसा हताः ॥६-३०-३०॥
translation: "It is not even possible to recount the virtues of Rama who killed all the Rakshasas approaching Janasthana."

raw: पद्भ्याम् एव जगाम अथ ससीतः सह लक्ष्मणः । सम्निकृष्ट पद न्यासो रामः वन परायणः ॥२-४५-१८॥
translation: Then Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana began walking on foot with slow steps towards the forest.

raw: अवेक्षमाणः सस्नेहम् चक्षुषा प्रपिबन्न् इव । उवाच रामः स्नेहेन ताः प्रजाः स्वाः प्रजाइव ॥२-४५-५॥
translation: Looking at the people with love as if they were his own children and as though drinking them with his glances, Rama appealed to them:

raw: तमापृष्ट्वा नरपतिं राजा दशरथस्तदा । मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगामाशु महायशा: ॥१-७२-२०॥
translation: Then renowned king Dasaratha, took leave of the two great ascetics. Then the rowned king Dasaratha took have of the king (Janaka) immediately following the two great ascetics.

raw: सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षो महारथः । चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तो मेघस्तनितनिस्वनः ॥६-७१-१९॥
translation: "His chariot with standard, flag and axletree is a great one driven by four charioteers emitting sound like the rumblings of clouds."

raw: ततः शुचि समाचाराः पर्युपस्थान कोविदः । स्त्री वर्ष वर भूयिष्ठाउपतस्थुर् यथा पुरम् ॥२-६५-७॥
translation: Thereafter, as usual, men observing purificatory practices and skilled in royal service assembled along with women and eunuchs.

raw: विष्णुर्यथा गरुत्मन्तं बलवन्तं समाहितः । तच्छुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् । आरुरोह महाशूरो बलवन्तं महाकपिम् ॥६-५९-१२५॥
श्वः प्रभाते तु लवणं वधिष्यसि न संशयः । अगृहीतायुधं क्षिप्रं ध्रुवो हि विजयस्तव ॥७-६७-२३॥
translation: Tomorrow morning, you will certainly kill Lavana, and your victory is assured, especially when he has not taken up his weapon.

raw: वैदूर्य तल सोपानैः स्फाटिक अन्तर पाम्सुभिः । चारु सम्जवन उपेतैः खम् इव उत्पतितैः शुभैः ॥५-३-१०॥
translation: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

raw: ऋषिपुत्र प्रभावेण कामान् प्राप्स्यामि च अपि अहम् । ततः साधु इति तद् वाक्यम् ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन् ॥१-१२-१०॥
स्वं परित्यज्य रूपं यः परिव्राजकरूपधृत् । जनस्थाने मया दृष्टस्त्वं स एवासि रावणः ॥५-३४-१५॥
translation: "You are the same Ravana who took the guise of a mendicant, giving up your real form and came to Janasthana.

raw: निष्फलाः खलु संवृत्ताः शरा वासुकितेजसः । आदत्तं यैः सुसङ्ग्रामे रिपूणां मम जीवितम् ॥६-५१-१६॥
translation: "My arrows which are equal in brilliance to Vasuki by which my enemies' life was taken away has become in fructuous now."

raw: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमम् । अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥६-५९-२६॥
translation: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."

raw: मातंगीम् अथ शार्दूलीम् श्वेताम् च सुरभीम् तथा । सर्व लक्षण संपन्नाम् सुरसाम् कद्रुकाम् अपि ॥३-१४-२२॥
translation: O Ramato Krodhavasa were born Mrugi, Mrugamanda, Hari, Bhadramada, Mathangi, Sardooli, Sweta, Surabhi and Surasa, Kadruva and endowed with all virtues.

raw: सीतापि चरणांस्तासामुपसंगृह्य दु:खिता । श्वश्रूणामश्रुपूर्णाक्षी सा बभूवाग्रत: स्थिता ॥२-१०३-२२॥
translation: Sita, too, overcome with grief, grasped the feet of her mothersinlaw and stood before them, her eyes full of tears.

raw: अदृष्ट्वा तत्र वैदेहीम् संनिरीक्ष्य च सर्वशः । उवाच रामः प्राक्रुश्य प्रगृह्य रुचिरौ भुजौ ॥३-६१-२॥
translation: Rama, son of Dasaratha, saw the empty cottage devoid of Sita. The mats were displaced. He searched everywhere but unable to see Vaidehi lifted his lovely arms and said:

raw: अनिसृष्टम् सुरैः एकम् त्र्यम्बकाय युयुत्सवे । त्रिपुर घ्नम् नरश्रेष्ठ भग्नम् काकुत्स्थ यत् त्वया ॥१-७५-१२॥
translation: O Best among men O Descendant of Kakustha one of these broken by you, was given by the gods to the threeeyed Siva, who, wishing to fight the demon Tripura with this bow, destroyed him.

raw: ततस्तस्याविदूरे स निपत्य हरिपुङ्गवः । दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदः कनकाङ्गदः ॥६-४१-७४॥
translation: Thereafter, the leader of the monkeys, Angada adorned with golden armlets stood like a blazing fire at a distance.

raw: परिव्राजक रूपेण वैदेहीम् अन्ववर्तत । ताम् आससाद अतिबलो भ्रातृभ्याम् रहिताम् वने ॥३-४६-४॥
प्रसन्ना स्सुरसाश्चापो वनानि फलवन्ति च । प्रवान्त्यभ्य नाधिकं गन्धान्यथर्तुकुसुमा द्रुमाः ॥६-४-५४॥
translation: The water is pure and of good taste. The forests are filled with fruits. The wind with fragrance is not blowing excessively or violently. The trees are in bloom beyond season.

raw: ताम् प्रेक्ष्य भरतः क्रुद्धम् शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । अवध्याः सर्व भूतानाम् प्रमदाः क्षम्यताम् इति ॥२-७८-२१॥
translation: Bharata, addressing the enraged Satrughna said Of all beings a lady is not to be killed. Pardon her.

raw: प्रविश्य च महातेजा रावणस्य निवेशनम् । ददर्श मृजया हीनां सातङ्कामिव रोहिणीम् । वृक्षमूले निरानन्दां राक्षसीभिः समावृताम् ॥६-११६-२॥
translation: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.

raw: अहो त्वम् कर्णिकार अद्य पुष्पितः शोभसे भृशम् । कर्णिकार प्रियाम् साध्वीम् शंस दृष्टा यदि प्रिया ॥३-६०-२०॥
translation: O Karnikara tree with flowers in full bloom, tell me if you have seen my faithful beloved who is fond of karnikara flowers.

raw: अनन्तरं तत्सरितश्चित्रकूटश्च पर्वत: । तयो: पर्णकुटी तात तत्र तौ वसतो ध्रुवम् ॥२-९२-१२॥
translation: O dear child, beyond that river lies mount Chitrakuta on which there is a hut made of leaves where, for sure, they both dwell.

raw: सूत रत्न सुसम्पूर्णा चतुर् विध बला चमूः । रागवस्य अनुयात्रा अर्थम् क्षिप्रम् प्रतिविधीयताम् ॥२-३६-२॥
translation: O Sumantra arrange immediately four divisions of the army, wellequipped with precious stones to escort Rama in his journey to (the forest).

raw: ततः सुषेण प्रमुखाः प्लवंगमाःसुग्रीव वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्य । आमंत्र्य सर्वे प्लवगाधिपम् तेजग्मुर् दिशम् ताम् वरुण अभिगुप्ताम् ॥४-४२-५८॥
एवम् त्वयि तत् न चित्रम् भवेत् यत् सौम्य शोभनम् । जानामि अहम् त्वाम् सुग्रीव सततम् प्रिय वादिनम् ॥४-३९-४॥
translation: 'O gentle Sugriva this your help to me is not surprising. You always help your friends and speak in a pleasing manner.

raw: वातस्य तरसा वेगम् निहन्तुम् अपि च उत्सहे । दहेयम् अपि संक्रुद्धः तेजसा आदित्य पावकौ ॥३-३१-७॥
प्रसादयन्नरवृषभ स्समातरं पराक्रमाज्जिगमिषुरेव दण्डकान् । अथानुजं भृशमनुशास्य दर्शनं चकार तां हृदि जननीं प्रदक्षिणम् ॥२-२१-६३॥
translation: Rama, the best among men, thus pacified his mother insisting on his desire to depart for Dandaka forest with courage. And elaborately instructed his brother about his good intentions after which he circumambulated his mother with all his heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अनुज्ञाताः ततः सर्वे पुनर् जग्मुर् यथा आगतम् । विसर्जयित्वा तान् विप्रान् सचिवान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-८-२१॥
अस्माकमतिथिश्चैव पूज्यश्च प्लवतां वरः । चामीकरमहानाभ देवगन्धर्व सेवित ॥५-१-९९॥
translation: "Rise up from the waters. Let him rest on you since this noble monkey is our guest and worthy of worship.

raw: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तम: । किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि ॥२-१११-१६॥
translation: Rama, the foremost of royal sages and highly powerful said, 'Dear Bharata, what wrong have I done that you should prevent me by lying down in front of me?'

raw: दुर्गे विनाशिते कर्म भवेत् सुखपरिश्रमम् । अल्पयत्नेन कार्ये ऽस्मिन् मम स्यात् सफलः श्रमः ॥५-५४-४॥
translation: 'If the citadel is destroyed it would be a happy conclusion with a little effort. I can successfully complete my task.

raw: आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन । तत्करिष्याम्यहं वीर गतानृण्येन चेतसा ॥६-१०६-२४॥
translation: "O Tamer of enemies! Order now and in that way, I shall carry out your order in accordance with you wholeheartedly."

raw: ततः परम संभ्रान्ताः स ऋषि संघाः सुर असुराः । विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् ऊचुः स अनुनयम् वचः ॥१-६०-२४॥
translation: Struck with wonder and fear, hosts of rishis, suras and asuras humbly addressed Viswamitra.

raw: भगवन्पूर्वमप्येषा लङ्कासीत्पिशिताशिनाम् । श्रुत्वेदं भगवद्वाक्यं जातो मे विस्मयः परः ॥७-४-३॥
translation: O revered one, having heard your statement that this Lanka formerly belonged to the flesh-eaters, a great astonishment has arisen within me.

raw: शिष्टैरपरिमेयैश्छ लोके लोकोत्तरैर्गुणैः । तं समीक्ष्य महाराजो युक्तं समुदितैः शुभैः ॥२-१-४१॥
translation: King Dasaratha in consultation with his ministers observed that Rama is endowed with various virtues not found in other kings, immeasurable virtues which are praiseworthy, and exemplary. He is distinguished in this world as all qualities seem to have merged in him. The king then made up his mind to make him princeregent.

raw: उरसा पातयामास जीमूतमिव मारुतः । स तथा पातितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः ॥५-१-१०९॥
पुष्पार्ककेतकाभाश्च केचिज्ज्योतीरसप्रभा: । विराजन्ते ऽचलेन्द्रस्य देशा धातुविभूषिता: ॥२-९४-६॥
translation: This mountain with its peaks is adorned with various minerals. Some of the regions have the radiance of silver and bronze, some look bloodred or maddercrimson, some sparkle like the rarest of gems while others shine like topaz or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant or shimmer like stars and quicksilver.

raw: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम् । तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये येन वृत्रो निहन्यते ॥७-८५-५॥
translation: Your supreme happiness must certainly be achieved, therefore I shall explain a method by which Vritra can be killed.

raw: नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा पापो वा यदि वा शुभ: । यासां स्त्रीणां प्रियो भर्ता तासां लोका महोदया: ॥२-११७-२१॥
translation: One who is devoted to her husband, whether he be in the city or in the forest, whether he is sinful or virtuous, will attain the most prosperous worlds.

raw: राक्षसानां सहस्राणि निहत्य मधुसूदनः । वारिजं पूरयामास तोयदं सुरराडिव ॥७-७-२३॥
translation: Having slain thousands of rakshasas, Madhusudana blew his conch, just as the king of gods (Indra) causes a cloud to thunder.

raw: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि सुव्रत । राज्यं कारयतो ब्रह्मन्प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ॥७-७८-६॥
translation: O virtuous one, O Brahmana, thus thousands of years passed while I ruled the kingdom and protected the subjects righteously.

raw: तत् सारम् अखिलम् नॄणाम् धनम् निचय वर्धनम् । मनसा चिन्तितम् सर्वम् यथा शुक्रस्य लक्ष्मण ॥३-४३-३३॥
translation: O Lakshmana the essence of forest wealth is mineral wealth, which helps the growth of the treasury. It is conceived mentally as in the case of Venus.

raw: सा हि चंपक वर्ण आभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयक उचिता । कोमला विलपन्त्याः तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा ॥३-६०-३२॥
translation: That delicate, beautiful neck of my beloved having the complexion of a champak flower and adorned with necklaces was perhaps eaten up.

raw: एवं सुविहितो यज्ञो हयमेधो ऽभ्यवर्तत । लक्ष्मणेनागुप्ता च हयचर्या प्रवर्तत । ईदृशं राजसिंहस्य यज्ञप्रवरमुत्तमम् ॥७-९२-९॥
translation: Thus, the well-arranged Ashvamedha sacrifice proceeded, and the horse's journey, unguarded by Lakshmana, also took place, such was this excellent and supreme sacrifice of the lion among kings.

raw: आकाशम् इव दुष्पारम् सागरम् प्रेक्ष्य वानराः । विषेदुः सहिता सर्वे कथम् कार्यम् इति ब्रुवन् ॥४-६४-७॥
translation: All the monkeys were worried when they suddenly saw the ocean which looked impassable like the sky. They wondered if they can at all accomplish the task (of finding Sita)

raw: ततः समुपजिघ्रंती कपि राजस्य तत् मुखम् । पतिम् लोकश्रुता तारा मृतम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-२३-१॥
translation: Tara kissed (smelt) the forehead of the king of monkeys who had departed and said:

raw: हतवीरप्रधानां हि हतौत्साहा निरुद्यमा । सेना भ्रमति सङ्ख्येषु हतकर्णेव नौर्जले ॥६-४८-२७॥
translation: "The army chief killed, the interest of the troop lost, Pushpaka will move about without making an effort like the ship which lost the helmsman."

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सविमर्शो विभीषणः । रामस्योपानयत् सीतां सन्निकर्षं विनीतवत् ॥६-११७-३०॥
translation: Rama having spoken clearly in that way, Vibheeshana reverently conducted Sita to Rama.

raw: या श्रीःशौर्यम् च रामस्य या च कल्याणसत्वता । निवृत्तारण्यवासः स्वं क्षिप्रम् राज्यमवाप्स्यति ॥२-४४-१४॥
translation: On return from his sojourn in the forest, Rama, endowed with splendour, valour and a strength that brings wellbeing will quickly regain his kingdom.

raw: क्वचिद् भक्ष्यामः च विविधान् क्वचित् पानानि भागशः । क्वचिद् अन्न अवशेषाणि पश्यन् वै विचचार ह ॥५-११-२६॥
translation: He moved about looking at different types of eatables and drinks arranged separately along with the left over food.
