translation: O Raghava, this full month has passed without any disease among beings, and even for the aged, death does not come.

raw: शीघ्रं वरय धर्मज्ञ वरो यस्ते ऽभिकाङ्क्षितः । कं ते कामं करोम्यद्य न वृथा ते परिश्रमः ॥७-१०-१४॥
translation: Brahma tells Ravana, "O righteous one, quickly choose the boon you desire; what wish of yours shall I fulfill today, for your effort will not be in vain."

raw: रावणात्कुम्भकर्णाच्च प्रहस्ताद्विकटादपि । रावणस्य च पुत्रेभ्यः किं नु ते बलवत्तराः ॥७-४-५॥
translation: Are these new Rākṣasas indeed more powerful than Rāvaṇa, Kumbhakarṇa, Prahasta, Vikaṭa, and even Rāvaṇa's own sons?

raw: विषये ते महा राज माम व्यसन कर्शिताः । अपि वृक्षाः परिम्लानः सपुष्प अन्कुर कोरकाः ॥२-५९-४॥
translation: O great king even trees with their flowers, buds and shoots throughout your empire have withered because of the calamity on Rama.

raw: एतद्वच स्तस्य निशम्य माता । सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लबम् च । मृतेव सम्ज्ञाम् प्रतिलभ्य देवी । समीक्ष्य रामम् पुनरित्युवाच ॥२-२१-५०॥
translation: Having heard these words so unruffled and tranquil which conformed to righteousness, mother (Kausalya), like a dead person regaining consciousness spoke to Rama again:

raw: शत ह्रदानाम् लोलत्वम् शस्त्राणाम् तीक्ष्णताम् तथा । गरुड अनिलयोः शैघ्र्यम् अनुगच्छन्ति योषितः ॥३-१३-६॥
translation: Women are fickle like lightning, sharp like weapons and fast like Garuda or the windgod.

raw: अथ सो ऽभ्यपतद्रोषाद्राक्षसो बलदर्पितः । महानादं प्रकुर्वाणो राक्षसाञ्जीवयन्निव ॥७-७-२७॥
translation: Then, that Rakshasa, proud of his strength, rushed forward in anger, making a great roar as if to revive the other Rakshasas.

raw: ततः नान्दी मुखीम् रात्रिम् भरतम् सूत मागधाः । तुष्टुवुर् वाग् विशेषज्ञाः स्तवैः मन्गल सम्हितैः ॥२-८१-१॥
translation: Thereafter bards and panegyrists adept in conversation with an auspicious start pleased Bharata with eulogy in the last part of the night.

raw: येन कालेन रामश्च वनात्प्रत्यागमिष्यति । तेन कालेन पुत्रस्ते कृतमूलो भविष्यति ॥२-९-३४॥
translation: By the time Rama returns from the forest, your son (now) confident, would have become deep rooted by gaining the company of friends and the acceptability of the people.

raw: सताम् लोकात् सताम् कीर्त्याः सज् जुष्टात् कर्मणः तथा । भ्रश्यतु क्षिप्रम् अद्य एव यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४७॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be expelled this very moment from the world approved by virtuous men, from their renown and from their (noble) actions

raw: अतिमात्रप्रहर्षोऽयं किं जनस्य च शंस मे । कारयिष्यति किं वापि संप्रहृष्टो महीपतिः ॥२-७-९॥
translation: Why do the people look exceedingly happy? Tell me, what the king with great delight is proposing to do?

raw: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप । अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम् । गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानीं त्वया ऽनघ ॥६-१२६-१८॥
translation: "O King! I wish to go to the capital city Ayodhya with you, Tara and other consorts of Sugriva, and other women, surrounded by Vanara chiefs."

raw: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः । स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तेजस्वी स्थैर्यं कृत्वा महामतिः । आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ॥६-५९-६१॥
translation: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.

raw: राक्षसानाम् अयम् वासो घोराणाम् काम रूपिणाम् । प्रासाद अग्राणि रम्याणि नगर उपवनानि च ॥३-४६-२५॥
कंदरात् अभिनिष्क्रम्य स विन्ध्यस्य महागिरेः । उपविष्टान् हरीन् दृष्ट्वा हृष्टात्मा गिरम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५६-३॥
translation: Coming out of the cave of the great mount Vindhya, Sampati was glad to see the monkeys seated there and said to himself:

raw: सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं प्रममाथ रथं तदा ॥६-५४-२५॥
translation: The hillock discharged by Angada went right in the forefront of the battle and shattered the chariot along with its wheels and pole.

raw: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा ग्रहाश्च न चकाशिरे ॥६-५७-३७॥
translation: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

raw: निवेश्य सेनां तु विभु: पद्भ्यां पादवतां वर: । अभिगन्तुं स काकुत्स्थमियेष गुरुवर्त्तकम् ॥२-९८-१॥
translation: On encamping the army, lord Bharata, the best among men, wished to approach on foot Rama who was devoted to his father.

raw: इमे च पुरुष व्याघ्र ये तिष्ठन्ति अभितः दिशम् । शतम् शतम् कुण्डलिनो युवानः खड्ग पाणयः ॥३-५-१५॥
translation: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

raw: ततः सञ्चोदयानो वै हरीन् रक्षो रणप्रियान् । उवाच वचनं काले कालज्ञो रक्षसां वरः ॥६-९०-७॥
translation: Then Vibheeshana, who is a knower of what is the right time to act spoke to Vanaras to embolden them who were eager to fight with Rakshasas.

raw: कुर्वन्तः कदनं घोरमेते शस्त्रास्त्रपारगाः । अन्तकप्रतिमैर्बाणैर्दिष्ट्या विनिहतास्त्वया ॥७-१-२६॥
translation: Fortunately, these masters of weapons and missiles, who were causing terrible slaughter, have been killed by you with arrows resembling those of Yama.

raw: यस्यार्था धर्मकामार्थास्तस्य सर्वं प्रदक्षिणम् । अधनेनार्थकामेन नार्थः शक्यो विचिन्वता ॥६-८३-३८॥
translation: For one who has wealth all his actions of dharma would give pleasure and favourable. One who has no wealth and is worrying about it can't attain it.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजाः पुत्रान् परम धार्मिकान् । व्यादिदेश महाप्राज्ञान् यज्ञ संभार कारणात् ॥१-५९-६॥
translation: Most brilliant Viswamitra having thus spoken, ordered his deeply religious and highly learned sons to make preparations for the sacrifice.

raw: वसिष्ठः कश्यपो ऽथात्रिर्विश्वामित्रः सगौतमः । जमदग्निर्भरद्वाजस्ते ऽपि सप्तर्षयस्तथा ॥७-१-५॥
translation: Vasishtha, Kashyapa, Atri, Vishwamitra with Gautama, Jamadagni, and Bharadvaja, who are also known as the Saptarshis, were among those who arrived.

raw: प्रकृत्या हिम कोश आढ्यो दूर सूर्याः च सांप्रतम् । यथार्थ नामा सुव्यक्तम् हिमवान् हिमवान् गिरिः ॥३-१६-९॥
translation: Presently with the Sun far away, the Himalayas abounding in snow has naturally justified its name.

raw: वासवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः । रक्षांस्यावाहयामास कुम्भकर्णं ददर्श ह ॥६-६१-२२॥
translation: Hearing the words of Indra, Brahma conjured the Rakshasas and saw Kumbhakarna with them.

raw: कुटजैर् अर्जुनैस् तालैस् तिकलैस् तिमिशैर् अपि । बिल्वकैः सप्तपर्णैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः ॥६-२२-५५॥
translation: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.

raw: कौसल्यायै नरपतिः पायस अर्धम् ददौ तदा । अर्धात् अर्धम् ददौ च अपि सुमित्रायै नराधिपः ॥१-१६-२७॥
translation: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

raw: त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता । किम् पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवम् मरणम् एव मे ॥२-२०-४१॥
translation: O child even when you are nearby I am neglected like this. What to say when you are banished. Death is certain to me.

raw: धनूंषि चास्य सज्यानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः । शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठं शक्रचाप इवाम्बरम् ॥६-७१-१५॥
translation: "His bows decorated with gold on the back, are like a rainbow in the sky on all sides and makes the chariot excellent."

raw: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि बहून्यथ ययुः सुखम् । यज्ञैर्बहुविधं धर्मं वर्धयानस्य सर्वदा ॥७-९९-२०॥
translation: Thus, many thousands of years passed happily for him who was always increasing various kinds of righteousness through sacrifices. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनशततमः सर्गः ।। 99 ।। Thus ends the ninety-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: आविकं विविधं चौर्णं काञ्चनं भाण्डमायुधम् । नानाविकृतसंस्थानं वाजिभाण्डपरिच्छदौ ॥६-७५-९॥
तस्याङ्गदः प्रकुपितो राक्षसस्य तमायसम् । दूरस्थितस्य परिघं रविरश्मिसमप्रभम् ॥६-९९-१३॥
translation: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

raw: यावदुत्पाटयामासुर्वृक्षान् शैलान् वनौकसः । तावत् प्रासहताः पेतुर्वज्रकृत्ता इवाचलाः ॥६-६९-७५॥
translation: Uplifting his lance in the battle, Naranthaka consumed the Vanara troops as fire would burn up forests even before the Vanaras uprooted trees and rocks. many Vanaras fell like mountains hit by a thunderbolt.

raw: औरसान् अपि पुत्रान् हि त्यजन्ति अहित कारिणः । समर्थान् सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनान् अपि नर अधिपाः ॥२-२६-३६॥
translation: Kings abandon (even) their own sons if they are harmful and receive capable people even if they are strangers.

raw: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः प्रज्वलन्निव सागरः । उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धः स्पृशन्निव दिवाकरम् ॥६-१०३-३१॥
translation: The waves of the ocean were, as if in fury, waves covered with mist turning around as though to touch the radiant sun rose high.

raw: ते तव प्रबलं दर्पमुत्सेधं च पृथग्विधम् । व्यपनेष्यन्ति सम्भूय सहामात्यसुतस्य च ॥७-१६-१९॥
translation: They will unitedly destroy your mighty and diverse arrogance and haughtiness, along with your ministers and sons.

raw: स राजा वीर्यसम्पन्नः पुरं देवपुरोपमम् । निवेशयामास तदा अभ्याशे गौतमस्य तु ॥७-५५-५॥
translation: That valiant king then founded a city, resembling a divine city, near the hermitage of Gautama.

raw: पात्रीणां च सहस्राणि स्थालीनां नियुतानि च । न्यर्बुदानि च पात्राणि शातकुम्भमयानि च ॥२-९१-७०॥
यो हि मोहाद्विषं पीत्वा नावगच्छति दुर्मतिः । स तस्य परिणामान्ते जानीते कर्मणः फलम् ॥७-१५-१९॥
translation: An evil-minded person who, out of delusion, drinks poison and does not understand its nature, will only realize the consequence of that action at its ultimate fruition.

raw: न सुवर्णेन मे ह्यर्थो न रत्नैर्न च भूषणैः । एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते ॥२-९-५९॥
translation: I do not aspire for gold, nor gems nor ornaments. If Rama is installed, that will be the end of my life.

raw: इदं शरीरं कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य चरता हितम् । पाण्दुरस्यातपत्रस्य च्छायायां जरितं मया ॥२-२-७॥
translation: My body has attained old age after ruling the entire world ensuring the welfare of the people under the shade of royal white parasol.

raw: द्वितीयं रावणशिरश्छिन्नं संयति सायकैः । छिन्नमात्रं तु तच्छीर्षं पुनरन्यत् स्म दृश्यते ॥६-११०-२८॥
translation: Before cutting that second head of Ravana again another head appeared.

raw: सुधृतेरपि धर्मात्मा दृष्टकेतुस्सुधार्मिक: । दृष्टकेतोस्तु राजर्षेर्हर्यश्व इति विश्रुत: ॥१-७१-८॥
translation: To Sudhruti was born the righteous Drishtaketu, committed to dharma. Rajarshi Drishtaketu was father to the wellknown Haryasva.

raw: पातितो अहम् तदा तेन गंभीरे सागर अंभसि । प्राप्य संज्ञाम् चिरात् तात लंकाम् प्रति गतः पुरीम् ॥३-३८-२१॥
translation: O dear I was thrown into the deep sea and after a long time regained consciousness and returned to the city of Lanka.

raw: कुम्भश्चैव निकुम्भश्च राक्षसौ भीमदर्शनौ । दिष्ट्या तौ निहतौ राम कुम्भकर्णसुतौ मृधे ॥७-१-२४॥
translation: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed Kumbha and Nikumbha, the two sons of Kumbhakarna who were of terrible appearance, in battle.

raw: उवास सुखितः तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षभः । स रामः पर्ण शालायाम् आसीनः सह सीतया ॥३-१७-३॥
त्रिविष्टप निभम् दिव्यम् दिव्य नाद विनादितम् । वाजि हेषित सम्घुष्टम् नादितम् भूषणैः तथा ॥५-४-२६॥
translation: And then the great vanara entered the wonderful mansion that resembled heaven. It was resonating with pleasing sounds of jingling ornaments made more noisy by the neighing of the horses. There were carriages, chariots, flying chariots, horses and elephants. The beautiful entrance was looking splendid with intoxicated animals and birds. That place looked splendid with fourtusked elephants resembling heaps of white clouds. The beautiful entrance was guarded by thousands of valiant demons.

raw: जहि वीर महावीर्यौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । अदृश्यो दृश्यमानो वा सर्वथा त्वं बलाधिकः ॥६-८०-३॥
translation: "Oh, Valiant son! You destroy the two heroic brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, by being visible or invisible as you are always superior to them."

raw: त्वयि प्रव्रजिते वीर गुरोश्च वचने स्थिते । रक्षसा ऽपहृता भार्या प्राणैः प्रियतरा तव ॥६-८३-४१॥
translation: "O heroic Rama! You have been faithful to the promise to your father and left home following dharma (giving up wealth), and your dear wife who is your life has been abducted by Rakshasa."

raw: राक्षसा ये विकर्तारः तेषाम् अपि विनाशने । श्रेयः च अस्मै प्रदास्यामि बहुरूपम् न संशयः ॥१-१९-१०॥
स कीर्यमाणः शरजालवृष्टिभिर्महात्मना दीप्तधनुष्मता ऽर्दितः । भयात् प्रदुद्राव समेत्य रावणो यथा ऽनिलेनाभिहतो बलाहकः ॥६-१०१-६३॥
अन्योन्यस्य न लज्जन्ते न निरीक्षन्ति पृष्ठतः । विप्रकर्षन्ति चान्योन्यं पतितं लङ्घयन्ति च ॥६-५०-६॥
translation: "Without waiting to look back at others, not shy to see one another, the Vanaras are distancing themselves from those fallen and are seen fleeing."

raw: स रामो बहुभिः बाणैः खर कार्मुक निःसृतैः । विद्धो रुधिर सिक्तांगो बभूव रुषितो भृशम् ॥३-२८-२५॥
translation: Rama, hit by the arrows released from the bow of Khara, all his limbs drenched in blood, became very furious.

raw: पार्श्वेषु दारिताः केचित् केचिद्राशीकृता द्रुमैः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचित् केचिद्दन्तैर्विदारिताः ॥६-५२-११॥
translation: Some tore by the sides of the body, some crushed by the trees, some powdered by the rocks, and some were torn into pieces with teeth.

raw: नलिन्यो ध्वस्त कमलाः त्रस्त मीन जले चराः । सखीम् इव गत उत्साहाम् शोचन्ति इव स्म मैथिलीम् ॥३-५२-३५॥
translation: Lotusponds with withering lotuses and with disturbed aquatic life like fishes in fright were as if grieving for Sita as one would grieve for a companion who is unable to breathe.

raw: कैकेयि मा मम अन्गानि स्प्राक्षीस् त्वम् दुष्ट चारिणी । न हि त्वाम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि न भार्या न च बान्धवी ॥२-४२-६॥
translation: O Kaikeyi you are a woman of evil conduct. Do not touch my body. I do not wish to see you. You are not my wife or my relation.

raw: वासम् चक्रुर् मुनि गणाः शोणा कूले समाहिताः । ते अस्तम् गते दिनकरे स्नात्वा हुत हुताशनाः ॥१-३१-२०॥
शोक उपहत चेताः च वृद्धः च जगती पतिः । काम भार अवसन्नः च तस्मात् एतत् ब्रवीमि ते ॥२-५२-२३॥
translation: I tell you this because the lord of the earth (Dasaratha), is in deep distress. He is old. And he is under the control of his passion.

raw: स गत्वा मनसा पूर्वम् अशोक वनिकाम् शुभाम् । उत्तरम् चिन्तयाम् आस वानरो मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-१३-६१॥
translation: Hanuman started thinking again about his task after reaching the auspicious Ashoka grove.

raw: हिरण्मयैः च करकैर् भाजनैः स्फाटिकैर् अपि । जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्याः करकैरभिवम्वृता ॥५-११-२२॥
translation: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.

raw: द्युमत्सेन सुतम् वीर सत्यवन्तम् अनुव्रताम् । सावित्रीम् इव माम् विद्धि त्वम् आत्म वश वर्तिनीम् ॥२-३०-६॥
translation: Know, O valiant one, that by remaining subordinate to you, I am as faithful to you as Savitri was to her husband, Satyavanta, son of Dyumatsena.

raw: देवान्तकाय तं वीरश्चिक्षेप सहसा ऽङ्गदः । महावृक्षं महाशाखं शक्रो दीप्तमिवाशनिम् ॥६-७०-६॥
translation: Just as Indra took a flaming thunderbolt, Angada, the hero took hold of huge branches of trees and hurled at Devanthaka with force.

raw: नान्यो रामाद्धि तद्द्वारं समर्थः परिरक्षितुम् । रावणाधिष्ठितं भीमं वरुणेनेव सागरम् ॥६-४१-३४॥
translation: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.

raw: स तु तेन प्रहारेण महापार्श्वो विचेतनः । ससूतः स्यन्दनात्तस्माद्विसञ्ज्ञः प्रापतद्भुवि ॥६-९९-७॥
translation: By that hit, Mahaparsva became unconscious and fell on the ground, senseless, from the chariot along with the charioteer.

raw: न खलु अस्ति मम त्रासो लक्ष्मणान् न अपि राघवात् । मित्रम् तु अस्थान कुपितम् जनयति एव संभ्रमम् ॥४-३२-६॥
translation: 'I have no fear either from Lakshmana or from Rama. However, when a friend is enraged without reason, it creates misgivings.

raw: उषित्वा स सुखम् तत्र पूर्ज्यमानो महर्षिभिः । जगाम च आश्रमान् तेषाम् पर्यायेण तपस्विनाम् ॥३-११-२३॥
translation: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeated his stay.

raw: तौ तु दत्तौ वरौ देव निक्षेपौ मृगयाम्यहम् । तथैव पृथिवीपाल सकाशे सत्यसंगर ॥२-११-२०॥
translation: O protector of the earth, O king, honest in keeping promises, I (now) seek those two boons which were reserved as deposits.

raw: पराक्रमोत्साहमनस्विनां च सुरासुराणामपि दुर्जयेन । त्वया मनोनन्दन नैर्ऋतानां युद्धायतिर्नाशयितुं न युक्ता ॥५-५२-२३॥
translation: "O delighter of demons even the gods and demons who are endowed with valour and energy cannot win you. You are invincible. It is not proper for you to lose chances of a good war.

raw: विरराज महा बाहुः चित्रया चन्द्रमा इव । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः ॥३-१७-४॥
पञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वम् निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि । अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याऽभिप्रचोदितः ॥२-३४-३७॥
translation: Instigated by this Kaikeyi, the destroyer of traditions (of the race) I have been deceived for which you wish to pay.

raw: ऋषभं च सुविक्रान्तं जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम् । ये चेमे सुमहात्मानो मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः ॥७-४०-६॥
translation: Also see Rishabha, the very valorous, and Jambavan of great strength, and all these other great-souled beings who risked their lives for my sake.

raw: ततो रामम् यथा न्यायम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे । दीर्घबाहुः विशालाक्षः चीर कृष्ण अजिन अम्बरः ॥३-३४-५॥
तस्मिन् हते राक्षससैन्यपाले प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे । भीमायुधं सागरतुल्यवेगं विदुद्रुवे राक्षसराजसैन्यम् ॥६-५९-१॥
translation: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.

raw: अयोध्याम् न प्रवेक्ष्यामि प्रवेक्ष्यामि तपो वनम् । तयोः विलपितम् श्रुत्वा व्यसनम् च अन्ववेक्ष्य तत् ॥२-७७-१९॥
धूम्राक्षेणार्दितं सैन्यं व्यथितं दृश्य मारुतिः । अभ्यवर्तत सङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम् ॥६-५२-२६॥
translation: Beholding the perturbed army, Hanuman seized a huge rock and turned towards Dhumraksha.

raw: अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम् । समानयस्व वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना ॥५-१-१७१॥
translation: "O noble vanara proceed happily to achieve your purpose. Go and unite Vaidehi with the noble self, Raghava.

raw: एताम् बुद्धिम् ततः चक्रुः सर्वे ते हरि यूथपाः । अवतार्य गिरेः शृंगात् गृध्रम् आह अंगदः तदा ॥४-५७-४॥
भर्ता तु खलु नारीणाम् गुणवान् निर्गुणो अपि वा । धर्मम् विमृशमानानाम् प्रत्यक्षम् देवि दैवतम् ॥२-६२-८॥
translation: O Devi for women who have regard for righteousness, a husband, whether virtuous or not, is a god incarnate.

raw: स दुरात्मा समुद्यम्य कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् । प्रविवेश ततः सैन्यं नयन्यक्षान्यमक्षयम् ॥७-१४-१४॥
translation: The evil-minded one, having raised his mace resembling the staff of Yama, then entered the army, leading the Yakshas to their death.

raw: न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव । सुराणाम् ईश्वरः शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुम् ओजसा ॥२-२९-६॥
translation: If I am in your company, O Rama even the lord of the gods, Indra with all his might will not be able to hurt me.

raw: अनुहो नाम तस्य एष रावणस्य विभीषणः । पृच्च्यताम् मधुरेण अयम् शनैर् नर वर ईश्वर ॥६-१७-४८॥
translation: "O king of mortals This is Ravana's brother called Vibheeshana. Let him be slowly and gently interrogated for long."

raw: प्रशान्तपीडाबहुलो नष्टारिष्टः प्रतापवान् । बभूव लोकः पतिते राक्षसेन्द्रसुते तदा ॥६-९१-८६॥
translation: Then many were at peace and rejoiced in the world, being relieved, when Ravana's son dropped dead.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७४ ॥६-७४-७९॥
अथवा नैतदेवं हि यन्मया परिशङ्कितम् । मनसो हि मम प्रीतिरुत्पन्ना तव दर्शनात् ॥५-३४-१७॥
translation: "May be my suspicion is not correct Because I am experiencing pleasure in my mind in your presence.

raw: सौवर्णींशिबिकांदिव्यामारोप्यक्षौमवासनम् रावणंराक्षसाधीशमश्रुपूर्यमुखाद्विजाः । तूर्यघोषैश्चविविधैस्स्तुवद्भिश्चाभिनन्दितम् प्ताकाभिश्चचित्राभिस्सुमनोभिश्चचित्रिताम् । उत्क्षिप्यशिबिकांतांतुविभीषणपुरोगमाः दक्षिणाभिमुखास्सर्वेगृह्यकाष्ठानिभेजिरे ॥६-११४-१०७॥
translation: As the dead body of Ravana was lifted up for final beatitude, panegyrists hailed him with blasts of several musical instruments and praised him with their faces bathed in tears. The golden cart was decorated with beautiful, picturesque, wonderful pictures and flags. Logs of wood were placed on the body and consecrated by sprinkling fragrant water. With Vibheeshana in the forefront, faces turned to the southern side, all proceeded.

raw: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः । उत्पत्योत्पत्य ददृशुस्तां पुरीं शुभदर्शनाम् ॥६-१२६-५०॥
translation: Then all the Vanaras, Vibheeshana too and Rakshasas got up and saw the delightful city.

raw: प्रजगुर्धेवगन्धर्वाननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । अभिषेकेतदर्हस्यतदारामस्यधीमतः ॥६-१३१-७२॥
translation: The Gandharvas from among the gods sang and Apsara groups danced for Rama's consecration.

raw: असावत्यन्तनिर्भग्न स्तवपुत्रो भविष्यति । अनाथवत्सुखेभ्यश्च राजवंशाच्च वत्सले ॥२-८-२५॥
translation: O (Kaikeyi) dear cut off from royal succession as well as from its comforts, your son will become totally forlorn and brokenhearted.

raw: धिक् त्वाम् इति च माम् उक्त्वा बहु तत् तत् उवाच ह । प्रकृतीः च समानीय मंत्रिणः चैव सम्मतान् ॥४-१०-१२॥
ततः प्रवृत्तं तुमुलं हरीणां राक्षसैः सह । घोराणां भीमरूपाणामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥६-५३-१८॥
translation: Then dreadful encounters of fierce form took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas each one trying to kill another.

raw: सशरीरा गता स्वर्गम् भर्तारम् अनुवर्तिनी । कौशिकी परमोदारा सा प्रवृत्ता महानदी ॥१-३४-८॥
translation: Following her husband my highly generous sister reached heaven with her human body and down assuming the form of a sacred river, flowed Kausiki.

raw: तस्मान्नास्य वदे यत्नः कार्यः परपुरञ्जय । भवान् सेन्द्रेषु देवेषु यत्नमास्तातुमर्हति ॥५-५२-२१॥
translation: "You who can conquer citadels of enemies should not direct your efforts to kill an envoy.You are fit to make efforts against enemies like gods including Indra.

raw: पितामहानाम् सर्वेषाम् कुरुष्व सलिलक्रियाम् । स्वस्ति ते अस्तु गमिष्यामि स्वम् लोकम् गम्यताम् नृप ॥१-४४-१५॥
translation: O King perform the rites of all your forefathers with the waters (of Ganga), farewell. I shall return to my world (now). Go back, O King" (said Grandsire)

raw: उपायमेते वक्ष्यन्ति ग्रहणे नात्रसम्शयः । कृत्स्नाद् भयाज्ज्ञातिभयम् सुकष्टम् विदितम् च नः ॥६-१६-८॥
translation: "It is known that they (paternal relatives) teach the means to catch us. Out of all fears the fear of close relatives is the great difficulty for us."

raw: आलोक्य तु महा प्राज्ञः परम आकुल चेतसम् । रामम् एव अनुशोचन्तम् सूतः प्रान्जलिर् आसदत् ॥२-३४-४॥
translation: Seeing the king brooding over Rama, in an extremely agitated state, the sagacious charioteer approached him with folded hands.

raw: रामं दृष्ट्वा सुसङ्क्रुद्धमुत्पातांश्च सुदारुणान् । वित्रेसुः सर्वभूतानि रावणस्याभवद्भयेम् ॥६-१०४-४॥
translation: Rama became highly furious, most dreadful sounds were rising up and all beings were frightened. Ravana was also afraid.

raw: वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः । स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः ॥२-२६-३२॥
translation: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.

raw: सीतायाः च विनाशो अयम् मम च अमित्र सूदन । विस्तरेण जनन्या विनिवेद्य त्वया भवेत् ॥३-६२-१९॥
translation: O Lakshmana, subduer of the enemy this loss of Sita and me should be explained in detail to my mother.

raw: राक्षसानां वधे साह्यं लङ्कायाश्च प्रधर्षणम् । करिष्यामि यथाप्राणं प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वाहिनीम् ॥६-१९-२४॥
translation: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."

raw: द्रष्टव्यं च पदं तेषां वानराणां निशाचराः । प्रदोषे वा ऽर्धरात्रे वा प्रत्यूषे वापि सर्वतः ॥६-७२-१५॥
परित्यक्ता वसिष्ठेन किम् अहम् सुमहात्मना । या अहम् राज भृतैः दीना ह्रियेयम् भृश दुःखिता ॥१-५४-३॥
translation: "I am being carried away by attendants of the king in this greatly distressed and pitiable condition. Have I been abandoned by the magnanimous Vasishta?

raw: स बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः सप्तभिः कायभेदनैः ॥६-७६-५४॥
पतितं तमभिज्ञाय राक्षसी सा महाचमूः । वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ॥६-९१-७९॥
translation: Great army of Rakshasas even though desired to win seeing (Indrajith dead), Vanaras started attacking them. Unable to bear Rakshasas screamed.

raw: तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः । दृष्ट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः ॥६-१००-१०॥
translation: Ravana's shafts had burnt many hundreds of Vanaras in war and seeing that Rama took a firm stand.

raw: ददर्श लङ्कां सुन्यस्तां रम्यकाननशोभिताम् । तस्यां गोपुरशृङ्गस्थं राक्षसेन्द्रं दुरासदम् ॥६-४०-३॥
कदा प्रेक्ष्य नर व्याघ्राव् अरण्यात् पुनर् आगतौ । नन्दिष्यति पुरी हृष्टा समुद्रैव पर्वणि ॥२-४३-११॥
translation: When will, like the swelling sea on a full Moon day, the city hail the return of Rama and Lakshmana, the best among men?

raw: क्रोधम् उत्पाद्य नो भर्तुः खरस्य सुमहात्मनः । त्वम् एव हास्यसे प्राणान् अद्य अस्माभिर् हतो युधि ॥३-२०-१३॥
translation: You have incited the wrath of Khara, our great master for which you will now pay with your life in the fight.

raw: आह्वये लोकपालांस्त्रीन् देवान् शक्रमुखांस्तथा । आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥२-९१-१३॥
translation: I invoke the three deities, guardians of the four quarters headed by Indra to extend hospitality (to Bharata). Let them make adequate arrangements in this regard.

raw: स देवगन्धर्वगणैरभिष्टुतस्तथाप्सरोनृत्यविभूषितालयः । गभस्तिभिः सूर्य इवावभासयन्पितुः समीपं प्रययौ स वित्तपः ॥७-३-३६॥
translation: Praised by hosts of gods and Gandharvas, and with his abode adorned by the dances of Apsaras, that lord of wealth, Kubera, approached his father, shining like the sun with its rays. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे तृतीयः सर्गः ।। 3 ।। Thus ends the third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: त इमे बहु विक्रान्तैः बलिभिः भीम विक्रमैः । आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः ॥४-४०-३॥
translation: 'Dreadful monkeys, powerful monkeys of fierce valour who resemble demons in form, have arrived.

raw: प्रतिषिद्ध्य शुभम् छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलंकृते । विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथम् पौरास्तथा जन्नान् ॥२-१९-३४॥
translation: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unpleasant news.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु पापसंयुक्तमात्मानं पुरषर्षभ । किमुवाच नृगो राजा द्विजौ क्रोधसमन्वितौ ॥७-५४-३॥
translation: O best of men, what did King Nṛga say to the two enraged Brahmins after hearing himself accused of sin?

raw: यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे द्विजपुत्रः स जीवतु । दिशन्तु वरमेतं मे इप्सितं परमं मम ॥७-७६-१०॥
translation: Rama requested that if the gods were pleased with him, they should grant his greatest desire: that the brahmin's son be brought back to life.

raw: कन्दर्पो मूर्तिमान् आसीत् काम इति उच्यते बुधैः । तपस्यंतम् इह स्थाणुम् नियमेन समाहितम् ॥१-२३-१०॥
translation: "Kandarpa (the god of love) once lived here in human form. He is called Kama by the learned. The wicked Kama on his way with the maruts (god of wind) insulted Siva, the god of gods, while he was absorbed in austere meditation along with his newly wedded consort. On seeing Kama Lord Siva roared at him (menacingly).

raw: पतिते त्वनृते तस्मिन्नधर्मे च महीतले । शुभान्येवाचरँल्लोकः सत्यधर्मपरायणः ॥७-७४-१९॥
translation: Indeed, even when that untruth and unrighteousness had descended upon the earth, people devoted to truth and righteousness still performed only auspicious deeds.

raw: पतत्रिणः तस्य वपाम् उद्धृत्य नियतेइन्द्रियः । ऋत्विक् परम संपन्नः श्रपयामास शास्त्रतः ॥१-१४-३६॥
translation: The official priest, highly knowledgeable in scriptures and having restrained senses, removed the marrow from the horse and cooked it according to tradition.

raw: पदानुगाश्च ये राज्ञस्तां श्रुत्वा गीतिसम्पदम् । अवाङ्मुखाश्च दीनाश्च ह्याश्चर्यमिति चाब्रुवन् ॥७-७१-१८॥
translation: And the king's followers, having heard that excellent song, became downcast and distressed, exclaiming, "This is indeed a wonder!"

raw: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः । नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥५-६७-९॥
translation: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.

raw: ऋष्यशृङ्गः तु जामाता पुत्रान् तव विधास्यति । सनत्कुमार कथितम् एतावत् व्याहृतम् मया ॥१-९-१९॥
translation: 'Risyasringa, your soninlaw, would help you to obtain sons'. Thus said Sanathkumara which I have related to you.

raw: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् । महत् समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं दुद्राव रक्षोधिपतिं हरीशः ॥६-५९-३६॥
translation: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.

raw: हर्यश्वस्य मरु: पुत्रो मरो: पुत्र: प्रतिन्धक: । प्रतिंधकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीर्तिरथस्सुत: ॥१-७१-९॥
translation: Haryasva's son was Maru, father of Pratindhaka. Pratindhaka's son was the righteous king Kirtiratha.

raw: दीक्षितस्य कुतो युद्धं क्रोधित्वं दीक्षिते कुतः । संशयश्च जये नित्यं राक्षसश्च सुदुर्जयः ॥७-१८-१८॥
translation: For one consecrated for a sacrifice, whence comes battle, and whence comes anger; moreover, there is always doubt in victory, and the demon is very difficult to conquer.

raw: लाज पूर्णैः च पात्रीभिः रक्षितैः अपि संस्कृतैः । दर्भैः समैः समास्तीर्य विधिवत् मंत्र पुरस्कृतम् ॥१-७३-२३॥
कृतक्ण्ठगुणाः क्षीबा र्क्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः । र्क्तक्षाः पुष्कराक्षाश्च गगनं प्रतिपेदिरे ॥५-१-२५॥
translation: The intoxicated vidyadharas with eyes red like lotuses, wearing garlands around the neck and smeared with red sandalpaste flew into the sky.

raw: उपगम्य समाघ्राय विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश । राक्षसः सो अपि तान् वन्यान् मृगान् मृगवधे रतः ॥३-४२-२९॥
स रथेनाग्निवर्णेन बलवान् रावणात्मजः । इन्द्रजित् कवची धन्वी सध्वजः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥६-८७-८॥
translation: Indrajith, who was endowed with mighty prowess, armed with shield and sword, appeared like glowing gold in the chariot decorated with a post.

raw: ततः प्रतेरतुर्य त्तौ वीरौ दशरथात्मजौ । कालिन्दीमध्यमायाता सीता त्वेनामवन्दत ॥२-५५-१९॥
आजगाम रिपुम् हत्वा दानवम् स तु वानरः । अभिषिक्तम् तु माम् दृष्ट्वा कोपात् संरक्त लोचनः ॥४-९-२२॥
निवर्त्तयितुकामस्तु त्वामेतद्वाक्यमुक्तवान् । इमां लोकसमुत्पत्तिं लोकनाथ निबोध मे ॥२-११०-२॥
translation: O lord of the worlds, Jabali had spoken all this only with the intention to make you return (to Ayodhya). Listen I shall (now) relate to you the origin of the world.

raw: तवास्त्रबलमासाद्य नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः । न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं सुरेश्वरसमाश्रिताः ॥५-४८-३॥
translation: "None could face you in war including Indra, Maruts and gods because of your skill and the power of your astras.

raw: विष्णुपादच्युताम् दिव्यामपापाम् पापनाशिनीम् । ताम् शङ्करजटाजूटाद्भ्रष्टाम् सागरतेजसा ॥२-५०-२५॥
translation: Mightyarmed Rama reached Srngaberapura on the bank of this consort of the ocean, this Ganga loud with the cries of kraunchas and herons. This sinless, divine Ganga, destroyer of sins who flows from the feet of lord Visnu and by the effulgence (penance) of Sagara's son (Bhagiratha) emerged from the matted locks of lord Siva.

raw: सोमश्च राजसूयेन इष्ट्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित् । प्राप्तश्च सर्वलोकेषु कीर्तिस्थानं च शाश्वतम् ॥७-८३-७॥
translation: And Soma, the knower of dharma, having righteously performed the Rajasuya sacrifice, attained an eternal place of fame in all worlds.

raw: रामाभिषेकसंकल्पान्निगृह्य विनिवर्तय । अनर्थमर्थरूपेण ग्राहिता सा ततस्तया ॥२-९-३६॥
न मां प्रार्थयितुं युक्तस्त्वं सिद्धिमिव पापकृत् । अकार्यं न मया कार्यमेकपत्न्या विगर्हितम् । कुलं सम्प्राप्तया पुण्यं कुले महति जातया ॥५-१९-४॥
त्रिविक्रमे मया तात स शैल वन कानना । त्रिः सप्त कृत्वः पृथिवी परिक्रान्ता प्रदक्षिणम् ॥४-६६-३२॥
translation: 'O dear when Visnu (Vamana incarnate) took three strides I circumambulated the whole earth including its mountains and trees twentyone times.

raw: ब्रूहि प्रत्युपकार अर्थम् किम् ते कुर्वन्तु वानराः । एवम् उक्ता तु सर्वज्ञा वानरैः तैः स्वयंप्रभा ॥४-५२-१८॥
ब्राह्मणेष्वपि तृप्तेषु पश्चाद्भोक्तुम् द्विजर्षभाः । नाभ्युपैतुमलम् प्राज्ञाः शृङ्गच्चेदमिवर्ष्भाः ॥२-६१-१४॥
translation: The bulls (best) among the wise brahmins would not like to accept the food after it is tasted by other brahmins, just as bulls dislike their horns being shorn.

raw: त्वत्पराक्रमकालो ऽयं नान्यं पश्यामि कञ्चन । ऋक्षवानरवीराणामनीकानि प्रहर्षय । विशल्यौ कुरु चाप्येतौ सादितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-७४-२८॥
translation: For the Bears and Vanaras, create excessive happiness. For Rama and Lakshmana who are unconscious, make them comfortable.

raw: मयि कौतूहलं कुर्युरिति मेने महाकपिः । ततः शरीरं संक्षिप्य तन्महीधरसन्निभम् ॥५-१-२०५॥
तत्र देवो मया दृष्टः सह देव्या मया प्रभुः । सव्यं चक्षुर्मया दैवात्तत्र देव्यां निपातितम् ॥७-१३-२२॥
translation: There, I saw the Lord, the god Shiva, with the goddess Parvati, and by chance, my left eye fell upon the goddess.

raw: गिरे: सानूनि रम्याणि चित्रकूटस्य सम्प्रति । वारणैरवमृद्यन्ते मामकै: पर्वतोपमै: ॥२-९३-९॥
translation: The enchanting ridges of mount Chitrakuta are now trampled by my mountainlike elephants.

raw: यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोष्स्तेन मैथिलि । यताहारैर्वनचरैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१७॥
translation: The wanderers in the jungle, O daughter of Mithila, have to be satisfied daily with whatever little food is available. So forest (life) is a hard life.

raw: ताश्च सर्वाः समं दुःखान्मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम् । तुल्यमग्न्यर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् ॥७-२४-४॥
translation: All of them simultaneously shed tears born of sorrow, which resembled flames of fire, arising from the intense sorrow and fear they experienced.

raw: पतङ्गाः पन्नगाः सिम्हास्त्वाम् रक्षन्तु नरोत्तम । स्वस्ति साध्याः च विश्वे च मरुतः च महर्षयः ॥२-२५-८॥
आपितोविमानंतद्भरतस्सत्यविक्रमः राममासाद्यमुदितःपुनरेवाभ्यवादयत् ॥६-१३०-३८॥
translation: Bharata of unfailing valour duly permitted to ascend Pushpaka by Sri Rama, reached Rama and once again offered salutations to Rama.

raw: विशीर्णनयने भूमौ गतसत्त्वे गतायुषि । पतिते राक्षसे तस्मिन् विद्रुतं राक्षसं बलम् ॥६-७०-६१॥
translation: Strength gone, life ceased, eyes crushed, his own Rakshasas fallen on the ground, the Rakshasa army fled.

raw: तथा शयानस्य ततः अस्य धीमतः । यशस्विनो दाशरथेर् महात्मनः । अदृष्ट दुह्खस्य सुख उचितस्य सा । तदा व्यतीयाय चिरेण शर्वरी ॥२-५०-५१॥
आज्ञाप्य अथ यथा आज्ञप्ति युक्ताः ते अधिकृता नराः । रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहु स्वादु फलेषु च ॥२-८०-१५॥
translation: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.

raw: हनुमन् दूरमध्वानं कथं मां वोढुमिच्छसि । तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप ॥५-३७-२८॥
translation: "Hanuman how do you intend to carry me to such a distant place? Indeed, it is your monkey nature, I suppose.

raw: द्रक्षामि च पुनस्त्वाम् तु तीर्णवन्तम् पितुर्वचः । मङ्गशैरुपसम्पन्नो वनवासादिहागतः ॥२-२५-४४॥
translation: After you have fulfilled your father's words and returned from your exile I shall behold you seated on the throne, O Rama

raw: तत्कृत्वादुष्करंकर्मभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । सायाह्नेशरभङ्गस्यरम्यमाश्रममीयतुः ॥६-१२९-१४॥
translation: "Both the brothers Rama and Lakshmana encountered Viradha who was difficult to attack and having completed their task, reached the beautiful hermitage of Sarabhanga in the evening."

raw: मेखलीनाम् महासघः कौसल्याम् समुपस्थितः । तेषाम् सहस्रम् सौमित्रे प्रत्येकम् सम्प्रदापय ॥२-३२-२१॥
translation: Give each of the large number of brahmacharis wearing girdles and working under Kausalya a thousand (cows or gold coins), O Lakshmana

raw: दूत वाक्यम् तु तत् श्रुत्वा राजा परम हर्षितः । वसिष्ठम् वामदेवम् च मंत्रिणः च एवम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६८-१४॥
translation: Exceedingly happy to hear the words of the messengers, the king said to Vasishta, Vamadeva and other ministers.

raw: तत्र चोर्ध्वं प्रदीप्तानां गृहाणां सागरः पुनः । भाभिः संसक्तपातालश्चलोर्मिः शुशुबे ऽधिकम् ॥६-७५-५२॥
translation: There the waves of the ocean shone brightly getting united with the fire of half burnt houses.

raw: सैन्यैः परिवृताः सर्वे वानराणाम् महौजसाम् । उपायैर् अभिगच्चामो यथा नद नदी पतिम् ॥६-१८-२९॥
तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् हेम गर्भम् महागिरिम् । ततः सुदर्शनम् नाम पर्वतम् गन्तुम् अर्हथ ॥४-४३-१६॥
translation: 'Crossing this lord of hills filled with gold, you should reach the great mountain called Sudarsana.

raw: पौरा हि आत्म कृतात् दुह्खात् विप्रमोच्या नृप आत्मजैः । न तु खल्व् आत्मना योज्या दुह्खेन पुर वासिनः ॥२-४६-२३॥
translation: The prince should deliver the citizens from the sufferings caused by themselves but should not make them suffer on their account.

raw: मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतो विरूपाक्षो निशाचरः । तेन खड्गेन सङ्क्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे । कवचं पातयामास पद्भ्यामभिहतो ऽपतत् ॥६-९७-२६॥
translation: Hit by the fist, Virupaksha became very angry and tore the armor of Sugriva by his sword in the forefront of the army. Wounded severely, Sugriva fell on his feet.

raw: बाणपातान्तरे रामं पतितं पुरुषर्षभम् । स तत्र लक्ष्मणो दृष्ट्वा निराशो जीविते ऽभवत् ॥६-४५-२५॥
translation: Lakshmana remained beholding the best of men fallen at an arrow's throw disappointed at his life.

raw: अथ चीराणि कैकेयी स्वयम् आहृत्य राघवम् । उवाच परिधत्स्व इति जन ओघे निरपत्रपा ॥२-३७-६॥
translation: Thereupon in the assembly of people, without any sense of shame Kaikeyi herself brought the bark robes and said to the son of the Raghus (Rama), Wear it.

raw: दुर्दर्शाम् पारियात्रस्य गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः । कोट्यः तत्र चतुर्विम्शत् गंधर्वाणाम् तरस्विनाम् ॥४-४२-२०॥
तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तस्य कर्षत: क्षेत्रमण्डलम् । अहं किलोत्थिता भित्त्वा जगतीं नृपते: सुता ॥२-११८-२८॥
translation: When he was ploughing the circular plot of land for performing a sacrifice, it is said I emerged from the earth by breaking it and therefore I became his dauhghter.

raw: आपत् संशयिता श्रेयो न तु निस्संशयीकृता । प्रतिलोमानुलोमं वा यद्वा नो मन्यसे हितम् ॥६-५७-११॥
translation: "If uncertain death comes it is good, not when it comes by not encountering. Think what is acceptable to you and what is not acceptable to you and that is acceptable to me."

raw: सा तात कच्चित्कौसल्या सुमित्रा च प्रजावती । सुखिनी कच्चिदार्य्या च देवी नन्दति कैकयी ॥२-१००-११॥
translation: Dear child I trust, Kausalya and Sumitra, mothers of an excellent progeny are happy. I trust, the noble queen Kaikeyi is happy too.

raw: सुतीक्ष्णः प्रत्युवाच इदम् प्रीतो दशरथात्मजम् । अहम् अपि एतद् एव त्वाम् वक्तु कामः स लक्ष्मणम् ॥३-११-३५॥
तं विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि । सञ्जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेततुररिन्दमौ ॥५-४६-२७॥
translation: Seeing the body of Durdhara fallen on the ground, enraged Virupaksha and Yupaksha, the unassailable crushers of enemies leaped towards him.

raw: सुपुष्ट बल सम्गुप्ताम् यथैव विटपावतीम् । चारु तोरण निर्यूहाम् पाण्डुर द्वार तोरणाम् ॥५-३-४॥
translation: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.

raw: न मत् विधो दुष्कृत कर्म कारीमन्ये द्वितीयो अस्ति वसुंधरायाम् । शोक अनुशोको हि परंपरायामाम् एति भिन्दन् हृदयम् मनः च ॥३-६३-३॥
translation: I think there is none on earth like me who has performed such forbidden acts. One grief after the other is successively piercing my heart and my mind.

raw: स राजा पुनः एव एतान् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् । प्रत्याख्यातो भगवता गुरु पुत्रैः तथैव हि ॥१-५७-७॥
ततः प्रवृत्तं मधुरं गान्धर्वमतिमानुषम् । न च तृप्तिं ययुः सर्वे श्रोतारो गानसम्पदा ॥७-९४-१५॥
translation: Then commenced the sweet, superhuman Gandharva music, and all the listeners could not get enough of the richness of the song.

raw: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो वातोद्धूत इव द्रुमः । लाक्षारससवर्णं च सुस्राव रुधिरं मुखात् ॥६-७०-१६॥
translation: That astonishing Rakshasa shaken like a tree, thrown by the wind, shed huge amounts of blood which was of the colour of lacquer.

raw: अत्र सा मृगशाबाक्षी रावणेनोपरुध्यते । अभिभूता ग्रहेणेव लोहिताङ्गेन रोहिणी ॥६-२४-७॥
translation: The doveeyed Sita is obstructed by Ravana there (at Lanka) like the planet Rohini is caught by the red coloured planet (Mars).

raw: देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षकिन्नरसूदनम् । रक्तमाल्यं महाधामस्वतश्चोद्गतपावकम् ॥६-६५-२०॥
ततः तम् भीम धन्वानम् क्रुद्धाः सर्वे निशाचराः । रामम् नाना विधैः शस्त्रैः अभ्यवर्षन्त दुर्जयम् ॥३-२५-७॥
translation: Thereafter all the infuriated demons showered on invincible Rama, wielder of a fierce bow, many kinds of weapons.

raw: जघ्नतुस्तौ तदा ऽन्योन्यं नेदतुश्च पुनःपुनः । तलैश्चान्योन्यमाहत्य पेततुर्धरणीतले ॥६-९८-२४॥
translation: Then both of them again and again striking each other slapping with palms fell down and rolled on the ground.

raw: भगवमः च अपहस्तः अहम् सरयू तीरम् आगतः । जिघाम्सुः श्वा पदम् किम्चिन् निपाने वा आगतम् गजम् ॥२-६४-१४॥
translation: Wishing to hunt a wild elephant coming down to the water hole for drinking, I went to the bank of Sarayu, bow in hand, O revered sage

raw: ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पिता चैव यः च विद्याम् प्रयच्छति । त्रयः ते पितरो ज्ञेया धर्मे च पथि वर्तिनः ॥४-१८-१३॥
translation: The elder brother, the father, and he who imparts knowledge—these three, who conduct themselves on the path of righteousness, are to be known as fathers.

raw: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवः प्रीतो महर्षेर्मातुलस्य च । उवाच बाढमित्येव भरतं चान्ववैक्षत ॥७-१००-१४॥
translation: Hearing the proposal from the great sage and his maternal uncle, Rama, pleased, agreed and then looked at Bharata.

raw: प्रक्षिप्य प्रहसन् नित्यम् मज्जतस् तान् निरीक्ष्य वै । एवम् पाप समाचारः सज्जन प्रतिबाधकः ॥१-३८-२१॥
साहमद्यैव दिष्टान्तम् गमिष्यामि पतिव्रता । इदम् शरीरमालिङ्ग्य प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम् ॥२-६६-१२॥
translation: As his faithful wife, I shall enter the fire by clasping this (Dasaratha's) body and go to death today itself

raw: वनानि तु व्यतिक्रम्य जुष्टानि मृगपक्षिभि: । गङ्गाया: परवेलायां गिरिष्वपि नदीषु च ॥२-९२-३८॥
translation: That vast army teeming with elephants, horses and chariots proceeded southward spreading like a lofty cloud that had risen in the sky, traversing through the forests full of birds and beasts, passing through the mountains and streams on the other side of the river Ganga.

raw: देव गन्धर्व संकाशाः तत्र ते न्यवसन् सुखम् । चित्रकूटम् गते रामे पुत्र शोक आतुरः तथा ॥१-१-३२॥
न च तौ राघवात् अन्यो हन्तुम् उत्सहते पुमान् । वीर्य उत्सिक्तौ हि तौ पापौ काल पाश वशम् गतौ ॥१-१९-१२॥
बुद्धिरूपं फलं पुत्राञ्छौर्यं धीरत्वमेव च । प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा लोके निर्जितं पुण्यकर्मभिः ॥७-१५-२६॥
translation: Men in this world obtain intellect, beauty, prosperity, sons, valor, and steadfastness, all of which are acquired through meritorious deeds.

raw: सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादिताञ्च । द्विजातिदेवातिथिपूजनं च पन्थानमाहुस्त्रिदिवस्य सन्त: ॥२-१०९-३१॥
translation: The virtuous maintain that truthfulness, righteousness, valour, compassion towards all beings, speaking pleasing words, paying homage to gods, brahmins and guests -- all these are paths to heaven.

raw: सो अभिदुद्राव वेगेन रामम् दृष्ट्वा विशाम् पतिः । तम् असम्प्राप्य दुह्ख आर्तः पपात भुवि मूर्चितः ॥२-३४-१७॥
translation: At the sight of Rama, the lord of men (king Dasaratha), tortured with grief, immediately ran towards him but before he could reach him, fell unconscious on the floor.

raw: विधवा पृथिवी राजम्स् त्वया हीना न राजते । हीन चन्द्रा इव रजनी नगरी प्रतिभाति माम् ॥२-७६-९॥
translation: O king bereft of you, the earth (kingdom) is widowed and has lost its radiance. The city appears to me like a moonless night.

raw: गतेषु पृथिवीशेषु राजा दशरथः पुनः । प्रविवेश पुरीम् श्रीमान् पुरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान् ॥१-१८-५॥
translation: After the departure of the rulers, the exalted king Dasaratha preceded by the foremost of brahmins entered the city (of Ayodhya).

raw: नय रथमधिरोप्य वासवं नगरमितो व्रज सेनया वृतस्त्वम् । अहमपि तव गच्छतो द्रुतं सह सचिवैरनुयामि पृष्ठतः ॥७-२९-४१॥
translation: Take Vasava (Indra), place him on the chariot, and you, surrounded by the army, go from here to the city; I also, with my ministers, will quickly follow behind you as you go.

raw: उवाचैनं समारब्धः सौमित्रिं सविभीषणम् । तांश्च वानरशार्दूलान् पश्यध्वं मे पराक्रमम् ॥६-८८-५॥
translation: Lakshmana was like the Sun on the eastern mountain mounted on the back of Hanuman, the tiger among Vanaras. He saw Vibheeshana and spoke.

raw: सो ऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः । उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञं धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन् ॥७-१०८-१३॥
translation: Then, having saluted Rama, the knower of Dharma, he spoke with folded hands and controlled senses, contemplating only righteousness.

raw: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम् । कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ॥५-६७-८॥
translation: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?

raw: तथेत्युक्त्वा द्रुततरं मायावी राक्षसेश्वरः । निर्जगाम बलै सार्धं बहुभिः परिवारितः ॥६-५३-४॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

raw: प्रचचाल मही च अपि स शैल वन कानना । खरस्य च रथस्थस्य नर्दमानस्य धीमतः ॥३-२३-१६॥
मया रोषपरीतेन यदिदं व्याहृतं वचः । नैतच्छक्यं वृथा कर्तुं प्रदास्यामि च ते वरम् ॥७-६५-३५॥
translation: The words I have spoken while overcome by anger cannot be made in vain, but I will grant you a boon.

raw: नक्क्षत्रे अदिति दैवत्ये स्व उच्छ संस्थेषु पंचसु । ग्रहेषु कर्कटे लग्ने वाक्पता इंदुना सह ॥१-१८-९॥
translation: Six seasons (one year) passed after the completion of the sacrifice. In the twelfth month of Chaitra on the ninth day (of the bright fortnight), with Aditi as presiding deity when the star Punarvasu was in the ascendent and the five planets Sun, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter and Venus, were exalted in their own house in karkata lagna, when Brihaspati was in conjunction with the Moon, Kausalya gave birth to a son: a facet of Visnu, Lord of the entire universe who received obeisance from all the worlds and was adorned with all auspicious signs, the venerable one to perpetuate the Ikshvaku race.

raw: संवृताम् मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः । ताम् देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा ॥५-१७-२७॥
translation: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.

raw: अथवा पुत्रशोकेन अहत्वा रामलक्ष्मणौ । विधमिष्यति मां रौद्रो राक्षसः पापनिश्चयः ॥६-९३-५३॥
translation: Wow! Has the destruction of the two brothers brought about on account of the grief of the death of his son or on my account? Not able to kill Rama and Lakshmana, has this fierce Rakshasa who does not hesitate, resolved to kill me?

raw: तपसा सत्यवाक्येन अनन्यत्वाच्च भर्तरि । अपि सा निर्दहेदग्निं न तामग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति ॥५-५५-२९॥
translation: 'By virtue of her power of asceticism, power of truthfulness and exclusive devotion towards her husband, she may consume the fire. Fire will not burn her'.

raw: तान् गृहीत आयुधान् सर्वान् वारयित्वा विभीषणः । अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् पुनः प्रत्युपवेश्य तान् ॥६-९-७॥
translation: With folded hands, Vibheeshana made all the (Rakshasas) wielding arms to stop and sit and addressed these words to Ravana.

raw: अनेन हि महाराज महेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । इष्ट्वा यज्ञम् वरो लब्धो लोके परमदुर्लभः ॥६-७-१९॥
translation: "Oh Great King By performing supreme sacrifices, Indrajith obtained boons from Lord Maheswara, which are very difficult to get."

raw: यः कृतः समयो अस्माकम् सुग्रीवेण महात्मना । स तु कालो व्यतिक्रान्तो बिले च परिवर्तताम् ॥४-५२-२२॥
नराः च नार्यः च समेत्य सम्घशो । विगर्हमाणा भरतस्य मातरम् । तदा नगर्याम् नर देव सम्क्षये । बभूवुर् आर्ता न च शर्म लेभिरे ॥२-६६-२९॥
translation: After the demise of the king, men and women in the city assembled in groups and denounced the mother of Bharata. Extremely distressed, they had no peace of mind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तमङ्गदगतो रामं लक्ष्मणश्शुभया गिरा । उवाच परिपूर्णार्थ: स्मृतिमान् प्रतिभानवान् ॥६-४-४४॥
translation: Lakshmana, who was borne by Angada, has a good memory and sense of intuition. Set to accomplish his desire fully, he spoke to Rama these auspicious words.

raw: पितुर्वाक्यानुरोधेन गतस्य विजनम् वनम् । तावद्दर्शनमस्या नः सफलम् भवतु प्रभो ॥२-३७-१७॥
translation: In obedience to the words of your father, O lord you are going to the forest. Till you return, please allow us to have her (Sita's) audience.

raw: अनसूया तु धर्मज्ञा श्रुत्वा तां महतीं कथाम् । पर्य्यष्वजत बाहुभ्यां शिरस्याघ्राय मैथिलीम् ॥२-११९-१॥
translation: Then righteous Anasuya, having heard the great story of Sita, kissed her on the forehead and embraced her with both the arms.

raw: तेन चेमं महाप्राज्ञमभिषिञ्च विभीषणम् । राजानं रक्षसां क्षिप्रं प्रसन्ने मयि मानद ॥६-१९-२६॥
translation: "I am pleased with this highly intelligent Vibheeshana, a respectable one. I will coronate him at once as king of Rakshasas."

raw: ततो धान्यधनोपेतान् दानशीलजनान् शिवान् । अकुतश्चिद्भयान् रम्याम् श्चैत्ययूपसमावृतान् ॥२-५०-८॥
translation: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was rich with herds of cattle, wealth and foodgrains. It was inhabited by charitable, contented and wellnourished people free from fear from any quarter. And it reverberated with the sounds of Vedic recitations.

raw: स हि तस्य मयो राम शापाभिज्ञस्तपोधनात् । विदित्वा तेन सा दत्ता तस्य पैतामहं कुलम् ॥७-१२-२०॥
translation: O Rama, Maya, indeed knowing of the curse from the ascetic regarding Ravana's paternal grandfather's lineage, gave his daughter to him.

raw: अपयाहि जन स्थानात् त्वरितः सह बान्धवः । जहि त्वम् समरे मूढान् यथा तु कुलपांसन ॥३-२१-१८॥
अनरण्यान्महाबाहु: पृथू राजा बभूव ह । तस्मात् पृथोर्महाराजस्त्रिशङ्कुरुदपद्यत । स सत्यवचनाद्वीर: सशरीरो दिवङ्गत: ॥२-११०-११॥
translation: Mightyarmed king Prithu was the son of Anaranya and Prithu was father of the great king Trishanku. That heroic Trishanku, on account of his truthfulness ascended the heaven with his physical body.

raw: तारा अंगदादि सहितः प्लवगः पवनात्मजः । अगस्त्य चरिताम् आशाम् दक्षिणाम् हरि यूथपः ॥४-४५-६॥
translation: Vinata, leader of the monkeys, set out for the eastern direction.The troop leader, son of the Windgod along with Angada and Tara left for the south inhabited by Agastya.

raw: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा । न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः ॥५-३९-५१॥
translation: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.

raw: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य सगर्वितं रोषविवृद्धदोषम् । महोदरो नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यः कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ॥६-६०-८२॥
translation: Hearing the words of the reply of Kumbhakarna, filled with arrogance and pride, Mahodara, chief of the army, submitted with folded hands and said.

raw: केसरी च चतुर्दंष्ट्रो हि श्रेष्ठो महाबलः । सिंहानस्नं व्याघ्रतनुः समिद्धश्छ हुताशनः ॥२-१४-३९॥
translation: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

raw: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः । एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः ॥६-५८-१९॥
translation: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnata, all these associates of Prahastha made short work of the monkeys.

raw: ते रत्न हीनाः तरुणाः फल काले विवासिताः । कथम् वत्स्यन्ति कृपणाः फल मूलैः कृत अशनाः ॥२-४३-८॥
translation: Deprived of all costly things they have been banished at the tender age of youth, a time for enjoying their lives. How will they lead a miserable life subsisting on fruits and roots?

raw: एते कथा बहुविधाः परिहाससमन्विताः । कथयन्ति स्म संहृष्टा राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥७-४३-३॥
translation: These delighted individuals used to tell the great-souled Rama many kinds of stories filled with humor.

raw: तस्य आलय वरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलम् आयतम् । ददर्श भवन श्रेष्ठम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-९-१॥
translation: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, saw a huge, spacious and excellent of all mansions in the centre of the palace.

raw: प्रीतिस्पीताक्षौ सम्प्रहृष्टौ कुमारौ दृष्ट्वा सिद्धार्थौ वानराणां च राजा । अङ्गैः संहृष्टैः कर्मसिद्धिं विदित्वा बाह्वोरासन्नां सो ऽतिमात्रं ननन्द ॥५-६३-२९॥
translation: "Beholding young Rama and Lakshmana extremely delighted, their eyes filled with joy out of fulfilment of the purpose, Sugriva who was also highly delighted felt an auspicious thrill on his limbs and knew that good time had come. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अर्थ अनर्थ निमित्तम् हि यद् उक्तम् सचिवैस् तव । तत्र दोषम् प्रपश्यामि क्रिया न हि उपपद्यते ॥६-१७-५३॥
translation: "Your counsellors have said that after judging good or bad qualities we should accept or reject Vibheeshana. I see a flaw in that statement as such action would not arise."

raw: यदि मत्सन्निधौ सीता धर्षिता स्यात्त्वया बलात् । भ्रातरं तु खरं पश्येस्तदा मत्सायकैर्हतः ॥६-१०५-१८॥
translation: "If Sita had been seen by me forcibly taken by you in my presence, then you would have been killed by my arrows and seen your brother Khara."

raw: रामं तत्रानयांचक्रे रथेन रथिनां वरम् । अथ तत्र समासीनास्तदा दशरथं नृपम् ॥२-३-२४॥
ममन्थ च महाकायो राक्षसान् वानरेश्वरः । युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव ॥६-९७-१०॥
translation: The Vanara Lord of gigantic body, moving like the wind, tortuously destroyed the Rakshasas like a huge wind destroying the universe.

raw: किन्किणी जाल सम्काशाः ता हेम विपुल अम्बुजाः । भाव ग्राहा यशः तीराः सुप्ता नद्य इव आबभुः ॥५-९-५२॥
translation: With their tiny bells round their girdle looking like buds, the bold golden ornaments like lotuses, their gestures of love like crocodiles and their radiant beauty like silver banks, the women looked like smoky rivers.

raw: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्त लोचना । अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् रहिते राक्षस अधिपम् ॥३-४८-२०॥
translation: Thus addressed, Sita was enraged and her eyes turned red. She replied in harsh words to the chief of the demons in that solitary place:.

raw: रोदनादतिनिःश्वासाद्भूतमिसंस्पर्शनादपि । न त्वां देवीमहं मन्ये राज्ञः संज्ञावधारणात् ॥५-३३-११॥
translation: "From your weeping, your sighing and your touching the earth (gods do not touch the earth) and your signs of sovereignty, I do not think you are a goddess (meaning otherwise she posessed divine grace).

raw: कपि पत्न्या वचः श्रुत्वा कपयः काम रूपिणः । प्राप्त कालम् अविश्लिष्टम् ऊचुर् वचनम् अंगनाम् ॥४-१९-१०॥
translation: On hearing Tara, the wife of Vali, the monkeys who could assume any form at their will replied with clear words appropriate to the occasion:

raw: मथितामृतफेनाभमरजोवस्त्रमुत्तमम् । सलीलमनुकर्षन्तं विमुक्तं सक्तमङ्गदे ॥५-१८-२४॥
translation: He was playfully pulling up his upper garment that slipped and stuck to his armlet. This excellent unsoiled robe was looking like the foam of churned nectar.

raw: तमेव दिवसं सो ऽथ हैहयाधिपतिर्बली । अर्जुनो नर्मदां रन्तुं गतः स्त्रीभिः सहेश्वरः ॥७-३१-९॥
translation: On that very day, the powerful lord of the Haihayas, Arjuna, had gone to the Narmada river with his wives to sport.

raw: प्रियमाख्यामि ते देवि त्वां तु भूयः सभाजये । दिष्ट्या जीवसि धर्मज्ञे जयेन मम संयुगे ॥६-११६-१०॥
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः । रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत् ॥७-१०९-१॥
translation: When the night had dawned, the broad-chested, highly renowned, lotus-eyed Rama then spoke to his chief priest.

raw: अमृतम् प्रार्थयानस्य तत् ते भवतु मन्गलम् । अमृतोत्पादने दैत्यान् घ्नतो वज्रधरस्य यत् ॥२-२५-३४॥
खड्ग धारा हता मे अद्य दीप्यमानाइव अद्रयः । पतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघाइव सविद्युतः ॥२-२३-३४॥
translation: The elephants, struck by the blows of my sword, will fall on earth like mountains engulfed in flames and like clouds with lightning.

raw: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत् । स्नुषा ऽस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः । देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता ॥७-२६-४०॥
translation: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.

raw: त्वया पुनर्ब्राह्मणगौरवादियं कृता प्रतिज्ञा ह्यनवेक्ष्य कारणम् । ततश्च कर्ता ह्यसि नात्र संशयो महाभयात्ऺत्रातुमृषींस्त्वमर्हसि ॥७-६०-१८॥
translation: But you, out of respect for Brahmins, made this vow without considering the difficulty, and therefore you are indeed the one who will accomplish it, without a doubt, and you ought to protect the sages from great fear. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 60 ।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अन्वगच्छत् धनुष् पाणिः प्रव्रजंतम् मया सह । जटी तापस रूपेण मया सह सह अनुजः ॥३-४७-२०॥
व्यूढेनैव सुघोरेण पूर्वद्वारात् स निर्ययौ । गजयूथनिकाशेन बलेन महता वृतः ॥६-५७-३२॥
translation: He, emerged from the eastern gate, surrounded by a huge, formidable army formed into a battlearray, which resembled a herd of elephants.

raw: प्रथमम् मरणम् नार्या भर्तुर् वैगुण्यम् उच्यते । सुवृत्तः साधु वृत्तायाः सम्वृत्तस् त्वम् मम अग्रतः ॥६-३२-९॥
translation: "O Rama, you are faithful to your vows, a noble one! It is said that because of a woman's faults, the husband will die. It is not even so as you died in front of a virtuous woman of good conduct."

raw: ते भित्त्वा बाणरूपाणि पञ्चशीर्षा इवोरगाः । श्वसन्तो विविशुर्भूमिं रावणप्रतिकूलिताः ॥६-१००-३९॥
translation: The five headed serpent like arrows released by Rama penetrated and having been repelled by Ravana they entered the earth hissing.

raw: उवाच कामतो वाक्यम् मृदु सत्य पराक्रमौ । राजर्षि देव प्रतिमौ तापसौ संशित व्रतौ ॥४-३-५॥
भूयः स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-५३-३९॥
translation: Once more a thought came to the great Hanuman,the elephant among monkeys. He sprang up and shouted loud.

raw: दशाननो भ्रातरमाप्तवादिनम् । विसर्जयामास तदा विभीषणम् ॥६-१०-३३॥
translation: Then mighty tenheaded Ravana of formidable valour, a destroyer of Devatas' army in war, sent away Vibheeshana who had spoken words of good advice in that manner. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेवामलीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेदशमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the tenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: शत्रवः तव सुव्यक्तम् हीन वीर्या निशा चर । इच्छन्ति त्वाम् विनश्यन्तम् उपरुद्धम् बलीयसा ॥३-४१-४॥
translation: This is clear that your enemy demons are now powerless. Hence they want you to be engaged with a stronger power and be destroyed.

raw: द्विजः सुहृद्भृत्यजनोऽथवा तदा । दरिद्रभिक्षाचरणश्च योऽभवत् । न तत्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तर्पितो । यथार्ह सम्मानन दान सम्ब्रमैः ॥२-३२-४४॥
translation: Thus there was none among those brahmins, attendants, poor people, and beggars, who was not satisfied with the honour (received) or with the charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं चास्यं ह्रस्वं ह्यकरवं वपुः । तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते च पुनर्बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः ॥५-५८-३०॥
translation: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.

raw: त्वया ऽपहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा । भक्षगृध्रेन काकेन दारिता त्वामुपागता .३८.१७ ॥५-३८-१८॥
translation: 'Then you made fun of me, and I became angry. I was abashed. Torn by the voracious bird I sought your shelter.

raw: कुमुदो द्विविदो मैन्दो नीलः शरभ एव च । पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च युगपत् समभिद्रवन् ॥६-७१-३९॥
translation: Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Neela, even Sarabha, all at once assailed him with trees and mountain peaks.

raw: नैव वाचा न मनसा नानुध्यानान्न चक्षुषा । सुवृत्ता वृत्तशौण्डीर न त्वामतिचचार ह ॥६-१२१-७॥
translation: "Sita is of good conduct and auspicious. To you who are endowed with valour, she is faithful by speech, by intention of thought and intellect and even by glance."

raw: सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽहमेष्यामि सह सीतया । आनयिष्यामि वा लङ्कां समुत्पाट्य सरावणाम् ॥५-१-४२॥
translation: "I will, by all means return successful with Sita or else I will uproot Lanka along with Ravana and bring him here".

raw: ततस्तमक्षोभ्य बलम् लंका अधिपतये चराः । सुवेले राघवम् शैले निविष्टम् प्रत्यवेदयन् ॥६-३०-१॥
translation: Thereafter, the spies reported to the king of Lanka that Raghava had camped with an unshakable army at the Suvela mountain.

raw: अग्राण्यारुह्य शैलानां शिखराणि महान्त्यपि । ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य तरसा प्रतिगृह्णाति वीर्यवान् ॥४-११-५॥
translation: 'Climbing up speedily, valiant Vali would catch the huge mountain peaks.

raw: तस्य एवम् ब्रुवतः चिन्ता बभूव हृदि वीक्षतः । शोकार्तेन अस्य शकुनेः किम् इदम् व्याहृतम् मया ॥१-२-१६॥
translation: Brooding over his utterances, he reflected, 'What is this that I uttered in reaction to the grief of this bird?'

raw: पित्र्यः सौमनसः चैव विधूत मकरौ उभौ । परवीरम् रतिम् चैव धन धान्यौ च राघव ॥१-२८-८॥
translation: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

raw: विचित्र कुसुम आपीडा बहु मन्जलि धारिणः । अकाले च अपि मुख्यानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च ॥२-४८-१२॥
मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः । भ्रातऽणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च ॥५-३७-५७॥
translation: "O strongarmed Hanuman your life and the life of the great self Rama, of his brother, and relatives of your king is dependent upon my survival.

raw: वसिष्ठः परमप्रीतः परमर्षिर्विवेश च । स त्वपश्यद्विनिष्क्रान्तं सुमन्त्रं नाम सारथिम् । द्वारे मनुजसिंहस्य सचिवं प्रियदर्शन्म् ॥२-१४-३२॥
translation: Sage Vasistha saw handsome Sumantra, minister to Dasaratha, a lion among the charioteers coming out of the gate.

raw: केन इदम् उपदिष्टम् ते क्षुद्रेण अहित बुद्धिना । यः त्वाम् इच्छति नश्यन्तम् स्व कृतेन निशाचर ॥३-४१-५॥
translation: O Ravana by which mean fellow is this advice given against your welfare? Who wants you to be destroyed by your own action.

raw: बाला अपि क्रीडमाना गृ हद्वारेषु संघशः । रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताश्चक्रुरेवं मिथः कथाः ॥२-६-१६॥
translation: Similarly children playing in groups in front of the houses also related to each other stories regarding the coronation of Rama.

raw: एकाकिनं प्रमत्तं वा नयेयुर्दशनैः क्षयम् । तस्मात् परमदुर्धर्षैः सैन्यैः परिवृतो व्रज । रक्षसामहितं सर्वं शत्रुपक्षं निषूदय ॥६-६५-२४॥
translation: "Therefore, go surrounded by the army. They are extremely difficult to encounter. They are like thunderbolts. Destroy them who are on the enemy side and not favourable to Rakshasas."

raw: वसन्तः काल कालेषु वने मूल फल अशनाः । न लभन्ते सुखम् भीरु राक्षसैः क्रूर कर्मभिः ॥३-१०-५॥
translation: The sages living in the forest, eating roots and fruits and ever engaged in righteous activities are afraid of the depredations of the demons, with their happiness gone.

raw: घोरो राक्षसराजो ऽयं दृष्टिश्च न सुखा मयि । त्वां च श्रुत्वा विषज्जनं न जीवेयमहं क्षणम् ॥५-४०-११॥
translation: "The demon king is frightful. He looks at me with immoral (lusty) eyes. I do not wish to live even for a moment after hearing about the adversities (you have faced)."

raw: सनातने वर्त्मानि सम्निविष्टाम् । रामेक्षणां तां मदनाभिविष्टाम् । भर्तुर्मनः श्रीमदनुप्रविष्टाम् । स्त्रीभ्यो वराभ्यश्च सदा विशिष्टाम् ॥५-५-२४॥
translation: 'Sita must have had a pair of beautiful eyes. She must have been a passionate lady with mind fixed on her glorious husband. Ever established in dharma, she is perhaps a distinguished lady compared to her counterparts (in Lanka).

raw: यच्च तिर्यग्गतं किञ्चित्त्वामेवमनुचिन्तयत् । प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यति भक्त्या वै तत्सन्ताने निवत्स्यति ॥७-११०-१९॥
translation: And whatever animal, meditating upon you in this manner, abandons its life with devotion, will indeed reside in that Santanika world.

raw: तिमि नक्र आकुल जलम् गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः । ततः केतक खंडेषु तमाल गहनेषु च ॥४-४२-११॥
ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः । प्रणिपत्य ह्युमां देवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना ॥७-८७-२१॥
translation: Then, overwhelmed by great sorrow, the king bowed down to the goddess Uma, the daughter of the king of mountains, with his entire heart and soul.

raw: एतान् वित्रासितान् पश्य बर्हिण: प्रियदर्शनान् । एतमाविशत: शीघ्रमधिवासं पतत्ऺित्रण: ॥२-९३-१७॥
translation: Behold, these lovely frightened peacocks and other birds hurriedly entering their nests.

raw: स्फोटयति अभिसम्रब्धो लान्गूलम् च पुनः पुनः । यस्य लान्गूल शब्देन स्वनन्ति इव दिशो दश ॥६-२६-१६॥
translation: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."

raw: पूर्ण चन्द्र आननम् वीरम् राज वत्सम् जितेन्द्रियम् । पृथु कीर्तिम् महाबाहुम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३६॥
translation: I am the devoted wife of great Rama, whose face is like a fullmoon, who is the son of a king, who has conquered his senses and whose fame is widespread (on earth).

raw: न त्वस्य ब्रुवतो जातु लक्ष्यते दुष्ट भावता । प्रसन्नम् वदनम् च अपि तस्मान् मे न अस्ति सम्शयः ॥६-१७-६२॥
translation: "Even when one is speaking, his malevolence is known. It does not seem so as his countenance is also pleasing. Therefore, I have no doubt (of him)."

raw: तदपत्यं भवानस्तु मा भवान् दुष्कृतं पितु: । अभिपत्ता कृतं कर्म लोके धीरविगर्हितम् ॥२-१०६-१६॥
translation: So be a worthy son and let not the sinful act committed by our father and condemned by men of wisdom be approved by you.

raw: ततस्तस्य नगस्याग्रे ह्याकाशस्थस्य दन्तिनः । भर्त्रा परिगृहीतस्य जानकी स्कन्धमाश्रिता ॥५-२७-१४॥
translation: "Then from the front of the mountain Janaki shifted to the back of the elephant held by her husband waiting in the sky.

raw: न अस्ति अभाग्यतरो लोके मत्तो अस्मिन् स चराचरे । येन इयम् महती प्राप्ता मया व्यसन वागुरा ॥३-६७-२६॥
translation: In this world of the animate and the inanimate there is no one more unfortunate than me fallen into the trap of adversities.

raw: घृत पूर्णेषु कुंभेषु धात्र्यः तान् समवर्धयन् । कालेन महता सर्वे यौवनम् प्रतिपेदिरे ॥१-३८-१८॥
translation: Nurses placed all of them in pots filled with clarified butter and fostered them. They attained adolescence after a long time.

raw: स मधुर्वीर्यसम्पन्नो धर्मे च सुसमाहितः । बहुवर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रप्रीत्या ऽकरोत्तपः ॥७-६१-५॥
translation: That Madhu, endowed with great valor and steadfast in righteousness, performed penance for many thousands of years to please Rudra.

raw: बलमप्रतिमं राम वालिनो ऽभवदुत्तमम् । सो ऽपि त्वया विनिर्दग्धः शलभो वह्निना यथा ॥७-३४-४६॥
translation: O Rama, Vali possessed supreme and unequalled strength, yet even he was completely destroyed by you, just as a moth is consumed by fire. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 34 ।। Thus ends the thirty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तां सीतां शोकभारार्तां वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं ह्लादयन्निव तेजसा ॥७-४९-१०॥
translation: The foremost sage Valmiki spoke sweet words to that Sita, who was afflicted by the burden of sorrow, as if comforting her with his spiritual radiance.

raw: नील जीमूत संकाशः तप्त कांचन कुण्डलः । भयम् लोकस्य जनयन् किरीटी परिघ आयुधः ॥३-३८-२॥
translation: Once I was roaming the earth, like a mountain possessing the strength of a thousand elephants, like a dark cloud, wearing bright gold earrings and crown,holding a spear in hand, terrorising the people. I was wandering in Dandaka forest feeding on the flesh of ascetics.

raw: वालुकावेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः । अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः ॥७-३१-४२॥
translation: Ravana placed that Lingam in the middle of a sand altar and worshipped it with fragrant substances and flowers that smelled like nectar.

raw: प्रेषयिष्यति दुर्धषो रामो न ह्यपरीक्षितम् । पराक्रममविज्ञाय मत्सकाशं विशेषतः ॥५-३६-११॥
translation: "The formidable Rama will not send any one specially to me without testing him or knowing his valour.

raw: ततो अस्तुवन् मुनि गणा वसिष्ठम् जपताम् वरम् । अमोघम् ते बलम् ब्रह्मन् तेजो धारय तेजसा ॥१-५६-२०॥
translation: Then hosts of saints praised Vasishta, the best among sages, saying "O Brahmin, your energy is infallible, hold your energy by your enegy".

raw: तस्मात्त्वं वस काकुत्स्थ सप्तरात्रमिहावस । ऊर्ध्वं गन्तासि मधुरां सभृत्यबलवाहनः ॥७-७२-१७॥
translation: Therefore, O Kakutstha, stay here for seven nights, and thereafter you shall proceed to Mathura with your servants, army, and vehicles.

raw: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना ॥७-९१-३॥
translation: O Lakshmana, having assembled all these and consulted with them, I shall release a horse endowed with auspicious marks, with proper ritual observance.

raw: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्यवान् बलवानपि । किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ॥५-३८-४३॥
translation: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'

raw: ततो दधिमुखः क्रुद्धो वनपस्तत्र वानरः । हतं मधुवनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वयामास तान् हरीन् ॥५-६२-१८॥
translation: Then Dadhimukha, the guardian of the garden became furious on the vanaras. Having heard from the guards that the garden was destroyed, he said soothing words to them.

raw: ते दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं वानराः पर्वतोपमम् । वायुनुन्ना इव घना ययुः सर्वा दिशस्तदा ॥६-६५-५५॥
translation: On seeing the mountain like form of the foremost of the Rakshasas. the vanaras dispersed in all directions like clouds swept by the wind.

raw: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हर्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः । यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीन् शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति ॥५-३९-१४॥
translation: "Kakutstha Rama, accompanied by vanaras and bears will reach here soon and conquer the enemies in war and relieve your grief.

raw: अविक्लवमसम्भ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् । रश्मिसञ्चारनियतं प्रचोदय रथं द्रुतम् ॥६-१०८-११॥
translation: "Drive the chariot swiftly without confusion, without any agitation, with steady heart and vision, controlling the movement of reins and determination.

raw: तं सवृक्षं महाबाहुमापतन्तं महाबलम् । आर्यकं प्राहरत्तत्र बाहुभ्यां कुपितो ऽङ्गदः ॥५-६२-२६॥
translation: Seeing the revered, powerful and strongarmed Dadhimukha rushing to him, the angry Angada caught him with both hands tightly.

raw: प्रविष्टं तु तदा रामं मेघाः सूर्यमिवाम्बरे । नाभिजग्मुर्महाघोरं निर्दहन्तं शराग्निना ॥६-९४-१९॥
translation: Then Rama entered the army with fire like arrows which were consuming the Rakshasas like the clouds in the sky which can't approach the scorching Sun.

raw: अत्र देवाः च यक्षाः च नागाः च पतगैः सह । वसन्ति नियत आहारा धर्मम् आराधयिष्णवः ॥३-११-९१॥
translation: Here gods, yakshas, nagas and birds live, following the righteous path and observing discipline in food habits.

raw: ममापि परमा प्रीतर्हते तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि । रावणे सगणे चैव सपुत्रे सहबान्धवे ॥७-४१-६॥
translation: He further said, "My supreme joy also arises from the killing of that evil-minded Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, and relatives."

raw: अपि शांतेन मनसा गुरुः मे कुशिकात्मज । इह आगतेन रामेण पूजितेन अभिवादितः ॥१-५१-९॥
translation: O Kushika's son did pious Rama welcome my father with a tranquil mind when he arrived?"

raw: त्रिस्थिरस्त्रिप्रलम्बश्च त्रिसमस्त्रिषु चोन्नतः । त्रिताम्रस्त्रिषु च स्निग्धो गम्भीरस्त्रिषु नित्यशः ॥५-३५-१७॥
translation: "He has three stiff parts, three long parts, three even parts, three shining parts, elevated in three parts, has three raised parts, his body has lines in three parts and is of coppery reddish colour in three parts. He has a majestic look.

raw: रामाद् विशिष्टः को ऽन्यो ऽस्ति कश्चित् सौमित्रिणा समः । अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ ॥५-३९-५३॥
translation: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.

raw: अहम् पुनर्देवकुमाररूप । मलकृतम् तम् सुतमाव्रजन्तम् । नन्दामि पश्यन्नपि दर्शनेन । भवामि दृष्ट्वा च पुनर्युवेव ॥२-१२-१०५॥
translation: When I see my son, handsome and welladorned like the son of a celestial deity, coming towards me, I rejoice. Even his very sight makes me grow young again.

raw: पुरुषस्येह जातस्य भवन्ति गुरवस्त्रय: । आचार्य्यश्चैव काकुत्स्थ पिता माता च राघव ॥२-१११-२॥
translation: Every man born has three preceptors. They are his teacher, father and mother.

raw: न मिथ्या ऽहं वदे राम देवलोकजिगीषया । शूद्रं मां विद्धि काकुत्स्थ तप उग्रं समास्थितम् ॥७-७६-३॥
translation: Shambuka affirmed to Rama that he was not speaking falsely out of a desire to conquer the world of gods, and asked Rama to know him as a Shudra engaged in severe penance.

raw: स निकामम् विमानेषु विषण्णः काम रूपधृत् । विचचार पुनर्लङ्काम् लाघवेन समन्वितः ॥५-६-१॥
translation: The mighty Hanuman, who could assume any form at will, not finding Sita in the tall mansions, again started rapidly ranging in Lanka.

raw: घोररूपसमाचाराः क्रूराः क्रूरतरेक्षणाः । राक्षस्यो दारुणकथा वरमेतत् प्रयच्छ मे मुष्टिभिः पाणिभिः सर्वाश्चरणैश्चैव शोभने । इच्छामि विविधैर्घातैर्हन्तुमेताः सुदारुणाः ॥६-११६-३३॥
सभार्ये निर्गते रामे कौसल्याम् कोसलेश्वरः । विवक्षुरसितापाङ्गाम् स्मृवा दुष्कृतमात्मनः ॥२-६३-३॥
translation: After Rama had left along with his wife the king of Kosala (Dasaratha) recollected his former evil deed and wanted to narrate it to the darkeyed Kausalya.

raw: राजन् दास्यामि शबलाम् राशिभी रजतस्य वा । न परित्यागम् अर्हा इयम् मत् सकाशात् अरिन्दम ॥१-५३-१२॥
वानाराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत् कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥६-४१-४१॥
translation: Renowned generals of the Vanara army and thirtysix crores of Vanaras stood there camping.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना । सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे ॥५-६७-१॥
translation: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.

raw: स सम्प्राप्य चिरात् सञ्ज्ञामृषभो वानरर्षभः । अबिदुद्राव वेगेन गदां तस्य महात्मनः ॥६-७०-५८॥
एतत् सुरुचिरम् भाति पितुर् मे शयनम् पुरा । शशिनेवामलम् रात्रौ गगनम् तोयदात्यये ॥२-७२-१९॥
translation: This couch of my father once used to shine like the spotless night sky irradiated by the autumnal Moon.

raw: आरग्वधैस्तमालैश्च प्रियालवकुलैरपि । एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे । किन्नरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः ॥७-२६-६॥
translation: In that forest region, illuminated by these and other trees like Aragvadha, Tamala, Priyala, and Bakula, Kinnaras, tormented by love, sang passionately with their sweet voices.

raw: बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम् । गतो रमयतो ऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः ॥७-८९-८॥
translation: For Budha, the lustful one, the month of Madhava passed like a moment while he was exceedingly enjoying with Tamila of the beautiful face.

raw: स दैवतबलं सर्वं नानाप्रहणैः शितैः । व्यध्वंसयत सङ्क्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरं यथा ॥७-२७-४०॥
translation: Greatly enraged, he destroyed the entire army of gods with his sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters a cloud.

raw: अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये सागरस्य ममैव च । प्रीतिं प्रीतमनाः कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि महाकपे ॥५-१-१२९॥
translation: "O great monkey when I hold you so high, you ought to oblige me and the (god of the) ocean wholeheartedly (and accept our hospitalty).

raw: सिम्हनादाश्च शूराणाम् तदा शुश्रुविरे पथि । हर्म्यवातायनस्थाभिर्भूषिताभिः समन्ततः ॥२-१६-३७॥
कच्चित्ते दयिता: सर्वे कृषिगोरक्षजीविन: । वार्त्तायां संश्रितस्तात लोको हि सुखमेधते ॥२-१००-४८॥
translation: I trust all those men who live on agriculture and cattlerearing are favourable to you. The world's prosperity, dear brother, grows on the profession of cattle rearing.

raw: तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् । महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ॥६-५९-३८॥
translation: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.

raw: चारु स्मिते चारु दति चारु नेत्रे विलासिनि । मनो हरसि मे रामे नदी कूलम् इव अंभसा ॥३-४६-२१॥
translation: O lady with an elegant smile, beautiful teeth, lovely eyes you are enticing.Your slender waist can be compassed by my fist.Your hair is beautiful and your large breasts are rubbing against each other.You are capturing my mind just as the flow of water in a river touches its banks.

raw: स्थितया पार्श्वतः च अपि वाल व्यजन हस्तया । उपेतम् सीतया भूयः चित्रया शशिनम् यथा ॥२-१६-१०॥
translation: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.
