raw: गच्छायोध्यामितो वीर विसर्जय च वानरान् ॥६-१२३-१९॥
translation: "King, return from here to Ayodhya leaving the monkeys. Reassure Mythili, who is very dear to you and an illustrious one."

raw: चरित ब्रह्मचर्यस्य विद्या स्नातस्य धीमतः । धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य को राज्यम् मद्विधो हरेत् ॥२-८२-११॥
translation: Would any man seize this kingdom which rightfully belongs to sagacious Rama, who practises brahmacharya, who is wellversed in all branches of learning and who endeavours to protect righteousness?

raw: विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात् सफेनं रुधिराप्लुतम् । ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम् ॥६-९७-३३॥
translation: The Vanaras witnessed Virupaksha who had misshapen eyes, turning his eyeballs in anger, foaming blood flowing from nostrils.

raw: नास्ति रामस्य सदृशो विक्रमे भुवि कश्चन । विराधो निहतो येन कबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः ॥६-३०-२९॥
translation: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."

raw: स शिरः सशिरस्त्राणं श्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । प्रमथ्येन्द्रजितः कायात् पातयामास भूतले ॥६-९१-७४॥
translation: Prosperous Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, aiming at Indrajith's head shining with earrings belonging to the head severed from the body, it fell on ground.

raw: यदि माम् आश्रम गतम् वैदेही न अभिभाषते । पुनः प्रहसिता सीता विनशिष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥३-५८-१०॥
translation: I will die if Sita, princess from Videha, is not there to speak to me with her sweet smile when I return to the cottage, O Lakshmana

raw: तदेतत् सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्यं भीमपराक्रम । न हि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली ॥६-६२-२२॥
translation: "O Brother of fierce valour! Get up. I have not seen anyone stronger than you among all beings."

raw: सिंह व्याघ्र वराहैः च वारणैः च अपि शोभितम् । धव अश्वकर्ण ककुभैः बिल्व तिन्दुक पाटलैः ॥१-२४-१५॥
न वने नंदनोद्देशे न चैत्ररथ संश्रये । कुतः पृथिव्याम् सौमित्रे यो अस्य कश्चित् समो मृगः ॥३-४३-२६॥
translation: O Lakshmana, see the eagerness of Sita. Such a deer of exceptional beauty will not be found in this forest. There is no equal to this animal even in the Nandan garden of Indra, or the Chaitraratha, the garden of Kubera. Where can such an animal be found on earth?

raw: सिञ्चस्तुपृथिवींकृत्स्नांहिवशीतेववारिणा ततोऽभ्यवकिरन्त्वन्येलाजैःपुष्पैश्चसर्वतः ॥६-१३०-७॥
translation: Let the ground be sprinkled with cold water and then parched grain and flowers to be sprinkled.

raw: प्राप्तराज्यस्य रामस्य राक्षसानां वधे कृते । आजग्मुर्ऋषयः सर्वे राघवं प्रतिनन्दितुम् ॥७-१-१॥
translation: After Rama had attained his kingdom and the destruction of the Rakshasas was accomplished, all the sages came to congratulate Raghava.

raw: न अराजके जनपदे माल्यमोदकदक्षिणाः । देवताभ्यर्चनार्थय कल्प्यन्ते नियतैर्जनैः ॥२-६७-२७॥
translation: In a country where there is no king, people who are disciplined in spiritual practices do not offer garlands of flowers, sweetmeats and alms while worshipping gods.

raw: वधे तस्य समाज्ञप्ते रावणेन दुरात्मना । निवेदितवतो दौत्यं नानुमेने विभीषणः ॥५-५२-२॥
translation: Vibhishana did not approve of the killing of Hanuman, who had declared that he was an envoy (of Sri Rama) when the wicked Ravana ordered his murder.

raw: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनी पतिः । प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे साधु साध्विति च अब्रवीत् ॥४-८-२५॥
translation: On hearing Rama's words, Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys experienced immeasurable happiness and exclaimed, 'you're great, you're great.'

raw: नास्मि विप्रकृता देव केन चिन्नावमानिता । अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित्तमिच्छामि त्वया कृतम् ॥२-११-२॥
translation: O king I have neither been offended nor disregarded by any one, but I have a purpose which you should fulfil.

raw: नास्मिन्नर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम् । कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि ॥६-१०६-१३॥
translation: "O King! I who wish your welfare ought not to be blamed like an unworthy and pettyminded person by mistake."

raw: एवं कुरुष्व सौमित्रे मत्कृते रघुनन्दन । अस्माभिर्विप्रहीणाया मातुर्नो न भवेत्सुखम् ॥२-३१-१७॥
translation: O delight of the Raghu race, do this for my sake, since deprived of us, there will be no happiness for our mother, O son of Sumitra

raw: दु:शील: कामवृत्तो वा धनैवा परिवर्जित: । स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानां परमं दैवतं पति: ॥२-११७-२२॥
translation: For a woman of noble nature her husband, whether he be licentious or of bad character or devoid of riches, is her supreme lord.

raw: कालेन अनेन न अभ्येषि यदि माम् चारु हासिनि । ततः त्वाम् प्रातः आशा अर्थम् सूदाः छेत्स्यन्ति लेशशः ॥३-५६-२५॥
translation: O comely princess from Mithila, O lady with a sweet smile listen to my words. If you do not accept my hand in the course of twelve months, the cooks will cut you off into small bits for the (my) breakfast.

raw: चिरम् जीवितुमाशम्से रुदतीम् चापि मैथिलीम् । सा नूनम् विधवा राज्यम् सपुत्रा कारयिष्यसि ॥२-१२-७५॥
ददौ च अस्त्राणि दिव्यानि यस्मै ब्रह्मा महा ओजसे । दानव इन्द्रम् हतम् दृष्ट्वा तिमि ध्वज सुतम् रणे ॥२-४४-११॥
translation: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.

raw: तत्र लंकाम् समासाद्य पुरीम् रावण पालिताम् । ददर्श सीताम् ध्यायन्तीम् अशोक वनिकाम् गताम् ॥१-१-७३॥
translation: Hanuman arrived at the city of Lanka ruled by Ravana and found Sita in the Ashoka garden meditating on Rama.

raw: ततो देवाः स गन्धर्वाः तुष्टुवुः मधुसूदनम् । त्वम् गतिः सर्व भूतानाम् विशेषेण दिवौकसाम् ॥१-४५-२८॥
तं पद्मदलपत्राक्षं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम् । धन्याः पश्यन्ति मे नाथं कृतज्ञं प्रियवादिनम् ॥५-२३-१६॥
पलाशबदरीमिश्रम् रम्यम् वम्शैश्च यामुनैः । स पन्थाश्चित्रकूटस्य गतः सुबहुशो मया ॥२-५५-९॥
उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवः सुर ईश्वरः । सर्वान् लोकान् जितान् आह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा ॥३-७-१२॥
translation: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

raw: त्वम् च धर्मात् अतिक्रान्तः कथम् शक्यम् उपेक्षितुम् । गुरु धर्म व्यतिक्रान्तम् प्राज्ञो धर्मेण पालयन् ॥४-१८-२४॥
अनृतं पातयित्वा तु पादमेकमधर्मतः । ततः प्रादुष्कृतं पूर्वमायुषः परिनिष्ठितम् ॥७-७४-१८॥
translation: Indeed, when untruth caused one foot of Dharma to fall due to unrighteousness, then the duration of life was previously determined and established.

raw: आयसं परिघं गृह्य सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभम् । समरे वानरश्रेष्ठो महापार्श्वे न्यपातयत् ॥६-९९-६॥
translation: The foremost of the Vanaras (Angada), taking an iron bar flung on Mahaparsva in the battlefield.

raw: अम्बां च कैकयीं रुष्य परुषं चाप्रियं वदन् । प्रसाद्य पितरं श्रीमान् राज्यं मे दातुमागत: ॥२-९७-१२॥
translation: Auspicious Bharata, angry with Kaikeyi and having spoken to her unpleasant, bitter words and having propitiated our father, has come here to offer me the kingdom.

raw: मुदा परमया युक्तो विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । स तस्यां वीर्यसम्पन्नमपत्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥७-३-५॥
translation: The foremost sage Vishrava, filled with supreme joy, begot in her an exceedingly wonderful offspring endowed with great valor.

raw: कल्प्यन्ते मत्त मातम्गा युज्यन्ते रथ वाजिनः । तत्र तत्र च सम्नद्धाः सम्पतन्ति पदातयः ॥६-३३-२३॥
अत्यन्त सुख संवृद्धः सुकुमारो हिमार्दितः । कथम् तु अपर रात्रेषु सरयूम् अवगाहते ॥३-१६-३०॥
translation: How can Bharata who was brought up in luxury, who is delicate, and deserves all comfort, take a dip in river Sarayu (in cold morning) ?

raw: रक्ताक्षाः सुमहाकाया नीलाञ्जनचयोपमाः । शूलानुद्यम्य खड्गांश्च निशितांश्च परश्वधान् ॥६-६५-३९॥
वालिनः च भयात् तस्य सर्वलोक भयापह । कर्तुम् अर्हसि मे वीर प्रसादम् तस्य निग्रहात् ॥४-१०-३०॥
translation: 'O great warrior you are one who can frighten the entire world Due to the fear of Vali I seek your grace.You may resist Vali and provide me security.'

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रौद्रस्य रक्षसः । आर्ता दीनस्वरा दीनं प्रत्युवाच शनैर्वचः ॥५-१९-१॥
सकामा भव कैकेयि हतो अयम् कुल नन्दनः । कुलम् उत्सादितम् सर्वम् त्वया कलह शीलया ॥६-३२-४॥
translation: "O Kaikeyi! Your desire is fulfilled with the killing of the delight of the race. You, who are given to creating quarrel have ruined the race."

raw: तृष्णार्तम् सति पानीये विप्रलम्भेन योजयेत् । लभेत तस्य यत्पापम् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५७॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person who in possession of water does not give it to one suffering from thirst acquires it

raw: आरुह्य च रथं शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ । ययतु: परमप्रीतौ वृतौ मन्त्रिपुरोहितै: ॥२-११५-९॥
translation: Highly pleased, Bharata and Satrughna ascended the chariot and, surrounded by counsellors and priests, set out speedily.

raw: अब्रवीत्तानिदं सर्वान्सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः । रामः च सम्यग् आस्तीर्णो भास्वरा व्याघ्र चर्मणा ॥२-१५-१७॥
धन्यः खलु महाभागो लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षमणः । भ्रातरम् विषमे काले यो राममनुवर्तते ॥२-८८-२०॥
translation: Surely Lakshmana of great merit and auspicious virtues is fortunate since he is accompanying his brother Rama in times of adversity.

raw: अचिरप्रोषितं रामं चिरविप्रोषितं यथा । द्रष्टुकामो जन: सर्वो जगाम सहसाश्रमम् ॥२-१०२-३८॥
translation: The whole multitude of people at once rushed towards the hermitage wishing to see Rama as if he had left long ago though he had gone on exile very recently.

raw: ऋषिसङ्घैस्तदाकाशेदेवैश्चसमरुद्गणैः । स्तूयमास्यरामस्यशुश्रुवमधुरध्वनिः ॥६-१३१-३०॥
translation: Then the host of sages, Rudras and gods from the heaven started praising Rama with sweet sounding chanting.

raw: विदितो हि एष वृत्तांतो मम सर्वः तव अनघ । तपसः च प्रभावेण स्नेहाद् दशरथस्य च ॥३-१३-१५॥
translation: O sinless one, I have kown all these facts about you by the power of penance and love for Dasaratha.

raw: दुर्धरेण प्रहस्तेन महापार्श्वेन रक्षसा । मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैर्निकुम्भेन च मन्त्रिणा ॥५-४९-११॥
translation: He was attended by Durdhara, Prahasta, Mahaparsva and Nikumbha who were his learned ministers. Seated comfortably and attended by the four arrogant ministers, he was puffed with pride of their strength and appeared like the entire world surrounded by four oceans.

raw: अन्तपालाश्च यास्यन्ति सदारो यत्र राघवः । सहोपजीव्यम् राष्ट्रम् च पुरम् च सपरिच्छदम् ॥२-३७-२६॥
translation: The guardians of the harem, its patron king Dasaratha with his retinue and, the people of this city will go wherever Rama lives with his wife.

raw: अद्वारेण मःआतेजा हौमान् कपिसत्तमः । प्रविश्य नगरीम् लङ्काम् कपिराजहितम्करः ॥५-४-२॥
काव्यम् रामायणम् कृत्स्नम् सीतायाः चरितम् महत् । पौलस्त्य वधम् इति एवम् चकार चरित व्रतः ॥१-४-७॥
translation: Valmiki who practised religious austerities composed this entire epic named the Ramayana which constitutes the great history of Sita and the killing of Paulastya (Ravana).

raw: न विषादे मनः कार्यम् विषादो दोषवत्तरः । विषादो हन्ति पुरुषम् बालम् क्रुद्ध इव उरगः ॥४-६४-९॥
translation: 'Do not be despondent. It is the biggest flaw. It destroys a person like an angry serpent killing a young child.

raw: भजन्त्येते यथा काममश्वानारुह्य शीघ्रगान् । एते भ्राजन्ति संहृष्टा गजानारुह्य सादिन: ॥२-९६-१९॥
translation: These men mounted on swiftlymoving horses are following the post. The riders of elephants mounted on the elephants look cheerful.

raw: भवान् धर्म विनीतः च सुतपाः सर्व वत्सलः । आख्याता वायुपुत्रेण तत्त्वतो मे भवद् गुणाः ॥४-५-९॥
translation: 'You are a great hero, affectionate to all and wellversed in all dharmas. The son of the Windgod has, in fact, apprised me of your virtues

raw: मेघाम्बुसिक्तो वर्षासु वीरासनमसेवत । नित्यं च शिशिरे काले जलमध्यप्रतिश्रयः ॥७-१०-४॥
translation: In the rainy season, he practiced the Vīrāsana posture, drenched by rainwater, and always took refuge in the middle of water during the cold season.

raw: तव चैव महाभागे विदितं मम तत्त्वतः । सर्वं च विदितं मह्यं त्रैलोक्ये यद्धि वर्तते ॥७-४९-१३॥
translation: O highly fortunate one, your true nature is indeed known to me, and everything that exists in the three worlds is also known to me.

raw: रावणस्य पुरीं रात्रौ प्रविश्य सुदुरासदाम् । विचिन्वन् भवनं स्र्वं द्रक्ष्यामि जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-२-४७॥
translation: 'Entering by night the inaccessible city of Ravana, I shall search all over the palace and find Sita'.

raw: उत्पाट्य च महाशैलानश्वकर्णान् धवान् बहून् । अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षांश्चिक्षेप च महाबलः ॥६-७६-६५॥
translation: Mighty strong he was, uprooting Aswakarna and many other several kinds of trees he hurled at them (Rakshasas).

raw: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे । वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल ॥२-२९-९॥
translation: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.

raw: इत्युक्त्वा ऽश्रुपरीताक्षो भ्रातरं विससर्ज ऺह ॥२-११२-२८॥
translation: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.

raw: व्यथितो विक्लबशचैव व्याघ्रीम् दृष्ट्वा यथा मृगः । असम्वृतायामासीनो जगत्याम् दीर्घमुच्छ्वसन् ॥२-१२-४॥
translation: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed by sorrow fell into a stupor again.

raw: धारितुम् शक्स्यसि चिरम् विषम् पीत्वा इव निर्घृणः । बद्धः त्वम् काल पाशेन दुर्निवारेण रावण ॥३-५३-२२॥
कुबेरेण स्वयं स्वप्ने स्वस्मै दत्तं महात्मना । दुर्जयं दुर्विषह्यं च सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ॥६-९१-४८॥
translation: That arrow was gifted to Lakshmana in dream by Kubera, the god of wealth and even Suras or Asuras cannot resist it and is difficult to win.

raw: समर्थो ह्य् असि वीर्येण सुराणाम् अपि निग्रहे । तद् भवाम्सः चतुर् अन्गेण बलेन महता वृतः ॥६-३७-२४॥
अथ वासान् परित्यज्य तं सर्वे ऽभिमुखा: स्वनम् । अप्येकमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्थानं प्रधाविता: ॥२-१०२-३६॥
translation: Then all of them left their camps with one single thought (of seeing Rama) in their minds and ran in the direction from where that sound emanated.

raw: ॥ इति रामायने सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्थः सर्गः ॥५-४-३०॥
उन्मत्तेव प्रमत्तेव भ्रान्तचित्तेव शोचती । उपावृत्ता किशोरीव विवेष्टन्ती महीतले ॥५-२४-२॥
इति सूतः नर इन्द्रेण चोदितः सज्जमानया । उवाच वाचा राजानम् स बाष्प परिर्बद्धया ॥२-५८-१३॥
translation: Thus questioned by the king the charioteer, his voice choked with tears and words faltering in grief, addressed the king:

raw: ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् । प्रविश्य राक्षसं सैन्यं शरवर्षं ववर्ष ह ॥६-९४-१८॥
translation: Then, the highly energetic and valiant Rama, taking up the bow showered rain of arrows on Rakshasa army.

raw: विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसा दीनचेतसः । विद्रवन्ति ततः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तचेतसः ॥६-९८-३४॥
translation: All the Rakshasas became dull and piteous with sad faces. Out of fear they ran.

raw: अमनाः तेन शोकेन राम शोकेन च प्रभुः । द्वाभ्यामपि महाराजः शोकाब्यामभितप्यतो ॥२-६२-५॥
translation: The great king, the lord with a broken heart started regretting deeply about both the grievous acts he had committed previously (one is shooting at the son of a sage and the other, banishing Rama).

raw: त्वत्प्रसादात् समेयुस्ते वरमेतदहं वृणे ॥६-१२३-७॥
translation: "They were fond of doing and not counted death. I seek your grace to give a boon to relieve all of them from death."

raw: ततस्समुद्रमासाद्यनलंसेतुमकारयत् अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना ॥६-१२९-४९॥
translation: "Then Nala constructed the bridge, and the monkey heroes crossed the bridge."

raw: न च शक्नोम्यहं द्रषुं पूर्वं तथा सुखम् । हतहर्षं निरानन्दं पुनर्जनमवाङ्मुखम् ॥२-१४-१८॥
translation: Having seen people formerly enjoying happiness, I cannot see them again with their downcast, cheerless faces devoid of all happiness.

raw: किम् अयम् काम वृत्तः ते लुप्त धर्मार्थ संग्रहः । भर्ता भर्तृ हिते युक्ते न च एवम् अवबुध्यसे ॥४-३३-४३॥
translation: 'O lady, your husband engrossed in sensual pleasures, has lost sight of dharma and artha. Why don't you understand it in the interest of your husband whose wellwisher you are?

raw: मेघ उदर विनिर्मुक्ताः कर्पूर दल शीतलाः । शक्यम् अंजलिभिः पातुम् वाताः केतकि गन्धिनः ॥४-२८-८॥
translation: 'The winds released from the wombs of clouds, cool as the delicate touch of white lotuses,charged with the fragrance of ketaka flowers can be inhaled through the hollow of one's palms.

raw: स सागरमनाधृष्यमतिक्रम्य महाबलः । त्रिकूटशिखरे लङ्कां स्थितां स्वस्थो ददर्श ह ॥५-२-१॥
translation: The mighty Hanuman crossed the inviolable sea, stood comfortably on the peak of Trikuta mountain and looked at Lanka.

raw: कथयन्तं तु सौमित्रिं सन्निवार्य विभीषणः ॥६-८४-८॥
translation: Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to Rama, who was unconscious, restraining Saumithri from speaking.

raw: जानासि हि यथा सौम्य न मातृषु मम अन्तरम् । भूत पूर्वम् विशेषो वा तस्या मयि सुते अपि वा ॥२-२२-१७॥
translation: You know, O gentle Lakshmana that never in the past had I any feeling of distinction amongst my mothers. And Kaikeyi never differentiated between me and her son.

raw: क्षमा यस्मिन् दमस्त्यागः सत्यम् धर्मः कृतज्ञता । अप्यहिम्सा च भूतानाम् तमृते का गतिर्मम ॥२-१२-३३॥
translation: Where is the refuge for me without him in whom dwell forgiveness, forbearance, renunciation, truthfulness, righteousness, gratefulness and also nonviolence towards all living beings?

raw: सा हि राज्यम् इदम् प्राप्य नृपस्य अश्व पतेः सुता । दुह्खितानाम् सपत्नीनाम् न करिष्यति शोभनम् ॥२-३१-१३॥
translation: Once the daughter of king Aswapati (Kaikeyi) gains control over the kingdom, she will do nothing to help her afflicted cowives (Kausalya and Sumitra).

raw: तच्छूलं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । साधु साध्विति भूतानि व्याहरन्ति नभोगता ॥६-७९-३५॥
translation: Seeing the unwearied action of Raghava in destroying the pike, the beings in the sky praised him saying," well done, well done."

raw: भुजग आचरिताम् गुप्ताम् शुभाम् भोगवतीम् इव । ताम् सविद्युत् घन आकीर्णाम् ज्योतिः मार्ग निषेविताम् ॥५-३-५॥
translation: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.

raw: संस्कार क्रम संपन्नाम् अद्भुताम् अविलम्बिताम् । उच्चारयति कल्याणीम् वाचम् हृदय हर्षिणीम् ॥४-३-३२॥
translation: 'His words are auspicious. They are refined. Neither fast nor slow, his utterances captivate the heart.

raw: शार्दूलसिंहविव जातदंष्ट्रौ । गजेन्द्रपोताविव संप्रयुक्तौ । संहत्य संवेद्य च तौ कराभ्यां । तऊ पेतुतुर्वै युगपद्धरायाम् ॥६-४०-१९॥
translation: Both of them resembled a tiger and lion affected by pride, connecting to each other through their shoulders like Lordly elephants, hitting and hurting one another holding one another fell down at once simultaneously.

raw: हतम् त्वया राज्यम् इदम् सराष्ट्रम् । हतः तथा आत्मा सह मन्त्रिभिः च । हता सपुत्रा अस्मि हताः च पौराः । सुतः च भार्या च तव प्रहृष्टौ ॥२-६१-२६॥
पिता च राजा काकुत्स्थः श्रीमान् सन्नः तदा बभौ । परिपूर्णः शशी काले ग्रहेण उपप्लुतः यथा ॥२-४०-३०॥
translation: The king born in the race of Kakutstha, though bright, looked dull then like the full Moon eclipsed (by Rahu).

raw: यथान्यः पुरुषः कश्चित्पलाशैर्मोओहितो भवेत् । एवम् मम अपि अविज्ञातम् शब्द वेध्यमयम् फलम् ॥२-६३-१३॥
translation: Like some one who is deluded by palasa trees I too did not realise the consequences of shooting the target following the direction of the sound.

raw: तान् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाः सर्वे द्रवमाणान् वलीमुखान् । नेदुस्ते सिंहवद्धृष्टा राक्षसा जितकाशिनः ॥६-७९-७॥
translation: The monkeys saw all the arrogant Rakshasas roaring like lions and running as though triumphed.

raw: प्रथममर्धमुत्तरार्धेन योजनीयम् ॥२-९७-२७॥
कथयिष्यन्ति लोकेषु पुरुषाः कर्म कुत्सितम् । सुनृशम्सम् अधर्मिष्ठम् तव शौण्डीर्य मानिनः ॥३-५३-८॥
translation: You consider yourself to be brave after committing such a cruel, despicable and unrighteous act for which people of the world will condemn you.

raw: रुदन्तम् इव वृक्षैः च ग्लान पुष्प मृग द्विजम् । श्रिया विहीनम् विध्वस्तम् संत्यक्त वन दैवतैः ॥३-६०-६॥
translation: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.

raw: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि । किं करोमि कथं वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम् ॥५-३५-८८॥
translation: "Mythili, everything I intended to say has been narrated to you. Calm yourself down. What shall I do? Or else, tell me what pleases you. I shall go back.

raw: धनुर् आदाय सशरम् खनित्र पिटका धरः । अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि पन्थानम् अनुदर्शयन् ॥२-३१-२३॥
translation: Holding the bow and arrows and carrying a crowbar and a basket, I shall go in front of you leading the way.

raw: भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः । त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम ॥२-२६-३३॥
translation: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.

raw: तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैःकाञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः । मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्चप्रतिबुध्यस्वशेष्व च ॥६-१३१-१०॥
translation: May you wake up to the sounds of musical instruments and the tinkling of ornaments worn around the waist and anklets and sweet sounds of singing.

raw: प्रतिगृह्य ततः अस्त्राणि प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः । गच्छन् एव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-२८-१॥
translation: After performing the purificatory rites, Rama received the weapons with a cheerful face. In the way Rama said to Viswamitra.

raw: काञ्चनानि च चित्राणि तोरणानि च रक्षसाम् । लङ्कामुद्द्योतयामासुः सर्वतः समलंकृताम् ॥५-२-५४॥
translation: The golden archways of the demon were colourful. They illuminated the well decorated Lanka from all sides.

raw: न हि शक्या प्रवेष्टुम् सा मया अयोध्या त्वया विना । राज धानी महा इन्द्रस्य यथा दुष्कृत कर्मणा ॥२-५२-५५॥
translation: Just as a sinner cannot enter the capital of Indra (heaven), it is impossible for me to enter Ayodhya without you.

raw: किम् अर्थम् च नर श्रेष्ठौ सम्प्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि । वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥१-४८-६॥
translation: O Great ascetic they resemble each other in personality, expression and gestures. They adorn this land like Sun and moon in the sky holding excellent weapons. These heroes have trodden paths difficult to traverse. For what purpose have they come? I want to hear clearly".

raw: सर्वान् शिष्यान् समाहूय वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह । सर्वान् ऋषि वरान् वशिष्ठान् आनयध्वम् मम आज्ञया ॥१-५९-७॥
translation: He summoned all his disciples, and said, "Children bring here hosts of rishis along with their disciples and friends, officiating priests and persons wellversed in the Srutis. This is my order.

raw: चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य वने निर्यापितास्त्वया । वसता सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता ॥६-१२२-२२॥
translation: "O Gentle Rama! Fourteen years have been spent in the forest with Sita and Lakshmana after my departure from life."

raw: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः । अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं वेगेनाभ्युत्पपात ह ॥६-८८-१॥
translation: Hearing Vibheeshana's words, Indrajith was deluded with fury, spoke harshly and advanced.

raw: न शक्रस्य धनेशस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा । ईदृशो दृष्टपूर्वो न एवमूचुस्तपोधनाः ॥७-९२-१७॥
translation: The ascetics declared that such a spectacle had never been seen before, not even in the realms of Indra, Kubera, Yama, or Varuna.

raw: सः अहम् वन गतम् रामम् परिभूय महाबलम् । तापसो अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा पूर्व वैरम् अनुस्मरन् ॥३-३९-९॥
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै तां दिशं प्रति । उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा ॥५-६५-७॥
translation: The son of the Wind god, Hanuman who was wise in speech heard the words of Rama, offered salutations to Sita in the direction in which she was located and narrated the story about her discovery.

raw: त्रिशंकुः इति विख्यात इक्ष्वाकु कुल वर्धनः । तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना यजेयम् इति राघव ॥१-५८-११॥
नवीकृतं च तत्सर्वं वाक्यैस्ते धर्मचारिणि । पतिशुश्रूषणान्नार्य्यास्तपो नान्यद्विधीयते ॥२-११८-९॥
translation: O righteous one (Anasuya), after listening to your words the instructions given by my motherinlaw and my mother are renewed (remembered again). For a woman, no other penance is laid down (in scriptures) except service to her husband.

raw: यद् असौ मातुल कुले पुरे राज गृहे सुखी । भरतः वसति भ्रात्रा शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वितः ॥२-६८-२॥
translation: Bharata on whom the kingdom has been conferred is living comfortably in his maternal uncle's house. Let swift messengers go quickly on speeding horses and bring back the valiant brothers, Bharata and Satrughna. What is there to deliberate for us in this matter?

raw: अस्मान् अभ्यवपद्य इति माम् ऊचुर् द्विज सत्तमाः । मया तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा तेषाम् एवम् मुखात् च्युतम् ॥३-१०-७॥
तयोर्भूतानि वित्रेसुर्युगपत् सम्प्रयुध्यतोः । रौद्रयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः ॥६-१००-२७॥
translation: Just as created beings fight at the end of the dissolution of the universe, like God of death and God of retribution, both were fighting discharging arrows which was frightening to all beings.

raw: आदाय निशितं शूलं शत्रुशोणितरञ्जितम् । कुम्भकर्णो महातेजा रावणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६५-२१॥
translation: The dart was like Indra's thunderbolt in form and was equal to thunderbolt, capable of destroying Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yakshas and Pannagas, was like rising fire shining like the face of an enemy. It was sharp, wreathed in garlands of red colour and emitting flame. Kumbhakarna wielding the dart said.

raw: मारुतस्यात्मजः श्रीमान् कपिर्व्योमचरो महान् । हनुमान् मेघजालानि विकर्षन्निव गच्छति ॥५-५७-६॥
translation: Great Hanuman, son of the Windgod, flew through the abode of the Windgod as if he was swallowing the space, scratching the Moon, lord of the stars, as if seizing the heavens along with the constellation of Sun and stars and as though he was drawing the clusters of clouds.

raw: न च ते मर्षये पापम् क्ष्त्रियो अहम् कुलोद्गतः । औरसीम् भगिनीम् वा अपि भार्याम् वा अपि अनुजस्य यः ॥४-१८-२२॥
translation: 'I am a kshatriya born of a good family. I will not pardon you for your sin. Whosoever transgresses dharma against his own daughter, sister or brother's wife out of lust should be killed according to smriti.

raw: रक्षांसि पुरुषादानि नानारूपाणि राघव । वसन्त्यस्मिन् महारण्ये व्यालाश्च रुधिराशना: ॥२-११९-१८॥
translation: O Rama, this great forest is haunted by carnivorous demons who can assume any form and by blooddrinking wild animals.

raw: तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता । पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः ॥७-२६-५८॥
translation: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.

raw: ताम् ऊर्मि कलिल आवर्ताम् अन्ववेक्ष्य महा रथः । सुमन्त्रम् अब्रवीत् सूतम् इह एव अद्य वसामहे ॥२-५०-२७॥
translation: Beholding river Ganga full of waves and whirlpools, the great chariotwarrior (Rama) said to Sumantra: We shall spend the night here.

raw: तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते । एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ॥५-३९-४०॥
translation: "O noble lady therefore, give up your agony. Enough of your lamentation. The monkey troops will reach this place in one stride.

raw: सर्वे तु शिरसा भूमावभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च । प्रत्यूचू राघवं दीनमेवमेतन्न संशयः ॥७-४३-२२॥
translation: All of them, having saluted and bowed down with their heads to the ground, replied to the distressed Rama, "This is indeed so, there is no doubt."

raw: सर्व शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् भर्तारम् अपराजितम् । तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन अभिजनेन च ॥६-२८-२९॥
translation: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

raw: सो ऽयं ममानुपस्थाने व्यक्तं नैराश्यमागतः । क्रोधमोहसमाविष्टो निहन्तुं मां समुद्यतः ॥६-९३-५१॥
translation: 'I who am devoted to my husband and this Ravana wanted me to revel with him. He has been entreated by me several times. Surely, he, having been rejected by me is dejected, filled with anger and infatuation, intends to kill me, is evident'.

raw: अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धाः तिष्ठ तिष्ठ इति च अब्रुवन् । अस्माकम् त्वम् हि तुरगम् यज्ञियम् हृतवान् असि ॥१-४०-२८॥
इत्येवं संवदन् वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । तस्मादवातरच्छीव्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ॥६-४१-२२॥
translation: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.

raw: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् वैर अनुकथनम् महत् । अनागसा मया प्राप्तम् व्यसनम् पश्य राघव ॥४-१०-२९॥
translation: 'O Rama I have given you this long, full account of the cause of our enmity. For no fault of mine I am suffering.

raw: संपातेः वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरयो रावण क्षयम् । हृष्टाः सागरम् आजग्मुः सीता दर्शन कान्क्षिणः ॥४-६४-२॥
translation: On hearing the words of Sampati, the monkeys felt glad and, eager to see Sita, reached the ocean, the passage to the abode of Ravana.

raw: एवं सम्मन्त्र्य बलिनः सर्वे सैन्यसमावृताः । उद्योगं घोषयित्वा तु सर्वे नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवाः ॥७-६-४४॥
एवम् उक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदती शोक मूर्च्छिता । शिरः च उरः च बाहुभ्याम् दुःखेन समभिघ्नती ॥४-१९-२०॥
translation: So saying, the griefstricken, weeping Tara hastened, sadly beating with both hands her head and her chest.

raw: सुयज्ञो अपि अथ जाबालिः काशय्पो अपि अथ गौतमः । मार्कण्डेयः तु दीर्घायुः तथा कात्यायनो द्विजः ॥१-७-५॥
एवमुक्तः सुरसया दशयोजनमायतः । ततो ऽर्धगुणविस्तारो बभूवाहं क्षणेन तु । मत्प्रमाणानुरूपं च व्यादितं तु मुखं तया ॥५-५८-२९॥
translation: "When Surasa said this I who was ten yojanas in height increased by fifteen yojanas.

raw: राक्षसेनाहवे तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः । स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजो ऽभ्यवर्धत ॥६-५९-१३५॥
translation: Even though Hanuman was hurt by the arrows discharged by the Rakshasa king, being endowed with energy by nature, his energy went on increasing.

raw: एवंविधाश्च प्रवरा: स्त्रियो भर्तृदृढव्रता: । देवलोके महीयन्ते पुण्येन स्वेन कर्मणा ॥२-११८-१२॥
translation: Execellent women such as these, firm in their vows to their husband are highly revered in the world of gods through their own meritorious deeds.

raw: अथाश्वास्य महातेजा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-६४॥
translation: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

raw: कोटीशतपरीवारः केसरी पनसो गजः । अर्कश्चातिबल: पार्श्वमेकं तस्याभिरक्षति ॥६-४-३३॥
translation: Kesari, Panasa, Gaja, Atibala, Arka and their army of one hundred crores were protecting the army on one side.

raw: यो हि माम् सेवते कश्चित् अथ वा अपि अनुवर्तते । कैकेय्याः पुत्रम् अन्वीक्ष्य स जनो न अभिभाषते ॥२-२०-४३॥
translation: Any one who serves me or follows me will not talk to me after seeing Bharata (installed as heirapparent).

raw: माम् हि पल्लव ताम्रार्चिः वसन्ताग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति । न हि ताम् सूक्ष्मपक्ष्माक्षीम् सुकेशीम् मृदु भाषिणीम् ॥४-१-३०॥
एकेनान्तककल्पेन प्रासेनादित्यतेजसा । भिन्नानि हरिसैन्यानि निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥६-६९-७८॥
translation: With lance that looked like death and the spear glowing like the Sun, Naranthaka routed the Vanaras, who fell down.

raw: न अराजके जनपदे बद्दघण्टा विषाणीनः । आटन्ति राजमार्गेषु कुञ्जराः षष्टिहायनाः ॥२-६७-२०॥
translation: In a country without a king, young elephants of sixty years of age, their tusks adorned with bells no longer wander about on the highways.

raw: वने वन चराम् च अन्यान् खेचराम् च विहंगमान् । पश्यन्तः त्वरिता जग्मुः सुग्रीव वश वर्तिनः ॥४-१३-१२॥
translation: Following Sugriva faithfully, they proceeded swiftly, observing animals of the forest and birds flying in the sky.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तदशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ ११७ ॥६-११७-३७॥
ततो दूरात्प्रददृशे धनाध्यक्षो गदाधरः । शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्यां च पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः ॥७-१५-१६॥
translation: Then, from afar, the mace-wielding lord of wealth (Kubera) was seen, accompanied by Shukra and Praushthapada, and surrounded by Padma and Shankha.

raw: अग्निचूर्णमिवाविद्धं भास्वराम्बुमहोरगम् । सुरारिविषयं घोरं पाताळविषमं सदा ॥६-४-११७॥
translation: The sea that was the domain of snakes was shining as though sparks of fire from the sky penetrated the drops of sea water.

raw: अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मम गन्तुं त्वया ऽनघ । वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव ॥५-३७-४२॥
translation: "O sinless and foremost monkey going with you is not proper for me. Your windlike speed will render me unconscious.

raw: ततः शुश्रुपुराक्रुष्टम् लङ्कायाः काननौकसः । भेरीमृदङ्गसम्घुष्टम् तुमुलम् रोमहर्षणम् ॥६-२४-३॥
translation: There upon having settled down, the army hordes heard from Lanka terrific and tumultuous noise of drums and percussion instruments that caused horripilation.

raw: सा सुशीला वपुः श्लाघ्या रूपेण अप्रतिमा भुवि । तव अनुरूपा भार्या सा त्वम् च तस्याः पतिः वरः ॥३-३४-२०॥
translation: She is a woman of good conduct, of praiseworthy beauty. She is matchless in her beauty on earth. She will be a suitable wife for you and you, a suitable husband for her.

raw: तवादर्शनजेनार्ये शोकेन स परिप्लुतः । न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः ॥५-३६-३७॥
translation: "O noble lady not being able to see you, Rama is immersed in an ocean of sorrow, he has no solace like an elephant tormented by a lion.

raw: एवं स राजा तं शापमुपभुज्यारिसूदनः । प्रतिलेभे पुना राज्यं प्रजाश्चैवान्वपालयत् ॥७-६५-३७॥
translation: Thus, that king, the destroyer of enemies, having endured the curse, regained his kingdom and indeed protected his subjects.

raw: सीताया वचनम् श्रुत्वा कौसल्या हृदयम् गमम् । शुद्ध सत्त्वा मुमोच अश्रु सहसा दुह्ख हर्षजम् ॥२-३९-३२॥
translation: Listening to the heartstirring words of Sita, Kausalya with her heart so pure burst instantaneously into tears of joy and grief.

raw: भगवन्पर्वतं दुर्गं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि सहानुगः । न च पश्यामि तत्सैन्यं क्व नु ते मामका गताः ॥७-८९-११॥
translation: The king addressed Budha, saying, "O venerable one, I entered this difficult mountain with my followers, but I do not see my army; where have my people gone?"

raw: क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम् । तत् आख्यातु भवान् सर्वम् गतिः भव वन ओकसाम् ॥४-५९-३॥
translation: 'Where is Sita now? By whom else was she seen while being carried? Pray, tell us everything. You are the ultimate saviour of monkeys.

raw: वृष्ट्वेवोपरते देवे कृतकर्मणि राक्षसे । आजगामाथ तं देशं ससुग्रीवो विभीषणः ॥६-४६-२॥
translation: Indrajith retired after completing the task, like a cloud that retires after raining. Then came Vibheeshana and Sugriva to that location.

raw: ततः सुरैः संसहृष्टैः सर्वप्राणसमीरितः । सिंहनादरवोन्मुक्तः साधु देवेतिवादिभिः ॥७-७-४५॥
translation: Then, the greatly delighted gods, exclaiming "Well done, O God!", uttered a mighty roar with all their might.

raw: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि । स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् ॥७-२६-३॥
translation: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.

raw: तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव । प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि दुर्मते ॥७-६८-१३॥
translation: As he spoke thus, the demon, as if laughing, replied to the best of men, "Fortunately, O evil-minded one, you have arrived!"

raw: निष्फलाः फलिनश्चासन् विपुष्पाः पुष्पशालिनः । शुष्काः समग्रपत्रास्ते नगाश्चैव मधुस्रवाः ॥६-१२७-२०॥
तत्र योजन विस्तारम् उच्छ्रितम् दश योजनम् । शृंगम् सौमनसम् नाम जातरूपमयम् ध्रुवम् ॥४-४०-५७॥
translation: 'There is a huge golden peak called Saumanas of ten yojanas in height spread over a breadth of one yojana.

raw: हा कौसल्ये नशिष्यामि हा सुमित्रे तपस्विनि । हा नृशम्से ममामित्रे कैकेयि कुलपाम्सनि ॥२-६४-७७॥
translation: Ah, Kausalya, Ah, pitiable Sumitra, Ah, cruel Kaikeyi, my enemy and defiler of my race, I am going to die.

raw: शक्यम् अंबरम् आरुह्य मेघ सोपान पंक्तिभिः । कुटज अर्जुन मालाभिः अलंकर्तुम् दिवाकरम् ॥४-२८-४॥
translation: 'It is possible to climb up to the sky on the stairs formed by the clouds and decorate the Sungod with garlands made of kutaja and arjuna flowers.

raw: ततस्तु तां पाम्डुरहर्म्यमालिनीं विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिसङ्कुलाम् । पुरीमयोध्यां ददृशुः प्लवङ्गमाः पुरीं महेन्द्रस्य यथा ऽमरावतीम् ॥६-१२६-५१॥
स तु गत्वा मधुपुरं प्रविश्य च दशाननः । न ददर्श मधुं तत्र भगिनीं तत्र दृष्टवान् ॥७-२५-३८॥
translation: Having gone to Madhupura and entered it, Ravana did not find Madhu there, but instead saw his sister.

raw: सम्पूर्णाम् प्राविशत् राजा जन ओघैः समलम्कृताम् । पौरैः प्रति उद्गतो दूरम् द्विजैः च पुर वासिभिः ॥१-७७-८॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम पुलस्त्यतनयो द्विजः । अग्निहोत्रमुपातिष्ठच्चतुर्थ इव पावकः ॥७-९-१४॥
translation: O Rama, in the meantime, the brahmin Vishravas, son of Pulastya, performed the Agnihotra ritual, appearing like a fourth sacred fire himself.

raw: परिवार्य प्रमुदिता भेजिरे विपुलाः शिलाः । श्रोतुकामाः समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः ॥५-५७-४८॥
स्वम् आश्रमम् स प्रविगाह्य वीरोविहार देशान् अनुसृत्य कांश्चित् । एतत् तत् इति एव निवास भूमौप्रहृष्ट रोमा व्यथितो बभूव ॥३-५८-२०॥
translation: Thus blaming his dejected brother, the valiant Rama entered the hermitage, sighing deeply, his face pale and his throat dried up with hunger, exhaustion and thirst. Reaching his dwellingplace, he found it empty. He thoroughly searched the hermitage and the places where she used to move about on the premises. And 'so it has happened', he sadly said to himself, his hair raised on end. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सामंत राज सन्घैः च बलि कर्मभिः आवृतम् । नाना देश निवासैः च वणिग्भिः उपशोभिताम् ॥१-५-१४॥
translation: It was embellished with a host of tributary kings who used to pay tributes and with merchants from different countries.

raw: अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली । रामस्य दक्षिणे बाहुः नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः ॥३-३४-१४॥
translation: He is impatient, invincible, victorious, bold, intelligent and strong. He is even the right hand of Rama, his outer life.

raw: त्वाम् न एते हि अनुयुंजेयुः प्रत्यक्षम् प्रवदामि ते । यथा अयम् जांबवान् नीलः सुहोत्रः च महाकपिः ॥४-५४-१०॥
translation: 'This I am telling you openly and frankly. These monkeys are not going to be obedient to you. Neither Jambavan, nor Nila nor the great monkey Suhotra nor even myself would subscribe to this opinion (of staying in the cave) and follow you. It is not possible for you to keep us or these monkeys from Sugriva through the policy of appeasement like Sama, Dana, Bheda or even Danda (persuasion, giving gifts, creating differences or imposing punishment).

raw: सुव्यूढ कक्ष्यम् हनुमान् प्रविवेश महा गृहम् ॥५-६-४५॥
translation: Hanuman entered the delightful, lofty palace comparable to Kubera's mansion. It was filled with vessels encrusted with gems scattered all over. The floor was drenched with liquor. It was resonating with sounds of golden anklets of women and of drums. The rows of mansions, lofty palaces with welllaid apartments were full of hundreds of exquisite women. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: मुक्तमिन्द्रजिता तत्तु शरवर्षमरिन्दमः । अवारयदसम्भ्रान्तो लक्ष्मणः सुदुरासदम् ॥६-९१-२३॥
translation: Lakshmana, the tamer of enemies, without reacting intercepted the shower of arrows released by Indrajith which was difficult to resist.

raw: अत्र सप्तजना नाम मुनयः संशित व्रताः । सप्त एव आसन् अधः शीर्षा नियतम् जल शायिनः ॥४-१३-१८॥
translation: Here dwelt seven sages called the Saptajana, strict in their austere vows and highly disciplined, all seven lying immersed in water with heads bowed down.

raw: ते वध्यमानाः पतिताः प्रवीरा नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः । शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम् ॥६-५९-४५॥
translation: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.

raw: इमां भवन्त्यः(?) पश्यन्तु स्नेहेन परमेण हि । गौरवान्मम वाक्याच्च पूज्या वो ऽस्तु विशेषतः ॥७-४९-२३॥
translation: Indeed, may you all regard her with supreme affection, and especially, let her be worthy of your reverence out of respect for my words.

raw: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत । ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः ॥७-२२-२१॥
translation: Then, from the enraged Yama's face, a fire of anger arose, garlanded with flames, accompanied by his breath and smoke.

raw: अथ रेणु समुध्वस्तम् तम् उत्थाप्य नर अधिपम् । न्यवर्तत तदा देवी कौसल्या शोक कर्शिता ॥२-४२-१०॥
translation: Then Kausalya, emaciated due to sorrow, lifted the king who was thoroughly coated with dust and returned to the palace.

raw: ततः षोडशमे वर्षे गोलभो विनिपातितः । तम् हत्वा दुर्विनीतिम् तु वाली दंष्ट्र करालवान् । सर्वा अभयम् करः अस्माकम् कथम् एष निपातितः ॥४-२२-३०॥
translation: 'In the sixteenth year Golabha, the uncontrollable enemy was killed by Vali with his dreadful fangs and rendered protection to everybody. How did he get killed?'

raw: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् । अशोकमालाविततम् ददर्श परमासनम् ॥५-१०-४॥
translation: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.

raw: सो अहम् त्वाम् आगतः द्रष्टुम् प्रस्थितः विजनम् वनम् । भरतस्य समीपे ते न अहम् कथ्यः कदाचन ॥२-२६-२४॥
translation: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.

raw: आश्चर्याणि बहूनीह भवन्त्यस्याश्रमे मुनेः । न तु कौतूहलाद्युक्तमन्वेष्टुं तं महामुनिम् ॥७-७१-२३॥
translation: Many wonders occur here in this sage's hermitage, but it is not proper to question that great sage out of mere curiosity.

raw: एष ते यद्य् अभिप्रायस् तस्माद् गच्चामि जानकि । गृह्य शत्रोर् अभिप्रायम् उपाव्र्त्ताम् च पश्य माम् ॥६-३४-१३॥
translation: "Janaki! If you think so, I shall go to Ravana secretly and find out his intention and return back."

raw: कच्चित्त्वां नावजानन्ति याजका: पतितं यथा । उग्रप्रतिग्रहीतारं कामयानमिव स्त्रिय: ॥२-१००-२९॥
translation: Just like a performer of sacrifice scorns at an outcaste or a woman scorns at a lustful lover, do the subjects not scorn you for collecting taxes more than what is due?

raw: हृत भार्यो वने त्रस्तो दुर्गम् एतत् उपाश्रितः । सोऽहम् त्रस्तो वने भीतो वसामि उद् भ्रान्त चेतनः ॥४-५-२२॥
समुदाचार सम्युक्तम् इदम् वचनम् ऊचतुः । किम् अर्थम् नो नर व्याघ्र न रोचिष्यति राघव ॥६-१८-३८॥
ताम् स नन्दन सम्काशाम् मृग पक्षिभिर् आवृताम् । हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्बाधाम् कोकिल आकुल निह्स्वनाम् ॥५-१५-३॥
translation: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

raw: प्रहर्षमुपनीताश्च वालिपुत्रेण धीमता । आज्ञाप्रतीक्षास्तस्थुश्च सर्वे वानरयूथपाः ॥६-६६-३३॥
translation: All the Vanara troops having heard Angada, son of Vali happily restored awaiting his command.

raw: समीक्ष्य तु महा बाहः राघवस्य पराक्रमम् । लक्ष्मणस्य च विक्रान्तम् अभवत् प्रीतिमान् कपिः ॥५-३-१७॥
translation: Reflecting upon the valour of longarmed Rama and valiant advances of Lakshmana Hamuman felt pleased (within himself).

raw: विदितं भवतामेतद्यथा मे राज्यमुत्तमम् । पूर्वकैर्मम राजेन्द्रैस्सुतवत् परिपालितम् ॥२-२-४॥
translation: It is wellknown to all of you that people of this greatest kingdom were ruled by my predecessors who were great kings, who looked after the subjects as though they were their own children.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सत्यं सुभाषितम् । जानकी बहुमेने ऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-१८॥
translation: On hearing the truthful, proper, pleasing words by Hanuman whom she held in great esteem, Sita said this:

raw: वानराणां च हृष्टानां सिंहनादश्च पुष्कलः । स्फोटयन्निव शब्देन लङ्कां साट्टालगोपुराम् ॥६-९९-२४॥
translation: Highly rejoiced Vanaras roared in high pitch sound. The tall attics and gates of Lanka vibrated with sound. Even the gods, accompanied by Indra, made great sounds.

raw: स रावणः समागम्य विधिवत् तेन रक्षसा । मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा सर्व कामैः अमानुषैः ॥३-३५-३९॥
translation: When king Ravana reached there, Maricha received him in accordance with tradition and made worshipful offering to the king, fulfilling all his superhuman desires.

raw: न विन्दते तत्र तु शर्म मैथिलीविरूप नेत्राभिः अतीव तर्जिता । पतिम् स्मरन्ती दयितम् च देवरम्विचेतना अभूत् भय शोक पीडिता ॥३-५६-३६॥
translation: Sita had no peace as she was threatened excessively by those women of deformed looks. Remembering her beloved husband who was also her god, and overtaken by fear and grief , she fell unconscious. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सिद्ध अर्थाः तु नरा रामम् आगतम् सीतया सह । लक्ष्मणम् च महा बाहुम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुनर् आगतम् ॥२-७२-३८॥
translation: 'Those men who will see Rama returning home along with Sita and mightyarmed Lakshmana, will have their desires fulfilled.'

raw: अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति राक्षसः । निहन्ति समरे शत्रून् बध्नाति च शरोत्तमैः ॥६-८७-५॥
translation: "Thereafter he becomes invisible for all beings and kills his enemies with the best of arrows and binds them."

raw: अयम् आत्म भवः शोको माम् अनाथम् अचेतनम् । सम्सादयति वेगेन यथा कूलम् नदी रयः ॥२-६४-७५॥
translation: This selfcreated grief is rapidly destroying me like the bank of a river eroded by its swift current, leaving me helpless and insensible.

raw: गृहीतधनुषो यस्ते तिष्ठे दभिमुखो रणे । वानरेषु समासक्तम् न ते कार्यम् विपत्स्यते ॥६-२-१९॥
यच्च तेन पुरा शुभ्रं लवणेन कृतं महत् । तच्छोभयति शत्रुघ्नो नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् ॥७-७०-१२॥
translation: Shatrughna now beautifies that great and pure city, which was formerly created by Lavana, adorning it with various colors.

raw: प्रहृष्टस्त्वभवद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथ: । मैथिल्या: सत्क्रियां दृष्ट्वा मानुषेषु सुदुर्लभाम् ॥२-११९-१४॥
translation: Rama the great charioteer and Lakshmana were exceedingly gratified to see the honour conferred on Sita, rare among mortals.

raw: पृथिव्यां राजसिहानां मुख्यस्य विदितात्मनः । स्नुषा दशरथस्याहं शत्रुसैन्यप्रतापिनः ॥५-३३-१६॥
translation: "I am daughterinlaw of king Dasaratha, knower of the self, the foremost among kings on earth and a slayer of enemy army.

raw: निष्पपात च मालेव गृध्रो ऽस्य पथि गच्छतः । प्रास्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यो बाहुश्च कम्पते ॥६-६५-५१॥
translation: On the way as he was going an eagle alighted on his pike. His eyes twitched and left shoulder throbbed.

raw: न हि तद्भविता राष्ट्रम् यत्र रामो न भूपतिः । तद्वनम् भविता राष्ट्रम् यत्र रामो निवत्स्यति ॥२-३७-२९॥
translation: That is not a kingdom where Rama does not rule. If Rama lives in the forest, that shall be the kingdom.

raw: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाहरीन् । अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते ॥५-५९-५॥
translation: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.

raw: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद्वा हिमवान् वा हिमं त्यजेत् । अतीयात् सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितु: ॥२-११२-१८॥
translation: The Moon might lose its splendour, snow might abandon the Himavat mountain, the ocean might overstep its shores, but I shall not forsake the promise made to my father.

raw: ततो रुधिरताम्राक्षो भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् । अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनोऽब्रवीज्जानपदम् जनम् ॥२-५०-४॥
translation: He looked miserable, his copperred eyes filled with tears. He raised his right hand and said to the villagers who had come to see him:

raw: राजभावे नियोगः अयम् मम त्वत् विरहात् कृतः । स अमात्य पौर नगरम् स्थितम् निहत कण्टकम् ॥४-१०-८॥
translation: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.

raw: स दक्षिणाम् दिशम् गत्वा महिष्या सह राघव । तताप परमम् घोरम् विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ॥१-५८-२॥
यवीयान् आत्मनः पुत्रः शिष्यः च अपि गुणोदितः । पुत्रवत् ते त्रयः चिंत्या धर्मः चैव अत्र कारणम् ॥४-१८-१४॥
translation: A younger brother, a son, and a virtuous pupil—these three are to be regarded like one's own son; here righteousness is the deciding consideration.

raw: अथ तौ भ्रातरौ दीप्तम् शर वर्षम् ववर्षतुः । विराधे राक्षसे तस्मिन् कालांतक अयम् उपमे ॥३-३-१५॥
translation: And then both the brothers showered bright arrows on the demon Viradha who looked like Yama, the god of death.

raw: ततो ऽब्रवीदृशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम् । पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्द्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः ॥७-२५-१४॥
translation: Then Dashagriva spoke, saying that this was not good because the enemies, led by Indra, had been honored with wealth.

raw: पन्नग अशनम् आकाशे पतन्तम् पक्षि सेवितम् । वैनतेयम् अहम् शक्तः परिगंतुम् सहस्रशः ॥४-६७-१४॥
translation: 'I am capable of circumambulating a thousand times the great Garuda who consumes snakes and flies in the sky, the abode of birds.

raw: इन्द्रजित्तु ततो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । रणायाभ्युद्यतौ वीरौ मायां प्रादुष्करोत्तदा ॥६-८१-४॥
translation: Indrajith, also witnessing the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana prepared for war, exhibited his trickery.

raw: नातिगौरान्नातिकृष्णान्नातिकुब्जान्न वामनान् । विरूपान् बहु रूपामः च सुरूपामः च सुवर्चसः ॥५-४-१९॥
translation: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

raw: गच्छेयम् स्व शरीरेण देवानाम् परमाम् गतिम् । वसिष्ठम् स समाहूय कथयामास चिन्तितम् ॥१-५८-१२॥
रिपुः प्रच्छन्न चारी त्वम् मत् अर्थम् अनुगच्छसि । राघवस्य अन्तर प्रेप्सुः तथा एनम् न अभिपद्यसे ॥३-५९-१९॥
translation: 'You are an enemy moving in disguise with an interest in me. You are waiting for an opportunity to set aside Rama. That is why you are not rushing to him.'

raw: रुक्मवेणुध्वजः श्रीमान् देवराजरथो वरः । देवराजेन सन्दिष्टो रथमारुह्य मातलिः ॥६-१०३-८॥
नृशंसे पापसंकल्पे रामं स्त्यपराक्रमम् । किम् विप्रियेण कैकेयि प्रियं योजयसे मम ॥२-१३-१३॥
translation: O cruel, malevolent Kaikeyi, why do you propose such a harmful act against Rama who has truth as his prowess and who is so dear to me? Certainly, you will get unparalleled infamy and disgrace in this world.

raw: न्यपातयत तेजस्वी चतुरः तस्य वाजिनः । अष्टभिः सायकैः सूतम् रथ उपस्थे न्यपातयत् ॥३-२७-१५॥
वचनम् राघवस्यैतद्धर्मयुक्तम् समाहितम् । शुश्रुवु स्ताः स्त्रियम् सर्वाः शोकोपहतचेतसः ॥२-३९-३९॥
translation: All the women with their senses afflicted by grief heard the virtuous and wellbalanced words of the scion of the Raghu race:

raw: प्रभवन्तंपदस्थंहिपरुषंकोऽभिभाषते । पण्डितश्शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञोविनाप्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः ॥६-३६-७॥
translation: "Which person who has learned the truth of sastras will address such harsh words to one in power without instigation?"

raw: आर्येण एव परिक्रुष्टम् - पराक्रुष्टम् - हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति च । परित्राहि इति यत् वाक्यम् मैथिल्याः तत् श्रुतिम् गतम् ॥३-५९-७॥
translation: Uttered loudly, 'Alas Sita, Alas, Lakshmana, save me', as if these were the words of your noble self, reached Sita's ears.

raw: राम राम न सन्तापं कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत । स्मर त्वं पूर्वकं भावं मन्त्रं चामित्रकर्शन ॥७-९८-१२॥
translation: O virtuous Rama, you should not grieve; O destroyer of enemies, remember your ancient divine nature and the sacred incantation.

raw: तासां श्रुत्वा तु वचनं राक्षसीनां मुखाच्च्युतम् । उवाच वचनं काले त्रिजटा स्वप्नसंश्रितम् ॥५-२७-८॥
translation: "O Trijata, tell us the kind of dream you dreamt last night", they insisted. Hearing the words from the mouth of the shedemons, Trijata told them all about her dream.

raw: तैरश्वैर्भ्राम्यते भ्रान्तैः सुमाली राक्षसेश्वरः । इन्द्रियाश्वैः परिभ्रान्तैर्धृतिहीनो यथा नरः ॥७-७-३०॥
translation: Sumali, the lord of Rakshasas, was whirled around by those bewildered horses, just as a man devoid of steadfastness is bewildered by the horses of his senses.

raw: इदम् च उवाच धर्मज्ञम् कर्मणा तेन हर्षितः । रामम् सर्व अस्त्र विदुषाम् श्रेष्ठम् शूरम् अवस्थितम् ॥४-१२-७॥
translation: Sugriva who stood by, elated to watch the deed of Rama, best among the valiant, proficient in the use of arms of all kinds and knower of dharma, said:

raw: मातापित्रोर्महाहर्षं जनयन्रावणात्मजः ॥७-१२-३२॥
translation: Ravana's son was causing great joy to his mother and father. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वादशः सर्गः ।। 12 ।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: विवर्णवदना भूयो विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः । मूढाः शोणितगन्धेन निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥६-५२-१५॥
translation: Some others with pale faces and dishevelled hair lost senses due to rolling in blood dropped on the ground.

raw: अकाले चापि मुख्यानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च । दर्शयिष्यन्ति अनुक्रोशात् गिरयो रामम् आगतम् ॥२-४८-१३॥
translation: The hills will exhibit their excellent flowers and fruits off season out of compassion in order to welcome Rama.

raw: तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचन्म् । ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेता महीपतिम् ॥२-१५-१४॥
translation: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

raw: सा हि जन्म च बाल्यं च यौवनं च महात्मनः । धर्मकार्यानुरूपं च रुदन्ती संस्मरिष्यति ॥६-९३-५७॥
translation: 'She will be crying and keep remembering his birth, childhood, youth, and his rightful actions, and his charm'.

raw: हेमचित्रतनुत्राणां स्रग्दामाम्बरधारिणाम् । शीधुपानचलाक्षाणां मदविह्वलगामिनाम् ॥६-७५-१४॥
translation: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

raw: न चकार व्यथां चैव यक्षशस्त्रैः समाहतः । महीधर इवाम्भोदैर्धाराशतसमुक्षितः ॥७-१४-१३॥
translation: Even though struck by the weapons of the Yakshas, he felt no pain, just like a mountain remains unaffected when drenched by hundreds of streams of rain from clouds.

raw: ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वशः । वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्ससृजुस्तदा ॥६-११७-२१॥
translation: The hordes of Bears, Vanaras and Rakshasas moving about all over there were driven away to a distance from the vicinity.

raw: यदि तु आर्यम् न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुम् वनात् । वने तत्र एव वत्स्यामि यथा आर्यो लक्ष्मणः तथा ॥२-८२-१८॥
translation: If I am not able to bring back my noble brother (Rama) from the forest, I shall also dwell there like my noble brother Lakshmana.

raw: ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च । बभूवुस्त्राससंभ्रान्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः ॥५-४२-१॥
translation: The residents of Lanka panicked at the shrieking sounds of birds and cracking sounds of trees.

raw: निशाचरीणां प्रत्यक्षमनर्हं चापि भाषणम् । कथं तु खलु कर्तव्यमिदं कृच्छ्रगतो ह्यहम् ॥५-३०-११॥
translation: "I cannot talk to her in the presence of these nightroamers. How can I discharge my duty in this predicament?

raw: सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता । प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुतां गता ॥५-५९-३५॥
translation: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).

raw: न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनो वा व्रीडितो वा ऽपि दुःखितः । हृष्टं समुदितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम् ॥७-१०९-१७॥
translation: There was no one miserable, ashamed, or sorrowful; everything was joyful, prosperous, and extremely wonderful.

raw: ततः श्रुतः मया शब्दो जले कुम्भस्य पूर्यतः । द्विपो अयम् इति मत्वा हि बाणेन अभिहतः मया ॥२-६४-१५॥
translation: There I heard the sound of a pot being filled with water and mistaking it to be an elephant's, shot an arrow.

raw: तेनिवृत्तामहाकायाश्श्रुत्वाङ्गदवचस्तदा । नैष्ठिकींबुद्धिमास्थायसर्वेसङ्ग्रामकाङ्क्षिणः ॥६-६७-१॥
translation: Having heard Angada's words, the Vanaras of gigantic body firmly decided to wage war and returned back.

raw: न ते सम्भाषितुम् शक्याः सम्प्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते । प्रकृत्या कोपनास्तीक्षिणा वानरा राक्षसाधिप ॥६-२४-३०॥
translation: "O king of Rakshasas! It was not possible to negotiate there with the Vanaras). I had no opportunity to interrogate with them. By nature, Vanaras are violent and are highly furious."

raw: संचचक्षेऽथ मेधावी शरीरे चात्मनो जराम् । पूर्णचन्द्राननस्याथ शोकापनुदमात्मनः ॥२-१-४३॥
स बाल एव सौदासो मृगयामुपचक्रमे । चञ्चूर्यमाणं ददृशे स शूरो राक्षसद्वयम् ॥७-६५-११॥
translation: When Saudasa was still young, he went hunting and that brave king saw two rakshasas roaming about.

raw: हन्त शीघ्रम् इतः गत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि च मही पतिः । सह त्वम् परिवारेण सुखम् आस्स्व रमस्य च ॥२-१६-२०॥
translation: I shall go from here immediately and see the king. Remain here happily and rejoice with your maids.

raw: वेपमानम् श्रमेण अद्य भवद्भिः स्थीयताम् इति । एक एव आहरिष्यामि पातालात् अपि जानकीम् ॥४-४५-१३॥
translation: 'I will alone restore Sita, exhausted and trembling (in fear), even from the nether world. Wait here' (said another leader).

raw: न हि अव्यवसितः शत्रुम् राक्षसम् तम् विशेषतः । समर्थः त्वम् रणे हन्तुम् विक्रमैः जिह्म कारिणम् ॥४-२७-३६॥
translation: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.

raw: पुत्राः च अस्य भविष्यन्ति चत्वारो अमित विक्रमाः । वंश प्रतिष्ठानकराः सर्व बूतेषु विश्रुताः ॥१-११-१०॥
translation: Four sons of immense prowess would be born to him bringing glory and fame to their dynasty. They would be renowned in all the worlds.

raw: ब्राह्मणो ह्येकपार्श्वेन नरान् रोद्धुमिहार्हति । न तु मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तानां विधि: प्रत्युपवेशने ॥२-१११-१७॥
translation: A brahmin alone is competent in this world to prevent a person by lying down on one side (in front of him). One who is anointed king is not permitted by (scriptural) tradition to squat in protest.

raw: न क्रुध्यति अभिशस्तः अपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन् । क्रुद्धान् प्रसादयन् सर्वान् सम दुह्खः क्व गच्चति ॥२-४१-३॥
translation: Where is he who, even if reviled, never gets angry, never does acts that provoke anger, pacifies those who are enraged and shares the sorrows of others going now?

raw: ततः सूर्योदयम् यावत्सर्वम् परिसमुत्सुकम् । तस्थावनुपसम्प्राप्तम् किम् स्विदित्युपश् ॥२-६५-११॥
translation: All the highly enthusiastic attendants waited for the king till sunrise. Unable to see the king they doubted about what had happened

raw: निराकृतश्च बहुशस्त्वया ऽहं राक्षसाधिप । अपराद्धा हि बाल्याच्च रमणीयाः स्वबान्धवाः ॥७-१३-२०॥
translation: O lord of Rakshasas, I have been disregarded by you many times, yet one's own relatives, even if they have erred due to childishness, should indeed be cherished.

raw: एष त्वाम् राम रूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर । येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एक इषुणा रणे ॥४-२५-४३॥
translation: 'O monkey a single arrow from Rama who appeared in the forest in the form of death dragged you away from us and turned us all into widows.

raw: तत्र प्रविशतश्चापि कल्पान्तघनसन्निभा । अट्टहासं विमुञ्चन्ती नारी काप्युत्थिता पुरः ॥५-५८-४७॥
translation: As I entered the city, a woman like a doomsday cloud rose up before me, yelling and laughing wildly, opposing me.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ॥ ६३ ॥६-६३-५८॥
यौगंधर विनिद्रौ च दैत्य प्रमधनौ तथा । शुचि बाहुर् महाबाहुर् निष्कलि विरुचर् तथासार्चिर्माली धृतिमाली वृत्तिमान् रुचिरः तथा ॥१-२८-७॥
नहि मे जीवितैरर्थो नैवार्थैर्न च भूषणैः । वसन्त्या राक्षसीमध्ये विना रामं महारथम् ॥५-२६-५॥
translation: "In the absence of the great charioteer Rama, of what use is my living in the midst of ogresses? I need no wealth, no ornaments.

raw: अद्य ते व्यसनं प्राप्तं किं मां त्वमिह वक्ष्यसि । प्रवेष्टुं न त्वया शक्यो न्यग्रोधो राक्षसाधम ॥६-८७-२८॥
translation: "O Lowly Rakshasa! This worry has come to you today. Entering the banyan tree is not possible for you today."

raw: सारथे तुरगाञ्छीघ्रं योजयस्व रथोत्तमे । स्वास्तीर्णं राजभवनात्सीतायाश्चासनं कुरु ॥७-४६-२॥
translation: O charioteer, quickly harness the horses to the excellent chariot and prepare a well-cushioned seat for Sita from the royal palace.

raw: नीलजीमूतसङ्काश पीताम्बरशुभाङ्गद । स्वगात्राणिविनिक्षिप्यकिंशेषेरुधिराप्लुतः ॥६-११४-७९॥
translation: "Resembling a dark cloud clad in yellow silk, why are you lying like this with limbs thrown down and body covered with blood?"

raw: कक्षान्तरगतो वायुर्जीमूत इव गर्जति । खे यथा निपतन्त्युल्का ह्युत्तरान्ताद्विनिःसृता ॥५-१-६५॥
अन्तःपुराणि सर्वाणि शांताम् दृष्ट्वा तथा आगताम् । सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षीम् प्रीत्या आनंदम् उपागमन् ॥१-११-३०॥
translation: All the royal ladies, experienced immense delight when they saw the largeeyed Shanta arriving along with her husband in that manner.

raw: तावत् इच्छामहे गन्तुम् इति उक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः । ववन्दे सह सौमित्रिः सीतया सह राघवः ॥३-८-९॥
translation: We wish to depart before the Sun grows unbearably hot like the man devoid of good lineage who acquires wealth through unlawful means (becomes arrogant). Thereafter Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana offered worship at the feet of the venerable sage.

raw: श्रूयतां त्वभिधास्यामि यन्निमित्तं मया रथः । नदीवेग इवाभोगे संयुगे विनिवर्तितः ॥६-१०६-१४॥
translation: "O yes! I will answer you. Please listen. like the river entering the ocean speedily is diverted, I have taken back the chariot from the battle.

raw: पुरोहितः त्वा कुशलम् प्राह सर्वे च मन्त्रिणः । त्वरमाणः च निर्याहि कृत्यम् आत्ययिकम् त्वया ॥२-७०-३॥
translation: The family priest (Vasistha) and all the counsellors have enquired about your welfare. You must return immediately. There is an urgent matter to be attended by you.

raw: अहोओ महात्मा राजायमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः । ज्ञात्वा यो वृद्ध मात्मानं रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति ॥२-६-२१॥
translation: Oh having realised that he himself has grown old the highsouled king Dasaratha the veritable delight to the Ikshvaku race, is going to coronate Rama in the kingdom.

raw: ततः सतामार्तिहरं परं वरं वरप्रदं चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम् । समर्चयित्वा स निशाचरो जगौ प्रसार्य हस्तान्प्रणनर्त चाग्रतः ॥७-३१-४३॥
translation: Then, having worshipped Shiva, who removes the distress of the virtuous, is the supreme boon, grants boons, and is adorned with the moon's rays, Ravana, the night-wanderer, sang and danced in front of the deity with outstretched hands. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 31 ।। Thus ends the thirty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: उदीक्षमाणा गगनं केचिन्नेत्रेषु ताडिताः । शरैर्विविशुरन्योन्यं पेतुश्च जगतीतले ॥६-७३-५६॥
translation: Some Vanaras looking up to the sky eyes pierced with arrows held one another and fell on the ground.

raw: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः । क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः ॥५-६७-२१॥
दर्पणान् परिमृष्टांश्च वाससां चापि सञ्चयान् । पादुकोपानहश्चैव युग्मानि च सहस्रश: ॥२-९१-७५॥
इहस्थां मां न जानीते शङ्के लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । जानन्नपि हि तेजस्वी धर्षणां मर्षयिष्यति ॥५-२४-१८॥
शङ्खभेरीनिनादैस्तं घोयषयन्तः स्वकर्मभिः । राक्षसाः क्रूरकर्माणश्चारयन्ति स्म तां पुरीम् ॥५-५३-१८॥
translation: The cruel demons started blowing conches and beating drums. They paraded him in the city announcing their deeds.

raw: रसातलं वा प्रविशेत् पातालं वापि रावणः । पितामहसकाशं वा न मे जीवन् विमोक्ष्यते ॥६-१९-२१॥
translation: "Even if Ravana enters the hell or underground or the abode of Brahma the creator, I will not let him be alive."

raw: ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः सम्प्रधनो हरिः । अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तु महागजम् ॥६-९७-१८॥
translation: Then springing up, the valiant Vanara uprooting a tree struck the face of the Rakshasa seated on the great elephant.

raw: घोररूपाः शिवा नेदुः सज्वालकवलैर्मुखैः । मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि बबन्धुश्च विहङ्गमाः ॥६-६५-५०॥
translation: She jackals were seen with flaming morsels throwing from their mouths. Birds wheeled in a circular way and settled.

raw: महा इन्द्र ध्वज सम्काशः क्व नु शेते महा भुजः । भुजम् परिघ सम्काशम् उपधाय महा बलः ॥२-६१-७॥
translation: Where will that mightyarmed and powerful Rama, as lofty as Indra's banner, sleep using his ironbarlike arm as pillow?.

raw: युद्धश्रद्धा ऽथवा ते ऽस्ति शङ्खचक्रगदाधर । ४अहं स्थितो ऽस्मि पश्यामि बलं दर्शय यत्तव ॥७-८-५॥
translation: Or if you have a desire for battle, O holder of conch, discus, and mace, I am standing here; show me the strength that is yours.

raw: विविधान्यपि यानानि महान्ति च लघूनि च । प्रययु: सुमहार्हाणि पादैरेव पदातय: ॥२-९२-३४॥
translation: Various types of costly carriages, large and small, set forth, while the infantry marched on.

raw: तां तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतां तृणविन्दुरथाब्रवीत् । किं त्वमेतत्त्वसदृशं धारयस्यात्मनो वपुः ॥७-२-१९॥
translation: Seeing her in such a transformed state, Tṛṇabindu then asked her why she was bearing a form so unbefitting her true self.

raw: रावणोऽयम् महाबाहुरिति संचिन्त्य वानरः । अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः ॥५-१८-३०॥
translation: The brilliant vanara (Hanuman), son of the Windgod recognising the strongarmed Ravana got down a little, saying 'This is truly the strongarmed Ravana.'

raw: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् । पुरा हि नमुचिं सङ्ख्ये वज्रेणेव पुरन्दरः ॥६-५६-१७॥
translation: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.

raw: अथ त्रिवेणु संपन्नम् कामगम् पावक अर्चिषम् । मणि सोपान चित्र अंगम् बभंज च महारथम् ॥३-५१-१६॥
translation: Then he(Jatayu) broke down the great chariot(of Ravana) glowing like fire, glittering with gold and gems, made of three bamboo reeds, and capable of flying wherever the rider willed.

raw: तद् धनुर् नरशार्दूल मैथिलस्य महात्मनः । तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि काकुत्स्थ यज्ञम् च परम अद्भुतम् ॥१-३१-११॥
translation: O best of men, O descendent of Kakustha, there you will see the bow that belongs to the magnanimous king of Mithila and the wonderful sacrifice at that place.

raw: गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ दुर्धर्षा मुक्ता हारम् इव ऊर्मिभिः । तस्य मध्ये महा श्वेतो ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः ॥४-४०-४४॥
विशेषमालम्ब्य विशेषसम्स्थितम् । विचित्रकूटम् बहुकूटमण्डितम् । मनोऽभिरामम् शरद्न्दुनिर्मलम् । विचित्रकूटम् शिखरम् गिरेर्यथा ॥५-८-५॥
translation: The Pushpaka was specially designed in a unique manner. It was decorated with many colourful peaks. It was delghtful and pleasing to the mind and bright like the autumnal fullmoon. It looked like a mountain with many wonderful towers around.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महाबाहुः अगस्त्यम् सूर्य वर्चसम् । जग्राह आपतत् तस्य पादौ च रघुनन्दन ॥३-१२-२४॥
translation: Having said so, the mightyarmed Rama, the scorcher of enemies, grasped the feet of Agastya who was shining like the Sun.

raw: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि रामे प्रव्राजिते वन्म् । रूढश्च कृतमूलश्च शेषं स्थास्यति ते सुतः ॥२-९-३१॥
translation: After Rama has been exiled into the forest for fourteen years your son grown strong and deeprooted will remain (king) for the rest of his life.

raw: प्रवर्ग्यम् शास्त्रतः कृत्वा तथा एव उपसदम् द्विजाः । चक्रुः च विधिवत् सर्वम् अधिकम् कर्म शास्त्रतः ॥१-१४-४॥
translation: Brahmins performed pravargya and upasada and other ceremonies as per the scriptures and traditions.

raw: तम् दृष्ट्वा सगुणम् चापम् उद्यम्य खर निःस्वनम् । रामस्य अभिमुखम् सूतम् चोद्यताम् इति अचोदयत् ॥३-२५-२॥
translation: On seeing Rama, Khara held his terribly twanging bow and arrow, stood facing him, and ordered the charioteer to drive towards him.

raw: ततस्तु कम्पनं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो हतं रणे । रथेनाभ्यपतत् क्षिप्रं तत्राङ्गदमभीतवत् ॥६-७६-४॥
translation: Then seeing Kampana killed, Sonitaksha, a fearless hero, quickly reached Angada by chariot.

raw: वने चराणाम् सततम् नूनम् स्पृहयते पुरा । रामस्य दयिता भार्या जनकस्य सुता सती ॥५-१४-४८॥
translation: "The daughter of Janaka, the chaste wife of Rama, used to for the company of those creatures wandering in the forest.

raw: एतदेव मया ऽ ऽख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा । सर्वथा सागरजले सन्तारः प्रविधीयताम् ॥५-६५-२६॥
translation: "O Rama I have spoken everything that has happened. We have to pay attention to the means of crossing the ocean."

raw: भक्ताः चैव अनुरक्ताः च हिताः च मम नित्यशः । हन्यमाना अपि न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युः वचो मम ॥३-२१-३॥
translation: They are loyal and faithful to me. They are always my wellwishers. Even when attacked, they cannot be killed. They never fail to carry out my orders.

raw: उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदानार्दितः । सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रम ॥५-५८-७६॥
translation: "She spoke sweetly to Ravana, who was tormented by the god of love saying, 'For what purpose do you desire Sita? You are equal to Mahendra in might'.

raw: तत: शिरसि कृत्वा तु पादुके भरतस्तदा । आरुरोह रथं हृष्ट: शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वित: ॥२-११३-१॥
translation: Then Bharata accompanied by Satrughna, placing the sandals on his head in delight, boarded the chariot.

raw: न चास्य माता न पिता च नान्यः स्नेहाद्विशिष्टो ऽस्ति मया समो वा । तावत्त्वहं दूत जिजीविषेयं यावत् प्रवृत्तिं श्रृणुयां प्रियस्य ॥५-३६-३०॥
translation: "His love for me is superior to his love for his father, mother or any one else. O messenger, I wish to survive till I hear any news from my dear lord."

raw: इष्टका बहु साहस्री शीघ्रम् आनीयताम् इति । उपकार्याः क्रियन्ताम् च राज्ञो बहु गुणान्विताः ॥१-१३-९॥
translation: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

raw: विधिः किल नरम् लोके विधानेन अनुवर्तते । यथा अयम् विहितो भक्ष्यः चिरात् मह्यम् उपागतः ॥४-५६-४॥
translation: 'Destiny rules the world of men in accordance with a divine arrangement. Or else, it would not have brought me food after a long time (of fasting)'. (The monkeys are food for Sampati)'

raw: स तु तं तादृशं दृष्ट्वा रथं लोकभयावहम् । नाक्षुभ्यत दशग्रीवो न चापि भयमाविशत् ॥७-२२-११॥
translation: But Ravana, upon seeing that chariot which struck terror into the world, was neither disturbed nor did fear enter his heart.

raw: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः कानन द्रुमाः । वायु वेग प्रचलिताः पुष्पैः अवकिरन्ति गाम् ॥४-१-१२॥
translation: Various forest trees shaken by the force of the wind scatter flowers on the beautiful rocky surface of earth.

raw: समानयत् स तान् सर्वान् समस्तान् वेद पारगान् । तान् पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथः तदा ॥१-१२-७॥
एवम् उक्त्वा शुभम् वाक्यम् जटायुः तस्य रक्षसः । निपपात भृशम् पृष्ठे दशग्रीवस्य वीर्यवान् ॥३-५१-३३॥
translation: Brave Jatayu having thus said these cautious words to the demon dashed against his back again and again.

raw: कूप काराः सुधा कारा वम्श कर्म कृतः तथा । समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतः ते प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-८०-३॥
translation: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.

raw: यदैवहिजनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतः । खरस्तुनिहतोभ्रातातदारामो न मानुषः यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ॥६-११४-१९॥
translation: " At Janasthana when your brother Khara was surrounded by many Rakshasas also he got killed by a mortal. So also, when Hanuman entered the city of Lanka, which is difficult to enter even for gods, I got perturbed."

raw: तमाश्रमं महातेजाः पिता ते सुमहायशाः । पुरोहितं महात्मानं दिदृक्षुरगमस्त्वयम् ॥७-५१-३॥
translation: Your highly effulgent and very famous father went to that hermitage, desirous of seeing the great-souled priest.

raw: स तथा गृध्र राजेन क्लिश्यमानो मुहुर् मुहुः । अमर्ष स्फुरित ओष्ठः सन् प्राकंपत स राक्षसः ॥३-५१-३६॥
translation: Thus tormented again and again by the king of vultures, Ravana shook with anger, his lips quivering.

raw: तस्थौ तत्राङ्गदः श्रीमान् वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । उपास्यमानो विबुधैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा ॥५-५७-५०॥
translation: Surrounded by many great vanaras, Angada was shining like Indra, lord of the gods attended by the gods in heaven.

raw: प्रभविष्ण्वो भवामेति परस्परमनुव्रताः ॥७-५-१५॥
translation: They further requested, "And let us be mighty, always devoted to each other."

raw: बभूव भूयो भूतानाम् स्वयम् भूः इव सम्मतः । सर्वे वेद विदः शूराः सर्वे लोकहिते रताः ॥१-१८-२५॥
सो ऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम । कालधर्मं हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम् ॥७-७८-७॥
translation: O best of Brahmanas, having known my lifespan due to some cause, I then accepted the law of time in my heart and went to the forest.

raw: एतैर्निमित्तैरपरैश्च सुभ्रूः संबोधिता प्रागपि साधु सिद्धैः । वातातपक्लान्तमिव प्रनष्टं वर्षेण बीजं प्रतिसंजहर्ष ॥५-२९-६॥
translation: Reassured by such omens which augured well as tested by time, Sita, with beautiful eyebrows, and deep foresight experienced great joy, like a seed blighted by the wind and the Sun comes back to joyful life through a pleasing shower. (A foreteller is addressed as siddha in sanskrit dramas)

raw: प्रतारम् च समुद्रस्य रात्रौ लंका अवरोधनम् । विभीषणेन संसर्गम् वधोपाय निवेदनम् ॥१-३-३५॥
आत्मवान् को जित क्रोधो द्युतिमान् कः अनसूयकः । कस्य बिभ्यति देवाः च जात रोषस्य संयुगे ॥१-१-४॥
translation: Who (among men) is selfrestrained? Who has conquered anger? Who is endowed with brilliance and free from envy? Who is that when excited to wrath even the devatas, are afraid of (let alone foes)?

raw: पराक्रमोत्साहमतिप्रतापसौशील्यमाधुर्यनयानयैश्च । गाम्भीर्यचातुर्यसुवीर्यधैर्यैर्हनूमतः को ऽभ्यधिको ऽस्ति लोके ॥७-३६-४५॥
translation: Who in the world is superior to Hanuman in valor, enthusiasm, intelligence, prowess, good conduct, charm, policy, imprudence, profundity, cleverness, great courage, and fortitude?

raw: तम् ते भयपरीत अंगाः ख्सुब्धम् दृष्ट्वा प्लवंगमाः । काल मृत्यु युगांताअभम् शतशो विद्रुता दिशः ॥४-३१-२०॥
translation: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, who looked like a veritable god of Death at the time of dissolution of the universe, hundreds of monkeys, their limbs trembling in fear ran in different directions.

raw: निजघ्नुः सहसा ऽ ऽप्लुत्य यातुधानान् प्लवङ्गमाः । शैलशृङ्गाचिताङ्गाश्च मुष्टिभिर्वान्तलोचनाः ॥६-६९-५२॥
translation: The Rakshasa leaders, hit by the blows of Vanaras, fell down on the mountain peaks, trembling with their eyes protruded by the blows of fists.

raw: तरुणौ रूप संपन्नौ सुकूमारौ महाबलौ । पुण्डरीक विशालाक्षौ चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरौ ॥३-१९-१४॥
translation: Here are two young sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Lakshmana, who are gentle, handsome, strong, with eyes like white lotus, wearing deerskin and bark robes, living on fruits and roots, selfrestrained like ascetics and following the righteous path.

raw: न ततर्प समायान्तं पश्यमानो नराधिपः । अवतार्य सुमन्त्रस्तं राघवं स्यन्दनोत्तमात् ॥२-३-३०॥
translation: Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.

raw: किं ब्रह्मणः सर्वपितामहस्य सर्वस्य धातुश्चतुराननस्य । इहागतोवाग्रूपधारीरक्षोपसंहारकरः प्रकोपः ॥५-५४-३७॥
translation: 'Or is it Grandfather Brahma, the supreme fourfaced god enraged and arrived in the form of vanara to kill the clan of demons?

raw: तम् दृष्ट्वा पतितम् भूमौ क्षतज आर्द्रम् जटायुषम् । अभ्यधावत वैदेही स्व बंधुम् इव दुःखिता ॥३-५१-४४॥
translation: Sita, princess of Videha, saw the wounded Jatayu fallen on the ground drenched in blood. Grieving, she ran towards him as if he was her relative.

raw: उरोगतेन निष्केण भुजस्थैरङ्गदैरपि । कुण्डलाभ्यां च चित्राभ्यां मालया च विचित्रया ॥६-७७-५॥
translation: Nikumbha was shining with ornaments on his chest, golden armlets on arms, wonderful earrings and wonderful garland s holding clubs in hand, with bow like Indra's and roaring like lightning and thunder in the clouds.

raw: न हि दृष्टिपथं प्राप्य राघवस्य रणे रिपुः । जीवन् प्रतिनिवर्तेत यद्यपि स्यान्मनोजवः ॥६-४८-१८॥
translation: "Even if the enemy is endowed with speed of thought, if he comes in the range of Rama's sight, he will not go alive."

raw: तस्मिन्युगे प्रज्वलिते धर्मभूते ह्यनावृते । अधर्मः पादमेकं तु पातयत्पृथिवीतले ॥७-७४-१५॥
translation: In that brightly shining age, which was indeed full of unobstructed dharma, unrighteousness nevertheless placed one foot upon the surface of the earth.

raw: इन्द्रजित्त्वग्रतः (अग्रतः) सैन्यात्सैनिकान्परिगृह्य च । जगाम रावणो मध्ये कुम्भकर्णश्च पृष्ठतः ॥७-२५-३४॥
translation: Indrajit led the army from the front, Ravana marched in the middle, and Kumbhakarna followed at the rear.

raw: ते तु तेन मुहूर्तेन कपयः शीघ्र चारिणः । किष्किंधाम् त्वरया प्राप्ताः सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥४-३७-३४॥
