raw: इति तेनातियशसा राक्षसेनाभिचोदिताः । वानरेन्द्रा जहृषिरे लाङ्गूलानि च विव्यधुः ॥६-९०-१९॥
translation: Incited by the encouraging words of Vibheeshana (Rakshasa), Vanara chiefs rejoiced and went shaking their tails.

raw: प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सर्वम् उपानयम् उपाहृतम् । वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा च सर्वान् एव व्यसर्जयत् ॥४-३८-१॥
translation: On receiving all the gifts presented by the monkeys, Sugriva permitted them to go happy.

raw: ते बाणा वज्र संकाशाः सुघोरा रक्त भोजनाः । आजग्मुः सहिताः सर्वे त्रयः संनतपर्वणः ॥३-३९-१२॥
translation: All the three tightly jointed, welltargetted darts, strong as thunderbolt, and which could feed on blood came together all at once.

raw: श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम् । प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना ॥५-५८-९३॥
translation: "The divine lady heard my enumeration, sanctifying the royal seers. She replied me, with her eyes blinded by tears:

raw: सबाष्पपूर्णवदनो निःश्वसन् शोककर्शितः । माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम् ॥२-६४-२२॥
translation: The griefstricken, glorious ascetic with his face filled with tears, heaving deep sighs broke down with grief and spoke to me as I was standing with folded palms.

raw: विरूप रूपा विकृता विवर्चसो । महा आनना दीर्घ विरूप दर्शनाः । समीक्ष्य सा राक्षस राज योषितो । भयाद् विनष्टा जनक ईश्वर आत्मजा ॥५-१२-४॥
translation: 'The daughter of Janaka might have collapsed out of fear, looking at the distorted faces of ugly, tall and monstrous demon maids of Ravana.

raw: ततः काञ्चीनिनादं च नूपुराणाम् च निस्वनम् । शुश्राव परमस्त्रीणां स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः ॥५-१८-२०॥
translation: Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, heard their jingling golden girdles and anklets.

raw: हयोष्ट्रखरवक्त्राश्च राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः । शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः ॥५-१७-१५॥
translation: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.

raw: लालिताः कपि राजेन प्राणामः त्यक्ष्यन्ति वानराः । न वनेषु न शैलेषु न निरोधेषु वा पुनः ॥५-१३-३४॥
अहम् एव आहरिष्यामि स्वयम् लोकान् महामुने । आवासम् तु अहम् इच्छामि प्रदिष्टम् इह कानने ॥३-७-१५॥
translation: O great sage I will win all the worlds myself. I (only) want to live in this forest. Allow me.

raw: न ह्य् अस्माभिः प्रतिग्राह्यम् सखे देयम् तु सर्वदा । इति तेन वयम् राजन्न् अनुनीता महात्मना ॥२-८७-१७॥
translation: O king that great Rama entreated us in a friendly manner by saying 'O friend we should always give to others but should never accept anything from others'.

raw: किमग्नौ निपताम्यद्य अहोस्विद्वडवामुखे । शरीरमाहो सत्त्वानां दद्मि सागरवासिनाम् ॥५-५५-१४॥
translation: 'Shall I end my life by jumping into fire just now, or else into the mouth of submarine fire? Should I offer my body to the living creatures of the ocean as their food?

raw: स ददर्श महातेजा रावणः कपिसत्तमम् । रक्षोभिर्विकृताकारैः कृष्यमाणमितस्ततः ॥५-४८-५९॥
translation: Resplendent Ravana saw the ogres of ugly appearance dragging the foremost of the monkeys here and there.

raw: यस्याः पुत्र सहस्त्रैस्तु कृत्स्नम् व्याप्तमिदम् जगत् । ताम् दृष्ट्वा रुदतीम् शक्रो न सुतान्मन्यते परम् ॥२-७४-२६॥
translation: The wishfulfilling cow (Kamadhenu) had innumerable sons spread all over the world. When Indra saw that Kamadhenu too was weeping for her sons, he concluded 'there is no one greater than a son'.

raw: न कामान् न च लोभाद् वा न भयात् पार्थिव आत्मज । रागान्नक्राकुलजलम् स्तम्भयेयम् कथम्चन ॥६-२२-२७॥
translation: "O Lord of the land Out of desire or covetousness or even out of fear I will not be able to solidify the water infested with poisonous animals."

raw: विसर्जयामास तदा कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः । राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातः काशीशो ऽप्यकुतोभयः । वाराणसीं ययौ तूर्णं राघवेण विसर्जितः ॥७-३८-२०॥
translation: Then, Rama, who brings joy to Kaushalya, dismissed the fearless lord of Kashi, who, having been permitted and sent off by Rama, quickly returned to Varanasi.

raw: अथ तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे पर्वतस्याविदूरतः । सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यं नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् ॥७-८८-८॥
translation: Then, in that forest region not far from the mountain, there was a lake, very beautiful in appearance and filled with various flocks of birds.

raw: उत्तरे पर्वते राम देवतानाम् अभूत् भयम् । अमंत्रयन् समागम्य सर्वे स ऋषि गणाः सुराः ॥१-६३-१६॥
उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर । कृतकार्यस्य मे वासः कथं स्यादिह सम्मतः ॥६-१२४-२०॥
translation: "O Ruler of Rakshasas, send for my aerial car. My task has been completed here. How can I continue to stay here?"

raw: धनुश्शतपरीणाहः स षट्छतसमुच्छ्रितः । रौद्रः शकटचक्राक्षो महापर्वतसन्निभः ॥६-६५-४२॥
translation: Assuming another fearful form, Kumbhakarna who was highly energetic, endowed with mighty strength and frightful in form, which was a hundred bows in breadth and six hundred bows in height, with eyes like wheels of chariot, enraged, seemed like a huge mountain.

raw: समुत्सृज्य तु सा गर्भं विद्युत्केशरतार्थिनी । रेमे तु सार्धं पतिना विस्मृत्य सुतमात्मजम् ॥७-४-२५॥
translation: Having abandoned her offspring, she, desiring union with Vidyutkesha, then enjoyed herself with her husband, completely forgetting her own son.

raw: साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः । साधु साध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम् ॥७-९७-२२॥
translation: A very great acclamation of "well done" suddenly arose from the gods, praising, "Well done, well done, O Sita, whose character is indeed of such purity!"

raw: स्वामिना प्रतिकूलेन प्रजाः तीक्ष्णेन रावण । रक्ष्यमाणा न वर्धन्ते मेषा गोमायुना यथा ॥३-४१-१४॥
translation: O Ravana, people who are ruled by a cruel and hostile king will not grow like the sheep protected by a jackal.

raw: देव कार्यम् स्म सा कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्ट चेतना । अभिज्ञा राज धर्मानाम् राज पुत्रम् प्रतीक्षते ॥२-२६-४॥
translation: Experienced in palace rituals, Sita, grateful (to God) after performing worship of the deities was awaiting in a happy mood the arrival of the prince.

raw: न एव अकृतज्ञः सुग्रीवो न शठो न अपि दारुणः । न एव अनृत कथो वीर न जिह्मः च कपीश्वरः ॥४-३५-३॥
translation: 'O hero Sugriva, king of monkeys, is not ungrateful or deceitful, He is neither crooked nor false.

raw: शत्रुघ्नश्चतदाराममभिवाद्यसलक्ष्मणम् सीतायाश्चरणौवीरोविनयादभ्यवादयत् ॥६-१३०-४७॥
translation: Then hero Shatrughna and Lakshmana also greeted Rama and then worshipped Sita also.

raw: अल्प वीर्या यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुङ्गव । कथम् नाग सहस्रस्य धारयति अबला बलम् ॥१-२५-२॥
translation: "O best of ascetics, I have heard the yakshas possess little prowess. How can a woman who is by gender weak possess the strength of a thousand elephants?

raw: स राम: स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पृथिवीपतिम् । उवाच भरतं वाक्यं धर्मात्मा धर्मसंहितम् ॥२-१०२-७॥
translation: On hearing that his father, king Dasaratha, the lord of the world had attained heaven, righteous Rama said to Bharata in conformty with his rightful conduct.

raw: ताः स्त्रीयः स्वप्नशीलज्ञास्चेष्टासम्चलनादिषु । ता वेपथु परीताः च राज्ञः प्राणेषु शन्किताः ॥२-६५-१४॥
translation: Those women knowledgeable in ascertaining the nature of sleep based on the actions, movements, etc. were apprehensive whether the king was alive or not. Trembling severely they seemed like the tips of reeds that stand against the current.

raw: मया लङ्केति नगरी शक्राज्ञप्तेन निर्मिता । तस्यां वसत दुर्धर्षा यूयं राक्षसपुङ्गवाः ॥७-५-२६॥
translation: This city, named Lanka, was built by me at Indra's command; O invincible and foremost Rakshasas, you should dwell there.

raw: अमुं तु विजयं सौम्य दशग्रीववधार्जितम् । भूयिष्ठं स्वपुरे पौरैः कथ्यन्ते पुरुषर्षभ ॥७-४३-८॥
translation: O gentle one, O best among men, this victory, indeed, obtained by the slaying of Dashagriva, is mostly narrated by the citizens in your city.

raw: अग्निमुखा अशोकाः च सुरक्ताः परिभद्रकाः । तान् आरुह्य अथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा च तान् बलात् ॥३-७३-५॥
सूतः ततः सम्त्वरितः स्यन्दनम् तैः हय उत्तमैः । योजयित्वा अथ रामाय प्रान्जलिः प्रत्यवेदयत् ॥२-४६-२६॥
translation: Thereupon the charioteer hurriedly harnessed the splendid horses to the chariot and informed Rama with folded hands:

raw: कार्यसिद्धिंपुरस्कृत्यमन्द्रयध्वंविनिर्णये । नित्यंसन्निहितोह्यत्ररावणोराक्षसाधिपः ॥६-३७-५॥
translation: "Rakshasa king Ravana is ever present here. Prepare yourself to achieve success in the mission and determine your duty."

raw: तस्याश्रमपदस्थस्य बुद्धिर्जज्ञे महात्मनः । चरिष्ये परमं धर्मं धर्मो हि परमा गतिः ॥७-३-१०॥
translation: A thought arose in the mind of the great sage residing in his hermitage that he would practice supreme righteousness, for righteousness is indeed the ultimate goal.

raw: अपश्यदुमया सार्धं रुदन्तं राक्षसात्मजम् । कारुण्यभावात्पार्वत्या भवस्त्रिपुरसूदनः ॥७-४-२८॥
translation: Shiva, the destroyer of Tripura, then saw the demon's son crying, accompanied by Uma, moved by Parvati's feeling of compassion.

raw: प्रध्यायत इव अपश्यत् प्रदीपामः तत्र कान्चनान् (ःइअतुस्!) । धूर्तान् इव महा धूर्तैर् देवनेन पराजितान् ॥५-९-३२॥
translation: Seeing the golden lamps that stood burning steadily, Hanuman thought they looked like gamblers in deep thought defeated by expert gamblers in a game of dice.

raw: अतः परमतीरोऽयं सागर स्सरितां पतिः । न चायमनुपायेन शक्यस्तरितुमर्णवः ॥६-४-१०१॥
translation: There is only the ocean, the lord of rivers, and the shore is beyond this. We cannot cross the ocean without any mode.

raw: जले तरुण सूर्याभैः षट्पद आहत केसरैः । पन्कजैः शोभते पम्पा समन्तात् अभिसंवृता ॥४-१-६४॥
translation: 'Lake Pampa shines with lotuses with bees on their filaments like the rising sun.

raw: द्रुमान् पश्य इह सौमित्रे पम्पाया रुचिरान् बहून् । वात विक्षिप्त विटपान् यथा आसन्नान् द्रुमान् इमान् ॥४-१-८४॥
यद् अर्थम् अयम् आरंभः कृतः पर पुरम् जय । समयम् न अभिजानाति कृतार्थः प्लवगेश्वरः ॥४-३०-७६॥
translation: 'O conqueror of the enemy capital the monkey lord who has achieved his goal does not realise the importance of my mission.

raw: सरी सृपाः च बहवो बहु रूपाः च भामिनि । चरन्ति पृथिवीम् दर्पात् अतः दुखतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-१९॥
translation: There are various forms of fierce reptiles fearlessly crawling on the ground. So (living in the) forest is extremely dangerous.

raw: निवारयति बाहुभ्याम् यः शैल शिखरोपमः । दश वर्ष सहस्राणि तपः तप्त्वा महावने ॥३-३२-१७॥
गंगा त्रिपथगा नाम दिव्या भागीरथी इति च । त्रीन् पथो भावयन्ति इति तस्मत् त्रिपथगा स्मृता ॥१-४४-६॥
translation: O King divine Ganga will be called Tripathaga as well as Bhagirathi. Since she flows in the three worlds (heaven, earth and the lower world: Patala), she will be known as Tripathaga.

raw: अभ्यवर्तत वैदेहीम् चित्राम् इव शनैश्चरः । सहसा भव्य रूपेण तृणैः कूप इव आवृतः ॥३-४६-१०॥
वत्स्यसि त्वं मया सार्धं तदा हि वरवर्णिनि । एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिराजगाम स्वमाश्रमम् ॥७-३०-४५॥
translation: Then, O beautiful lady, you will indeed dwell with me; having spoken thus, the Brahmana-sage returned to his own hermitage.

raw: एकेन खलु बाणेन मर्मणि अभिहते मयि । द्वाव् अन्धौ निहतौ वृद्धौ माता जनयिता च मे ॥२-६३-४२॥
translation: 'By striking at the vital part of my body with one arrow, you have killed both my aged and blind mother and father too.

raw: संहृत्य च भुजौ श्रीमांस्तथैव च शिरोधराम् । तेजः स्त्त्वं तथा वीर्यमाविवेश स वीर्यवान् ॥५-१-३६॥
translation: The glorious and courageous Hanuman his head and shoulders contracted, summoned up all his energy and vigour.

raw: यत्त्वाम् पुत्रकः पश्येयम् जटावल्कधारिणम् । तथा हि रामम् वन वास निश्चितम् । ददर्श देवी परमेण चेतसा । उवाच रामम् शुभ लक्षणम् वचो । बभूव च स्वस्त्ययन अभिकान्क्षिणी ॥२-२४-३७॥
translation: Seeing Rama full of auspicious qualities resolved to go to the forest and having spoken to him with the fullness of her heart, Devi Kausalya now braced herself up to perform ceremonies in the interest of Rama's wellbeing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfourth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सु संवृत्तम् पार्थिव लक्षणैः च तम् चारु नेत्रम् मृगशाव नेत्रा । अदृष्ट पूर्वम् पुरुष प्रधानम् अयम् स काकुत्स्थ इति प्रजज्ञे ॥४-२४-२८॥
translation: The fawneyed Tara saw the magnificent man of Kakutstha family endowed with all royal marks and beautiful eyes, whom she had never seen before and knew he was Rama.

raw: ताम् अपश्यन् पुनः तत्र तपः परमम् आस्थितः । स तेन तोषितः च असीत् अत्यंतम् रघुनंदन ॥१-४३-१०॥
यन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं नावगच्छसि दुर्मते । पश्चादस्य फलं प्राप्य ज्ञास्यसे निरयं गतः ॥७-१५-१८॥
translation: O evil-minded one, because you do not understand even when restrained by me, you will realize the consequence of this after having gone to hell.

raw: अद्य तु एतस्य कालस्य साग्रम् वर्ष शतम् गतम् । देश काल प्रतीक्षो अस्मि हृदि कृत्वा मुनेः वचः ॥४-६३-३॥
translation: 'More than a hundred years have passed and all this time I have borne the sage's words in my heart and have waited for the right time and place.

raw: पुत्रि प्रदानकालो ऽयं यौवनं व्यतिवर्तते । प्रत्याख्यानाच्च भीतैस्त्वं न वरैः प्रतिगृह्यसे ॥७-९-७॥
translation: O daughter, this is the time for your marriage, and your youth is passing; you are not being accepted by suitors, who are afraid of rejection.

raw: तितीर्षुर्लक्ष्मणो गङ्गां शुभां नावमुपारुहत् । गङ्गां सन्तारयामास लक्ष्मणस्तां समाहितः ॥७-४६-३४॥
translation: Desiring to cross the Ganga, Lakshmana boarded the auspicious boat and then attentively ferried Sita across the Ganga. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 46 ।। Thus ends the forty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: कायक्लेशाश्च बहवो भयानि विविधानि च । अरण्यवासे वसतो क्धुःखमेव ततो वनम् ॥२-२८-२३॥
translation: There are various physical afflictions and fears for one who lives in the forest. Therefore, forest brings suffering.

raw: इति विलपति राघवो तु दीनोवनम् उपगम्य तया विना सु केश्या । भय विकल मुखः तु लक्ष्मणो अपिव्यथित मना भृशम् आतुरो बभूव ॥३-६२-२०॥
translation: When Rama, devoid of Sita, the lady with beautiful hair, wailed piteously after reaching the forest, Lakshmana too, his face pale out of fear and mind dejected, felt extremely agitated. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: त्रै लोक्यम् येन संभ्रांतम् आतापितम् इव अभवत् । ततो देवर्षि गन्धर्वाः पन्नग उरग राक्षसाः ॥१-६५-९॥
पातयित्वा तु कैकेय्या रामम् स्थानात् यथा इष्टतः । प्रदिष्टः रक्षसाम् भागः पर्वणि इव आहित अग्निना ॥२-४३-५॥
translation: You have thrown away Rama from his place as per the whim of Kaikeyi, like the share of offering meant for gods given away to rakshasas by the sacrificers on the new Moon days.

raw: न वृथा ते श्रमो ऽयं स्यात् संशये न्यस्य जीवितम् । सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायं निष्फलस्तव ॥६-११९-१३॥
translation: "O Life! If you had a doubt this exertion to you is wasteful. This fruitless hard work was perhaps not required on your part nor your friends."

raw: तमप्रतिमकर्माणमप्रतिद्वन्द्वमाहवे । ददर्शान्तर्हितं वीरं वरदानाद्विभीषणः ॥६-४६-१०॥
न लोका धारयिष्यन्ति तव तेजः सुरोत्तम । ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तो देव्या सह तपः चर ॥१-३६-१०॥
translation: "O best among the gods, the worlds cannot contain your energy (the son born of your energy) You may engage yourself in penance in the company of Uma in conformity with the Vedas. Retain your energy in your body for the welfare of the three worlds."

raw: सम्प्रयुद्धौ ततो दृष्ट्वा बलवन्नरराक्षसौ । व्याक्षिप्तहृदयाः सर्वे परं विस्मयमागताः ॥६-१०९-३॥
translation: Then, when the mighty human and the Rakshasa were both engaged in the battle, distracted at heart, all experienced supreme wonderment.

raw: एते दोषा मम भ्रातुर्जीवितैश्वर्यनाशनाः । गुणान् प्रच्छादयामासुः पर्वतानिव तोयदाः । दोषैरेतैः परित्यक्तो मया भ्राता पिता तव ॥६-८७-२६॥
translation: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."

raw: मया तु एतत् वचः श्रुत्वा याचितः स परंतपः । शापयित्वा च माम् पद्भ्याम् प्रविवेश बिलम् ततः ॥४-९-१४॥
translation: 'On hearing him, I begged the scorcher of enemies (Vali) that I would follow him, but he made me swear on his feet and entered the cave.

raw: एवमुक्तस्तदा राम राक्षसेन्द्रेण दानवः । महर्षेस्तनयं ज्ञात्वा मयो हर्षमुपागतः । दातुं दुहितरं तस्मै रोचयामास यत्र वै ॥७-१२-१६॥
translation: O Rama, when the king of demons spoke thus, Maya, the Danava, felt joy upon knowing him to be the son of the great sage, and indeed desired to give his daughter to him.

raw: स तु हर्षात् तम् उद्देशम् जन ओघो विपुलः प्रयान् । अशोभत महा वेगः सागरस्य इव पर्वणि ॥२-८०-४॥
translation: Like a swollen ocean on a fullmoon day the multitude of people proceeded joyfully with great speed to the appointed place.

raw: उपरक्तमिवादित्यं भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम् । तटाकमिव निस्तोयमपश्यज्जगतीपतिम् ॥२-३४-३॥
translation: He saw the lord of the world (Dasaratha) dull like the Sun in eclipse, like the fire covered with ashes, like a tank with its water dried up.

raw: पिता हि दैवतम् तात देवतानामपि स्मृतम् । तस्माद्दैवतमित्येव करिष्यामि पितुर्वचः ॥२-३४-५२॥
translation: Father is divine even for the gods as cited in scriptures, therefore, looking upon father as my god, I will carry out his words, O father

raw: धर्मशास्त्रेषु मुख्येषु विद्यमानेषु दुर्बुधा: । बुद्धिमान्वीक्षिकीं प्राप्य निरर्थं प्रवदन्ति ते ॥२-१००-४०॥
translation: While principal scriptures do exist, these superficial fellows take resort to the science of logic based on abstract reasoning, and indulge in futile talks.

raw: ततः पद्म सहस्रेण वृतः शन्कु शतेन च । युव राजो अंगदः प्राप्तः पितृ तुल्य पराक्रमः ॥४-३९-३०॥
translation: Then arrived the heir apparent, Angada, whose prowess is comparable to that of his father with him came a thousand padmas and a hundred sankus of followers.

raw: पूजितान् दधिपात्रैश्च सर्पिर्भिः सुमनोक्षतैः । मन्त्रवेदविदो विप्रान् ददर्श स महाबलः ॥६-१०-९॥
translation: Mighty Vibheeshana saw there, brahmins learned in vedas and mantras, who worshipped with yellow rice, curd, clarified butter and flowers.

raw: तां श्रुत्वा दिव्यसङ्काशां कथामद्भुतदर्शनाम् । लक्ष्मणः परमप्रीतो राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥७-५७-१॥
translation: Having heard that divine-like and amazing story, Lakshmana was greatly pleased and spoke these words to Rama.

raw: एवम् उक्{]तः ततो देवैः देवेश्वरः प्रभुः । प्रादुर् आसीत् ततो अत्र एव शंख चक्र धरो हरिः ॥१-४५-२२॥
translation: Thereupon, Hari the Lord of celestial beings extolled by the devatas appeared bearing the conch and discus.

raw: निष्कंप पत्राः तरवो नद्यः च स्तिमित उदकाः । भवन्ति यत्र तत्र अहम् तिष्ठामि च चरामि च ॥३-४८-९॥
translation: Wherever I stay or move about, the leaves of trees do not shake, and the waters in rivers remain still.

raw: प्रस्रविष्यन्ति तोयानि विमलानि महीधराः । विदर्शयन्तः विविधान् भूयः चित्रामः च निर्झरान् ॥२-४८-१४॥
translation: The mountains, displaying various wonderful streams here and there, will flow with pellucid waters (for Rama).

raw: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतोविसंज्ञःपपातभूमौयुधिवानरेन्द्रः । तंप्रेक्ष्यभूमौपतितंविसंज्ञनेदुःप्रहृष्टास्त्वथयातुधानाः ॥६-६७-६८॥
translation: Struck by the piece of mountain the Vanara king became unconscious and dropped on the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas were happy and naturally roared with a feeling of triumph.

raw: एवम् गृध्रो हतः तेन रावणेन बलीयसा । संस्कृतः च अपि रामेण गतः च गतिम् उत्तमाम् ॥४-५७-११॥
स तु दिव्यो महाभीमः सज्ज एव महारथः । उपस्थितो मातलिना वाह्यमानो महाजवः ॥७-२८-२४॥
translation: That divine, very formidable, and indeed ready great chariot, of immense speed, was then brought forth by Matali.

raw: अतिकायं हतं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसा । उद्वेगमगमद्राजा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-७२-१॥
translation: On hearing that Atikaya was killed by highly energetic Lakshmana, the king was overtaken by emotion and spoke as follows.

raw: गुरु पुत्रान् अहम् सर्वान् नमस् कृत्य प्रसादये । शिरसा प्रणतो याचे ब्राह्मणान् तपसि स्थितान् ॥१-५८-१९॥
न चान्यदपि वक्तव्यमतो वीर न शासनम् । विलोक्यमानमिच्छामि मद्विधेन विशेषतः ॥७-१०८-१५॥
translation: Therefore, O hero, nothing else is to be said, and I do not wish this to be regarded as a command, especially by one like me.

raw: अहम् एव आहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान् महामुने । आवासम् तु अहम् इच्छामि प्रदिष्टम् इह कानने ॥३-५-३३॥
translation: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

raw: स शक्तिमान् शक्तिसमाहतः सन् मुहुः प्रजज्वाल रघुप्रवीरः । तं विह्वलन्तं सहसा ऽभ्युपेत्य जग्राह राजा तरसा भुजाभ्याम् ॥६-५९-१०९॥
translation: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.

raw: सा बाष्पशोकाभिहता समीक्ष्य तौ भ्रातरौ देवसमप्रभावौ । वितर्कयन्ती निधनं तयोः सा दुःखान्विता वाक्यमिदं जगाद ॥६-४७-२३॥
त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । दिष्ट्या ते निहता राम महावीर्या निशाचराः ॥७-१-२३॥
translation: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed those extremely powerful demons Trishira, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka.

raw: सर्वे च हरि शार्दूलाः पुत्रः च अयम् तव अंगदः । हरि ऋक्ष पति राज्यम् च त्वत् सनाथम् अनिन्दिते ॥४-२१-८॥
translation: 'O blemishless lady these great monkeys including your son Angada and the entire kingdom of monkeys and bears are under your protection.

raw: स्थिरा मया प्रतिज्ञाता प्रतिज्ञा गुरुसन्निधौ । प्रहृष्यमाणा सा देवी कैकेयी चाभवत्तदा ॥२-१०९-२५॥
translation: I had taken a firm vow in the presence of my father (about my stay in the forest). And then Devi Kaikeyi was immensely delighted.

raw: इत्युक्त्वा पाणिना शैलमालभ्य हरिपुङ्गवः । जगामाकाशमाविश्य वीर्यवान् प्रहसन्निव ॥५-१-१३३॥
translation: Having said this, the mighty monkey gently touched the mountain with his hands before ascending to the sky with a smile on his face.

raw: अहम् वः प्रतिजानामि न गमिष्यामि अहम् पुरीम् । इह एव प्रायम् आसिष्ये श्रेयो मरणम् एव मे ॥४-५५-१२॥
translation: 'I swear I will not return to the city. I will fast unto death here only. Death for me is desirable.

raw: योधानाम् अग्नि कल्पानाम् पेशलानाम् अमर्षिणाम् । संपूर्णा कृत विद्यानाम् गुहा केसरिणाम् इव ॥१-६-२१॥
translation: It abounded with warriors, like a cave with lions. They were almost like flaming fire, the most determined among experts and accomplished in learning (the science of arms).

raw: कदा अहम् पुनर् आगम्य सरय्वाः पुष्पिते वने । मृगयाम् पर्याटष्यामि मात्रा पित्रा च सम्गतः ॥२-४९-१५॥
translation: When shall I return and reunite with my father and mother and go hunting in the blooming forest on the bank of the river Sarayu?

raw: सत्य रूपम् तु तत् वाक्यम् राज्ञः स्त्रीणाम् निशामयन् । प्रदीप्तम् इव शोकेन विवेश सहसा गृहम् ॥२-५७-२३॥
translation: Listening to the correct words of the king's wives, he immediately entered the palace as if in flames (of grief).

raw: ध्वजीन् पताकिनश्चैव ददर्श विविधायुधान् । शक्ति वृक्ष आयुधामः चैव पट्टिश अशनि धारिणः ॥५-४-२०॥
उवास रजनीम् तत्र ताटकाया वने सुखम् । मुक्त शापम् वनम् तत् च तस्मिन् एव तत् आहनि । रमणीयम् विबभ्राज यथा चैत्र रथम् वनम् ॥१-२६-३५॥
translation: Freed from the curse from that day that forest looked charming and shone like Chitraratha Kubera's (garden).

raw: गम्यताम् इति तेन उक्तो जगाम रघु नन्दनः । यथा उद्दिष्टेन मार्गेण वनम् तत् च अवलोकयन् ॥३-११-७३॥
translation: With his permission, Rama, the delight of the Raghu race, proceeded along the path indicated, watching (the beauty of) the forest.

raw: तथा ब्रुवति रामे तु जामदग्न्ये प्रतापवान् । रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् चिक्षेप शरम् उत्तमम् ॥१-७६-२१॥
translation: Thus spoke Parasurama, son of Jamadagni to Rama, the valiant son of Dasaratha who (then) discharged the principal arrow.

raw: ह्लादिनी पावनी चैव नलिनी च तथा एव च । तिस्रः प्राचीम् दिशम् जग्मुः गंगाः शिव जलाः शुभाः ॥१-४३-१२॥
translation: As she (Ganga) was released, she branched out into seven streams. Three streams known as Hladini, Pavani and Nalini having auspicious waters and conferring prosperity flowed eastwards.

raw: सीतां ताभिरनार्याभिर्दृष्ट्वा सन्तर्जितां तदा । राक्षसी त्रिजटा वृद्धा शयाना वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥५-२७-४॥
translation: Then seeing the ignoble shedemons threatening Sita, an old demoness called Trijata, who was lying down there, said:

raw: वाल्मीकिर्भगवान्कर्ता सम्प्राप्तो यज्ञसंविधम् । येनेदं चरितं तुभ्यमशेषं सम्प्रदर्शितम् ॥७-९४-२५॥
translation: The revered Valmiki, the author, has arrived at this sacrificial assembly, and it is by him that this entire story has been revealed to you.

raw: निःसाध्वसम् इदम् प्रोक्तम् धर्मात् अपि विगर्हितम् । अतिक्रम्य तु मत् वाक्यम् दारुणम् रोम हर्षणम् ॥१-६२-१६॥
translation: "(You have) not only trangressed my words but also (you are) censurable according to dharma. You have uttered such audacious and dreadrul words causing the hair to stand on end.

raw: एवम्प्रकारा बहवः समुत्पाता भयावहाः । रावणस्य विनाशाय दारुणाः सम्प्रजज्ञिरे ॥६-१०८-३२॥
translation: In that manner, many frightful and dreadful objects falling indicated destruction of Ravana.

raw: जाम्बवन्तं हरिश्रेष्ठं मैन्दं द्विविदमेव च । एतदस्त्रबलं दिव्यं मम वा त्र्यम्बकस्य वा ॥६-९४-३८॥
translation: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.

raw: सुग्रीवं ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः । तं रामं द्रष्टुमनसः स्वर्गायाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥७-१०८-१८॥
translation: All of them gathered, making Sugriva their leader, with the intention of seeing Rama, who was standing facing towards heaven.

raw: रूप संहननम् लक्ष्मीम् सौकुमार्यम् सुवेषताम् । ददृशुर् विस्मित आकारा रामस्य वन वासिनः ॥३-१-१३॥
translation: Those sages living in the forest were wonderstruck to see the handsome, graceful, delicate and welldressed Rama.

raw: ताम् तु विस्तीर्ण जघनाम् पीन उत्तुंग पयो धराम् । भार्या अर्थे तु तव आनेतुम् उद्यता अहम् वर आननाम् ॥३-३४-२१॥
translation: O mightyarmed one I have been disfigured by cruel Lakshmana as I was attempting to bring that lady of broad thighs, pointed breasts, heavy hips and a beautiful face to make her your wife.

raw: सख्यम् संबन्धकम् चैव तदा तम् प्रत्यपूजयत् । एवम् सुसत्कृतः तेन सहोषित्वा नरर्षभः ॥१-११-१८॥
राजविद्याविनीतश्च ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता । श्रुतवान् शीलसम्पन्नो विनीतश्च परन्तपः ॥५-३५-१३॥
translation: "He is welltrained in statecraft. He is devoted to brahmins. Endowed with an excellent conduct, he is learned in scriptures and a scorcher of enemies.

raw: त्वम् कर्म कृतवान् एतत् काल उपहत चेतनः । जीवित अंतकरम् घोरम् रामात् व्यसनम् आप्नुहि ॥३-४९-२८॥
translation: Time has taken a toll of your senses. This has made you do what you have done. A great calamity is awaiting you in the hands of Rama. It will end your life.

raw: आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर । प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीम् यथा इष्टम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-४०-१८॥
translation: Transform yourself into a wonderful golden deer with silver spots and move about in front of Sita at the hermitage of Rama. After fascinating her, you may go whereever you desire.

raw: पितामहानाम् सर्वेषाम् त्वम् अत्र मनुजाधिप । कुरुष्व सलिलम् राजन् प्रतिज्ञाम् अपवर्जय ॥१-४४-७॥
translation: O Lord of men O King you may offer the waters of Ganga here to all your ancestors and thereby fulfil your vow.

raw: कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम । कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिर्ह्यहम् ॥७-७५-१६॥
translation: "O venerable ascetic, in which birth or species do you exist, O one of firm resolve? I ask you out of curiosity, for I am Rama, the son of Dasharatha."

raw: इदम् चिर गृहीतत्वाद् वसनम् क्लिष्टवत्तरम् । तथा हि नूनम् तद् वर्णम् तथा श्रीमद् यथा इतरत् ॥५-१५-४७॥
translation: "This cloth worn long is crumpled. Even then it has retained its shine and looks fresh.

raw: यानि यान्यत्र योग्यानि श्वो भाविन्यभिषेचने । तानि मे मङ्गलान्यद्य वैदेह्याश्चैव कारय ॥२-४-३७॥
ददौ नाग सहस्रस्य बलम् च अस्याः पितामहः । न तु एव पुत्रम् यक्षाय ददौ च असौ महायशाः ॥१-२५-७॥
translation: The illustrious grandsire Brahma granted her the strength of a thousand elephants, but did not bestow a son on the yaksha.

raw: युद्धप्रमत्तो व्याक्षिप्तो जयाकाङ्क्षी क्षिपञ्छरान् । नावगच्छामि युद्धेषु स्वान्परान्वाप्यहं शुभे ॥७-२४-३३॥
translation: Ravana explained that in the heat of battle, intoxicated and distracted by the desire for victory while showering arrows, he cannot distinguish between his own people and enemies.

raw: सन्निविष्टं गिरौ तस्मिन्राक्षसेन्द्रं निशम्य तु । युद्धे ऽत्यर्थकृतोत्साहं दुरात्मानं समन्त्रिणम् ॥७-१४-४॥
translation: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, was perceived to be settled on that mountain with his ministers, an evil-minded one extremely enthusiastic for battle.

raw: समये सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति स्त्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः । अहं तु नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम ॥५-३-४५॥
प्राणैरपि प्रियं तस्माद्भर्तुः कार्यं विशेषतः । इति मद्वचनाद्रामो वक्तव्यो मम सङ्ग्रहः । निरीक्ष्य मा ऽद्य गच्छ त्वमृतुकालातिवर्तिनीम् ॥७-४८-१८॥
translation: Therefore, the husband's duty is dearer even than life, and thus, Rama should be told this message from me: "Having seen me today, who has passed the time of menstruation (i.e., pregnant), you may go."

raw: स चक्रवाकानि स शैवलानिकाशैः दुकूलैः इव संवृतानि । स पत्र रेखाणि स रोचनानिवधू मुखानि इव नदी मुखानि ॥४-३०-५४॥
translation: 'Crowded with chakravaka birds and green moss, and covered with kasa reeds like silken veils, the river banks appear like the face of the bride decorated with designs of green leaves and gorochana tilaka.

raw: स तु बाहुसहस्रेण बलाद्गृह्य दशाननम् । बबन्ध बलवान्राजा बलिं नारायणो यथा ॥७-३२-६४॥
translation: The powerful King Kārtavīrya Arjuna, using his thousand arms, forcibly seized Daśānana (Rāvaṇa) and bound him, just as Nārāyaṇa (Viṣṇu) had bound Bali.

raw: स बाणजालान्यथ तानि तानि मोघानि पश्यं स्त्रिदशारिराजः । विसिष्मिये लक्ष्मणलाघवेन पुनश्च बाणान्निशितान् मुमोच ॥६-५९-१०१॥
translation: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.

raw: प्रभातायाम् रजन्याम् तु भरद्वाजम् उपागमत् । उवाच नर शार्दूलो मुनिम् ज्वलित तेजसम् ॥२-५४-३६॥
translation: When the night passed into dawn, Rama the best of men approached the resplendent Bharadwaja and said.

raw: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्य वर्णम् महारथम् । सत् अश्वैः शबलैः युक्तम् आचचक्षे अथ दूषणः ॥३-२२-१२॥
translation: While Khara was speaking thus, Dusana reported that a huge chariot of the colour of the Sun yoked with good horses of variegated hues stood ready.

raw: तत् एवम् प्रस्थितस्य अस्य परिज्ञातस्य कर्मभिः । भर्त्रा परिगृहीतस्य ध्रुवः कार्य फलोदयः ॥४-४४-१०॥
translation: 'The king Sugriva knows for sure that if Hanuman goes forth, success is assured. So he favours him.'

raw: अपि सत्य प्रतिज्नेन सार्धम् कुशलिना वयम् । निवृत्ते समये ह्य् अस्मिन् सुखिताः प्रविशेमहि ॥२-८६-२२॥
translation: Can we ever reenter Ayodhya happily after safely fulfilling the vow and completing the term of exile?

raw: उपकारेण वीरो हि प्रतिकारेण युज्यते । अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्त्ववताम् मनः ॥४-२८-६४॥
translation: A hero should in return help whoever has helped him. An ungrateful person hurts the heart of the virtuous by not returning the assistance.'

raw: किम् समर्थम् जनस्य अस्य किम् प्रियम् किम् सुख आवहम् । इति रामेण नगरम् पितृवत् परिपालितम् ॥२-५७-१४॥
translation: Rama looked after his people like a father always thinking what was good for them, dear to them and comfortable to them.

raw: तस्य बुद्धिः इयम् जाता महर्षेः भावितात्मनः । कृत्स्नम् रामायणम् काव्यम् ईदृशैः करवाण्यहम् ॥१-२-४१॥
translation: A thought occurred to Valmiki, who is capable of putting thoughts into action "I shall compose the epic named Ramayana entirely in this metre".

raw: सुग्रीवो विपुल ग्रीवो महाबन्धुः मतः तव । भ्रातृ सौहृदम् आलंब्य न अन्या गति इह अस्ति ते ॥४-१५-२८॥
translation: 'Extend your brotherly affection to broadnecked Sugriva. He is always your great relation. There is no alternative for you other than this at present.

raw: स रोषसंवर्तितताम्रदृष्टिर्दशाननस्तं कपिमन्ववेक्ष्य । अथोपविष्टान् कुलशीलवृद्धान् समादिशत्तं प्रति मन्त्रिमुख्यान् ॥५-४८-६१॥
translation: That tenheaded rakshasa king, rolling his red eyes rapidly in rage and observing the monkey unwinkingly ordered the noble and aged ministers of his clan to interrogate Hanuman.

raw: त तु मायाप्रतिच्छन्नं माययैव विभीषणः । वीक्षमाणो ददर्शाथ भ्रातुः पुत्रमवस्थितम् ॥६-४६-९॥
translation: Vibheeshana started looking with occult powers for his brother's son endowed with occult power following occult means and found Indrajith.

raw: मुमोच यदि रामाय शंसेयुः इति भामिनी । वस्त्रम् उत्सृज्य तन् मध्ये विनिक्षिप्तम् स भूषणम् ॥३-५४-३॥
अहमग्निं विषं तीक्ष्णमपो वा मुनिसत्तम । भक्षयिष्ये प्रवेक्ष्यामि न तु शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम् ॥७-५८-१९॥
translation: O best of sages, I will consume fire or potent poison, or I will enter water, but I will not be able to live.

raw: ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्रं रराज शैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् । गिरेः समीपानुगतं यथैव महन्महाम्भोधरजालमुग्रम् ॥६-६१-४०॥
translation: Then Vanaras taking trees and mountains in their shining hand s marching close to each other seemed like a huge mass of terrible clouds hanging close to a mountain. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सारस आरव संनादैः सारस आरव नादिनी । या आश्रमे रमते बाला सा अद्य मे रमते कथम् ॥४-३०-७॥
translation: 'How will the young lady (Sita) whose voice is like the sarasa bird's, who was revelling, listening to its sweet cackle at the hermitage be living now?

raw: अम्बरीषस्य पुत्रोऽभून्नहुष: पृथिवीपति: । नहुषस्य ययातिस्तु नाभागस्तु ययातिज: ॥१-७०-४२॥
translation: King Nahusha was the son of Ambarisha. To Nahusha was born Yayati whose son was Nabhaga.

raw: वलीमुखं प्रजङ्घं च सन्नादं च महाबलम् । दरीमुखं दधिमुखमिन्द्रजानुं च यूथपम् ॥७-३९-२२॥
translation: This verse lists the names of several prominent monkey chiefs: Valimukha, Prajangha, the mighty Sannada, Darimukha, Dadhimukha, and Indrajānu, who were all leaders of troops.

raw: सर्व सम्पत्तयो राम स्वस्तिमान् गच्च पुत्रक । स्वस्ति ते अस्तु आन्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यः पुनः पुनः ॥२-२५-२२॥
मम अपराधात् गर्भो अयम् सप्तधा शकली कृतः । न अपराधो हि देव ईश तव अत्र बलसूदन ॥१-४७-२॥
translation: "O Indra, Slayer of Balasura, because of my fault this embryo has been made into seven pieces and rendered useless. In this matter you have not committed any fault.

raw: धन्यम् यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् पुत्र्यम् स्वर्ग्यम् अथ अपि च । यः श्रावयति विप्रेषु क्षत्रियेषु इतेरेषु च ॥१-४४-२१॥
translation: He will be blessed with fame, longevity, progeny and (after death) heaven brahmins One who recites this story of Ganga to the kshatriyas and others, the gods and his forefathers would be pleased with him.

raw: न स्मराम्यप्रियम् वाक्यम् लोकस्य प्रियवादिनः । स कथम् त्वत्कृते रामम् वक्ष्यामि प्रियमप्रियम् ॥२-१२-३२॥
translation: How can I, for your sake, speak harsh to my beloved Rama who uses pleasing words to the people of the world, and never an unpleasant word which I can recall?

raw: ततः सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता । रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ॥५-६५-१६॥
translation: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.

raw: दृष्टाः च अहम् पुनः तेन शर चाप असि धारिणा । मद्वधो उद्यत शस्त्रेण विनष्टम् जीवितम् च मे ॥३-४२-२॥
translation: If that warrior Rama carrying bow, arrows and sword sees me once again he will raise his weapon to kill me, and I will cease to be.

raw: आसां राम सपत्नीनां वस्तुं मध्ये न मे क्षमम् । नय मामपि काकुत्स्थ वनं वन्यां मृगीं यथा ॥२-२४-१८॥
translation: O Rama, I am not able to live in the midst of these cowives. O descendant of Kakutstha, if you have resolved to go to the forest as per the wishes of your father take mea wild deeralong with you into the forest.

raw: सो ऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः । निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले ॥६-५९-८९॥
translation: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.

raw: कच्चिदर्थं विनिश्चित्य लघुमूलं महोदयम् । क्षिप्रमारभसे कर्त्तुं न दीर्घयसि राघव ॥२-१००-२०॥
translation: O Bharata, having determined on an endeavour involving a little effort and yielding great results, I trust you commence to execute it quickly without procrastination?

raw: नैवार्थेन न कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया । शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता ॥६-११३-२५॥
translation: "In the world, to change the divine course of action, it is not possible with wealth, or will or by prowess or king's orders."

raw: आयतैः विमलैः नेत्रैः अश्रु वेग परिप्लुतैः । अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्ते व्यक्तम् आर्ततराः स्त्रियः ॥२-५९-१३॥
translation: The women, with their large, bright eyes flooded with gushing tears looked in silence at one another in deep anguish.

raw: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते । सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥७-९३-१॥
translation: While that supremely wonderful sacrifice was thus going on, Valmiki, the foremost among sages, quickly arrived with his disciples.

raw: तस्य राम कथाम् श्रुत्वा मारीचस्य महात्मनः । शुष्कम् समभवत् वक्त्रम् परित्रस्तो बभूव च ॥३-३६-२२॥
translation: At the mention of Rama's name, great Maricha's mouth dried up and he became concerned.

raw: सुग्रीव दोषेण न माम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि किल्बिषात् । कृष्यमाणम् भविष्येण बुद्धि मोहेन माम् बलात् ॥४-२२-३॥
translation: 'O Sugriva you ought not to accuse me of exiling you, and wresting your wife. My mind was deluded by the force of fate that controls one's future.

raw: शठो नैकृतिकः क्षुद्रो मिथ्या प्रश्रित मानसः । कथम् दशरथेन त्वम् जातः पापो महात्मना ॥४-१७-४३॥
translation: 'You are treacherous, dishonest, mean, guised with false humility and a sinner to the core. How were you born to that highsouled Dasaratha?

raw: त्वत्कृते च वयं सर्वे यन्त्रिता धर्मबुद्धयः । त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके । कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥७-९-८॥
translation: For your sake, all of us, though righteous-minded, are troubled, for you, O daughter, are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

raw: इतीव देवी बहुधा विलप्य सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती । प्रवेपमाना परिशुष्कवक्त्रा नगोत्तमं पुष्पितमाससाद ॥५-२८-१७॥
translation: Queen Sita was wailing in many ways, constantly remembering Rama, the soul of all. Shivering, her face pales as she approached the great Simsupa tree in bloom.

raw: ज्योतिष्टोम आयुषी च एवम् अतिरात्रौ विनिर्मितौ । अभिजित् विश्वजित् च एवम् अप्तोर्यामो महाक्रतुः ॥१-१४-४२॥
translation: Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga in Atiratra, Abhijit, Viswajit and Aptoryama ceremonies constituting the great sacrifice were performed in the prescribed manner.

raw: शिखराणि महेन्द्रस्य स्थिराणि च महान्ति च । येषु वेगम् गमिष्यामि महेन्द्र शिखरेषु अहम् ॥४-६७-३७॥
यानैश्च मुख्यैः परिचारकैश्च । सुसम्वृता गच्छतु राजपुत्री । वस्रैश्च सर्वैः सहितैर्विधानै । र्नेयम् वृता ते वरसम्प्रदाने ॥२-३७-३६॥
translation: Equipped with excellent chariots, attendants, garments, and all other needs let the princess (Sita) go. While seeking boons, you did not include Sita.

raw: तासाम् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरिः परम कोपनः । प्रविश्य सर्व गात्राणि बभंज भगवान् प्रभुः ॥१-३२-२३॥
translation: Having heard the words of those maidens, the most powerful and venerable Windgod became furious. He entered all the limbs of their bodies, twisted and distorted them.

raw: ततः त्वाम् शरणार्थम् च शरण्यम् समुपस्थिताः । परिपालय नः राम वध्यमानान् निशाचरैः ॥३-६-१९॥
translation: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.

raw: सुवर्ण कोण अभिहतः प्राणदद् याम दुन्दुभिः । दध्मुः शन्खामः च शतशो वाद्यामः च उच्च अवच स्वरान् ॥२-८१-२॥
translation: The drums of the night watch were beaten by golden sticks. Conches in hundreds were blown and sounds of various modulations were created.

raw: नाग्निस्तृप्यति काष्ठानां तृणानां हरियूथपः । नाग्नेर्नापि विशस्तानां राक्षसानां वसुन्धरा ॥५-५४-२९॥
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम् । स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः ॥४-११-६२॥
translation: 'On hearing the monkeys, Vali went to the sage and begged forgiveness with folded hands.

raw: पादुके त्वभिषिच्याथ नन्द्रिग्रामे ऽवसत्तदा । भरत: शासनं सर्वं पादुकाभ्यां न्यवेदयत् ॥२-११५-२५॥
इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः । सन्दिदेश ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः ॥५-२०-३०॥
एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा । उवाच धर्मसहितं हनुमन्तं यशस्विनी ॥६-११६-३७॥
तेभक्ष्यमाणाहरयोरामंजुग्मुस्तदागतिम् । कुम्भकर्णोभृशंक्रुद्धःकपीन् खादन् प्रधावति ॥६-६७-९८॥
translation: Being devoured by Kumbhakarna, the Vanaras went for refuge to Rama. Enraged Kumbhakarna followed the Vanaras behind.

raw: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च । अवस्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिरागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन ॥६-५९-९७॥
translation: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"

raw: स ब्रह्मकोशं रजतालयं च शक्रालयं रुद्रशरप्रमोक्षम् । हयाननं ब्रह्मशिरश्च दीप्तं ददर्श वैवस्वतकिङ्करांश्च ॥६-७४-६०॥
translation: He saw the seat of Brahma, the abode of Rajathanabha, the abode of Indra, the location from which Rudra discharged an arrow (at Tripura), the abode of Lord Hayagriva, and glowing abode of the deity presiding over Brahmastra and Vyvasvatah's attendants.

raw: तरुण आदित्य वर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु नित्यशः । पर्वतेषु समुद्र अंते पश्चिमस्याम् तु ये दिशि ॥४-३७-३॥
translation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

raw: अध्यर्थ योजने तातः महर्षिः सूर्य संनिभः । तम् क्षिप्रम् अभिगच्छ त्वम् स ते श्रेयो अभिधास्यति ॥३-४-२१॥
translation: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

raw: अपि चास्या विशालाक्ष्या न किञ्चिदुपलक्षये । विरूपमपि चाङ्गेषु सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षण् ॥५-२७-४५॥
translation: "Look at the signs on her body. There is not a little inauspiciousness in the limbs of the largeeyed princess from Mithila.

raw: अदीर्घ दर्शिनम् तम् वा रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् । अन्तिके यदि वा दूरे यदि जानासि शंस नः ॥४-५८-१०॥
translation: 'Tell us about Ravana, king of the demons who is unaware of the consequences. If you know his residence, tell us if it is near or far.'

raw: तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ । तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । दूताञ्छुद्धसमाचारानाहूयात्ममनीषया ॥७-९५-२॥
translation: Having recognized Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons through that song, Rama, by his own intention, called messengers of pure conduct and spoke words in the midst of that assembly.

raw: निषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनः सुतम् । रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा ॥५-५७-३६॥
translation: Then holding the hand of Vali's son he sat down at a beautiful location of the garden of mountain Mahendra.

raw: तौ तु तत्र निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा रावणराघवौ । कृतबुद्धी स्थिरामर्षौ युयुधाते ब्यभीतवत् ॥६-१०९-६॥
translation: Both Ravana and Rama, seeing their portents, firmly resolved in mind with indignation, fought fearlessly.

raw: न शेकुरभिसंरोद्धुं राज्ञः प्रयचिकीर्ष्वः । स सवीपस्थितो राज्ञ्स्तामवस्थामजज्ञीवान् ॥२-१४-४५॥
दण्ड निर्घात वादिन्याः श्रुत्वा भेर्या महा स्वनम् । उवाच सरमा सीताम् इदम् मधुर भाषिणी ॥६-३३-२१॥
translation: On hearing the loud sounds of army maces, rods, and drums, Saarana looked at Sita and spoke these sweet words.

raw: षत्पद तंत्री मधुर अभिधानम्प्लवंगम् उदीरित कण्ठ तालम् । आविष्कृतम् मेघ मृदंग नादैःवनेषु संगीतम् इव प्रवृत्तम् ॥४-२८-३६॥
translation: 'The sweet humming of bees like the music of string instruments (Vina), the croaking of frogs, the rumbling of clouds sounding like the beating of drums make it appear as if a musical concert has started in the forest.

raw: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत् । आवामिह व्यतिक्रान्तौ पूर्ववद्बलिनौ कृतौ ॥६-५०-४२॥
translation: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."

raw: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् रामः संताप मोहितः । अब्रवीत् दुष्कृतम् सौम्य ताम् विना यत् त्वम् आगतः ॥३-५९-२१॥
translation: To Lakshmana thus reporting, Rama, overcome with grief, said,(Even then) O noble brother your coming here, leaving her behind, is a wrong step taken.

raw: सन्धायामित्रदलनं विचकर्ष शरासनम् । सज्यमायम्य दुर्धर्षं कालो लोकक्षये यथा ॥६-९१-७०॥
कस्मान् माम् अपहाय त्वम् गतो गतिमताम् वर । अस्माल् लोकाद् अमुम् लोकम् त्यक्त्वा माम् इह दुह्खिताम् ॥६-३२-२२॥
translation: "O Jewel among those who attained good state! Why have you gone abandoning me dear? To which world have you gone from here? I am pained by your deserting me."

raw: उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् । सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ॥६-५८-४७॥
तं क्रुद्धमभिधावन्तं माणिभद्रो दशाननम् । शक्तिभिस्ताडयामास तिसृभिर्यक्षपुङ्गवः ॥७-१५-१३॥
translation: The foremost among Yakshas, Maṇibhadra, struck that angry Daśānana, who was rushing towards him, with three spears.

raw: तानुवाच ततःसर्वान् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । विषण्णवदनान् दीनांस्त्रस्तान् विद्रवतः पृथक् ॥६-८२-२॥
translation: Thereafter, Maruti's son, Hanuman said to all Vanaras who were looking sad, piteous, feeling singly out of fear, and running away.

raw: युध्यस्व यदि शूरो असि मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ रावण । शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा पूर्वम् खरः तथा ॥३-५०-२३॥
translation: O Ravana, if you are brave, fight with me. In a moment, you will be killed like Khara and lie down on the ground.

raw: प्रसीद इच्चामि ते अरण्ये भवितुम् प्रत्यनन्तरः । प्रीत्या अभिहितम् इच्चामि भव मे पत्यनन्तरः ॥२-५२-५२॥
translation: Be pleased. I wish to stay with you in the forest I long to hear from you these favourable words, 'Stay with me'.

raw: वाच्यावाच्यं प्रकुपितो न विजानाति कर्हिचित् । नाकार्यमस्ति क्रुद्धस्य नावाच्यं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥५-५५-६॥
translation: 'An angry person knows not what he should utter and what he should not. No act appears wrong for an angry man. Nothing is unutterable for him at any time, anywhere.

raw: राक्षसानां सहस्राणि गदापरिघयोधिनाम् । काञ्चनध्वजचित्राणां शूराणां कामरूपिणाम् ॥६-९५-२॥
translation: "Rama who can work without getting tired put an end to thousands of Rakshasa warriors with his sharp glowing arrows decked with gold. Thousands of warriors sent by king Ravana, mounted on chariots, yoked to horses, of the colour of fire, thousands of warriors who could wage with iron bars, decked in gold, mounted on colourful chariots of golden colour pictures and Rakshasas who can change their form at will, were destroyed by Sri Rama."

raw: न विवेश तदा वाली मतंगस्य भयात् तदा । एवम् मया तदा राजन् प्रत्यक्षम् उपलक्षितम् । पृथिवी मण्डलम् सर्वम् गुहाम् अस्मि आगतः ततः ॥४-४६-२४॥
translation: 'O king that way I surveyed the entire earth directly and returned to this cave and lived here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षटचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: शेपुः परम संक्रुद्धाः चण्डालत्वम् गमिष्यसि । इति उक्त्वा ते महात्मानो विविशुः स्वम् स्वम् आश्रमम् ॥१-५७-९॥
प्रसादः क्रियताम् देवि भद्रे राज्ञो विशेषतः । शून्येन खलु सुश्रोणि मया इदम् समुदाहृतम् ॥२-१३-२१॥
नील नाग आभया वेण्या जघनम् गतया एकया । नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥५-१५-२५॥
translation: She (from behind) appeared like the earth covered with a range of trees at the end of rainy season with her single long black braid touching her hips looking like a black serpent. She who deserved to be happy and had not experienced worries was burning in grief. (एकवेणी is a trait of a प्रोषितभर्तृका Sita who was forced to stay in Lanka was a प्रोषितभर्तृका नायिका.)

raw: वृद्धाः च व्याधिताः च एव स्त्री बालाः तथा एव च । अनिशं भुंजमानानां न तृप्तिः उपलभ्यते ॥१-१४-१३॥
translation: The aged, the sick, women and also children ate there and knew no limit to their enjoyment.

raw: कस्य धास्याम्यहं वृत्तं केन वा स्वर्गमाप्नुयाम् । अनया वर्त्तमानो हि वृत्त्या हीनप्रतिज्ञया ॥२-१०९-८॥
translation: How can I advise others for a virtuous conduct or how can I attain heaven if I break the vow which I follow at present.

raw: स ब्राह्मणस्याश्रममभ्युपेत्य महात्मनो देवपुरोहितस्य । ददर्श रम्योटजवृक्षषण्डं महद्वनं विप्रवरस्य रम्यम् ॥२-८९-२२॥
अद्य रामं वधिष्यामि लक्ष्मणं च निशाचराः । शाखामृगं च सुग्रीवं वानरांश्च शरोत्तमैः ॥६-७८-११॥
translation: "Now I shall put an end to Rama and Lakshmana, Sugriva and the Vanaras with the best of arrows."

raw: सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतजिह्वो महर्षभः ॥६-१२०-१९॥
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव । यस्य एतत् आश्रम पदम् शप्तम् कोपान् महात्मना ॥१-४८-१५॥
translation: "O Descendant of the Raghus I shall tell all you about this hermitage cursed by the wrath of a great man.

raw: इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया । मामैक्षत ततः क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव ॥५-५८-१४३॥
translation: 'This I was asked to tell you by the king of vanaras wishing your welfare'. 'Ravana then angrily looked at me as if to burn me.

raw: न निस्सृतं भतत्योष्ठाद्वचनं यावदर्थिनाम् । तावद्वानररक्षोभिर्दत्तमेवाभ्यदृश्यत ॥७-९२-१२॥
translation: Before a word could even emerge from the lips of the supplicants, it was already seen to be given by the monkeys and rakshasas.

raw: एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा प्रायाद्ब्रह्मा सुरैः समम् । देवी सरस्वती चैव राक्षसं तं जहौ पुनः ॥७-१०-४६॥
translation: Having said "So be it" to him, Brahma departed with the gods, and Goddess Saraswati then abandoned that demon.

raw: मनोज्ञ गन्धैः प्रियकैः अनल्पैःपुष्प अति भार अवनत अग्र शाखैः । सुवर्ण गौरैः नयन अभिरामैःउद्योतितान् इव वन अन्तराणि ॥४-३०-३३॥
translation: 'The forests are delightful to the eyes, as if illuminated by a large number of goldencoloured, finesmelling priyaka branches bent under the heavy loads of flowers.

raw: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया । त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम् ॥२-२९-५॥
translation: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.

raw: प्रीतः ते अहम् नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम् । शिरसा धारयिष्यामि शैलराज सुताम् अहम् ॥१-४३-३॥
translation: "O Best of men I am pleased with your devotion. I will hold Ganga on my head, the daughter of the king of mountains (to reduce the force of her descent). I shall do your wish.

raw: इति स बहुविधं महानुभावो जगतिपतेः प्रमदामवेक्षमाणः । मधुरमवितथं जगाद वाक्यं द्रुमविटपान्तरमास्थितो हनूमान् ॥५-३०-४४॥
translation: Highsouled Hanuman seated on the branch of the tree without being seen began to speak faithfully in praise of the lord of the universe in many ways while looking at her. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: दीनया तु गिरा राजा इति होवाच कैकयिम् । अनर्थमिममर्थाभम् केन त्वमुपदर्शिता ॥२-१२-५६॥
translation: The king addressed Kaikeyi in humble words saying, Why did you exhibit this unfortunate act apparently beneficial to you? You are not ashamed of saying this like one whose faculties are possessed by an evil spirit.

raw: जित कामैः च सिद्धैः च चारणैः च उपशोभितम् । आजैः वैखानसैः माषैः वालखिल्यैः मरीचिपैः ॥३-३५-१५॥
पुलर्वसुमहामीनं लोहिताङ्गमहाग्रहम् । ऐरावतमहाद्वीपं स्वातीहंसविलोलितम् ॥५-५७-२॥
translation: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.

raw: न अराजके जन पदे बीज मुष्टिः प्रकीर्यते । न अराकके पितुः पुत्रः भार्या वा वर्तते वशे ॥२-६७-१०॥
translation: Where there is no king, even a handful of seeds will not be sown (will not sprout). In a kingless kingdom, a son or a wife will not obey the father (head of the family).

raw: वत्स्यामि मानुषे लोके पालयन् पृध्वीम् इमाम् । एवम् दत्वा वरम् देवो देवानाम् विष्णुः आत्मवान् ॥१-१५-३०॥
त्वाम् प्राप्य हि पिता मे.द्य सत्यसन्धो महायशाः । तीव्रदुःखाभिसम्तप्तो वृत्तो दशरथो नृपः ॥२-७३-६॥
translation: My father king Dasaratha who is bound to truth and highly renowned, having come under your influence and tormented by intense grief has departed from this world.

raw: देवाश्च राक्षसान्घोरान्महाबलपराक्रमान् । समरे विमलैः शस्त्रैरुपनिन्युर्यमक्षयम् ॥७-२७-३८॥
translation: And the gods, in battle, with their pure weapons, led the dreadful demons of great strength and valor to the abode of Yama.

raw: अथवा वर्तते तत्र वसन्तो यत्र मे प्रिया । किम् करिष्यति सुश्रोणी सा तु निर् भर्त्सिता परैः ॥४-१-४९॥
translation: 'Or, if there is spring where my beloved lives, what can that lady of beautiful hips do, threatened by enemies.

raw: प्रजापतिस्तु तान्याह सत्वानि प्रहसन्निव । आभाष्य वाचा यत्नेन रक्षध्वमिति मानदः ॥७-४-११॥
translation: Prajapati, the giver of honor, addressed those beings as if with a smile and instructed them with effort, "Protect!"

raw: क्षयो ऽस्य दुर्मतेः प्राप्तः सानुगस्य दुरात्मनः । यः प्रदीप्तां हुताशस्य शिखां वै स्प्रष्टुमिच्छति ॥७-८१-५॥
translation: The destruction of this evil-minded and wicked one, along with his followers, is imminent, for he desires to touch a blazing flame of fire.

raw: प्रियमेतदुदाहृत्य मैथिल्यास्त्वं हरीश्वर । प्रतिगृह्य च सन्देशमुपावर्तितुमर्हसि ॥६-११५-२५॥
तवादर्शनशोकेन राघवः प्रविचाल्यते । महता भूमिकम्पने महानिव शिलोच्चयः ॥५-३५-४६॥
translation: "On account of sorrow caused by not being able to see you, Rama of Raghu dynasty is shaken up like a lofty mountain is shaken by earthquake.

raw: तया दत्ताभयास्तत्र न्यवसन्नभयास्तदा ॥७-५१-१३॥
स खातम् पितृभिः मार्गम् अन्तर् भौमम् महात्मभिः । प्रापद्यत नरश्रेष्ठ तेन राज्ञा अभिचोदितः ॥१-४१-६॥
translation: O Best among men directed by the king (Sagara), Anshuman followed the path taken by his noble uncles into the depths of the earth.

raw: पम्पा तीर रुहाः च इमे संसक्ता मधु गन्धिनः । मालती मल्लिका पद्म करवीराः च पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-७६॥
translation: 'Very closely grown on the banks of Pampa, stand malati, mallika and karavira trees with their clusters of fragrant blossoms.

raw: यथा त्वां न प्रजानाति गच्छन्तं युद्धकाङ्क्षिणम् । लवणस्तु मधोः पुत्रस्तथा गच्छेरशङ्कितम् ॥७-६४-८॥
translation: You should go without suspicion, so that Lavana, the son of Madhu, does not recognize you as one going and desiring battle.

raw: रामः प्रेक्ष्य तु तम् गृध्रम् भुवि रौद्रेण पातितम् । सौमित्रिम् मित्र संपन्नम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६८-१॥
translation: Seeing the vulture lying on the ground thrown down by the fierce demon, Rama said to friendly Lakshmana:

raw: कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि पदन्यासं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । त्वां द्रष्टुमुपयातो ऽहं समाश्रित्य पराक्रमम् ॥५-३४-४०॥
translation: "Setting my foot with my valour on the head of the cruelminded Ravana, using my valour, I came here to see you.

raw: गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यम् किमनेनासनेन मे । विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयम् मामुपस्थितः ॥२-२०-२८॥
translation: I am setting forth to Dandaka forest. What is this seat for? A time has come for me when I am fit for a seat of kusa grass.

raw: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथावृत्तमनिन्दिते । अभिभाषस्व मां देवि दूतो दाशरथेरहम् ॥५-३५-७२॥
translation: "O sinless lady I have given you a faithful account. I am a messenger of Dasaratha's son. And you may speak now, O divine lady

raw: बभूव इन्द्रोपमम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काम मोहिता । सुमुखम् दुर्मुखी रामम् वृत्त मध्यम् महोदरी ॥३-१७-९॥
निविष्टायां तु सेनायामुत्सुको भरतस्तदा । जगाम भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं शत्रुध्नमनुदर्शयन् ॥२-९९-१॥
translation: Eager to see his brother, Bharata encamped the army and set out showing the hermitage to Satrughna.

raw: ततः प्रियम् वाक्यम् उपेत्य राक्षसामहाअर्थम् अष्टौ अभिवाद्य रावणम् । विहाय लंकाम् सहिताः प्रतस्थिरेयतो जनस्थानम् अलक्ष्य दर्शनाः ॥३-५४-२९॥
translation: The eight demons were glad to hear the pleasing and meaningful words of Ravana. They offered him salutations and left Lanka in the direction of Janasthana without being seen by any one.

raw: प्रतिच्छन्नाः च दृश्याः च गृह्णन्ति सुबहून् मृगान् । प्रधावितान् वा वित्रस्तान् विस्रब्धान् अतिविष्ठितान् ॥४-१८-३८॥
सवै न शक्नोमि पितुः प्रतिज्ञा । मिमामकर्तुम् सकलम् यथावत् । स ह्यवयोस्तत गुरुर्नियोगे । देवाश्च भर्ता स गतिस्स धर्मः ॥२-२१-५९॥
translation: It is impossible for me not to execute the promise completely, O my dear, he (Dasaratha) is our preceptor and, therefore, fit to command us. Even for mother Kausalya, he is her husband, her refuge and her dharma.

raw: क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तो ऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये । प्रजाः संहरते रौद्रो लोकत्रयभयावहः ॥७-२२-४१॥
translation: This terrible staff, when released by an angry one, destroys creatures without distinction between dear and not dear, causing fear to all three worlds.

raw: निहतं सारथिं दृष्ट्वा समरे रावणात्मजः । प्रजहौ समरोद्धर्षं विषण्णः स बभूव ह ॥६-९०-४७॥
translation: Seeing the charioteer killed, Ravana's son was despondent and lost enthusiasm to fight (said people).

raw: मुक्ताभिः च प्रवालैः च रूप्य चामी करैर् अपि । विभूषिताम् मणि स्तम्भैः सुबहु स्तम्भ भूषिताम् ॥५-९-२४॥
translation: It was decorated with pillars of silver and gold inlaid with pearls and corals and gems.

raw: प्रणम्य शिरसा शैलम् तम् विमार्गथ वानराः । तम् अतिक्रम्य दुर्धर्षम् सूर्यवान् नाम पर्वतः ॥४-४१-३१॥
translation: 'O monkeys bowing down to that mountain, proceed in search of Sita. O unassailable vanaras, beyond this mountain is another called Suryavan. It is at a distance of fourteen yojanas and it is difficult to cover that distance.

raw: तत्र सीते मया सार्धम् विहरस्व यथा सुखम् । वदनम् पद्म संकाशम् विमलम् चारु दर्शनम् ॥३-५५-३१॥
एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ । राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्द्धसु ॥६-६०-१२॥
translation: "Knowing all this, make effort doing what ought to be done and let the Rakshasas strive to succeed positioned on top of the gates."

raw: ततो विषण्णं समवेक्ष्य सैन्यं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः । उवाच शाखामृगराजवीरानाश्वासयन्नप्रतिमैर्वचोभिः ॥६-७४-२॥
translation: Thereafter, foremost among the wise, Vibheeshana observing the despondency of the monkey leaders spoke to them reassuring in incomparable words.

raw: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणाम् सम्जज्ञे निःस्वनो महान् । तुमुलः शङ्खशब्दश्च सभाम् गच्चति रवणे ॥६-११-९॥
translation: Then as Ravana entered the assembly thousands of band instruments sounded aloud. Conchs broke forth producing tumultuous noise.

raw: विनतम् क्वचित् उद्धूतम् क्वचित् याति शनैः शनैः । सलिलेन एव सलिलम् क्वचित् अभ्याहतम् पुनः ॥१-४३-२४॥
राघवस्य प्रमत्तस्य रक्षसा कामरूपिणा । रावणेन प्रमथ्याहमानीता क्रोशती बलात् ॥५-२६-३॥
translation: When Rama was engaged (in deer hunt) and I was screaming, I was brought forcibly by Ravana who can assume any form at his will.

raw: एवं प्रचोदितो राजा कैकेय्या निर्विशङ्कया । नाशकत्पाशमुन्मोक्तुं बलिरिन्द्रकृतं यथा ॥२-१४-११॥
translation: In this way urged by Kaikeyi without fear or hesitation, he (Dasaratha), like Bali unable to release himself from the noose cast by Indra (through Vamana), could not get out of the noose of promise.

raw: असंमूढस्य गृध्रस्य रामम् प्रति अनुभाषतः । आस्यात् सुस्राव रुधिरम् म्रियमाणस्य स अमिषम् ॥३-६८-१५॥
translation: As he(Jatayu) was speaking to Rama with an alert mind even while dying, blood mixed with flesh started oozing from Jatayu's mouth.

raw: ते हया मथिता भग्ना व्यसवो धरणीं गताः । ते निहत्य हयांस्तस्य प्रमथ्य च महारथम् ॥६-९०-५२॥
translation: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.

raw: खरम् तु विरथम् रामो गदा पाणिम् अवस्थितम् । मृदु पूर्वम् महातेजाः परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-२९-१॥
translation: Effulgent Rama looked at Khara who stood with a mace in hand minus his chariot and said to him first in a gentle voice and then harshly :

raw: प्रसुप्तः तु मम भ्राता नर्दितो भैरव स्वनम् । श्रुत्वा न ममृषे वाली निष्पपात जवात् तदा ॥४-९-६॥
translation: ' My brother Vali, who was asleep could not tolerate the frightful sound and jumped out of bed hastily.

raw: न च दर्शयते मन्दस् तदा रामस्य सागरः । प्रयतेन अपि रामेण यथा अर्हम् अभिपूजितः ॥६-२१-१२॥
translation: Though Rama remained selfrestrained and respected the ocean well according to propriety, the ocean was dull and did not show its real form.

raw: ते राज वचनात् गत्वा राजवेश्म प्रवेशिताः । ददृशुः देव संकाशम् वृद्धम् दशरथम् नृपम् ॥१-६८-२॥
translation: Having heard their words, the doorkeepers informed the descendant of Raghu (king Dasaratha). Thereafter, with the the king's permission, the messengers entered the royal palace and beheld the aged king Dasaratha who shone like a god.

raw: अपवाह्य स दुष्टात्मा भरतं तव बन्धुषु । काल्यं स्थापयिता रामं राज्ये निहतकण्टके ॥२-७-२६॥
translation: That evilminded one, having sent Bharata away to your relations house, is going to install Rama unhindered in the kingdom at dawn tomorrow.

raw: शराणां धनुषश्चाहमनृणो ऽस्मि महामृधे । ससैन्यं भरतं हत्वा भविष्यामि न संशय: ॥२-९६-३१॥
translation: Having slain Bharata and his army in this great forest, I shall doubtless discharge my debt to my arrows and bow. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षण्णवतितमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninetysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सुग्रीवेण एवम् उक्ते तु हनुमान् हरि पुंगवः । उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानर मंत्रिणाम् ॥४-३२-९॥
translation: When Sugriva spoke thus, Hanuman the great monkey, submitted in the presnce of the monkeyministers, applying his own logic:

raw: यदा तु शास्त्राण्यध्येतुं शक्तिरस्य भविष्यति । तदास्य शास्त्रं दास्यामि येन वाग्ग्मी भविष्यति ॥७-३६-१४॥
translation: And when he gains the ability to study scriptures, I will then impart knowledge to him by which he will become eloquent.

raw: शक्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानांसध्वजानांपताकिनाम् तुरगाणांसहस्रैश्चमुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः । पदातीनांसहस्रैश्चवीराःपरिवृताययुः ॥६-१३०-१३॥
translation: Chiefs on horses, champions in thousands went surrounded by thousands of foot soldiers carrying javelins, spears, and nooses.

raw: भार्यया च महाभाग सीतया अनुगतो वशी । दिन क्षये महातेजाः प्रभ एव दिवाकरः ॥४-४-११॥
translation: 'This glorious Rama was followed by his wife, Sita, like the rays of the effulgent Sun follow him to the end of the day.

raw: सदानृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितु: । अनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गं दशरथो गत: ॥२-११२-६॥
translation: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.

raw: इयम् कुसुम सन्घातैः उपस्तीर्णा सुखा कृता । स्वयम् निपतितैः भूमिः शयन प्रस्तरैः इव ॥४-१-८९॥
translation: 'With countless flowers fallen on their own from trees and scattered like a bed of flowers on stone the ground is rendered comfortable enough to relax on.

raw: स राज्ये स्थापितः तेन सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः । राजा वानर मुख्यानाम् तेन प्रस्थापिता वयम् ॥४-५७-१४॥
अस्याम् महिष्याम् तु भृशम् रुदत्याम् पुरे अति विक्रोशति दुःख तप्ते । हते नृपे संशयिते अंगदे च न राम राज्ये रमते मनो मे ॥४-२४-५॥
translation: 'O Rama when the queen (Tara) is weeping, plunged in deep sorrow, the entire city is lamenting in agony, my elder brother is dead and the survival of Angada is uncertain, my mind no longer longs for the enjoyment of the kingdom.

raw: अपक्रान्तेष्वमात्येषु प्रहस्ते वै निपातिते । रावणो ऽभ्यद्रवत्तूर्णमर्जुनं नृपसत्तमम् ॥७-३२-४९॥
translation: After his ministers had retreated and Prahasta was killed, Ravana quickly rushed towards Kartavirya Arjuna, the best among kings.

raw: इत्येवमुच्यमानासासशब्दंप्ररुरोद ह स्नापयन्तीतदास्रेणस्तनौवक्रंसुनिर्मलम् ॥६-११४-९०॥
translation: While Mandodari was being counselled by the co wives like this, she was weeping, shedding tears on her breast as well as bathing her face. She once again wept making a loud sound.

raw: समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते निर्भयो विगतज्वरः । फलमूलाशनो वीर निवसेह यथासुखम् ॥७-८९-१४॥
translation: Be comforted, may good fortune be with you; O hero, reside here fearlessly and free from anxiety, subsisting on fruits and roots as comfortably as you wish.

raw: ततः दश अहे अतिगते कृत शौचो नृप आत्मजः । द्वादशे अहनि सम्प्राप्ते श्राद्ध कर्माणि अकारयत् ॥२-७७-१॥
translation: Having observed the tenday mourning period, Bharata purified himself on the twelfth day and got the shraddha rites (obsequies) performed.

raw: सुप्रभाता निशा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते । उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ भद्रम् ते गमनाय अभिरोचय ॥१-३५-२॥
translation: "Rama, the night makes way for the dawn. It is time for morning rituals. Arise, arise May the day bring good news Get ready for the onward journey".

raw: स निगृह्य तु तम् बाष्पम् प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे । विनिःश्वस्य च तेजस्वी राघवम् पुनरूचिवान् ॥४-८-३१॥
translation: Effulgent Sugriva controlled his tears, wiped his bright eyes, took deep breath and said to Rama:

raw: द्रुमाणां च शिलानां च शस्त्राणां चापि निस्वनः । श्रूयते सुमहांस्तत्र घोरो हृदयभेदनः ॥६-५३-२१॥
translation: There, a very loud fearful noise was heard which pierced the hearts in the battlefield, that was produced by the striking of weapons with trees and rocks.

raw: चक्षुर्भ्याम् त्वाम् न पश्यामि कौसल्ये साधु माम्स्फृश । इत्युक्त्वा स रुदम्स्त्रस्तो भार्यामाह च भूमिपः ॥२-६४-६२॥
translation: O Kausalya, I cannot see you with my eyes. Touch me gently, said the frightened Dasaratha, Lord of the earth, to his wife weeping.

raw: ऋषयः तत्र बहवो विहृत्य शरदाम् शतम् । तपसा दिवम् आरूधाः कपाल शिरसा सह ॥२-५४-३१॥
translation: On the Chitrakuta mountain many ascetics wandered about (lived) for hundreds of years carrying on penance. In the process they became so much emaciated that they looked as if they were left (only) with the skulls on their heads. (In the end) they ascended heaven.

raw: अथ पवन समान विक्रमाःप्लवग वराः प्रतिलब्ध पौरुषाः । अभिजित् अभिमुखाम् दिशम् ययुःजनक सुता परिमार्गण उन्मुखाः ॥४-६३-१५॥
translation: The monkeys as strong as the wind regained courage and went in search of the daughter of Janaka in the direction of Abhijit (constellation known as Abhijit is associated with success). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अर्कमण्डलसङ्काशंदिव्यंदृष्टवारथंस्थितम् । आरुरोहमहाबाहूरामःपरपुरंञ्जयः ॥६-१३१-२०॥
translation: Seeing the wonderful chariot like the radiance of the planet sun, mighty armed Rama the conqueror of hostile enemies ascended.

raw: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः । वायसे त्वं कृथाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर ॥५-६७-११॥
translation: 'O longarmed, wise and revered Rama, then in anguish you took a cruel decision'.

raw: आनुपूर्व्यानिषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोहिता: । तत: सेनापति: पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च निषेदतु: ॥२-९१-३९॥
translation: First the ministers and priests took their respective seats in accordance with their rank, and then the army chief and finally the supervisor of the camp.

raw: अरुन्धन् मिथिलाम् सर्वे वीर्य संदेहम् आगताः । आत्मानम् अवधूतम् ते विज्ञाय मुनिपुंगव ॥१-६६-२१॥
मूलमर्थस्य संरक्ष्यमेष कार्यविदां नयः । मूले सति हि सिद्ध्यन्ति गुणा फलो पुष्पोदयाः ॥४-६५-२५॥
translation: 'The root of any objective should be protected well. This is the basis of an accomplisher. Only when the roots are intact, the trees have the ability to yield flowers and fruits.

raw: स तेन हरिसैन्येन सन्निकर्षं महायशाः । शीघ्रमागम्य रामाय दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-८३-७॥
translation: Hanuman of great fame accompanied by army quickly came to Rama and submitted as follows.

raw: स शरौघानवसृजन् स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः । जघान कपिशार्दूलान् स बहून् दृष्टविक्रमः ॥६-८२-१८॥
translation: Indrajith of unyielding valour, combining with his own army let go numerous arrows on the tigers of Vanaras and struck them.

raw: प्राणिनो मोचितास्तेन दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा । सुखमापुर्मुहूर्तं ते ह्यतर्कितमचिन्तितम् ॥७-२१-२३॥
translation: The beings released by that Rakshasa Dashagriva indeed attained unexpected and unthought-of happiness for a moment.

raw: देवान्तको वापि नरान्तको वा । तथातिकायोऽतिरथो महात्मा । अकम्पननश्चाद्रिसमानसारः । स्थातुम् न शक्ता युधि राघवस्य ॥६-१४-१६॥
translation: "Either by Devanthaka or Naranthaka, in the same way the great soul Athiratha or Akampana, who is of mountainlike size, will not be able to stand against Raghava in war."

raw: न मातुर् न पितुस् तत्र स्मरिष्यामि न वेश्मनः । आर्तवानि उपभुन्जाना पुष्पाणि च फलानि च ॥२-३०-१६॥
translation: Enjoying the seasonal flowers and fruits in the forest, I will not remember my mother or father or home.

raw: करेणु मातन्ग रथ अश्व सम्कुलम् । महा जन ओघैः परिपूर्ण चत्वरम् । पभूतरत्नम् बहुपण्यसम्चयम् । ददर्श रामो विमलम् महापथम् ॥२-१६-४७॥
लाघवाद्राघवः श्रीमान् शिरः कायादपाहरत् ॥६-९०-४२॥
translation: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

raw: स भीमकार्मुकधरः कालमेघसमप्रभः । रक्तास्यनयनः क्रुद्धो बभौ मृत्युरिवान्तकः ॥६-८६-१६॥
translation: Indrajith, armed with a terrific bow and arrows, his body shining like a rainy cloud, with red eyes, angry face, seemed like the spirit of death.

raw: यं मुहूर्तमपश्यंस्तु न जीवेयमहं ध्रुवम् । तेन रामेण कैकेयि शपे ते वचनक्रियाम् ॥२-११-७॥
translation: O Kaikeyi, in the name of Rama without seeing whom I, for sure, cannot live a momment, I swear I will fulfil your desire.

raw: जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतम् प्रभुर् एव च । भवत्या मम चैव अद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः । भरतः च अपि धर्मात्मा सर्व भूत प्रियम् वदः ॥२-२४-२०॥
स तु ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु मन्त्रिभिः संविचार्य च । ततस्तु रावणः पूर्वदिवसे राक्षसाधिपः । पुरीं परिययौ लङ्कां सर्वान् गुल्मानवेक्षितुम् ॥६-५७-२॥
translation: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, reflected for a while and deliberated with his ministers and proceeded in the forenoon to inspect all posts in Lanka.

raw: श्रुत्वा नियोगं ब्रह्मर्षेः सा ऽरजा भार्गवी तदा । तथेति पितरं प्राह भार्गवं भृशदुःखिता । इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो वासमन्यत्र समकारयत् ॥७-८१-१६॥
translation: Greatly distressed, Araja, the daughter of Bhargava, then said "So be it" to her father, the Brahmarshi, after hearing his command; having said this, Bhargava then arranged for his dwelling elsewhere.

raw: एका कथंचित् मुक्ता अहम् परिभूय महात्मना । स्त्री वधम् शंकमानेन रामेण विदितात्मना ॥३-३४-१२॥
translation: Sages have been assured safety. Peace has been restored to Dandaka forest. As Rama, the great soul, who knows the self, hesitated to kill a woman, I was alone saved after this humiliation.

raw: मांस हेतोः अपि मृगान् विहारार्थम् च धन्विनः । घ्नन्ति लक्ष्मण राजानो मृगयायाम् महावने ॥३-४३-३१॥
translation: O Lakshmana kings who wield bows in hunting expeditions kill deer in the forest for sport as well as for venison.

raw: जुगोप भ्रातरम् भ्राता रथम् आस्थाय पृष्ठतः । ततः हल हला शब्दः तुमुलः समजायत ॥२-१६-३३॥
श्रुत्वा सगर्वितम् वाक्यम् संभ्रान्ता जनकात्मजा । सीता प्रावेपिता उद्वेगात् प्रवाते कदली यथा ॥३-२-१५॥
सम्पीड्य च धनुर् घोरम् कम्पयित्वा शरैर् जगत् । मुमोच विशिखान् उग्रान् वज्राणि इव शत क्रतुः ॥६-२१-२६॥
translation: Bending the terrific bow, he released frightful arrows like Indra (who released thunderbolts) who performed a hundred sacrifices.

raw: प्रविष्टायां तु सीतायां भूतलं सत्यसम्पदा । तस्यावसाने यज्ञस्य रामः परमदुर्मनाः ॥७-९९-३॥
translation: And when Sita entered the earth by the power of her truth, at the conclusion of that sacrifice, Rama became extremely distressed.

raw: तां तथा दर्शयित्वा तु मैथिलीं गिरिनिम्नगाम् । निषसाद गिरिप्रस्थे सीतां मांसेन छन्दयन् ॥२-९६-१॥
translation: Rama showed Sita, the princess of Mithila the river Mandakini flowing in the mountain, gratified her by offering meat (to eat) and sat on the mountain slope.

raw: यदि ते गमने बुद्धिः कृता पितुर् अपेक्षया । ताम् तथा रुदतीम् रामः रुदन् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२४-१९॥
लोकेषु सर्वेषु न नास्ति किंचित्यत् ते न नित्यम् विदितम् भवेत् तत् । शंसस्व वयोः कुल शालिनीम् ताम्मृता हृता वा पथि वर्तते वा ॥३-६३-१७॥
translation: O Windgod, there is nothing that you know not in all the worlds. Do tell me if that lady of a noble race has been abducted or dead or is on the way.

raw: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः । अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतिता ऽसि मे ॥७-२६-४६॥
translation: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"

raw: तस्य बाण अंतरात् रक्तम् बहु सुस्राव फेनिलम् । गिरेः प्रस्रवणस्य इव धाराणाम् च परिस्रवः ॥३-३०-२१॥
translation: With his body pierced with arrows his blood started flowing like the waterfalls flow from mount Prasravana.

raw: ह्रस्वाम् दीर्घाम् च कुब्जाम् विकटाम् वामनां तथा । करालाम् भुग्नवक्त्राम् च पिङ्गाक्षीम् विकृताननाम् ॥५-१७-८॥
translation: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.

raw: अद्य अंगदो वीर वरो न जीवेत् जीवेत माता परि पालनार्थम् । विना तु पुत्रम् परिताप दीना सा नैव जीवेत् इत् निश्चितम् मे ॥४-२४-२१॥
translation: If the mighty Angada were to live, his mother would live on to care for him; but it is my firm conviction that, bereft of her son, the grief-stricken Tara would not survive.

raw: शिखरम् तु त्रिकूटस्य प्रांशु च एकम् दिवि स्पृशम् । समन्तात् पुष्प संचन्नम् महा रजत सम्निभम् ॥६-३९-१८॥
translation: Trikuta peak was fully covered with flowers, sparkled with gold, spread over a hundred yojanas, beautiful to look at, splendid and smooth. It is difficult even for birds to reach, for sages even in thought and difficult to access by any physical action. It is praiseworthy as if touching the sky alone.

raw: प्रतिपानह्रदान् पूर्णान् खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् । अवगाह्य सुतीर्थांश्च ह्रदान् सोत्पलपुष्करान् ॥२-९१-७७॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.

raw: बलि षड् भागम् उद्धृत्य नृपस्य अरक्षतः प्रजाः । अधर्मः यो अस्य सो अस्य अस्तु यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२५॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire unrighteousness in the same way as a king who, having received one sixth of the income as tax from people does not protect them

raw: इति ब्रुवाणा सरमा राक्षसी सीतया सह । सर्व उद्योगेन सैन्यानाम् शब्दम् शुश्राव भैरवम् ॥६-३३-२०॥
translation: While Saarana was speaking to Sita, frightening sounds of the army making all kinds of attempts were heard.

raw: साम दानम् क्षमा धर्मः सत्यम् धृति पराक्रमौ । पार्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपि अपकारिषु ॥४-१७-२९॥
translation: 'Conciliation, generosity, forbearance, righteousness, truthfulness, steadfastness in valour and punishing offenders are the hallmarks of rulers.

raw: सद्यो अहम् त्वत् प्रतीक्षो अस्मि वेद्याम् अस्याम् प्रतिषितः । अविघ्नम् कुरुताम् राजा किम् अर्थम् हि विलम्ब्यते ॥१-७३-१६॥
translation: Ready at the altar, I have been awaiting you, O King Without hindrance proceed Why delay?".

raw: अथान्तर्गृहमासाद्य राजा दशरथस्तदा । सूतमामन्त्रयामास रामं पुनरिहानय ॥२-४-३॥
translation: Therafter king Dasaratha on retiring to his private apartment, ordered Sumantra to bring Rama once again.

raw: माम् च पञ्चत्वमापन्नम् रामम् च वनमाश्रितम् । वैदेही बत मे प्राणान् शोचन्ती क्षपयिष्यति ॥२-१२-७३॥
ततस्तां निहतां दृष्ट्वा पत्नीं भृगुकुलोद्वहः । शशाप सहसा क्रुद्धो विष्णुं रिपुकुलार्दनम् ॥७-५१-१५॥
translation: Then, the enraged upholder of the Bhrigu lineage, having suddenly seen his wife slain, cursed Vishnu, the destroyer of the family of enemies.

raw: ततस्तेनैव सहसा सीदन्ति स्म पदातयः । मुसलानि विचित्राणि ततो भल्लशतानि च ॥७-२३-४४॥
translation: Then, by him alone, the foot-soldiers suddenly began to collapse under the impact of various maces and hundreds of spears.

raw: माया विदः च शूराम् च वायु वेग समान् जवे । नयज्ञान् बुद्धि संपन्नान् विष्णु तुल्य पराक्रमान् ॥१-१७-३॥
translation: Incarnate as monkeys in the womb of chiefs of apsarasas and gandharvas. Create sons who have the knowledge of deceitful tricks, who are brave, who match wind in speed, who are endowed with intellect and statecraft, who are determined, who are knowledgeable in various means of achieving victory, who are supernatural bodies, who possess capability of employing and resisting weapons, who resemble those who subsist on amrita (immortals) and are equal (to Visnu) in prowess.

raw: नैनाम् पश्यामि तीर्थेषु क्रोशतो न शृणोति मे । कम् नु सा देशम् आपन्ना वैदेही क्लेश नाशिनी ॥३-६४-४॥
अवध्यो वध्यतां को वा को वा वध्यो विमुच्यताम् । दरिद्रः को भवेदाढ्यो द्रव्यवान्वाप्यकिञ्चनः ॥२-१०-३३॥
translation: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).

raw: स मुहूर्तम् समाश्वस्य रुदन्न् एव महा यशाः । कौसल्याम् परिसान्त्व्य इदम् गुहम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-८७-१२॥
translation: Highly renowned Bharata, composing himself for a moment and still weeping, reassured Kauslaya, and then said this to Guha:

raw: एहीदानीं कृतं विद्धि सुकृतं तन्न संशयः । आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति ॥७-२५-१५॥
