translation: Come now, know that what is done is well done, there is no doubt about it; come, O gentle one, let us go to our own abode.

raw: जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम् । अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात् सागरोपमम् । भर्तारं ससमुद्रायाधरण्या वासवोपमम् ॥५-३८-४२॥
translation: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

raw: न वाति पवनः शीतः न शशी सौम्य दर्शनः । न सूर्यः तपते लोकम् सर्वम् पर्याकुलम् जगत् ॥२-४१-१८॥
translation: The breeze did not blow cool. No more did the Moon look pleasant. The Sun did not give warmth to the world. All the world was agitated.

raw: तस्माद्भवन्तः पश्यन्तु पतितं शोकसागरे । नहि पश्याम्यहं भूतं किञ्चिद्दुःखमतो ऽधिकम् ॥७-४५-१५॥
translation: Therefore, you should see me fallen into an ocean of sorrow, for I indeed do not see any existing sorrow greater than this.

raw: स भूमौ न्यस्त सर्वांगः तप्त कांचन भूषणः । अपतत् देव राजस्य मुक्त रश्मिर् इव ध्वजः ॥४-१७-२॥
translation: Adorned with shining gold ornaments,Vali fell down with all his limbs touching the ground like Indra's flag when its ropes are loosened.

raw: सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् । अवध्यो ऽहं प्रजाध्यक्ष देवतानां च शाश्वत ॥७-१०-१९॥
translation: Ravana declares to Brahma that he is invulnerable to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, Rakshasas, and gods.

raw: मसार गल्वर्क मुखः शंख मुक्ता निभ उदरः । कस्य नाम अनिरूप्यः असौ न मनो लोभयेत् मृगः ॥३-४३-२९॥
translation: His face is a drinking pot of emerald, the belly is a conch or a pearl. Whose mind will not be attracted by this indescribable beauty ?

raw: एष पुष्पवहो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो हिमावहः । ताम् विचिन्तयतः कान्ताम् पावक प्रतिमो मम ॥४-१-५३॥
translation: 'This cool breeze that carries the fragrance of flowers, that is gentle in its touch feels like fire when I think about my beautiful beloved.

raw: तस्यासौ दण्डविषयो विन्ध्यशैवलयोर्नृप । शप्तो ब्रह्मर्षिणा तेन वैधर्म्ये सहिते कृते ॥७-८१-१८॥
translation: O king, this region of Daṇḍa, situated between the Vindhya and Śaivala mountains, was cursed by that Brahmarṣi when unrighteousness was committed there.

raw: अस्माभिः उपभुक्तानि बुभुक्षा परिपीडितैः । यत् त्वया रक्षिताः सर्वे म्रियमाणा बुभुक्षया ॥४-५२-१७॥
तथैव मत्ता मदिरोत्कटा नरास्तथैव दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिता: । तथैव दिव्या विविधा: स्रगुत्तमा: पृथक् प्रकीर्णा मनुजै: प्रमर्दिता: ॥२-९१-८३॥
न त्वाम् प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणी मुख्याः च भूषिताः । अनुव्रजितुम् इच्चन्ति पौर जापपदाः तथा ॥२-२६-१४॥
translation: How is it that welladorned ministers, citizens from towns and villages, heads of guilds and others do not follow you?

raw: संनिकर्षे तु नः शूर जयम् शत्रोः पराजयम् । सुप्रभम् च प्रसन्नम् च तव वक्त्रम् हि लक्ष्यते ॥३-२४-८॥
translation: A mass destruction of life is going to take place. There is no doubt about it. O brave Lakshmana my right shoulder trembles again and again, indicating the defeat of the enemy. Your beaming visage presages victory.

raw: अर्चयिष्यति माल्यैः च रत्नैः च त्वाम् विशेषतः । इमाम् गिरि गुहाम् रम्याम् अभिगन्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि ॥४-२६-७॥
पर्वत आरोहणम् च अपि सागर्स्य अपि लङ्घनम् । समुद्र वचनात् च एव मैनाकस्य च दर्शनम् ॥१-३-२७॥
translation: (He described) the climbing of Mahendra mountain (by Hanuman), crossing the sea emergence of Mainaka hill at the command of the lord of ocean.

raw: सः अयम् रोष परीताक्षो द्वारि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान् । वानरान् वानरपते चक्षुसा निर्दहन इव ॥४-३१-४९॥
translation: 'O lord of monkeys Valiant Lakshmana is standing at the entrance,eyes filled with anger as if he would burn the vanaras'.

raw: न हि चक्षुः पथम् प्राप्य तयोः पार्थिव पुत्रयोः । स सैन्यो अपि समर्थः त्वम् मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम् ॥३-५३-११॥
translation: If you come within sight of these two princes, it will not be possible for you to live for a moment even if you are with your entire army.

raw: दशवर्षसहस्रं तु निराहारो दशाननः । पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शिरश्चाग्नौ जुहाव सः ॥७-१०-१०॥
translation: Dashanana (Ravana) fasted for ten thousand years, and upon the completion of each thousand years, he offered one of his heads into the fire as an oblation.

raw: शरैश्च विददारैनं शूरः परपुरञ्जयः ्च्छितः । स ददर्श ततः क्रुद्धः परिघं पतितं भुवि तः । आविध्य तु स तं दीप्तं परिघं तस्य दर्शयन् । परिघाग्रेण वेगेन जघानास्य हयोत्तमान् ॥६-९८-१६॥
तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं बद्धं कपिवरोत्तमम् । राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ॥५-४८-५५॥
translation: The ogres presented the best of monkeys, Hanuman looking like an elephant in rut to Ravana, the demon king.

raw: तरुणैश्चारुवेषैश्च नरैरुन्नतगामिभि: । सम्पतद्भिरयोध्यायां नाभिभान्ति महापथा: ॥२-११४-२९॥
translation: The highways of Ayodhya thronged with groups of elegantly attired young men or adults with their majestic gait, do not shine.

raw: हा राम सत्यव्रत दीर्घबाहो हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्र । रा जीवलोकस्य हितः प्रियश्च वध्यां न मां वेत्सि हि राक्षसानाम् ॥५-२८-११॥
translation: "Alas, O long-armed one unfailing in vows, whose face shines like the full moon. Alas, beloved of all the worlds! you are dear to every one. How is it that you are not aware that I am going to be killed by the demons?

raw: अनुजो रावणस्याहं तेन चाप्यवमानितः । भवन्तं सर्वभूतानां शरण्यं शरणागतः ४ ॥६-१९-४॥
translation: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."

raw: अभिवाद्य च तत् भूतम् अद्भुतम् प्रिय दर्शनम् । मुदा परमया युक्तः चकार अभिप्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-१६-२२॥
translation: Overwhelmed with great joy, he, walked around that wonderful being of pleasant countenance again and again and saluated him respectfully.

raw: तां तर्ज्यमानां सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण जानकीम् । देवगन्धर्वकन्यास्ता विषेदुर्विपुलेक्षणाः ॥५-२०-१०॥
सौमित्रे भुङ्क्ष्व भोगां स्त्वमिष्टान् राज्यफलानि च । जीवितं च हि राज्यं च त्वदर्थमभिकामये ॥२-४-४४॥
विवर्धयति पक्षम् च सुराणाम् सुर भावनः । विषयेषु प्रसक्तेन यत् किम्चित् कारिणा त्वया ॥६-३५-१७॥
मितं व्यक्ताक्षरपदं तमुवाचाथ दुन्दुभिम् । हरीणामीश्वरो वाली सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् ॥४-११-२९॥
translation: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:

raw: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्को ऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ । मामतीत्य हि यं च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ॥७-२६-२५॥
translation: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?

raw: तावत् ऊर्ध्वम् अधः च त्वम् मत् लोकेषु निवत्स्यसि । इति उक्त्वा भगवान् ब्रह्मा तत्र एव अन्तरधीयत । ततः स शिष्यो भगवान् मुनिः विस्मयम् आययौ ॥१-२-३८॥
तेषाम् धर्मैकरक्षाणाम् कुलचारित्रयोगिनाम् । अत्र चारित्रशौण्डीर्यम् त्वाम् प्राप्य विनिवर्ततम् ॥२-७३-२३॥
translation: As for the Ikshvaku kings, righteousness is their sole protection. They follow the ancestral traditions befitting the noble race. This tradition has been topsyturvied by admitting you into the family.

raw: वसिष्ऺठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिश्च दृढव्रत: । अग्रत: प्रययु: सर्वे मन्त्रिणो मन्त्रपूजिता: ॥२-११३-२॥
translation: Vasishta, Vamadeva, Jabali of rigorous penance and all the ministers honoured for their counsel proceeded ahead.

raw: शिरसि प्रहरन् वीरस्तदा वायुसुतो बली । नादेनाकम्पयच्चैव राक्षसान् स महाकपिः ॥६-७०-२५॥
translation: When the heroic and strong son of the wind god hit on the head of Devanthaka, the Rakshasas trembled by the sound of the great monkey 's blow.

raw: अहत्वा ताम् च दुर्धर्षान् राक्षसान् काम रूपिणः । न शक्यो रावणो हंतुम् येन सा मैथिली हृता ॥४-३५-१६॥
translation: 'It is not possible to kill Ravana who has stolen Sita without killing those unassailable demons who can assume any form at their will.

raw: आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिश्रृणोमि ते ॥५-५८-२७॥
translation: "I told her that it is proper for her (living in the domain of Rama) to help his queen and wife. Or else, I promised after I disclose to Rama, Sita's whereabouts, I will come and enter her mouth.

raw: जीवितम् सुखम् अर्थाम् च धर्म हेतोः परित्यजन् । ह्रियमाणाम् अधर्मेण माम् राघव न पश्यसि ॥३-४९-२५॥
translation: O Rama, you have given up your life, pleasure and treasure for the sake of righteousness. Do you not see me carried off by an unrighteous fellow ?

raw: पितामहस्य भवनम् गच्चन्तीम् पुञ्जिकस्थलाम् । चञ्चूर्यमाणामद्राक्षमाकाशेऽग्निशिखामिव ॥६-१३-११॥
translation: "While I was going in the sky to the abode of Grandfather Brahma, I saw a celebrated one called Punjikasthala flying concealing herself, glowing like the flame of the fire."

raw: अग्रतस् तस्य सैन्यस्य श्रीमान् रामः सलक्ष्मणः । जगाम धन्वी धर्म आत्मा सुग्रीवेण समन्वितः ॥६-२२-८२॥
translation: Accompanied by Lakshmana and joined together with Sugriva, glorious and righteous Rama walked in front of the army.

raw: इत्युक्तास्ते सुराः सर्वे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । यथावासं ययुर्हृष्टाः प्रशंसन्तो जनार्दनम् ॥७-६-२१॥
translation: Thus addressed by the all-powerful Vishnu, all the gods, delighted, returned to their respective abodes, praising Janardana.

raw: मम प्रिय अर्थम् राज्ञः च सरथः त्वम् पुरीम् व्रज । सम्दिष्टः च असि या अनर्थाम्स् ताम्स् तान् ब्रूयाः तथा तथा ॥२-५२-६४॥
translation: Sumantra, return to the city with the chariot for my pleasure and also for the pleasure of the king and convey to each of the persons concerned the message exactly as instructed.

raw: कुशस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा चत्वारो लोक सत्तमाः । निवेशम् चक्रिरे सर्वे पुराणाम् नृ वराः तदा ॥१-३२-५॥
translation: "O my sons, govern with righteousness so that you will acquire immense merit'. Hearing the words of the rishi, the four sons who were the best among men and revered in the world constructed four cities as their abodes.

raw: कच्चिदाशास्ति देवानां प्रसादं पार्थिवात्मजः । कच्चित् पुरुषकारं च दैवं च प्रतिपद्यते ॥५-३६-१९॥
translation: "Does the prince ever seek the blessings of gods or fall back upon personal effort as well as providence?

raw: लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिर्निहतो रणे । अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः ॥६-१२६-७॥
द्विजाति वेषेण हि तम् दृष्ट्वा रावणम् आगतम् । सर्वैः अतिथि सत्कारैः पूजयामास मैथिली ॥३-४६-३३॥
translation: Seeing Ravana, a villain in the guise of a brahmin praising her, Sita, the princess of Videha, honoured him with all hospitality.

raw: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकुर्वन् दुर्हृद: साधु निर्द्दहन् । सुहृदस्तर्पयन् कामैस्त्वमेवात्रानुशाधि माम् ॥२-१०६-२८॥
translation: Discharging completely the three debts, to gods, to ancestors and to sages, subduing your enemies and gratifying your friends, you alone (have the right) to dictate me.

raw: स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलंतुप्रांशुशैलोपमंमहत् केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् । कान्तंविहारेष्वधिकंदीप्तांसङ्ग्रामभूमिषु भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः । तदेवाद्यशरीरंतेतीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम् पुनर्दुर्लभसम्पर्शंपरिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते । श्वाविधःशलकैर्यद्वद्भाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसुभृशंसञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् । क्षितौनिपतितंराजन् श्यामंवैरुधिरच्छवि वज्रप्रहाराभिहतोविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ॥६-११४-४२॥
translation: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

raw: ते वध्यमाना हरयो नाराचैर्भीमविक्रमाः । सौमित्रिं शरणं प्राप्ताः प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः ॥६-९१-१६॥
translation: (The Vanaras), though endowed with prowess and of terrific courage, struck by the Rakshasa, they sought refuge of Lakshmana, their Lord, just as people seek the refuge of their Lord, the creator.

raw: भरतेनापि सन्दिष्टा सम्मर्दो न भवेदिऺति । समन्तात्तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासमकल्पयत् ॥२-९७-२९॥
translation: Let not the hermitage be crowded commanded Bharata, and the army encamped around the mountain.

raw: उवाच एनम् स्मितम् कृत्वा रुद्रम् शूलधरम् हरिः । दैवतैः मध्यमानो तु तत् पूर्वम् समुपस्थितम् ॥१-४५-२३॥
translation: Hari, smiling said to the tridentbearing Rudra "O Chief of celestial beings you were born the earliest among the devatas. Therefore, while churning the ocean whichever is produced first shall be offered to you. Considering it the first offering, O Lord accept this venom."

raw: ततो गिरि तटे जाताम् उत्पाट्य कुसुमायुताम् । लक्ष्मणो गज पुष्पीम् ताम् तस्य कण्ठे व्यसर्जयत् ॥४-१२-४०॥
translation: Then Lakshmana went to the mountain slope, plucked the (creeper with) gajapuspi blossoms and fastened it on the neck of Sugriva.

raw: निर्यास रस मूलानाम् चंदनानाम् सहस्रशः । वनानि पश्यन् सौम्यानि घ्राण तृप्ति कराणि च ॥३-३५-२१॥
translation: He saw thousands of tree trunks with finesmelling resins and sandalwood trees.

raw: तथैव आयुध जातानि भ्रातृभ्याम् कवचानि च । रथ उपस्थे प्रतिन्यस्य सचर्म कठिनम् च तत् ॥२-४०-१४॥
इत्युक्ता सा समुत्थाप्य प्रसुप्तं तं निशाचरम् । अब्रवीत्सम्प्रहृष्टेव राक्षसी सा पतिं वचः ॥७-२५-४६॥
translation: Thus addressed, she, the female demon, awakened her sleeping husband, the night-wanderer, and spoke words to him as if greatly delighted.

raw: अथवास्वयमप्येषमोक्षंप्राप्स्यतिपार्थिव । गृहीतोऽयंयदिभवेत्रिदशैस्सासुरोरगैः ॥६-६७-७७॥
translation: 'Or else this Sugriva alone can get liberated by fighting by himself with gods, demons and Nagas also, even if he is captured'.

raw: तत् शूलम् वज्र संकाशम् गगने ज्वलन उपमम् । द्वाभ्याम् शराभ्याम् चिच्छेद रामः शस्त्रभृताम् वरः ॥३-३-१८॥
translation: With two arrows, Rama, the best among wielders of weapons, broke down the spike in the sky burning like fire, and resembling the thunderbolt of Indra.

raw: शृणोति य इदंकाव्यंपुरावाल्मीकिनाकृतम् । श्रद्धधानोजितक्रोधोदुर्गाण्यतितरत्यसौ ॥६-१३१-११३॥
translation: He who listens with devotion, this epic composed by sage Valmiki in the past, will conquer anger and overcome difficulties.

raw: ये चापि सचिवाः स्तस्य संश्रिता मामकं वनम् न च तैरिह वस्तव्यं श्रुत्वा यान्तु यथासुखम् ॥४-११-५५॥
translation: 'Indeed his counsellors who are here must leave this forest. Let them depart safely.

raw: श्रत्वा तद्वचनं क्रूरमात्मापहरणोपमम् । वैदेही शोकसन्तप्ता हुताशनमुपागमत् ॥५-५३-२६॥
translation: Distressed on hearing the news which was as cruel as her own abduction Sita started burning with grief and invoked the firegod.

raw: नखैः शुष्कमुखीभिश्च दारणैर्लङ्घनैर्हतैः । निपात्य हन्तुमिच्छामि तव विप्रियकारिणीः ॥६-११६-३५॥
translation: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

raw: तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः । लोकान्सान्तानिकान्नाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः ॥७-११०-१८॥
translation: Having heard those words of Vishnu, Lord Brahma, the preceptor of the worlds, declared that all these assembled beings would go to the worlds named Santanika.

raw: नर वानर राजौ तौ स च वायु सुतः कपिः । जाम्बवान् ऋक्ष राजसः च राक्षससः च विभीषणः ॥६-३७-१॥
translation: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.

raw: कोपम् कथम् नाम गुण प्रकृष्टःकुमार कुर्यात् अपकृष्ट सत्त्वे । कः त्वत् विधः कोप वशम् हि गच्छेसत्त्व अवरुद्धः तपसः प्रसूतिः ॥४-३३-५२॥
translation: 'O prince how can you, richly endowed with virtues be angry with an inferior person? How can a person like you, preeminent in virtues,and a source of great penance fall a victim to anger?

raw: सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेएशु च । ध्वजाः समुच्छ्रिताश्चित्राः पताकाश्चाभवंस्तदा ॥२-६-१३॥
translation: Banners of varying colours and flags were raised on the temples looking resplendent like peaks wreathed by a mass of white clouds, at the crossroads, on the thoroughfares, on the trees standing on avenues, on the towers and stalls of the merchants abounding in various kinds of merchandise, on prosperous and graceful houses of householders, in all public halls and on trees looking tall from a distance.

raw: ग्रहणे चापि रक्षोभिर्महान् मे गुणदर्शनः । राक्षसेन्द्रेण संवादस्तस्मादगृह्णन्तु मां परे ॥५-४८-४५॥
translation: 'If I am caught by the demon I will have the opportunity to see the demon lord. Therefore, let me be caught by my enemies'.

raw: एषो अस्त्रान् विविधान् वेत्ति त्रैलोक्ये स चराचरे । न एनम् अन्यः पुमान् वेत्ति न च वेत्स्यन्ति केचन ॥१-२१-११॥
translation: This Viswamitra knows the use of various kinds of weapons which no one knows among the animate and the inanimate in the three worlds. Nor will any one even know in future.

raw: सप्तरात्रं च काकुत्स्थो राघवस्य यथाज्ञया । उष्य तत्र महेष्वासो गमनायोपचक्रमे ॥७-७२-१९॥
translation: And the great archer Shatrughna, having stayed there for seven nights as per Rama's command, began preparations for his departure.

raw: सा त्वया धर्षिता शक्र कामार्तेन समन्युना । दृष्टस्त्वं च तदा तेन ह्याश्रमे परमर्षिणा ॥७-३०-३१॥
translation: O Shakra, she was violated by you, who were afflicted by lust and anger, and you were then indeed seen in the hermitage by the great sage.

raw: भद्रे हृदयमप्येतदन्नुमृश्योद्धरस्व मे । एतत्समीक्ष्य कैकेयि ब्रूहि यत्साधु मन्यसे ॥२-११-९॥
translation: O gentle lady my heart is sinking. Touch my heart and deliver me from distress. O Kaikeyi considering all this, tell me what you think is good.

raw: कालो गृहाणि सर्वेषाम् काले काले अन्ववेक्षते । एतान्य् अन्यानि दुष्टानि निमित्तान्य् उत्पतन्ति च ॥६-३५-३५॥
translation: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.

raw: प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम् । दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला ॥६-११६-४०॥
translation: "Mighty Armed Hanuman! Do not speak in this manner. It was my fate which was supreme. Because of my predetermined circumstances I reaped such a result. I am feeblehearted and condone the maids surely."

raw: पितुर्निदेशेन तु धर्मवत्सलो । वन प्रवेशे कृत बुद्धि निश्चयः । स राघवः प्रेक्ष्य सुमन्त्रम् अब्रवीन् । निवेदयस्व आगमनम् नृपाय मे ॥२-३३-३१॥
translation: Rama, lover of righteousness, determined to go to the forest in obedience to his father's command said to Sumantra, Inform the king of my arrival. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तावुभौ वेगसम्पन्नौ रणकर्मविशारदौ । सर्वभूतमनोग्राहि चक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम् ॥५-४८-३३॥
translation: Both the warriors endowed with speed and skill in warfare carried on the fight which captivated the minds of all creatures.

raw: निहतस्य अस्य सत्त्वस्य जांबूनदमय त्वचि । शष्प बृस्याम् विनीतायाम् इच्छामि अहम् उपासितुम् ॥३-४३-२०॥
translation: If this animal is killed and its golden skin is spread on a tender grass cushion, there will I like to sit.

raw: ततः सकपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः । सीतामुवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं वक्यविशारदः ॥५-३८-१॥
translation: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:

raw: विधास्ये येन गन्तासि विषहिष्ये ह्यहम् तथा । न ग्राहा विधमिष्यन्ति यावत्सेना तरिष्यति ॥६-२२-२८॥
translation: "O Rama I shall arrange a base in such a mode, by means of which the entire army of Vanaras can cross over the passage and I will also be seizing the poisonous animals and not be aggressive."

raw: अशोभनम् यो अहम् इह अद्य राघवम् । दिदृक्षमाणो न लभे सलक्ष्मणम्इति इव राजा विलपन् महा यहाशःपपात तूर्णम् शयने स मूर्चितः ॥२-५९-३३॥
translation: Though I wish I cannot see Rama together with Lakshmana. Indeed this is very unfortunate. Lamenting thus, king Dasaratha of great reknown fell on the bed, unconscious.

raw: अपि देवाः शयिष्यन्ते क्रुद्धे मयि महीतले । यमं च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम् । आदित्यं पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रं महीतले ॥६-६३-५२॥
translation: "I shall quell Lord Yama also, devour fire god, make the Sun including stars fall on earth."

raw: एतावत् जीव लोकस्य भास्करो रजनी क्षये । कृत्वा वितिमिरम् सर्वम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-५०॥
translation: 'The world of living beings is extended to this extent. The Sun dispels darkness at the end of the night and thereafter reaches the mountain behind which he sets (at the end of the day).

raw: क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम् । स्फुरन्ती रावणस्य अन्के पन्नगेन्द्र वधूः यथा ॥४-६-१०॥
translation: 'Yes, I remember. I had observed a lady being carried away by a wicked demon. She was crying loudly 'Oh, Rama Oh Rama Oh Lakshmana' in a husky voice. It was Maithili. She was wriggling on the lap of Ravana like a female serpent.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा वदनान्मुक्तं चन्द्रं राहुमुखादिव । अब्रवीत्सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण वानरम् ॥५-१-१७०॥
translation: Seeing Hanuman released out of her mouth like the Moon released from the mouth of Rahu, Surasa assumed her true form and said:

raw: शतयोजनविस्तीर्णः सागरो मकरालयः । विक्रमश्लाघनीयेन क्रमता गोष्पदीकृतः ॥५-३६-८॥
translation: "You with your admirable prowess have reduced this ocean which is an abode of crocodiles stretching over a hundred yojanas to a cow's hoof mark.

raw: स दीनो दीनया वाचा लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । शीघ्रम् लक्ष्मण जानीहि गत्वा गोदावरीम् नदीम् ॥३-६४-१॥
translation: Rama in dejection said these pitiable words to Lakshmana,O Lakashmana, go swiftly to the river Godavari and find out if Sita has gone there to get lotuses.

raw: इतीव सर्वा रजनीचरस्त्रियः परस्परं सम्परिरभ्य बाहुभिः । विषेदुरार्ता भयभारपीडिता विनेदुरुच्चैश्च तदा सुदारुणम् ॥६-९५-४०॥
तेषु च अपरिहार्येषु न एवम् भवितुम् अर्हति । सुमन्त्रः च अपि शत्रुघ्नम् उत्थाप्य अभिप्रसाद्य च ॥२-७७-२४॥
माम् अपि एवम् विशालाक्षी जानकी जात संभ्रमा । मदनेन अभिवर्तेत यदि न अपहृता भवेत् ॥४-१-४३॥
translation: 'Had the largeeyed Janaki not been stolen, she would have also paid advances to me in this manner with all her love and excitement.

raw: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं च न श्रुतं प्रपितामह । देवानां भयसम्मोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ॥७-६९-२३॥
translation: They declared to Brahma that such fear and bewilderment among the gods, concerning the destruction of the worlds, had never been seen or heard of before.

raw: स त्वम् पुरुष शार्दूल समानय सुसत्कृतम् । स्वयम् एव महाराज गत्वा स बल वाहनः ॥१-११-१२॥
translation: "Greatest among men, O king, along with vehicles and retinue, you may go and bring him (Rsyasringa) personally with due respect".

raw: द्रुमांश्च विपुलस्कन्धान् गृह्य वानरपुङ्गवाः । तद्युद्धमभवद् घोरं रक्षोवानरसङ्कुलम् ॥६-६९-४८॥
translation: Vanara leaders seizing huge branches of trees fought a frightening war with Rakshasas.

raw: जनस्थानवधं बुद्ध्वा बुद्ध्वा वालिवधं तथा । रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च बुद्ध्यस्व हितमात्मनः ॥५-५१-३०॥
translation: "You know about the killing of all ogres at Janasthana and of Vali also. You know about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. You may decide on a proper course of action for the sake of your own welfare.

raw: क्व च ते क्षत्रिय बलम् क्व च ब्रह्म बलम् महत् । पश्य ब्रह्म बलम् दिव्यम् मम क्षत्रिय पांसन ॥१-५६-४॥
translation: O mean kshatriya where does your energy of a kshatriya stand in comparison with the great energy of Brahma? Behold my Brahmabala (Brahman's energy)".

raw: बालो हि अकृत विद्यः च न च वेत्ति बलाबलम् । न च अस्त्र बल संयुक्तो न च युद्ध विशारदः ॥१-२०-७॥
translation: Rama is still a child, he is not learned in the science of warfare,he does not know the strength and weakness of enemies. He has not acquired as yet the strength of using weapons and is not proficient in warfare. You know certainly those rakshasas are deceitful in battle. And hence he is not qualified to oppose them in the battle succesfully.

raw: परिमृश्य च पाणिभ्यामभिसंत्रस्तचेतनः । कामी कमलपत्राक्षीमुवाच वनितामिदम् ॥२-१०-२७॥
translation: With a mind extremely terrified yet passionate, he caressed his lotuseyed wife with his hands, and said:

raw: द्वन्द्वे यस्य न तिष्ठन्ति दैवतान्य् अपि सम्युगे । स कस्माद् रावणो युद्धे भयम् आहारयिष्यति ॥६-३६-१०॥
translation: As even gods will not with stand Ravana in war, of whom Ravana will be afraid of in a duel.

raw: अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः पितामहमुवाच ह । एषां लोकं जनौघानां दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत ॥७-११०-१६॥
translation: Then, the greatly effulgent Vishnu addressed Brahma, the one of good vows, saying, "You ought to grant an abode to these multitudes of people."

raw: अद्य ते सुमहान् कालः शयानस्य महाबल । सुखितस्त्वं न जानीषे मम रामकृतं भयम् ॥६-६२-१३॥
translation: "Oh! Kumbhakarna of extraordinary prowess! You were asleep for long happily. You do not know that I am afraid of Rama."

raw: तौ हन्यमानौ नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतौ । हेमपुङ्खान्नरव्याघ्रौ तिग्मान् मुमुचतुः शरान् ॥६-८०-२९॥
translation: The tigers among humans, Rama, and Lakshmana, like two mountains hit by steel arrows, released sharp pointedgold shafted steel arrows and tormented (Indrajith).

raw: भगवन्प्राणिनां नित्यं नान्यत्र मरणाद्भयम् । नास्ति मृत्युसमः शत्रुरमरत्वमहं वृणे ॥७-१०-१६॥
translation: Ravana addressed Brahma, stating that living beings constantly fear nothing but death, for there is no enemy equal to death, and therefore he desired immortality.

raw: प्राज्ञलिर्भरतोभूत्वाप्रसृष्टोराघवोन्मुखः स्वागतेनयथार्हेणततोराममपूजयत् ॥६-१३०-३४॥
translation: Highly rejoiced, Bharata offered salutations standing as he ought to within himself and worshiped Sri Rama from a distance.

raw: सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी । भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा ॥२-२६-३७॥
translation: O auspicious one live here by being obedient to king Bharata. Absorbed in righteousness, follow truth and (religious) vows.

raw: कच्चित् ते नियमाः प्राप्ताः कच्चित् ते मनसः सुखम् । कच्चित् ते गुरु शुश्रूषा सफला चारु भाषिणि ॥३-७४-९॥
translation: O Sweettongued Sabari, have you achieved selfcontrol? Has your mind attained peace ? Have your services to the preceptor yielded results?

raw: तां श्रुत्वा करुणां वाचं पितुर्मरणसंहिताम् । राघवो भरतेनोक्तां बभूव गतचेतन: ॥२-१०२-१॥
translation: Having heard the words of Bharata regarding the death of his father, Rama became unconscious.

raw: आत्मा हि दाराः सर्वेषाम् दारसम्ग्रहवर्तिनाम् । आत्मेयमिति रामस्य पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम् ॥२-३७-२४॥
translation: For every householder, his wife is the soul. Since Sita is the soul of Rama, she can rule this earth.

raw: तव इष्टा ननु चैव इमा भार्याः चन्द्र निभ आननाः । इदानीम् न ईक्षसे कस्मात् सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम् ॥४-२५-४५॥
translation: 'O lord of monkeys these moonfaced wives were indeed once your favourites. Why don't you look at them? Why don't you look Sugriva?

raw: आतिथ्यम् कर्तुम् इच्छामि बलस्य अस्य महाबल । तव च एव अप्रमेयस्य यथा अर्हम् संप्रतीच्छ मे ॥१-५२-१३॥
translation: O Highy powerful Viswamitra I wish to offer appropriate hospitality to you and to your incomparable army. Be pleased to accept it.

raw: बहवो दुर्लभाः च एव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः । मुने वक्ष्ष्यामि अहम् बुद्ध्वा तैः उक्तः श्रूयताम् नरः ॥१-१-७॥
translation: "O sage rare indeed are men endowed with the many qualities you have described. I ascertained one. Listen carefully.

raw: तस्य धर्मात्मनो देवि वनवासम् यशस्विनः । कथम् रोचयसे भीरु नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च ॥२-१२-२२॥
translation: O lady how do you wish this righteous and illustrious Rama to dwell in the forest for fourteen years?

raw: धिगस्तु मम वीर्येण यस्त्वं जीवसि रावण । सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे । ततस्त्वां मामिका मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ॥६-५९-६६॥
translation: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."

raw: राक्षसानामधिपतिर्दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैः परमर्मातिभेदिभिः । शरैरादीपयामास नीलं हरिचमूपतिम् ॥६-५९-७०॥
translation: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

raw: संनियच्छति मे क्रोधं त्वयि कामः समुत्थितः । द्रवतो मार्गमासाद्य हयानिव सुसारथिः ॥५-२०-३॥
पश्य लक्ष्मण पुष्पाणि निष्फलानि भवन्ति मे । पुष्प भार समृद्धानाम् वनानाम् शिशिरात्यये ॥४-१-४४॥
translation: Look, Lakshmana—at winter's end the flowers of the forest, laden with blossoms, are of no use to me.

raw: वानराणां विनाशो ऽयं रक्षसां च महाहवे । तव चैव महाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः ॥६-११३-२४॥
translation: "O mighty armed Ravana! For Vanaras, Rakshasas and you too, this destruction in this war has come by divine grace."

raw: विभीषणं च भरतःसान्त्ववाक्यमथाब्रवीत् दिष्ट्यात्वयासहायेनकृतंकर्मसुदुष्करम् ॥६-१३०-४६॥
translation: And then Bharata spoke this good word. "Luckily with your help, the very difficult task was done."

raw: सशेषभाग्यता ऽस्माकं यदि वीर भविष्यति । मोहमेतौ प्रहास्येते महात्मानौ महाबलौ ॥६-४६-३३॥
आश्रमं त्वृषिविरहितं प्रभु: क्षणमपि न विजहौ स राघव: । राघवं हि सततमनुगतास्तापसाश्चार्षचरितधृतगुणा: ॥२-११६-२६॥
translation: Lord Rama, did not leave that hermitage deserted by the sages even for a moment. Those who had adopted the traditions of the sages and had acquired many virtues followed Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षोडशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredsixteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: स्निग्धो धर्मरतो वीरस्सततम् सत्पथे स्थितः । प्रियः प्राणसमो वशो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे ॥२-३१-१०॥
translation: You are affectionate, you are devoted to dharma. You are valiant. You always walk the path of virtue. You are dear to me like my own life. You are not only an obedient brother but also a friend.

raw: ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्य । स्तथा परास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः । सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः । क्रुद्धाः पराश्चपि विनिःश्वसन्त्यः ॥५-५-१३॥
translation: He even saw women collected there, their limbs smeared with unguents on their bodies, like wise women with beautiful countenances laughing at others, some sleeping, and others hissing (sighing) like angry serpents.

raw: एतौ वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् वालि प्रणिहितौ ध्रुवम् । छद्मना चीर वसनौ प्रचरन्तौ इह आगतौ ॥४-२-६॥
translation: Surely these two, clad in bark garments and wandering here in disguise into this difficult forest, have come sent by Vali.

raw: ततोऽहं मानयामि त्वां मान्यो हि मम मारुतः । त्वया मे ह्येष संबन्धः कपिमुख्य महागुणः ॥५-१-१२८॥
translation: "O esteemed vanara the Windgod is revered by me and so I honour you. O chief of monkeys, my bondage with you is therefore of high value to me, indeed.

raw: ते पतन्ति जले नित्यम् सूर्यस्य उदयनम् प्रति । अभितप्ताः च सूर्येण लंबन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः ॥४-४०-४२॥
शूलैस्त्रिशूलैः कुलिशैः पट्टिशासिपरश्वधैः । अन्योन्यं बिभिदुः क्रुद्धा राक्षसा दानवास्तथा ॥७-२३-८॥
translation: The enraged Rakshasas and Danavas fiercely pierced each other with spears, tridents, thunderbolts, sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes.

raw: शक्राशनिसमस्पर्शैर्लक्ष्मणेनाहतः शरैः । मुहूर्तमभवन्मूढः सर्वसङ्क्षुभितेन्द्रियः ॥६-८९-६॥
translation: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt like arrows of Lakshmana, all sense organs of Indrajith remained excited for a short while.

raw: ऋषयश्चमहान्तोऽपिगन्धर्वाश्चयशस्विनः । ननुनामतवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्चदिशोगताः ॥६-११४-४॥
translation: "For fear of you, even great seers, illustrious Gandharvas, Charanas also went in all directions, is well known."

raw: विस्मय व्यग्र मनसो बभूवुः वानरर्षभाः । संजात परिशंकाः ते तत् बिलम् प्लवग उत्तमाः ॥४-५०-११॥
पप्रच्छ मुनिशार्दूलम् कौतूहल समन्वितः । भगवन् कः नु अयम् देशः समृद्ध वन शोभितः ॥१-३१-२३॥
विश्वामित्रम् पूजयन् ततः संध्या प्रवर्तते । ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतः ताटका वध तोषितः ॥१-२६-३२॥
ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते क्रूरकर्मा स राक्षसः । आगच्छद्बहुसाहस्रं प्राणिनां भारमुद्वहन् ॥७-६८-४॥
translation: Then, as midday arrived, that cruel demon came, carrying the burden of many thousands of living beings.

raw: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते । यज्ञं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा शक्रो ऽभ्यपूजयत् ॥७-८६-१९॥
translation: And when the thousand-eyed Indra was re-established, the entire world became peaceful, and then Indra worshipped the wondrous sacrifice.

raw: अभार्याः सह भार्याः च सन्ति अत्र वन चारिणः । लुब्धेभ्यो विप्रलब्धेयः तेभ्यो नः सुमहद् भयम् ॥४-१९-१६॥
translation: 'There are monkeys wandering in the forest (sent away by Vali). Some of them have made others' wives their own and some have been separated from their wives. They are a great cause of fear.'

raw: रक्षसा तेन रोषाच्च भुजानां पीडनात्तदा । मुक्तो विरावः सहसा त्रैलोक्यं येन कम्पितम् ॥७-१६-२९॥
translation: Then, from the anger and the crushing of his arms, that demon suddenly let out a roar by which the three worlds were shaken.

raw: यस्य देवाः स गंधर्वाः पिशाच पतग उरगाः । विद्रवन्ति भयात् भीता मृत्योः इव सदा प्रजाः ॥३-४८-३॥
translation: Just as people get scared of death, all (creatures) including gandharvas, gods, evil spirits, birds and snakes run away from me.

raw: ततः योध अन्गनाः सर्वा भर्तृऋन् सर्वान् गृहे गृहे । यात्रा गमनम् आज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः ॥२-८२-२५॥
translation: Then, the wives of the soldiers having come to know of the expedition were all delighted and in every household hastened up their husbands.

raw: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य रामस्य तथा अभूतस्य धीमतः । त्रि पुरम् जग्नुषः पूर्वम् रुद्रस्य इव बभौ तनुः ॥३-६४-७३॥
सिंह शार्दूल जुष्टाः च गुहाः च परितः तथा । विषमेषु नग इन्द्रस्य महा प्रस्रवणेषु च ॥४-५०-२॥
translation: They also searched near rivers, mountain streams, hill ranges, caves of lions and tigers, in the rock shelters and difficult spots of vast mountains.

raw: तत् शीघ्रम् जवना दूता गच्चन्तु त्वरितैः हयैः । आनेतुम् भ्रातरौ वीरौ किम् समीक्षामहे वयम् ॥२-६८-३॥
translation: Bharata on whom the kingdom has been conferred is living comfortably in his maternal uncle's house. Let swift messengers go quickly on speeding horses and bring back the valiant brothers, Bharata and Satrughna. What is there to deliberate for us in this matter?

raw: आदित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते नियमादूर्द्ध्वबाहव: । एते परे विशालाक्षि मुनय: संशितव्रता: ॥२-९५-७॥
translation: O largeeyed Sita, some other ascetics of rigid austerities worship the sungod according to tradition, lifting up their arms and invoking the Sun.

raw: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः । यैस्तौ सत्पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलौ ॥६-५०-३७॥
translation: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.

raw: दिदृक्षमाणौ वैदेहीम् तत् वनम् तौ विचिक्यतुः । तत्र तत्र अवतिष्ठन्तौ सीता हरण दुःखितौ ॥३-६९-७॥
translation: Tormented due to abduction of Sita, the two princes anxious to see her searched all over the dense forest stopping here and there on the way. The thick forest looked like a conglomeration of big clouds. It was filled with different kinds of birds, snakes and animals.

raw: ददर्श पतितम् भूमौ क्षतज आर्द्रम् जटायुषम् । तम् दृष्ट्वा गिरि शृंग आभम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६७-१०॥
अस्मात् हंसा जल क्लिन्नाः पक्षैः सलिल रेणुभिः । कुरराः सारसाः चैव निष्पतन्ति पतत्रिणः ॥४-५२-१२॥
translation: 'Drenched in water the swans, kuraras, and sarasas were seen emerging with water dripping from thier wings.

raw: पर्वत प्रभवा नद्यः सुभीम बहु निष्कुटाः । मार्गितव्या दरीमन्तः पर्वताः च वनानि च ॥४-४०-३५॥
प्रहस्तो अथ विरूप अक्षो वज्र दम्ष्ट्रो महाबलः । धूम्र अक्षः च अतिकायः च दुर्मुखः चैव राक्षसः ॥६-९-३॥
translation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञो दीनस्य नारदः । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमृषीणां सन्निधौ नृपम् ॥७-७४-७॥
translation: Having heard the distressed king's words, Narada replied with auspicious words to the king in the presence of the sages.

raw: मणिसोपानविकृतां हेमजालविभूषिताम् । स्फाटिकैरावृततलां दन्तान्तरितरूपिकाम् ॥५-९-२३॥
translation: The stairways of the mansion were inlaid with special gems, windows were latticed with gold, floors were covered with crystals, figures of ivory with silver.

raw: स निकुम्भं च कुम्भं च कुम्भकर्णात्मजावुभौ । प्रेषयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सह ॥६-७५-४५॥
translation: Seized with anger, he sent for Kumbha and Nikumbha, both the sons of Kumbhakarna and many Rakshasas.

raw: यस्य पार्श्वेषु निखिला कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । पावकाशनिसङ्काशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः ॥७-२२-३३॥
translation: On whose sides all the nooses of Death are established, and an embodied mace, resembling fire and lightning, stands.

raw: त्वया अहम् पुरुषव्याघ्र धार्मिकेण महत्मनाअ । समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवम् च अवरम् परम् ॥३-५-३०॥
translation: O Rama, the best of men (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.

raw: सा क्षौमवसना हृष्टा नित्यं व्रतपरायणा । अग्निं जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवत्कृतमङ्गला ॥२-२०-१५॥
translation: Always engaged in the observance of vows, Kausalya (then) clad in silk cloth was performing rituals of auspiciousness, offering oblations to the firegod in accordance with mantras (Vedic hymns).

raw: भङ्क्त्वा वनं पादपरत्नसङ्कुलं हत्वा तु रक्षांसि महान्ति संयुगे । दग्ध्वा पुरीं तां गृहरत्नमालिनीं तस्थौ हनूमान् पवनात्मजः कपिः ॥५-५४-४४॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod stood at ease having shattered the garden that was full of excellent trees, and killed the demons and burnt down rows of beautiful houses in the city.

raw: एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण देवो नारायणः प्रभुः । अब्रवीन्न परित्रासः कर्तव्यः श्रूयतां च मे ॥७-२७-१४॥
translation: Thus addressed by Indra, the Lord Narayana replied that there was no need for such great fear, and asked Indra to listen to His words.

raw: एतावदुक्त्वा चोत्थाय काकुत्स्थः परमासनात् । पर्यष्वजत धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतम् ॥७-३८-१९॥
translation: Having said this much, the righteous Rama rose from his excellent seat and embraced him closely to his chest.

raw: पिधाय इन्दु निभम् सीता मंदम् अश्रून् अवर्तयत् । ध्यायन्तीम् ताम् इव अस्वस्थाम् सीताम् चिंता हत प्रभाम् ॥३-५५-३३॥
धर्मार्थसहितं वाक्यं सर्वेषां रक्षसां हितम् । युक्तं विभीषणेनोक्तं मोहात्तस्य न रोचते ॥६-९५-१८॥
translation: "Good advice given by Vibheeshana in accordance with righteousness was not liked by him in delusion."

raw: शूरो धीमान् रथी खड्गी रथप्रवरमास्थितः । हत्वा दशरथिं रामं भवान् प्राप्स्यति मैथिलीम् ॥६-९३-६६॥
translation: "Shrewd carwarrior, you are wise. Seated in the foremost chariot with your sword, kill Dasharatha's son and attain Sita."

raw: करिष्यति स साहाय्यम् युवयोः भास्करात्मजः । सुग्रीवः सह च अस्माभिः सीतायाः परिमार्गणे ॥४-४-२८॥
translation: 'Sugriva, son of the Sungod, along with us will extend all help to you, in your search for Sita.'

raw: स तथोक्त्वा मुनिजनमरजामिदमब्रवीत् । इहैव वस दुर्मेधे आश्रमे सुसमाहिता ॥७-८१-१३॥
translation: Having thus spoken to the sages, he then said to Araja, "O foolish one, dwell here in this hermitage, well-composed."

raw: इत्येवं विहितो राजन् वधस्तस्यैष धीमतः । वधायेन्द्रजितो राम सन्दिशस्व महाबल । हते तस्मिन् हतं विद्धि रावणं ससुहृज्जनम् ॥६-८५-१६॥
translation: Rama, you are endowed with extraordinary prowess! Order now for the destruction of Indrajith as with his death Ravana and all his kinsfolk are killed, you may know.

raw: तं देवाः प्रीतमनसो बाढमित्येव राघवम् । भविष्यति पुरी रम्या शूरसेना न संशयः ॥७-७०-६॥
translation: With pleased minds, the gods replied to Shatrughna, the descendant of Raghu, saying "So be it," and assured him that the city would indeed become a beautiful one in the region of Shurasena, without a doubt.

raw: निहता ब्रह्म तेजोभिः अहनि अहनि राक्षसाः । ततः पाण्डुर मेघाभम् क्षीरौदम् नाम सागरम् ॥४-४०-४३॥
ततो नारायणो देवो विषुणुः नियुक्तः सुर सत्तमैः । जानन् अपि सुरान् एवम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-१६-१॥
translation: Although Omniscient lord Narayana knew the means to be employed, when he was requested by the best of devatas he spoke to them softly:

raw: आगच्छ हरिशार्दूल वानरांस्त्रातुमर्हसि । नान्यो विक्रमपर्याप्तस्त्वमेषां परमः सखा ॥६-७४-२७॥
बलैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः । मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ॥५-६८-१४॥
translation: 'If Rama, the slayer of the enemy army, could fill Lanka with his arrows and take me that will be a good sight for him to see.

raw: किमर्थं चापि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलमिहागत: । कस्मान्नेहोपयातोसि सबल: पुरुषर्षभ ॥२-९१-५॥
translation: Why did you, O Bharata, the best of men, station your army at a distance before coming here? Could you not approach me along with your army?

raw: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयातो महाद्युतिः । अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम् ॥६-४९-१८॥
translation: "This Lakshmana glowing in brightness, travelled with me following me in the forest. In the same way I shall follow him to the abode of death."

raw: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् । तथा ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४०-१२॥
translation: Hearing the words of Sita who was weeping piteously, brilliant Hanuman said this:

raw: पौरजानपदान्स्थाप्य स्वकार्येष्वहमागतः । क्रतूनेव करिष्यामि प्रभावाद्भवतां सताम् ॥७-३६-५७॥
translation: Having settled the citizens and country-dwellers in their respective duties, I have come here and shall indeed perform sacrifices by the power and influence of you, the virtuous ones.

raw: अर्ध सप्त शताः ताः तु प्रमदाः ताम्र लोचनाः । कौसल्याम् परिवार्य अथ शनैः जग्मुर् धृत व्रताः ॥२-३४-१३॥
translation: Thereafter, Kausalya surrounded by three hundred and fifty ladies who were faithful to their vows, reached there slowly with their eyes turned copperred (in grief).

raw: आजैश्चापि च वाराहैर्निष्ठानवरसञ्चयै: । फलनिर्यूहसंसिद्धै: सूपैर्गन्धरसान्वितै: ॥२-९१-६६॥
निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिन्दमम् । अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ॥५-६८-२८॥
translation: 'You will soon see Rama, the slayer of enemies crowned as king of Ayodhya with you, having duly completed the term of exile in the forest'.

raw: संपूर्णौ निशितैः बाणैः ज्वलद्भिः इव पावकैः । महा रजत कोशो अयम् असिः हेमविभूषितः ॥३-१२-३४॥
translation: These two quivers filled fully with sharp inexhaustible arrows, shining like flames of fire and this sword adorned with gold and this big silver sheath were given to me by Indra.

raw: विशालस्य सुतो राम हेमचन्द्रो महाबलः । सुचन्द्र इति विख्यातो हेमचन्द्रात् अनंतरः ॥१-४७-१३॥
translation: O Rama mighty Hemachandra was Vishala's son. Hemachandra's successor was the celebrated Suchandra.

raw: जानामि परमाम् भक्तिम् मयि ते भर्तृ वत्सल । शृणु च अपि यद् अर्थम् त्वाम् प्रेषयामि पुरीम् इतः ॥२-५२-६०॥
translation: O Sumantra, listen I know your deep devotion to me (I also know) you are loyal to your master (Dasaratha). So I am sending you to the city (Ayodhya) from here.

raw: तस्याहम् करुणम् श्रुत्वा निशि लालपतो बहु । सम्भ्रानतः शोकवेगेन भृशमास विचेतनः ॥२-६३-३७॥
translation: Having heard his pathetic lamentations at night, I was extremely frightened by the force of grief and stood bewildered.

raw: भैरवाभिरुते भीमे युद्धे वानररक्षसाम् । भूतैर्बहुभिराकाशं विस्मितैरावृतं बभौ ॥६-९१-६३॥
translation: As the frightful war between Vanaras and Rakshasas went on, many beings surrounded in the sky were astonished and looked charming.

raw: तम् चैव सर्वम् सुख दुःख योगम् लोको अब्रवीत् तेन कृतम् विधात्रा । त्रयो अपि लोका विहितम् विधानम् न अति क्रमन्ते वशगा हि तस्य ॥४-२४-४२॥
स च मेघाचलप्रख्यो वज्रायुधसमप्रभः । वरायुधधरो वीरो दिव्याभरणभूषितः ॥६-१७-४॥
translation: Vibheeshana looked like a mass of cloud, like someone who can cause thunderbolt, possessing excellent weapons and wonderful jewels.

raw: अग्निष्तोम आदिभिर् यज्नैर् इष्टवान् आप्त दक्षिणैः । अग्नि होत्रेण संस्कारम् केन त्वम् तु न लप्स्यसे ॥६-३२-२४॥
translation: "Why are you, who performed all kinds of sacrificial rituals of fire with all offerings deserve sanctification without doing fire sacrifice?"

raw: ताम् चित्र माल्य आभरणाम् कपि राज हितम् करः । राघव अर्थम् चरन् श्रीमान् ददर्श च ननन्द च ॥५-४-८॥
translation: Glorious Hanuman, wellwisher of Sugriva, king of vanaras, looked around the city, decorated with colourful garlands. Surveying it for the cause of Raghava, he was greatly delighted.

raw: इच्छेयम् गिरि दुर्गात् च भवद्भिः अवतारितुम् । यवीयसो गुणज्ञस्य श्लाघनीयस्य विक्रमैः ॥४-५६-२१॥
तेषाम् इच्छामि अहम् गन्तुम् समीपम् भावित आत्मनाम् । मुनीनाम् आश्रमो येषाम् अहम् च परिचारिणी ॥३-७४-२९॥
translation: I wish to reach those realisers of the Supreme Spirit whom I served and to whom this hermitage belonged.

raw: अस्मिन्काले तु यत्प्राप्तं तत्करिष्यामि ते हितम् । भ्रातुरैश्वर्ययुक्तस्य खरस्य वस पार्श्वतः ॥७-२४-३५॥
translation: At this time, I will do what is beneficial for you; dwell by the side of your brother Khara, who is endowed with power.

raw: धिगस्तुहृदयंयस्याममेदं न सहस्रधा त्वयिपञ्चत्वमापन्नेफलतेशोकपीडितम् ॥६-११४-८५॥
translation: "You have returned to the five elements. This heart of mine distressed with grief is not breaking into a thousand pieces."

raw: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा भरत: पुरुषर्षभ: । पद्भ्यामेव महाबाहु: प्रविवेश महद्वनम् ॥२-९८-१४॥
translation: Having said thus, the best of men, mightyarmed and highly energetic Bharata entered the great forest on foot.

raw: तदद्भुतं स्थैर्यमवेक्ष्य राघवे समं जनो हर्षमवाप दु:खित: । न यात्ययोध्यामिति दु:खितो ऽभवत् स्थिरप्रतिज्ञत्वमवेक्ष्य हर्षित: ॥२-१०६-३४॥
translation: Having seen the wonderful deternmination of Rama, people were, at once, anguished and delighted, anguished because he would not return to Ayodhya, and delighted because he was firm in his resolve.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे अष्टनवतितमः सर्गः ॥ ९८ ॥६-९८-३७॥
द्वितीयो बलि भोजानाम् ये च वृक्ष फल अशिनः । भासाः तृतीयम् गच्छन्ति क्रौन्चाः च कुररैः सह ॥४-५८-२७॥
translation: 'By intuition I know you would see Sita and return. On the first plane you will see sparrows and birds which live on grain. On the second, you will see crows living on the food offered to the dead and birds living on the fruits of trees, and then cocks, cranes and kraunchas moving on the third plane, on the fourth, hawks and falcons and on the fifth, vultures.

raw: त्रयाणां भरतादीनां भार्तऽणां देवता च या । रामस्य च मनःकान्ता सा कथं विनशिष्यति ॥५-५५-२६॥
translation: 'To Bharata, Lakshmana and Satrughna she is a goddess and she is dear to Rama's heart, how would she perish?

raw: भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह् । नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम् ॥२-२९-२०॥
translation: O Rama, I am faithful and devoted to you. I have equal disposition to happiness and sorrow. I equally share your prosperity and adversity. Therefore, you should take your wife (to the forest). In this time of distress.

raw: रावणस्याप्रसह्यं तं शरसम्पातमेकतः । न शेकुः सहितुं दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ॥६-९७-२॥
translation: Just as moths cannot bear the blazing fire, the Vanaras could not bear the glowing hail of Ravana's arrows even for an instant.

raw: अद्य युद्धेन महता समुद्रम् परिशोषये । क्षमया हि समायुक्तम् माम् अयम् मकर आलयः ॥६-२१-२०॥
अस्मदीया च लङ्केयं नगरी राक्षसोचिता । निवेशिता तव भ्रात्रा धनाध्यक्षेण धीमता ॥७-११-७॥
translation: This city of Lanka, suitable for Rakshasas, was established by your intelligent brother, the lord of wealth (Kubera), and belongs to us.

raw: ततस्तु हुतभोक्तारं हुतभुक्सदृशप्रभः । जुहाव राक्षसश्रेष्ठो मन्त्रवद्विधिवत्तदा ॥६-७३-१७॥
translation: Then the foremost of Rakshasas, who was like fire god in brilliance worshipped fire god with chanting of mantras as per tradition.

raw: त्वरमणः ततो गत्वा जनस्थानात् अकंपनः । प्रविश्य लंकाम् वेगेन रावणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-१॥
translation: Quickly did Akampana leave Janasthana, and quickly he entered Lanka. He said to Ravana:

raw: अथ सम्स्कार सम्पन्नो हनूमान् सचिव उत्तमः । उवाच वचनम् श्लक्ष्णम् अर्थवन् मधुरम् लघु ॥६-१७-५०॥
translation: On the other hand, Hanuman who was endowed with rich culture spoke these soft, sweet, and meaningful words briefly.

raw: देव गन्धर्व पुत्राः च वानराः काम रूपिणः । स्वैः स्वैः परिवृताः सैन्यैः वर्तन्ते पथि राघव ॥४-३८-२९॥
translation: 'O Rama valiant bears of fierce appearance, also golangulas (a variety of monkeys with tails like cows') familiar with the inaccessible fortresses of forest have come. These monkeys are sons of divine beings and gandharvas who can assume any form at will. They are on their way along with their armies.

raw: अवटे ये निधीयन्ते तेषाम् लोकाः सनातनाः । एवम् उक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थम् विराधः शर पीडितः ॥३-४-२३॥
विभक्तरक्षस्सम्बाधमाससादानिलात्मजः ॥५-५३-४१॥
translation: Then the illustrious Hanuman reached the entrance of the lofty city, which was like the peak of a mountain and turned away the demons.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा तु वैदेही वेपमाना तपस्विनी । जगाम जगतीम् बाला चिन्ना तु कदली यथा ॥६-३२-६॥
translation: That miserable young, Vaidehi, having said so, fell on the ground trembling like a cut off banana plant.

raw: स तु तेनैव हर्षेण तस्मिन्नहनि वीर्यवान् । वनं गतो दशग्रीवः सह तैः क्षणदाचरैः ॥७-११-२१॥
translation: Indeed, on that very day, the powerful Ravana, filled with that joy, went to the forest with those night-wanderers.

raw: कामगम् रथम् आस्थाय शुशुभे राक्षसाधिपः । विद्युन् मण्डलवान् मेघः स बलाक इव अंबरे ॥३-३५-१०॥
translation: Ravana, enemy of the gods, slayer of towering sages, with white yaktail fans, and white parasols, shining like smooth vaidurya, wearing pure gold earrings, clad in attractive attire, ten necks with twenty strong hands, ten heads looking like ten mountain peaks, a cloud in the sky encircled by lightnings and accompanied by cranes, ascended the chariot that could go wherever he desired.

raw: मयूरनादाभिरुतो गजराजनिषेवितः । गम्यताम् भवता शैलश्चित्रकूटः स विश्रुतः ॥२-५४-४०॥
translation: O mighty Rama, I think mount Chitrakuta is the right place for you to stay. Go there. That mountain is full of trees of every kind, is inhabited by kinneras and uragas (serpents). It echoes with the cries of peacocks, is frequented by mighty tuskers. Filled with fruits and roots, it is sacred and pleasant.

raw: यत्त्वया हीदृशम् पापम् कृतम् घोरेण कर्मणा । सर्वलोकप्रियम् हित्वा ममाप्यापादितम् भयम् ॥२-७४-५॥
translation: That by doing this horrible deed you have committed a great sin of renouncing Rama, the beloved of all worlds. Therefore I am overtaken by fear.

raw: तदैन्द्रमस्त्रं सौमित्रिः संयुगेष्वपराजितम् । शरश्रेष्ठं धनुः श्रेष्ठे नरश्रेष्ठो ऽभिसन्दधे ॥६-९१-६९॥
अपकृष्याश्रमपदान्मृगरूपेण राघवम् । शून्ये येनापनीता ऽसि तस्य द्क्ष्यसि यत्फलम् ॥५-३४-३२॥
translation: "You will see the consequences of the action of Ravana who abducted you deceitfully in the form of deer when Rama was away from the hermitage.

raw: बाढम् कल्यम् गमिष्यामि हि एकः सारथिना सह । आनेष्यामि च वैदेहीम् इमाम् हृष्टो महा पुरीम् ॥३-३१-३३॥
translation: Yes, early in the morning I will go alone gladly with the charioteer and bring Vaidehi here to this great city.

raw: सैन्यैः परिवृतो गच्छ शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः । वानरा हि महात्मानः शीघ्राः सुव्यवसायिनः ॥६-६५-२३॥
स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः । करेणैकेन शेलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतये ऽसृजत् ॥६-५९-७१॥
translation: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.

raw: क्षुधा चैव सहस्राक्षम् ब्रह्म हत्या सम् आविशत् । तम् इन्द्रम् मलिनम् देवा ऋषयः च तपोधनाः ॥१-२४-१९॥
व्यावृत्तगुरुपीनस्रक्प्रकीर्णवरभूषणाः । पानव्यायामकालेषु निद्रापहृतचेतसः ॥५-९-४५॥
translation: Garlands displaced and jewels scattered, they were drowsy due to drink and sexual exercise.

raw: कांचनम् रथम् आस्थाय कामगम् रत्न भूषितम् । पिशाच वदनैः युक्तम् खरैः कनक भूषणैः ॥३-३५-६॥
translation: The younger brother of Kubera (Ravana), the prosperous lord of the demons ascended the chariot which could go where he desired. Embellished with gold, studded with gems, harnessed with demonfaced donkeys, the chariot rolled towards the ocean, rumbling like a cloud.

raw: तदा त्वया हि विज्ञेयम् रक्षसाम् भयामागतम् । स हि म् समयः सौम्य प्राप्तोऽय तव द्र्शनात् ॥५-३-४८॥
शरौ प्रतिहतौ दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ रणमूर्धनि । व्रीडितौ जातरोषौ च लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितौ तदा ॥६-९१-५४॥
translation: Then both Lakshmana and Indrajith in the face of the battle seeing their arrows in nought with each other were abashed and got agitated.

raw: निश्चितार्थस्ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवः पवनात्मजे । लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत ॥५-६४-३८॥
translation: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.

raw: ऋक्षवानरसम्घानामनीकानि सहस्रशः । गिरिमेघनिकाशानाम् चादयन्ति वसुन्धराम् ॥६-२४-३३॥
translation: "Thousands of army forces of monkeys and Bears resembling mountains and clouds have settled on the ground."

raw: स च एनम् अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् वैनतेयो महाबलः । मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र वधो अयम् लोक सम्मतः ॥१-४१-१७॥
translation: Highly powerful Garuda, son of Vinata, addressing Anshuman said 'O Tiger among men do not grieve. This act of assasination is meant for the welfare of the three worlds'.

raw: अन्यैः अपि कृतम् पापम् प्रमत्तैः वसुधा अधिपैः । प्रायश्चित्तम् च कुर्वन्ति तेन तत् शाम्यते रजः ॥४-१८-३४॥
translation: 'Vicious deeds have been committed by others when the kings were not watchful. Kings punish such sinners when they are vigilant. Otherwise they have to atone for their negligence.

raw: शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च परस्पर जय एषिणोः । तदा तु जृम्भितम् शैवम् धनुः भीम पराक्रमम् ॥१-७५-१७॥
वितत्य रुचिरौ पक्षौ रुतैः उपहसन् इव । मयूरस्य वने नूनम् रक्षसा न हृता प्रिया ॥४-१-४०॥
इत्यहम् तस्य शापस्य भीतः प्रसभमेव ताम् । नारोहये बलात्सीताम् वैदेहीम् शय्ने शुभे ॥६-१३-१५॥
translation: "Thus, frightened on account of his curse, I do not perforce to get her to my lustrous bed."

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपताम् वरः । विश्वामित्रम् तदा वाक्यम् स रोषम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५५-२६॥
translation: The infuriated Vasishta who was highly brilliant, foremost among those who meditate said to Viswamitra:

raw: यथा तु खलु दुर्भद्धिर्भरतः स्वयमागतः । स एष हि महा कायः कोविदार ध्वजो रथे ॥२-८४-३॥
translation: It appears that the evilminded Bharata himself has come here. The emblem of a huge kovidara (pomegranate) tree is seen on his chariot.

raw: असञ्चाल्यं मनुष्यैश्च यत्नेनापि च गौरवात् । तन्न शक्ता नमयितुं स्वप्नेष्वपि नराधिपा: ॥२-११८-४०॥
translation: Because of its weight, no human could move that bow despite great effort nor were the kings capable of bending it even in their dreams.

raw: अंगार चूर्ण उत्कर संनिकाशैःफलैः सुपर्याप्त रसैः समृद्धैः । जंबू द्रुमाणाम् प्रविभान्ति शाखानिपीयमाना इव षट्पद ओघैः ॥४-२८-३०॥
translation: 'The branches of jambu trees profusely filled with fruits appear like piled up balls of charcoal, while swarms of bees rest on the branches on the jambu trees.

raw: मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्याः स्वलंकृताः । दृष्ट्वा एव च ततो विप्रम् आयान्तम् हृष्ट मानसाः ॥१-१०-२५॥
तत: सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम् । सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद्धृष्टा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे ॥२-११७-१९॥
translation: Anasuya was delighted to see the glorious Sita who was always engaged in righteous acts and said in kind words, You are fortunate. You are observing your rightful duty.

raw: राक्षसानामुपरि खे भ्रमते ऽलातचक्रवत् । कपोता रक्तपादाश्च शारिका विद्रुता ययुः ॥७-६-५७॥
पूर्वद्वारं तु कुमुदः कोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ॥६-४२-२३॥
translation: Kumuda, surrounded by ten crores of mighty monkeys, who appeared like conquerors, stationed at the east gate.

raw: दिव्य आभरण माल्याभिः प्रमदाभिः समावृतम् । संरब्धतर रक्ताक्षो बभूव अंतक संनिभः ॥४-३३-६५॥
translation: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

raw: न चैतत्कर्मरामस्यश्रद्धधामिचमूमुखे । सर्वतस्समुपेतस्यतवतेनाभिमर्षणम् ॥६-११४-८॥
translation: "You are always well equipped with the army, so such action (killing you) is not possible for Rama."

raw: यदि शूर्पणखा हेतोः जनस्थान गत खरः । अति वृत्तो हतः पूर्वम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा । अत्र ब्रूहि यथावत् त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः ॥३-३९-२४॥
translation: For the sake of Surpanakha, Khara of Janasthana committed excesses and got killed by Rama who can accomplish things with ease.Tell me truly if Rama did violate anything here.

raw: सा प्रहृष्ट्वा वचः श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनात् च्युतम् । प्रशशंस पुनर् मौर्ख्यात् भ्रातरम् रक्षसाम् वरम् ॥३-२२-६॥
translation: On hearing the words that came out of Khara's mouth, she was pleased. And in stupidity began praising her brother once again as the best of demons.

raw: रामस्यार्थे पराक्रम्य वानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः । नर्दन्तस्ते ऽभिवृत्तास्तु समरे सशिलायुधाः ॥६-७३-३८॥
translation: Vanaras, armed with rocks in the battle, roaring and not turning back, stood for the cause, giving up their life.

raw: मातङ्ग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः । अभिभूतो ऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना ॥६-६०-२॥
translation: Overcome by humiliation from the high souled Rama, Ravana remained like an elephant rejected by a lion and a serpent rejected by Garuda.

raw: स घोषवद्भिश्च हयैः सनागैः । पुरस्सरैः स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः । महीयमानः प्रवरैः च वादकैः । अभिष्टुतः वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ ॥२-१६-४६॥
translation: With bards, panegyrists and great musical performers invoking blessings and walking ahead, he (Rama) proceeded, like Kubera amid intoxicated elephants and horses.

raw: वाताश्च परुषा वान्ति कम्पते च वसुन्धरा । पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीरुहाः ॥६-४१-१३॥
translation: "The winds are blowing severely, the earth is quaking in, the mountain peaks are shaking, and the elephants bearing the earth (in the four corners) are falling."

raw: तेषां गुप्तिपरीहारै: कच्चित्ते भरणं कृतम् । रक्ष्या हि राज्ञा धर्मेण सर्वे विषयवासिन: ॥२-१००-४९॥
translation: I trust you nourish them and also afford portection and prevent adversities. A king must protect all those people living in his country in accordanc with righteousness.

raw: तस्यास्तद्वनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । हर्षयन् मैथिलीं वाक्यमुवाचेदं महाद्युतिः ॥६-११६-४९॥
translation: On hearing Mythili, wise Hanuman spoke these words to her bringing joy to her.

raw: यमेव दिवसं ह्येष ग्रहीतुं भास्करं प्लुतः । तमेव दिवसं राहुर्जिघृक्षति दिवाकरम् ॥७-३५-३१॥
translation: On the very day that this child leaped to seize the sun, Rahu also desired to grasp the sun.

raw: ज्येष्ठा शैलेन्द्र दुहिता मानयिष्यति तम् सुतम् । उमायाः तत् बहुमतम् भविष्यति न संशयः ॥१-३७-८॥
translation: "Ganga, the eldest daughter of the king of the mountains, will tend that son of Agni. This will be totally acceptable to Uma. No doubt".

raw: प्रहृष्टो मां पितृव्यस्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः । शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तानिति होवाच पार्थिवः ॥५-६४-१०॥
translation: "Your father's brother, Sugriva, the lord of vanaras felt very glad and indeed asked me to send you quickly."

raw: विरराज महाकायो महावीर्यो महामनाः । पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशो विधूम इव पावकः ॥६-५६-२८॥
translation: The gigantic Hanuman, exceedingly valiant and courageous one shone like a fully blossomed Ashoka tree, resembled smokeless fire.

raw: नाना प्रहरणैः शूरैर् आवृतो रावण आत्मजः । राक्षसानाम् सहस्रैस् तु बहुभिः शस्त्र पाणिभिः ॥६-३७-१२॥
आगाच्छक्रो महच्चापं विस्फार्य सुमहास्वनम् । यस्य विस्फारघोषेण स्तनन्ति स्म दिशो दश ॥७-२८-४६॥
translation: Indra arrived, drawing his mighty bow with a tremendous sound, the reverberations of which caused the ten directions to thunder.

raw: सर्वकामैः उपहृतैः उपेतम् वै समन्ततः । द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि राजेन्द्र मनसेव विनिर्मितम् ॥१-१३-३८॥
translation: O foremost of kings, you ought to see the sacrificial ground full of sources of entertainment arranged everywhere, as though improvised by imagination".

raw: साधु रामेति केचित्तु साधु सीतेति चापरे । उभावेव च तत्रान्ये प्रेक्षकाः सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः ॥७-९६-१४॥
translation: Some spectators acclaimed, "Excellent, Rama!", others cried, "Excellent, Sita!", and still others there loudly praised both of them.

raw: दीर्घ गंभीर निर्घोषाः शैल द्रुम पुरोगमाः । विसृज्य सलिलम् मेघाः परिश्रांता नृप आत्मज ॥४-३०-२२॥
translation: 'O prince having discharged their water the clouds (after the rains) are exhausted. They are moving now over trees and mountains, making deep and pleasant sounds.

raw: स हि सर्वस्य राज्यस्य मुखम् एकम् भविष्यति । ताते च वयसा अतीते मयि च अरण्यम् आश्रिते ॥२-५३-१२॥
translation: The king is advanced in age and I have to dwell in the forest. Therefore, Bharata alone will be the chief of this entire kingdom.

raw: प्रदोषकाले हनुमांस्तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वीर्यवान् । प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् ॥५-२-५०॥
translation: As soon as dusk had set in, courageous Hanuman jumped in and entered the well laidout royal path of the beautiful city.

raw: हारनूपुरकेयूरपारिहार्यधराः स्त्रियः । विस्मिताः सस्मितास्तस्थुराकाशे रमणैः सह ॥५-१-२६॥
translation: Adorned with necklaces, anklets and armlets, the vidyadharis stayed wonderstruck in the sky, smiling gently in the company of their lovers.

raw: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो घोरदर्शनाः । पुनः परुषमेकार्थमनर्थार्थमथाब्रुवन् ॥५-२७-२॥
translation: The dreadfullooking demonesses once again approached Sita and conveyed her categorically in harsh words the terrible consequences (ahead)

raw: तां तु भार्यां स निर्भर्त्स्य सो ऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः । दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः ॥७-३०-३७॥
translation: Having rebuked his wife, the great ascetic then said, "O ill-behaved one, disappear from the vicinity of my hermitage!"

raw: तेषां संवदतामेव तमाश्रममुपागमत् । कर्दमस्तु महातेजा द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः ॥७-९०-८॥
translation: Just as they were conversing, the greatly refulgent Kardama approached that hermitage along with other great-souled brahmins.

raw: अहम् हि नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम । सर्वतः परिरक्षामि ह्येतत्ते कथितम् मया ॥५-३-३०॥
translation: "O monkey I am the presiding ogress of Lanka presenting myself personally. I am to protect this city. This is my answer to you".

raw: समासाद्य तु राजेन्द्रान्महेन्द्रवरुणोपमान् । अब्रवीद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु युद्धं मे दीयतामिति ॥७-१९-२॥
translation: Having approached those great kings who were comparable to Mahendra and Varuṇa, the lord of Rākṣasas then demanded, "Let battle be given to me."

raw: विभ्राजमानान् वपुषा पादपान् च हिरण्मयान् । नील वैदूर्य वर्णाः च पद्मिनीः पतगैः आवृताः ॥४-५०-२८॥
translation: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

raw: मनोज्ञोऽयं गिरिस्सौम्य नानाद्रुमलतायुतः । बहुमूलफलो रम्य स्स्वाजीवः प्रतिभाति मे ॥२-५६-१४॥
translation: O gentle one this enchanting mountain with different kinds of trees and creepers and many roots and fruits appears to be a happy place to live in.

raw: त्वत्तो जना: पूर्वतरे वराश्च शुभानि कर्माणि बहूनि चक्रु: । जित्वा सदेमं च परञ्च लोकं तस्माद्द्विजा: स्वस्ति हुतं कृतं च ॥२-१०९-३५॥
translation: Men superior to you in preceding generations had conquered this world and the other world by always performing many auspicious acts. Twiceborn brahmins perform religious acts and offer libations for the welfare of the world.

raw: निशम्य रामागमनं नृपात्मजः कपिप्रवीरस्य तदद्भुतोपमम् । प्रहर्षितो रामदिदृक्षया ऽभवत् पुनश्च हर्षादिदमब्रवीद्वचः ॥६-१२८-४५॥
वेश्याश्चैव शुभाचाराः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः । चन्द्रांशुविकचप्रख्यं काञ्चनं रत्नभुषितम् ॥२-१५-९॥
कारिताः सर्व एवैते शास्त्रज्ञैः यज्ञकोविदैः । शोभाअर्थम् तस्य यज्ञस्य कांचन अलंकृत अभवन् ॥१-१४-२४॥
translation: All these posts were prepared by knowers of sastras and by those wellversed in the performance of sacrifices. They were decorated with gold to add elegance to the sacrifice.

raw: कानु पद्मपलाशाक्षि क्लिष्टकौशेयवासिनि । द्रुमस्य शाखामालम्ब्य तिष्ठसि त्वमनिन्दिते ॥५-३३-३॥
translation: "O blameless lady with eyes like lotus petals, in crumpled silk, holding a branch, and standing, who are you?

raw: जम्बुमाली महामाली तीक्ष्णवेगो ऽशनिप्रभः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च राक्षसः ॥६-९०-११॥
translation: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

raw: न हि मे संप्रयातस्य त्वामितो नयतो ऽङ्गने । अनुगन्तुं गतिं शक्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः ॥५-३७-२५॥
translation: "O beautiful lady it is not possible for all the inhabitants of Lanka together to follow me while I carry you from this place.

raw: उपांशु दण्डेन हि माम् बंधनेन उपपादयेत् । शठः क्रूरो नृशंसः च सुग्रीवो राज्य कारणात् ॥४-५५-१०॥
translation: 'Sugriva is deceitful, cruel and treacherous. He will inflict secret punishment on me by way of imprisonment for the sake of the kingdom.

raw: स तदा प्रतिविद्धस्तु बह्वीभिः शरवृष्टिभिः । हनुमान् ददृशे वीरः प्ररूढ इव सानुमान् ॥६-५६-२७॥
translation: Valiant Hanuman, even though interrupted several times with rain of arrows, stood still like a mountain full of trees.

raw: मातङ्गरथकूलाश्च वाजिमत्स्या ध्वजद्रुमाः । शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः प्रसस्रुः शोणितापगाः ॥६-९४-१२॥
translation: There with rivers of blood flowing, elephants and chariots were like banks, horses were like fish, staff of chariots like trees and dead bodies as logs of wood seemed.

raw: रुमणो नाम तेजस्वी विक्रान्तैः वानरैः वृतः । आगतो बलवान् तूर्णम् कोटि शत समावृतः ॥४-३९-२८॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः । नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ॥७-२७-३९॥
translation: O Rama, in the meantime, a demon named Sumali, enraged and wielding various weapons, attacked that army.

raw: सो ऽर्चिःपिनद्धो ददृशे होमशोणिततर्पितः । सन्ध्यागत इवादित्यः सुतीव्रो ऽग्निः समुत्थितः ॥६-८२-२८॥
translation: The flame had swollen up with the offering of blood as oblation and risen. It was very bright and wrapped in the flames the fire resembled the sun.

raw: प्रदीप्ते नरशार्दूल प्रयच्छामि नृपाअत्मज । धर्म पाशम् अहम् राम काल पाशम् तथैव च ॥१-२७-८॥
कल्याणाभिजनः साधुरदीनः सत्यवागृजुः । वृद्धैरभिविनीतश्च द्विजैर्धर्मार्थदर्शिभिः ॥२-१-२१॥
translation: Born in a family of noble descent, he was saintly. A man without meanness.He was truthful and a man of rectitude. The training he received under aged brahmins conversant with dharma and artha made him welldisciplined.

raw: इदम् हि माया विहितम् सुदुर्गमम्प्रभूत वृक्ष उदक भोज्य पेयम् । इह अस्ति नः न एव भयम् पुरंदरात्न राघवात् वानर राजतो अपि वा ॥४-५३-२६॥
जगाम रुदतीम् गृह्य मैथिलीम् राक्षस ईश्वरः । ताम् जहार सुसंहृष्टो रावणो मृत्युम् आत्मनः ॥३-५४-६॥
इदम् हि वृत्तम् उचितम् कुलस्य अस्य सनातनम् । दानम् दीक्षा च यज्ञेषु तनु त्यागो मृधेषु च ॥२-४०-७॥
translation: Charity, initiation at sacrifices and yielding life in battles are the befitting ancient traditions prevailing in your race.

raw: स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा सुधार्मिकः । राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत् ॥७-८७-४॥
translation: That very righteous king, having brought the entire earth under his control, protected his kingdom as if it were his own son, O tiger among men.

raw: सीतामादायं हस्तेन मधुमैरेयकं शुचि । पाययामास काकुत्स्थः शचीमिव पुरन्दरः ॥७-४२-१८॥
रसातले वा वर्तन्तीम् वर्तन्तीम् वा नभः तले । अहम् आनीय दास्यामि तव भार्याम् अरिन्दम ॥४-६-६॥
translation: 'O subduer of enemies I will restore her to you even if she is kept in the bowels of the earth or in the vaults of heaven.

raw: सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थंजयार्हस्यमहात्मनः । कर्तुमर्हथरामस्ययद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम् ॥६-१३१-२५॥
translation: For the success of the great soul Rama's consecration, whatever was auspicious, all that ought to be done as he deserves.

raw: ततो नानाप्रहरणाञ्छितधारान्सहस्रशः । पातयामास सङ्क्रुद्धः सुरसैन्येषु रावणिः ॥७-२८-१३॥
translation: Then, greatly enraged, Ravana's son hurled thousands of various sharp-edged weapons upon the armies of the gods.

raw: मित्रैर् वा अपि समान अर्थैर् बान्धवैर् अपि वा हितैः । सहितो मन्त्रयित्वा यः कर्म आरम्भान् प्रवर्तयेत् ॥६-६-८॥
translation: "He who decides, after deliberating with his wellwishers, with capable ministers of good counsel, relatives of common interest or friends before undertaking his task and tries with faith in god is said to be best among men."

raw: शोकसम्तापनित्येन कामेन कलुषीकृतः । सा तु सम्वत्सरम् कालम् मामयाचत भामिनी ॥६-१२-१८॥
कुतस्त्वमसि सुश्रोणि कस्य वा ऽसि सुता शुभे । पीडितो ऽहमनङ्गेन गच्छामि त्वां शुभानने ॥७-८०-६॥
translation: O beautiful-hipped one, from where are you, or whose daughter are you, O auspicious one; I am tormented by Cupid, and so I approach you, O beautiful-faced one.

raw: रावणश्च मया दृष्टः क्षितौ तैलसमुक्षितः । रक्तवासाः पिबन् मत्तः करवीरकृतस्रजः ॥५-२७-२२॥
translation: "I saw the body of Ravana lying on the ground smeared with oil, clad in red, wearing a garland of lilies and intoxicated with drinking.

raw: सर्वं पुष्टं प्रमुदितं सुसम्पूर्णमनोरथम् । साधु साध्विति तैर्देवैस्त्रिदिवं गतकल्मषम् ॥७-११०-१५॥
translation: All were nourished, greatly delighted, and had their desires completely fulfilled, as the gods exclaimed "Excellent! Excellent!" and heaven became free from all blemish.

raw: योनि देशात् च यवनः शकृ देशात् शकाः तथा । रोम कूपेषु म्लेच्छाः च हारीताः स किरातकाः ॥१-५५-३॥
translation: "From her lowing Kambhojas bright like the Sun, from the udder Paplavas, weapons in hand, from the vagina Yavanas, from the anus Sakas, from the roots of the hair Mlecchas along with Kiratas and Haritas were born.

raw: अकम्पनः सुपार्श्वश्च चक्रमाली च राक्षसः । कम्पनः सत्त्ववन्तौ तौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ॥६-९०-१४॥
translation: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

raw: तमवज्ञाय तु हतं शत्रुघ्नं भुवि पातितम् । रक्षो लब्धान्तरमपि न विवेश स्वमालयम् ॥७-६९-१४॥
translation: Disregarding Shatrughna, who had fallen to the ground as if killed, the demon, even though he had found an opportunity, did not enter his own abode.

raw: अनेन स परामृष्टो राम सूर्यरथोपरि । अपक्रान्तस्ततस्त्रस्तो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः ॥७-३५-३२॥
translation: O Rama, when he (the original Rahu), the tormentor of the moon and sun, was touched by that other one upon the sun's chariot, he became frightened and departed from there.

raw: क एषां पूर्वको ब्रह्मन्किन्नामा च बलोत्कटः । अपराधं च कं प्राप्य विष्णुना द्राविताः कथम् ॥७-४-६॥
translation: O Brāhmaṇa, who was their first ancestor, what was his name, and how were these exceedingly powerful beings driven away by Viṣṇu after committing what offense?

raw: राघवोऽपि महातेजा नावमारुह्य ताम् ततः । ब्रह्मवत् क्षत्रवच्चैव जजाप हितमात्मनः ॥२-५२-७८॥
translation: Resplendent Rama boarded the boat and muttered for his own safety mantras befitting brahmins and kshatriyas.

raw: यत् तादृशम् चारुरवम् क्रौन्चम् हन्यात् अकारणात् । शोचन् एव पुनः क्रौन्चीम् उप श्लोकम् इमम् जगौ ॥१-२-२९॥
उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये च अभ्यागते अहनि । अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विज इन्द्रैः उपकल्पितम् ॥२-१५-३॥
भ्रातुः जटायुषः तस्य जनस्थान निवासिनः । तस्य एव च मम भ्रातुः सखा दशरथः कथम् ॥४-५६-२३॥
तस्याम् स वैदूर्यमयम् प्रियाकाजिनसम्वृतम् । महत्सोपाश्रयम् भेजे रावणः परमासनम् ॥६-११-१७॥
translation: Ravana sat on a huge excellent seat encrusted with Vydurya gems and covered with deer skin and which had a pillow.

raw: दक्षिण अभिमुखाः सर्वे दर्शयन्तो नभः स्थलम् । मैथिली ह्रियमाणा सा दिशम् याम् अभ्यपद्यत ॥३-६४-१८॥
translation: Thus asked by the prince, all the deer got up suddenly, and pointed towards the southern sky, the direction in which the princess from Mithila was carried off. Looking at the Lord of men (Rama), they started running in that direction.

raw: क्रौन्च बर्हिण सम्घुष्टे राज हम्स निषेवितैः । तूर्य आभरण निर्घोषैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम् ॥५-३-११॥
translation: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

raw: शक्र दत्ता वरा माला कान्चनी रत्न भूषिता । दधार हरि मुख्यस्य प्राणान् तेजः श्रियम् च सा ॥४-१७-५॥
translation: As the most beautiful golden necklace, studded with diamonds, given by Indra was there on him, the life, brightness and splendour of Vali's body remained.

raw: अपश्यन् दयितां भार्यां पप्रच्छ विषसाद च । न ही तस्य पुरा देवी तां वेलामत्यवर्तत ॥२-१०-१८॥
भरतस्यवच्श्रुत्वारामःपरपुरञ्जयः । तथेतिप्रतिजग्राहनिषसादासनेशुभे ॥६-१३१-१२॥
translation: Hearing Bharata's words, the conqueror of enemies, Rama said 'Be it so'. Then Bharata took the auspicious seat.

raw: अद्य रामस्य पश्यन्तु निधनं सुमहत् प्रियम् । लङ्कायां राक्षसाः सर्वे ये ते निहतबान्धवाः ॥६-६३-३६॥
translation: " All the Rakshasas in Lanka whose relations have been killed will witness Rama's death which will be very welcome."

raw: इषुभिस्तोमरैः शूलैस्त्रिशूलैर्वज्रकर्षणैः । सरावणानर्दयन्तः समन्तात्समभिद्रुताः ॥७-३२-३४॥
translation: They attacked from all sides, tormenting Ravana and his forces with arrows, lances, spears, tridents, and thunderbolt-like weapons.

raw: प्रेषिताः च त्वया शूरा राक्षसाः ते चतुर् दश । निहन्तुम् राघवम् घोराम् मत् प्रियार्थम् स लक्ष्मणम् ॥३-२१-८॥
translation: O warrior you had sent, out of anger, fourteen demons to put an end to Rama along with Lakshmana in order to please me.

raw: यश्चैव शक्त्या ऽभिहतस्त्वया ऽद्य इच्छन् विषादं सहसा ऽभ्युपेतः । स एव रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्ययुद्धे ॥६-५९-१३२॥
translation: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."

raw: द्वौ अयाचत भर्तारम् सत्यसंधम् नृपोत्तमम् । न अद्य भोक्ष्ये न च स्वप्स्ये न पास्ये कदाचन ॥३-४७-८॥
अद्यैव तस्य रौद्रस्य शरीरं मामकाः शराः । विधमिष्यन्ति भित्त्वा तं महाचापगुणच्युताः ॥६-८५-२७॥
translation: "Today loosed from my mighty bow, the arrows will split his fierce body and kill him."

raw: न चान्यो राक्षसान्हन्ता सुरारीन्देवकण्टकान् । ऋते नारायणं देवं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ॥७-८-२५॥
translation: No one else can kill the Rākṣasas, who are enemies and tormentors of the gods, except for the god Nārāyaṇa, who holds the conch, discus, and mace.

raw: इति उक्त्वा परुषम् वाक्यम् रावणः शत्रु रावणः । राक्षसीः च ततः क्रुद्ध इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-५६-२६॥
translation: Enraged Ravana, who used to make enemies wail, turned to the demonesses and said these words.

raw: ददर्श रावणस्तत्र गोवृषेन्द्रवरारणिम् । यस्माच्चन्द्रः प्रभवति शीतरश्मिर्निशाकरः ॥७-२३-२२॥
translation: There Ravana saw the ocean, the best source of cows, bulls, and excellent things, from which the cool-rayed moon, the maker of night, originated.

raw: महाज्वरेण दुर्धर्षम् यमलोकमहार्णवम् । अवगाह्य त्वया राजन् यमस्य बल सागरम् ॥६-७-१४॥
तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यपेतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम् । शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपजीविनः ॥५-२९-१॥
translation: Like wellwishers flocking round a person on whom fortune is smiling, omens foretelling auspicious happenings in near future appeared to Sita. She was unimpeachable. She was in agony, distressed in mind, bereft of all joy (now) standing under that Simsupa tree.

raw: सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तंमणिभिश्चविभूषितम् । मुक्ताहारंनरेन्द्रायददौशक्रप्रचोदितः ॥६-१३१-७१॥
translation: Urged by Indra the wind god gave a dazzling pearls chain intercepted by several kinds of gems and precious stones to the ruler of the world.

raw: पुरा स्वयंभुवे धीरः शिरांसि उपजहार यः । देव दानव गधर्व पिशाच पतग उरगैः ॥३-३२-१८॥
यः पुरा गोमती तीरे रम्यम् पर्येति पर्वतम् । नाम्ना सम्कोचनो नाम नाना नग युतो गिरिः ॥६-२६-२७॥
translation: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

raw: कृतानि प्लवगैस्तूर्णम् भीमकायैर्महाबलैः । अह्ना तृतीयेन तथा योजनानि तु सागरे ॥६-२२-६८॥
त्वं पद्ममिव वातेन सन्नता प्रियदर्शना । उरस्तेऽभिनिविष्टं वै यावत् स्कन्धात्समुन्नतम् ॥२-९-४१॥
उत्सहे शत्रु वशगा प्राणान् धारयितुम् चिरम् । न नूनम् च आत्मनः श्रेयः पथ्यम् वा समवेक्षसे ॥३-५३-१६॥
अधस्तात् व्रजतः तस्याः सुर राज्ञो महात्मनः । बिन्दवः पतिता गात्रे सूक्ष्माः सुरभि गन्धिनः ॥२-७४-१७॥
translation: The fine drops of her fragnant tears trickled down the body of the great king of the gods (Indra).

raw: पश्येदानीं जगच्चित्रमिमं विश्रवसः सुत । इदं मुहूर्तं तिष्ठस्व दुर्लभं ते भविष्यति ॥७-३४-९॥
translation: O son of Vishravas, behold this wonder of the world now, and wait for a moment, for such an opportunity will be rare for you in the future.

raw: नैतदाश्चर्य्यमार्याया यन्मां त्वमनुभाषसे । विदितं तु ममाप्येतद्यथा नार्य्या: पतिर्गुरु: ॥२-११८-२॥
translation: It is no wonder that a noble lady like you should instruct me this way. It is known to me that a husband is a guru to his wife.

raw: अंगदः तु आनयेत् माल्यम् वस्त्राणि विविधानि च । घृतम् तैलम् अथो गन्धान् यत् च अत्र समनंतरम् ॥४-२५-१६॥
translation: 'Let Angada for his part collect garlands of many kinds, clothes, clarified butter, oil, fragrants and all that is required to be procured.

raw: त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः । रामेण निहतः सङ्ख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः ॥५-५१-११॥
translation: "You know of Vali, chief of the vanaras, in the past. Rama killed him with a single arrow in the combat.

raw: अन्या कक्ष गतेन एव मड्डुकेन असित ईक्षणा । प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बाल पुत्रा इव वत्सला ॥५-१०-३८॥
translation: A woman with dark eyes asleep with a drum placed in her armpit looked like a beautiful mother holding her loving baby (the drum was hung to her arm with a rope).

raw: शैल इन्द्रम् इव गन्ध आढ्यम् द्वितीयम् गन्ध मादनम् । अशोक वनिकायाम् तु तस्याम् वानर पुम्गवः ॥५-१५-१५॥
translation: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.

raw: राक्षसेन्द्र समाधूतम् तस्याः तत् वदनम् शुभम् । शुशुभे न विना रामम् दिवा चन्द्र इव उदितः ॥३-५२-२२॥
translation: Shaken up by the demon and deprived of Rama's company, Sita's beautiful face looked like the Moon during daytime without any glow.

raw: पूर्वं कृतयुगे तात पर्वताः पक्षिणोऽभवन् । ते हि जग्मुर्दिशः सर्वा गरुडानिलवेगिनः ॥५-१-१२३॥
