translation: "Formerly in Kritayuga, O dear, mountains were endowed with wings. They used to move speedily in all directions like Garuda and the Windgod.

raw: ताम् हेम वर्णाम् हेम अंगीम् सीताम् दर्शय पर्वत । यावत् सानूनि सर्वाणि न ते विध्वंसयामि अहम् ॥३-६४-३१॥
translation: Like a lion aiming at a petty animal, angry Rama said, O Mountain before I destroy all your slopes show me that goldenhued Sita with lustre like gold.

raw: अलं राक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्य ते । रोषं च सम्परित्यज्य स्वस्थो भवितुमर्हसि ॥६-६३-३०॥
translation: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."

raw: ततो महेन्द्रप्रतिमः स लक्ष्मणः पदातिनं तं निशितैः शरोत्तमैः । सृजन्तमाजौ निशितान् शरोत्तमान् भृशं तदा बाणगणैर्न्यवारयत् ॥६-९०-५४॥
ताः पाताका इव उद्धूताः पत्नीनाम् रुचिर प्रभाः । नाना वर्ण सुवर्णानाम् वक्त्र मूलेषु रेजिरे ॥५-९-५५॥
translation: The fringes of their garments glowing beautifully close to the faces of the wives (of Ravana) with different beautiful hues, shone splendid like flags.

raw: न अस्य अपराधम् पश्यामि न अपि दोषम् तथा विधम् । येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्रात् वन वासाय राघवः ॥२-२१-४॥
translation: I do not see any fault in Rama nor any offence committed by him for which he is exiled from the kingdom.

raw: प्रहृष्टा च अनवद्यान्गी मृष्ट हाटक वर्णिनी । भर्तारम् अपि च आक्रन्द लक्ष्मणम् चैव सायुधम् ॥३-४३-२॥
translation: Sita while plucking flowers Sita who had fine hips, flawless beautiful limbs and pure golden complexion felt delighted to see the deer with gold and silver colours on both sides of his body. She called out to Rama and Lakshmana who were equipped with arms.

raw: तत् च अपि जानामि यथा अविषह्यम्बलम् नरश्रेष्ठ शरीरजस्य । जानामि यस्मिन् च जने अवबद्धम्कामेन सुग्रीवम् अस्तकम् अद्य ॥४-३३-५४॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana I am aware of the irresistible strength of lust born out of the body. I am aware of Sugriva's indifference to his duty due to his passion with whomsoever it be.

raw: श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः । चमूं प्रकर्षन् महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम् ॥५-३६-३४॥
translation: "As soon as he hears your words from me, Rama will reach (here), leading a huge army of powerful troops of vanaras and bears.

raw: भार्गवाणाम् कुले जातः स्वाध्याय व्रत शालिनाम् । सहस्राक्षे प्रतिज्ञाय शस्त्रम् प्रक्ष्द् इप्तवान् असि ॥१-७५-७॥
translation: Born in the family of (saint) Bhrigu versed in the study of the Vedas and observance of vows. You have promised in the name of the thousandeyed Indra to renounce the arms.

raw: ततोऽम्बुधरसङ्काशं प्रवृद्धशिखरं गिरिम् । विचित्रकूटं कूटैश्च सर्वतः परिवारितम् ॥५-१४-२७॥
translation: The tiger among monkeys beheld a delightingful mountain, resembling the raincloud with tall, pleasing peaks, wonderful peaks spread all over the mountain. There were caves built of stone, with a variety of trees.

raw: न खल्वन्येन काकुत्स्थ श्रोतव्यमिदमुत्तमम् । परमम् ऋषिणा वीर त्वयैव रघुनन्दन ॥७-९८-२२॥
translation: Indeed, O Kakutstha, O hero, O delight of the Raghus, this excellent and supreme work, composed by the sage, is not to be heard by anyone else, but only by you.

raw: द्विजातीम्स् तु पदातीम्स् तान् रामः चारित्र वत्सलः । न शशाक घृणा चक्षुः परिमोक्तुम् रथेन सः ॥२-४५-१९॥
translation: Rama a man of probity and compassion could not ride off in his chariot while those brahmins were trudging far behind.

raw: न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुम् अर्हति भामिनी । न भोक्तुम् न अपि अलम्कर्तुम् न पानम् उपसेवितुम् ॥५-११-२॥
translation: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.

raw: तथोक्तो धर्मशीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रत: । लक्ष्मण: प्रविवेशेव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया ॥२-९७-१९॥
translation: Having heard the words uttered by his brother, Rama of virtuous disposition, Lakshmana who was devoted to his brother's welfare, shrank.

raw: न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये । कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैस्तु कातर्यं जनितं मम ॥४-११-८०॥
translation: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.

raw: इहैव निधनम् यामो महाप्रस्थानमेव वा । रामेण रहितानाम् हि किमर्थम् जीवितम् हि नः ॥२-४७-७॥
translation: We all will die here. We will go on the everlasting journey to death. Of what use is this life to us without Rama?

raw: अहम् वा अस्य रणे मृत्युः एष वा समरे मम । विनिवर्त्य रण उत्साहम् मुहूर्तम् प्राश्निको भव ॥३-२७-४॥
translation: Restrain yourself for a moment from the enthusiasm to fight the war. Please act as an arbitrator and see who is killing whom.

raw: अव्यक्तप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्यय: । तस्मान्मरीचि स्संजज्ञे मरीचे: काश्यप: सुत: ॥१-७०-२०॥
translation: "From the unmanifest was born the eternal, the constant, the imperishable Brahma. To him was born Marichi and to Marichi, Kasyapa.

raw: इदम् प्रविष्टाः सहसा बिलम् तिमिर संवृतम् । क्षुत् पिपासा परिश्रांताः परिखिन्नाः च सर्वशः ॥४-५१-२॥
translation: 'We are exhausted with thirst and hunger. We are fatigued. (Hence) we entered this dark cave all at once(without waiting for permission).

raw: भो महेन्द्रेशवरुणप्रजेश्वरधनेश्वराः । जानतामपि वः सर्वं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां हितम् ॥७-३६-८॥
translation: Brahma addressed the gods, including Mahendra, Ishvara, Varuna, Prajeshvara, and Dhaneshvara, stating that even though they might already know, he would speak to them about something beneficial, which they should hear.

raw: क्षत्रियो अहम् दशरथो न अहम् पुत्रः महात्मनः । सज्जन अवमतम् दुह्खम् इदम् प्राप्तम् स्व कर्मजम् ॥२-६४-१३॥
translation: O magnanimous sage I am a kshatriya known as Dasaratha. I am not your son. A pathetic incident has been caused by my own action, condemnable by the virtuous.

raw: देहीत्यन्यो ददात्यन्यो ददामीत्यपरः पुनः । किं क्लेशयसि तिष्ठेति तत्रान्योन्यं बभाषिरे ॥६-७५-६७॥
translation: There they conversed this way with one another 'One said hit me and another one offered to hit,', again another intervened and said, 'Why are you crying?' meaning I offer resistance, one said 'Why are you suffering like this?'.

raw: ततो रुद्रैर्महाघोरैः सङ्गम्याथ निशाचरः । प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च सङ्ग्रामे क्षतः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम् ॥७-२८-३६॥
translation: Then, the night-wanderer Kumbhakarna, having encountered and fought with the extremely terrible Rudras in battle, was continuously wounded by their weapons.

raw: विशालम् जघनम् पीनम् ऊरू करि कर उपमौ । एतौ उपचितौ वृत्तौ संहतौ संप्रगल्भितौ ॥३-४६-१९॥
तम् एव उवाच वचनम् सुग्रीवम् शत्रु सूदनः । कृत अभिज्ञान चिह्नः त्वम् अनया गज साह्वया ॥४-१४-८॥
प्रतिगृह्य ततः पूजां सम्पूज्य च महामुनिम् । जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशा हृष्टा नाकपृष्ठं सहानुगैः ॥७-७६-२२॥
translation: Having accepted the worship and honored the great sage, the delighted gods then departed to heaven with their followers.

raw: प्रमादाच्चरितं कच्चित्किञ्चिन्नावरजस्य मे । लक्ष्मणस्यर्षिभिर्दृष्टं नानुरूपमिवात्मन: ॥२-११६-६॥
translation: Have the sages found my younger brother Lakshmana doing something unbecoming of him through inadvertence?

raw: ततः कृष्णाजिनधरं कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् । ददर्श स्वसुतं तत्र मेघनादं भयावहम् ॥७-२५-४॥
translation: Then, he saw his own formidable son, Meghanada, there, wearing a black deer skin and distinguished by his water-pot and top-knot.

raw: यज्ञियम् च हयम् तत्र चरन्तम् अविदूरतः । ददर्श पुरुषव्याघ्रो दुःख शोक समन्वितः ॥१-४१-१४॥
translation: Possessed by grief and tears, Anshuman, that tiger among men, beheld the sacrificial horse grazing nearby.

raw: यो ह्यधर्ममकार्यं वा विषये पार्थिवस्य तु । करोति चाश्रीमूलं तत्पुरे वा दुर्मतिर्नरः । क्षिप्रं च नरकं याति स च राजा न संशयः ॥७-७४-२९॥
translation: Indeed, any evil-minded person who commits unrighteousness or an improper act, which is the root of misfortune, in the king's kingdom or city, quickly goes to hell, and so does the king, without a doubt.

raw: विभीषणं तं सुग्रीवो दृष्ट्वा वानरभीषणम् । ऋक्षराजं समीपस्थं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-८॥
translation: Beholding Vibheeshana, the Vanaras fled, said Sugriva to the great Jambavan who stood near him.

raw: यथा ऽ शनिरवेभ्यस्तु जायते ऽथ प्रतिश्रुतिः । तथा तयोर्गदापोथैर्दिशः सर्वाः प्रतिश्रुताः ॥७-३२-५५॥
translation: Just as an echo arises from the sounds of thunder, similarly, all directions reverberated with the impacts of their maces.

raw: अयुक्त चारम् दुर्दर्शम् अस्वाधीनम् नराधिपम् । वर्जयन्ति नरा दूरात् नदी पंकम् इव द्विपाः ॥३-३३-५॥
translation: Just as elephants keep away from a muddy river, people will keep distance from the king who does not employ spies, does not give audience to his people and is not independent.

raw: दह्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रासादं हरियूथपः । स राक्षसशतं हत्वा वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान् । अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-४३-१८॥
translation: Thereafter fire was generated (through friction) and with if the palace blazed. Hanuman saw the palace burning. He killed a hundred demons there as Indra killed demons with his thunderbolt. (The whirling pillar that generated fire apeared like a thunderbolt) Later he stood in the air and proclaimed this:

raw: अधर्मं धर्मवेषेण यदीमं लोकसङ्करम् । अभिपत्स्ये शुभं हित्वा क्रियाविधिविवर्जितम् ॥२-१०९-६॥
translation: If like a man who appears noble, though ignoble, clean, though unclean or dishonest, auspicious, though inauspicious, a man of character, though depraved, I forsake auspicious ways for unrighteousness, abandon pious acts and scriptural practices and indulge, under the cloak of dharma, in acts of wickedness by causing harm and confusion to the world, will any sensible man with a sense of discrimination between should and should not hold me in high esteem?

raw: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ॥५-३८-५३॥
translation: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka into ashes.

raw: केचिद्विनिहताः शूलै रुधिरार्द्रा वनौकसः । केचिद्विद्राविता नष्टाः सबलै राक्षसैर्युधि ॥६-५२-२१॥
translation: In the battlefield some Vanaras, attacked by Rakshasas, were floating on the ground in blood, dead.

raw: नलः प्रतपनस्याशु पातयामास चक्षुषी । भिन्नगात्रः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा ॥६-४३-२४॥
गच्छ शीघ्रम् इतो वीर सुग्रीवम् तम् महाबलम् । वयस्यम् तम् कुरु क्षिप्रम् इतो गत्वा अद्य राघव ॥३-७२-१७॥
translation: O Rama, immediately proceed today from here to mighty Sugriva. Having reached him, make him your friend without malice in the presence of burning fire.

raw: दिशम् अपि उत्तराम् सर्वाम् विविच्य स महाकपिः । आगतः सह सैन्येन वीरः शतबलिः तदा ॥४-४७-८॥
translation: Then the great monkey hero Satabali came back from the northern direction along with the army after searching in vain for Sita.

raw: आसीनम् पर्वतस्य अग्रे सर्व भूत नमस्कृतम् । सहस्र शिरसम् देवम् अनंतम् नील वाससम् ॥४-४०-५२॥
translation: 'O monkeys on top of the mountain you will see Ananta, a thousandhooded serpent seated, as bright as the Moon, robed in blue, with large eyes like lotus petals bearing the load of the earth, and revered by all beings.

raw: उत्पत्यचैनंतरसातलेनोरस्यताडयत् । स तेनाभिहतःकोपात्प्रमुमोहाचलोपमः ॥६-६७-४९॥
translation: Jumping up that way, Angada slapped him with his palm on the chest in anger. By that the mountain like Kumbhakarna became unconscious.

raw: रामादपि हि तम् मन्ये धर्मतो बलवत्तरम् । कथम् द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य वनम् गच्छेति भाषिते ॥२-१२-६२॥
स तत्र सीताम् परिदाय मैथिलीम् सह एव तेन अतिबलेन पक्षिणा । जगाम ताम् पंचवटीम् सलक्ष्मणो रिपून् दिधक्षन् शलभान् इव अनलः ॥३-१४-३६॥
translation: Entresting the protection of Sita, the princess of Mithila, to that strong vulture, Jatayu, and accompanied by Lakshmana Rama went to Panchavati wishing to destroy the enemies like fire burning the moths. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामयणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: इत्युदीरितवाक्ये तु देवे तस्मिन्महात्मनि । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता ॥७-१६-२१॥
translation: When those words were spoken by that great-souled god, divine drums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell from the sky.

raw: तदागन्तव्यमनिशं भवद्भिरिह सङ्गतैः । अगस्त्याद्यास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषयः संशितव्रताः ॥७-३६-६०॥
translation: Therefore, you should constantly come here assembled together; and Agastya and other sages of firm vows, having heard that (request)...

raw: अद्य शोक रसज्ञाः ताः भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः । अनुरूप कुलाः पत्न्यो यासाम् त्वम् पतिः ईदृशः ॥३-३०-११॥
translation: Your wives, who have got a husband like you, must have been born to a befitting race. They will taste the pangs of sorrow today, for no reasons whatsoever.

raw: अस्याहं दर्शनाकांक्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो । मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम् ॥५-५८-१३२॥
translation: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

raw: तथा ज्येष्ठा हि मे माता कौसल्या दीर्घ दर्शिनी । त्वयि धर्मम् समास्थाय भगिन्याम् इव वर्तते ॥२-७३-१०॥
translation: In the same way my eldest mother the farsighted Kausalya, too adhered to righteousness and conducted herself towards you like a sister.

raw: अतिक्रम्य महावीर्यान् किं प्रशंसथ रावणिम् ॥७-१-३८॥
यावन्न चरणौ भ्रातु: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ । शिरसा धारयिष्यामि न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥२-९८-८॥
translation: Peace shall not come to me until I hold on my head the feet of my brother, the insignia of royalty.

raw: अद्य मे कुशलं देव अद्य मे कुशलं व्रतम् । अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः । यस्माद्देवगणैर्वन्द्यौ वन्दे ऽहं चरणौ तव ॥७-३३-११॥
translation: O revered one, today is auspicious for me, my vow is fulfilled, my life is fruitful, and my penance is successful, because I bow to your feet, which are worshipped even by the hosts of gods.

raw: करोत्सेकेन मुक्तौ च प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम् । सुराणाममृतं वीरौ पीतवन्तौ प्लवङ्गमौ ॥५-५९-२०॥
translation: "The heroic monkeys, proud of their boons became intoxicated it and slaughtered vast army and drank the nectar of immortality.

raw: त्वाम् आसाद्य महात्मानम् धर्मज्ञम् धर्म वत्सलम् । अर्थित्वात् नाथ वक्ष्यामः तत् च नः क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-६-१०॥
translation: O lord, do excuse us. We sought your help to fulfil our needs since you are at hand. You are a great soul, knower and lover of dharma.

raw: न अराजके जन पदे प्रभूत नट नर्तकाः । उत्सवाः च समाजाः च वर्धन्ते राष्ट्र वर्धनाः ॥२-६७-१५॥
translation: In a country without a king, celebrations of associations promoting the welfare of the country, actors and dancers in large numbers do not prosper.

raw: ददृशुस्तां त्रयो लोका देवगन्धर्वदानवाः । शप्तां पतन्तीं निरये त्रिदिवाद्देवतामिव ॥६-११९-३३॥
translation: All the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas of the three worlds who witnessed her falling, extolled her as if goddess was falling from heaven into hell.

raw: सुवर्ण काराः प्रख्याताः तथा कम्बल धावकाः । स्नापक आच्चादका वैद्या धूपकाः शौण्डिकाः तथा ॥२-८३-१४॥
translation: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

raw: अवगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च । अस्तम् पर्वतम् आसाद्य पूर्णे मासे निवर्तत ॥४-४२-५२॥
translation: 'Go and find out Sita and the abode of Ravana. After this, return to the mountain behind which the Sun sets and come back on completion of a month.

raw: न हि मम हरि राज संश्रयात्क्षमतरम् अस्ति परत्र च इह वा । अभिमुख हत वीर सेवितम्शयनम् इदम् मम सेवितुम् क्षमम् ॥४-२१-१६॥
translation: There is nothing more befitting for me than joining the king of monkeys either here or in the next world. It is proper for me to resort to this resting place (pyre) used by this slain hero in front of me. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सुसंक्षिप्यात्मनः कायं बभूवाञ्गुष्ठमात्रकः । सोऽभिपत्याशु तद्वक्त्रं निष्पत्य च महाजवः । अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-१-१६८॥
translation: Glorious and mighty Hanuman quickly went into her mouth and got out and stood in the sky and said:.

raw: स निवृत्तो गुरोर्वाक्यान्मरुत्तः पृथिवीपतिः । विसृज्य सशरं चापं स्वस्थो मखमुखो ऽभवत् ॥७-१८-१९॥
translation: Following his guru's words, King Marutta turned back, abandoned his bow and arrows, and became composed and intent on his sacrifice.

raw: हन्यमाने बले तूर्णमन्योन्यं ते महामृधे । सरसीव महाघर्मे सोपक्षीणे बभूवतुः ॥६-९८-१॥
translation: In the major conflict, each one destroying the other army, it seemed like the midsummer lakes totally lost its water.

raw: अपिते चरणौ मूर्ध्ना स्पृशाम्येष प्रसीद मे । किमिदम् चिन्तितम् पापे त्वया परमदारुणम् ॥२-१२-१५॥
एष्यन्ति प्रेषिताः तत्र राम दूताः प्लवंगमाः । आख्येया राम महिषी त्वया तेभ्यो विहंगम ॥४-६२-११॥
translation: 'Rama's messenger and other monkeys will be coming to search for the his queen. O Sampati you should narrate this to them.

raw: अङ्गदं परिरक्षान्तौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च । तस्य तस्थातुरभ्याशे परस्परदिदृक्षया ॥६-७६-१५॥
translation: Both Mainda and Dwivida (maternal uncles of Angada) took position for the protection of one another facing the enemy.

raw: ततः निषाद अधिपतिम् दृष्ट्वा दूरात् अवस्थितम् । सह सौमित्रिणा रामः समागच्चद् गुहेन सः ॥२-५०-३५॥
तथा सञ्चोदितः सूतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । तद्वाक्यमृषिणा प्रोक्तं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥७-५१-१॥
translation: Thus urged by the great-souled Lakshmana, the charioteer began to narrate the words spoken by the sage.

raw: रथमास्थाय विपुलं तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः । मेघाभो मेघवर्णश्च मेघस्वनमहास्वनः । राक्षसैः संवृतो भीमैस्तदा निर्यात्यकम्पनः ॥६-५५-७॥
translation: Mounted on a huge chariot, Akampana, decked in pure gold jewels, like cloud in form and complexion, whose loud voice resembled thunder, surrounded by Rakshasas went forward.

raw: युद्धे कापुरुषैर्नित्यं भवद्भिः प्रियवादिभिः । राजानमनुगच्छद्भिः कृत्यमेतद्धि सादितम् ॥६-६५-६॥
translation: "You, who always fear in combat, are talking pleasingly to the king , going after him happily brought the matter to this state."

raw: प्रवृद्ध निद्रे शयिते त्वयि राक्षस पांसने । भविष्यन्ति अशरण्यानाम् शरण्या दण्डका इमे ॥३-३०-८॥
translation: When you, O vile demon, will go into eternal sleep the Dandaka grounds will provide shelter to those who deserve it here.

raw: रामो भामिनि लोकस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता । मर्यादानां च लोकस्य कर्ता कारयिता च सः ॥५-३५-११॥
translation: "O beautiful lady Rama is a protector of the four classes of society (Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaisya and Sudra) in the world. He follows codes of conduct and makes others follow them.

raw: स भास्करसहस्रस्य सङ्घातमिव भास्वरम् । रथमास्थाय शक्रारिरभिदुद्राव वानरान् ॥६-७१-४॥
translation: Adorned with a crown, Ravana glowing like a thousand suns collected together mounted the chariot and darted towards Vanaras.

raw: व्याघ्रो मृगमिवादाय मृगराडिव दन्तिनम् । ननाद हैहयो राजा हर्षादम्बुदवन्मुहुः ॥७-३२-६६॥
translation: The Haihaya king (Kārtavīrya Arjuna) roared repeatedly with joy, like a tiger seizing a deer or a lion capturing an elephant, and like a thundering cloud.

raw: अन्तरम् प्रेप्सुना तेन हत्वा गृध्रम् जटायुषम् । भार्या वियोगजम् दुःखम् प्रापितः तेन रक्ष्सा ॥४-६-४॥
महाबाहुम् महोरस्कम् सिंह विक्रांत गामिनम् । नृसिंहम् सिंह संकाशम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३५॥
translation: I am the faithful wife of the longarmed, broadchested Rama, a lion among men. His gait is the gait of an advancing, invincible lion.

raw: ततस्तु शिंशुपामूले जानकीं पर्यवस्थिताम् । अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्दिष्ट्या पश्यामि त्वामिहाक्षताम् ॥५-५६-१॥
translation: Then Hanuman offered salutations to Janaki, stationed at the foot of the simsupa tree, and said, "Luckily I see you unscathed."

raw: नेदुः बलस्य अभिमुखम् ज्वाल उद्गारिभिः आननैः । कबन्धः परिघ आभासो दृश्यते भास्कर अंतिके ॥३-२३-११॥
सुख उपविष्टम् राजानम् विश्वामित्रम् महातपाः । पप्रच्छ जपताम् श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठो ब्रह्मणः सुतः ॥१-५२-६॥
translation: Vasishta, son of Brahma, the greatest among those who recite prayers and possess rich asceticism enquired of king Viswamitra comfortably seated (before him):

raw: उपादाय समाक्रान्तैस्तथा जानपदैर्जनैः । रामाभिषेकसुमुखैरुन्मुखैः समलम्कृतम् ॥२-१५-३९॥
translation: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. The arches were studded with different gems and corals. Bright like dense autumnal cloud, it shone like the cave of mount Meru. It was ornamented with excellent garlands and precious diamonds. Pearls were strewn around. Decorated with sandal and aloe wood, it emitted, like the peak of mount Dardura, captivating fragrance৷৷ Sarasas and peacocks were singing sweetly. The palace was full of skilfully carved images of deer and other embellishments. It attracted the minds and the eyes of all living beings with brilliant splendour. Resplendent like the Sun and the Moon, it looked like the abode of Kubera and a reflected image of the abode of Mahendra. It was crowded with birds of various kinds. In height it was equal to the peak of mount Meru. Villagers thronged the palace with gifts, eagerly waiting with folded hands to see the spectacle of Rama's coronation. Lofty, it looked like a vast cloud. Welldecked and filled with various gems, it was crowded with hunchbacks and kiratas (hunters) too.

raw: रत्न माल्य अम्बर धरः पद्म पत्र निभ ईक्षणः । सर्वपुष्पमयीम् दिव्याम् शिरसा धारयन् स्रजम् ॥६-२२-१९॥
translation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

raw: नीलेषु नीला नव वारि पूर्णामेघेषु मेघाः प्रविभान्ति सक्ताः । दवाग्नि दग्धेषु दवाग्नि दग्धाःशैलेषु शैला इव बद्ध मूलाः ॥४-२८-४०॥
translation: 'Dark clouds filled with fresh water, leaning on dark clouds appear like boulders of rock, scorched with wild fire with their bases yet firmly rooted shining.

raw: प्राप्ते यूपः उच्छ्रये तस्मिन् षड् बैल्वाः खादिराः तथा । तावन्तो बिल्व सहिताः पर्णिनः च तथा अपरे ॥१-१४-२२॥
हिंसापरस्वहरणे परदाराभिमर्शनम् । त्याज्यमाहुर्दुराचारं वेश्म प्रज्वलितं यथा ॥६-८७-२३॥
translation: "Seizing the property of others, uniting with others wife, evil mindedness is said to be given up like getting out of a burning house."

raw: इति उक्त्वा परम प्रीतो गृह्य रामम् स लक्ष्मणम् । प्रविशन् आश्रम पदम् व्यरोचत महामुनिः । शशी इव गत नीहारः पुनर्वसु समन्वितः ॥१-२९-२५॥
एवम् उक्तः तु सौमित्रिः लक्ष्मणः शुभ लक्षणः । भूयो दुःख संआविष्टो दुःखितम् रामम् अब्रवी ॥३-५९-५॥
translation: Thus addressed, virtuous Lakshmana, overwhelmed with sorrow replied to the grief stricken Rama:

raw: कच्चित्सुखं नदीतीरे ऽवात्सी: काकुत्स्थ शर्वरीम् । कच्चित्ते सहसैन्यस्य तावत्सर्वमनामयम् ॥२-८९-५॥
translation: O scion of the Kakutstha race (Bharata) I trust, you and your army passed the night on the river bank comfortably without any inconvenience.

raw: मारीचस्य एव हृदयम् विभेद अशनि संनिभः । ताल मात्रम् अथ उत्प्लुत्य न्यपतत् स भृश आतुरः ॥३-४४-१६॥
काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने । पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः ॥५-३९-२८॥
translation: "O slayer of enemy heroes if you alone can accomplish this task the fame of doing this will be yours.

raw: प्लावयस्व त्वम् आत्मानम् नरोत्तम सदा उचिते । सलिले पुरुषश्रेष्ठ शुचिः पुण्यफलो भव ॥१-४४-१४॥
translation: O Best among men O Tiger among men take a dip in the eternally sacred waters, purify yourself and acquire holiness.

raw: ततो विमनसः सर्वे देवा वै मुनिपुंगव । प्रसादयन्ति देवेशम् तेषाम् प्रीतो अभवत् भवः ॥१-६६-११॥
translation: "O Eminent ascetic thereafter all the gods with agitated minds propitiated lord of the gods, Siva and he was pleased with them.

raw: ते मुहूर्तम् समाश्वस्ताः किंचित् भग्न परिश्रमाः । पुनर् एव उद्यताः कृत्स्नाम् मार्गितुम् दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥४-४९-२१॥
translation: Resting for a while, the frustrated monkeys resumed their search throughout the southern direction.

raw: शरम् अप्रतिमम् राम मोक्तुम् अर्हसि सु व्रत । शर मोक्षे गमिष्यामि महेन्द्रम् पर्वतोत्तमम् ॥१-७६-२०॥
translation: You are faithful to vows O Rama This arrow has no equal in prowess. It behoves of you to release it against me. After its release I shall go to the excellent Mahendra mountain".

raw: यत् करोति परम् धर्मम् मुनिः मूल फल अशनः । तत्र राज्ञः चतुर् भागः प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ॥३-६-१४॥
translation: One fourth of the supreme merit a sage earns by living on fruits and roots, accrues to the king through which the people are protected righteously.

raw: स रथं भूषयित्वा तु रुचिरं हेमभूषितम् । प्रासासिशतसम्पूर्णं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः ॥६-९१-९॥
translation: Ravana's son ascended a decorated chariot yoked to horses, directed by a charioteer who could tender good advice and a knower of the nature of horses. It was a beautiful chariot decked with darts and swords adorned with gold which Ravana's son of extraordinarily bright, who has won enemies, ascended.

raw: प्राज्य धूम आकुल वनः चीर माला परिष्कृतः । प्रशान्त मृग यूथः च नाना शकुनि नादितः ॥३-११-८०॥
translation: This forest is enveloped with the smoke rising from the sacrificial altar. There are rows of bark robes hanging. Herds of quiet animals lying and different kind of birds chirping around.

raw: चन्दन अगरु पद्मानाम् गन्धैः सुरभि गन्धिताम् । मैरेयाणाम् मधूनाम् च सम्मोदित महा पथाम् ॥४-३३-७॥
translation: The royal roads were filled with fragrant unguents, like sandal, agaru and lotus incenses, finesmelling honey of several kinds and happy inhabitants.

raw: ताम् समीक्ष्य तदा द्वाह्स्थो भृशम् पापस्य कारिणीम् । गृहीत्वा अकरुणम् कुब्जाम् शत्रुघ्नाय न्यवेदयत् ॥२-७८-८॥
translation: Seeing the hunchback, doer of many sinful deeds, the gatekeepers caught hold of her and informed Satrughna.

raw: स तु सुप्ते जने रात्रौ किष्किन्धा द्वारम् आगतः । नर्दति स्म सुसम्रब्धो वालिनम् च आह्वयत् रणे ॥४-९-५॥
translation: 'One midnight when all were asleep, he (Mayabi) came to the entrance of Kishkinda screaming angrily and bellowing at Vali, challenging him to a duel.

raw: शुभ अशुभास्व् अवस्थासु तच् च मे सुव्यवस्थितम् । न अन्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम् ॥५-११-४२॥
ततः स्वस्त्ययनम् कृत्वा मंत्रवित् विजय एषिणी । अंतःपुरम् सह स्त्रीभिः प्रविष्टा शोक मोहिता ॥४-१६-१२॥
translation: The wise counsellor, Tara bade him farewell, wishing him victory and then, overwhelmed with sorrow, entered the inner apartment followed by the womenfolk.

raw: इति भ्रातरमाश्वास्य हृष्ट स्सौमित्रिरब्रवीत् । अथावृत्य महीं कृत्स्नां जगाम महती चमू: ऋक्षवानरशर्दूलैर्न खदंष्ट्रायुधैर्वुता ॥६-४-५७॥
translation: Saumithri reassured his brother who was surrounded by the vanara force saying that those vanaras who use their nails and teeth as weapons and tigerlike bears spread all over the expansive land are proceeding.

raw: दृश्यमाने भवेत्प्रीतः सौहृदं नास्त्यपश्यतः । नाशयन्ति कृतघ्रास्तु न रामो नाशयिष्यति ॥५-२४-४१॥
शराणामन्तरेष्वाशु व्यवर्तत महाकपिः । हरिस्तस्याभिलक्ष्यस्य मोघयँल्लक्ष्यसंग्रहम् ॥५-४८-३१॥
translation: The great tawny monkey moved quickly between spaces of arrows that were aimed at him rendering hosts of Indrajit's targets futile.

raw: ततः दशरथ स्त्रीणाम् प्रासादेभ्यः ततः ततः । राम शोक अभितप्तानाम् मन्दम् शुश्राव जल्पितम् ॥२-५७-२०॥
translation: From different spots in the palace, Sumantra heard the sobs and whispers of Dasaratha's wives who were tormented with the sorrow of Rama's exile.

raw: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं मुनिभिः साप्सरोगणम् । जगद्धि सर्वमस्वस्थं पितामहमुपस्थितम् ॥७-६९-२१॥
translation: Indeed, the entire world, including gods, asuras, gandharvas, sages, and groups of Apsaras, became uneasy and approached Brahma.

raw: न च अधर्म्यम् वचः श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम् । विहाय शोक सम्तप्ताम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि माम् इतः ॥२-२१-२१॥
translation: By heeding the unrighteous words of my cowife (Kaikeyi) it does not behove you to leave me griefstricken and go away from here.

raw: मनसा प्रहसामि त्वां देवि दुःखार्धिता सती । यच्छोचितव्ये हृष्टासि प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत् ॥२-८-३॥
translation: O queen at a time when this great misfortune has befallen you, you are rejoicing instead of feeling miserable. I am indeed laughing at you at heart.

raw: श्रुत्वा एव उपस्थितौ वीरौ कदा अयोध्या भविष्यति । यशस्विनी हृष्ट जना सूच्च्रित ध्वज मालिनी ॥२-४३-१०॥
translation: When will the city of Ayodhya attain that glory when having heard that both the brave brothers have come back the people will rejoice and fill it with uplifted banners?

raw: सा अहम् एवम् गता श्रेष्ठा श्रुत धर्म पर अवरा । आर्ये किम् अवमन्येयम् स्त्रीणाम् भर्ता हि दैवतम् ॥२-३९-३१॥
translation: Instructed about my obligations by an eminent lady (her mother?), imbued with these ideals, how can I, O exalted one, underestimate him (my husband)? For a woman the husband is a god indeed

raw: न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो यथा भवान् पश्यति राजपुत्र । यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा तथा भवान् पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धम् ॥५-६०-७॥
translation: "O prince what you think is acceptable to us also. Even though we are capable of achieving, knowing what is in Rama's mind, we should act only according to his command to accomplish the task. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramyana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: मरणं वापि निश्चित्य शत्रूणां वा पराजयम् ॥६-६९-३७॥
ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्ना विपेतुर्भुवि भीमकायाः । ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ॥६-५९-४४॥
translation: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.

raw: क्रीडा गृहाणि च अन्यानि दारु पर्वतकान् अपि । कामस्य गृहकम् रम्यम् दिवा गृहकम् एव च ॥५-६-३७॥
translation: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.

raw: तच्छुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य गर्जितं लक्ष्णस्तदा । अभीतवदनः क्रुद्धो रावणिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-८८-१२॥
translation: On hearing Indrajith's words, Lakshmana spoke these words in anger with fearless countenance.

raw: तम् तु तारा परिष्वज्य स्नेहाद् दर्शित सौहृदा । उवाच त्रस्त संभ्रांता हित उदर्कम् इदम् वचः ॥४-१५-६॥
translation: Tara, perplexed out of fear, glanced at Vali lovingly, embraced him and gave him wise counsel:

raw: मया च स महाबाहुः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः । समाश्वासयितुं न्याय्यः सीतादर्शनलालसः ॥५-३०-१०॥
translation: "I should provide some comfort to the strongarmed Rama with a face like the fullmoon yearning to see Sita.

raw: ततः शशासेश्वरवद्दूतान् लघुपराक्रमान् । समानयत मे क्षिप्रमिहैतान् राक्षसानिति ॥६-११-१८॥
translation: Then that Lord like Ravana said "We have to do a great task against the enemies now. It has to be performed." He commanded quick footed messengers to get the Rakshasas to him at once.

raw: पादपानवभञ्जन्तो विकर्षन्त स्तथा लताः । विधमन्तो गिरिवरान्प्रययुः प्लवगर्षभाः ॥६-४-९२॥
translation: The vanaras (who are best among leaping animals) went smashing the trees, pulling out the creepers and purposefully destroying the mountains (on their way).

raw: यः ते प्रभावः सुग्रीव यत् च ते शौचम् ईदृशम् । अर्हः तम् कपि राज्यस्य श्रियम् भोक्तुम् अनुत्तमाम् ॥४-३६-१४॥
translation: 'You are powerful and straightforward by nature.You are humble and noble. Therefore, you deserve the high prosperity of the kingdom of the monkeys.

raw: राक्षसानां विशेषश्च पुरी चेयमवेक्षिता । राक्षसाधिपतेरस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च ॥५-३०-५॥
translation: "I have seen the ability of the demons and the citadel of Lanka. I have seen the power of Ravana the demon king.

raw: तं तु नैवंविध: कश्चित् प्राज्ञ: शोचितुमर्हति । तद्विधो यद्विधश्चापि श्रुतवान् बुद्धिमत्तर: ॥२-१०५-३८॥
translation: No one like you or me should ever mourn about this highly sagacious and learned king who was proficient in scriptural knowledge.

raw: निश्श्रेयसफलावेव धर्मार्थावितरावपि । अधर्मानर्थयोः प्राप्तिः फलं च प्रत्यवायिकम् ॥६-६४-८॥
translation: " All virtues and worldly pleasures and even otherwise give only benefit. But if done with disinterest and unrighteousness it can give a result which is other than prosperity."

raw: स शास्ति चिरम् ऐश्वर्यम् अरीम्श्च कुरुते वशे । सम्दधानो हि कालेन विगृह्णम्सः चारिभिः सह ॥६-३५-८॥
केचित् क्ष्वेलां प्रकुर्वन्ति केचित् कूजन्ति हृष्टवत् । हरयो मधुना मत्ताः केचित् सुप्ता महीतले ॥५-६२-१३॥
translation: Some roared, some warbled happily, some felt drowsy, drinking honey and some dropped off to sleep on the ground.

raw: धनदस्य सुतः श्रीमान् वानरो गन्धमादनः । विश्वकर्मा तु अजनयन् नलम् नाम महा कपिम् ॥१-१७-१२॥
translation: Kubera begot glorious Gandhamadana and Viswakarma begot a great monkey Nala.

raw: ततः ते सहिताः तत्र हि सः अंगदम् स्थाप्य च अग्रतः । सुग्रीव तारा सहिताः सिषिचुः वानरा जलम् ॥४-२५-५२॥
translation: Then the monkeys along with Sugriva and Tara positioning Angada in the forefront made waterofferings (to Vali) collectively.

raw: तेन पूरयता वेगान्मध्ये भग्नं द्विधा धनु: । तस्य शब्दो ऽभवद्भीम: पतितस्याशनेरिव ॥२-११८-४९॥
translation: When Rama was stringing the bow with force, it was broken into two in the middle and fell down with a dreadful sound like that of thunder.

raw: कम्पयन् मेदिनीम् सर्वाम् पातयन् च महान् द्रुमान् । तमसा संवृतः सूर्यः सर्वे न वेदिषुर् दिशः ॥१-७४-१४॥
योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्तीर्त्वाप्युत्तमविक्रमः । अनिःस्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति ॥५-२-३॥
translation: The glorious, powerful vanara (Hanuman) even after crossing a hundred yojanas, felt neither suffocated nor exasperated.

raw: जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः । पुष्पकं भेजिरे सर्वे सान्त्विता रावणेन तु ॥७-२३-३॥
translation: After Ravana had consoled them and celebrated their victory, Maricha and the other chiefs all boarded the Pushpaka chariot.

raw: तत्र तां प्रवणामेव मातरं क्षौमवासिनीम् । वाग्यतां देवतागारे ददर्शायाचतीं श्रियम् ॥२-४-३०॥
translation: There he beheld his mother in silk apparel engrossed in silent prayer (to the gods) for his royal fortune in the room meant for the worship of the gods.

raw: कथम् वीर्यः कथम् रूपः किम् कर्मा स च राक्षसः । क्व च अस्य भवनम् तात ब्रूहि मे परिपृच्छतः ॥३-६८-७॥
translation: O father how powerful is that demon ? How does he look?What work does he do? Where does he dwell? Do answer my questions?

raw: भरतश्च विसञ्ज्ञो ऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम् । राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥७-१०७-५॥
translation: Bharata also became unconscious upon hearing Rama's words, and condemning kingship, he spoke these words to Rama.

raw: यं समाश्रित्य जीवन्ति फेनपाः परमर्षयः । अमृतं यत्र चोत्पन्नं स्वधा च स्वधभोजिनाम् ॥७-२३-२३॥
translation: Great sages known as foam-drinkers subsist by depending on this ocean, and it is also where nectar and Svadhā, the offering for ancestors, originated.

raw: तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां शुभां काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् । ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्रं शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ॥६-६०-२६॥
translation: The tigers among Rakshasas entered the residence paved with gold and precious stones, a delightful one and saw sleeping Kumbhakarna of great prowess.

raw: त्वमेव तु ममार्थेषु नित्ययुक्ता हितैषिणी ॥२-९-३९॥
translation: O hunchback you alone always show interest in my affairs and seek my welfare. I might not have known the intended (deceptive) action of the king (without you).

raw: मन्त्रयित्वा प्रसुप्तो ऽयमितस्तु नवमे ऽहनि । तं तु बोधयत क्षिप्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥६-६०-१७॥
translation: "Deliberating like this with me, Kumbhakarna is sleeping for the ninth day from now. He may be quickly informed (aroused)."

raw: वरदास्तु महाबाहो सर्व एव समागताः । विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यममोघं दर्शनं हि नः ॥७-७०-३॥
translation: O mighty-armed one, all of us who have assembled here are indeed givers of boons, having desired your victory, and our presence here is certainly not in vain.

raw: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातः साक्षात् धर्म इव अपरः । धृतिमान् सुव्रतः श्रीमान् न धर्मम् हातुम् अर्हसि ॥१-२१-६॥
translation: "Born in the line of Ikshvaku, you are a veritable the second god of righteousness, firm adherent of vows auspicious and virtuous. It is not right on your part to abandon your promise.

raw: वसिष्ठ प्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखात् च्युतम् । ऋष्यशृङ्ग पुरोगाः च प्रति ऊचुः नृपतिम् तदा ॥१-१२-११॥
तम् पुनः प्रत्यानयित्वा वै तम् देशम् पतग ईश्वरम् । बभूवुः वानरा हृष्टाः प्रवृत्तिम् उपलभ्य ते ॥४-५८-३७॥
translation: Th mightiest of monkeys carried Sampati, whose wings were totally burnt, to the sea shore and after he had offered oblations took him back to the same place. Having obtained all information from the king of vultures the monkeys were very happy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं प्राप्तो ऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः । अस्मिन् क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ॥६-५९-९५॥
translation: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."

raw: श्रुत्वा तु तस्य निनदम् सर्वभूत प्रकंपनम् । मदः च एकपदे नष्टः क्रोधः च आपादितो महान् ॥४-१५-२॥
translation: The roar (of Sugriva) that frightened all beings gave Vali's vanity a jolt and at once aroused in him violent rage.

raw: तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह । वाक्यं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा प्रोवाच लक्ष्मणम् ॥७-१०२-१॥
translation: Having heard that, Rama, along with his brothers, felt great joy and then spoke amazing words to Lakshmana.

raw: ददृशुश्च महात्मानं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् । चरन्तं हरिसैन्येषु विद्याधरमहर्षयः ॥६-६९-७१॥
translation: Vidhyadhara, the great sage, witnessed Naranthaka moving seated on the horseback firmly.

raw: भेरीमृदङ्गाभिरुतम् शङ्खघोषनिनादितम् । नित्य अर्चितम् पर्व हुतम् पूजितम् राक्षसैः सदा ॥५-६-१२॥
translation: Reverberating with the sounds of trumpets, mridangam and conches, there the demons daily performed worships and sacrifices on new and fullmoon days.

raw: राज स्त्री बाल वृद्धानाम् वधे यत् पापम् उच्यते । भृत्य त्यागे च यत् पापम् तत् पापम् प्रतिपद्यताम् ॥२-७५-३७॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin as one acquires for murdering a king, a woman, children and the aged and deserting dependents

raw: परिभ्रमति चित्राणि मण्डलानि विनिष्पतन् । समुद्वीक्ष्य च सर्वे तम् मृगा ये अन्ये वनेचराः ॥३-४२-२८॥
बलोद्धतौ यथा नागौ वाशितार्थे यथा वृषौ । मेघाविव विनर्दन्तौ सिंहाविव बलोत्कटौ ॥७-३२-५२॥
translation: They were like two elephants arrogant with strength, like two bulls fighting over a cow, like two roaring clouds, and like two exceedingly strong lions.

raw: ललाटे भ्रुकुटीभिश्च सङ्गताभिर्व्यारोचत । युगान्ते सह नक्रैस्तु महोर्मिभिरिवोदधिः ॥६-९३-१८॥
translation: Ravana's eyebrows contracted on his forehead, he shone like the waves in the great ocean with crocodiles at the time of dissolution of the universe.

raw: यदि दत्वा वरौ राजन् पुनः प्रत्यनुतप्यसे । धार्मिकत्वम् कथम् वीर पृथिव्याम् कथयिष्यसि ॥२-१२-३९॥
translation: O valiant king, if you repent like this after having given two boons, how will you talk about your righteousness on this earth?

raw: किम् नु मृत्योर् भयम् न अस्ति माम् वक्तुम् परुषम् वचः । यस्य मे शासतो जिह्वा प्रयच्चति शुभ अशुभम् ॥६-२९-११॥
translation: "Did you not have fear of death when you spoke such harsh words to me, who can by mere order make good or evil to you?"

raw: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः । गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान् हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे ॥६-४१-४४॥
translation: Vanaras who resembled tigers, endowed with sharp teeth joyfully stood there holding trees and peaks of mountain waiting to combat.

raw: तयोः अन्वेषतोः एवम् सर्वम् तत् वनम् ओजसा । संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दः प्रभंजन् इव तत् वनम् ॥३-६९-२४॥
translation: As both the brothers with great prowess were searching for Sita all over, a huge sound exploded as if shattering the forest.

raw: न अत्यर्थम् अभिकान्क्षामि मृगयाम् सरयू वने । रतिर् हि एषा अतुला लोके राज ऋषि गण सम्मता ॥२-४९-१६॥
translation: In this world, hunting is a unique pleasure. It is regarded as a delightful sport for royal sages. But I do not have a great longing for hunting in the forest on the bank of river Sarayu.

raw: उद्वेजनीयो भूतानाम् नृशंसः पाप कर्मकृत् । त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् ईश्वरो अपि न तिष्ठति ॥३-२९-३॥
translation: One who is wicked, does sinful deeds and causes distress to all beings, will not survive even if he is the lord of the three worlds.

raw: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् । त्रासयन् रावणं धीमान् हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-५४॥
translation: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.

raw: निविष्टमात्रे सैन्ये तु यथोद्देशं विनीतवत् । भरतो भ्रातरं वाक्यं शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९८-२॥
translation: After the army encamped in the assigned places, Bharata said to his brother Satrughna thus:

raw: धिक् कष्टम् इति निह्श्वस्य राजा शोक परिप्लुतः । मूर्चितः न्यपतत् तस्मिन् पर्यन्के हेम भूषिते ॥२-१९-१७॥
translation: 'Fie, what a calamity' sighing thus, the king, overwhelmed with sorrow, fainted and fell back on the golden couch.

raw: एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा । अधः शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे ॥५-५९-३१॥
translation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

raw: एष क्रोशति नत्यूहः तम् शिखी प्रतिकूजति । रमणीये वन उद्देशे पुष्प सम्स्तर सम्कटे ॥२-५६-९॥
translation: In this delightful forest region strewn with fallen flowers the peacock is responding to the screaming of natyuha bird.

raw: भरतः च अपि वक्तव्यो यथा राजनि वर्तसे । तथा मातृषु वर्तेथाः सर्वास्व् एव अविशेषतः ॥२-५२-३४॥
translation: You should tell Bharata that just as he treats the king so should he treat all the mothers without differentiating betwen them.

raw: एभिश्च सचिवै: सार्द्धं शिरसा याचितो मया । भ्रातु: शिष्यस्य दासस्य प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-१२॥
translation: With my head bowed down, I beseech you along with all these ministers to show favour to me who is your brother, disciple and slave.

raw: को नु दार प्रणाशम् ते साधु मन्येत राघव । सरितः सागराः शैला देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ॥३-६५-११॥
ततो रंभः तु अनुप्राप्तः तरुण आदित्य संनिभः । आयुतेन वृतः चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च ॥४-३९-३३॥
translation: Thereafter Rambha of the colour of the rising Sun brought together an army of one thousand and one hundred ayuta troops.

raw: न ते ददृशिरे रामं दहन्तमरिवाहिनीम् । मोहिताः परमास्त्रेण गान्धर्वेण महात्मना ॥६-९४-२६॥
translation: The Rakshasas got confused by the supreme missile presided over by Gandharvas, released by Rama, which was burning their army, and were not able to see.

raw: स यन्तरि महातेजा हते मन्दोदरीसुतः ॥६-९०-४३॥
translation: When the charioteer got killed, the brilliant son of Mandodari, played the role of charioteer and wielded the bow again.

raw: मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव हनुमान् जांबवान् अपि । अंगदो युव राजः च तारः च वनगोचरः ॥४-५०-६॥
translation: Having explored the region surrounded by a network of mountains, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda and also Dvivida, Sushena, Jambavan, Angada the heir apparent, Tara the forestdweller staying close to one another and Hanuman too not far from the others searched in the southern direction. While they were exploring, they saw the mouth of a large cave called Rikshabilam, which had its mouth open, guarded by a demon.

raw: स मार्गमाणस्तां देवीं रामः सीतामनिन्दिताम् । आससाद वने मित्रं सुग्रीवं नाम वानरम् ॥५-३१-११॥
translation: "While looking for the goddesslike lady, the sinless Sita in the forest, Rama met a monkey called Sugriva and made friendship with him

raw: वातसङ्घातजातोर्मिचन्द्रांशुशिशिराम्बुमत् । भुजङ्गयक्षगन्धर्वप्रबुद्धकमलोत्पलम् ॥५-५७-३॥
translation: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.

raw: सन्निपत्य च रक्षांसि दग्धशैलोपमो महान् । कुम्भकर्णो महावक्त्रः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६५-४३॥
translation: Thus spoke, Kumbhakarna who resembled a charred mountain, with wide mouth, reaching near the Rakshasas, laughing.

raw: मिथ्या प्रव्राजितः रामः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः । भरते सम्निषृष्टाः स्मः सौनिके पशवो यथा ॥२-४८-२८॥
translation: Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana has been deceitfully exiled and all of us delivered to Bharata like beasts to a butcher (for protection).

raw: तत् तु श्रुत्वा तदा वाक्यम् अंगदस्य मुख उद्गतम् । अब्रवीत् वचनम् गृध्रः तीक्ष्ण तुण्डो महास्वनः ॥४-५६-१८॥
मम प्राणैः प्रियतरम् पुत्रम् पुत्रम् इव औरसम् । मया हीनम् अहीनार्थम् सर्वतः परिपालय ॥४-२२-९॥
translation: 'He is dearer to me than my life. Take care of him like your own son. He is separated from me. Take care of him in all respects, so that he is not deprived of anything.

raw: सुखम् हि कारणम् श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर । आनन्तर्यद् विधास्यामि संप्रधार्य बलाबलम् ॥४-८-४२॥
translation: 'On hearing the cause of your enmity and considering your strength and weakness, I will take steps to make you happy.

raw: महारोम्णस्तु धर्मात्मा स्वर्णरोमा व्यजायत । स्वर्णरोम्णस्तु राजर्षेर्ह्रस्वरोमा व्यजायत ॥१-७१-१२॥
translation: To Maharoma's was born the virtuous Swarnaroma. Swarnaroma's son was Hrasvaroma.

raw: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही परिमोहित चेतना । उवाच अश्रूणि मुंचन्ती दारुणम् माम् इदम् वचः ॥३-५९-१६॥
translation: Deluded by her senses, Vaidehi said these words, shedding tears when I tried to console her:

raw: करिष्ये सर्वम् एव अहम् आर्या यद् अनुशास्ति माम् । अभिज्ञा अस्मि यथा भर्तुर् वर्तितव्यम् श्रुतम् च मे ॥२-३९-२७॥
translation: I shall do exactly all that the venerable motherinlaw instructs me. I have heard it earlier and have fully understood as to how I should conduct myself towards my husband.

raw: अमित बल पराक्रमा भवन्तोविपुल गुणेषु कुलेषु च प्रसूताः । मनुज पति सुताम् यथा लभध्वम्तत् अधिगुणम् पुरुषार्थम् आरभध्वम् ॥४-४१-४९॥
translation: (Note:The Vindhya range and the several rivers mentioned here are not south of Kishkinda.The inconsistency is irreconcilable. Candidly speaking the geographical description is not at all factual. Some interpolator in the north (Kurukshetra as central region) has committed several anachronous inconsistencies betraying his ignorance of geography.) इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्दाकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: क्षत्र रोषात् प्रशांतः त्वम् ब्राह्मणः च महातपाः । बालानाम् मम पुत्राणाम् अभयम् दातुम् अर्हसि ॥१-७५-६॥
translation: "You are a brahmana, highly renowned and withdrawn from anger against kshatriyas. It behoves of you to give assurance of security to my sons who are young.

raw: आर्तस्य हृत दारस्य परुषम् पुरुष अन्तरात् । वचनम् मर्षणीयम् ते राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥४-३२-१६॥
translation: 'The message sent by a man who is in distress, and is deprived of his wife should be accepted even if they are harsh since he is a great self (who has rendered you help).

raw: तेन शब्देन महता प्रत्यबुध्यत वानरः । मद विह्वल ताम्राक्षो व्याकुल स्रग्वि भूषणः ॥४-३१-४१॥
translation: By the great sound (of the monkeys) the drunken redeyed vanara king awakened, his garlands and ornaments in disarray.

raw: रक्षाम्सि वक्षाम्सि च विक्षिपन्ति । गात्राणि कान्तासु च विक्षिपन्ति । रूपाअणि चित्राणि च विक्षिपन्ति । दृढानि चापानि च विक्षिपन्ति ॥५-५-१२॥
translation: The demons were seen expanding their chests sportively and caressing their wives by placing their limbs on them. They were assuming wonderful forms, and drawing their bows up to their ears.

raw: धात्र्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कुब्जा क्षिप्रममर्षिता । कैलासशिखराकारात्प्रासादादवरोहत ॥२-७-१२॥
translation: Having heard these words of the royal maid, the hunchback became furious and speedily descended from that palace resembling the peak of mount Kailasa.

raw: तपसा च अभि संप्राप्ता ब्रह्मणो हि प्रसादजा । शस्त्रेण अवध्यता लोके अच्छेद्य अभेद्यत्वम् एव च ॥३-३-६॥
translation: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.

raw: ततो मन्युर्वसिष्ठस्य प्रादुरासीन्महात्मनः । अदर्शनेन राजर्षेर्व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥७-५५-१६॥
translation: Then, anger arose in the great-souled Vasiṣṭha due to the absence of the royal sage, and he began to speak.

raw: स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्दीकृतच्छविः । कृतकर्मा निभृतवत् स्वतूणीं पुनरागमत् ॥६-१११-१९॥
translation: That arrow of Rama, on killing Ravana, soaked in blood, having accomplished the task quietly reentered its quiver.

raw: बहवः शत्रवश्चापि संयुगेषु निपातिताः । त्रिषु लोकेषु रत्नानि भुङ्क्ते चाहृत्य रावणः ॥६-९३-४३॥
जनयामास धर्मज्ञः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम् । तस्मिञ्जाते तु संहृष्टः सम्बभूव पितामहः ॥७-३-६॥
translation: This knower of Dharma begot a child endowed with all divine qualities, and when he was born, the grandfather (Brahma) became greatly delighted.

raw: तस्मात् आहार वीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः । आयोजन शतात् साग्रात् वयम् पश्याम नित्यशः ॥४-५८-३२॥
translation: 'O monkeys therefore, by the strength of food and by nature we can always see beyond a hundred yojanas from this edge.

raw: यः तु एनम् विषम आचारः पाप कर्मा अधिरोहति । तत्र एव प्रहरन्ति एनम् सुप्तम् आदाय राक्षसाः ॥३-७३-३४॥
translation: If an evildoer or a sinner ascends the (Rishyamuka) mountain, he, in his sleep, will be thrown down with asleep by the demons from there itself. A sinner does not climb this mountain of uneven terrain.

raw: स्थितह् ककुद्मानिव तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो । महाचलः श्वेत इवोच्चशृङ्गः । हस्तीव जाम्बूनदबद्धशृङ्गो । रराज चन्द्रह् परिपूर्णशृङ्गः ॥५-५-५॥
translation: The fullmoon with its hornlike spot shone like a bull with sharp horns, like the white Himalayan mountain with its lofty peaks, and like an elephant with gold plated tusks

raw: स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा यान आसन समावृताः । प्रविश्य सुमहत् गुप्तम् ददर्श अंतःपुरम् महत् ॥४-३३-१९॥
translation: Righteous Lakshmana crossed the seven enclosures filled with different kinds of people and saw a great harem full of several bright gold and silver cots, excellent seats here and there with best of cushions spread.

raw: आयसीं तु गदां वीरः प्रगृह्य कनकाङ्गदः । शोणिताक्षः समाविध्य तमेवानुपपात ह ॥६-७६-१२॥
translation: Sonitha adorned with golden armlets taking hold of iron mace rushed behind Angada.

raw: अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राजा कुशलम् एव च । अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राघवौ बलशालिनौ ॥४-५५-१३॥
इत्युक्तस्तेन विप्रेण तद्धनु: समुपानयत् । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदानम्य स वीर्य्यवान् ॥२-११८-४७॥
translation: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.

raw: तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह संप्राप्तान् अतिथीन् इव । महाकपालस्य शिरः चिच्छेद रघुनंदनः ॥३-२६-२०॥
अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगाम उत्तर पर्वतम् ॥१-७४-१॥
translation: Night over, the great ascetic Viswamitra, profusely blessed the princes born in the race of Raghu, took leave of the two kings and set out towards the northern (Himalayas) mountains.

raw: तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं त्वास्यं वायुपुत्रः सुबुद्धिमान् । दीर्घजिह्वं सुरसया सुघोरं नरकोपमम् ॥५-१-१६७॥
translation: Intelligent Hanuman observing Surasa's enlarged mouth open and dreadful like hell with a long tongue, suddenly shrunk his body to the size of a thumb.

raw: असौ रणान्तः स्थितिसंधिवालो विदग्धरक्षोमृगहा नृसिंहः । सुप्तस्त्वया बोधयितुं न युक्तः शराङ्गपूर्णो निशितासिदंष्ट्रः ॥३-३१-४७॥
translation: Rama is a lion in the form of man, a lion on warfront with its tail touching the waist when angry. This lion is deft in killing deer in the form of clever demons. His body is full of arrows. The sharp swords are his pointed teeth. It does not behove you to rouse such a lion who is asleep.

raw: कालाग्निनेव घोरेण तप्तेनैव महार्चिषा । पतता वृत्रशिरसा जगत्ऺत्रासमुपागमत् ॥७-८५-१४॥
translation: As Vritra's head fell, burning like the terrible, great-flamed fire of universal destruction, the world experienced immense terror.

raw: अथ राक्षससिंहस्य कृष्णान् कनकभूषणान् । शरैश्चतुर्भिः सौमित्रिर्विव्याध चतुरो हयान् ॥६-९०-३९॥
translation: Then Saumithri pierced with four shafts all the four black horses decked in gold, of the lion of Rakshasas (Indrajith) and finished them

raw: अनेन वयसा दृष्ट्वा यथा स्वर्गमवाप्नुयाम् । इत्येतै र्विविधै स्तैस्तै रन्यपार्थिवदुर्लभैः ॥२-१-४०॥
अतः दुह्खतरम् किम् नु प्रमदानाम् भविष्यति । त्वयि सम्निहिते अपि एवम् अहम् आसम् निराकृता ॥२-२०-४०॥
नारायणगिरिं ते तु गर्जन्तो राक्षसाम्बुदाः । ववर्षुः शरवर्षेण वर्षेणेवाद्रिमम्बुदाः ॥७-७-१॥
translation: Those roaring demon-clouds, like actual clouds showering rain upon a mountain, indeed showered a rain of arrows upon the mountain-like Narayana (Vishnu/Rama).

raw: आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः । कविर्विश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः ॥६-१०७-१४॥
translation: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.

raw: सो अपश्यमः ताम् महा बाहुः पश्यमः च अन्या वर स्त्रियः । विषसाद महा बाहुर् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-१२-२३॥
translation: The longarmed Hanuman, son of the Windgod was able to see other great women but not Sita. So he became despondent.

raw: रोहिता नाम गंधर्वा घोरम् रक्षन्ति तद् वनम् । तत्र गंधर्व पतयः पंच सूर्य सम प्रभाः ॥४-४१-४२॥
अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगणोत्तम । क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम् ॥५-४०-४॥
translation: "O best leader of vanaras remind Rama about the incident of the release of a blade of grass in anger blinding one of the eyes of the crow narrated to you.

raw: तानि दिव्यानि भद्रम् ते ददामि अस्त्राणि सर्वशः । दण्ड चक्रम् महत् दिव्यम् तव दास्यामि राघव ॥१-२७-४॥
ततः स कपिशार्दुलो लङ्काया ताडितो भृशम् । ननाद सुमहानादम् वीर्यवान् पवनात्मजः ॥५-३-३९॥
translation: At this strong slap, the heroic Hanuman, son of the Windgod roared loudly.

raw: इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम् । इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन् ॥६-१२२-३७॥
translation: Having admonished the two glowing sons, and Sita, Dasaratha went by aerial car to the world of Indra.

raw: सत्यात् पाणि गृहीतः च कृत कर्मा महायशाः । विस्मृतो राघवो येन स कस्य सुकृतम् स्मरेत् ॥४-५५-५॥
translation: 'Illustrious Rama, who faithfully held his hand was forgotten after he received his help. Indeed whose help would he remember?

raw: तेषु तेषु महार्हेषु भवनेषु महायशाः । गृहेष्वृद्धिमतामृद्धिं ददाह स महाकपिः ॥५-५४-१७॥
translation: Moving among those highly luxurious mansions the glorious Vanara burnt away the wealth of all the rich demons.

raw: परिगृह्य च बाहुभ्यां परिवृत्य शिरोधराम् । उत्पाटयामास शिरो भैरवं नदतो महत् ॥६-७७-२३॥
translation: Taking hold of the neck with both arms and twisting it round Hanuman broke off the neck of Nikumbha while he was crying terribly.

raw: इति हृदय मनो विदारणम्मुनि वचनम् तद् अतीव शुश्रुवान् । नरपतिः अभवत् महान् महात्माव्यथित मनाः प्रचचाल च असनात् ॥१-१९-२२॥
translation: The great king felt shaken off his throne after listening to the words of the sage (Viswamitra) which broke his heart and terribly upset his mind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तासां नास्ति विशेषो हि दर्शने लक्षणे ऽपि वा । ततो ऽहमेकाग्रमनास्ताः प्रजाः परिचिन्तयम् ॥७-३०-२२॥
translation: Indeed, there was no distinction among them in appearance or even in characteristics, so I pondered deeply about those creatures with a concentrated mind.

raw: भवान् सर्वत्र कुशलः सर्वभूत हिते रतः । आख्यातः शरभंगेन गौतमेन महात्मना ॥३-७-१६॥
translation: You are ever engaged in the welfare of all beings. I have heard this from the great sage Sarabhanga of Gautama's clan.

raw: छत्रं धारयत क्षिप्रमार्यपादाविमौ मतौ । आभ्यां राज्ये स्थितो धर्म: पादुकाभ्यां गुरोर्मम ॥२-११५-१६॥
translation: Hold the royal paresol now. This is the accepted symbol of the exalted feet of my brother. These sandals shall establish righteousness in the kingdom.

raw: आघ्राय रामस्तं मूर्ध्नि परिष्वज्य च राघव: । अङ्के भरतमारोप्य पर्यपृच्छत् समाहितः ॥२-१००-३॥
translation: Born in the race of Raghu, Rama embraced Bharata and kissed him on his forehead. Placing him on his lap, he enquired thus with a composed mind:

raw: अतिथिः किलपूजार्हः प्राकृतोऽपि विजानता । धर्मं जिज्ञासमानेन किं पुनस्त्वादृशो महान् ॥५-१-१२०॥
translation: "Even a newcomer, however ordinary, deserves worship by a wise man who wishes to educate himself in the path of righteousness. Needless to say that distinguished guest like you deserves all reverence.

raw: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः । न च सर्वे रणे शक्ता रामं प्रतिसमासितुम् ॥५-६७-२०॥
वायुप्रकोपाद्भूतानि निरुच्छ्वासानि सर्वतः । सन्धिभिर्भिद्यमानैश्च काष्ठभूतानि जज्ञिरे ॥७-३५-५१॥
translation: Due to the wrath of Vayu, creatures everywhere became breathless, and with their joints splitting, they became like lifeless wood.

raw: कृतंभारसहस्रस्यशूलंकालायसंमहत् । बभञ्जजानुमारोप्यतदाहृष्टःप्लवङ्गमः ॥६-६७-६४॥
translation: Then a rejoiced monkey, resting the thousand bharas iron pike on his knee broke it.

raw: जटाबन्धनम् अन्यः तु काष्ठ रज्जुम् मुदान्वितः । यज्ञ भाण्डम् ऋषिः कश्चित् काष्ठभारम् तथा परः ॥१-४-२४॥
तिष्ठतः किम् नु माम् दृष्ट्वा क्षुधा आर्तम् क्षत्रिय ऋषभौ । आहार अर्थम् तु सन्दिष्टौ दैवेन गत चेतसौ ॥३-७०-२॥
translation: O bulls among the kshatriyas You are sent by destiny as food to appease my hunger. Seeing me hungry, why do you stand there with your senses switched off ?

raw: गतेषु ब्रह्मपूर्वेषु देवेष्वथ नभस्थलम् । वने स पितरं प्राह प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतात्मवान् । निवासनं न मे देवो विदधे स प्रजापतिः ॥७-३-२२॥
translation: After Brahma and the other gods departed to the heavens, Ravana, with folded hands and a controlled mind, addressed his father in the forest, stating that Brahma had not provided him with a dwelling place.

raw: सालं चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद वानरं पञ्चभिर्भुजे । उरस्येकेन बाणेन दशभिस्तु स्तनान्तरे ॥५-४४-१४॥
translation: He struck the sala tree with four arows, the arm of Hanuman with five arrows, chest with one, the hollow of the chest with ten more arrows.

raw: पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्चैव वषट्कारस्तथैव च । ओङ्कारश्च महातेजास्तमाश्रममुपागमत् ॥७-९०-९॥
translation: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaṣaṭkāra, and the greatly effulgent Oṅkāra also similarly approached that hermitage.

raw: कथं त्वं राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः । जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ॥६-६३-३९॥
translation: "O Sinless Ravana! As I am going to kill this son of Dasaratha whom Rakshasas are intending to kill, how can Rama kill you now?"

raw: स शरीरस्य भद्रम् वः त्रिहन्कोः अस्य भूपतेः । आरोहणम् प्रतिज्ञातम् न अनृतम् कर्तुम् उत्सहे ॥१-६०-२७॥
translation: "I wish you well Having promised king Trisanku ascent to heaven with his physical form, I do not wish to go back on my word.

raw: पूर्वमुक्तो ऽहमनया गङ्गातीरे ऽहमाश्रमान् । पश्येयमिति तस्याश्च कामः संवर्त्यतामयम् ॥७-४५-२३॥
translation: She had previously told me that she wished to see the hermitages on the bank of the Ganga, so let this desire of hers be fulfilled.

raw: क्रेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने । महागज इन्वारण्ये स्नेहात्परिममर्श ताम् ॥२-१०-२६॥
translation: Like a mighty sheelephant caressing her cow wounded with a poisoned arrow in the forest, he caressed her lovingly.

raw: ताम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् विसम्ज्ञाम् इव दुह्खिताम् । उवाच वचनम् रामः परिविश्वासयम्स् तदा ॥२-३०-२६॥
translation: With his arms Rama embraced Sita who had almost fainted in grief. And in order to create confidence in her he said these words:

raw: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः । प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्वाभिः स्त्रीभिरचोदयत् ॥६-११७-८॥
translation: When Rama had spoken in that manner, Vibheeeshana for his part hastened to the Gynaeceum and assigned through the women to convey to Sita.

raw: राम चाप विसृष्टेन शरेण अंतकरेण तम् । दृष्ट्वा विनिहतम् भूमौ तारा ताराधिप आनना ॥४-२०-१॥
translation: Beholding her husband lying on the ground pierced by a deathdealing arrow released by Rama, the lovely moonfaced Tara went and embraced him.

raw: स लोकान् आहिताग्नीनाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम् । देवानाम् च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्म लोकम् व्यरोहत ॥३-५-४२॥
translation: Sarabhanga then went beyond the worlds of the gods, of the great sages who constantly kindle sacrificial fire, and ascended to the world of Brahman.

raw: हतोऽहम् पुरुषव्याघ्रः शक्र तुल्य बलेन वै । मया तु पूर्वम् त्वम् मोहान् न ज्ञातः पुरुषर्षभः ॥३-४-१४॥
translation: You have killed me, O Rama, a tiger among men. You are equal to Indra in prowess. O best of men, out of delusion I could not recognise you earlier.

raw: देवानां दानवानां च ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् । हितमेव भविष्यद्धि रामप्रव्राजनादिह ॥२-९२-३०॥
translation: Banishment of Rama will bring about the welfare of the gods, the demons, and the sages of purified souls.

raw: भूषणानि च मुख्यानि तानि सेव मया सह । पुष्पकम् नाम सुश्रोणि भ्रातुः वैश्रवणस्य मे ॥३-५५-२९॥
तासां मध्यात् समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत् । आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति ॥५-५८-८४॥
translation: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

raw: एवम् उक्ते तयोः वाक्यम् सर्व एव महर्षयः । विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य रामम् वचनम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-३१-५॥
translation: Addressed, thus by both of them, Viswamitra ahead of all the sages, spoke to Rama.

raw: इन्द्रजित्तु महामायः सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः । विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां पितरं चाभ्युपागमत् ॥६-४६-४६॥
translation: Great Indrajith surrounded by all army entered the city of Lanka and approached his father.

raw: तस्य मे कुरु साचिव्यम् तस्य भार्य अपहरणे । राक्षसेन्द्र वचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-४१॥
बालिशः खलु कामात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः । इति वक्ष्यन्ति मां सन्तो जानकीमविशोध्य हि ॥६-१२१-१५॥
translation: "The people will surely say that mighty Dasharatha's son, Rama being lusty at heart has accepted Janaki without testing."

raw: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनैर्युक्तः पृथुश्रीः पार्थिवर्षभः । पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां विश्रुतः सुखदः सुखी ॥५-३१-५॥
translation: "Endowed with signs of kingship and vast wealth, he was a bull among rulers of the vast earth, surrounded by the sea. A happy king himself, he was wellknown as a provider of happiness.

raw: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनम् कैकेयी विरराम ह । विलपन्तम् च राजानम् न प्रतिव्याजहार सा ॥२-१२-५०॥
translation: Kaikeyi, having spoken to this extent remained silent. She heeded not the lament of the king.

raw: यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति । पूर्वम् चापरकर्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ ॥६-१२-३२॥
translation: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."

raw: तिष्ठेदानीं न मे जीवन्प्रतियास्यसि दुर्मते । अद्य त्वां निशितैर्बाणैः प्रेषयामि यमक्षयम् ॥७-१८-१४॥
translation: Marutta declares, "Stop now, O evil-minded one, you will not return alive from me; today I will send you to Yama's abode with sharp arrows."

raw: स्कन्दोत्सृष्टेव सा शक्तिर्गोविन्दकरनिस्सृता । काङ्क्षन्ती राक्षसं प्रायान्माहेन्द्रीवाञ्जनाचलम् ॥७-८-१२॥
translation: That spear, released from Govinda's hand, flew towards the demon as if thrown by Skanda, desiring to strike, just as Indra's thunderbolt strikes the Anjana mountain.

raw: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनु: श्रेष्ठं गौरवाद्गिरिसन्निभम् । अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने ॥२-११८-४३॥
translation: Beholding the mighty bow resembling a mountain in weight, the kings, unable to lift it, paid their homage and left.

raw: पुनः प्रजापतिः प्रीतो विभीषणमुवाच ह । धर्मिष्ठस्त्वं यथा वत्स तथा चैतद्भविष्यति ॥७-१०-३४॥
translation: Prajapati, being pleased, again said to Vibhishana, "As you are righteous, dear child, so shall this be."

raw: जुह्वत्य् अग्नीम्सः च विधिवद् वेदाम्सः च उच्चैर् अधीयते । अभिभूय च रक्षाम्सि ब्रह्म घोषान् उदैरयन् ॥६-३५-२०॥
translation: "Their power is difficult to overcome as they are pure souls and blazing like fire by their austerity. They follow virtues faithfully intending to acquire merit like brahmanas. They are standing firmly curbing their senses doing sacrifices offering oblations into sacrificial fires following tradition. Having subdued the Rakshasas, they are continuing to recite Vedas and on hearing Vedas the Rakshasas are running away in different directions like the rain cloud is scattered in the hot season."

raw: स्फुरते नयनम् सव्यम् बाहुः च हृदयम् च मे । दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मण दूरे त्वाम् सीता विरहितम् पथि ॥३-५९-४॥
translation: O Lakshmana, as I saw you from a distance without Sita, my left eye, my shoulder and my heart throbbed.

raw: धूम्राक्षवचनं श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षो बलानुगः । बलमुद्योजयामास रावणस्याज्ञया द्रुतम् ॥६-५१-२१॥
translation: On hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the CommanderinChief of the large army, he got ready quickly by the order of Ravana.

raw: पुत्रः दशरथस्य अयम् महा राजस्य धीमतः । निदेशम् पालयतु एनम् गन्गे त्वद् अभिरक्षितः ॥२-५२-८३॥
translation: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

raw: अङ्गदेनानुमतास्सन्तस्ततो मुदिताः तत्प्रेरिताः प्रनृत्यन्तो ऽभवन् ॥५-६१-१३॥
ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कृतज्ञश्च सानुक्रोशश्च राघवः । सद्वृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसङ्क्षयात् ॥५-२४-१२॥
राघवो रावणं तूर्णं रावणो राघवं तदा । अन्योन्यं विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः शरैरभिववर्षतुः ॥६-१००-२५॥
translation: Thus, Raghava on Ravana and Ravana on Raghava, in that manner sharp arrows showered on one another.

raw: निष्प्रमाणशरीरः सन् लिलङ्घयिषुरर्णवम् । बाहुभ्यां पीडयामास चरणाभ्यां च पर्वतम् ॥५-१-११॥
translation: Having swollen to an immeasurable figure, he pressed on the mountain with his feet and hands in an attempt to cross the ocean.

raw: इति उक्त्वा क्रोध ताम्र अक्षः स्फुरमाण ओष्ट संपुटः । वल्कल अजिनम् आबद्ध्य जटा भारम् बन्धयत् ॥३-६४-७२॥
प्रांशुभिर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च शिलाभिश्च महाबलः । पादपैः पुष्पिताग्रैश्च हन्यमानो न कम्पते ॥६-६६-१०॥
translation: Though Kumbhakarna was hit with lofty mountain peaks and trees with blossoms at crests, he was not shaken.

raw: सा मही रुधिरौघेण प्रच्छन्ना सम्प्रकाशते । सञ्छन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैरिव पुष्पितैः ॥६-५८-२८॥
translation: That battlefield drenched with blood shone bright as though veiled with blossoms of Palasa in the month of Magha.

raw: ऋक्षाणाम् भीम वेगानाम् धूम्रः शत्रु निबर्हणः । वृतः कोटि सहस्राभ्याम् द्वाभ्याम् समभिवर्तत ॥४-३९-२०॥
translation: Dhumra, destroyer of enemies, came next followed by two thousand crore of bears of terrible speed.

raw: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्रस्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नभश्च । शैलान् समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥६-५९-४२॥
translation: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.

raw: क्रोधम् आहारयत् तीव्रम् वधार्थम् सर्व रक्षसाम् । दुष्प्रेक्ष्यश्चाभवत्क्रुद्धोयुगान्ताग्निरिवज्वलन् - यद्वा -दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः च अभवत् क्रुद्धो युगान्त अग्निः इव ज्वलन् ॥३-२४-३३॥
एवं दत्त्वा वरांस्तेभ्यस्तस्मिन्यज्ञोत्सवे सुराः । निवृत्ताः सह राज्ञा ते पुनः स्वभवनं गताः ॥७-१८-३६॥
translation: After granting boons to them during that sacrificial festival, the gods, along with the king, returned to their respective abodes. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टादशः सर्गः ।। 18 ।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: एकाह्ना राजपुत्रीणां चतसृणां महामुने । पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राजपुत्रा महाबला: ॥१-७२-१२॥
translation: O Great ascetic let the valiant four princes take the hands of four princesses on the same day.

raw: स विधूय चितां तां तु वैदेहीं हव्यवाहनः । उत्तस्थौ मूर्तिमानाशु गृहीत्वा जनकात्मजाम् ॥६-१२१-२॥
translation: Then the fire god taking human form emerged from the fire immediately,with Janaka's daughter shaking off the fire sticks.

raw: आपृच्छे त्वाम् पुरीश्रेष्ठे काकुत्स्थपरिपालिते । दैवतानि च यानि त्वाम् पालयन्त्यावसन्ति च ॥२-५०-२॥
translation: O Ayodhya, the best of cities ruled by those born in the Kakutstha race I take leave of you and of all those gods inhabiting and guarding you.

raw: सर्वानाकुलयंस्तत्र यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् । हनुमान् मेघसङ्काशो ववृधे मारुतात्मजः ॥६-७४-४५॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

raw: स किष्किंधाम् प्रविश्य त्वम् ब्रूहि वानर पुंगवम् । मूर्खम् ग्राम्य सुखे सक्तम् सुग्रीवम् वचनात् मम ॥४-३०-६९॥
translation: 'Go to Kishkinda and speak (on my behalf ) to that fool, Sugriva, the chief of monkeys who is revelling in habitual sensual pleasures

raw: ततः सुमाली माली च श्रुत्वा माल्यवतो वचः । ऊचतुर्भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं भगांशाविव वासवम् ॥७-६-३८॥
translation: Then, Sumali and Mali, having heard the words of Malyavan, spoke to their elder brother, just as Bhaga and Amsha would speak to Indra.

raw: शिरसा चरणावेतौ वन्दमानमनिन्दिते । पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि कल्याणि! पुत्रं चन्द्रमिवोदितम् ॥२-४४-२२॥
translation: O irreproachable and auspicious one you will see your son, like the rising Moon, touching your feet with his head.

raw: देवासुरनृकन्यानामाहर्तारंततस्ततः शत्रुस्त्रीशोकदातारं नेतारं स्वजनस्य च ॥६-११४-५३॥
translation: "Brought by force virgin girls of Devas, suras and human beings from here and there forcibly and caused the enemy women to mourn"

raw: ततः क्रुद्धो गदां तस्मै चिक्षेप रजनीचरः । ज्वलन्तीं भास्कराभासां सुग्रीवाय महोदरः ॥६-९८-१९॥
translation: Then provoked by anger, the night ranger, Mahodara flung his mace at Sugriva which shone like the Sun.

raw: देवतानाम् पितृऋणाम् च माता पित्रोस् तथैव च । मा स्म कार्षीत् स शुश्रूषाम् यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४६॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a person who fails to show obedience to the gods and the ancestors and to serve his parents

raw: तस्य अहम् शीघ्र वेगस्य शीघ्र गस्य महात्मनः । मारुतस्य औरसः पुत्रः प्लवने च अस्मि तत् समः ॥४-६७-१०॥
translation: 'I am the lawfulson of the swiftmoving Windgod, Maruta, comparable to him in leaping.

raw: ततो लोकत्रयं क्षुब्धमकम्पन्त दिवौकसः । कालं दृष्ट्वा तथा क्रुद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ॥७-२२-६॥
translation: Then, having seen Time thus enraged and terrifying to all worlds, the three worlds were agitated and the gods trembled.

raw: अविज्ञानान्नृपसुता व्याली तीक्ष्णविषा यथा । जीवलोको यदा सर्वो रामस्याह गुणस्तवम् ॥२-१२-९॥
तंगङ्गांपुनारासाद्यवसन्तंमुनिसन्निधौ अविघ्नंपुष्ययोगेनश्वोरामंद्रष्टुमर्हसि ॥६-१२९-५४॥
translation: "He reached the bank of Ganga and is staying at the hermitage of sage. Tomorrow at the time when Pushya star is in union with the moon you will be able to see Rama without any obstruction."

raw: विवर्धमानो वीर्येण समुद्र इव पर्वणि । हतम् मेने तदा राम वसिष्ठम् ऋषि सत्तमम् ॥१-५५-२०॥
translation: Like the sea during the full moon, with his increased power (blessed with the invincible strength of the weapons) Viswamitra thought the foremost of ascetics Vasishta was (already) slain. (It shows the height of the king's ignorance and arrogance).

raw: पुरे जनपदे चैव कुशलं प्राणिनामपि । इत्यञ्जलिकृता सीता देवता अभ्ययाचत ॥७-४६-१७॥
translation: With folded hands, Sita thus prayed to the deities for the well-being of all living beings in the city and the kingdom.

raw: तस्मिन् द्रवति संत्रस्ते हि आवाम् द्रुततरम् गतौ । प्रकाशः अपि कृतः मार्गः चन्द्रेण उद्गच्छता तदा ॥४-९-१०॥
translation: 'Frightened, he ran. We too chased him running faster. As the Moon was rising the path was welllit.

raw: मिथिल उपवने तत्र आश्रमम् दृश्य राघवः । पुराणम् निर्जनम् रम्यम् पप्रच्छ मुनि पुंगवम् ॥१-४८-१२॥
translation: At the sight of an old uninhabited, beautiful and desolate hermitage in a grove near Mithila, the descendant of the Raghus enquired of the foremost among the ascetics (Viswamitra):

raw: अन्तरा पण्यवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः । सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः ॥७-९१-२२॥
translation: Along the way, there should be market streets, and all actors and dancers, as well as many cooks and perpetually youthful women.

raw: शैलप्रस्थेषु रम्येषु पश्येमान् रोमहर्षणान् । किन्नरान् द्वन्द्वशो भद्रे रममाणान् मनस्विन: ॥२-९४-११॥
translation: O auspiciouslooking one, behold these highspirited kinneras in pairs who are sporting on the picturesque hill plateaus causing thrills.

raw: अब्रवीत्तुतदारामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् वहवैश्रवणंदेवमनुजानामिगम्यताम् ॥६-१३०-५९॥
translation: Then Rama told Pushpaka that he was permitted to go to God Vysravana.

raw: एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः । व्याजह्रुर्हृष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम् ॥७-९७-२३॥
translation: The celestial gods, with joyful minds, uttered various words upon witnessing Sita's entry into the earth.

raw: ततो अस्य सशरम् चापम् मुक्ता मणि विभूषितम् । चरणाभ्याम् महातेजा बभंज पतगोत्तमः ॥३-५१-१०॥
translation: The glorious lord of birds crushed with his feet the bow and arrow of Ravana with pearls and gems encrusted.

raw: ऋषेर् हि न्यस्त दण्डस्य वने वन्येन जीवतः । कथम् नु शस्त्रेण वधो मद् विधस्य विधीयते ॥२-६३-३०॥
translation: 'Renouncing violence I live the life of an ascetic on forest produce. Why should any one kill me with a weapon?

raw: न अराकजे जन पदे धनवन्तः सुरक्षिताः । शेरते विवृत द्वाराः कृषि गो रक्ष जीविनः ॥२-६७-१९॥
translation: In a country without a king, wealthy people who live on farming and raising cattle cannot sleep safely in their homes with doors wide open.

raw: स तैः बाणैः महावीर्यः पूर्ण मुक्तैः अजिह्म गैः । बिभेद निशितैः तीक्ष्णैः गृध्रम् घोरैः शिली मुखैः ॥३-५१-८॥
translation: The mighty Ravana fully released his dreadful, sharp arrows that went straight and pierced the vulture.

raw: न विरोधो बलवता क्षमो रावण तेन ते । अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् रावणः काल चोदितः ॥१-१-५१॥
भविष्यच्छूद्रयोन्यां वै तपश्चर्या कलौ युगे । अधर्मः परमो राजन्द्वापरे शूद्रजन्मनः ॥७-७४-२७॥
translation: Indeed, the performance of penance by a Shudra will be permissible in the Kali Yuga, but in the Dvapara Yuga, O King, it is the greatest unrighteousness for one born as a Shudra.

raw: तत्रैन्द्रेण च भागेन महीमाज्ञापयन्नृपः । वारुणेन तु भागेन वपुः पुष्यति पार्थिवः ॥७-७६-४४॥
translation: There, the king rules the earth with the share of Indra, and with the share of Varuna, the king nourishes his body.

raw: आश्रमम् प्रति याते तु खरे खर पराक्रमे । तान् एव औत्पातिकान् रामः सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श ह ॥३-२४-१॥
translation: When Khara endowed with malicious might was marching towards the hermitage, Rama and his brother saw the same omens of impending calamity the demon had seen.

raw: तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः । बभूवुः परमर्षीणां मध्यादित्यगते ऽहनि ॥७-५१-७॥
translation: As they sat there, various very pleasant conversations took place among the great sages during the midday.

raw: प्रत्यक्षमेव भवतां महेन्द्राग्रात् खमाप्लुतः । उदधेर्दक्षिणं पारं कांक्षमाणः समाहितः ॥५-५८-७॥
translation: "I rose upwards leaping into the sky, intent on reaching the southern shore from the mountain Mahendra.It has been witnessed directly by all of you.

raw: तेषु शांतेषु ब्रह्मास्त्रम् क्षिप्तवान् गाधि नंदनः । तत् अस्त्रम् उद्यतम् दृष्ट्वा देवाः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः ॥१-५६-१४॥
ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्बुधाश्रमसमीपतः । रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः ॥७-९०-१५॥
translation: A great sacrifice then took place near Budha's hermitage, and the highly renowned Rudra attained supreme satisfaction.

raw: चतुरन्तां महीं भुक्त्वा महेन्द्रसदृशो विभु: । कथमिङ्गुदिपिण्याकं स भुङ्क्ते वसुधाधिप: ॥२-१०३-१२॥
translation: How can Indralike Dasaratha, having ruled the earth bounded by four oceans, eat a cake of ingudi pulp?

raw: शोचन्त्याः च अल्प भाग्याया न किम्चित् उपकुर्वता । पुर्त्रेण किम् अपुत्राया मया कार्यम् अरिम् दम ॥२-५३-२३॥
translation: My mother has less fortune and more grief like a woman without a son, O Lakshmana, subduer of enemies For her, what is the use of a son like me who cannot render any service to her?

raw: भवन्तम् सर्व भूतानाम् शरण्यम् शरणम् गतः । परित्यक्ता मया लंका मित्राणि च धनानि च ॥६-१८-५॥
महाबलो महावीर्यो राक्षसैः बहुभिः वृतः । श्रूयते च महाराजा रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥१-२०-१७॥
यक्षत्वम् अमरत्वम् च राज्यानि विविधानि च । अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैः आराधिताः शुभैः ॥३-११-९३॥
translation: Worshipped by benevolent beings, the gods here bestow on them the status of demigods or of the immortals or several kinds of kingdoms.

raw: यकृत्प्लीहमथोत्पीडं हृदयं च सबन्धनम् । अन्त्राण्यपि तथा शीर्षं खादेयमिति मे मतिः ॥५-२२-३५॥
स नः समीक्ष्य द्विज वर्य वृत्तम् । नृपम् विना राज्यम् अरण्य भूतम् । कुमारम् इक्ष्वाकु सुतम् वदान्यम् । त्वम् एव राजानम् इह अभिषिन्चय ॥२-६७-३८॥
translation: O Vasistha, the best of brahmins, considering all that has happened and knowing that a kingdom without a king is like a forest, you may consecrate a generous son from the Ikshvaku race as our king. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: भोगकाले महत्कृच्छ्रम् पुनरेव प्रपत्स्यते । नालम् द्वितीयम् वचनम् पुत्रो माम् प्रति भाषितुम् ॥२-१२-८४॥
प्रलोभनार्थम् वैदेह्या नाना धातु विचित्रितम् । विचरन् गच्छते सम्यक् शाद्वलानि समंततः ॥३-४२-२१॥
translation: Transfigured into a beautiful, magnificent form painted with the colours of different minerals in order to tempt Sita, Maricha roamed all around the grassland.

raw: राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम् । उवाच स तदा वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत ॥७-७५-१५॥
translation: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."

raw: नृत्त वादित्र कुशला राक्षस इन्द्र भुज अन्कगाः । वर आभरण धारिण्यो निषन्ना दद्र्शे कपिः ॥५-१०-३२॥
translation: Hanuman saw the women there wearing fine jewellery, performing dances, playing musical instruments, and resting on the lap or leaning on the arms of the demon king.

raw: ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वतन्त्रे नियोज्य च । ततो ऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिशम् ॥७-९२-२॥
translation: After appointing Lakshmana along with the priests to supervise the sacrificial horse, Rama then proceeded towards Naimisha with his army.

raw: दिष्ट्या त्वया हतो राजन्रावणो लोकरावणः । न हि भारः स ते राम रावणः पुत्रपौत्रवान् ॥७-१-१८॥
translation: O King, it is fortunate that you have slain Ravana, who tormented the worlds, for indeed, even with his sons and grandsons, he was no match for you, O Rama.

raw: उत्पेततुस्ततस्तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम् । भुजैश्चिक्षिपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ । जग्मतुस्तौ श्रमं वीरौ बाहुयुद्धे परन्तपौ ॥६-९८-२५॥
translation: Then quickly getting up striking one another, both the heroes who have never been defeated, pushed each other by their arms.
