raw: नियुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र दक्षिण द्वारम् आश्रितम् । चतुर् अन्गेण सैन्येन योधास् तत्र अपि अनुत्तमाः ॥६-३-२५॥
translation: At the southern gate also one lakh of rakshasas are garrisoned with four divisions of army. They are also the best warriors.

raw: स महात्मा कुलीनायाम् युक्तायाम् सुमहाबलान् । वैदर्भ्याम् जनयाम् आस चतुरः सदृशान् सुतान् ॥१-३२-२॥
translation: That great soul, Kusa, married the princess of Vidarbha born in a noble family and a match for him. He begot four virtuous sons who resembled him. They were Kusamba, Kusanabha, Adhurtarajas and Vasu.

raw: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत । वैदेही सन्निकर्षं मे शीघ्रं समुपगच्छतु ॥६-११७-१८॥
translation: "O gentle Vibheeshana, let Sita who sought my victory always be quickly brought near me."

raw: ययाऽहम् सर्वभूतानाम् प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम् । अद्य इदानीम् सकामा सा या माता मम मध्यमा ॥३-२-२०॥
translation: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

raw: तच्च शूलं महत्तेन हते लवणराक्षसे । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां रुद्रस्य वशमन्वगात् ॥७-६९-३८॥
translation: And that great trident, after the demon Lavana was killed by Shatrughna, returned to the control of Rudra while all the gods watched.

raw: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण क्रुद्धः संरक्त लोचनः । प्रति उवाच ततो रामम् प्रहसन् क्रोध मूर्चितः ॥३-२९-१५॥
translation: Challenged by Rama in that manner, Khara, his senses switched off, eyes turned red due to anger, replied laughing :

raw: शिबिकाभिः च यानैः च यथा अर्हम् तस्य योषितः । नगरान् निर्ययुस् तत्र वृद्धैः परिवृताः तदा ॥२-७६-१९॥
translation: Then in accordance with their rank and surrounded by aged guards, the wives of king Dasaratha departed for that place from the city in palanquins and other carriages.

raw: इमां तु विषमां दुर्गां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् । प्राप्यापि स महाबाहुः किम् करिष्यति राघवः ॥५-२-२८॥
translation: 'What will Rama the mighty armed hero do even after reaching this formidable city of Lanka ruled by Ravana?

raw: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तस्यातिचक्रमुः । धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य सत्पथे निष्ठितस्य च ॥७-१०-५॥
translation: Thus, ten thousand years passed for him, who was striving in righteousness and firmly established on the path of truth.

raw: परिघाभिहतश्चापि वानरेन्द्रात्मजस्तदा । जानुभ्यां पतितो भूमौ पुनरेवोत्पपात ह ॥६-७०-१८॥
translation: Then, hurt by the club the son of Vanara king fell down on his knees once again and got up.

raw: तां कराभ्यां परामृश्य रामः शक्तिं भयावहाम् । बभञ्ज समरे क्रुद्धो बलवान् विचकर्ष च ॥६-१०१-४४॥
translation: It pierced through Lakshmana's body and entered into the earth. Mighty Rama held the terrific javelin with both hands bent it and removed in the course of struggle.

raw: विपातितः शरो यत्र वज्राशनिसमप्रभः । ननाद च तदा तत्र वसुधा शल्यपीडिता ॥६-२२-३६॥
वाल्मीकिः अथ तम् दृष्ट्वा सहसा उत्थाय वाग्यतः । प्रान्जलिः प्रयतो भूत्वा तस्थौ परम विस्मितः ॥१-२-२४॥
translation: Greatly surprised to see him, Valmiki, purified by austerities and disciplined in speech, immediately got up and with folded palms stood before him.

raw: ततः पूर्वाम् दिशम् भित्त्वा दक्षिणाम् बिभिदुः पुनः । दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिशि ददृशुः ते महागजम् ॥१-४०-१७॥
मलदाः च करूषाः च देव निर्माण निर्मितौ । पुरा वृत्र वधे राम मलेन समभिप्लुतम् ॥१-२४-१८॥
ततो दशरथः प्राप्य पायसम् देव निर्मितम् । बभूव परम प्रीतः प्राप्य वित्तम् इव अधनः ॥१-१६-२३॥
translation: Dasaratha who received the payasam prepared by devatas was highly pleased like a poor man who received wealth.

raw: सदृशम् शारदस्य इन्दोह् फुल्लस्य कमलस्य च । सुगन्धि मम नाथस्य धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति तन् मुखम् ॥२-६४-७१॥
translation: Fortunate indeed are the men who will behold my son's fragrant countenance camparable to the autmnal Moon and the fullblown lotus.

raw: चिताम् चक्रुः सुबहवो वानरा वन चारिणः । अवरोप्य ततः स्कंधात् शिबिकाम् वानरोत्तमाः ॥४-२५-३८॥
समन्तान् नर नारीणाम् तम् अद्य न शृणोम्य् अहम् । उद्यानानि हि साय अह्ने क्रीडित्वा उपरतैः नरैः ॥२-७१-२२॥
तस्य रोषः समभवत्क्षुधार्तस्य विशेषतः । निर्दहन्निव लोकांस्त्रीञ्छिष्यांश्चैतदुवाच ह ॥७-८१-३॥
translation: His anger, especially due to hunger, arose as if burning the three worlds, and he spoke this to his disciples.

raw: यथा पुष्करपत्रेषु पतितास्तोयबिन्दवः । न श्लेषमभिगच्चन्ति तथानार्येषु सौहृदम् ॥६-१६-११॥
translation: "Just as drops of water that fall on lotus leaves do not adhere to each other, like wise however long you spend with an unworthy (relative) one, good friendship does not take place."

raw: यद्यद्यास्ति मतिर्योद्धुं युद्धतृष्णासमावृता । निहत्यास्मांस्ततो युद्धमर्जुनेनोपयास्यसि ॥७-३२-३१॥
translation: The ministers further challenged Ravana, stating that if he was still consumed by the thirst for battle today, he would first have to defeat them before he could fight Arjuna.

raw: लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खड्गं खड्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः । जहार सशिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपहितं शिरः ॥६-९८-३१॥
translation: While Mahodara was extracting the sword stuck to the head, Sugriva, the elephant of the monkeys, severed the head of Mahodara which was decked with earrings and helmet.

raw: शकटांश्च बहून्पूर्णान्फलमूलैश्च शोभनान् । वाल्मीकिवाटे रुचिरे स्थापयन्नविदूरतः ॥७-९३-३॥
translation: He also had many carts, full of excellent fruits and roots, placed not far off in his charming hermitage.

raw: हत्वा ऽहं रावणं युद्धे सपुत्रबलवाहनम् । अभिषिच्य च लङ्कायां विभीषणमथापि च । भरते राज्यमावेश्य त्यक्ष्ये देहं महाबल ॥६-४१-७॥
translation: "Mighty Sugriva! You resemble Indra and Varuna in might. Your valour is known to me. I have decided in my mind to kill the sons of Ravana and his relatives in battle, coronate Vibheeshana in Lanka, and hand over the kingdom to Bharata and give up my body."

raw: ततो अन्यत् धनुः आदाय रावणः क्रोध मूर्च्छितः । ववर्ष शर वर्षाणि शतशो अथ सहस्रशः ॥३-५१-११॥
translation: Overcome with anger, Ravana took another bow and rained (on him) hundreds and thousands of arrows.

raw: तम् अद्य एव प्रियार्थम् मे वैरिणम् भ्रातृ रूपिणम् । वालिनम् जहि काकुत्स्थ मया बद्धो अयम् अंजलिः ॥४-१२-११॥
translation: 'O Rama, for my pleasure kill Vali who is, to me, an enemy in the guise of a brother. I fold my hands to you.

raw: राज्ञः संप्रतिबुद्धस्य चानागमनकारणम् । इत्युक्त्वान्तःपुरद्वारमाजगाम पुराणवित् ॥२-१५-१९॥
इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा । दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव ॥७-७६-३०॥
translation: O gentle Raghava, please accept this divine ornament, created by Vishwakarma, which shines with its own splendor and divine form, and by doing so, fulfill my wish.

raw: प्रासं समाविध्य तदा ऽङ्गदाय समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज । स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ॥६-६९-९२॥
translation: Hearing Angada's words Naranthaka flew into a rage. Biting his lips with teeth, hissing like a serpent Naranthaka stood before Angada. He hurled his spear glowing like fire on Angada's chest violently. It struck Angada and shattered, went round, and fell.

raw: स्वागतम् ते रघु श्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृताम् वर । आश्रमओ अयम् त्वया आक्रान्तः सनाथ इव सांप्रतम् ॥३-७-९॥
translation: O Rama, the best among the Raghavas and among the upholders of truth, you are welcome. With your presence this hermitage will have a protector now.

raw: रात्र्याम् तु तस्याम् व्युष्टायाम् भरद्वाजो अब्रवीद् इदम् । मधु मूल फल उपेतम् चित्र कूटम् व्रज इति ह ॥२-५४-३८॥
translation: When the night came to a close, Bharadwaja said (to Rama): You may proceed to Chitrakuta which abounds in roots, fruits and honey.

raw: सा हेम वर्णा नील अंगम् मैथिली राक्षस अधिपम् । शुशुभे कांचनी कांची नीलम् मणिम् - गजम् - इव आश्रिता ॥३-५२-२३॥
translation: Goldencomplexioned Sita, princess of Mithila, held by the darkcoloured king of the demons, shone like a girdle resting on a dark blue sapphire.

raw: धूम्र अक्षस्य च सम्पातेर् भवनम् मारुत आत्मजः । विद्युद् रूपस्य भीमस्य घनस्य विघनस्य च ॥५-६-२३॥
translation: Hanuman jumped the houses of Dhumraksha, Sampati, Vidyudrupa, Bhima, Ghana and Vighana, Sukanasa, Vakra, Shatha, Vikata, Brahmakarna, Damshtra Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhvajagriva, Nadi, Vidyujjihva and Indrajihva Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha and Sonitaksha.

raw: ममापि त्वं सुदयितः प्राणैरपि न संशयः । अवश्यं करणीयं च राज्यस्य परिपालनम् ॥७-७२-१६॥
translation: Rama tells Shatrughna that he is dearer than life itself, but the protection of the kingdom is an essential duty.

raw: रुद्रकालाविव क्रुद्धौ तदा तौ राक्षसार्जुनौ । परस्परं गदाभ्यां तौ ताडयामासतुर्भृशम् ॥७-३२-५३॥
translation: Then, those two, the demon Ravana and Arjuna, enraged like Rudra and Kala, fiercely struck each other with their maces.

raw: तम् पथ्य हित वक्तारम् मारीचम् राक्षसाधिपः । अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् अयुक्तम् काल चोदितः ॥३-४०-२॥
translation: The king of the demons, driven by fate, replied with improper and harsh words to Maricha whose advice was salutary and beneficial to him :

raw: एवम् पृष्ठः तु कैकेय्या प्रियम् पार्थिव नन्दनः । आचष्ट भरतः सर्वम् मात्रे राजीव लोचनः ॥२-७२-७॥
translation: Thus asked lovingly by his mother Kaikeyi, the lotuseyed Bharata, the king's delight narrated everything to her.

raw: निस्सञ्ज्ञावप्युभावेतौ नैव लक्ष्मीर्वियुज्यते । प्रायेण गतसत्त्वानां पुरुषाणां गतायुषाम् । दृश्यमानेषु वक्त्रेषु परं भवति वैकृतम् ॥६-४८-३२॥
translation: "Normally when we see men who have ceased life and stopped breathing their features are unappealing."

raw: साधनानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ततो अहम् भृश दुःखितः । ततो देव गणान् सर्वान् तपसा अहम् प्रसादयम् ॥१-६६-२३॥
शूलैः अशनि कल्पैः च हलैः च अपि सुदारुणैः । भिद्यमाना वसुमती ननाद रघुनंदन ॥१-३९-१८॥
translation: O Son of the Raghus (Rama) dreadful sounds emanated while the earth was being broken open by ploughs and lances similar to thunderbolt.

raw: द्वादश एते महावीर्या बल अध्यक्षाः । स सैनिकाःरमम् एव अभ्यधावंत विसृजंतः शरोत्तमान् ॥३-२६-२८॥
translation: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

raw: अपास्य फालम् कुद्दालम् कुरुष्व वचनम् ममम् । रामम् दर्शय धर्मज्जनम् यदि किम्चिदवाप्स्यसि ॥२-३२-३१॥
translation: Listen to me throw away this ironspade. Go and see the righteous Rama.You may obtain something.

raw: इष्ट्वा संग्राम यज्ञेन राम प्रहरण अंभसा । अस्मिन् अवभृथे स्नातः कथम् पत्न्या मया विना ॥४-२३-२७॥
translation: 'You have performed a warsacrifice. You have bathed in the waters of Rama's weapon signifying the end of the sacrifice. How did you take this customary bath without me, your wife?

raw: विधास्यति विनाशाय त्वम् माम् यदि न मुंचसि । येन त्वम् व्यवसायेन बलात् माम् हर्तुम् इच्छसि ॥३-५३-१४॥
स एष राघव भ्राता लक्ष्मणो वाक्य सारथिः । व्यवसाय रथः प्राप्तः तस्य रामस्य शासनात् ॥४-३१-४७॥
translation: 'By the command of Rama, his brother has come to you, Rama's words as charioteer and his work as chariot'.

raw: पुनर् यत्र एकताम् प्राप्तः स मन्त्रो मध्यमः स्मृतः । अन्योन्य मतिम् आस्थाय यत्र सम्प्रतिभाष्यते ॥६-६-१४॥
मन्थराया वचः श्रुत्वा शयनात्स शुभानना । उत्तस्थौ हर्षसंपूर्णा चन्द्रलेखव शारदी ॥२-७-३१॥
translation: Hearing the words of Manthara, Kaikeyi of charming countenance lying in her couch rose, full of joy, like the autumnal streak of the Moon's crescent.

raw: रामम् एव अनुगच्चामि स राजा द्विपदाम् वरः । त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् राघवो राज्यम् अर्हति ॥२-८२-१६॥
translation: I shall follow Rama the best among men. He alone and no one else deserves to rule over the kingdom of the three worlds.

raw: मधूनि पीत्वा जुष्टानि परम् गच्छत वानराः । तत्र नेत्र मनः कांतः कुंजरो नाम पर्वतः ॥४-४१-३४॥
निम्नेषु वनदुर्गेषु वनेषु च वनौकसः । अभिप्लुत्याभिपश्येयुः परेषां निहितं बलम् ॥६-४-१२॥
translation: "O Vanaras You should even look for (the rakshasas) in the low lying lands, in inaccessible water sources, in forests and also beyond sight leaping up to the sky".

raw: अन्योन्यस्य अन्ग सम्स्पर्शात् प्रीयमाणाः सुमध्यमाः । एकी कृत भुजाः सर्वाः सुषुपुः तत्र योषितःअन्योन्य भुज सूत्रेण स्त्री माला ग्रथिता हि सा । माला इव ग्रथिता सूत्रे शुशुभे मत्त षट्पदा ॥५-९-६३॥
आविला च पुरी लंका सर्वा हनुमता कृता । किम् करिष्यामि भद्रम् वः किम् वा युक्तम् अनन्तरम् ॥६-६-४॥
कृशाश्व तनयान् राम भास्वरान् काम रूपिणः । प्रतीच्छ मम भद्रम् ते पात्र भूतोऽसि राघव ॥१-२८-१०॥
translation: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

raw: रामः कमलपत्राक्षः सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरः । रूपदाक्षिण्यसम्पन्नः प्रसूतो जनकात्मजे ॥५-३५-८॥
translation: "O daughter of Janaka Rama with eyes like lotus petals is a person born with a delightful form, richly endowed with indescribable charm and politeness.

raw: सन्निबद्धं हि श्लोकानां चतुर्विशत्सहस्रकम् । उपाख्यानशतं चैव भार्गवेण तपस्विना ॥७-९४-२६॥
translation: This epic, consisting of twenty-four thousand verses and a hundred sub-stories, was indeed composed by the ascetic Valmiki.

raw: तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति । तिष्ठ त्वं हरिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम् ॥५-१-११६॥
येन बद्धः समुद्रस्य स सेतुः परम अद्भुतः । कुरुष्व नर राजेन सम्धिम् रामेण रावण ॥६-३५-३७॥
translation: Rama is Lord Vishnu in human form endowed with fortitude and prowess. One who has constructed an amazing bridge on the ocean is not just a human being. O Ravana! Align with the ruler of men, Sri Rama. After careful thinking and determining correctly, do what is good.

raw: यो ऽसौ चक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जनार्दनः । हरिर्नारायणः श्रीमान् शरणं तं प्रपद्यथ ॥७-६-२९॥
translation: You should take refuge in that glorious Narayana, also known as Janardana and Hari, who holds the discus and mace in his hands and wears yellow garments.

raw: अयोध्याम् मनुना राज्ञा निर्मिताम् स ददर्श ह । ताम् पुरीम् पुरुष व्याघ्रः सप्त रात्र उषिटः पथि ॥२-७१-१८॥
पपात स गदोद्भिन्नः परिघस्तस्य भूतले ोषताम्राक्षः समुद्यम्य महाहवे । ततो जग्राह तेजस्वी सुग्रीवो वसुधातलात् । आयसं मुसलं घोरं सर्वतो हेमभूषितम् ॥६-९८-२१॥
मध्यमे च स्वयं गुल्मे सुग्रीवः समतिष्ठत । सह सर्वैहरिश्रेष्ठैः सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः ॥६-४१-४०॥
translation: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.

raw: उद्यतानाम् हि युद्धार्थम् येषाम् भवति लक्ष्मणः । निष्प्रभम् वदनम् तेषाम् भवति आयुः परिक्षयः ॥३-२४-९॥
translation: O Lakshmana, while preparing for war, those whose faces look pale are, for sure, going to die.

raw: इत्युक्त्वा वानरश्रेष्ठो वारयन् सर्ववानरान् । शनैः शनैरसंत्रस्तः सबलः सन्न्यवर्तत ॥६-८२-२४॥
translation: The foremost of the Vanaras, kept back all the Vanaras after speaking that way to the army and slowly and slowly retreated.

raw: धनुर्मण्डलनिर्मुक्तैराशीविषविषोपमैः । शरैर्हन्तुं महेष्वासो रावणिं समितिञ्जयः ॥६-८५-१२॥
आसीनः पर्वतस्य अग्रे हेम धातु विभूषिते । शारदम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा जगाम मनसा प्रियाम् ॥४-३०-६॥
translation: Sitting on top of the mountain shining with gold and minerals, Rama gazed at the pleasant autumnal sky and started thinking of his beloved.

raw: अथवा नायमुन्मादो मोहो ऽप्युन्मादलक्षणः । संबुद्ध्ये चाहमात्मानमिमं चापि वनौकसम् ॥५-३४-२४॥
translation: "No, this cannot be insanity. nor even delusion. But I recognise this vanara well"

raw: तत: पुरुषसिंहानां वृतानां तै: सुहृद्गणै: । शोचतामेव रजनी दु:खेन व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥२-१०५-१॥
translation: That night passed off painfully for the four lion like brothers as they lamented, surrounded by their hosts of friends.

raw: शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च । श्लाघनीयं यशस्यं च कृतं कर्म महत्त्वया ॥६-१०५-१५॥
translation: "By laudable great action performed by you (of abducting Sita and your penance) you have attained fame. You are a heroic brother of Kubera, rich in might."

raw: प्रभग्नान् वानरान् दृष्टवावज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजः । अभ्यधावतवेगेनकुम्भकर्णंमहाहवे ॥६-६७-४३॥
translation: The son of Vali who sprung from Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt seeing the Vanaras routed, rushed towards Kumbhakarna to assault.

raw: यथा रूपा हि दृष्टा वै तथा रूपा इयम् अन्गना । पूर्ण चन्द्र आननाम् सुभ्रूम् चारु वृत्त पयो धराम् ॥५-१५-२८॥
शतशश्चापि धर्मज्ञाः क्रतुमुख्यमनुत्तमम् । अनुभूय महायज्ञं नैमिशे रघुनन्दन ॥७-९१-१७॥
translation: O delight of the Raghus, let hundreds of knowers of dharma, having experienced this great and unsurpassed chief of sacrifices in Naimisha...

raw: धन्यो अस्मि अनुगृहीतो अस्मि यस्य मे विषयम् मुने । संप्राप्तो दर्शनम् चैव न अस्ति धन्यतरो मम ॥१-४७-२२॥
translation: "O Sage no one is more blessed than me since you have favoured me with your arrival in my country." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: स पपात महाबाहुः चिन्न बाहुः महा स्वनः । खम् च गाम् च दिशः चैव नादयन् जलदो यथा ॥३-७०-१०॥
translation: The strongarmed demon, his arms severed, rumbling like a raincloud filling the sky, the earth and the quarters, fell down.

raw: उत्क्रामन्तं दरीवन्तं हिमवत्सन्निभं गिरिम् । पश्यमानस्ततो विन्ध्यं रावणो नर्मदां ययौ ॥७-३१-१८॥
translation: Ravana, after observing the Vindhya mountain, which rose high, possessed many caves, and resembled the Himalayas, then proceeded to the Narmada river.

raw: तपस्विनाम् रणे शत्रून् हन्तुम् इच्छामि राक्षसान् । पश्यन्तु वीर्यम् ऋषयः सः ब्रातुर् मे तपोधनाः ॥३-६-२५॥
translation: I wish to kill in the fight the demons who are your enemies. O great ascetics, you may witness my prowess supported by my brother.

raw: एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा प्रयातुमुपचक्रमुः ॥७-३६-६१॥
translation: ...and having said "So be it" to him, they began to depart.

raw: ननु नाम अविनीतानाम् विनेता असि परंतप । कथम् एवम् विधम् पापम् न त्वम् शास्सि हि रावणम् ॥३-४९-२६॥
translation: O scorcher of enemies you are the chastiser of the haughty. Why do you not punish such a sinner like Ravana.

raw: ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च महाबलम् । चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवम् ॥६-१११-३०॥
translation: The foremost of the Rakshasas killed, Raghava was pleased and having fulfilled the desire of Sugriva, Angada, Vibheeshana, he made them happy.

raw: न च तं जानकी सीता हरिं हरिणलोचना । अस्माभिर्बहुधा पृष्टा निवेदयितुमिच्छिति ॥५-४२-१४॥
translation: "The deereyed Sita is not willing to disclose to us his identity even when we questioned her.

raw: स राजा सत्यवाग् देव्या वरदानमनुस्मरन् । मुमोह वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्याः क्रूरमप्रियम् ॥५-३३-२३॥
translation: "Remembering the boons the ever truthful king had granted to Kaikeyi, he fainted after hearing her cruel and harsh words.

raw: स नीलमिव जीमूतं तोयपूर्णं नभस्थलात् । आपपात गृहीत्वा तु हनुमान् शिखरं गिरेः ॥६-१०२-२७॥
translation: Like a dark cloud filled with water carried by wind, Hanuman held the mountain peak and went in the air from the surface of the earth.

raw: न हि निष्क्रमितुम् शक्यम् अनिमीलित लोचनैः । ततो निमीलिताः सर्वे सुकुमार अंगुलैः करैः ॥४-५२-२८॥
दशवर्षसहस्राणि गतानि सुमहात्मनोः । प्राप्तयोर्विविधान्भोगानतीतः शिशिरागमः ॥७-४२-२५॥
translation: The auspicious and always pleasure-giving winter season, during which Rama and Sita had enjoyed various pleasures, passed away.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा कैकसी तत्र ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आगम्य राक्षसी तत्र दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ॥७-९-४१॥
translation: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.

raw: न अध्यगच्चत् तदा पारम् शोकस्य कपि कुन्जरः । रावणम् वा वधिष्यामि दशग्रीवम् महा बलम् ॥५-१३-४९॥
सर्वमेतन्महाराज कृतमप्रतिमम् तव । विधीयेत सहास्माभिरादावेवास्य कर्मणः ॥६-१२-२९॥
translation: "Great king If you had discussed with us about all this action earlier, it would have been very good."

raw: नलिनैः अपि संछन्ना हि अत्यर्थ शुभ दर्शना । सर्प व्याल अनुचरिता मृग द्विज समाकुला ॥४-१-७॥
translation: Abounding in lotuses, birds and beasts and vicious serpents moving about, it looks splendid indeed.

raw: हर्षेण महता युक्तो ननन्द हरि यूथपः । आश्पोटयाम् आस चुचुम्ब पुच्चम् । ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम । स्तम्भान् अरोहन् निपपात भूमौ । निदर्शयन् स्वाम् प्रक्र्तिम् कपीनाम् ॥५-१०-५४॥
translation: He rejoiced clapping his palms, kissing his tail and jumping up, climbing up the pillars and jumping down on the ground in joy. Thus he exhibited his monkey nature. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: प्रतस्थे सहसा वीरो हरिः शतबलिः तदा । पूर्वाम् दिशम् प्रति ययौ विनतो हरि यूथपः ॥४-४५-५॥
एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामतौ । विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित ॥७-३५-१३॥
translation: O revered one, worshipped by gods, please tell me all about the great-minded Hanuman in detail and truly.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिमायान्तं वैदेह्या मुनिपत्नयः । उपाजग्मुर्मुदा युक्ता वचनं चेदमब्रुवन् ॥७-४९-१९॥
translation: Seeing the sage approaching with Vaidehi, the wives of the sages, filled with joy, came forward and spoke these words.

raw: तथा हि आत्तम् इदम् राज्यम् हृत साराम् सुराम् इव । न अभिमन्तुम् अलम् रामः नष्ट सोमम् इव अध्वरम् ॥२-६१-१८॥
translation: In the same way Rama will not accept this kingdom enjoyed by others like liquour or soma juice drained of its essence.

raw: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा पुत्राणाम् मुनिपुंगवः । क्रोध संरक्त नयनो व्याहर्तुम् उपचक्रमे ॥१-६२-१५॥
translation: On hearing the words of his sons Viswamitra, the eminent ascetic, eyes reddened with anger began to speak:

raw: महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ॥६-९७-३१॥
translation: Hurt by the palm which resembled Indra's weapon, blood started flowing from Virupaksha's body just like water flowed from waterfalls. Bathed in blood, vomiting blood, Virupaksha fell on the ground.

raw: ततः प्रहर्षमगमद्विपुलं पर्वतोत्तमः । देवतानां पतिं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टं शतक्रतुम् ॥५-१-१४३॥
translation: Thereafter Mainaka, the great mountain was delighted to see Indra, lord of the gods, performer of a hundred yajnas satisfied.

raw: लोबितः तेन रूपेण सीताया च प्रचोदितः । उवाच राघवो हृष्टो भ्रातरम् लक्ष्मणम् वचः ॥३-४३-२४॥
translation: On hearing Sita's words and seeing the wonderful deer, Rama was tempted by its appearance.Prompted by Sita,he joyfully said this to Lakshmana:

raw: तेषां समुपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः । कथ्यन्ते धर्मसंयुक्ताः पुराणज्ञैर्महात्मभिः ॥७-३७-२४॥
translation: To those who were seated, various very sweet stories imbued with righteousness were narrated by great souls who were learned in the Puranas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 37 ।। Thus ends the thirty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सहायम् वरयामास मारीचम् नाम राक्षसम् । वार्यमाणः सुबहुशो मारीचेन स रावणः ॥१-१-५०॥
तमुत्पतन्तं त्रिशिरास्त्रिभिर्बाणैरजिह्मगैः । घोरैर्हरिपतेः पुत्रं ललाटे ऽभिजघान ह ॥६-७०-१९॥
translation: While Angada was getting up, Trisira again hit him on the forehead with three straight going arrows.

raw: दृष्ट्वा रामम् क्रिया दक्षम् सुग्रीवो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । हरि वागुरया व्याप्तम् तप्त कांचन तोरणाम् ॥४-१४-५॥
ततो वित्रासयन्मर्त्यान्पृथिव्यां राक्षसाधिपः । आससाद घने तस्मिन्नारदं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ॥७-२०-१॥
translation: Then, the lord of demons, terrifying mortals on earth, met Narada, the foremost among sages, in that dense region.

raw: यदि धर्मेण युज्येरन्नाधर्मरुचयो जनाः । धर्मेण चरतां धर्मस्तथा चैषां फलं भवेत् ॥६-८३-२०॥
translation: "The righteous attains the benefit through righteous means, and the unrighteous suffer by unrighteous means. If unrighteousness is rooted in the unrighteous and are pleased with unrighteousness they will be deprived of the result of righteousness. It is not otherwise."

raw: अद्य बाणैर्धनुर्मुक्तैर्युगान्तादित्यसन्निभैः । राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव नेष्यामि यमसादनम् ॥६-९६-१०॥
translation: Loosening the shafts from the bow, Ravana resembling the Sun at the time of dissolution of the universe said," I shall dispatch Raghava and Lakshmana to the abode of the Lord of death."

raw: निवसन्ति उत्तम गिरौ तीक्ष्ण दम्ष्ट्रा नख आयुधाः । सिम्ह इव चतुर् दम्ष्ट्रा व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः ॥६-२७-४०॥
translation: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

raw: तमुवाच महातेजा वैनतेयो महाबलः । पतत्रिराजः प्रीतात्मा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ॥६-५०-४५॥
translation: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.

raw: क्ष्वेलन्तश्च नदन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । लब्धलक्षा रघुसुतं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे ॥६-९१-९५॥
translation: Having accomplished their goal, monkeys roaring, playing, surrounded Lakshmana, and stood.

raw: दिव्यैराच्छादयामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैः सुगन्धिभिः । धूपं सुगन्धं ससृजुस्तुष्टुवुश्च परन्तपम् ॥६-६०-३५॥
तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमं वृक्षं मन्दरसन्निभम् । समुत्सृजन्तं वेगेन पश्यतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥६-७६-५३॥
translation: All the Rakshasas seeing the tall tree, which was like Mandara mountain, resembling Indra's banner hurriedly was about to let loose.

raw: ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारुणं तथा । यदि शक्रजितो ऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्षाणि संयुगे ॥५-५९-१०॥
translation: "Even if the missiles used by Indrajit are Brahmastra, Indrastra, Rudrastra, Vayavastra, Varunastra which are difficult to see. I will destroy them in war and kill them.

raw: तस्यैव रथचक्रेण नीलो विष्णुरिवाहवे । शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे निकुम्भस्य च सारथेः ॥६-४३-३१॥
translation: Like Lord Vishnu, Nila took the wheels of the chariot of Nikumbha and shattered the charioteer into pieces.

raw: इमाम् गिरम् दारुण शब्द सम्श्रिताम् । निशम्य राजा अपि मुमोह दुह्खितः । ततः स शोकम् प्रविवेश पार्थिवः । स्वदुष्कृतम् च अपि पुनः तदा अस्मरत् ॥२-६१-२७॥
हतमित्येव तम् मन्ये युद्धे शत्रुनिबर्हण । किमुक्त्वा बहुधा चापि सर्वथा विजया भवान् ॥६-२-२५॥
स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम् । तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणो ऽस्फुरत् ॥७-२२-३५॥
translation: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.

raw: मेघ कृष्ण अजिन धरा धारा यज्ञ उपवीतिनः । मारुत आपूरित गुहाः प्राधीता इव पर्वताः ॥४-२८-१०॥
translation: 'The mountains are covered with dark clouds which appear like the hide of the antelope. Streams of rain water flowing are like the sacred threads hanging down the shoulder and the sounds of wind filling the caves resemble the recitation of Vedas by priests. (These mountains are comparable to the brahmacharins engaged in the recitation of Vedas wearing antelopeskin and sacred threads).

raw: एषा हि प्रकृतिः स्त्रीणाम् आसृष्टे रघुनंदन । समस्थम् अनुरंजंते विषमस्थम् त्यजन्ति च ॥३-१३-५॥
translation: O Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty from the beginning of the creation women, by nature, keep the husband company when all goes well and give them up when hard times come.

raw: देवान्तकश्च सङ्क्रुद्धः परिघेण तदा ऽङ्गदम् । उपगम्याभिहत्याशु व्यपचक्राम वेगवान् ॥६-७०-११॥
translation: Then infuriated Devanthaka quickly came over Angada directly and attacked him with his iron club and retreated.

raw: माहेश्वरमिदं सत्रमसमाप्तं कुलं दहेत् ॥७-१८-१७॥
translation: This sacrifice dedicated to Maheshvara, if left unfinished, would consume the whole lineage.

raw: तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् दृष्ट्वा सूर्य रश्मिभिः अर्दितम् । पक्षाभ्यम् छादयामास स्नेहात् परम विह्वलम् ॥४-५८-६॥
translation: 'Seeing my brother tormented due to the Sun's radiance I was overwhelmed with grief. Out of love I covered him with both my wings.

raw: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते । पुनः पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिपः ॥२-३४-२९॥
translation: Having fulfilled the vow on the completion of fourteen years of wandering in the forest I shall come back to touch your feet, O lord of men

raw: शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः । द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत् ॥६-४१-४२॥
translation: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.

raw: शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यम् नियता ब्रह्म चारिणी । सह रम्स्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु ॥२-२७-१२॥
translation: I shall wander with you, O heroic Rama in the honeyscented forest remaining selfpossessed, always doing your service, and observing the vow of celibacy.

raw: जातिरेव मम त्वेषा वानरो ऽहमिहागतः । दर्शने राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दुर्लभे तदिदं मया ॥५-५०-१४॥
translation: An audience with the lord of demons being hard to obtain, I destroyed this garden of the demon king in order to gain a sight of him.

raw: तथा निपतितं रामं जगत्यां जगतीपतिम् । कूलघातपरिश्रान्तं प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम् ॥२-१०२-४॥
ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामि तत् । विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः ॥७-८२-१९॥
translation: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."

raw: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः । शतानंदो महातेजा रामम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५१-१२॥
translation: Having heard Viswamitra the highly brilliant Satananda said to Rama:

raw: स कुम्भकर्णस्यशरान् शरीरेसप्तवीर्यवान् । निचखादाददेचान्यावनिससर्ज च लक्ष्मणः ॥६-६७-१०२॥
translation: Valiant Lakshmana pierced seven arrows on Kumbhakarna's body and discharged many arrows on him.

raw: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो रामो दशरथात्मजः । उवाच रावणं वीरः प्रहस्य परुषं वचः ॥६-१०५-१०॥
translation: Then Rama, the heroic son of Dasharatha, overcome by anger, laughing at Ravana, spoke these words.

raw: रामम् च एव महात्मानम् लक्ष्मणम् च पुनः पुनः । प्रीताः च तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिनि ॥४-२६-४०॥
translation: As Sugriva and Angada were installed, all the monkeys were highly pleased and praised the noblehearted Rama and Lakshmana again and again.

raw: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना यस्मात्त्वमनवस्थिता । तस्माद्रूपवती लोके न त्वमेका भविष्यति ॥७-३०-३८॥
translation: Because you, endowed with beauty and youth, are unstable, therefore you will not be the only beautiful woman in the world.

raw: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः कपिलाघवविस्मितः । अस्त्रमाहारयामास दीप्तमाग्नेयमद्भुतम् ॥६-५९-८१॥
translation: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.

raw: कृत्यमस्ति महाज्जाने कर्तव्यमिति शत्रुभिः । राक्षसास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा लङ्कायाम् परिचक्रमुः ॥६-११-१९॥
अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम् । प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह ॥७-१०६-१७॥
translation: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.

raw: वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभ राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽस्मि रावणः । युद्धेप्सुरिह सम्प्राप्तः स चाद्यासादितस्त्वया ॥७-३४-३६॥
translation: Ravana addressed Bali, saying, "O king of monkeys, resembling Mahendra, I am Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, who arrived here desirous of battle, and that desire has been fulfilled by you today."

raw: प्राप्स्यसि त्वम् महाप्राज्ञ मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम् । यथा विष्णुः महाबाहुः बलिम् बद्ध्वा महीम् इमाम् ॥३-६१-२४॥
translation: O longarmed brother O wise sire just as Visnu obtained the earth by binding Bali you will obtain Sita certainly.

raw: कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतस्सुतान् । जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान् ॥७-७९-१३॥
translation: The righteous son of Manu, Ikshvaku, then begot a hundred sons, resembling the sons of gods, through various kinds of rituals and deeds.

raw: प्रजापतेस्तुपौत्रस्त्वंतथैवरक्षरजस्सुतः । श्रुतपौरुषसम्पन्नःकस्माद्गर्जसिवानर ॥६-६७-५९॥
translation: "O Vanara! You are the grandson of creator Brahma and son of Rksharaja, endowed with fortitude and so roaring like this."

raw: प्रासादैर्विविधाकारैर्वृतां वैद्यजनाकुलाम् । कच्चित्सुमुदितां स्फीतामयोध्यां परिरक्षसि ॥२-१००-४३॥
translation: My dear brother I trust you are protecting the (impregnable) city of Ayodhya worthy of its name, formerly defended by our heroic ancestors, with its sturdy gates, its elephants, horses and chariots, its thousands of venerable, selfcontrolled and highly energetic brahmins, kshatriyas and vaisyas engaged in their respective professions, filled with palaces of various kinds, abounding in learned people and a prosperous city where everything is available in abundance.

raw: राजा जयति सुग्रीव इति शब्दो महानभूत् ॥६-४२-४३॥
translation: "May the vanara king,triumphant Sugriva be victorious", thus sounded the cry of vanaras in the battlefield.

raw: स किंचिदनुसंप्राप्तः समालोक्य महागिरिम् । महेन्द्रमेघसङ्काशं ननाद हरिपुङ्गवः ॥५-५७-१५॥
translation: The chief of the monkeys arrived near, and beholding the face of the Mahendra mountain, which resembled a mass of clouds, thundered.

raw: तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु यथेमे काननौकसः । न युद्ध्येयुर्दुरात्मानः प्रविष्टे नगरं मयि ॥६-९१-७॥
translation: "While I enter the city you must see that these wicked minded Vanaras do not prevent me from going."

raw: यः समुत्पतितं क्रोधं क्षमयैव निरस्यति । यथोरगस्त्वचं जीर्णां स वै पुरुष उच्यते ॥५-५५-७॥
translation: 'A man who drives away his rising anger with tolerance just as a snake casts off its slough is alone called a truly wise man.

raw: एवम् विलपतीम् ताराम् पति शोक परीवृताम् । उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोक कर्शिताः ॥४-२५-४८॥
translation: The griefstricken female monkeys helped Tara, overwhelmed with sorrow due to her husband's death, rise from the ground.

raw: कंबलानाम् च मुख्यानाम् क्षौमान् कोटि अंबराणि च । हस्ति अश्व रथ पादातम् दिव्य रूपम् स्वलंकृतम् ॥१-७४-४॥
translation: The king of Mithila and father of the brides gave a hundred thousand cows, excellent woollen carpets, crores of silk garments, four divisions of elephants, horses, chariots and infantry and welldecorated, excellent male and maidservants shining in celestial beauty.

raw: ततः सहस्ताभरणान् प्रगृह्य विपुलान् भुजान् । अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रैष्ठाः प्राञ्जलिं राघवं स्थितम् ॥६-१२०-५॥
translation: Then foremost of gods adorned with ornaments in hands lifted up their long shoulders and greeted Raghava with joined palms and spoke as follows.

raw: आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ चापमिन्द्रारिराहवे । मुमोच तं शरं क्रुद्धस्त्रिपुरे शङ्करो यथा ॥७-२१-४२॥
translation: Then, Indrajit, the enemy of Indra, enraged in battle, drew his bow up to his ear and released that arrow, just as Shiva did at Tripura.

raw: दृष्टं मे नन्दनं भग्नमृषयो निहताः श्रुताः । देवतानां समुद्योगस्त्वत्तो राजन्मम श्रुतः ॥७-१३-१९॥
translation: I have seen the Nandana garden destroyed, I have heard that sages were killed, and I have heard from you, O King, about the gods' preparations.

raw: यस्य ते वज्रनिष्पेषो न कुर्याद्व्यसनं सदा । स कथं रामबाणार्तः प्रसुप्तो ऽसि महीतले ॥६-६८-१४॥
translation: "You are never affected by the strike of thunderbolt. How are you sleeping on the ground hit by Rama's arrows?"

raw: विषाण्णा हरयः सर्वे हनुमन् किम् उपेक्षसे । विक्रमस्व महावेग विष्णुः त्रीन् विक्रमान् इव ॥४-६६-३७॥
translation: 'O Hanuman All the monkeys look dejected. Why do you delay? O warrior, act quick with your rapid speed like Trivikrama who took three strides that covered the entire universe'.

raw: भृत्यो युक्तः समर्थश्च तमाहुः पुरुष्धमम् । तन्नियोगे नियुक्तेन कृतम् हनूमता ॥६-१-१०॥
ततः तु जल शेषेण लक्ष्मणो अप्य् अकरोत् तदा । वाग् यताः ते त्रयः सम्ध्याम् उपासत समाहिताः ॥२-८७-१९॥
translation: Thereafter Lakshmana also drank the remainder of water. Then all the three observing silence intently performed the evening worship.

raw: तस्मिन् दग्धे तदा कुक्षौ समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः । राघवम् सर्वशास्त्रज्ञमिदम् वचनम्ब्रवीत् ॥६-२२-४३॥
translation: Thereafter when that land of Drumakulyam was burnt (by Rama's arrow) the Lord of rivers looked at Rama who was learned in all sastras spoke these words.

raw: स तु तत्रावसत्प्रीतो धर्मात्मा नैर्ऋतर्षभः । समुद्रपरिघायां तु लङ्कायां विश्रवात्मजः ॥७-३-३४॥
translation: That righteous soul, the chief of Rakshasas and son of Vishrava (Kubera), happily dwelt there in Lanka, which was surrounded by the ocean.

raw: इक्ष्वाकुकुलमक्षोभ्यमाकुलम् पालयिष्यसि । प्रियम् चेद्भरतस्यैतद्रामप्रव्राजनम् भवेत् ॥२-१२-९३॥
ततः त्रिशंकोः वचनम् श्रुत्वा क्रोध समन्वितम् । ऋषि पुत्र शतम् राम राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५७-१॥
इति एवम् उक्तः सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृ सौहृदात् । हर्षम् त्यक्त्वा पुनर् दीनो ग्रह ग्रस्त इव उडु राट् ॥४-२२-१७॥
translation: Thus spoken to by Vali with brotherly affection, Sugriva gave up joy (of victory) and appeared dull like the Moon eclipsed by planet Rahu.

raw: अहो महत् कर्म कृतं निरर्थकं न राक्षसैर्मन्त्रगतिर्विमृष्टा । पुनश्च नास्त्रे विहते ऽस्त्रमन्यत् प्रवर्तते संशयिताः स्म सर्वे ॥५-४८-५१॥
translation: 'Alas! my achievement has been wasted. The ogres had not considered the impact of the mantra of astra . Once the Brahmastra is ineffective another astra cannot be operative again. We are all running a risk.'

raw: गुहासमीरणो गन्धान् नानापुष्पभवान् वहन् । घ्राणतर्प्पणमभ्येत्य कं नरं न प्रहर्षयेत् ॥२-९४-१४॥
translation: The breeze from the caves carrying the fragrance of many flowers is satisfying the sense of smell. Who will not find it delightful?

raw: चन्दनस्य च शीतस्य शीधोर् मधु रसस्य च । विविधस्य च माल्यस्य पुष्पस्य विविधस्य च ॥५-११-३१॥
translation: With the many scents of cool sandal, of sweetsmelling wines of diverse kinds, as well as flower garlands of several types and of incense burning in that hall, the cool wind blew spreading several fragrances all over.

raw: सहसाभूत्ततो वेगाद्भीमवेगो महोदधिः । योजनम् व्यतिचक्राम वेलामन्यत्र सम्प्लवात् ॥६-२२-१५॥
translation: There after those waves of water with its creatures, serpents and demons were at once thrown off at terrific speed that was unprecedented. They were thrown beyond a yojana by the high tides.

raw: निवृत्ताः सम्विगाहन्ते वनानि वन गोचराः । ऋक्षाम् च द्विपिनः चैव नील कोमलक प्रभान् ॥३-७३-३८॥
लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्म भूतो महातपाः । ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तम् पुत्रम् इच्छामि धार्मिकम् ॥१-३३-१६॥
translation: Bestowed with the great asceticism and brilliance of a brahmin, you look like Brahma. O righteous one, I desire a son endowed with the ascetic virtues of a brahmin.

raw: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवः सपरिच्छदः । अग्नि होत्रम् उपासीनम् शरभंगम् उपागमत् ॥३-५-२५॥
translation: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

raw: रामस्य प्रिय भार्यस्य न निवेदयितुम् क्षमम् । निवेद्यमाने दोषः स्याद् दोषः स्याद् अनिवेदने ॥५-१३-१८॥
अथापराह्णसमये भ्रातृभिः सह राघवः । शुश्राव मधुरां वाणीमन्तरिक्षात् प्रभाषिताम् ॥७-४१-२॥
translation: Then, in the afternoon, Rama, along with his brothers, heard a sweet voice spoken from the sky.

raw: क्षमस्व रोषं त्यज राक्षसेन्द्र प्रसीद मद्वाक्यमिदं शृणुष्व । वधं न कुर्वन्ति परावरज्ञा दूतस्य सन्तो वसुधाधिपेन्द्राः ॥५-५२-५॥
translation: "O king of ogres give up your wrath, forgive and calm down. Please listen to my appeal. You know the basic values of life. Virtuous rulers of the earth do not order killing of an envoy.

raw: विनतं जाम्बवन्तं च सानुप्रस्थं महाबलम् । ऋषभं चर्षभस्कन्धमादिदेश परन्तपः ॥६-४५-३॥
translation: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, ordered the two sons of Sushena, the best of Vanaras Neela, Jambavantha, Angada, as well as courageous Sarabha, Vinatha, and Hanumantha and Sanuprastha endowed with extraordinary might, also Rshaba and Rshaba Skanda.

raw: इत्युक्तः सोओऽभ्यनुज्ञातः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने । व्रजेति रामः पितरमभिवाद्याभ्ययाद्गृहम् ॥२-४-२८॥
translation: Having spoken to Rama about the installation ceremony fixed for the next day, he (Dasaratha) permitted him to leave saying, 'You may go'. Rama paid obeisance to his father and returned to his abode.

raw: राक्षसानां विनाशाय दूषणस्य खरस्य च । चकाराप्रतिरूपा सा राघवस्य प्रधर्षणम् ॥६-९५-९॥
translation: "Because of our bad luck and to the destruction of her own people, Khara and Dooshana, that old lady, with wrinkled face, grey haired (Surpanakha) Rakshasa woman tried to go and attack Raghava, a misdeed which was ridiculed and condemned by the whole world?"

raw: मा च बुद्धिमधर्मे त्वं कुर्या राजन्कथञ्चन । बुद्धिमन्तो हि राजानो ध्रुवमश्नन्ति मेदिनीम् ॥७-४०-१०॥
translation: O King, never let your mind incline towards unrighteousness, for intelligent kings certainly rule the earth.

raw: समग्रयवमच्छिद्रं पाणिपादं च वर्णवत् । मन्दस्मितेत्येव च मां कन्यालक्षणिनो द्विजाः ॥६-४८-१३॥
translation: "My palms and feet placed together have no space which are auspicious marks and brahmins have said that my gentle smile is also a mark of auspiciousness."

raw: आर्य लक्ष्मण संप्राह वीरो दधिमुखः कपिः । अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्भक्षितं मधु वानरैः ॥५-६३-१४॥
यदि माम् प्रतियुध्येरन् देव गन्धर्व दानवाः । न एव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्व लोक भयाद् अपि ॥६-३०-१५॥
translation: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas come to wage war with me and even if I have threats from all worlds, I will not give away Sita."

raw: किम् नु कुःखमलीकम् वा मयि रामे च पश्यसि । न कथम्चि दृते रामाद्भरतो राज्यमावसेत् ॥२-१२-६१॥
चापापहारे भुज वेग पंकेशर ऊर्मिमाले सु महा आहव ओघे । न राम पाताल मुखे अति घोरेप्रस्कन्दितुम् राक्षस राज युक्तम् ॥३-३१-४८॥
translation: O king of demons it is not proper (for you) to jump into the extremely fierce mouth of the nether world known as Rama. Who can steal the bow from his mighty arms which are whirlpools of mud. His arrows are rows of waves in the flow of the great war.

raw: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम । मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तन्निदर्शय ॥६-४१-६५॥
translation: "O lowly Rakshasa! By deceiving me you took away Sita. Display that strength now."

raw: हा राम इति जनाः केचित् राम माता इति च अपरे । अन्तः पुरम् समृद्धम् च क्रोशन्तम् पर्यदेवयन् ॥२-४०-३८॥
translation: Some among them wailed 'Oh Rama', while some others cried 'Oh mother of Rama' By crying loudly, they made the women in the inner apartment cry too.

raw: मुक्ता मणि चितम् च इदम् तपनीय विभूषितम् । धरण्याम् पतितम् सौम्य कस्य भग्नम् महत् धनुः ॥३-६४-४३॥
translation: O handsome Lakshmana whose is this huge bow embedded with pearls and gems and adorned with gold fallen on the ground?

raw: अयोध्याधिपते वीर वैदेहो मिथिलाधिप: स त्वां द्रष्टुं व्यवसितस्सोपाध्यायपुरोहितम् ॥१-७०-१३॥
translation: "O Heroic lord of Ayodhya, Janaka, the lord of Mithila desires to see you along with preceptors and priest".

raw: तप्तचामीकराभाय वह्नये विश्वकर्मणे । नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे ॥६-१०७-२१॥
translation: "Namaskar to one possessing the lustre of pure gold, dispeller of darkness, architect of the universe, splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, witnessor of all actions in the world.

raw: स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तरुण्यश्च सायं प्रातः समाहिताः । सर्वान् देवान् नमस्यन्ति रामस्यार्थे यशस्विनः ॥२-२-५२॥
translation: Women, young and old alike devoutly invoke at dusk and at dawn all the gods for the sake of the celebrated Rama.

raw: प्राप्य सीताम् अयुद्धेन वंचयित्वा तु राघवम् । लंकाम् प्रति गमिष्यामि कृत कार्यः सह त्वया ॥३-४०-२५॥
translation: I will deceive Rama and obtain Sita, without waging a war. With the work done, I will return to Lanka along with you.

raw: स तमभ्रमिवाविष्टमुद्भ्रन्तमिव मेदिनीम् । अपश्यद्रावणो विन्ध्यमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम् ॥७-३१-१४॥
translation: Ravana saw that Vindhya mountain, which seemed to pervade the clouds and bewilder the earth, as if it were scratching the sky.

raw: अग्निदीप्तमुखान् बाणान् तथा सूर्यमुखानपि । चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रवक्त्रांश्च धूमकेतुमुखानपि ॥६-१००-४६॥
translation: There Rama produced missiles glowing like fire, like Sun 's face, like moon's face, crescent moon face, face like Dhumakethu, missiles like planets, and star faced, with fire sticks like face resembling flashes and lightning and several others and let loose.

raw: तत: सन्दर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघव: । मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानुपुरोहितम् ॥२-९०-३॥
translation: Then the scion of the Raghu race (Bharata) halted his ministers within sight of Bharadwaja's (hermitage) and went along following his priest Vasistha.

raw: तस्याः पुनर्बिम्बफलाधरोष्ठं स्वक्षिभ्रु केशान्तमरालपक्ष्म । वक्त्रं बभासे सितशुक्लदंष्ट्रं राहोर्मुखाच्चन्द्र इव प्रमुक्तः ॥५-२९-७॥
translation: Her face shining with beautiful red lips like bimba fruit, sparkling teeth, and curved eyelashes with lovely brows extending up to her hair, she appeared like a Moon released from the mouth of Rahu.

raw: तस्य कोटिः दिवम् स्पृष्ट्वा शत योजनम् आयता । जातरूपमयी दिव्या विराजति स वेदिका ॥४-४०-५५॥
translation: 'The flag of Ananta is fixed by the gods in the eastern direction. Beyond that stands the famous golden mountain behind which the sun rises. Its golden peak with a divine altar spread over a hundred yojanas touches heaven.

raw: स गङ्गां प्राग्वटे तीर्त्वा समायात्कुटिकोष्ठिकाम् । सबल स्तां स तीर्त्वाऽथ समायाद्धर्मवर्धनम् ॥२-७१-१०॥
translation: With Ganga at Pragvata city and river Kutikoshtika crossed along with his army, he reached Dharmavardhana village.

raw: धिक् त्वाम् इति परे लोके व्यक्तम् वक्ष्यति मे पिता । विवशम् शोक संतप्तम् दीनम् भग्न मनोरथम् ॥३-६१-९॥
न हि एषा बुद्धिः आस्थेया हनूमन् अंगदम् प्रति । पिता हि बंधुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरि सत्तम ॥४-२१-१५॥
translation: 'O Hanuman the best of monkeys, you need not think about (the future of) Angada. A father plans for a son and not (even) the mother.

raw: शृणु ब्रह्मन्पुरा वृत्तं ममैतत्सुखदुःखयोः । अनतिक्रमणीयं हि यथा पृच्छसि मां द्विज ॥७-७८-२॥
translation: O Brahmana, O twice-born, listen to this unavoidable story of my past joys and sorrows, as you have asked me.

raw: प्रिय कामः च ते मातुः तत् अर्थम् च अस्य जीवितम् । तस्य अपत्यम् च न अस्ति अन्यत् तस्मात् अंगद गम्यताम् ॥४-५४-२२॥
शङ्खे नेत्रे करौ पादौ गुल्फावूरू च मे चितौ । अनुवृत्तनखाः स्निग्धाः समाश्चाङ्गुलयो मम ॥६-४८-१०॥
translation: "My temporal bones, eyes, hands, feet, ankles, thighs are even, and my fingers are fleshy and round with nails proportioned and bright."

raw: कर्मभिस्तु शुभैरिष्टै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणै: । स्वर्गं दशरथ: प्राप्त: पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥२-१०५-३४॥
translation: Dasaratha, our father and lord of the earth, reached heaven by performing auspicious acts and offering abundant charities in sacrifices.

raw: स तानि शर जालानि पक्षाभ्याम् तु विधूय ह । चरणाभ्याम् महातेजा बभंज अस्य महत् धनुः ॥३-५१-१३॥
translation: Powerful Jatayu scattered the shower of arrows with his wings and broke down the great bow with his claws.

raw: लाङूलेन प्रदीप्तेन राक्षसांस्तानपातयत् । रोषामर्षपरीतात्मा बालसूर्यसमाननः ॥५-५३-८॥
translation: The demons soaked the tail and set fire to it. His face burning in anger shone like the rising Sun and his mind seized with indignation, he struck them with the burning tail.

raw: तमृषि: पुरुषव्याघ्रं प्राञ्जलिं प्रेक्ष्य चागतम् । हुताग्निहोत्रो भरतं भरद्वाजो ऽभ्यभाषत ॥२-९२-२॥
translation: Seeing Bharata, the best among men, who stood with folded palms, sage Bharadwaja, who had just completed his firesacrifice, said to him:

raw: किम् उद्यमम् व्यर्थम् इमम् कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप । दृष्टः चेत् त्वम् रणे तेन तत् अंतम् तव जीवितम् ॥३-३७-२१॥
translation: O chief of the demons, why do you make this futile attempt ? The moment you are seen by Rama in war will be the last of your life.

raw: प्रसादयित्वा सुग्रीवम् वचनैः स अर्थ निश्चितैः । आसीनम् पर्युपासीनौ यथा शक्रम् मरुत्पतिम् ॥४-३१-४४॥
translation: Both of them sat close by Sugriva who was like Indra and said these pleasing words:

raw: बलवान् वीर्य सम्पन्नो लक्ष्मणो नाम यो अपि असौ । किम् न मोचयते रामम् कृत्वा अपि पितृ निग्रहम् ॥२-७८-३॥
translation: And why did not Lakshmana who is strong and powerful release Rama from exile by restraining our father?

raw: तव राज्यं नरव्याघ्र मम प्रव्राजनं तथा । तौ च राजा तदा तस्यै नियुक्त: प्रददौ वरौ ॥२-१०७-६॥
translation: Thereafter, O tiger among men, your illustrious mother of fair complexion, under oath demanded of that best of men, king Dasaratha, the two boons, namely kingdom for you and banishment for me. Bound by such agreement (oath), the king granted her the boons.

raw: येन इयम् आगता द्वैधम् तव बुद्धिर् मही पते । स हि धर्मः मम द्वेष्यः प्रसन्गात् यस्य मुह्यसि ॥२-२३-११॥
translation: O noble minded one I hate this righteousness which has deluded your intellect and created this dilemma about this issue.

raw: तस्य दृष्ट्वा मुखम् देवि पूर्ण चन्द्रम् इव उदितम् । मोक्ष्यसे शोकजम् वारि निर्मोकम् इव पन्नगी ॥६-३३-३६॥
translation: "God like Lady! Beholding the face of Sri Rama whose face is like a just risen full moon, you will cast off tears of sorrow just as a female snake sets its slough free."

raw: यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दीप्तरश्मिर्दिवाकरः । स महात्मा मुहूर्तेन सर्वतः सलिलावृतः ॥५-१-१०३॥
तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रः त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । सुग्रीवम् वानरेन्द्रम् तु रामः शरणम् आगतः ॥४-४-२३॥
translation: 'Famous in all the three worlds, this Rama, who was the firshborn of Dasaratha, endowed with all virtues and ever respected by all the kings of this earth, now seeks shelter of Sugriva, Chief of monkeys.

raw: एतत्तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो लघु विक्रमः । लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रतो रामम् सम्रब्धम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥६-१७-१८॥
translation: Highly valiant Sugriva having heard all this (from Vibheeshana) eagerly spoke these words to Rama in the presence of Lakshmana.

raw: अथ विनदति सादिते निकुम्भे पवनसुतेन रणे बभूव युद्धम् । दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रसून्वोर्भृशतरमागतरोषयोः सुभीमम् ॥६-७७-२४॥
translation: And thereafter as Nikumbha killed by windgod's son was crying aloud in the battlefield, a violent and fierce war took place between the highly disturbed son of Dasharatha and Rakshasa Makara.

raw: यः कपीन् अति बभ्राज हिमवान् इव पर्वतान् । किष्किन्धाम् यः समध्यास्ते गुहाम् सगहन द्रुमाम् ॥६-२८-३०॥
translation: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

raw: तम् स दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुः सुग्रीवम् पर्यवस्थितम् । गाढम् परिदधे वासो वाली परम कोपिनः ॥४-१६-१६॥
translation: On seeing the great hero Sugriva standing firmly, the enraged Vali tied his upper cloth (around his loin) tightly.

raw: स देवर्षि गणम् तुष्टम् राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥बभौ रामः संप्रहृष्टः पूजितः सर्व देवतैः ॥१-१-८४॥
करः च निहतः सम्ख्ये त्रिशिराः च निपातितः । दूषणः च महा तेजा रामेण विदित आत्मना ॥५-१६-१०॥
translation: "Ogres like Khara and Trisira and the powerful Dooshana were kileed in battle by Rama endowed with selfknowledge.

raw: रावणेनापनीतैषा वीर्योत्सिक्तेन रक्षसा । त्वया विरहिता दीना विवशा निर्जनाद्वनात् ॥६-१२१-८॥
translation: "When she was lonely, piteous, having no control, Rakshasa Ravana, who was proud of his valour abducted her from the forest when no one was there."

raw: कैलास शिखरेभ्यः च सिंह केसर वर्चसाम् । ततः कोटि सहस्राणि वानराणाम् समागमन् ॥४-३७-२२॥
translation: From the peaks of Kailasa mountain moved out one thousand crores of monkeys who were of bright colour like the lion's mane.

raw: समालभ्य ततः सर्वे कृत्वा च एनम् प्रदक्षिणम् । षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि बिभिदुर् वसुधा तलम् ॥१-४०-२३॥
translation: Then all sixty thousand sons having touched the elephant and circumambulated it, penetrated the earth.

raw: स्वर् गतः च महा राजो रामः च अरण्यम् आश्रितः । लक्ष्मणः च अपि तेजस्वी रामेण एव गतः सह ॥२-६७-६॥
translation: The great king has attained heaven, Rama has taken refuge in the forest and brilliant Lakshmana has also gone with Rama.

raw: सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम् । त्वयाप्युक्तं महाराज न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम् ॥७-२५-४३॥
translation: O king of kings, be truthful in your word and consider me, who is begging, for you yourself, O great king, said, "You should not be afraid."

raw: ततस्तु वानराः सर्वे भिन्नदेहा विचेतसः । व्यथिता विद्रवन्ति स्म रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ॥६-७३-३७॥
translation: Then Vanaras with their bodies broken, courage and consciousness lost, blood flowed from mutilated bodies.

raw: जित्वा वैश्रवणं देवं कैलासात्समवातरत् ॥७-१५-४४॥
translation: Having conquered the god Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera), he descended from Mount Kailasa.

raw: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे ॥५-३९-५॥
translation: Hanuman possessed with fierce valour said to Vaidehi, 'so be it' and bowed his head, and offered salutations before he departed.

raw: विवस्वान् काश्यपाज्जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वत स्स्मृत: । मनु: प्रजापति: पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुस्तु मनोस्सुत: ॥१-७०-२१॥
translation: Kasyapa begot Vivasvan and Vivasvan, Manu. Ikshavaku was the son of Manu otherwise called Prajapati or Vaivasvata.

raw: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टः सुषेणो हरिपुङ्गवः । शिलां सुमहतीं गृह्य निशाचरमभिद्रवत् ॥६-४३-३८॥
translation: Thereafter overtaken by anger, the monkey leader Sushena seized the huge rock from the Rakshasa and dropped it.

raw: लङ्घयन्तः प्रधावन्तो वानरा नावलोकयन् ॥६-६६-१४॥
translation: The Vanaras leapt without looking back. Indeed, some dropped into the ocean, and some flew into space.

raw: दीपानाम् च प्रकाशेन तेजसा रावणस्य च । अर्चिर्भिर् भूषणानाम् च प्रदीप्ता इति अभ्यमन्यत ॥५-९-३३॥
translation: Hanuman fancied that the entire place was set ablaze with the glow of lamps, the lustre of Ravana and the brilliant glow of Ravana's ornaments (everything was shining).

raw: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः । गच्छन्तमन्वगछंस्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः ॥७-१०९-१४॥
translation: Then, all the subjects, filled with joyful and well-nourished people, who were charmed by Rama's virtues, followed him as he departed.

raw: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः । विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ॥५-३०-३७॥
translation: "Even well planned diplomatic missions fail like darkness dispelled at Sunrise if the messenger is confused and if the place and time are not propitious for them.

raw: हनुमान् वक्षसि व्यूढे सञ्चचाल पुनःपुनः ॥६-५९-६८॥
का त्वम् कांचन वर्ण आभे पीत कौशेय वासिनि । कमलानाम् शुभाम् मालाम् पद्मिनी इव च बिभ्रती ॥३-४६-१६॥
translation: Who are you with a golden complexion, clad in yellow silk, and looking like a lotuspond and wearing an auspicious lotus garland?

raw: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते भयार्दिताः । चोदयामासुरव्यग्रान् राक्षसांस्तान् नृपाज्ञया ॥६-९६-६॥
translation: On hearing the words of the king's order, the Rakshasas stricken with fear, unagitated, started thinking.

raw: स्वदत्तकृतसाक्षी यो द्वितीय इव पावकः । लब्धसञ्ज्ञा विजेष्यन्ते लोका यस्य महात्मनः ॥७-२०-२८॥
translation: How can one conquer that great being (Yama), who is a witness to all deeds, like a second fire, and by whom all conscious beings in the worlds are eventually overcome?

raw: सर्वमुक्तम् यथादिष्टम् रावणेन दुरात्मना । तत्प्रपयन्तम् वचनम् तूर्णमाप्लुत्य वानराः ॥६-२०-१५॥
translation: Thus, commanded by evil minded Ravana, Suka communicated everything as spoken by Ravana. At once the Vanaras rose and started to injure Suka with their fists.

raw: ततः कपिः प्राप्तमनोरथार्थस्तामक्षतां राजसुतां विदित्वा । प्रत्यक्षतस्तां पुनरेव दृष्ट्वा प्रतिप्रयाणाय मतिं चकार ॥५-५५-३५॥
translation: Hanuman, having fulfilled his desires and knowing that Sita is not hurt, thought of departing after meeting Sita once again (to testify that she is really safe). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अप्रसन्नमनाः किम् नु सदा मां प्रति वत्सलः । विवर्ण वदनो दीनो न हि माम् अभिभाषते ॥२-१८-१२॥
translation: Father has always been affectionate to me but today why is he in a dejected mood? Why does his countenance look pale and wretched? Why does he not speak to me?

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १०१ ॥६-१०१-६४॥
एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी । उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ ॥५-६५-१८॥
translation: "O bull among men I saw Janaki,the delight of Janaka, a formidable lady filled with devotion to you and richly endowed with austerity.

raw: जनानाम् रतिसम्योगेष्वत्यन्तगुणवन्ति च । तान्येतान्यद्य वश्यामि निरानन्दानि सर्वशः ॥२-७१-२६॥
कुरु कल्याणम् अत्यर्थम् यदि जानासि तत्त्वतः । एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण वाक्यम् दनुः अनुत्तमम् ॥३-७१-२६॥
एतत् श्रुत्वा वचः तस्य रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् । प्रहृष्ट वदनः श्रीमान् भ्रातरम् पार्श्वतः स्थितम् ॥४-३-२५॥
translation: Having heard him, the Illustrious Rama cheerfully said to brother Lakshmana standing nearby:

raw: अहम् प्रभाव संपन्ना स्वच्छंद बल गामिनी । चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किम् करिष्यसि ॥३-१७-२५॥
translation: I have influence over others, I have capacity to move wherever I want. Be my husband forever. What will you do with Sita?

raw: कौसल्या बिभृयात् आर्या सहस्रम् अपि मद् विधान् । यस्याः सहस्रम् ग्रामाणाम् सम्प्राप्तम् उपजीवनम् ॥२-३१-२०॥
translation: Noble Kausalya has under her charge a thousand villages for her sustenance. She can support a thousand men like me.

raw: ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम् । प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ॥५-६५-१॥
translation: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.

raw: हृष्ट पक्षि गण आकीर्णः कन्दर उदर कूटवान् । दक्षिणस्य उदधेः तीरे विन्ध्यो अयम् इति निश्चितः ॥४-६०-७॥
translation: 'I came to know then that this place is inhabited by flocks of happy birds and full of many caves and mountain peaks. This is mount Vindhya on the shore of the southern ocean.

raw: तदार्य कलुषा बुद्धिः जायते शस्त्र सेवनात् । पुनर् गत्वात् तत् अयोध्यायाम् क्षत्र धर्मम् चरिष्यसि ॥३-९-२८॥
translation: Lord, when we handle the weapon, the mind gets vitiated. (Only) after returning to Ayodhya can you perform the duty of a kshatriya.

raw: सुपर्णपृष्ठे स बभौ श्यामः पीताम्बरो हरिः । काञ्चनस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे सतडित्तोयदो यथा ॥७-६-६८॥
translation: Dark-complexioned Hari, adorned in yellow garments, shone on Garuda's back like a lightning-streaked cloud upon the peak of a golden mountain.

raw: तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे हनूमता शक्रपराक्रमेण । नेदुः प्लवङ्गाः प्रचचाल भूमी रक्षांस्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात् ॥६-७०-४९॥
translation: Trisira, the enemy of gods, endowed with the prowess of Indra got killed by Hanuman. The earth shook, the monkeys roared and the Rakshasas from all sides took to their heels.

raw: स राक्षस रथे पश्यन् जानकीम् बाष्प लोचनाम् । अचिंतयित्वा बाणाम् तान् राक्षसम् समभिद्रवत् ॥३-५१-९॥
translation: Seeing Sita, daughter of Janaka, on the demon's chariot with eyes full of tears, Jatayu without minding the arrows renewed his attack.

raw: भविष्यति दृढं रामो दुःखप्रायो ऽपि सौख्यभाक् । प्राप्स्यते च महाबाहुर्विप्रयोगं प्रियैर्ध्रुवम् ॥७-५०-११॥
translation: Rama, though predominantly sorrowful, will certainly experience happiness, and the mighty-armed one will undoubtedly face separation from his dear ones.

raw: विक्रान्तो रक्षिता नित्यम् आत्मनश्च परस्य च । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा कुशली नय शास्त्रवित् ॥६-३३-१२॥
translation: "O Sita! One who is endowed with long rounded arms and broad chest, a valorous one, a glorious wielder of bow and powerful Rama along with his brother Lakshmana, is always a protector of himself and all surrounding him. He is a knower of sastras of propriety. Raghava is majestic with inconceivable courage and a destroyer of foes. He will not be killed."

raw: उत्थास्यति च मेदिन्याः कृपणः पाम्शु गुण्ठितः । विनिह्श्वसन् प्रस्रवणात् करेणूनाम् इव ऋषभः ॥२-४२-१६॥
ताम्यमानः स माम् दुःखादुवाच परमार्तवत् । सीदमानो विवृत्ताङ्गो वेष्टमानो गतः क्षयम् ॥२-६३-५१॥
translation: Suffering from excruciating pain, sinking with his limbs twisting and writhing and plunging into death and destruction, with intense agony he uttered the following words with great difficulty:

raw: मारुतस्य समो वेगे गरुडस्य समो जवे । अयुतम् योजनानाम् तु गमिष्यामि इति मे मतिः ॥४-६७-२७॥
translation: 'I am equal to Maruta and Garuda in speed. I feel I can cover ten thousand yojanas (at a stretch).

raw: अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम् । अग्निं तत्र स निक्षिप्य श्वसनेन समो बली ॥५-५४-८॥
translation: Powerful and brave Hanuman who was equal to the Windgod in speed jumped down on the house of Prahasta and set fire to it. From there he jumped on to Mahaparsva's house and set it ablaze. Hanuman appeared like the fireflame at the time of dissolution.

raw: मखा ह्यद्य महाबाहो तृतीये दिवसे प्रभो । फल्गुन्यामुत्तरे राजंस्तस्मिन्वैवाहिकं कुरु रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् दानं कार्यं सुखोदयम् ॥१-७१-२४॥
translation: Today the star Makha is on the ascendant. O King perform the marriage on the, third day from today under UttaraPhalguni star. Gifts may be given for the happiness of Rama and Lakshmana". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः । नैतदस्तीति निश्चित्य तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ॥७-१०५-१८॥
translation: Then, the greatly renowned Rama, having intellectually ascertained the words of Kala and deciding that "this is not (to be avoided)", remained silent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 105 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: लक्ष्मणं परिवार्येह तिष्ठध्वं वानरोत्तमाः ॥६-१०१-४७॥
ते सुतीर्थां तत: कृच्छ्रादुपागम्य यशस्विन: । नदीं मन्दाकिनीं रम्यां सदा पुष्पितकाननाम् ॥२-१०२-२४॥
translation: The illustrious brothers approached with great difficulty the swiftflowing and enchanting river Mandakini which had convenient descent and endowed with forests always in bloom. They descended at an auspicious place that was not slushy and offered libations of water saying 'O father, let these offerings be yours'.

raw: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् वीरो दुःखितो दुःखितम् वचः । अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानि इमानि इह लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-२६॥
चक्र हस्तो यथा युद्धे सर्वान् असुर पुंगवान् । एवम् उक्त्वा पुनः प्र ऊचुः आलोक्य च परस्परम् ॥३-३४-२२॥
प्लवे कठिनकाजम् च रामश्चक्रे सहायुधैः । आरोप्य प्रथमम् सीताम् सम्घाटम् प्रतिगृह्य तौ ॥२-५५-१८॥
तुषार पतनात् चैव मृदुत्वात् भास्करस्य च । शैत्यात् अग अग्रस्थम् अपि प्रायेण रसवत् जलम् ॥३-१६-२५॥
translation: Due to snowfall, mildness of the Sun, and coldness (of weather) even the water flowing from the mountain top is not generally tasty.

raw: इक्ष्वाकूणां हि सर्वेषां राजा भवति पूर्वज: । पूर्वजे नावर: पुत्रो ज्येष्ठो राज्ये ऽभिषिच्यते ॥२-११०-३३॥
नित्यं ते बन्धुलुब्धस्य तिष्ठतो भ्रातृसौहृदे । आर्यमार्गं प्रपन्नस्य नानुमन्येत क: पुमान् ॥२-११५-६॥
translation: You are always attached to your relations, firmly established in the welfare of your brothers and are pursuing a noble path. Who would not approve of this?

raw: कर्णवन्ति हि भूतानि विशेषण तुरम्गमाः । यूयम् तस्मान्निवर्तध्वम् याचनाम् प्रतिवेदिताः ॥२-४५-१५॥
translation: All animals, especially horses have a keen sense of hearing. Therefore, having listened to our entreaty, turn back.

raw: विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ । काङ्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोः समौ ॥६-५८-४८॥
translation: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

raw: स्मृतिर्न ते ऽस्ति वा मन्ये व्यक्तं वा यमसादनम् । आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं यन्मां योद्धुं व्यवस्थितः ॥६-८८-११॥
translation: "I am like a poisonous serpent, enraged. Is it that you have lost memory, or you stood here on the way to Yama's abode, I think."

raw: वैदेह्या दर्शनेनाद्य धर्मतः परिरक्षिताः । इदम् तु मम दीनस्य मनो भूयः प्रकर्षति ॥६-१-१२॥
विपुलां विततां चैव युक्तपाशां तरस्विनाम् । भूमौ बाणैर्विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां ज्यामिवायुधात् ॥२-११४-१६॥
translation: It was like a powerful man's bowstring, broad and stretched taut with its loops, severed by arrows and fallen from the weapon to the ground.

raw: यन्न दैवैः कृतो राजा नापि दैत्यैर्न दानवैः । कृतः स इह रामेण विमुक्तः प्राणसंशयात् ॥६-६०-७८॥
translation: "The king could escape from the verge of death and such an act was never done by Daityas or Danavas earlier in the encounter."

raw: मुमोच लीलया रामः कंकपत्रान् कांचन भूषणान् । ते शराः शत्रु सैन्येषु मुक्ता रामेण लीलया ॥३-२५-१८॥
ततो महद्बालदिवाकरप्रभं प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसंततम् । रतं समास्थाय ययौ स वीर्यवान् महाहरिं तं प्रति नैर्ऋतर्षभः ॥५-४७-३॥
translation: Ascending a glittering chariot inlaid with pure gold Aksha, the courageous bull among giants looking splendid like the rising Sun, marched forth towards the great vanara.

raw: तदात्मभरणे चैव मम मातुस्तथैव च । पर्याप्ता मद्विधानाम् च भरणाय यशस्विनी ॥२-३१-२१॥
translation: Illustrious Kausalya is competent enough to support herself, my mother and men like me.

raw: रामस्य च सुता ये स्युस्तेषामायुः कियद्भवेत् । काम्यया भगवन्बूहि वंशस्यास्य गतिं मम ॥७-५१-१०॥
translation: Dasharatha further inquires about the lifespans of Rama's future sons and eagerly requests the sage to reveal the future course of his dynasty.

raw: कामं त्वमसि पर्याप्तौ निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान् । राघवस्य यशो हीयेत्त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः ॥५-३७-५४॥
translation: "It may be that you can kill all the demons but by such an act the fame of Rama will be diminished. (He cannot give his strength a trial)

raw: शासनात् कपि राजस्य वयम् सर्वे विनिर्गताः । मासः पूर्णो बिलस्थानाम् हरयः किम् न बुध्यते ॥४-५३-८॥
औरसस्तस्य पुत्रोऽहम् सदृशो विश्वकर्मणा । स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेन तत्त्वमाह महोदधिः ॥६-२२-५०॥
परिष्वज्य च सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणेन प्रचोदितः । पूज्यमानो हरिश्रेष्ठैराजगाम बलालयम् ॥६-११५-७॥
translation: On embracing Sugriva, greeted by Lakshmana, and worshipped by the army of Vanaras, Rama returned to the camp.

raw: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा केशिनी रघुनंदन । पुत्रम् वंश करम् राम जग्राह नृप संनिधौ ॥१-३८-१३॥
translation: "O Rama, delight of the descendants of Raghus, on hearing the words of the ascetic in the presence of king Sagara, Kesini chose the boon to have a son who perpetuates the race.

raw: ज्ञातींस्तान्धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वया ऽ ऽनीता वराङ्गनाः । त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता ॥७-२५-१९॥
translation: O King, while you brought these beautiful women after humiliating their kinsmen, Madhu has abducted Kumbhinasi, disregarding your authority.

raw: रावणस्य समीपे तु राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः । विरूपं वानरं भीममाख्यातुमुपचक्रमुः ॥५-४२-१२॥
translation: The uglyfaced ogresses went to the presence of Ravana and reported about the frightening form of the vanara.

raw: सेनानीर्ग्रामणीश्च त्वं बुद्धिः सत्त्वं क्षमा दमः । प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्च त्वमुपेन्द्रो मधुसूदनः ॥६-१२०-१७॥
translation: "You are the Karthikeya, the commander of army, village headman. You are the intellect, forbearance. You are the origin and end also. You are Vamana and destroyer of demon Madhu."

raw: वीरबाहुः सुबाहुश्च नलश्च वनगोचरः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्ते प्राकारं हरियूथपाः । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चक्रुः स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् ॥६-४२-२२॥
translation: Veerabahu, Subahu, Nala and the foremost of the Vanara leaders storming the boundary walls in the meantime went inside and stationed at the northeast gate.

raw: चक्षुर्मनोहरं पीनं मेखलादामभूषितम् । समुद्वहन्ती जघनं रतिप्राभृतमुत्तमम् ॥७-२६-१६॥
translation: She bore her hips, which were plump, charming to the eyes and mind, adorned with a girdle of bells, and an excellent offering for love.

raw: ये च त्वाम् उपजीवन्ति न अहम् तेषाम् न ते मम । केवल अर्थ पराम् हि त्वाम् त्यक्त धर्माम् त्यजाम्य् अहम् ॥२-४२-७॥
translation: Your dependents have nothing to do with me nor I with them. I denounce you since you are a selfseeker without any sense off righteousness.

raw: मध्ये सभम् समीपस्थौ इदम् काव्यम् अगायताम् । तत् श्रुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे बाष्प पर्याकुलेक्षणाः ॥१-४-१५॥
या च अन्या शैल दुहिता कन्या आसीत् रघुनंदन । उग्रम् सुव्रतम् आस्थाय तपः तेपे तपोधना ॥१-३५-२०॥
translation: O Delight of the Raghus The other daughter of the mountain Himavan was a maiden whose wealth was tapas. She pursued a vow and observed severe austerities.

raw: न एव सा नूनम् अथवा हिंसिता चारु हासिनी । कृच्छ्रम् प्राप्तम् न माम् नूनम् यथा उपेक्षितुम् अर्हति ॥३-६०-२९॥
translation: O lady with a sweet smile I have never hurt you. When I am in difficulty it does not behove you to ignore me.

raw: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम् । लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-१२६-३॥
translation: "Vaidehi, you may see the peak of Trikuta which stands on Lanka in the shape of the peak of Kailasa, constructed by Viswakarma."

raw: यदि तस्य आगमः कश्चित् आर्या वा सा अथ लक्ष्यते । बाढम् इति एव काकुत्स्थः प्रस्थितो दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥३-६४-२३॥
अवसज्य आअयसे शूले विनदन्तम् महास्वनम् । स रामम् लक्ष्मणम् चैव सीताम् दृष्ट्वा च मैथिलीम् ॥३-२-८॥
देव गंधर्व पुत्रैः च वानरैः काम रूपिभिः । दिव्य माल्य अम्बर धारैः शोभिताम् प्रिय दर्शनैः ॥४-३३-६॥
translation: The inhabitants of Kishkinda being sons of gods and gandharvas, were of beautiful appearance wearing wonderful garlands. They could change their form at their free will. They were delightful.

raw: तमुक्तवाक्यं विक्रान्तं राजपुत्रं विभीषणः । उवाच शोकसन्तप्तो भ्रातुर्हितमनन्तरम् ॥६-११२-२१॥
translation: Having spoken that way by the valiant prince to Vibheeshana, who was immersed in grief, spoke to Rama for the good of his brother.

raw: यस्त्वं रथमिमं मोहात् न चोद्वहसि दुर्मते । सत्यो ऽयं प्रतितर्को मे परेण त्वमुपस्कृतः ॥६-१०६-७॥
translation: "O Evil minded one! If out of delusion you are not willing to drive, truly you are influenced by the enemy."

raw: एवम् उक्तो वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रो महामतिः । कृतम् इति अब्रवीत् राजा पूजा वाक्येन मे त्वया ॥१-५२-१५॥
translation: To these words of Vasishta, the great intellectual Viswamitra said, "you have spoken pleasing words. This in itself is hospitality for me".

raw: ततो भग्नप्रहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः । तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ ॥६-९८-२३॥
translation: Thereafter, both of them fully endowed with strength, with their weapons broken, who resembled glowing fires, fought with their fists.

raw: घोरः शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् सम्ग्रामम् अभिकान्क्षताम् । एष पर्वतम् अध्यास्ते पारियात्रम् अनुत्तमम् ॥६-२६-४०॥
translation: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

raw: ताम् लताम् इव वेष्टन्तीम् आलिंगन्तीम् महाद्रुमान् । मुंच मुंच इति बहुशः प्रवदन् राक्षस अधिपः ॥३-५२-७॥
translation: Separated from Rama in the forest, Sita hugged huge trees, running round and round like a creeper coiled, crying loudly, 'Rama, O Rama' . The king of the demons, like Yama, caught hold of her hair only to invite his death, all the time saying, Leave it, Leave it (Leave the tree).

raw: तस्य वै यजमानस्य पशुम् इन्द्रो जहार ह । प्रणष्टे तु पशौ विप्रो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६१-६॥
translation: While he was performing the sacrifice Indra stole away the sacrificial animal. The animal could not be traced. Hence the priest said to the king:

raw: सहस्रबाहोस्तद्युद्धं विंशद्बाहोश्च दारुणम् । नृपराक्षसयोस्तत्र चारब्धं रोमहर्षणम् ॥७-३२-५०॥
translation: There, a terrible and hair-raising battle began between the king with a thousand arms (Arjuna) and the demon with twenty arms (Ravana).

raw: सख्यं च रामस्सुग्रीवेप्रभावंचानिलात्मजे । वानराणां च तत्कर्मह्याचचक्षेऽऽथमन्त्रिणाम् ॥६-१३१-३९॥
translation: Rama narrated about his friendship with Sugriva and the distinct performance of Hanuman and Vanaras to the ministers.

raw: रुद्धां तु नगरीं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । उवाचामर्षतः काले प्रहस्तं युद्धकोविदम् ॥६-५७-४॥
translation: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.

raw: धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव । पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते । विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम् ॥७-२६-३३॥
translation: O best of Rakshasas, I am rightfully the wife of your son, Nalakubara, who is dearer to your brother Vaishravana (Kubera) than life itself and is renowned in all three worlds.

raw: प्रसीद पथ्यम् श्रुणु जल्पितम् हि मेन रोषम् एव अनुविधातुम् अर्हसि । क्षमो हि ते कोशल राज सूनुनान विग्रहः शक्र सम तेजसा ॥४-१५-३०॥
translation: 'Do not lose your temper. Quieten your mind. My advice is beneficial to you. You should not fight with the prince of Kosala who is comparable to Indra in splendour.It is not proper for you.'

raw: तान्मुक्तमात्रानाकाशे लक्ष्मणेन धनुष्मता । बाणान् बाणैर्महातेजा रावणः प्रत्यवारयत् ॥६-१००-१९॥
translation: As soon as the excellent archer, Lakshmana released his arrows, effulgent Ravana intercepted the arrows in the sky.

raw: उद्यानानि परित्यज्य क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च । एक दुह्ख सुखा रामम् अनुगच्चाम धार्मिकम् ॥२-३३-१७॥
translation: Deserting our gardens, fields and houses and experiencing the same joy and sorrow of the virtuous Rama, we shall follow him.

raw: येन सप्त महा साला गिरिर् भूमिः च दारिताः । बाणेन एकेन काकुत्स्थ स्थाता ते को रण अग्रतः ॥४-१२-९॥
translation: 'O Rama who can in a battle confront you, capable of splitting seven huge sala trees, the mountain and the earth with a single arrow?

raw: ततः कोप समाविष्टो विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः । स्रुवम् उद्यम्य स क्रोधः त्रिशंकुम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६०-१२॥
translation: When, the gods invited by him did not come to receive their share of offerings, the great ascetic Viswamitra seized with anger lifted the sacrificial ladle and said to Trisanku:

raw: अभीतवदनः क्रुद्धो रावणिं लक्ष्मणौ युधि । नैवं रणगताः शूराः प्रहरन्ते निशाचर न् । लघवश्चाल्पवीर्याश्च सुखा हीमे शरास्तव । नैवं शूरास्तु युध्यन्ते समरे जयकाङ्क्षिणः ॥६-८९-१६॥
राघवश्चापिधर्मात्माप्राप्यराज्यमनुत्तमम् । ईजेबहुविधैर्यज्ञैससुतभ्रातृबान्धवः ॥६-१३१-९८॥
translation: Righteous Rama also, having inherited the kingdom, conducted several sacrifices with brothers, friends and relatives.

raw: ददृशुस्ते महायुद्धं लोकसंवर्तसंस्थितम् । नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैः शूरयोः सम्प्रयुद्ध्यतोः ॥६-१०४-६॥
translation: Then from the aerial chariots, Devas, Gandharvas, great Nagas, sages, devils, giants, birds, and eagles watched the duel war that went on between the heroes clashing with different kinds of frightening weapons like at the dissolution of the world.

raw: क्रियताम् तत् सखे शीघ्रम् यत् अर्थम् वयम् आगताः । स रावण वचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो राक्षसः तदा ॥३-४२-१४॥
तर्जापयति माम् नित्यम् भर्त्सापयति च असक्र्त् । राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर् या माम् रक्षन्ति नित्यशः ॥६-३४-९॥
translation: "He, that Ravana makes even the frightful Rakshasa care takers threaten me and reproach me repeatedly every day."

raw: सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमाम् त्वम् प्रतिपत्स्यसे । भुंक्ष्व राज्यम् अनुद्विग्नः शस्तो भ्राता रिपुः तव ॥४-२०-२१॥
translation: '(Now turning to Sugriva she said) O Sugriva your enemy brother has been killed and your desire has been fulfilled.You will get back Ruma and enjoy the kingdom without any obstacles.'

raw: गुरोर् गुण गृहीताः च प्रख्याताः च पराक्रमे । विदेशेषु अपि विज्ञाता सर्वतो बुद्धि निश्चयाः ॥१-७-१७॥
translation: They imbibed virtues from the elderlies. They were renowned in prowess. They were guided by their intellect in all affairs. They were wellknown everywhere.

raw: पूर्वजो अपि उक्त मात्रः तु लक्ष्मणेन सुभाषितम् । सार ग्राही महासारम् प्रतिजग्राह राघवः ॥३-६७-१॥
translation: Even though Rama was elder, he could grasp the quintessence of the wise counsel only after Lakshmana had said it.

raw: इति उवाच पुनः वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् सत्य विक्रमम् । कथम् मया विना सीताम् शक्यम् लक्ष्मण जीवितुम् ॥३-७५-२८॥
विप्रकीर्ण अजिन कुशम् विप्रविद्ध बृसी कटम् । दृष्ट्वा शून्य उटज स्थानम् विललाप पुनः पुनः ॥३-६०-७॥
translation: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.

raw: बाहुच्छायामवष्टब्धो यस्य लोको महात्मनः ॥५-३४-३१॥
translation: "He shows anger to one who deserves it, he is the foremost charioteer of the world and he is a great self under the shadow of whose shoulders the whole world takes refuge.

raw: निर्याणश्रीश्च या ऽस्यासीद्भास्वरा वसुदुर्लभा । सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः ॥६-५७-४१॥
translation: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.

raw: वधाय देव शतॄणाम् नृणाम् लोके मनः कुरु । एवम् स्तुतस्तु देवेशो विष्णुः त्रिदशः पुंगवः ॥१-१५-२६॥
देव असुर विमर्देषु वज्र अशनि कृत व्रणम् । ऐरावत विषाण अग्रैः उत्कृष्ट किण वक्षसम् ॥३-३२-७॥
translation: He had scars of wounds caused by the thunderbolt received in war between gods and demons, and marks of scars on his chest made by tips of the the tusks of elephant Airavata.

raw: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते । दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि परित्रासमुपागमन् ॥७-६९-२०॥
translation: Seeing that arrow blazing like the fire of destruction at the end of a cosmic age, all beings were struck with great terror.

raw: इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेलायामभितुष्टाव मातलिः ॥२-१४-४८॥
translation: Just as Indra's charioteer at this time (at dawn) extols him, the conquerer of demons, so do I rouse you (with a song).

raw: मन्त्रे व्यूहे नये चारे युक्तो भवितुमर्हसि । वानराणाम् च भद्रम् ते परेषाम् च परम्तप ॥६-१७-२०॥
translation: "O Scorcher of enemies For Vanara's safety and considering to be spies also you should be alert in your deliberations, with a plan and policy in moving together and deciding what is to be done. Let you be safe."

raw: दिष्ट्या त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतः । देवतानामवध्येन विजयं प्राप्तवानसि ॥७-१-२७॥
translation: Fortunately, you engaged in a duel with the king of Rakshasas, who was invincible even to the gods, and you have achieved victory.

raw: स एवमुक्त्वा द्विजपुङ्गवाग्र्यः सुतां समाश्वास्य च देवयानीम् । पुनर्ययौ सूर्यसमानतेजा दत्त्वा च शापं नहुषात्मजाय ॥७-५८-२५॥
translation: Having thus spoken, the foremost Brahmin Shukra, after consoling his daughter Devayani and cursing Yayati, the son of Nahusha, departed again with a splendor like the sun. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 58 ।। Thus ends the fifty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: स ददर्श आसने रामः निषण्णम् पितरम् शुभे । कैकेयी सहितम् दीनम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता ॥२-१८-१॥
translation: Rama beheld his father reclined on an auspicious couch and by his side was seated Kaikeyi. He looked wretched with a pale face.

raw: उर्वश्या एवमुक्तस्तु रेतस्तन्महदद्भुतम् । ज्वलदग्निशिखाप्रख्यं तस्मिन्कुम्भे ह्यपासृजत् ॥७-५६-२१॥
translation: Thus addressed by Urvashi, he indeed discharged that great and wonderful semen, resembling a burning flame of fire, into that pot.

raw: जानासि च यथा शुद्धा सीता तत्त्वेन राघव । भक्त्या च परया युक्ता हिता च तव नित्यशः ॥७-४८-१२॥
translation: O Rama, you truly know how pure Sita is, and how she is always endowed with supreme devotion and is beneficial to you.

raw: माता ते पितरम् देवि ततह् केकयमब्रवीत् । शम्स मे जीव वा मा वा न मामपहसिष्यसि ॥२-३५-२३॥
translation: Then your mother said to your father, 'Whether you live or die, tell me the cause. You are laughing at me'.

raw: प्रकाशम् च अभिरामम् च ददृशुः देशम् उत्तमम् । ततः तस्मिन् बिले भीमे नाना पादप संकुले ॥४-५०-२१॥
हरीनेव सुसङ्क्रुद्धा हरयो जघ्नुराहवे । राक्षसाश्चापि रक्षांसि निजघ्नुस्तिमिरे तदा ॥६-५५-२२॥
