translation: 'That sinful Vali who has abducted your wife and violated the moral code will live only as long I do not see him.

raw: भ्रातुः समीपे शोक आर्ता ससर्ज निनदम् महत् । सस्वरम् मुमोच बाष्पम् विवर्ण वदना तदा ॥३-२०-२४॥
translation: Then desperately screaming and shedding tears with a sad face beside her brother, she roared again and again.

raw: तौतस्यपादौप्रदिशोदिशश्चगिरेर्गुहाश्चैवमहार्णवं च । लङ्कां च सेनांकपिराक्षसानांविनादयन्तौविनिपेततुश्च ॥६-६७-१६४॥
translation: Both the feet falling on ground made a resounding noise that filled all over the four quarters, all directions, nay all mountains and caves of Trikuta and also Lanka.

raw: दान्तकैः तापनीयैः च स्फाटिकै राजतैः तथा । वज्र वैदूर्य चित्रैः च स्तम्भैः दृष्टि मनोरमैः ॥३-५५-८॥
translation: His home was a complex of palaces and mansions served by thousands of women. It was an abode of different flocks of birds. It had captivating pillars studded with gold, crystals, silver, diamonds and vaiduryas. It resounded with wonderful sounds of drums. Its golden entrances were glittering.

raw: न हि तद्विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकाङ्क्षिणः । रिपूणां सदृशं चैतन्न त्वयैतत् स्वनुष्ठितम् ॥६-१०६-८॥
translation: What has been done by you is not befitting, this is What an enemy should have done. Being good at heart you have done What is good for enemy.

raw: अधर्मम् तु सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान् । निवृत्तेन च शक्यो अयम् व्यसनात् कामजाद् इह ॥३-९-२॥
translation: This great path of dharma you are following now can be attained only through subtle means by one free from addiction born of passion.

raw: सर्वकालायसं दीप्तं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् । इन्द्राशनिसमं भीमं वज्रप्रतिमगौरवम् ॥६-६५-१९॥
यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः । वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नार्थी रत्नमेव च ॥७-९२-१५॥
translation: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.

raw: कच्चित् ते निर्जिता विघ्नाः कच्चित् ते वर्धते तपः । कच्चित् ते नियतः कोप आहारः च तपोधने ॥३-७४-८॥
translation: O ascetic hope you have overcome your obstacles to penance, you have controlled your anger and your desire for food. Is your austerity in progress.

raw: अथर्षिर्जरया वृद्धस्तपसा च जरां गत: । वेपमान इवोवाच रामं भूतदयापरम् ॥२-११६-८॥
translation: Hearing those words, an ascetic old in age and austerities, as though trembling said to Rama who is compassionate to all beings:

raw: दीर्घम् आयुः स मे प्रादात् ततो माम् विभ्रमो अस्पृशत् । दीर्घम् आयुः मया प्राप्तम् किम् मे शक्रः करिष्यति ॥३-७१-९॥
सम्भग्नाः पादपाश्चैमेक्षिपतेहासुरीं तनुम् । समन्तादाद्योजनं पूर्णमाश्रमं मामकं यदि आगमिष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्व्यक्तं स न भविष्यति ॥४-११-५४॥
translation: 'Whoever has broken the trees all over this forest and has thrown the demon's body will not survive if he enters within a radius of one yojana of my hermitage.

raw: प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् कृत पौर्व अह्णिक क्रियौ । विश्वामित्रम् ऋषीम् च अन्यान् सहितौ अभिजग्मतुः ॥१-३१-२॥
translation: As the night dawned, both the brothers performed the morning rites and approached Viswamitra and other rishis.

raw: शान्तम् पातम् न वः किम्चित् कुतश्चित् अमर अधिप । अहम् तु मग्नौ शोचामि स्व पुत्रौ विषमे स्थितौ ॥२-७४-२३॥
translation: 'God forbid, O Indra, lord of the Immortals no calamity has befallen you from any quarter. Only I am in trouble. I am weeping for these pair of bulls, my own sons who are in difficulty. When I see them scorched by the rays of the Sun, miserable, emaciated and weeping, beaten by a ploughman, I am immersed in grief'.

raw: सीतापि देवकार्याणि कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकानि वै । श्वश्रूणामकरोत्पूजां सर्वासामविशेषतः ॥७-४२-२७॥
translation: Sita also, having performed her morning divine duties, reverently honored all her mothers-in-law without any distinction.

raw: त्वं श्वः प्रभाते लवणं महात्मन्वधिष्यसे नात्र तु संशयो मे । शूलं विना निर्गतमामिषार्थे ध्रुवो जयस्ते भविता नरेन्द्र ॥७-६७-२६॥
translation: O great-souled one, you will kill Lavana tomorrow morning; there is no doubt in my mind about this, and your victory will be certain, O king, when he has gone out without his trident for the sake of food. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 67 ।। Thus ends the sixty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अगुरूणाम् च दिव्यानाम् चंदनानाम् च संचयम् । शुचीनि अभ्यवहाराणि मूलानि च फलानि च ॥४-५०-३५॥
translation: There they noticed a wonderful collection of incense and sandal, tasty and pure eatables, roots and fruits

raw: किम्प्रमाणमिदं काव्यं का प्रतिष्ठा महात्मनः । कर्ता काव्यस्य महतः क्व चासौ मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥७-९४-२३॥
translation: Rama inquired about the length of this poem, the fame of its great author, and the whereabouts of that foremost sage who composed this great work.

raw: विश्वेदेवाः च वसवो मरुतः च दिव ओकसः । आगत्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् मेरुम् उत्तम पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-४१॥
translation: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

raw: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशस्विनी । परित्राणमविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत् ॥५-३०-९॥
translation: "If I so back, this illustrious princess, Janaki will give up her life, finding no means of deliverance (from this tragic situation).

raw: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामम् धर्म भृताम् वरम् । ऊचुः परम धर्मज्ञम् ऋषि संघाः समागताः ॥३-६-७॥
translation: All groups of sages, who knew dharma, and were upholders of righteousness reached Rama, the supreme knower of dharma, and said:

raw: ते वयं कार्यनैराश्यात् कालश्यातिक्रमेण च । भयाच्च कपिराजस्य प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं व्यवस्थिताः ॥५-३५-५८॥
translation: "We decided to give up our lives due to disappointment, transgression of the time limit fixed for us and fear of the monkey lord (fear of facing the king without finding you).

raw: अन्यैः च विविधैः वृक्षैः प्रमदा इव उपशोभिताम् । अस्याः तीरे तु पूर्व उक्तः पर्वतो धातु मण्डितः ॥३-७५-२५॥
ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतः । फुल्लाशोक इवाभाति पुष्पके राक्षसाधिपः ॥७-२१-३४॥
translation: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, with his limbs smeared with blood and wounded by the blows, appeared on his Pushpaka chariot like a blooming Ashoka tree.

raw: करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि । कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि ॥५-५४-१४॥
translation: The brilliant monkey leader bypassed Vibhishanas's house and avoiding it that way set fire to the mansions of other ogres, Rasmiketu, Suryasatru, Hrasvakarna, Vajradamshtra, Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhwajagriva, Vidyujjihva, Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha, Sonitaksha, Kumbhakarna, Makaraksha, Yagnasatru, Brahmasatru, Naranthaka, Kumbha, and wicked Nikumbha.

raw: अपरं किन्तु कृत्वायं विधानं संविधास्यति । कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नो यास्यामि यमसादनम् ॥७-२०-३१॥
translation: What other plan will this Ravana make after this, but filled with curiosity, I myself will go to the abode of Yama.

raw: दर्शयन्ति क्षितिम् चैव दक्षिणाम् च दिशम् मृगाः । सधु गच्छावहे देव दिशम् एताम् च नैर्ऋतीम् ॥३-६४-२२॥
translation: O lord these deer are indicating the land on the southern side.Therefore it will be proper for both of us to proceed in the southwestern direction. Maybe we will get some clue or find that noble Sita.

raw: ताम् पिशाचशतैः षड्भिरभिगुप्ताम् सदाप्रभाम् । प्रविवेश महातेजाः सुकृताम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-११-१६॥
translation: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

raw: ततः कुश परिस्तीर्णम् समिद्धम् जात वेदसम् । मंत्र पूतेन हविषा हुत्वा मंत्रविदो जनाः ॥४-२६-३०॥
translation: Then the priests (people who recite Vedic hymns) strew around kusa grass, kindled sacred fire with recitation of mantras and made offerings of havis into the fire.

raw: हनुमन्तं कपिं व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा । अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम् ॥५-३५-८७॥
translation: She realised that the monkey was none other than Hanuman. Then he looked at her who was pleasing to see and spoke again:

raw: श्रुतकीर्तेः महाबाहो पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना । सर्वे भवन्तः सौम्याः च सर्वे सुचरित व्रताः ॥१-७३-३३॥
अथ तान् राक्षसान् सर्वान् मकराक्षो ऽब्रवीदिदम् । यूयं सर्वे प्रयुद्ध्यध्वं पुरस्तान्मम राक्षसाः ॥६-७८-९॥
translation: Thereafter, Maka raksha spoke to all Rakshasas, 'All of you be ahead of me and fight violently'.

raw: महा बलानाम् हरि यूथपानाम् इदम् कुलम् राघव मन् निमित्तम् । अस्य अंगदस्य अपि च शोक तापात् अर्थ स्थित प्राणम् इतीव मन्ये ॥४-२४-१९॥
translation: 'O Rama this race of mighty monkey chiefs is as though reduced to a halfdead state because of my action and the grief of Angada.

raw: प्रियार्हं प्रियमाख्यातुं विवेशान्तःपुरं वशी । स कैकेय्या गृहं श्रेष्ठं प्रविवेश महायशाः ॥२-१०-११॥
यस्त्विदं रघुनाथस्य चरितं सकलं पठेत् । सो ऽसुक्षये विष्णुलोकं गच्छत्येव न संशयः ॥७-१११-२१॥
translation: One who reads this entire story of Raghunatha certainly goes to the world of Vishnu at the end of life; there is no doubt about it.

raw: करेणुभिर् यथा अरण्यम् परिकीर्णो महा द्विपः । सर्व कामैर् उपेताम् च पान भूमिम् महात्मनः ॥५-११-१०॥
स सौष्ठवोपेतमदीनवादिनः कपेर्निशम्याप्रतिमो ऽप्रियं वचः । दशाननः कोपविवृत्तलोचनः समादिशत् तस्य वधं महाकपेः ॥५-५१-४६॥
translation: The tenheaded Ravana who was of matchless strength, hearing the unpleasant words of advice and warning expressed skilfully with dignity by the great Hanuman, enraged Ravana, his eyes rolling in anger ordered the execution of Hanuman. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: पुरमाकाशगं प्रादात्पार्वत्याः प्रियकाम्यया । उमयापि वरो दत्तो राक्षसानां नृपात्मज ॥७-४-३०॥
translation: To please Parvati, Shiva gave him a city that could move in the sky, and O son of the king, Uma also granted a boon to the demons.

raw: ताम् एव वेलाम् वक्तव्यम् त्वया राघव तत्त्वतः । वालिनम् न निहन्मि इति ततो न अहम् इतो व्रजे ॥४-१२-२७॥
translation: 'Had you, in fact, told me that you were not going to kill Vali, I would not have budged from this place.'

raw: नेदानीम् गुह योग्योऽयम् वसो मे सजने वने । अवश्यम् ह्याश्रमे वासह् कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः ॥२-५२-६६॥
translation: Guha this forest where people live is not suitable for my stay. It is necessary that I live in a hermitage. So please do the needful.

raw: भरतस्य अथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वा अस्य हितम् इच्चति । सर्वान् एतान् वधिष्यामि मृदुर् हि परिभूयते ॥२-२१-११॥
translation: I shall slay all of them who support Bharata and those who seek his prosperity. A gentleman is treated with disgrace indeed.

raw: कच्चिन्नोग्रेण दण्डेन भृशमुद्वेजितप्रजम् । राष्ट्रं तवानुजानन्ति मन्त्रिण: कैकयीसुत ॥२-१००-२८॥
translation: Are not the citizens of your kingdom agitated at severe punishment meted out to them reproaching your ministers?

raw: दूतो ऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । वालिपुत्रो ऽङ्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः ॥६-४१-७६॥
translation: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"

raw: बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम् । ब्राह्मणा बलमुख्याश्च नैगमाश्चागता नृप ॥२-१५-२४॥
स याच्यमानो गुरुणा मया च दृढविक्रम: । राघव: परमप्रीतो वसिष्ठं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-११३-९॥
translation: Entreated by me and by preceptor (Vasistha), the highly pleased Rama with his firmness of mind replied to Vasistha:

raw: आगता हि महा वीर्या हरयः काम रूपिणः । कोटि शत सहस्राणि नाना नग निवासिनः ॥४-३३-६०॥
translation: 'O great warrior monkeys residing at different mountains who can assume any form they like have arrived in hundreds and thousands of crores.

raw: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानिनिष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः । प्रच्चन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते ॥५-१-८२॥
translation: Entering into and emerging from the clouds, he looked like the Moon that appears and disappears (behind a bank of clouds).

raw: कच्चिन् न दुष्टः व्रजसि रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः । इयम् ते महती सेना शन्काम् जनयति इव मे ॥२-८५-७॥
translation: Are you not going to that place with the evil intention of causing harm to Rama of unwearied actions? This large army of yours arouses doubts in me.

raw: अथ जीज्ञाससे माम् त्वम् भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये । अस्तुयत्तत्त्वयाअपूर्वम् व्याहृतम्राघवम्प्रति ॥२-१२-१६॥
translation: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

raw: रसातलम् वा प्रविशेत्पातालम् वापि रावणः । पितामहसकाशम् वा न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यते ॥६-१८-२०॥
गुहो अपि सह सूतेन सौमित्रिम् अनुभाषयन् । अन्वजाग्रत् ततः रामम् अप्रमत्तः धनुर् धरः ॥२-५०-५०॥
दुन्धुभिस्वनकल्पेन गम्भीरेणानुनादिना । स्वरेण महता राजा जीमूत इव नादयन् ॥२-२-२॥
translation: Lord of men (king Dasaratha) addressed the feudatory kings with words deep, resonant, loud like the kettledrum or the rumbling cloud, in a delightful, incomparable and attractive voice that carried all the dignity of royalty:

raw: भवान्नारायणो देवश्चतुर्बाहुः सनातनः । राक्षसान्हन्तुमुत्पन्नो ह्यजेयः प्रभुरव्ययः ॥७-८-२६॥
translation: You are indeed the eternal, four-armed god Nārāyaṇa, manifested to kill the Rākṣasas, and you are the unconquerable, imperishable lord.

raw: युगपत् पतमानैः च युगपच्च हतैः भ्रिशम् । युगपत् पतितैः चैव विकीर्णा वसुधा अभवत् ॥३-२५-४१॥
translation: It seemed as if it all happened at the same time, the entire earth filling with demons seriously injured, slain and fallen down on the ground.

raw: सर्वम् तीर्णम् च मे सैन्यम् जितमित्युपधारय । इमे हि समरे वीरा हरयः कामरूपिणः ॥६-२-१३॥
translation: "On building a bridge over the large ocean up to Lanka, when all my army of vanaras can cross over, you may consider that you have won. These vanaras are heroic in war and can assume any form at will."

raw: निमित्तान्यनुपश्यामि यान्यस्मिन् रावणात्मजे । त्वर तेन महाबोहो भग्न एष न संशयः ॥६-८९-४॥
translation: "On the basis of the indications of the pale face of Ravana's son, it is clear that he is broken at heart. No doubt about it."

raw: अथवा देवि दोषम् त्वं कंचित्पश्यसि राघवे । तमद्य ब्रूहि तत्वैन तदा रोमो विवास्यताम् ॥२-३६-२८॥
translation: O Kaikeyi speak truly if you find any fault in this scion of the Raghu race (Rama). Then he will be exiled.

raw: विद्युन्माली रथस्थस्तु शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । सुषेणं ताडयामास ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥६-४३-३५॥
translation: Vidyunmali mounting the chariot started releasing arrows covered with gold at Sushena and roared.

raw: भस्म राशी कृतान् एतान् पावयेत् लोक कांतया । तया क्लिन्नम् इदम् भस्म गंगया लोक कान्तया । षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि स्वर्ग लोकम् गमिष्यति ॥१-४१-२०॥
translation: Ganga, the purifier of the three worlds, will sanctify your uncles reduced to heaps of ashes. These heaps when inundated by waters of Ganga, beloved of the worlds, will take all the sixty thousand sons to heaven.

raw: कुरु साधु प्रसादम् मे बाले सहृदया हि असि । प्रसीद देवि रामो मे त्वद्धत्तं राज्यमव्ययम् ॥२-१३-२२॥
एक अन्ते पश्य भगवन्न् आश्रम स्थानम् उत्तमम् । रमते यत्र वैदेही सुख अर्हा जनक आत्मजा ॥२-५४-२६॥
translation: O revered one, Janaka's daughter (Sita) deserves comfort. Suggest a solitary and agreeable place for our hermitage where she can enjoy herself.

raw: त्वदधीना हि नगरी राज्यम् चैतदनामयम् । तत् पुत्र शीघ्रम् विधिना विधिज्ञैः । वसिष्ठ मुख्यैः सहितः द्विज इन्द्रैः । सम्काल्य राजानम् अदीन सत्त्वम् । आत्मानम् उर्व्याम् अभिषेचयस्व ॥२-७२-५४॥
तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्तीं कामबाणवशं गतः । करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानो ऽभ्यभाषत ॥७-२६-२०॥
translation: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.

raw: सुताभिलाषो मत्तस्ते मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि । दारुणायां तु वेलायां यस्मात्त्वं मामुपस्थिता ॥७-९-२१॥
translation: O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, since you have approached me at this dreadful time with a desire for a son from me.

raw: ततस्तु सुग्रीवविभीषणादयः सुहृद्विशेषाः सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा । समेत्य हृष्टा विजयेन राघवं रणे ऽभिरामं विधिना ह्यपूजयन् ॥६-१११-३२॥
translation: Then all of them (hosts of gods) coming together, accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada along with other friends, happy about the victory in the battle offered prayers to charming Sri Rama in accordance with tradition.

raw: जटायुः तम् अतिक्रम्य तुण्डेन अस्य खग अधिपः । वाम बाहून् दश तदा व्यपाहरत् अरिन्दमः ॥३-५१-३८॥
translation: Then Jatayu, lord of the birds, subduer of enemies, overpowered Ravana and dismembered his ten left arms with his beak.

raw: मया विहीना विजने वने यारक्षोभिः आहृत्य विकृष्यमाणा । नूनम् विनादम् कुररि इव दीनासा मुक्तवती आयत कान्त नेत्रा ॥३-६३-११॥
translation: The lovely, largeeyed lady separated from me in the desolate forest, abducted and dragged by demons must have cried at that time desperately like a female osprey.

raw: सम् उद् वहन्तः सलिल अति भारम्बलाकिनो वारि धरा नदन्तः । महत्सु शृंगेषु मही धराणाम्विश्रम्य विश्रम्य पुनः प्रयान्ति ॥४-२८-२२॥
translation: 'The huge rumbling clouds on the high mountain peaks carry heavy load of water. Now they rest and now resume their journey accompanied by herons.

raw: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः । हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः ॥५-३८-७२॥
translation: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.

raw: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः । ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं प्रति ॥६-८६-६॥
translation: Lakshmana, who had auspicious marks, on hearing Vibheeshana rained showers of arrows on Ravana's son.

raw: ततः ते वानर श्रेष्ठम् अभिषेक्तुम् यथा विधि । रत्नैर् वस्त्रैः च भक्ष्यैः च तोषयित्वा द्विजर्षभान् ॥४-२६-२९॥
translation: Then they duly propitiated the brahmins, offering them gifts of gems, clothes and eatables.

raw: यथा हि तव वै दैन्यं रूपं चाप्यतिमानुषम् । तपसा चान्वितो वेषस्त्वं राममहिषी ध्रुवम् ॥५-३३-१४॥
translation: "Indeed your plight, the superhuman beauty and your robes marked with asceticism, surely tell me that you are Rama's queen."

raw: अद्य मे पौरुषं दृष्टमद्य मे सफलः श्रमः । अद्य तीर्णप्रतिज्ञत्वात् प्रभवामीह चात्मनः ॥६-११८-४॥
translation: "Now you see the result of my effort. I am successful and fulfilled my vow. Today I am independent."

raw: रामशोकमहाभोगः सीताविरहपारगः । श्वसितोर्मिमहावर्तो बाष्पफेनजलाविलः ॥२-५९-२९॥
मैन्दं नलं ज्योतिमुखं द्विविदं पनसं तथा । एतांश्चान्यांस्ततो वीरौ ददृशाते हतान् रणे ॥६-७४-११॥
translation: Vibheeshana and Hanuman saw in the battlefield Sugriva, Angada, Neela, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Gavaksha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Ahuka, Mainda, Nala, Jyothimukha, Dwivida and Panasa struck down.

raw: कोसलो नाम मुदितः स्फीतो जनपदो महान् । निविष्ट सरयू तीरे प्रभूत धन धान्यवान् ॥१-५-५॥
translation: On the banks of river Sarayu, a great and prosperous country named Kosala, abundant in foodgrains and wealth and inhabited by contended people, was situated.

raw: अस्वाधीनम् कथम् दैवम् प्रकारैरभिराध्यते । स्वाधीनम् समतिक्रम्य मातरम् पितरम् गुरुम् ॥२-३०-३३॥
translation: Mother, father and preceptor are present before us. By overstepping them, how can we, in various ways, worship God who is beyond reach (not visible)?

raw: प्रथमं वै महाराज कृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम् । केवलं वीर्यदर्पेण नानुबन्धो विचारितः ॥६-६३-४॥
translation: "O king! All this action was not thought of at the beginning, nor the consequences of action weighed in the pride of your prowess."

raw: विनिपन्ना मया दृष्टाः किमुतायं निशाचरः ॥७-२२-२८॥
translation: I have seen many fallen, so what to say of this demon?

raw: प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मण स्तदा । सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम् ॥२-४-३१॥
translation: Hearing the welcome tidings of the installation of her beloved Rama, Sita too, had been brought in. Sumitra and Lakshmana had already arrived there.

raw: इदं तु पतितं तस्मात्तव राम वशे स्थिताः । कालस्य वशमापन्नाः स्वल्पं हि नहि नः सुखम् ॥७-७३-१४॥
translation: But this misfortune has now befallen us, O Rama, who are under your control, as we have fallen under the sway of time, and indeed, our happiness is now very little.

raw: स तस्य ददृशो मार्गो मांसशोणितकर्दमः । पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसंवृतः ॥६-६९-७२॥
translation: On the way he saw flesh and blood fallen like a heap of a mountain covered fully with Vanaras.

raw: द्रक्ष्यन्ति नूनम् पुरुषा दीघ बाहुम् वने चराः । रामम् उत्थाय गच्चन्तम् लोक नाथम् अनाथवत् ॥२-४२-१८॥
translation: Surely the forestrovers will be gazing upon the longarmed Rama, protector of the world, as he rises (from the ground) and wanders in the jungle unprotected.

raw: क्व गतिः मानुषाणाम् च धनुषो अस्य प्रपूरणे । आरोपणे समायोगे वेपने तोलने अपि वा ॥१-६७-१०॥
translation: How then can men bend, string, fix the arrow, pull the string and lift it?

raw: येनेदमीदृशं प्राप्तं दुःखं शोकसमन्वितम् । न त्वया भरते वाच्यं शत्रुघ्नस्यापि सन्निधौ ॥७-५०-१९॥
translation: This sorrow, accompanied by grief, which has been experienced, should not be spoken of by you to Bharata, nor even in the presence of Shatrughna.

raw: ब्रह्म ऋषि गण संकीर्णम् देव ऋषि गण सेवितम् । तपः चरण संसिद्धैः अग्नि कल्पैः महात्मभिः ॥१-५१-२५॥
translation: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. That hermitage afounded in a variety of trees, species of animals, siddhas, charanas, devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinnaras, multitudes of birds and resting deer. It was inhabited by brahmarshis and devarishis, by sages who had attained perfection through austerities, by those resembling fire in brightness, by the magnanimous and the selfrestrained, by those who had conquered anger and controlled their senses, who was devoted to prayers and offerings of libations. Some of them subsisted on water, some on air. Some lived on fallen leaves, some on fruits and roots. The hermitage looked bedecked with valakhilyas (born from Vala of Brahma ) and vaikhanasas (born from the nails of Brahma).

raw: नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः । राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संसेव्यते त्वया ॥५-५८-१४६॥
translation: "Vibhishana, a tiger among demons, asked Ravana to give up his decision as it was a forbidden course according to the science of royal polity.

raw: निभृतः संवृताकारो गुप्तमन्त्रः सहायवान् । अमोघक्रोधहर्षश्च त्यागसंयमकालवित् ॥२-१-२३॥
translation: He (Rama) was modest and did not reveal his inner feelings. He counselled in secrecy and had good friends. Never was his anger or pleasure in vain. He knew the occasion when to sacrifce and when to exercise restraint.

raw: भृत्यानां भरणात् सम्यक् प्रजानां परिपालनात् । अर्थादानाच्च धर्मेण पिता नस्त्रिदिवं गत: ॥२-१०५-३३॥
translation: Our father nourished his dependents, splendidly governed his subjects and accepted wealth through righteous ways. Because of these pious acts, he could go to heaven.

raw: अक्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां तथारूपां मनस्विनीम् । ददौ रामाय वैदेहीमङ्के कृत्वा विभावसुः ॥६-१२१-४॥
translation: Radiating like the rising sun, adorned with polished gold ornaments, wearing red coloured clothes, with beautiful black hair, wearing fresh flowers, being in the same young form as before, blameless Vaidehi was held in the arms of the fire god and presented to Rama.

raw: भक्षयन्वन्यमाहारम् सुतो मे वर्तयिष्यति । महार्हवस्त्रसम्वीतो भूत्वा चिरसुखोषितः ॥२-१२-१००॥
यज्ञस्य अन्ते नरश्रेष्ठ विवाहम् ऋषि सत्तमैः । तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा ऋषि मध्ये नराधिपः ॥१-६९-१३॥
सुग्रीवोहनुमांश्चैवमहेन्द्रसदृशद्युती । स्नातौदिव्यनिभैर्वस्त्रैर्जग्मतुश्शुभकुण्डलौ ॥६-१३१-२१॥
translation: Sugriva and Hanuman having bathed wore sparkling earrings, clothed in heavenly robes vied with Mahendra in splendour, started.

raw: सो ऽहं वनमिदं प्राप्तो निर्जनं लक्ष्मणान्वित: । सीतया चाप्रतिद्वन्द्व: सत्यवादे स्थित: पितु: ॥२-१०७-८॥
translation: I have come to this lonely forest accompanied by Lakshmana and Sita, bent upon upholding the truth of our unrivalled father's words.

raw: सुग्रीवंकेकयीपुत्रोजाम्बवन्तमथाङ्गदम् मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलमृषभंपरिषस्वजे ॥६-१३०-४१॥
translation: Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi thereafter embraced Sugriva, Jambavantha, Angada, Mainda, Dwivivida, Nila and Rshaba.

raw: तम् प्रविष्टम् वनम् दृष्ट्वा वाली शाप भयात् ततः । मुक्तो हि असि त्वम् इति उक्त्वा स निवृत्तो महाबलः ॥४-१२-२३॥
translation: Effulgent Vali saw Sugriva entering the (prohibited) grove and turned back due to the fear of the curse (of sage Matanga) saying, 'You have escaped'.

raw: एतमर्थं महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम् । नगरं प्रययावाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम् ॥७-८०-१७॥
translation: Having committed this extremely dreadful and very cruel act, Daṇḍa quickly departed to his unequalled city of Madhumanta.

raw: केन प्रभावेण भवो नित्यं क्रीडति राजवत् । विज्ञातव्यं न जानीते भयस्थानमुपस्थितम् ॥७-१६-२४॥
translation: By what power does Shiva constantly play like a king, not recognizing the imminent danger that should be known?

raw: उत्तिष्ठ हरि शार्दूल भजस्व शयन उत्तमम् । न एवम् विधाः शेरते हि भूमौ नृपति सत्तमाः ॥४-२०-५॥
translation: 'O tiger among monkeys get up. Come and sleep on the best of beds. Best of kings, you should not lie on the ground.

raw: चतुर्दशसमा: सौम्य दण्डकारण्यमाश्रित: । उपभोक्ष्ये त्वहं दत्तं भागं पित्रा महात्मना ॥२-१०४-२६॥
translation: O handsome one, as for myself, I shall enjoy the portion bestowed on me by my magnanimous father and shall take refuge in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years.

raw: ये मां वाक्यान्तरे ब्रूयुरनुनेतुं कथञ्चन । अहिता नाम ते नित्यं मदभीष्टविघातनात् ॥७-४५-२१॥
translation: Those who would speak to me with other words, attempting to persuade me in any way, are indeed always my enemies because they obstruct my desire.

raw: प्राप्तां सुमहतीं प्रीतिं प्रतीतां तां हतद्विषम् । उपस्थास्यसि कौसल्यां दासीवत्त्वं कृताञ्जलिः ॥२-८-१०॥
translation: With folded palms like an attendant, you will have to serve that renowned Kausalya who is greatlly delighted by getting rid of her enemies.

raw: तस्य ते युद्धकामस्य युद्धं दास्यामि दुर्मते । तिष्ठं त्वं च मुहूर्तं तु यावदायुधमानये । ईप्सितं यादृशं तुभ्यं सज्जये यावदायुधम् ॥७-६८-१७॥
translation: O evil-minded one, I will give you the battle you desire; just wait for a moment until I bring and prepare the kind of weapon you wish for.

raw: सम्तुष्टा फल मूलेन भर्तृ शुश्रूषणा परा । या पराम् भजते प्रीतिम् वने अपि भवने यथा ॥५-१६-२०॥
translation: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way

raw: ताम् अकामाम् स काम आर्तः पन्नग इन्द्र वधूम् इव । विवेष्टमानाम् आदाय उत्पपात अथ रावणः ॥३-४९-२२॥
translation: Passionate Ravana took hold of Sita who was not willing and was writhing in pain. He seized her like (an eagle carrying away) a serpent queen and flew up.

raw: सोत्तराणि महात्मना । यदि बुद्धिः कृता राजञ्छ्रवणाय महारथ । कर्मान्तरे क्षणीभूतस्तच्छृणुष्व सहानुजः ॥७-९४-२९॥
translation: O King, O great warrior, if you have formed the intention to listen to this work, including the Uttara Kanda, composed by the great soul, then find a moment during your work interval and listen to it with your younger brothers.

raw: इत्येवं मतिमास्थाय वाली कर्णमुपाश्रितः । जपन्वै नैगमान्मन्त्रांस्तस्थौ पर्वतराडिव ॥७-३४-१८॥
translation: Vali, having adopted this resolve, resorted to a secluded spot and stood there, chanting Vedic mantras, appearing like the king of mountains.

raw: एष धर्मः पुरा दृष्टः लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्मृतः । अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः ॥२-२४-२७॥
ददामि च अस्त्रम् पैनाकम् अस्त्रम् नारायणम् तथा । आग्नेयम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् शिखरम् नाम नामतः ॥१-२७-१०॥
विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा स ददर्श नरान्तकम् । गृहीतप्रासमायान्तं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥६-६९-८३॥
translation: (Sugriva) saw the Vanaras troops running and Naranthaka seated on horseback advancing with a spear.

raw: अनागतम् च यत् किंचिद् रामस्य वसुधा तले । तत् चकार उत्तरे काव्ये वाल्मीकिः भगवान् ऋषिः ॥१-३-३९॥
translation: Divine sage Valmiki composed events yet to happen on this earth in the history of Rama in Uttarakanda. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the third sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana in synopsis of the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: पश्यमेमुद्गरंभीमंसर्वकालायसंमहत् । अनेननिर्जितादेवादानवाश्चपुरामया ॥६-६७-१५०॥
translation: "See my terrible club made of wrought iron. By this I have won earlier Devatas and Danavas."

raw: अथवा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयं परमुपस्थितम् । यदर्थमेवं त्वरितैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः ॥६-६०-६९॥
translation: "Is there any fear of some enemies Is it because of that you have woken me up Let me know."

raw: ततोयानान्युपारूढास्सर्वादशरथस्त्रियः । कौसल्यांप्रमुखेकृत्वासुमित्रांचापिनिर्ययुः कैकेय्यासहिताःसर्वानन्दिग्राममुपागमन् ॥६-१३०-१५॥
translation: Then all the consorts of Dasharatha, keeping Kausalya and Sumitra in front, seated in palanquin accompanied by Kaikeyi, started from Nandigram.

raw: तेषां चतुर्णां रामस्तु शिरांसि निशितैः शरै । क्रुद्धश्चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद घोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ॥६-४३-२७॥
translation: Raged Rama with his sharp arrows which were like flames of fire destroyed all the four Rakshasas by cutting their heads.

raw: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा देवेशः त्रिदिवम् पुनः अभ्यगात् । विश्वामित्रो महातेजा भूयः तेपे महत् तपः ॥१-६३-३॥
translation: Brahma, the lord of the gods, having said this returned to heaven. The brilliant Viswamitra continues his austerities.

raw: स तस्य मधुपर्कं गां पाद्यमर्घ्यं निवेद्य च । पुलस्त्यमाह राजेन्द्रो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ॥७-३३-९॥
translation: Having offered madhuparka, a cow, water for washing feet, and arghya to Pulastya, the king of kings then spoke to him with a voice choked with joy.

raw: साधु ते तत्त्वतो देवि कथितं साधु भामिनि । गृहाण सुस्मिते वाक्यमन्यथा न भविष्यसि ॥५-२१-१९॥
सो ऽहं वनमिदं दुर्गं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् । तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे ॥७-७८-८॥
translation: I entered this inaccessible forest, devoid of deer and birds, to perform penance near an auspicious lake.

raw: तमनुप्लवते वायुः प्लवन्तं पुत्रमात्मनः । सूर्यदाहभयाद्रक्षंस्तुषारचयशीतलः ॥७-३५-२८॥
translation: Vayu, the wind god, followed his own son (Hanuman) as he flew, protecting him from the sun's scorching heat by making himself cool with a mass of frost.

raw: स शैलशिखराभेण तोरणेन समाहतः । जगाम न क्षतिं वीरो वरदानात्स्वयम्भुवः ॥७-१४-२८॥
translation: Though struck by the archway resembling a mountain peak, the hero suffered no harm due to the boon granted by Svayambhu (Brahma).

raw: क्व नु लक्ष्मण वैदेही कम् वा देशम् इतो गता । केन आहृता वा सौमित्रे भक्षिता केन वा प्रिया ॥३-६१-३॥
translation: O son of Sumitra, where is my beloved ? Where did she go? By whom was she abducted? Or, devoured? O Lakshmana

raw: कुशाश्वस्य महातेजाः सोमदत्तः प्रतापवान् । सोमदत्तस्य पुत्रः तु काकुत्स्थ इति विश्रुतः ॥१-४७-१६॥
translation: Brilliant and powerful Somadatta was Kusaswa's son. That Somadatta's son was Kakutstha is wellknown.

raw: भरतेन तु सार्धं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः । नैगमा बलवृद्धाश्च द्विजाश्च सुसमाहिताः ॥७-९१-२३॥
translation: Indeed, let the armies go forth with Bharata, and also the merchants, the strong and old, and the well-prepared Brahmins.

raw: तैः मेघ बृन्दाचल कूट संनिभैःमहाबलैः वानर यूथप अधिपैः । बभूव भूः भीम शरीर रूपैःसमावृता राम सहाय हेतोः ॥१-१७-३७॥
translation: In order to assist Rama, this earth was filled with commanders of those who led the monkey forces resembling masses of clouds and mountains. They loan endowed with immense strength and fearful forms and countenances. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: बभूव बुद्धिस्तु हरीश्वरस्य यदीदृशी राघवधर्मपत्नी । इमा यथा राक्षसराजभार्याः सुजातमस्येति हि साधुबुद्धेः ॥५-९-७२॥
translation: 'If the lawful wife of Rama born of a good family can be allowed to remain with Rama in the same way as the consorts of the lord of demons, how fortunate it would be, thought the wise lord of monkeys'.

raw: अनर्थिनः सुताः स्त्रीणाम् भर्तारः भ्रातरः तथा । सर्वे सर्वम् परित्यज्य रामम् एव अन्वचिन्तयन् ॥२-४१-१९॥
translation: Mothers stopped thinking of their sons and husbands of their wives. Brothers were no longer interested in each other. Every one deserted every one and thought only of Rama.

raw: शारदस्तिभिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः । आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः ॥५-६६-१३॥
translation: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा विरराम द्विजोत्तमः । शतानंद वचः श्रुत्वा राम लक्ष्मण संनिधौ ॥१-६५-३०॥
translation: Having thus spoken, the most brilliant and best among brahmins (Satananda) became silent. In the presence of Rama and Lakshmana, Janaka listened to the words of Satananda. And with folded palms said to the son of Kushika (Viswamitra):

raw: आर्या च धर्म निरता धर्मज्ञा धर्म दर्शिनी । अरोगा च अपि कौसल्या माता रामस्य धीमतः ॥२-७०-८॥
translation: (I hope) Kausalya mother of the sagacious Rama the venerable lady devoted to righteousness one who knows the ways of righteousness and observes the prescribed code of conduct, is keeping sound health.

raw: पुत्रा वैवस्वतस्य अत्र पन्च काल अन्तक उपमाः । गजो गव अक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्ध मादनः ॥६-३०-२६॥
translation: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

raw: उताहो हतवीर्यास्ते बभूवुः पृथिवीक्षितः । बहिष्कृता वरास्त्रैश्च बहवो निर्जिता नृपाः ॥७-३१-४॥
translation: Or perhaps those kings became devoid of valor, and many rulers were conquered and deprived of their excellent weapons.

raw: दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिश स्थितम् श्वेतम् इव अंबरम् । कैलास शिखर प्रख्यम् नाना धातु विराजितम् ॥४-२७-१५॥
translation: 'In the southern direction is a white rock appearing as if it is another mountain. It looks like mount Kailas and is rich with various minerals.

raw: इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य सीता रामस्य तद्वचः । मृगीवोत्फुल्लनयना बभूवाश्रुपरिप्लुता ॥६-११८-१०॥
translation: Sita's broad eyes which were like that of female deer were filled with tears on hearing the words of Rama.

raw: युद्धार्थी समनुप्राप्तो रावणो नाम राक्षसः । रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणो ऽथार्जुनस्य ते । उत्तस्थुः सायुधास्त्राश्च रावणं वाक्यमब्रुवन् ॥७-३२-२७॥
translation: Having heard Ravana's words, "A Rākṣasa named Ravana, desirous of battle, has arrived," those ministers of Arjuna then stood up with their weapons and missiles and spoke to Ravana.

raw: एष एव आशम्सते युद्धे निहन्तुम् सर्व राक्षसान् । यस् तु सव्यम् असौ पक्षम् रामस्य आश्रित्य तिष्ठति ॥६-२८-२६॥
समुद्धृत निधानानि परिध्वस्त अजिराणि च । उपात्त धन धान्यानि हृत साराणि सर्वशः ॥२-३३-१८॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.

raw: वसानम् चर्म वैयाघ्रम् वस आर्द्रम् रुधिरोक्षितम् । त्रासनम् सर्व भूतानाम् व्यादितास्यम् इव अन्तकम् ॥३-२-६॥
translation: Wearing a tigerskin, he resembled the god of death. With a wide, open mouth, wet with marrow and drenched with blood, he struck terror into all beings.

raw: अस्य त्वम् धरमाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । रुमायाम् वर्तसे कामात् स्नुषायाम् पाप कर्मकृत् ॥४-१८-१९॥
translation: 'You are a sinner, since you live with Ruma, who is your virtual daughterinlaw, when the great self Sugriva is alive. (A younger brother is like a son and his wife, a daughterinlaw).

raw: स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बले सालमेकं तु निर्भिद्या भवेद्व्यक्तिर्बलाबले ॥४-११-९०॥
translation: 'O Dear, therefore, I have my doubt about your relative strength. If you can split a sala tree with a single arrow then can your strength or weakness be demonstrated.

raw: विभीषणमुखं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवं तांश्च वानरान् । लक्ष्मणोवाच मन्दार्थमिदं बाष्पपरिप्लुतः ॥६-८४-६॥
translation: Lakshmana looking at Sugriva's face and also at the Vanaras, his eyes bathed in tears spoke in a dull tone.

raw: तौ मुनी तापसश्रेष्ठौ विनीतो ह्यभिवादयत् । स ताभ्यां पूजितो राजा स्वागतेनासनेन च ॥७-५१-५॥
translation: The king (Rama) humbly greeted those two sages, the best among ascetics, and was honored by them with a welcome and a seat.

raw: त्रिशङ्कुर्विमलो भाति राजर्षिस्सपुरोहितः । पितामहाः पुरोऽस्माकमिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम् ॥६-४-५०॥
translation: Among the great kings of the Ikshvaku dynasty, the grandfather Trisanku who is a royal sage shines clearly along with Vasishta the foremost priest.

raw: बलस्य च निघातेन अङ्गदस्य जयेन च । राक्षसः क्रोधमाविष्टो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः ॥६-५४-१॥
translation: Vajradamshtra, the mighty Rakshasa became enraged with the destruction of his army and victory of Angada.

raw: लोकप्रवादः सत्योऽयं पण्डितैः समुदाहृतः । अकाले दुर्लभो मृत्युः स्त्रिया वा पुरुषस्य वा ॥५-२३-१२॥
आपतन्तीं च वेगेन कुम्भस्तां सान्त्वयच्चमूम् ॥६-७६-३६॥
translation: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.

raw: तत् श्रुत्वा विषसाद एव द्वितीया प्रिय शम्सनात् । विषण्ण वदनो भूत्वा भूयः पप्रच्च मातरम् ॥२-७२-३९॥
translation: Bharata was more distraught on hearing the words that conveyed the second unpleasant tidings. With downcast countenance, he again enquired of his mother thus:

raw: आगच्छन्त्याश्च विजनं वनमेवं भयावहम् । समाहितं मे श्वश्र्वा च हृदये तद्धृतं महत् ॥२-११८-७॥
translation: When departing for this frightful and desolate forest, the great (advice) imparted by my motherinlaw is firmly fixed in my mind.

raw: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुरुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १०४ ॥६-१०४-३३॥
दिव्यम् च मानुषम् च एवम् आत्मनः च पराक्रमम् । इक्ष्वाकु वृषभ अवेक्ष्य यतस्व द्विषताम् वधे ॥३-६६-२०॥
translation: O bull among the Ikshvakus, weigh your divine and human prowess before you try to kill your enemies.

raw: दिव्य अंबर धरा तत्र बभूव प्रिय दर्शन । विराजयन्ती तम् देशम् विद्युत् सौदामिनी यथा ॥३-७४-३४॥
translation: Adorned with wonderful ornaments and beautiful garlands, anointed with fragrant unguents, robed in most beautiful clothes, she appeared like a streak of lightning, her body shining bright and her face contented.

raw: स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसङ्काशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम् । एकान्ते ऋषिवाटानां चकार उटजाञ्छुभान् ॥७-९३-२॥
translation: Having seen the divine-like and wondrous sacrifice, he (Valmiki) constructed auspicious huts in a secluded spot among the hermitages of other sages.

raw: यदि त्वस्ति मया किञ्चित्कृतं दत्तं हुतं तथा । तस्मात्त्वयोनिजा साध्वी भवेयं धर्मिणः सुता ॥७-१७-३३॥
translation: If I have indeed performed any good deeds, given charity, or offered sacrifices, then may I be born as the virtuous, womb-born daughter of a righteous man.

raw: चरामि सायुधो नित्यम् ऋषि मांसानि भक्षयन् । इयम् नारी वरारोहा मम भार्या भविष्यति ॥३-२-१३॥
स गदाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च महाबलः । उद्यतां च पुनस्तस्य जहार द्विविदो गदाम् ॥६-७६-३०॥
translation: Dwivida, though mighty reeled and could not move when struck by Sonitaksha. He got up and again and snatched the mace from Sonithaksha.

raw: न ध्वजा न पताका वा चर्म वा तुरगो ऽपि वा । आयुधं स्यन्दनं वा ऽपि ददृशे तेन रेणुना ॥६-५५-२०॥
translation: By the dust raised, the posts, flags, shields and not even horses, weapons and chariots were visible.

raw: अहो तमैव इदम् स्यान् न प्रज्ञायेत किम्चन । राजा चेन् न भवेन् लोके विभजन् साध्व् असाधुनी ॥२-६७-३६॥
translation: If the king did not show the distinction between the good and evil actions, this world would have been enveloped by darkness. Nothing could have been seen. How great (is the king)?

raw: राम कोपात् अशेषाणाम् राक्षसाम् च तथा वधम् । कैकेय्या वर दानेन इदम् च विकृतम् कृतम् ॥४-५६-१६॥
translation: 'The exile of Rama and Lakshmana into the forest along with Sita, so also the death of Vali and of the demons in the hands of Rama due to his anger are all evil consequences of a boon granted to Kaikeyi.'

raw: चन्द्रमा रजनीम् कुर्यात् प्रभया सौम्य निर्मलाम् । त्वत् विधो वा अपि मित्राणाम् प्रीतिम् कुर्यात् परंतप ॥४-३९-३॥
translation: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.

raw: अक्षया बलवंतः च तथैव पुरुष आदकाः । किराताः तीक्ष्ण चूडाः च हेमाभाः प्रिय दर्शनाः ॥४-४०-२७॥
translation: 'There are people who have taken shelter in the deep pits in the midst of the sea, in deep valleys, mountains, cities and broad peaks of Mandara mountain and forests.All those regions should be thoroughly searched. There are innumerable inhabitants,such as strong cannibals, some who cover their ears, some who have ears extended up to the lips, some with dreadful metallic faces, some swiftmoving, onefooted indestructible beings. There are Kirata tribes of golden complexion and handsome looks whose tuft of hair is set to the sides so that it touches their ears. These Kiratas are Islanddwellers and they eat uncooked fish.They move in waters and are fierce, known as tigerlike men (Naravyagras because half of their body is human and other half is tiger in form). All the shelters of these forestdwellers should be searched well.Those who can be sent by crossing mountains, those who can leap (in air) and those who can swim through waters may be also dispatched.

raw: राज्यात् हीनो भ्रात्रा च पक्षाभ्याम् विक्रमेण च । सर्वथा मर्तुम् एव इच्छन् पतिष्ये शिखरात् गिरेः ॥४-६१-१७॥
translation: 'Bereft of my kingdom, my brother and my wings, and having lost my strength I desire to fall down from the mountain top and die.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: गिरिणा पीड्यमानेन पीड्यमानानि सर्वशः । गुहाविष्टानि भूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः ॥५-१-१७॥
translation: Squeezed on all sides of the mountain by Hanuman, all creatures living in the caves shrieked making horrible sounds .

raw: कामी वा न कदर्यो वा नृशंसः पुरुषः क्वचित् । द्रष्टुम् शक्यम् अयोध्यायाम् न अविद्वान् न च नास्तिकः ॥१-६-८॥
translation: The lustful, the miserly, the unscholarly and atheists were not to be seen anywhere in the city of Ayodhya.

raw: तन् मम एव एष सत्कारो लाभः च एव उत्तमः प्रभो । यत् त्वम् इच्छसि सौहार्दम् वानरेण मया सह ॥४-५-१०॥
translation: 'O Lord that you are eager to have friendship with me, who is a monkey is a great honour and is extremely beneficial to me.

raw: विनिहत्य च यक्षौघान् विक्षोभ्य च विगृह्य च । त्वया कैलास शिखराद् विमानम् इदम् आहृतम् ॥६-७-६॥
translation: "Causing terrific disturbance to the hordes of Yakshas and taking them as prisoners, you have brought the great aerial chariot from mount Kailas."

raw: कुम्भीनसी च इत्येते सुमालेः प्रसवाः स्मृताः ॥७-५-४२॥
translation: Kumbhinasi and others are known as the offspring of Sumali.

raw: सागरस्योत्तरे तीरेऽब्रवम् ते वचनम् तथा । यथासम्देशमक्लिष्टम् सान्त्वयन् श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥६-२४-२८॥
translation: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."

raw: त्वया पुनर्नृशंसेन सीतां संरुन्धता बलात् । राक्षसा वयमात्मा च त्रयं तुल्यं निपातितम् ॥६-११३-२२॥
translation: "With evil intention you kept Sita under detention. These Rakshasas and you and us all the three are together destroyed."

raw: सुखिता बत तम् कालम् जीविष्यन्ति नर उत्तमाः । परिष्वजन्तः ये रामम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुनर् आगतम् ॥२-४२-३१॥
translation: Oh how fortunate are those best of men who will live until that time to see Rama return and embrace him.

raw: यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि । जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव ॥७-१०६-४॥
translation: O great king, if there is affection and favor towards me, then abandon me without hesitation, O Raghava, and uphold your dharma.

raw: प्रकृतिः स्थः तु काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीव वचनात् प्रभुः । संपरिष्वज्य सुग्रीवम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-७-१६॥
translation: When lord Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race was comforted by these words of Sugriva, he came to his senses, and clasping him said:

raw: दिवः क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसङ्गताम् । गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च ॥६-७०-३९॥
translation: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, snapped the javelin flung by Trisira on him, which came down unobstructed like a meteor from heaven and the monkeys roared.

raw: प्रवाति पवनः श्रीमान् किम् नु नाद्य यथापुरम् । भेरीमृदङ्गवीणानाम् कोणसम्घट्टितः पुनः ॥२-७१-२९॥
जिघांसन्तीं ततस्तां तु ज्वलदग्निशिरोरुहाम् । सव्यमुष्टिप्रहारेण पराजित्य सुभैरवाम् ॥५-५८-४८॥
translation: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.

raw: ततः प्रकृतिमापन्नो हृतशल्यो गतव्यथः । सौमित्रिर्मुदितस्तत्र क्षणेन विगतज्वरः ॥६-९२-२६॥
translation: Then Saumithri, freed from arrows, relieved from pain, anguish gone in a moment, and naturally restored, was happy.

raw: कनीयानेष मे भ्राता अहं ज्येष्ठो महामुने । ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुङ्गव सीतां रामाय भद्रं ते ऊर्मिला लक्ष्मणाय च ॥१-७१-२०॥
translation: O Great ascetic (Vasishta), this one is my youger brother and I am the elder one. O preeminent among ascetics with immense pleasure I am giving these maidens, Sita to Rama and Urmila to Lakshmana. Be blessed

raw: अत्र विम्शति कोट्यः तु नृपतेर् मातुलस्य ते । दश कोट्यः तु सम्पूर्णाः तथैव च नृप आत्मज ॥२-७०-५॥
translation: O prince these gifts worth twenty crore are intended for the king and the rest of the gifts worth ten crore for your maternal uncle.

raw: अग्निष्टोमादिभिः यज्ञैः इष्टवान् आप्त दक्षिणैः । तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः ॥४-४-८॥
तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां सर्वेषां ध्वनिरुत्थितः । वायुनोद्वर्तमानस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः ॥६-११७-२२॥
translation: The great sound heard there was like the uproar of an ocean lashed by a storm.

raw: कुशध्वज सुते च उभे जगृहुः नृप योषितः । मंगल आलापनैः होमैः शोभिताः क्षौम वाससः ॥१-७७-१२॥
महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भिः । सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः । रराज वीरैश्च विनिःश्वसद्भि । र्ह्रदो भुजङ्गैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः ॥५-५-१४॥
translation: There were huge elephants trumpeting, respected people, warriors sighing for the lack of enemies (to vanquish). It had a lake infested with hissing snakes.

raw: यदुस्तु जनयामास यातुधानान्सहस्रशः । पुरे क्रौञ्चवने दुर्गे राजवंशबहिष्कृतः ॥७-५९-२०॥
translation: King Yadu, having been excluded from the royal lineage, begot thousands of Rākṣasas in the inaccessible region of Krauñcavana.

raw: एवमुक्ता तया देव्या मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी । रामार्थमुपहिंसन्ती कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९-४॥
translation: Thus addressed by queen Kaikeyi, that evil minded Manthara said this to Kaikeyi in order to spoil the interest of Rama:

raw: ललाटे च रुजो जाता न च मोहात् न्यवर्तत । तान् समीक्ष्य महोत्पातान् उत्थितान् रोम हर्षणान् ॥३-२३-१८॥
पुष्प भार अतिभारैः च स्पृशद्भिर् इव मेदिनीम् । कर्णिकारैः कुसुमितैः किम्शुकैः च सुपुष्पितैः ॥५-१५-८॥
translation: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

raw: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः । तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन्नमो ऽस्तु ते ॥६-१०७-१५॥
translation: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.

raw: कौसल्याम् धर्म सम्युक्ताम् वियुक्ताम् पाप निश्चये । कृत्वा कम् प्राप्स्यसे तु अद्य लोकम् निरय गामिनी ॥२-७४-१२॥
translation: O woman of sinful convictions you will go to hell. You have separated righteous Kausalya from her son. For having committed such a sin, what afterworld awaits you (is not known)?

raw: भरद्वाजाभिगमनम् प्रयागे च सहासनम् । आगिरेर्गमनम् तेषाम् तत्रस्थैरभिलक्षितम् ॥२-५७-२॥
translation: Positioned there, they could mark their arrival at Bharadwaja's at Prayaga, their stay (nighthalt) and their onward journey to Chitrakuta mountain.

raw: तमेनं सान्त्वयित्वा तु समाश्वास्य च राक्षसम् । सुषेणं श्वशुरं पार्श्वे सुग्रीवस्तमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-२३॥
translation: Thus, consoling and pacifying, the Rakshasa, Vibheeshana in that manner, Sugriva turned to his uncle Sushena and spoke.

raw: एवं मधुरमुक्तस्तु गुरुणा राघव: स्वयम् । प्रत्युवाच समासीनं वसिष्ठं पुरुषर्षभ: ॥२-१११-८॥
translation: When Rama, the best of men, was advised personally by Vasistha, the preceptor, with sweet words, he replied to him who was sitting beside him:

raw: विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च पतिदेवता । उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सोम्यतरानना ॥६-११७-३५॥
translation: Sita, a gentle lady, who considered her husband as God only wondered with a mixed feeling of joy and affection and looked at the gentle face of Rama.

raw: किमद्य शब्दो विरतः सदाऽदीनगतिः पुरा । अनिष्टानि च पापानि पश्यामि विविधानि च ॥२-७१-३०॥
राघवस्तु रथं दिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तं शिखिप्रभम् । अनुज्ञाय महाभागो मातलिं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥६-११५-४॥
translation: Bidding farewell to Matali joyously, honourable Raghava returned the aerial chariot bestowed to him by Indra.

raw: तरुणी रूपसंपन्ना सर्वाअभरण भूषिता । दृष्टा तत्र मया नारी तयोर् मध्ये सुमध्यमा ॥३-१९-१७॥
translation: I saw between them a young, beautiful woman of slender waist, adorned with all kinds of jewels.

raw: प्रत्यूचुस्तं च राजानो हर्षेण महता वृताः । दिष्ट्यां त्वं विजयी राम स्वराज्ये ऽपि प्रतिष्ठितः ॥७-३८-२७॥
translation: The kings, filled with great joy, replied to him, saying, "Fortunately, O Rama, you are victorious and re-established in your own kingdom."

raw: स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतो ऽभवत्तदा ॥७-९१-८॥
translation: Then, having heard the words of wonderful insight from those chief Brahmins regarding the Ashwamedha, he (Rama) became greatly pleased.

raw: लक्ष्मणः तम् तदा उवाच रक्ष्यमाणाः त्वया अनघ । न अत्र भीता वयम् सर्वे धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता ॥२-५१-८॥
translation: Lakshmana said to Guha, O sinless one when all of us are under your righteous protection we have nothing to fear.

raw: यत्त्वां विजयिनं राम पश्यामो हतशात्रवम् ॥७-३८-२९॥
translation: Our greatest joy is that we see you, O Rama, victorious and with your enemies slain.

raw: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थं जनको हृष्टमानसः । प्रययौ मिथिलां श्रीमांस्तमनुज्ञाय राघवम् ॥७-३८-८॥
translation: Having thus spoken to Rama, the glorious Janaka, with a joyful mind, took leave of Rama and departed for Mithila.

raw: प्रवीविवक्षोरिव सागरस्य लोकान्दिधक्षोरिव पावकस्ययुगक्षये ह्येव यथान्तकस्य हनूमतः स्थास्यति कः पुरस्तात् ॥७-३६-४९॥
translation: Who indeed will be able to stand before Hanuman, who is like the ocean wishing to overflow, like fire wishing to burn the worlds, or like Yama at the end of an eon?

raw: स वेगवान् महावेगं कृत्वा परमदुर्जयः । तलेन भृशमुत्पत्य जघानास्य महागजम् ॥६-७०-१३॥
translation: Angada, who was endowed with high speed, and exceedingly difficult to encounter, jumped up the huge elephant of Mahodara attacked him.

raw: एकं रामं परिक्षिप्य समरे हन्तुमर्हथ । वर्षन्तः शरवर्षेण प्रावृट्काल इवाम्बुदाः ॥६-९४-४॥
translation: Encircling the lone Rama in battle, you ought to slay him, raining showers of arrows like clouds at the time of the monsoon.

raw: ततो वानरसैन्येन मुक्तो नादः समन्ततः । मलयः पूरितो येन स सानुप्रस्थकन्दरः ॥६-४२-३८॥
translation: Thereafter the Vanara army emitted a sound that filled all sides of Malaya Mountain, its major and minor caves.

raw: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट् कालो अयम् आगतः । ततः स राष्ट्रम् स गणाम् रावणम् तम् वधिष्यसि ॥४-२७-३९॥
translation: 'This is the rainy season.Wait for autumn.Thereafter you will destroy Ravana along with his kingdom and clan.

raw: ताम् नष्ट तिमिराम् दीपैः भास्वरैः च महा गृहैः । नगरीम् राक्षस इन्द्रस्य ददर्श स महा कपिः ॥५-३-१९॥
translation: Hanuman looked at the city of the demon king, whose darkness was dispelled by bright gems and mighty mansions as if it were a young maiden. The prosperous city was like a well decorated woman, adorned with ornaments having walls for her dress, the stables for her earrings, the armouries for her breasts.

raw: स श्रुत्वा पुरुष व्याघ्रम् रामम् विषयम् आगतम् । वृद्धैः परिवृतः अमात्यैः ज्ञातिभिः च अपि उपागतः ॥२-५०-३४॥
अलम् काल अत्ययम् कृत्वा समुद्रो अयम् नियुज्यताम् । यथा कालात्ययम् कृत्वा सागराय नियुज्यताम् ॥६-१८-४१॥
दिवसे विंशतिः सर्गा गेया मधुरया गिरा । प्रमाणैर्बहुभिस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टा मया पुरा ॥७-९३-११॥
translation: Twenty cantos should be sung daily with a sweet voice, using the many meters and measures as I have previously instructed.

raw: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातः सिंह स्कन्धो महाद्युतिः । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा यः ते प्राणान् हरिष्यति ॥३-५६-४॥
translation: The brilliant Rama of the Ikshvaku dynasty with the lion's shoulders will come with his brother Lakshmana and take away your life.

raw: सुराः च सर्वे संहृष्टा विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रुवन् । मुने कौशिक भद्रम् ते सह इन्द्राः सर्वे मरुद् गणाः ॥१-२६-२८॥
उत्तरं नहि वक्तव्यं ज्येष्ठेनाभिहिते पुनः । अधर्मसहितं चैव परलोकविवर्जितम् ॥७-६३-६॥
translation: Indeed, a reply should not be spoken again when commanded by the elder brother, as doing so is unrighteous and leads to no good in the afterlife.

raw: ताः सर्वगुण संपन्ना रूप यौवन संयुताः । दृष्ट्वा सर्वात्मको वायुर् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३२-१५॥
translation: At the sight of the maidens embellished with all virtues and youth and beauty, the allpervading Windgod addressed them these words:

raw: क्षौद्रम् दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः । अष्टौ च कन्या रुचिरा मत्तश्छ वरवारणः ॥२-१४-३६॥
translation: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

raw: पद्भ्यामेव हि धर्मज्ञो न्यस्तशस्त्रपरिच्छद: । वसानो वाससी क्षौमे पुरोधाय पुरोधसम् ॥२-९०-२॥
translation: Bharata, the knower of righteous ways and the best among men, saw the hermitage of Bharadwaja from a distance of one krosa and brought his entire army to a halt. He laid aside all his royal robes and weapons. Clad in silk garments, he went on foot along with his ministers, with the family priest Vasistha ahead of him.

raw: सा तु शोक परीत अंगी मैथिली जनकात्मजा । राक्षसी वशम् आपन्ना व्याघ्रीणाम् हरिणी यथा ॥३-५६-३४॥
translation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, engulfed in grief found herself like a doe under the control of tigresses.

raw: ततो विद्राव्यमाणेषु दैवतेषु सुमालिना । वसूनामष्टमः क्रुद्धः सावित्रो वै व्यवस्थितः ॥७-२७-४२॥
translation: Then, as the gods were being put to flight by Sumali, Savitra, the eighth among the Vasus, enraged, stood firm.

raw: तथा सनियमामेव सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च । उवाच वचनं रामो हर्ष्यंस्तामिदं तदा ॥२-४-३४॥
translation: While she (Kausalya) was in that state of meditation, Rama approached her, offered reverential salutation and said these words of praise enhancing her joy:

raw: ययोर्वीर्यमुपाश्रित्य प्रतिष्ठा काङ्क्षिता मया । तावुभौ देहनाशाय प्रसुप्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ ॥६-५०-१८॥
translation: "These two bulls among men of great valour and fame whose refuge was sought by me are lying asleep wounded all over and limbs broken."

raw: धारयिष्यामि मासं तु जीवितं शत्रुसूदन । मासादूर्ध्वं न जीविष्ये त्वया हीना नृपात्मज ॥५-४०-१०॥
translation: "O subduer of enemies O prince I will hold on to life only for a month. I will not survive beyond a month in your absence.

raw: सशल्यो ऽयं महाप्राज्ञ सौमित्रिर्मित्रवत्सलः । यथा भवति सुस्वस्थस्तथा त्वं समुपाचर ॥६-९२-२०॥
translation: "O very wise Sushena! Treat Saumithri in such a way that this Lakshmana, loved by friends pained by the arrows pierced, will be relieved."

raw: रावणो ऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः । गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ॥६-११०-१५॥
translation: Enraged Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, also in return, retaliated with maces and mallets.

raw: स तस्य वेगं च कपेर्महात्मनः पराक्रमं चारिषु पार्थिवात्मजः । विधारयन् स्वं च बलं महाबलो हिमक्षये सूर्य इवाभिवर्धते ॥५-४७-९॥
translation: Aksha, the mighty prince judging the speed and prowess of the monkey with his own in confronting enemies and the strength of the monkey, began to swell up in spirit like the glow of the Sun at the end of winter.

raw: तेषां संवदतामेवं श्रोतऽणां हर्षवर्धनम् । गेयं प्रचक्रतुस्तत्र तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ ॥७-९४-१४॥
translation: While they were conversing thus, those two sons of the sage performed the song there, which increased the joy of the listeners.

raw: भरतस्य कुमारस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमत: । वरयामस्सुते राजन् तयोरर्थे महात्मनो: ॥१-७२-६॥
translation: O king we choose your brother's daughters for the great souls: the young Bharata and the sagacious Satrughna.

raw: न एनम् दुह्खेन सम्तप्तः प्रत्यवैक्षत राघवम् । न च एनम् अभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य प्रत्यभाषत दुर्मनाः ॥२-३९-२॥
translation: After hearing Rama and beholding him in the robes of an ascetic, Dasaratha and his wives fell unconscious. With his body and mind afflicted with grief, Dasaratha could not look Rama in the face nor could he make a reply.

raw: अथायान्तं तु मुसलं कार्तवीर्यस्तदार्जुनः । निपुणं वञ्चयामास सगदो ऽगदविक्रमः ॥७-३२-४५॥
translation: Then, Kartavirya Arjuna, of unimpaired valor and holding his mace, skillfully dodged that incoming mace.

raw: धरते मारुतिस्तात मारुतप्रतिमो यदि । वैश्वानरसमो वीर्ये जीविताशा ततो भवेत् ॥६-७४-२३॥
translation: "Dear! If Hanuman who is equal to wind god, resembles Vyshvanara (God of fire) is breathing, then we can hope to live (for life)."

raw: कार्यस्त्रीरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः । चरता नियमेनैव तस्माद्दुःखतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-१५॥
translation: One has to wander about all the while (like an ascetic) as per the customs and take ablutions three times a day at prescribed hours. Hence life in the forest is extremely hard.

raw: इति सम्भाषमाणे तु शत्रुघ्ने लक्ष्मण अनुजे । प्राग् द्वारे अभूत् तदा कुब्जा सर्व आभरण भूषिता ॥२-७८-५॥
translation: While Satrughna, brother of Lakshmana was conversing thus, the hunchback Manthara decorated with all kinds of ornaments arrived at the entrance.

raw: तौ सम्प्रचलितौ वीरौ मर्मभेदेन कर्शितौ । निपेततुर्महेष्वासौ जगत्यां जगतीपती ॥६-४५-१८॥
translation: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.

raw: धनुषस्य तस्य वीर्यम् हि जिज्ञासन्तो महीक्षितः । न शेकुर् आरोपयितुम् राजपुत्रा महाबलाः ॥१-३१-१०॥
translation: Mighty princes and kings have failed to string it, in their attempt to know its strength.

raw: सर्वथा हि मम भ्राता स नाथो वानरेश्वर । त्वया नाथेन सुग्रीव प्रश्रितेन विशेषतः ॥४-३६-१३॥
translation: 'O Sugriva, king of monkeys when you are extending due courtesy to my brother,he has a guardian in you by all means.

raw: सराजभृत्यम् शत्रुघ्नम् भरतम् च यश्स्विनम् । युधाजितम् सुमन्त्रम् च ये च तत्र हिता जनाः ॥२-८१-१३॥
translation: Bring all the royal attendants, Satrughna, the illustrious Bharata, Yudhajit, Sumantra and all those wellwishers of the king.

raw: यश्च वो वितथं कुर्यात्तत्र तत्र ह्युपस्थितः । स हन्तव्यो हि सम्प्लुत्य राजशासनदूषकः ॥६-७५-४२॥
translation: Sugriva the great king of Vanaras commanded all the bulls among Vanaras, to encounter after reaching the gate of Lanka. "He who is staying wherever they are does not obey the king's command will be killed for being guilty of flouting the command", ordered Sugriva to the Vanaras.

raw: एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः । आजघान दशग्रीवं रणे रामः समाहितः ॥६-१०१-५८॥
ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम् । अदग्द्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता ॥५-५८-१६०॥
translation: "It was amazing to hear the words of the charanas. On hearing that Jankai had not been burnt, I understood that it is on her account (that he is also not burnt although his tail was ignited.)

raw: सुलोहिततलौ श्लक्क्षणौ चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठतौ । दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखौ तस्या दीप्यते मे शरीरजः ॥६-१२-१५॥
translation: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."

raw: एषो ऽपि हि महाभाग: पितुर्वचसि तिष्ठति । अत एव न शक्ता: स्मो व्यावर्त्तयितुमञ्जसा ॥२-१११-२१॥
translation: Highly distinguished Rama is firmly fixed on the command of his father. That is why we are incapable of making him return quickly.

raw: त्वम् अद्य भव नो राजा राज पुत्र महा यशः । सम्गत्या न अपराध्नोति राज्यम् एतत् अनायकम् ॥२-७९-३॥
translation: O illutrious prince do assume kingship now. Incidentally, there has been yet no attack on this leaderless kingdom.

raw: इतीव स महाबाहुस्सीताहरणकर्शितः । रामस्सागरमासाद्य वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा ॥६-४-१०३॥
translation: On seeing the ocean, the mightyarmed Rama, tormented by the abduction of Sita in that way, ordered about the quartering of the vanaras.

raw: चः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणो ऽथार्जुनस्य ते । यः क्षीबं स्त्रीवृतं चैव योद्धुमुत्सहते नृपम् । स्त्रीसमक्षं कथं यत्तद्योद्धुमुत्सहसे ऽर्जुनम् । वाशितामध्यगं मत्तं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम् ॥७-३२-२९॥
translation: Ravana's ministers, having heard Arjuna's ministers, questioned Ravana why he desired to fight an intoxicated king surrounded by women, comparing it to a tiger attacking an intoxicated elephant amidst female elephants.

raw: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । विवृत्य नयने क्रूरे जानकीमन्ववैक्षत ॥५-२०-२३॥
तेषामपि च सङ्क्रुद्धश्चकार कदनं महत् टिभिर्वज्रकल्पैश्च तलैरशनिसन्निभैः । स ददर्श कपिश्रेष्ठमचलोपममिन्द्रजित् । सूदयन्तमभित्रघ्नममित्रान् पवनात्मजम् ॥६-८६-२४॥
स राजमार्गं वपुषा प्रकाशयन् सहस्ररश्मिर्धरणीमिवांशुभिः । जगाम तत्राञ्जलिमालया वृतः शतक्रतुर्गेहमिव स्वयम्भुवः ॥६-६०-९६॥
translation: Kumbhakarna went like the thousand rayed Sun illuminating the earth by his splendour brightening the royal path, greeted by a circle of Rakshasas joining palms like Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices went to the abode of selfborn Brahma.

raw: गम्यताम् इति तान् आह यथा इष्टम् रघुनन्दनः । मानसाः कार्य कालेषु साहाय्यम् मे करिष्यथ ॥१-२८-१४॥
ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥६-९६-२९॥
translation: Then Ravana surrounded by many Rakshasas set out swiftly rending the earth with all his might and majesty.

raw: यच्च फल्गु बलं किञ्चित्त दत्रैवोपपद्यताम् । एतद्धि कृत्यं घोरं नो विक्रमेण प्रयुज्यताम् ॥६-४-१३॥
translation: "If there are any weak ones in the army, they may be used here for this purpose (of looking for fruits etc.). Our task (ahead) is a terrific one and be prepared to overcome your power".

raw: यामिच्छसि महातेजस्तां तनुं प्रविश स्वयम् ॥७-११०-११॥
translation: O greatly effulgent one, enter that form which you yourself desire.

raw: चतुर्ष्वपि समुद्रेषु सन्ध्यामन्वास्य वानरः । रावणोद्वहनश्रान्तः किष्किन्धोपवने ऽपतत् ॥७-३४-३३॥
translation: After performing his twilight prayers in all four oceans, the monkey (Bali), exhausted from carrying Ravana, landed in the pleasure grove of Kishkindha.

raw: गंगाम् अन्वगमन् प्रीताः सर्वे जल चराः च ये । यतो भगीरथो राजा ततो गंगा यशस्विनी ॥१-४३-३२॥
जांबूनदम् कोओटि संख्यम् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ तदा । दरिद्राय द्विजाय अथ हस्त आभरणम् उत्तमम् ॥१-१४-५४॥
गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्य आत्मजो द्विजः । अस्वस्थ हृदयः च आसीत् दुःखात् च परिवर्तते ॥१-१०-२३॥
translation: When they all departed, Kasyapa's son, the brahmin roamed (Rsyasringa) with a restless mind charged with sorrow.

raw: अरविन्द उत्पलवतीम् पद्म सौगन्धिक आयुताम् । पुष्पित आम्र वणोपेताम् बर्हिण उद् घुष्ट नादिताम् ॥३-७५-२१॥
ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः । प्रजापतिं समाधावन्दुःखिताश्च सुखेच्छया ॥७-३५-५३॥
translation: Then, all beings including Gandharvas, Devas, Asuras, and humans, distressed and desiring happiness, rushed to Prajapati Brahma.

raw: स सर्वाः च दिशो बाणैः प्रदिशः च महारथः । पूरयामास तम् दृष्ट्वा रामो अपि सुमहत् धनुः ॥३-२८-६॥
translation: When Rama, the great warrior, saw Khara approaching him, he fixed powerful arrows on his bow and covered all directions and intermediate quarters with his arrows.

raw: भ्राता भव यवीयान् त्वम् शक्रस्य असुरसूदन । शोक आर्तानाम् तु देवानाम् साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥१-२९-१७॥
translation: "O Sinless Lord, Be born son to Aditi and to me, O Destroyer of asuras, be the younger brother to Indra. You can help these sorrowstricken devatas.

raw: ततस्त्रेतायुगं नाम मानवानां वपुष्मताम् । क्षत्रियास्तत्र जायन्ते पूर्णेन तपसा ऽन्विताः ॥७-७४-११॥
translation: Thereafter, in the age named Treta Yuga, embodied humans, specifically Kshatriyas, were born endowed with complete penance.

raw: स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत् पार्श्वे तस्य उत्तरे गिरेः । हिमवत् प्रभवे शृंगे सह देव्या महेश्वरः ॥१-३६-२५॥
translation: "Mahesvara along with goddess Uma, went north of the Himavat mountain and performed penance on a peak.

raw: दर्शनम् प्रतिकाङ्क्षन्ते प्रतिबुद्ध्यस्व राघव । स्तुवन्तं तम् तदा सूतं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम् ॥२-१५-२५॥
इमं तु कालं वनिते विजह्रिवांस्त्वया च सीते सह लक्ष्मणेन च । रतिं प्रपत्स्ये कुलधर्मवर्द्धनीं सतां पथि स्वैर्नियमै: परै: स्थित: ॥२-९४-२७॥
translation: O my beloved Sita, by spending time with you and Lakshmana following the path of the virtuous with utmost restraint and by enhancing the righteousness of my race, I shall obtain great felicity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: मान्धातुस्तु सुत श्श्रीमान् सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत । सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धि: प्रसेनजित् ॥१-७०-२६॥
translation: Mandhata's son was prosperous Susandhi who brought forth two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenajit.

raw: स तु दृष्ट्वा यमः प्राप्तं महर्षिं तत्र नारदम् । अब्रवीत्सुखमासीनमर्घ्यमावेद्य धर्मतः ॥७-२१-३॥
translation: Upon seeing the great sage Narada arrive there, Yama, having properly offered him a water offering and seated him comfortably, then spoke.

raw: तांस्तु स प्रतियुध्यन् वै युद्धे राजा प्रवासित: । हिमवन्तमुपागम्य भृगुप्रस्रवणेऽवसत् असितोऽल्पबलो राजा मन्त्रिभिस्सहितस्तदा ॥१-७०-२९॥
translation: The king Asita who was a weakling was defeated in the conflict against the kings and was exiled. Along with his counsellors he lived at on the Bhriguprasravana Himavat mountain.

raw: रामस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मयुक्तं मनोगतम् । शत्रुघ्नो दीनया वाचा बाढमित्येव चाब्रवीत् ॥७-७२-१८॥
translation: Having heard these righteous and heartfelt words of Rama, Shatrughna, with a humble voice, simply replied, "Indeed."

raw: महोदरमहापार्स्वौ राक्षसश्चाप्यकम्पनः । अवीकपास्तु तप्यैते लोकपालसमा युधि ॥६-१८-१४॥
उत्पन्ना मैथिलकुले जनकस्य महात्मनः । सीतोत्पन्ना तु सीतेति मानुषैः पुनरुच्यते ॥७-१७-४३॥
translation: She was born in the family of the great-souled Janaka, the king of Mithila, and because she emerged from the furrow, she is known by humans as Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः ।। 17 ।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: पीत कौशेयकेन असि सूचिता वर वर्णिनि । धावन्ति अपि मया दृष्टा तिष्ठ यदि अस्ति सौहृदम् ॥३-६०-२८॥
translation: O lady of lovely complexion, I can see your yellow silk (flying), while you are running away. If you have love for me, stay on.

raw: अभिवाद्य गुरुं प्राह रावणस्य यदीप्सितम् । एष तात दशग्रीवो दूतं प्रेषितवान्मम ॥७-११-३५॥
translation: Having saluted his father, Kubera informed him of Ravana's demand, saying, "O father, Dashagriva has sent a messenger to me with his desire."

raw: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्निं निबोधयितुमिच्छसि । न्यस्यचापं निवर्तस्व मा प्राणान् जहि मद्गतः ॥६-७१-५३॥
translation: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."

raw: साधु किम् ते अन्यया बुद्ध्या रोचयस्व वचो मम । भजस्व मा अभितप्तस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-५५-१८॥
translation: Do not think otherwise. Be good and accept my request. I am consumed by thoughts of you. You should be gracious to me.

raw: अग्रतो गुरवस्तत्र वसिष्ठप्रमुखा द्विजा: । प्रययु: प्राङ्मुखा: सर्वे नन्दिग्रामो यतो ऽभवत् ॥२-११५-१०॥
translation: Preceded by preceptors, like Vasistha and other brahmins, all of them proceeded eastward in the direction of Nandigrama.

raw: गोपुराट्टप्रतोलीषु चर्यासु विविधासु च । प्रासादेषु च संहृष्टाः ससृजुस्ते हुताशनम् । तेषां गृहसस्राणि ददाह हुतभुक् तदा ॥६-७५-६॥
translation: Rejoiced Vanaras set fire to the towering gates, attics, different streets as well as mansions to send away Rakshasas.

raw: भजस्व सीते माम् एव भर्ता अहम् सदृशः तव । यौवनम् हि अध्रुवम् भीरु रमस्व इह मया सह ॥३-५५-२२॥
translation: O Sita take refuge only in me. I am a befitting husband to you. O timid one youth is impermanent. Enjoy (your life) with me while it lasts.

raw: सीते मृतस्ते श्वशुर: पित्रा हीनो ऽसि लक्ष्मण । भरतो दु:खमाचष्टे स्वर्गतं पृथिवीपतिम् ॥२-१०२-१५॥
translation: O Sita, your fatherinlaw is dead. O Lakshmana, you are deprived of your father. Bharata is relating to me the sad news that king Dasaratha has attained his heavenly abode.

raw: तेन च इमम् महाप्राज्ञम् अभिषिन्च विभीषणम् । राजानम् रक्षसाम् क्षिप्रम् प्रसन्ने मयि मानद ॥६-१८-२५॥
द्रक्ष्यामि नगरीम् लङ्काम् साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् । इत्यर्थमिह सम्प्राप्तः परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे ॥५-३-३३॥
translation: "I would like to see this Lanka with marketplaces, gateways and ramparts. I have come here for that purpose. My curiosity has been roused to see this place.

raw: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु रामश्चेक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्षभः ॥७-५६-३॥
translation: Rama, the greatly effulgent best among men and descendant of Ikshvaku, thus replied to Lakshmana who had spoken to him.

raw: स्पृष्टमात्रस्ततः सो ऽथ सलीलं पद्मयोनिना । जलसिक्तं यथा सस्यं पुनर्जीवितमाप्तवान् ॥७-३६-४॥
translation: As soon as the child was playfully touched by Brahma, he regained life, just like a plant revived by water.

raw: ते तु सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः । कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे रणायाभिमुखा ययुः ॥६-९६-७॥
translation: All the Rakshasas with frightful looks saying 'Be it so', having prepared themselves with armor went towards the battlefield.

raw: नित्य मत्त विहम्गानि भ्रमर आचरितानि च । कोकिल आकुल षण्डानि विहग अभिरुतानि च ॥६-३९-१०॥
translation: There after the rejoiced heroic Vanaras who can change their form at will happily entered the woods and gardens inhabited by birds in heat full of emotion, trees covered with cuckoos, and wandering bees, rendered noisy by birds, resounded with the singing of large black bees and bees going around clinging to trees, mingled with sounds of various birds and noise of cries of cranes.

raw: तौ लोहितस्य प्रिय दर्शनस्यसदा उचितौ उत्तम चंदनस्य । वृत्तौ स्तनौ शोणित पंक दिग्धौनूनम् प्रियाया मम न अभिभात ॥३-६३-८॥
translation: Her captivating copper coloured skin, smeared with the best of red sandal paste would not be surely pleasing now, drenched in blood and mud.

raw: यथाज्ञप्तं महाबाहो त्वया गुल्मनिवेशनम् । तत्तथा ऽनुष्ठितं वीर त्वद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् ॥६-८५-५॥
translation: " After your command the army has been divided and placed at respective places as you said."

raw: ततस्तं निर्जितं मत्वा घोषयामास वै शुकः । रावणो जयतीत्युच्चैर्हर्षान्नादं विमुक्तवान् ॥७-१८-२०॥
translation: Then, Shuka, considering Marutta defeated, loudly proclaimed with joy, "Ravana is victorious!"

raw: वनम् सुविचितम् सर्वम् पद्मिन्यः फुल्ल पंकजाः । गिरिः च अयम् महाप्राज्ञ बहु कन्दर निर्झरः । न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम् ॥३-६१-२६॥
translation: O wise Lakshmana I have searched the entire forest, the ponds with fully blossomed lotuses, the mountains with many caves and streams. But could not see Vaidehi who is dearer to me than my life.

raw: गत्वा ऽथ रक्षोधिपतेः शशंसुः सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम् । तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य रक्षोधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम ॥६-५९-२॥
translation: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.

raw: विद्रुमेण विचित्रेण मणिभिश्च महाधनैः । विस्तुलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिस्तलेनाभिविराजितम् ॥५-९-१७॥
translation: It was shining bright with colourful corals, precious gems and peerless pearls fixed on its floor.

raw: एवमुक्त्वा तु सौमित्रिं जातहर्षो विभीषणः । धनुष्पाणिनमादाय त्वरमाणो जगाम ह ॥६-८७-१॥
translation: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Saumithri was satisfied. Wielding a bow Saumithri went quickly with Vibheeshana.

raw: तर्पयस्व महाबाहो गोसहसरैश्च मानद । सुवर्णै रजतैश्चैव मणिभिश्च महाधनैः ॥२-३२-१४॥
translation: Satisfy them, O highlyarmed Lakshmana, O bestower of honour with a thousand cows, gold, silver and with the great wealth of gems.

raw: स मया आहार संरोधात् पीडितः प्रीति वर्धनः । अनुमान्य यथा तत्त्वम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५९-११॥
translation: 'I was thinking, tormented with hunger, my son who always keeps me happy told me exactly what had happened:

raw: सो ऽहं भगवतः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य निश्चयम् । आहारं गर्हितं स्वशरीरं द्विजोत्तम ॥७-७८-२१॥
translation: O best of brahmins, having heard the resolve of the venerable god of gods (Shiva), I consider my own body as condemned food.

raw: निवार्यमाणः सुहृदा मया भृशम्प्रसह्य सीताम् यदि धर्षयिष्यसि । गमिष्यसि क्षीण बलः स बान्धवोयम क्षयम् राम शर आत्त जीवितः ॥३-३८-३३॥
translation: If you violate Sita forcibly notwithstanding my friendly warning, your life will be drained by the arrows of Rama and you will reach the abode of Yama with your kith and kin, your strength depleted. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: अथ ते मन्त्रिणस्तस्य विक्रोशन्तमथाब्रुवन् । तोषयस्व महादेवं नीलकण्ठमुमापतिम् ॥७-१६-३२॥
translation: Then his ministers said to him, who was crying out, "Please propitiate Mahadeva, the blue-throated one, the husband of Uma."

raw: विभीषणस्य तु वचस्तछ्रुत्वा रघुसत्तमः । अन्वीक्ष्य मनसा सर्वमिदम् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-१८-१७॥
ताम् तु शूर्पणखाम् रामः काम पाश अवपाशिताम् । स्वच्छया श्लक्ष्णया वाचा स्मित पूर्वम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥३-१८-१॥
translation: To Surpanakha bound by the noose of passion Rama with a smile replied in a clear, lucid manner:

raw: राघव आस्वासनम् चैव मणि निर्यातनम् तथा । संगमम् च समुद्रेण नल सेतोः च बन्धनम् ॥१-३-३४॥
तस्य तीक्ष्ण नखाभ्याम् तु चरणाभ्याम् महाबलः । चकार बहुधा गात्रे व्रणान् पतग सत्तमः ॥३-५१-६॥
translation: The mighty, virtuous vulture with his sharp claws wounded many parts of the body of Ravana.

raw: भगवन्कृतकृत्यो ऽहं यन्मे लोकगुरुः स्वयम् । प्रीतेन यदि दातव्यो वरो मे शृणु सुव्रत ॥७-१०-३०॥
translation: O Lord of good vows, I am fulfilled because the preceptor of the world himself is pleased with me; if a boon is to be granted to me, please listen.

raw: वाक्यम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु न चित्रम् स्त्रीषु मैथिलि । स्वभावः तु एष नारीणाम् एषु लोकेषु दृश्यते ॥३-४५-२९॥
translation: O princess from Mithila, I do not want to use such harsh words. To me you are a deity (worthy of adoration). It is not surprising that women of the world use such undeserving words. It is their nature.

raw: रामो अभ्येति पुरीम् लंकाम् अस्माकम् उपरोधकः । तरिष्यति च सुव्यक्तम् राघवः सागरम् सुखम् ॥६-६-१७॥
महेन्द्र हिमवत् विंध्य कैलास शिखरेषु च । मन्दरे पाण्डु शिखरे पंच शैलेषु ये स्थिताः ॥४-३७-२॥
translation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

raw: सगरस्य च पुत्राणाम् प्रादुर् आसीत् महास्वनः । पृथिव्याम् भिद्यमानायाम् निर्घात सम निःवनः ॥१-४०-६॥
translation: A sound like the resembling of thunder emanated while the earth was being riven by the noble sons of Sagara.

raw: इदं राज्यं महाप्राज्ञ स्थापय प्रतिपद्य हि । शक्तिमानसि काकुत्स्थ लोकस्य परिपालने ॥२-११२-१३॥
translation: O sagacious Rama, accept this kingdom and ensure its stability. You are powerful enough to govern this world. So accept this kingdom and restore its stability.

raw: अतिमानिनम् अग्राह्यम् आत्म संभावितम् नरम् । क्रोधिनम् व्यसने हन्ति स्व जनो अपि नराधिपम् ॥३-३३-१६॥
translation: A king who is extremely arrogant, who is not acceptable to good people, who is selfconceited and cholerictempered will be murdered even by his own people at the time of adversity.

raw: ततः पर्वत शृंगाणि वनानि विविधानि च । पश्यन्सहमयाकामीदण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि - यद्वा - पश्यन् सह मया कामी दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि ॥३-१७-२८॥
translation: O darling, thereafter you can keep wandering with me in this Dandaka forest, enjoying the beauty of the mountain tops and forests.

raw: जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान् । तत्तथा हनुमन् वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि ॥५-३९-१०॥
translation: "Let the illustrious Rama take me alive. Help me with your (persuasive) words and you will acquire merit.

raw: जांबूनदमयैः द्वारैः चित्रैः कांचन वेदिकैः । प्रासादैः हेम वर्णैः च महद्भिः सुसमाकृता ॥४-५८-२१॥
translation: 'The city has golden gates, golden platforms, huge, goldencoloured, uniformly built mansions surrounded by a tall boundary wall of the colour of sunlight.

raw: तन्त्रीस्वनाह् कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः । स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः । नक्तम्चराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता । विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः ॥५-५-९॥
translation: Pleasing sounds of string instruments had begun to be heard. Chaste women were found asleep with their husbands.The nightrangers had begun their strange (evil and cruel) deeds exhibiting their anger.

raw: यथा त्वयि अंगदो नित्यम् वर्तते वानरेश्वरः । तथा वर्तते सुग्रीवो मयि च अपि न संशयः ॥४-१८-६४॥
