translation: 'O lord of monkeys Angada will remain with Sugriva and with me as he used to live with you. Rest assured.'

raw: त्रिशिरा रथमास्थाय विरराज धनुर्धरः । सविद्युदुल्कः शैलाग्रे सेन्द्रचाप इवाम्बुदः ॥६-६९-२३॥
translation: Wielding a bow and sitting like a leader in the chariot Trisira shone as if attended by lightning, meteors, light, and rainbows.

raw: आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः । स प्राञ्जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके ॥२-३-३२॥
सहसा पिदधुः दृष्टिम् हृष्टा गमन कान्क्षिणः । वानराः तु महात्मानो हस्त रुद्ध मुखाः तदा ॥४-५२-२९॥
यत् इन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षम् न तत् चित्रम् भविष्यति । आदित्यो असौ सहस्रांशुः कुर्यात् वितिमिरम् नभः ॥४-३९-२॥
translation: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.

raw: कच्चिदग्निषु ते युक्तो विधिज्ञो मतिमानृजु: । हुतं च होष्यमाणं च काले वेदयते सदा ॥२-१००-१३॥
translation: I trust, the sagacious priest who knows ritual precepts, who is upright and is employed to take care of your sacred fires, informs you always regarding what was offered and what is to be offered as oblation at appropriate time.

raw: कर्मणा सूचयात्मानं न विकत्थितुमर्हसि । पौरुषेण तु यो युक्तः स तु शूर इति स्मृतः ॥६-७१-५९॥
translation: "Reveal yourself by action not by indication. You do not deserve it. He who is with prowess is a right hero."

raw: वयम् आश्वयुजे मासि काल संख्या व्यवस्थिताः । प्रस्थिताः सो अपि च अतीतः किम् अतः कार्यम् उत्तरम् ॥४-५३-९॥
जीवेत् चिरम् वज्र धरस्य हस्तात्शचीम् प्रधृष्य अप्रतिरूप रूपाम् । न मा दृशीम् राक्षस धर्षयित्वापीत अमृतस्य अपि तव अस्ति मोक्षः ॥३-४८-२४॥
translation: O demon, you may live long after forcibly snatching the most beautiful Sachi, from the hands of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, but after abusing a woman like me, you will not be released from death even if you drink nectar. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyeighty sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्षणम् । विसर्जयामास तदा तारा अद्याः च एव योषितः ॥४-३८-६॥
translation: Sugriva spoke to Lakshmana endowed with auspicious signs, and thereupon permitted Tara and other women to leave the place.

raw: विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः । तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम ॥२-४-२५॥
translation: While Bharata is away from the city, the time is favourable for your installation. This is my opinion.

raw: स वानरसहस्त्रैरजितः पर्वतोपमैः । रराजराक्षसव्याघ्रोगिरिरात्मरुहैरिव ॥६-६७-३४॥
translation: The tiger among Rakshasas covered with thousands of Rakshasas was resembling a mountain with trees grown on itself.

raw: स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः । अद्य तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम् ॥७-७४-२८॥
translation: That very great ascetic, O King, is indeed performing penance today at the border of your kingdom, and it is by this foolish act that this child's death has occurred.

raw: ततो यूथ पतिः वीरो दुर्मुखो नाम वानरः । प्रत्यदृश्यत कोटिभ्याम् द्वाभ्याम् परिवृतो बली ॥४-३९-३४॥
translation: Thereafter the mighty hero, leader of the troop, by name Durmukha appeared with two crore vanaras.

raw: वानराश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धाः प्राकारस्थान् महीगताः । राक्षसान् पातयामासुः समाप्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-४२-४६॥
translation: The vanaras jumping up dragged the Rakshasas stationed on the boundary wall down to the ground.

raw: आम्रम् चित्वा कुठारेन निम्बम् परिचरेत्तु यः । यश्चेनम् पयसा सिञ्चेन्नैवास्य मधुरो भवेत् ॥२-३५-१६॥
translation: By axing a mango tree and growing a nimba in its place and sprinkling it with milk one does not get sweet fruit.

raw: धर्मे रता: सत्पुरुषै: समेतास्तेजस्विनो दानगुणप्रधाना: । अहिंसका वीतमलाश्च लोके भवन्ति पूज्या मुनय: प्रधाना: ॥२-१०९-३६॥
translation: Those supreme ascetics who are radiant, devoted to righteousness and associated with men of virtue, with charity as their chief virtue, eschewing violence and purged of their impurities are truly worthy of reverence in this world.

raw: स यथैवागतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः । निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौ तद्वनं प्रविवेश ह ॥५-६४-३॥
translation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).

raw: ततो दधिमुखः श्रीमान् कोटिभिः दशभिः वृतः । संप्राप्तो अभिनदन् तस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ॥४-३९-३७॥
translation: Then the illustrious Dadhimukha, great Sugriva's favourite leader reached with ten crore vanaras.

raw: असर्पत जलम् तत्र तीव्र शब्द पुरस्कृतम् । मत्स्य कच्छप संघैः च शिशुमार गणैः तथा ॥१-४३-१६॥
तच्चैवामलचन्ध्रभम् मुखमायतलोचनम् । पर्यशुष्यत बाष्पेण जलोद्धृतमिवामुबुजम् ॥२-३०-२५॥
translation: Her face with large eyes assumed the brightness of an immaculate Moon and withered with tears like a lotus plucked out of water.

raw: मम भुज बल वेग वेगितःपततु शरोऽस्य महान् महोरसि । व्यपनयतु तनोः च जीवितम्पततु ततः च महीम् विघूर्णितः ॥३-२-२६॥
translation: Spurred by the speed of my strong arms, my arrow will fall on his broad chest and separate his life from his body. Then his body reeling round and round will fall on the ground. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: यत्ता भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु नेतो गन्तव्यमग्रत: । अहमेव गमिष्यामि सुमन्त्रो गुरुरेव च ॥२-९३-२५॥
translation: All of you carefully watch here. Do not proceed any further. Sumantra, the preceptor and myself shall go forward.

raw: लोका हि यावत्स्थास्यन्ति तावत्स्थास्यति मे कथा ॥७-४०-२१॥
translation: Indeed, as long as the worlds exist, so long will my story endure.

raw: ततो मरुत्तो नृपतिः को भवानित्युवाच तम् । अपहासं ततो मुक्त्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥७-१८-८॥
translation: Then King Marutta asked him, "Who are you?", whereupon Ravana, letting out a scornful laugh, spoke these words.

raw: न लक्ष्मण अस्मिन् मम राज्य विघ्ने । माता यवीयस्य् अतिशन्कनीया । दैव अभिपन्ना हि वदन्ति अनिष्टम् । जानासि दैवम् च तथा प्रभावम् ॥२-२२-३०॥
translation: O Lakshmana our younger mother (Kaikeyi) cannot be blamed for her obstruction to my coronation. Overpowered by destiny, she is speaking such unpleasant words. This you know is the impact of destiny. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: रामो हि भरताद्भूयस्तव शुश्रूष्ते सदा । विशेषम् त्वयि तस्मात्तु भरतस्य न लक्षये ॥२-१२-२५॥
translation: Rama is doing greater service to you than Bharata. Therefore, I do not find any reason for you to have a special love for Bharata.

raw: एष मे राम शोकान्तः शोक आर्तेन निवेदितः । दुःखितः सुखितः वा अपि सख्युः नित्यम् सखा गतिः ॥४-८-४०॥
translation: 'This what I had to tell you out of sorrow. This is how my sorrow will end. In joy and in sorrow your friend is your refuge.

raw: स मुहूर्तं गते तस्मिन् देवलोकम् मुनिः तदा । जगाम तमसा तीरम् जाह्नव्यात् अविदूरतः ॥१-२-३॥
translation: After Narada had gone to devaloka, sage Valmiki reached the bank of river Tamasa which is not very far from the Ganges for morning ablutions.

raw: तेन मार्गेण गच्छन्तो निरीक्षन्तो नराधिपम् । येन मार्गम् च भूमिम् च निरीक्षन्ते स्म ते मृगाः ॥३-६४-१९॥
यानि देवेषु च अस्त्राणि दानवेषु महर्षिषु । गंधर्व यक्ष रक्षस्सु प्रतिभांतु मम अनघ ॥१-५५-१७॥
translation: O Irreproachable one whatever weapons are known to devatas, danavas, maharshis, gandharvas, yakshas, rakshasas, be revealed to me.

raw: अष्टौ वर्ष सहस्राणि तेन अस्मिन् ऋषिणा गिरौ । वसतो मम धर्मज्ञो स्वर् गते तु निशाकरे ॥४-६०-९॥
translation: 'O righteous monkeys after the death of sage Nishakara eight thousand years have passed. And I have been living here.

raw: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः । भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ॥५-३९-३१॥
translation: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."

raw: अप्राप्तमन्तरारामःसप्तभिस्तमजिह्मगैः । चिच्छेदगिरिशृङ्गंतंपुनःसन्धायकार्मुकम् ॥६-६७-१२५॥
translation: Rama once again taking the bow, split the peak of the mountain with seven unfailing arrows on its way even before it reached the target.

raw: यथेष्टं भुङ्क्ष्व लोकांस्त्रीन्निगृह्यारातिमोजसा । वृथा किं ते श्रमेणेह युद्धमद्य तु निष्फलम् ॥७-२९-३७॥
translation: Enjoy the three worlds to your heart's content, having subdued the enemy with your might; why exert yourself in vain here, for today's battle is indeed fruitless.

raw: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वरितं यान्तं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् । वानरा दुद्रुवुः सर्वे मन्यमानास्तु रावणिम् * ॥६-४९-३३॥
translation: Seeing Vibheeshana resembling a dark mountain, thinking him to be Indrajith, all the Vanaras ran from there. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: हनुमज्जनकश्चापि पुच्छानलयुतो ऽनिलः । ववौ स्वास्थ्यकरो देव्याः प्रालेयानिलशीतलः ॥५-५३-३३॥
translation: "The Windgod accompanying Hanuman's firelit tail also blew cool like the wind from snow, to calm the mind of the divine lady.

raw: राक्षसी वशमापन्ना भर्त्यमाना सुदारुणम् । चिन्तयन्ती सुदुःखार्ता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥५-२४-४॥
कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च । सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया ॥६-१२२-२५॥
समुद्रपारगमने हरीणाम् किमिहोत्तरम् । इत्युक्त्वा शोकसम्भ्रान्तो रामह् शत्रुनिबर्हणः ॥६-१-१९॥
एवम् उक्तो महातेजाः शमम् चक्रे महातपाः । विश्वामित्रो अपि निकृतो विनिःश्वस्य इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५६-२२॥
translation: At this, Vasishta the most brilliant ascetic became quiet. The humiliated Viswamitra heaved a sigh and spoke these words:

raw: निर्गतं मकाराक्षं ते दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः । आप्लुत्य सहसा सर्वे योद्धुकामा व्यवस्थिताः ॥६-७९-१॥
translation: On seeing Maka raksha all the Vanara chiefs returned, jumped, and stood ready enthusiastically to fight.

raw: विभीषणहनूमद्भयां कृतं कर्म महद्रणे । अहोरात्रैस्त्रिभिर्वीरः कथञ्चिद्विनिपातितः ॥६-९२-१५॥
कुशली यदि काकुत्स्थः किन्नु सागरमेखलाम् । महीं दहति कोपेन युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः ॥५-३६-१३॥
translation: "Indeed if Kakutstha is well wherefore does he not burn the oceangirdled earth in his rage as (the earth is burnt) at the time of dissolution of the era?

raw: परिखाः पूरयन्ति स्म प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः । पांसुभिः पर्वताग्रैश्च तृणैः काष्ठैश्च वानराः ॥६-४२-१६॥
translation: The Vanaras started filling the moats with soil, pure water, logs of wood, grass, and mountain peaks.

raw: स धनुर् धन्विनाम् श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य परम आहवे । मुमोच परम इष्वासः षट् शरान् अभिलक्षितान् ॥३-२८-२६॥
translation: The best among archers and a supreme shooter, he lifted the bow, fixed his target and released six arrows in the great fight.

raw: कालिकाः पाण्डुरैर् दन्तैः प्रहसन्त्य् अग्रतः स्थिताः । स्त्रियः स्वप्नेषु मुष्णन्त्यो गृहाणि प्रतिभाष्य च ॥६-३५-२९॥
translation: "Women of dark colour like coal with yellow teeth are speaking unpleasant things standing before us in dreams laughing heartily."

raw: कुशलं चाहु सिद्धार्थो हतशत्रुररिन्दमः ॥६-११६-७॥
ताम् सत्य नामाम् दृढ तोरण अर्गलाम्गृहैः विचित्रैः उपशोभिताम् शिवाम् । पुरीम् अयोध्याम् नृ सहस्र संकुलाम्शशास वै शक्र समो महीपतिः ॥१-६-२८॥
translation: The king who equalled Indra (in splendour) ruled the invincible city of Ayodhya true to its name with its strong gates and solid locks. It was adorned with wonderful edifices teeming with thousands of men. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: कस्मै चित् याचमानाय ददौ राघव नंदनः । ततः प्रीतेषु विधिवत् द्विजेषु द्विज वत्सलः ॥१-१४-५५॥
सा विक्षरंती रुधिरम् बहुधा घोर दर्शना । प्रगृह्य बाहू गर्जन्ती प्रविवेश महावनम् ॥३-१८-२४॥
translation: Dripping blood profusely, the frightful demoness lifted her arms and entered the great forestroaring.

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो लक्ष्मणस्तं विभीषणम् । प्राणसंशयमापन्नं तूर्णमभ्यवपद्यत ॥६-१०१-२४॥
translation: In the meantime, seeing Vibheeshana's life in danger, heroic Lakshmana reached him and stood obstructing (the javelin).

raw: समाप्त वन वासानाम् राज्य स्थानाम् च नः पुनः । अंतःपुरे विभूषार्थो मृग एष भविष्यति ॥३-४३-१७॥
translation: After the completion of exile in the forest, when we are back in the kingdom, this deer will add beauty to the harem.

raw: ततो हृष्टो भरद्वाजो भरतं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । अपि कृत्यं कृतं तात रामेण च समागतम् ॥२-११३-७॥
translation: Then Bhardwaja asked Bharata in delight, My son, have you accomplished your task? Did you meet Rama?

raw: तान् न हिंस्यात् न च आक्रोशेन् न आक्षिपेन् न अप्रियम् वदेत् । देवा मानुष रूपेण चरन्ति एते मही तले ॥४-१८-४२॥
translation: 'One should not insult kings, nor shout at them, nor disregard them nor speak unpleasant words to them. They are gods in human form moving on this earth.

raw: अहं सखा ते काकुत्स्थ प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः । गरुत्मानिह सम्प्राप्तो युवाभ्यां साह्यकारणात् ॥६-५०-४६॥
translation: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."

raw: अतिकायो ऽपि तेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा । आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ॥६-६९-२५॥
translation: Then Atikaya the very bright son of Rakshasa king, foremost of all archers mounted on the best of chariots.

raw: बलमारोग्यमायुश्च रामस्य विदितात्मनः । देवासुरमनुष्येषु सगन्धर्वोरगेषु च ॥२-२-५०॥
translation: Gandharvas, uragas, devas, asuras, the inhabitants of towns and villages, all men living in neighbouring or distant regions are wish the illustrious Rama strength, health and long life.

raw: तत: पर्णकुटीद्वारमासाद्य जगतीपति: । परिजग्राह बाहुभ्यामुभौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ ॥२-१०२-३२॥
translation: Rama, lord of the earth, reached the door of the leafhut and took Bharata and Lakshmana in his arms.

raw: यथा सर्वम् सुविहितम् न किंचित् परिहीयते । तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु प्रीति युक्तेन चेतसा ॥१-१३-१७॥
translation: Every thing should be wellmanaged. In whatever manner you do, not even the smallest things be left out. Carry out the work with love and affection in your hearts".

raw: ताम्स्तु ते सम्प्रक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान् । राघव अर्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम् ॥६-२७-१॥
translation: "I will describe the Vanara force, who are not caring for their lives for the cause of Raghava. You may see."

raw: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि बहुवर्षशतानि च । श्वभ्रे ऽस्मिन् कृकलासो वै दीर्घकालं वसिष्यसि ॥७-५३-१९॥
translation: For many thousands and hundreds of years, you will indeed reside in this pit as a chameleon for a long duration.

raw: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ दशग्रीव मुहूर्तम् पश्य रावण । वृन्तात् इव फलम् त्वाम् तु पातयेयम् रथ उत्तमात् । युद्ध आतिथ्यम् प्रदास्यामि यथा प्राणम् निशा चर ॥३-५०-२८॥
किम् एतन् मेघ संकाशम् पर्वतस्य अविदूरतः । वृक्ष खण्डम् इतः भाति परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे ॥१-२८-१७॥
translation: "From this side of the mountain, not faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.

raw: अद्य कर्म करिष्यामि यल्लोकाः सचराचराः । सदेवाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति । समागम्य सदा लोके यथा युद्धं प्रवर्तितम् ॥६-१०१-५७॥
सर्वान् समभिधावन्तंयथारुष्टंदिशागजम् । मार्गमाणंहरीन्कक्रुद्धंराक्षसैःपरिवारितम् ॥६-६७-१४०॥
translation: Surrounded by Rakshasas, he was searching for Vanaras, like an elephant, guarding a quarter, searches.

raw: अचिताम् चित्र पत्तीभिः सुनिविष्टाम् समंततः । विमानम् इव सिद्धानाम् जाल वात आयान आयुताम् ॥४-२५-२३॥
translation: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

raw: स्वर्गे अपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव । त्वया मम नर व्याघ्र न अहम् तम् अपि रोचये ॥२-२७-२०॥
translation: O Raghava, tiger among men, if I were given heaven to live in without you, even that I shall not covet.

raw: परस्वानां च हरणं परदाराभिमर्शनम् । सुहृदामतिशङ्का च त्रयो दोषाः क्षयाबहाः ॥६-८७-२४॥
translation: "Stealing the wealth of others, possessing others wife, distrusting friends, these three faults will destroy a person."

raw: वानरैस्तैर्महावीर्यैर्घोररूपा निशाचराः । वीर्यादभिहता वृक्षैर्व्यवेष्टन्त रणाजिरे ॥६-८२-१६॥
translation: Night rangers of dreadful appearance beaten up with trees by most fierce Vanaras, fell on the battlefield and struck one another.

raw: अलम् चकार ताम् वेदीम् गन्ध पुष्पैः समंततः । सुवर्ण पालिकाभिः च चित्र कुम्भैः च स अंकुरैः ॥१-७३-२१॥
translation: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.

raw: स्वप्ने अपि सागरम् शुष्कम् चन्द्रम् च पतितम् भुवि । सहसा च अपि सम्शन्तम् ज्वलितम् जात वेदसम् ॥२-६९-११॥
translation: In that dream I beheld the sea being dried up and the Moon fallen onto the ground. I saw the earth as though enveloped by darkness and obscured, the tusk of an elephant worthy of a ride by the monarch broken into pieces, a blazing fire extinguished suddenly, the earth split open, various trees dried up and mountains crumbled and covered with smoke.

raw: न ते अम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कथंचन । ताम् एव इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य भरतस्य कथाम् कुरु ॥३-१६-३७॥
translation: O dear, Kaikeyi, our second mother, is never to be criticised like that. You may, however, speak more of Bharata, the lord of the Iksvakus.

raw: ततः तत् दारुणम् कर्म दुष्करम् साहसात् कृतम् । आचचक्षे मुनेः सर्वम् सूर्य अनुगमनम् तथा ॥४-६१-१॥
translation: 'Then I revealed everything to the sage,including the arrogant, impetuous action of rashly following the Sun (for challenging Indra).

raw: संवर्तस्य तु राजर्षेः शिष्यः पुरपुरञ्जयः । मरुत्त इति विख्यातस्तं यज्ञं समुपाहरत् ॥७-९०-१४॥
translation: The renowned Marutta, a disciple of the royal sage Samvarta and a conqueror of cities, then performed that sacrifice.

raw: ताम् हि वज्रसमाम् वाचमाकर्ण्य हृदया प्रियाम् । दुःखशोकमयीम् घोराम् राजा न सुखितोऽभवत् ॥२-१२-५३॥
translation: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.

raw: रक्षिणः च अत्र विहिता नूनम् रक्षन्ति पादपान् । भगवान् अपि सर्व आत्मा न अतिक्षोभम् प्रवायति ॥५-१३-६३॥
translation: "The guards posted there are surely protecting the grove. The divinity pervading all over me (the wind) must also have been controlled as it is also not blowing violently. I have turned my body small for Rama's cause and also to save myself from Ravana.

raw: प्रविष्टः शत्रु सैन्यम् हि प्राप्तः शत्रुरतर्कितः । निहन्यादन्न्तरम् लब्ध्वा उलूको वायसानिव ॥६-१७-१९॥
अभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम् । शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन् ॥२-१९-३१॥
translation: Rama circumambulated the vessels meant for the consecration ceremony and steadily glancing at them with attention slowly moved away.

raw: राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्षं ववर्ष ह । अश्मवर्षं यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्घेषु कानने ॥६-९७-११॥
translation: Just as clouds shower hail stones on flocks of birds in the forest, Sugriva rained showers of rocks on the Rakshasas.

raw: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च । ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ॥५-४०-२४॥
translation: "Foremost vanara tell Rama about my intense grief as well as the threats of the demons. May your journey be happy.

raw: विंध्य पर्वतम् आसाद्य निरीक्षेते परस्परम् । तयोर् मध्ये संभवत् यज्ञः स पुरुषोत्तम ॥१-३९-५॥
स च ताभिः परिवृतश्शुशुभे राक्षसाधिपः । यथा ह्युडुपतिश्शीमांस्ताराभिरभिसंवृतः ॥५-९-४२॥
translation: The lord of demons surrounded by women shone like the beautiful Moon encircled by stars.

raw: तम् उवाच किम् अर्थम् त्वम् आगतो अपास्य मैथिलीम् । यदा सा तव विश्वासात् वने विहरिता मया ॥३-५९-२॥
translation: Why did you come, leaving the princess from Mithila alone in the forest when I had left her under your trust ?

raw: तम् काम वृत्तम् मम सन्निकृष्टम्काम अभियोगात् च विमुक्त लज्जम् । क्षमस्व तावत् पर वीर हन्तःतव भ्रातर्म वानर वंश नाथम् ॥४-३३-५६॥
translation: 'O slayer of enemy heroes pardon Sugriva, the lord of vanara clan, who is to you a brother. He is here indulging in sports of love with me. He has no sense of shame about his passion.

raw: दिव्या पुण्य उदका रम्या हिमवंतम् उपाश्रिता । लोकस्य हितकार्य अर्थम् प्रवृत्ता भगिनी मम ॥१-३४-९॥
translation: Conferring the benefit of the other world and worldly pleasures on men my sister Kausiki who is divine and beautiful having sacred waters took resort in Himavat mountain and started flowing from there.

raw: ददर्श हनुमान् देवीम् लतामकुसुमामिव । सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गीवपुषा चाप्यलंकृता ॥५-१७-२५॥
स तस्य शीर्षाण्यसिना शितेन किरीटजुष्टानि सकुण्डलानि । क्रुद्धः प्रचिच्छेद सुतो ऽनिलस्य त्वष्टुः सुतस्येव शिरांसि शक्रः ॥६-७०-४७॥
translation: Enraged wind god's son, cut off the three heads of Trisira adorned with earrings just as Indra cut off the heads of Vishwarupa, son of Twashta.

raw: जातरूपमयैश्चैव तपनीयविभूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः । आत्मजानाम् च रत्नानाम् भूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः ॥६-२२-२०॥
translation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

raw: जाबालेस्तु वच: श्रुत्वा राम: सत्यात्मनां वर: । उवाच परया भक्त्या स्वबुद्ध्या चाविपन्नया ॥२-१०९-१॥
translation: Hearing Jabali's words, Rama, the foremost among the truthful, gave a rejoinder, exercising his own judgment and firm conviction with due respect (to Jabali).

raw: क्षत्रबन्धुं सदानार्यं रामः परमादुर्मतिः । भक्तं भ्रातरमद्यैव त्वां द्रक्ष्यति मया हतम् ॥६-८८-२४॥
translation: "Highly stupid Rama will see you, a devoted brother, a true kshatriya ever ignoble, killed by me today."

raw: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रामो दृढपराक्रमः । अन्वीक्ष्य मनसा सर्वमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-१९-१८॥
translation: Rama of mighty prowess having heard everything from Vibheeshana, examining in his mind, spoke.

raw: प्राप्तः अहम् प्रेषितः तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना । राज्ञा वानर मुख्यानाम् हनुमान् नाम वानरः ॥४-३-२१॥
translation: 'I am a monkey called Hanuman. I am here sent by great king Sugriva, the best of monkeys.

raw: तस्मादियं नरवरात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण तदा प्रविष्टा । लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदिता ऽपि शुद्धा ॥७-९६-२४॥
translation: Therefore, O son of the best among men, this Sita of pure nature, whom you, whose mind was defiled by public scandal, abandoned even though she was known to be pure and dearest to you, then entered the divine realm. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। 96 ।। Thus ends the ninety-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: रोष वेग प्रकुपितः श्रुत्वा च आभरण स्वनम् । चकार ज्या स्वनम् वीरो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ॥४-३३-२६॥
translation: On hearing the sounds of ornaments (of females), heroic Lakshmana lost his temper quickly. He pulled his bowstring forcefully in wrath producing frightening sound filling all quarters.

raw: सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम् । हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः ॥५-६१-४॥
translation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

raw: ऋश्यमूकात् स धर्मात्मा किष्किन्धाम् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः । जगाम सह सुग्रीवो वालि विक्रम पालिताम् ॥४-१३-१॥
translation: Lakshmana's righteous elder brother left Rishyamuka with Sugriva for Kishkinda protected by Vali's valour.

raw: उपस्पर्शनकाले तु पान्तु त्वाम् रघुन्ददन । सर्व लोक प्रभुर् ब्रह्मा भूत भर्ता तथा ऋषयः ॥२-२५-२५॥
लाजगन्धोदवर्षैस्तुसिच्यमानश्सनैश्शनैः । राजवीथ्यास्तुशीतत्वात्संज्ञांप्रापमहाबलः ॥६-६७-८४॥
translation: Exceptionally strong Sugriva with parched grain and fragrant water showered on him in the royal path, being cool, regained consciousness.

raw: तत: स्वस्तिकविज्ञेयां पाण्डुकम्बलसंवृताम् । सनन्दिघोषां कल्याणीं गुहो नावमुपाहरत् । तामारुरोह भरत: शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबल: ॥२-८९-१२॥
translation: Then Guha personally brought an auspicious boat known as Swastika covered with white canvas and generating captivating sounds.

raw: एष मे परमः कामो यन्मूलफलभोजिनाम् । अप्येकरात्रं काकुत्स्थ निवसेयं तपोवने ॥७-४२-३४॥
तिरोभावयितुम् बुद्धिम् चक्रे त्रिनयनः तदा । सा तस्मिन् पतिता पुण्या पुण्ये रुद्रस्य मूर्धनि ॥१-४३-७॥
ऊचुः समेताः सहसा धर्मज्ञा धर्म संहितम् । अयम् कुशिक दायादो मुनिः परम कोपनः ॥१-६०-५॥
जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च ऋषभश्च महामतिः । दुर्मुखश्च महातेजास्तथा शतबलिः कपिः ॥६-३८-१२॥
translation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.

raw: श्याम अवदाताः तत्र अन्याः काश्चित् कृष्णा वर अन्गनाः ॥५-११-३३॥
translation: There in the demons abode were women who were fair, some lovely with dark and others with golden complexion.

raw: हतो भर्ता हतो भ्राता यासां च तनया हताः । वधेनाद्य रिपोस्तासां करोम्यस्रप्रमार्जनम् ॥६-९६-१८॥
translation: "Today through the destruction of the enemy I will wipe the tears of the one whose son has been killed, whose brother has been killed."

raw: अबिदुद्राव वेगेन सुग्रीवः कुम्भमाहवे । शैलसानुचरं नागं वेगवानिव केसरी ॥६-७६-६४॥
translation: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

raw: तेवर्थयित्वाकाकुत्स्थंरामेणप्रतिनन्दिताः । अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानंभ्रातृभिःपरिवारितम् ॥६-१३१-३५॥
translation: They were blessing Sri Rama in turn and Rama responded to them very happily. Surrounded by brothers and all followed Rama the great soul.

raw: ततस्ताः सहिताः सर्वा विहताशा निरुद्यमाः । परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः ॥५-५८-८२॥
translation: "Then all of them gave up hope of their efforts and scattered around her, succumbed to sleep.

raw: यदि गन्तुम् कृता बुद्धिर्वनम् मृगगजायुतम् । अहम् त्वानुगमिष्यामि वनमद्रे धनुर्धरः ॥२-३१-३॥
translation: If you have decided to go to the forest where deer and elephants abound, I shall also accompany you by walking before you, holding the bow.

raw: भुवनम् स्वम् गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परंतप । इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान् ॥३-४-२०॥
एकेन उरसि घोरेण नयनेन आशु दर्शिना । महा दंष्ट्र उपपन्नम् तम् लेलिहानम् महा मुखम् ॥३-६९-३०॥
translation: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

raw: श्लोक एवास्त्वयाम् बद्धो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा । मत् च्छन्दात् एव ते ब्रह्मन् प्रवृत्ते अयम् सरस्वती ॥१-२-३१॥
वैनतेयस्य वा शक्तिः मम वा मारुतस्य वा । ऋते सुपर्ण राजानम् मारुतम् वा महाबलम् । न तत् भूतम् प्रपश्यामि यत् माम् प्लुतम् अनुव्रजेत् ॥४-६७-२३॥
translation: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

raw: ताम् एवम् उक्त्वा जननीम् लक्ष्मणम् पुनर् अब्रवीत् । तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-२१-३७॥
न तु सम्कलनम् राज्ञो विना पुत्रेण मन्त्रिणः । सर्वज्ञाः कर्तुम् ईषुस् ते ततः रक्षन्ति भूमिपम् ॥२-६६-१५॥
translation: The counsellors who were acquainted with all such matters (relating to the king's funeral) were unwilling to perform the obsequies in the absence of any of the king's sons. Meanwhile, they kept watch over the deadbody of the king.

raw: पश्य मे निशितान् बाणानरिदर्पनिषूदनान् । ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ॥६-७१-५५॥
translation: "See my sharp shafts capable of reducing enemy's pride like Ishwara's trident, ornamented with polished gold."

raw: न अराजके जन पदे योग क्षेमम् प्रवर्तते । न च अपि अराजके सेना शत्रून् विषहते युधि ॥२-६७-२४॥
translation: In a country without a king, there is no security of possessions and the army cannot withstand the enemy in a battle.

raw: विमुक्तकवचः क्रुद्धः सिक्तः शोणितविस्रवैः । ततः स पुष्पकं त्यक्त्वा पृथिव्यामवतिष्ठत ॥७-२१-३९॥
translation: With his armor loosened, enraged, and drenched in streams of blood, he then abandoned the Pushpaka chariot and stood on the earth.

raw: पद्म पुष्कर संबाधम् गज यूथैः अलंकृतम् । सारसैः हंस कादम्बैः संकुलम् जल जातिभिः ॥३-११-६॥
translation: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

raw: वानराः शुश्रुवुः शब्दमदूरे प्रत्यवस्थिताः । व्यादितास्यस्य नदतस्तहुर्गं संश्रितस्य च ॥६-८१-३५॥
translation: The sound of his roar was heard by the Vanaras waiting for war standing not far from there, which was difficult for Indrajith to access.

raw: मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याः श्वशुरेण मे । वधूकाले यथा बद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते ॥५-६६-४॥
translation: "At the time of marriage, this jewel was presented by my father-in-law. Vaidehi wore it on her forehead and it looked charming.

raw: नीयमाना तु शबला राम राज्ञा महात्मना । दुःखिता चिन्तयामास रुदंती शोक कर्शिता ॥१-५४-२॥
translation: O Rama when she was being taken away by the powerful king the distressed Sabala thus reflected choked with sorrow":

raw: अद्य रामस्य रामत्वं पश्यन्तु मम संयुगे । त्रयो लोकाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवाः सर्षिचारणाः ॥६-१०१-५६॥
कस्त्वम् केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय । कथय स्वेह यत्तत्त्वम् यावत्प्राणा धरन्ति ते ॥५-३-२३॥
translation: "O dweller of the forest, who are you? Why did you come here? Speak the truth about your identity, so long as you hold on to your life.

raw: तप्यन्तम् ऋषिभिः सार्थम् मातुलम् परम आतुरः । विषण्ण वदनो दीनः तृष्णया च श्रमेण च ॥१-६२-३॥
नैर्ऋताधिपते वाक्यं यदुक्तं ते विभीषण । भूयस्तच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् ॥६-८५-३॥
translation: "O Lord of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana! I wish to hear the words spoken by you. You may repeat that which you wanted to convey. I wish to hear."

raw: अस्मिन् काले तु यद्युक्तं तदिदानीं विधीयताम् । गतं तु नानुशोचन्ति गतं तु गतमेव हि ॥६-६३-२५॥
translation: "You may speak of only what is proper to do now. Do not think of the past as it is gone."

raw: ते तु त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः सम्प्राप्य मधुरामथ । शत्रुघ्नाय यथातत्त्वमाचख्युः सर्वमेव तत् ॥७-१०८-२॥
translation: Having reached Mathura in three days and nights, they truthfully narrated all the events to Shatrughna.

raw: त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके । मातुः कुलं पितृकुलं यत्र चैव प्रदीयते । कुलत्रयं सदा कन्या संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति ॥७-९-१०॥
translation: O daughter, you are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; a daughter always keeps three families—her mother's, her father's, and the one to which she is given—in a state of uncertainty.

raw: काननैः कॄत्रिमैः च अपि सर्वतः समलम्कृताम् । ये केचित् पादपाः तत्र पुष्प उपग फल उपगाः ॥५-१४-३५॥
सर्वं च सुखदुःखं ते विदितं मम राघव ॥६-१२७-९॥
translation: "Raghava, while you were sojourning at Janasthana, you experienced joy and sorrow abundantly all that is known to me."

raw: न च सर्पन्ति सत्त्वानि व्याला न प्रसरन्ति च । राम शोक अभिभूतम् तन् निष्कूजम् अभवद् वनम् ॥२-५९-६॥
translation: No living being move about and even wild animals roam no more. Overwhelmed with grief on account of Rama a great silence pervades the forest.

raw: यथा उक्त कारी वचनम् उत्तरम् चैव स उत्तरम् । बृहस्पति समो बुद्ध्या मत्त्वा रामानुजः तदा ॥४-३१-१२॥
translation: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

raw: हेत्वर्थयुक्तंविधिवच्छ्रेयस्करमदारुणम् । विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतंहेतुमत्त्वया ॥६-११४-७७॥
translation: "You have not listened to the meaningful, agreeable and reasonable advice given according to tradition by Vibheeshana."

raw: पापम् आचरताम् घोरम् लोकस्य अप्रियम् इच्छताम् । अहम् आसादितो राज्ञा प्राणान् हन्तुम् निशाचर ॥३-२९-१०॥
translation: O nightranger I have come with the orders of the king to put an end to the lives of the perpetrators of dreadful, sinful and offensive deeds in this world.

raw: व्यादाय विपुलं वक्त्रं स्थिता सा मरुतेः पुरः । तं दृष्ह्ट्वा मेघसंकाशं दशयोजनमायतम् ॥५-१-१६२॥
हत्वा च समरे रौद्र रावण सहबान्धवम् । राघवस्त्वां वरारोहे स्वां पुरीं नयते ध्रुवम् ॥५-६७-२९॥
जडी कृते तदा लोके रामे वर धनुर् धरे । निर्वीर्यो जामदग्न्यो असौ रमो रामम् उदैक्षत ॥१-७६-११॥
translation: Then when Rama stretched the great bow, the world became motionless. The son of Jamadagni, Parasurama, bereft of prowess gazed at him with astonishment.

raw: विक्रीडन् च पुनर् भूमौ पुनर् एव निषीदति । आश्रम द्वारम् आगम्य मृग यूथानि गच्छति ॥३-४२-२६॥
translation: The deer is now sporting, now sitting on the ground, now standing at the entrance of the hermitage and now running with the herds of deer.

raw: सा प्रहृष्टा महाराजम् हितकामानुवर्तिनी । जननी चार्थकामा मे केकयाधिपतेस्सुता ॥२-१६-१७॥
translation: My mother, daughter of the king of Kekaya, knows the king's intention and, heppy to do me good, seeks my wellbeing.

raw: स फालपिटकम् गृह्य गिरिदुर्गान्यलोडयत् । दिशः सर्वास्त्वनुचरन् स यथा पापकर्मकृत् ॥२-३६-२५॥
translation: Like an evildoer wandering about in different directions, holding a spade and a basket in his hand, he went about digging the impenetrable mountains.

raw: ते शरीरम् विराधस्य भित्त्वा बर्हिण वाससः । निपेतुः शोणिता दिग्धा धरण्याम् पावकोपमाः ॥३-३-१२॥
translation: The arrows tied with peacockfeathers, looking like fire, pierced the body of Viradha which, drenched in blood, fell on the ground.

raw: चिच्छेद केतुमुद्धिश्य शरेणैकेन रावणः । पातयित्वा रथोपस्थे रथात् केतुं च काञ्चनम् । ऐन्द्रानपि जघानाश्वान् शरजालेन रावणः ॥६-१०३-२६॥
translation: Ravana attacked the flag post of the chariot with one arrow and felled it down. Then he released a network of arrows on Indra's horses and struck them.

raw: प्रवृत्तमादितः पूर्वसर्गं नारददर्शितम् । ततः प्रभृति सर्गांश्च यावद्विंशत्यगायताम् ॥७-९४-१६॥
translation: They sang the Ramayana, starting from the first canto revealed by Narada, and continued singing up to the twentieth canto.

raw: पर्याप्तो अहम् गदा पाणिर् हन्तुम् प्राणान् रणे तव । त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् पाश हस्त इव अंतकः ॥३-२९-२२॥
translation: Just like lord Yama, holding a noose of death is alone enough to destroy the three worlds, I am alone sufficient to take away your life in war, a mace in hand.

raw: स तु ताम् राम राम इति रुदन्तीम् लक्ष्मण इति च । जगाम आदाय च आकाशम् रावणो राक्षसेश्वर ॥३-५२-१३॥
translation: While Sita was crying, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana', Ravana, lord of the demons, carried her back into the sky.

raw: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ॥७-८४-१॥
translation: After Rama and the great-souled Bharata had spoken, Lakshmana then addressed Rama, the delight of the Raghus, with auspicious words.

raw: राजा तु बाह्लिमुत्सृज्य मध्यदेशे ह्यनुत्तमम् । निवेशयामास पुरं प्रतिष्ठानं यशस्करम् ॥७-९०-२१॥
translation: But the king, having left Bahli, established the glorious and unsurpassed city of Pratishthana in the central region.

raw: तयोः शरपथं प्राप्तो रावणो राजपुत्रयोः । स बभौ च यथा राहुः समीपे शशिसूर्ययोः ॥६-१००-१७॥
translation: That way when the two princes came near the range of Ravana's arrows, it was like the Sun and the moon near planet Rahu.

raw: महा लतानाम् दामानि व्यधमत् तरसा कपिः । यथा प्रावृषि विन्ध्यस्य मेघ जालानि मारुतः ॥५-१४-२०॥
translation: Hanuman shook with tremendous speed the huge clusters of creepers hanging there just like stormy wind in rainy season scatters masses of clouds on the Vindhya mountain.

raw: त इमे बहु साहस्रैः अनेकैः बहु विक्रमैः । आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः ॥४-४०-७॥
translation: 'Dreadful monkeys who resemble demons have arrived along with thousands of fierce fighters.

raw: आजघान तदा नीलं ललाटे मुसलेन सः । प्रहस्तः परमायत्तस्तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम् ॥६-५८-४९॥
translation: Then Prahastha struck speedily with a mallet and hit Neela on the forehead and blood flowed from there.

raw: तथा रुदन्तीम् कौसल्याम् रथम् तम् अनुधावतीम् । क्रोशन्तीम् राम राम इति हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति च ॥२-४०-४४॥
translation: While Kausalya was weeping and running after the chariot, crying O 'Rama, O Sita, O Lakshmana, shedding tears for them, Rama repeatedly glanced at her who was twisting and bending as if in a dancing pose.

raw: ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरः सरथः सज्यकार्मुकः । किरन् शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिपेदे महाबलः ॥५-४६-२२॥
translation: Then the powerful, hero, Durdhara, mounted on his chariot, fastened his bowstring and hit Hanuman with hundreds of sharp arrows.

raw: अद्य निर्वानरामुर्वीं हत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम् । करिष्ये परमप्रीतिमित्युक्त्वा ऽन्तरधीयत ॥६-८०-१८॥
translation: 'Making the earth devoid of monkeys, killing Rama and Lakshmana, I will provide supreme joy to my father now', saying so he became invisible.

raw: दुःखितस्य च दीनस्य मम शोकातुरस्य च । लक्ष्यामास हृदये चिन्ताम् मुनिसुत स्तदा ॥२-६३-५०॥
translation: The son of the ascetic noticed my anguish and seeing me thus distressed, wretched and afflicted with sorrow, said:

raw: स्त्री तृतीयेन च तथा यत् प्राप्तम् चरता वने । सत्यसन्धेन रामेण तत्सर्वम् च अन्ववेक्षत ॥१-३-५॥
translation: All that was acquired by truthful Rama, Lakshmana and wife Sita as the third person when they were moving in the Dandakaranya forest, was visualised.

raw: किन्नराचरितं देशं पश्य शत्रुघ्न पर्वतम् । मृगै: समन्तादाकीर्णं मकरैरिव सागरम् ॥२-९३-११॥
translation: O Satrughna, behold this mountain frequented by kinneras and abounding in animals like great crocodiles in the ocean.

raw: दृष्ट्वा शत क्रतुम् तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् । रामोऽथ रथम् उद्दिश्य भ्रातुर् दर्शयत अद्भुतम् ॥३-५-१२॥
तेनातिविद्धौ तौ वीरौ रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुसंहितैः । बभूवतुर्दाशरथी पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥६-८०-३४॥
translation: Both the sons of Dasharatha looked like fully blossomed Kimsuka trees (blood flowing from the body) pierced by wellmade gold shafted arrows.

raw: स राजा रजनीम् षष्ठीम् रामे प्रव्रजिते वनम् । अर्ध रात्रे दशरथः सम्स्मरन् दुष्कृतम् कृतम् ॥२-६३-४॥
translation: After the banishment of Rama the king spent the sixth night, recalling the evil deed done by him in the past.

raw: ततः सर्वा दिशो राजा चोदयित्वा यथा तथम् । कपि सेना पतीन् वीरो मुमोद सुखितः सुखम् ॥४-४५-८॥
translation: Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys, having sent the leaders to all quarters felt relieved and rejoiced.

raw: ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः च धर्म आत्मा दिलीप नहुष उपमः । लब्धुम् अर्हति काकुत्स्थो राज्यम् दशरथो यथा ॥२-८२-१३॥
translation: The eldest, eminent and righteous Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, who is comparable to Dilipa and Nahusha deserves to inherit this kingdom just as Dasaratha did.

raw: धर्मः हि परमः लोके धर्मे सत्यम् प्रतिष्ठितम् । धर्म सम्श्रितम् एतच् च पितुर् वचनम् उत्तमम् ॥२-२१-४०॥
translation: Righteousness alone is supreme in this world and truth is established in righteousness. This excellent command of our father is supported by righteousness.

raw: कच्चिद्व्यपास्तानहितान् प्रतियातांश्च सर्वदा । दुर्बलाननवज्ञाय वर्त्तसे रिपुसूदन ॥२-१००-३८॥
translation: O slayer of foes, I hope you are always alert about your foes who were defeated by you and have come back. You should not ignore your enemies thinking they are weak.

raw: परंपराणाम् भक्षिष्ये वानराणाम् मृतम् मृतम् । उवाच एतत् वचः पक्षी तान् निरीक्ष्य प्लवंगमान् ॥४-५६-५॥
translation: Looking at them, the vulture continued, 'I will eat these monkeys one after the other as and when they die'.

raw: व्यक्तम् नभः शस्त्र विधौत वर्णम्कृश प्रवाहानि नदी जलानि । कह्लार शिताः पवनाः प्रवान्तितमो विमुक्ताः च दिशः प्रकाशाः ॥४-३०-३५॥
translation: 'Cleared of the black clouds, the sky is shining like a polished weapon. The river waters flow feebly. Winds blowing over white lotuses feel cool. All quarters clear of darkness are shining.

raw: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामः सुग्रीवं प्रत्यनन्तरम् । विभीषणं च धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ॥६-९४-३७॥
translation: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.

raw: ततः स्रग्दामसन्नद्धं दत्तपञ्चाङ्गुलं शुभम् । आददे परिघं वीरो नगेन्द्रशिखरोपमम् ॥६-७७-२॥
translation: Then the hero Nikumbha, girded with flowers measuring five digits in breadth, took an auspicious club like the peak of Mahendra mountain.

raw: प्राप्तिज्ञम् परमोदारम् सुसत्कृतम् पुरुषर्षभम् । राज्ञः शासनम् आदाय चोदयस्व नृपर्षभान् । प्राचीनान् सिन्धु सौवीरान् सौराष्ठ्रेयाम् च पार्थिवान् ॥१-१३-२७॥
तेषामपि महातेजा रामो रतिकरः पितुः । स्वयम्भूरिव भूतानां बभूव गुणवत्तरः ॥२-१-६॥
translation: Even among them the brilliant Rama was a source of delight to his father like the Selfborn (Brahma) to all living beings.

raw: ततः प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलः सविद्युदिव तोयदः । भवनाग्रेषु लङ्काया विचचार महाकपिः ॥५-५४-६॥
translation: The great Hanuman, with his burning tail wandered on tops of the mansions of Lanka, which looked like clouds with lightning.

raw: गजानाम् च सहस्रम् च रथानाम् अयुतम् पुरे । हयानाम् अयुते द्वे च साग्र कोटी च रक्षसाम् ॥६-३७-१६॥
translation: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."

raw: तान् तु निर्धावतो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसान् भीम दर्शनम् । खरस्य अथ रथः किंचित् जगाम तत् अनन्तरम् ॥३-२२-२१॥
translation: Khara's chariot moved a bit behind the army of demons of frightening prowess who rushed forward to attack (Rama).

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो वसूनामष्टमो वसुः । सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश रणाजिरम् ॥७-२७-३४॥
translation: In this interval, the brave eighth Vasu, renowned as Savitra, entered the battlefield.

raw: स निकृत्तौ भुजौ दृष्ट्वा शोणित ओघ परिप्लुतः । दीनः पप्रच्छ तौ वीरौ कौ युवाम् इति दानवः ॥३-७०-११॥
translation: The demon with his arms amputated, drenched in a pool of blood looked pathetic and asked them, Who are you?

raw: ततस्त्वदर्शयन् सर्वान् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून् । वराहान् महिषांश्चैव स बभक्ष महाबलः ॥६-६०-६३॥
translation: Thereafter having seen several kinds of food items of hogs, buffaloes he ate them.

raw: एवम् आज्ञापय क्षिप्रम् बलानाम् सर्व सम्ग्रहम् । मुहूर्तेन तु युक्तेन प्रस्थानमभिरोचय ॥६-३-३४॥
translation: "You may command the total army this way."Quickly start at an opportune time towards Lanka (said Hanuman to Rama)" commanded Hanuman." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेतृतीयस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the third Sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सा विस्फुरंती परिरभ्यमाणा भर्तुः समीपात् अपनीयमाना । ददर्श रामम् शर चाप पाणिम् स्व तेजसा सूर्यम् इव ज्वलंतम् ॥४-२४-२७॥
translation: While Tara was clinging to her husband and struggling, and was being removed from there, she saw effulgent Rama holding bow and arrows glittering like the Sun.

raw: एवम् उक्तः सुरैः सर्वैः चिन्तयित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत् । हन्ता अयम् विदितः तस्य वधोपायो दुरात्मनः ॥१-१५-१२॥
translation: After listening to the words of the devatas and reflecting over the matter, Brahma said, "Oh, the means of destruction of that wicked (rakshasa) has struck my mind".

raw: कार्यसिद्धिर्मतिश्चैव तस्मिन् वानरपुङ्गवे । व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च श्रुतं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥५-६३-१९॥
translation: "Hanuman alone has the ability to do it, the reason being he has the capacity the wisdom, streneous effort, virility and enthusiasm to accomplish it. These attributes are wellestablished in him.

raw: त्वां प्राप्य मे वधो वा स्याच्छापो वा यदि दारुणः । भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम् ॥७-८०-१५॥
translation: O timid one, even if I obtain you and face death or a terrible curse, please accept me, your devoted servant who is greatly agitated.

raw: कैकेय्यास्तु सुसंवृत्तम् क्षिप्रम् अद्य एव लक्ष्मण । या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घ दर्शिनी ॥३-२-१९॥
विलप्य बहु वैदेही न्यस्त देहा भविष्यति । अथवा निहिता मन्ये रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-१३-१५॥
सागरौघनिभं भीममग्रानीकं महाबलाः । कपिसिंहाः प्रकर्षस्तु शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥६-४-१४॥
translation: "These hundreds and thousands of lionlike vanaras would walk in groups leading the army like the fierce tides of the ocean".

raw: कथम् आत्म सुतान् हित्वा त्रायसे अन्य सुतम् विभो । अकार्यम् इव पश्यामः श्व मांसम् इव भोजने ॥१-६२-१४॥
translation: O Lord protecting other's son by abandoning one' own is like partaking the flesh of a dog. We consider it a prohibited act".

raw: वर्षेण एव आगतम् विप्रम् तापसम् स नराधिपः । प्रति उद्गम्य मुनिम् प्रह्वः शिरसा च महीम् गतः ॥१-१०-३०॥
translation: The king (Romapada) went out to welcome the ascetic, the brahmin who brought along with him rains to his country. He humbly bowed down his head and prostrated before him.

raw: स कृत्वा पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां शासने पृथिवीपतिः । सुरलोकमितो जेतुमुद्योगमकरोन्नृपः ॥७-६७-६॥
translation: Having brought the entire earth under his rule, that king, the lord of the earth, then made an effort to conquer the world of the gods from here.

raw: तेषां तद्व्याहृतं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम् । विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥७-९५-८॥
translation: Having heard their words and understood Rama's intention, the greatly effulgent sage Valmiki then spoke.

raw: ततः पुष्पातिभाराग्राँल्ल्ताशतसमावृतान् -यद्वा -ततः पुष्प अतिभार अग्रान् लता शत समावृतान् । द्रुमान् वासन्तिकान् दृष्ट्वा बभूवुः भय शन्किताः ॥४-५३-४॥
हद्गतो ह्यसि सम्प्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा । मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम् । स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहार यथा ह्याह पितामहः ॥७-१०४-१९॥
translation: You are indeed understood and your time has arrived, there is no doubt in my mind about that; for I must indeed act in all duties, obedient to the gods, for the destruction of all, just as the grandfather Brahma has indeed commanded. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 104 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सान्धकारा हतद्योता हतराक्षसपुङ्गवा । भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का निर्दग्धा रामसायकैः ॥५-२४-३०॥
भिक्षु रूपम् परित्यज्य वानरम् रूपम् आस्थितः । पृष्टम् आरोप्य तौ वीरौ जगाम कपिकुङ्जरः ॥४-४-३४॥
translation: Hanuman, who was an elephant among monkeys, gave up the guise of a mendicant, and assuming the form of the monkeys, lifted both the heroes on to his back and proceeded.

raw: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । अशक्नुवन् धारयितुम् कोपम् संतापम् आगतः ॥१-६४-१४॥
translation: The brilliant Viswamitra, the great ascetic, now experienced remorse for his inability to contain anger.

raw: तया परिगृहीतांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धः सुरेश्वरः । चक्रेण शितधारेण भृगुपत्न्याः शिरो ऽहरत् ॥७-५१-१४॥
translation: Seeing the demons protected by her, the enraged lord of gods (Vishnu) cut off the head of Bhrigu's wife with his sharp-edged discus.

raw: अकर्ता ह्यकृतज्ञश्च त्यक्तात्मा निरपत्रपः । लोके भवतु विद्वेष्यो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-३३॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be hated universally as one who never helps any one, who is ungrateful, shameless and as one who has committed the sin of suicide

raw: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः श्यामा मृग्यः सिंहवशा इव । काचिच्चिन्तयती तत्र किं नु मां भक्षयिष्यति ॥७-२४-११॥
translation: These young women, with their sad, curved glances, were like does under the control of a lion, and some among them wondered if he would devour them.

raw: न देवा न च गंधर्वा न असुरा न मरुत् गणाः । न च यक्षा भयम् तस्य कुर्युः किम् इव राक्षसाः ॥४-२९-२४॥
translation: 'Not gods, demons, gandharvas or even marutas, suras or yakshas can cause fright in him much less the rakshasas.

raw: एतावेव हि संक्रुद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् । लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः ॥५-५९-२१॥
translation: "If these two become angry they have the power to destroy Lanka, the cavalry, chariots and also the elephants even if the vanaras stay away.

raw: कथं नु खलु मे पुत्रो भविष्यति मया विना । कथं माता कथं भ्राता निमग्नाः शोकसागरे ॥७-२४-१३॥
translation: They lamented, "How will my son fare without me? How will my mother and brother, immersed in an ocean of sorrow, endure?"

raw: स तु धर्मप्रसङ्गेन मेरोः पार्श्वे महागिरेः । तृणविन्द्वाश्रमं गत्वा न्यवसन्मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥७-२-७॥
translation: Indeed, for religious purposes, that foremost sage went to the hermitage of Tṛṇavindu on the side of the great Mount Meru and resided there.

raw: कच्चिद् वृद्धांश्च बालांश्च वैद्यमुख्यांश्च राघव । दानेन मनसा वाचा त्रिभिरेतैर्बुभूषसे ॥२-१००-६१॥
translation: O Bharata, I trust you wish to thrive by treating the old, children and foremost of learned people with the three expedients namely gifts, affection and kind words.

raw: शिथिलां वलितां वृद्धां जरापाण्डरमूर्द्धजाम् । सततं वेपमानाङ्गी प्रवाते कदली यथा ॥२-११७-१६॥
ततः पार्श्वगतं दृष्ट्वा सविमर्शं विचारयन् । विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहृष्टं राघवो ऽब्रवीत् ॥६-११७-१७॥
translation: Raghava, analysed with in him, distressed and thinking deeply, seeing Vibheeshana close by, spoke these words.

raw: सा ददर्श सखीम् सीताम् सरमा नष्ट चेतनाम् । उपावृत्य उत्थिताम् ध्वस्ताम् वडवाम् इव पांसुषु ॥६-३३-४॥
translation: Saarana saw her friend Sita, who had lost consciousness, fully covered by dust by rolling on the dirty ground like a female horse.

raw: स्निग्ध पत्रा यथा वृक्षा यथा क्षान्ता मृग द्विजाः । आश्रमो न अतिदूरस्थो महर्षेर् भावित आत्मनः ॥३-११-७८॥
translation: The leaves of the trees here are glossy, the animals and birds are peaceful. It appears the hermitage of the selfrealized great sage Agastya is not very far from here.

raw: नानापताकाध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टं प्रासासिशूलायुधशस्त्रजुष्टम् । सैन्यं गजेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टं कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टम् ॥६-५९-१२॥
translation: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"

raw: तत् अपि अस्त्रम् महाघोरम् ब्राह्मम् ब्राह्मेण तेजसा । वसिष्ठो ग्रसते सर्वम् ब्रह्म दण्डेन राघव ॥१-५६-१६॥
translation: O Descendant of Raghu Vasishta who possessed the energy of Brahma swallowed that very dreadful Brahmastra entirely with the help of Brahmadanda.

raw: अजिन उत्तर सम्स्तीर्णे वर आस्तरण सम्चये । शयित्वा पुरुष व्याघ्रः कथम् शेते मही तले ॥२-८८-४॥
translation: How could Rama, the best among men used to a bed made of a pile of excellent spreads and overspread with deer skin, sleep on the bare ground?

raw: निहन्म्यहम् त्वाम् ससुतम् सबन्धुम् । सज्ञातिवर्गम् रजनीचरेश । लङ्काम् च सर्वाम् महता बलेन । सर्वैः करिष्यामि समेत्य भस्म ॥६-२०-२४॥
translation: "O Night ranger Ravana I shall kill all your sons, relatives, your kinsfolk. I shall come at once and even burn Lanka into ashes with my mighty prowess."

raw: उपेत्य च आश्रमम् पुण्यम् वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रितः । द्रष्टु कामः प्रतीक्षे च भगवंतम् निशाकरम् ॥४-६०-१३॥
translation: 'On reaching the sacred hermitage, I stood and waited under a tree for the audience of the divine sage Nishakara.

raw: तथैवापततां तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः । शिरांसि सहसा जह्नू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः ॥६-७५-६२॥
translation: When the Rakshasas showed up in that manner, the monkeys approaching them cut off their heads instantly with sharp swords.

raw: लङ्का चारयितव्या वै पुनरेव भवेदिति । रात्रौ न हि सुदृष्टा मे दुर्गकर्मविधानतः ॥५-५३-१४॥
कैकेय्या विनियुक्तेन पाप अभिजन भावया । मया न मन्त्र कुशलैः वृद्धैः सह समर्थितम् ॥२-५९-१८॥
translation: Incited by Kaikeyi of sinful relations and sinful motive, I did not consult expert, elderly counsellers.

raw: यदि नाम स शूरो मां रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः । जानीयाद्वर्तमानां हि रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-२४-३१॥
तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ । हरीन् विशल्यान् सह लक्ष्मणेन चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे ॥६-५९-१४५॥
translation: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.

raw: सा प्रसह्य मया भुक्ता कृता विवसना ततः । स्वयम्भूभवनम् प्राप्ता लोलिता नलिनी यथा ॥६-१३-१२॥
translation: "Then her clothes were stripped off by me forcibly and enjoyed her. Then like a violently shaken lotus stem, she went to the abode of Brahma."

raw: राज्ञस्तु भवनद्वारि सो ऽवतीर्य रथोत्तमात् । अवाङ्मुखो दीनमनाः प्रविवेशानिवारितः ॥७-५२-५॥
translation: At the king's palace gate, he alighted from his excellent chariot and, with a downcast face and sorrowful mind, entered unhindered.

raw: एतत् ब्राह्मण रामस्य व्रतम् ध्रुवम् अनुत्तमम् । तस्य भ्राता तु वैमात्रो लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान् ॥३-४७-१८॥
सा रामम् पर्णशालायाम् उपविष्टम् परंतपम् । सीतया सह दुर्धर्षम् अब्रवीत् काम मोहिता ॥३-१८-१४॥
translation: Deluded with passion, Surpanakha said to formidable Rama, the scorcher of foes, seated in the leafthatched hut along with Sita:

raw: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौसल्या चिरकालाभिकाङ्क्षितम् । हर्ष्बाष्पकलं वाक्यमिदं राम मभाषत ॥२-४-३८॥
तत्र माम् राम राज्यस्थः स्मर्तुम् अर्हसि सर्वदा । लक्ष्मणेन एवम् उक्तः तु रामः सौमित्रिम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६९-४१॥
तस्याः पुत्रम् कृत आत्मानम् चीर वल्कल वाससम् । प्रस्थाप्य वन वासाय कथम् पापे न शोचसि ॥२-७३-११॥
translation: You have forced Kausalya's son, so pure in mind, to wear garments made of bark and dwell in the forest. Do you not feel remorse for it, O perverse wretch?

raw: अनुयातः च माम् तूर्णम् अयम् भ्राता सुदारुणः । स तु दृष्ट्वा एव माम् रात्रौ स द्वितीयम् महाबलः ॥४-१०-१५॥
दुर्मुखः पुनरुत्थाय कपिः स विपुलद्रुमम् । राक्षसं क्षिप्रहस्तस्तु समुन्नतमपोथयत् ॥६-५८-२१॥
translation: Dhurmukha monkey uprooting a huge tree holding it in hand killed the Rakshasa Samunnata.

raw: आबभाषे गजस्तत्र प्लवेयं दशयोजनम् । गवाक्षो योजननान्याह गमिष्यामीति विंशतिम् ॥४-६५-३॥
translation: Gaja said he can leap ten yojanas and Gavaksha said he can go upto twenty yojanas.

raw: यदि माम् सम्स्पृशेद् रामः सकृदद्य लभेत वा । यमक्षयमनुप्राप्ता द्रक्ष्यन्ति न हि मानवाः ॥२-६४-६५॥
translation: Before I die, will Rama touch me once or will he come to me? After reaching the abode of Yama men cannot see their relations.

raw: तस्य देव प्रभावस्य तपसा भावित आत्मनः । समीपे शरभंगस्य ददर्श महत् अद्भुतम् ॥३-५-४॥
translation: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

raw: तत्र अपि शिशु नागानाम् आक्रंदः श्रूयते महान् । क्रीडताम् राम पंपायाम् मतंग आश्रम वासिनाम् ॥३-७३-३५॥
translation: O Rama, the trumpeting of the young playful elephants inhabiting sage Matanga's forest can be heard at Pampa.

raw: स शैलम् सागर अनूपम् वीर्यवान् अवलोकयन् । नाना पुष्प फलैर् वृक्षैर् अनुकीर्णम् सहस्रशः ॥३-३५-११॥
translation: Valiant Ravana wentwatching the mountains full of thousands of trees bearing flowers and fruits on the shore of the sea.

raw: ते च कर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे वसिष्ठाय च महर्षये । सर्वम् निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यत् उपकल्पितम् ॥१-१३-३२॥
translation: All the workers reported to the wise sage, Vasishta about the tasks completed for the sacrifice.

raw: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात् ॥७-२२-४९॥
translation: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.

raw: स वेगः कार्तवीर्येण सम्प्रेषित इवाम्भसः । पुष्पोपहारं सकलं रावणस्य जहार ह ॥७-३२-७॥
translation: That current, as if propelled by Kartavirya's water, indeed carried away all of Ravana's flower offerings.

raw: बहिर् लक्ष्मण निष्क्रामति अगस्त्यो भगवान् ऋषिः । औदार्येण अवगच्छामि निधानम् तपसाम् इमम् ॥३-१२-२३॥
translation: The valiant Rama said to Lakshmana, the enhancer of prosperity, O Lakshmana, sage Agastya is coming out. By virtue of his noble appearance, I know this sage to be a great treasuretrove of penances.

raw: शबरी दर्शनम् च एव फल मूल अशनम् तथा । प्रलापम् च एव पम्पायम् हनुमद् दर्शनम् ॥१-३-२२॥
इयम् धार्मिक कौसल्या मम माता यशस्विनी । वृद्धा च अक्षुद्र शीला च न च त्वाम् देव गर्हिते ॥२-३८-१५॥
translation: O righteous father O king my aged and illustrious mother, Kausalya possesses neither a mean character nor does she blame you.

raw: भवताम् अर्थ सिद्ध्यर्थम् आगतोऽहम् यदृच्छया । तस्य मे अयम् वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः ॥३-६-२४॥
translation: I came here to acomplish your task incidentally, Therefore, my stay in the forest will yield great results.

raw: प्राप्त राज्यस्य रामस्य वाल्मीकिर् भगवान् ऋषिः । चकार चरितम् कृत्स्नम् विचित्र पदम् अर्थवत् ॥१-४-१॥
translation: The divine sage Valmiki, composed in wonderful lines the entire lifestory of Rama who regained his kingdom.

raw: गो लांगूल महाराजो गवाक्षो भीम विक्रमः । वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण वानराणाम् अदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१९॥
translation: Next arrived Gavaksha, king of Langurs (whose tail resembled the cow's), of fierceful courage surrounded by a thousand crore of vanaras.

raw: स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान् । विमदानुत्थितान् सर्वान् मेहमानान् मधूदकम् ॥५-६४-४॥
translation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).

raw: देशो निवृत्त संग्रामः सु घोरः पार्थिव आत्मज । एकस्य तु विमर्दो अयम् न द्वयोः वदताम् वर ॥३-६५-८॥
विमानंपुष्पकंदिव्यंसम्गृहीतंतुरक्षसा अगमद्धनदंवेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् ॥६-१३०-६१॥
translation: That wonderful Pushpaka received from Rakshasa impelled by Rama's order speedily went to Kubera.

raw: दृष्ट्वैव तु रथस्थं तं पर्यवर्तत तद्बलम् । रक्षसां भीमवेगानां लक्ष्मणेन युयुत्सताम् ॥६-८६-१७॥
translation: Seeing Lakshmana prepared for war, the Rakshasa army endowed with speed surrounded him.

raw: मन्ये लक्ष्मण वैदेही राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः । भित्त्वा भित्त्वा विभक्ता वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति ॥३-६४-४१॥
translation: O Lakshmana, Vaidehi might have been cut into pieces, and eaten up by the demons who can assume any form at their free will.

raw: अङ्गदेनैष संयातु लक्ष्मणश्चान्त कोपमः । सार्वभौमेन भूतेशो द्रविणाधिपतिर्यथा ॥६-४-१९॥
translation: "Let Lakshmana who is like Anthaka (one who excels death) ride on Angada, like the lord of wealth (Kubera) rides on the elephant Saarvabhauma (the elephant that guards the four quarters)".

raw: कृतं मया यथा तथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम् । धर्मसेतुमथो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ ॥७-८३-३॥
translation: O Raghavas, I have truly and excellently performed the duty of a Brahmin, and now I wish to further establish a bridge of righteousness.

raw: पठन् द्विजो वाक् ऋषभत्वम् ईयात् । स्यात् क्षत्रियो भूमि पतित्वम् ईयात् ॥वणिक् जनः पण्य फलत्वम् ईयात् । जनः च शूद्रो अपि महत्त्वम् ईयात् ॥१-१-१००॥
translation: A brahmin becomes proficient in the eighteen branches of learning a kshatriya gets lordship over landed possessions a vaisya gets the fruits of his business and sudra also attains greatness by reading Ramayana". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे (श्रीमद्रामायणकथासङ्क्षेपो नाम) प्रथम: सर्ग:।। Thus ends the first sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana in synopsis of the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ददर्श सुमहा तेजा न ददर्श च जानकीम् । निरीक्षमाणः च ततः ताः स्त्रियः स महा कपिः ॥५-११-३६॥
स इन्द्रान् अपि सुरान् सर्वाम् त्वम् बाणैः पुरुषर्षभ । समर्थः समरे हन्तुम् किम् पुनर् वालिनम् प्रभो ॥४-१२-८॥
translation: 'O bull among men, O lord, you are capable of killing with your arrows even the gods including Indra in the battle, what to speak of Vali.

raw: नूनम् सर्वे गमिष्यामो मार्गम् रामनिषेवितम् । त्यक्ताया बान्धवैः सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैः साधुभिः सदा ॥२-३५-१२॥
translation: All of us certainly will follow the path pursued by Rama. Abandoned by relatives, brahmins and virtuous men for all times, what pleasure will you derive by your lust for this kingdom? O Kaikeyi, why do you intend to trangress the limits of honour?

raw: मन्दाकिनीं नदीं रम्यां प्राङ्मुखास्ते ययुस्तदा । प्रदक्षिणं च कुर्वाणाश्चित्रकूटं महागिरिम् ॥२-११३-३॥
translation: All of them circumambulated the mighty mountain Chitrakuta and proceeded east towards the charming river Mandakini.

raw: मद् द्वितीयो धनुष् पाणिः सहायैः परम ऋषिभिः । समुद्रम् च विचेष्यामः पर्वतान् च वनानि च ॥३-६५-१३॥
शैब्यः श्येनकपोतीये स्वमाम्सं पक्षिते ददौ । अलर्कश्चक्षुषी दत्वा जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम् ॥२-१२-४३॥
translation: (King) Saibya gave his own flesh to the hawk in the conflict between the hawk and the pigeon. (King) Alarka gave his eyes (to a blind man) and attained the highest state.

raw: मत् नियोगात् इमम् देशम् कुरु निष्कण्टकम् पुनः । न हि कश्चित् इमम् देशम् शक्तो हि आगन्तुम् ईदृशम् ॥१-२४-३१॥
ततो रामः परां प्रीतिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तथा । ययुर्युद्धे दुराधर्षा अभिषेकं च चक्रिरे ॥७-१०२-१०॥
translation: Then Rama, Lakshmana, and Bharata, who were unconquerable in battle, attained great joy and performed the anointment.

raw: तौ पुत्रम् आत्मनः स्पृष्ट्वा तम् आसाद्य तपस्विनौ । निपेततुः शरीरे अस्य पिता च अस्य इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६४-३०॥
translation: Both the ascetics stroking their son's body and collapsed upon it. And the father said:

raw: बाष्प संचन्न सलिला रुत विज्ञेय सारसाः । हिमाअर्द्र वालुकैः तीरैः सरितो भान्ति सांप्रतम् ॥३-१६-२४॥
translation: Now the rivers are not visible as the waters are covered with vapour. They are only inferred through the cackling of swans and the sands of the bank moistened with dewdrops.

raw: चित्य माल्य अनुलेपः च आयस आभरणो अभवत् । तम् दृष्ट्वा मंत्रिणः सर्वे त्यज्य चण्डाल रूपिणम् ॥१-५७-११॥
नास्तिको न अनृती वा अपि न कश्चित् अबहुश्रुतः । न असूयको न च अशक्तो न अविद्वान् विद्यते क्वचित् ॥१-६-१४॥
translation: That time there was no atheist, no liar and none ignorant of the sastras. There was no one who was jealous, incompetent or illiterate.

raw: ऋषयः पितरो देवा गन्धर्वा गरुडोरगाः । शतक्रतुं पुरस्कृत्य ररक्षुर्लक्ष्मणं रणे ॥६-९१-६४॥
translation: The Rsis, Devatas, manes, Gandharvas, Garudas, serpents and Indra who had performed hundred sacrifices, protected Lakshmana in war.

raw: चलकुण्डलमौलिस्रक्तपनीयविभूषणः । पादयोर्न्यपतद्वायुस्तिस्रोपस्थाय वेधसे ॥७-३६-२॥
translation: Vayu, adorned with his moving earrings, crown, garlands, and golden ornaments, approached Brahma and prostrated himself at his feet.

raw: भगीरथ महाराज प्रीतः ते अहम् जनाधिप । तपसा च सुतप्तेन वरम् वरय सुव्रत ॥१-४२-१६॥
translation: 'O distinguished one O mighty monarch O Bhagiratha of excellent vows I am pleased with your welldisciplined austerities. Ask for a boon'.

raw: सञ्जीवकरणीं दिव्यां विशल्यां देवनिर्मिताम् .५०.२ ॥ सम्पातिपनसादयः । चन्द्रश्च नाम द्रोणश्च क्षीरोदे सागरोत्तमे । अमृतं यत्र मथितं तत्र ते परमौषधी ॥६-५०-३०॥
ततः सुग्रीव वचनात् हत्वा वालिनम् आहवे । सुग्रीवम् एव तत् राज्ये राघवः प्रत्यपादयत् ॥१-१-७०॥
translation: After he killed Vali in the combat in compliance with the words of Sugriva, Rama installed Sugriva as king.

raw: निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयः सैन्ये चास्य समन्ततः । दुर्विषह्यस्वना घोरा विना जलधरस्वनम् ॥६-१०८-२८॥
translation: Without clouds, terrific thunderbolts of Indra (rain) dropped on his (Ravana's) army all over causing unbearable sound.

raw: तौ परस्परशापेन देहावुत्सृज्य धार्मिकौ । अभूतां नृपविप्रर्षी वायुभूतौ तपोधनौ ॥७-५६-४॥
translation: Those two righteous ones, the king and the brahmin sage, having abandoned their bodies due to a mutual curse, became beings of air, their wealth being penance.

raw: स वायुमार्गमास्थाय वायुतुल्यगतिर्द्विजः । पुरीं माहिष्मतीं प्राप्तो मनःसम्पातविक्रमः ॥७-३३-३॥
translation: Taking the aerial path, that brahmin, with speed like the wind and valor like the speed of thought, reached the city of Mahishmati.

raw: इतिउक्तः परुषम् वाक्यम् न्यायवादी विभीषणः । उत्पपात गदापाणिःचतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः ॥६-१६-१७॥
translation: Vibheeshana who was just in his argument rose up, wielding mace in hand accompanied by the four Rakshasas, when Ravana had spoken such harsh words to him.

raw: पुरा अहम् वलिना राम राज्यात् स्वात् अवरोपितः । परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतो अस्मि बलीयसा ॥४-८-३२॥
translation: 'O Rama I was subjected to the harsh words of powerful Vali in the past when he uprooted me from the kingdom and threw me out.

raw: रुदिताश्रुपरिद्यूनम् हाहाकृतमचेतनम् । प्रयाणे राघवस्यासीत्पुरम् परमपीडितम् ॥२-४०-३४॥
translation: At the time of Rama's departure, the insensate city was drenched with tears of the deeply afflicted people crying, 'Alas, Alas'.

raw: सत्त्वेन वीर्येण पराक्रमेणधैर्येण शौर्येण च तेजसा च । एकः कुलेऽस्मिन् पुरुषो विमुक्तो । विभीषणस्तातकनिष्ठ एषः ॥६-१५-३॥
translation: "In this race, alone younger father Vibheeshana is devoid of strength, valour, prowess, heroism, courage and boldness."

raw: यत् इदम् राज्य तंत्रम् मे त्वयि सर्वम् प्रतिष्ठितम् । जीवितम् च विशालाक्षि त्वम् मे प्राणैः गरीयसी ॥३-५५-१६॥
translation: For me alone there are a thousand attendants.The administration of the kingdom and all my subjects will be under your control. O largeeyed Sita you are dearer to me than my life.

raw: रक्षता तु मया वृत्तमपावदं च सर्वशः । प्रख्यातस्यात्मवंशस्य न्यङ्गं च परिरक्षता ॥६-११८-१६॥
translation: "Sita! This effort in carrying out with the assistance of valiant friends is not done for your sake. Let it be known to you. I have done this to protect good conduct and my illustrious race from scandal and rid of obloquy from all sides."

raw: रामम् प्रांजलयो भूत्वा अब्रुवन् मधुर भाषिणः । इमे स्म नरशार्दूल शाधि किम् करवाम ते ॥१-२८-१३॥
translation: "Certainly" said Rama, and with a delighted heart received the astras. Some of the astra devatas were coal-black, some like smoke, some resembled rays of Sun or Moon. Assuming corporal forms, with shining, divine bodies, those weapons the their bodies bent down and palms folder they spoke to Rama in a gentle voice: "O tiger among men, here we are, What can we do for you"?

raw: निर्जिताः स्मेति वा ब्रूत एष मे हि सुनिश्चयः । अन्यथा कुर्वतामेवं मोक्षो नैवोपपद्यते ततस्त्वभीरवः प्राज्ञाः पार्थिवा धर्मनिश्चयाः । मन्त्रयित्वा ततो ऽन्योन्यं राजानः सुमहाबलाः । निर्जिताः स्मेत्यभाषन्त ज्ञात्वा वरबलं रिपोः ॥७-१९-३॥
translation: Then, those fearless, wise, and righteous kings, though exceedingly powerful, consulted among themselves and, recognizing the enemy's strength derived from boons, declared, "We are conquered."

raw: ते सरांसि सरित् कक्षान् आकाशम् नगराणि च । नदी दुर्गान् तथा शैलान् विचिन्वन्ति समन्ततः ॥४-४७-२॥
translation: They went looking everywhere in the tanks, in the bottom of rivers, in towns, in the sky and similarly in inaccessible rivers, mountains, and forts surrounded by rivers.

raw: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत् । यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत् प्रकाशते ॥६-५९-२८॥
translation: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.

raw: विसर्जयामासततस्समन्त्रिणोविधानमाज्ञाप्यपुरस्यपुष्कलम् । जयाशिषामन्त्रिगणेनपूजितोविवेशचाऽन्तःपुरमृद्धिमन्महत् ॥६-३६-२२॥
translation: There after making arrangements adequately for the protection of Lanka, taking leave of ministers who offered blessings for his prosperity and uttered words of benediction for his success Ravana entered the inner chambers of the palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटित्रंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तस्मादाश्वासयात्मानं बलं चाश्वासय स्वकम् । यावत् कार्याणि सर्वाणि पुनः संस्थापयाम्यहम् ॥६-४६-४२॥
translation: "Therefore, restoring breath let us reassure the army again till all actions are carried out by restoring their confidence."

raw: आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् नगाः षट्पद नादिताः । कुसुमोत्तंस विटपाः शोभन्ते बहु लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-९२॥
translation: 'The trees, crowned with flowers filled with humming bees, look splendid. It appears they are calling one another, O Lakshmana

raw: ततो महाशक्तिशरैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि (पात्यमानो) । नाशक्नोत्प्रतिकर्तुं स राक्षसः शल्यपीडितः ॥७-२२-१४॥
translation: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.

raw: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहुर्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् । प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालैस्तान् वानरान् भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ॥६-५९-५२॥
translation: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.

raw: अदृष्टामः च विचेष्यामि देशान् रावण पालितान् । आपान शाला विचिताः तथा पुष्प गृहाणि च ॥५-१२-१२॥
त्वम् नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रथितः प्रिय दर्शनः । पराङ्मुख वधम् कृत्वा को अत्र प्राप्तः त्वया गुणः । यदहम् युद्ध सम्रब्धः त्वत् कृते निधनम् गतः ॥४-१७-१६॥
ततो रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् स उपाध्यायः स बान्धवः । राजा दशरथो हृष्टः सुमंत्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६९-१॥
translation: With the passing of the night king Dasaratha, accompanied by spiritual preceptors and relatives said to Sumantra:

raw: ततः क्लिन्नाम्बरं त्यक्त्वा शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतम् । रावणं प्राञ्जलिं यान्तमन्वयुः सर्वराक्षसाः ॥७-३१-४०॥
translation: Then, having discarded his wet garment and now clad in white, Ravana proceeded with folded hands, followed by all the Rākṣasas.

raw: हा वीर रिपुदर्पघ्न कुम्भकर्ण महाबल । त्वं मां विहाय वै दैवाद्यातो ऽसि यमसादनम् ॥६-६८-१०॥
translation: "Ha! Hero! Kumbhakarna! You, who crushed the pride of the enemy, endowed with great prowess have deserted me and gone to the abode of death, actually by divine will."

raw: हयान् गजान् खरानुष्ट्रांस्तथैव सुरभे: सुतान् । अभोजयन् वाहनपास्तेषां भोज्यं यथाविधि ॥२-९१-५४॥
translation: The attendants of draughtanimals fed the horses, elephants, donkeys, camels and oxen their appropriate food.

raw: सेवमाने दृढम् सूर्ये दिशम् अन्तक सेविताम् । विहीन तिलका इव स्त्री न उत्तरा दिक् प्रकाशते ॥३-१६-८॥
translation: As the Sun has resorted to the direction (south) that serves the god of death, the north devoid of (the Sun) shines like a woman without the vermilion mark on the forehead.

raw: दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः । वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथा ऽसौ विलयं व्रजेत् ॥५-५८-११२॥
translation: 'O king may orders be issued to kill this wickedminded vanara wandering aimlessly. He has done contrary to your interest.

raw: विशेषेण आश्रमस्थाने हासो अयम् न प्रशस्यते । अवगच्छामि ते शीलम् परिहास प्रियम् प्रिये ॥३-६२-६॥
translation: O darling joking specially in a hermitage is not appreciated. I know your nature.You love fun. O largeeyed Sita, come here. This cottage of yours is empty.

raw: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽभिषिक्तस्तु भ्रातृभ्यां सहितस्तदा । ततः प्रदानं राक्षस्या भगिन्याः समचिन्तयत् ॥७-१२-१॥
translation: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, having been crowned and accompanied by his two brothers, then thought about giving his Rakshasi sister in marriage.

raw: विह्वलाभ्यां च नेत्राभ्यामपश्यन्निव भूपतिः । कृच्छ्राद्धैर्येण संस्तभ्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-१३॥
translation: The king was unable to see with his eyes overwhelmed (with tears). Gaining with great difficulty a firm footing and courage he addressed Kaikeyi:

raw: ततः पितामहो वाणीमन्तरिक्षादभाषत । आगच्छ विष्णो भद्रं ते दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि राघव ॥७-११०-८॥
translation: Then, the Grandfather Brahma spoke a voice from the sky, saying, "Come, O Vishnu, may good fortune be with you; fortunately, you have arrived, O Raghava."

raw: गायंत्यो नृत्यमानाः च वादयंत्यः च राघव । आमोदम् परमम् जग्मुर् वर आभरण भूषिताः ॥१-३२-१३॥
translation: Those welladorned, beautiful, young maidens in the pleasuregarden looked like lightnings in the rainy season. Bedecked with fine ornaments they were singing, dancing, playing on instruments and moving in all directions in great delight.

raw: वज्रमुत्सृज्य वृत्राय भ्रान्ते ऽथ त्रिदिवेश्वरे । शतं वर्षसहस्राणि येनेन्द्रत्वं प्रशासितम् ॥७-५६-२८॥
translation: This refers to the one who ruled as Indra for a hundred thousand years when the actual Indra was agitated after casting his thunderbolt at Vritra.

raw: तेन वाक्येन संहृष्टा तमभिप्रायमागतम् । व्याजहार महाघोरमभ्यागतमिवान्तकम् ॥२-११-१२॥
translation: Delighted by the words (of the king), Kaikeyi disclosed him her highly dreadful wish which entered her mind like a sudden visitation of death:

raw: अथ याः कोसल इन्द्रस्य शयनम् प्रत्यनन्तराः । ताः स्त्रियः तु समागम्य भर्तारम् प्रत्यबोधयन् ॥२-६५-१२॥
translation: The women who usually attend to the bed (maids who do the bed in the morning) of Dasaratha (king of Kosala) without any restrictions, approached the king and began waking him up.

raw: भ्रातरस्ते महेष्वासं सर्वत: शोककर्शितम् । रुदन्त: सह वैदेह्या सिषिचु: सलिलेन वै ॥२-१०२-५॥
translation: Those brothers on all sides, with Sita lamenting, sprinkled water on Rama, the great archer and lord of the earth who, afflicted with grief, had fallen down on the ground, and was lying like an elephant exhausted from repeatedly striking a river bank.

raw: कपि रूपम् परित्यज्य हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । भिक्षु रूपम् ततो भेजे शठबुद्धितया कपिः ॥४-३-२॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, with an ingenious mind assumed the guise of a mendicant.

raw: सागरप्रतिमौघेन वृतस्तेन बलेन सः । प्रहस्तो निर्ययौ तूर्णं कालान्तकयमोपमः ॥६-५७-३३॥
translation: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).

raw: यम् पालयसि धर्मम् त्वम् धृत्या च नियमेन च । सवै राघवशार्दुल! धर्मस्त्वामभिरक्षतु ॥२-२५-३॥
translation: The duty which you are carrying out with courage and selfdiscipline, O tiger among the descendants of Raghu will alone protect you.

raw: ततो ददुर्लोकपालाः सर्वे भागान्स्वतेजसः । अक्षुपच्च ततो ब्रह्मा यतो जातः क्षुपो नृपः ॥७-७६-४२॥
translation: Then all the protectors of the worlds gave shares of their own splendor, and then Brahma sneezed, from which King Kṣupa was born.

raw: धन्यः खलु भवान्येन ज्येष्ठो भ्राता रणे जितः । न त्वया सदृशः श्लाध्यस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ॥७-१८-११॥
translation: Marutta sarcastically remarks, "Indeed, you are blessed, by whom the elder brother was conquered in battle; there is no one praiseworthy like you in the three worlds."

raw: वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रामाः । तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः ॥५-१८-२९॥
translation: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.

raw: तदस्त्रबन्धमासाद्य यदि मुक्तौ रिपू मम । संशयस्थमिदं सर्वमनुपश्याम्यहं बलम् ॥६-५१-१५॥
translation: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"

raw: एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मज्ञौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । निर्बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः प्रजहर्ष ननाद च ॥६-४५-१३॥
translation: Indrajith having spoken to the righteous brothers Rama and Lakshmana in that way, began to pain them with arrows and stood rejoiced roaring aloud.

raw: गन्धहस्तीव दुर्धर्षस्तरस्वी गन्धमादनः । तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्याः सव्यम् पक्षमधिष्ठतः ॥६-२४-१६॥
translation: "Let the mighty Gandhamadana, a difficult one to conquer like a proud elephant, take the battalion of army and stay on the right side"

raw: प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा परिष्वज्य च वीर्यवान् । जगामाकाशमाविश्य सुपर्णः पवनो यथा ॥६-५०-६०॥
translation: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.

raw: भर्तुरङ्कात् समुत्पत्य ततः कमललोचना । चन्द्रसूर्यो मया दृष्टा पाणिना परिमार्जती ॥५-२७-१५॥
translation: "Then I saw the lotuseyed Sita springing up from the lap of her husband and playfully caressing the Moon and Sun with her palms.

raw: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः । ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम् ॥५-३८-५७॥
translation: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.

raw: देव्य् अनूढा त्वम् अभवो युव राजो भवाम्य् अहम् । ततः प्रावृड् अनुप्राप्ता मद काम विवर्धिनी ॥२-६३-१४॥
translation: O Kausalya, you were not married then. I was prince regent. The rainy season that inflames passion and pride had just set in.

raw: नूनं न ते जनः कश्चिदसिन्निःश्रेयसे स्थितः । निवारयति यो न त्वां कर्मणोऽस्माद्विगर्हितात् ॥५-२०-१३॥
दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रयोर्जयमनवेक्ष्य रणे स राघवस्य । सुरवररथसारथिर्महान् रणगतमेनमुवाच वाक्यमाशु ॥६-११०-३८॥
एते वयमनुप्राप्ता स्सुग्रीव वरुणालयम् । इहेदानीं विचिन्ता साया नः पूर्वसमुत्थिता ॥६-४-१००॥
translation: Sugriva We have reached the ocean and now we have to think of that idea now, which we thought of earlier.

raw: बभूव ह्यस्य हृदते चिन्ता सुमहती तदा । त्वरया चापि दूतानाम् स्वप्नस्यापि च दर्शनात् ॥२-७०-२५॥
translation: Then his heart was filled with extreme anxiety due to the haste of the messengers to depart and also due to the dream he had.

raw: चिरात्सुमाली व्यचरद्रसातलं स राक्षसो विष्णुभयार्दितस्तदा । पुत्रैश्च पौत्रैश्च समन्वितो बली ततस्तु लङ्कामवसद्धनेश्वरः ॥७-८-२९॥
translation: For a long time, that powerful Rākṣasa Sumālī, tormented by fear of Viṣṇu, wandered in Rasātala accompanied by his sons and grandsons, while the lord of wealth (Kubera) then resided in Laṅkā. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टमः सर्गः ।। 8 ।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ते ऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदा ऽन्विताः । निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च ॥५-६४-३६॥
translation: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.

raw: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते । रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ॥५-३८-४॥
translation: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

raw: याश्च्यवन्तेऽम्बरात्ताराः पुण्यशेषसमावृताः । इमास्तास्सङ्गताः कृत्स्ना इति मेने हरिस्तदा ॥५-९-४३॥
translation: Seeing those women lying together Hanuman imagined them to be numerous meteors dropped from heaven after enjoying their merits, enjoyed and exhausted.

raw: अथ दत्त्वा स्वयं रक्षो मृगयामटते स्म तत् । तत्रापश्यत्ततो राम मयं नाम दितेः सुतम् ॥७-१२-३॥
translation: Then, Ravana himself, having given (leave to others), wandered for hunting, and there, O Rama, he saw Maya, the son of Diti.

raw: धृतिर्दृष्टिर्मतिर्दाक्ष्यं स कर्मसु न सीदति । स तैः संभावितः पूज्यः प्रतिपन्नप्रयोजनः ॥५-१-१९९॥
विनष्टा भक्षिता वा अप राक्षसैः वन चारिभिः । अशुभानि एव भूयिष्ठम् यथा प्रादुर् भवन्ति मे ॥३-५७-१९॥
translation: O heroic Lakshmana I see many inauspicious omens. I think Sita might have been lost or eaten away by the demons of the forest. There is no doubt about it.

raw: स सायकोराघवबाहुचोदितोदिशस्स्वभासादशसम्प्रकाशयन् । विधूमवैश्वानरभीमदर्शनोजगामशक्राशनिवीर्यविक्रमः ॥६-६७-१६९॥
translation: Discharged from Rama's arm, the terrific weapon went just as the Lord of god's weapon, which was like Indra's thunderbolt burning like fire, shining by its brilliance and went in all directions and cut the head of Vritasura.
