raw: वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ कस्य पुत्रौ महामुने । भूषयन्तौ इमम् देशम् चन्द्र सूर्यौ इव अंबरम् ॥१-५०-२०॥
translation: Great ascetic, these two young men with hair falling on their temples like the wings of a crow, each of them resemble the other in personality, expressions and gestures. Wielding excellent weapons they adorn this land like the Moon and the Sun deck the sky. Whose sons are they? I wish truly to hear about these heroes".

raw: त्वत्कृते च निमिष्यन्ति चक्षूंषि पृथिवीपते । वायुभूतेन चरता विश्रमार्थं मुहुर्मुहुः ॥७-५७-१६॥
translation: O King, for your sake, the eyes will blink repeatedly for rest, as you move within them as air.

raw: अवलिप्ते न जानासि त्वत्तः प्रियतरो मम । मनुजो मनुजव्याघ्राद्रामादन्यो न विद्यते ॥२-११-५॥
translation: O proud lady, don't you know there exists for me no woman dearer than you and no man other than Rama who is the best among men.

raw: वैहारिकाणां शिल्पानां विज्ञातार्थविभागवित् । आरोहे विनये चैव युक्तोवारणवाजिनाम् ॥२-१-२८॥
translation: He had understanding of art and craft useful for entertainment. He knew proper ways of dispensing wealth. He was experienced in riding elephants and horses and in humbling them.

raw: स मातामहम् आपृच्च्य मातुलम् च युधा जितम् । रथम् आरुह्य भरतः शत्रुघ्न सहितः ययौ ॥२-७०-२४॥
तदा वेगेन तत्रासीत्तेजः प्रज्वलितं मुहुः । वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता ज्वाला मेरौ यथा गिरौ ॥६-७६-८७॥
translation: Then by the speed of the hit on Sugriva's chest by Kumbha's fist a flame burst forth like the flame of Meru Mountain.

raw: प्रति उवाच ततः सीताम् भय संदर्शनम् वचः । शृणु मैथिलि मत् वाक्यम् मासान् द्वादश भामिनि ॥३-५६-२४॥
हिरण्यकशिपुः श्रीमान्नमुचिः शम्बरस्तथा । विसन्धिर्धूमकेतुश्च बलिर्वैरोचनो ऽपि च ॥७-२२-२४॥
translation: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.

raw: मया क्रीड महाराजसीतया किं तवानया । अकामां कामयानस्य शरीरमुपतप्यते । इच्छन्तीं कामयानस्य प्रीतिर्भवति शोभना ॥५-२०-३८॥
पुष्पेषूपहृतेष्वेवं रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । अवतीर्णो नदीं स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः ॥७-३१-३८॥
translation: When the flowers were thus brought, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, descended into the river to bathe, just like a great elephant entering the Ganga.

raw: ततः त्वाम् प्रस्थितम् दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्त आकुलम् मनः । त्वत् वृत्तम् चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेत् निःश्रेयसम् हितम् ॥३-९-१२॥
translation: I am, therefore, worried in my mind when I see you here and think of your wellbeing. I wish your ultimate good. [The next two lines appear, more or less, a repetition. So omitted : Editor]

raw: उत्सहेयम् अहम् कर्तुम् अद्य एव त्वाम् स पक्षकम् । इह स्थः त्वम् तु लोकानाम् हितम् कार्यम् करिष्यसि ॥४-६२-१३॥
translation: 'I am not enthusiastic about giving you the wings now. Remain here and carry on the work for the welfare of the world.

raw: अक्षतंजातरूपं च गावःकन्यास्सहद्विजाः । नरामोदकहस्ताश्चरामस्यपुरतोययुः ॥६-१३१-३८॥
translation: Taking yellow rice (rice smeared with turmeric) appearing like gold, cows, virgin women, brahmins with Modakas in hand went before Rama.

raw: आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतक्लमः । हनुमांस्त्वरितो वीरः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥६-७४-५५॥
translation: Hanuman who was equal to his father in prowess, went unwearied, hurriedly in the path of the Sun.

raw: ताम् आर्त रूपाम् विमना रुदन्तीम्सौमित्रिः आलोक्य विशाल नेत्राम् । आश्वासयामास न चैव भर्तुःतम् भ्रातरम् किंचित् उवाच सीता ॥३-४५-३९॥
translation: Saumitri saw the largeeyed, dejected Sita crying in distress.He pacified and consoled her but she did not say anything at all to her husband's brother.

raw: ते तु सर्वे सुविक्रान्ता दैतेया बलशालिनः । नानाप्रहरणास्तत्र प्रहृष्टा युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥७-२३-७॥
translation: All those Daityas were indeed very mighty, powerful, equipped with various weapons, and overjoyed and fierce in battle.

raw: तेषाम् सुतुमुलः शब्दः पूरयामास तद् वनम् । तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः श्वापदा वन चारिणः ॥३-२४-२९॥
प्रहृष्टवदन: सर्वा मातऽ: समभिवाद्य स: । आरुरोह रथं श्रीमान् शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वित: ॥२-११५-८॥
translation: With a cheerful countenance illustrious Bharata paid obeisance to all his mothers and, acompanied by Satrughna, ascended the chariot.

raw: स हि प्रसादे चात्यर्थं कोपे च हरिरीश्वरः । अतीत्य तस्य सन्देशं विनाशो गमने भवेत् ॥४-६५-३१॥
translation: 'The monkey king has the authority to shower grace or give vent to his anger. If we go without fulfilling the task we will face destruction.

raw: प्रत्यक्षं वानरेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् । त्वया सन्त्यक्तया वीर त्यक्तं स्याज्जीवितं मया ॥६-११९-१२॥
translation: "O hero! Had you given me up immediately on receiving your message from Vanara I would have given up my life in the presence of Hanuman there itself."

raw: उद्धृत्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ स्म परिवर्तते । हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत् ॥६-११३-९॥
translation: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.

raw: गदामादाय सङ्क्रुद्धो मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः । हरीन् समभिदुद्राव युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥६-७०-५४॥
translation: Matta, the Rakshasa leader became very furious and took hold of the mace glowing like fire, at the time of dissolution of the universe and scattered the monkeys.

raw: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गः किङ्किणीशतभूषितः । तरुणादित्यसङ्काशो वैडूर्यमयकूबरः ॥६-१०३-६॥
कुलीनान् रूप सम्पन्नान् गजान् पर गज आरुजान् । निष्ठितान् गज शिखायाम् ऐरावत समान् युधि ॥५-६-३२॥
translation: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.

raw: एषा ऽसि निर्जिता भद्रे शत्रुं जित्वा मया रणे । पौरुषाद्यदनुष्ठेयं तदेतदुपपादितम् ॥६-११८-२॥
translation: "O Auspicious Sita! You are won by destruction of the enemy in the battlefield. What was worth doing has been done with all my effort."

raw: स तु विश्वासितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना । उत्थाय सुमहाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं दधिमुखो ऽब्रवीत् ॥५-६३-३॥
translation: When great Sugriva gave assurance to wise Dadhimukha, he got up and said:

raw: सा त्वेवमुक्ता धर्मज्ञा तया प्रीततरा ऽभवत् । सफलं च प्रहर्षं ते हन्त सीते करोम्यहम् ॥२-११८-१७॥
translation: When Sita said so, Anasuya who knew her righteous duty was immensely pleased. and replied, 'What a joy I shall make the words you have spoken come true'.

raw: व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः । समागळितकेशान्ताः सस्वेदवदनास्तथा ॥५-१८-१६॥
translation: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.

raw: रावण अन्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता । जनकस्य आत्मजाम् राज्ञः तस्याम् द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम् ॥४-५८-२३॥
translation: 'You will see in the city of Lanka, the princess from Videha, daughter of Janaka, a picture of dejection, robed in silk, confined in the harem of Ravana, wellprotected by demonesses.

raw: तम् प्रविष्टम् रिपुम् दृष्ट्वा बिलम् रोष वशम् गतः । माम् उवाच ततो वाली वचनम् क्षुभित इन्द्रियः ॥४-९-१२॥
translation: 'Seeing the enemy entering the cave, Vali became wrathful and his senses were terribly disturbed.He said to me:

raw: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुर्व्रणाः । सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः ॥६-५०-३९॥
translation: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.

raw: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत् सुमुखेरितम् । उवाच राघवो वाक्यं नीलं सेनापतिं तदा ॥६-६१-३४॥
translation: Hearing the words of Vibheeshana, which was reasonable and, in their favour, Raghava said this to Nila, the commander in chief of the army.

raw: अनाथो हृत राज्यो अयम् रावणेन च धर्षितः । दीनो दूर गृहः कामी माम् चैव शरणम् गतः ॥४-३०-६६॥
तमूरुवेगोन्मथिताःसालाश्चन्ये नगोत्तमाः । अनुजग्मुर्हनूमन्तं सैन्या इव महीपतिम् ॥५-१-४८॥
translation: Uprooted by the force of Hanuman's thighs,great trees like sala followed him just like the troops follow the king.

raw: त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरम् अनुत्तमम् । कस्य शक्तिः श्रियम् दातुम् भरताय अरि शासन ॥२-२१-१५॥
translation: What authority, O Rama, chastiser of foes, this king has to bestow the kingdom upon Bharata by entering into undesirable hostility towards you and me?

raw: विद्युद्भिः इव विक्षिप्तैः आकाशम् अभवत् तदा । पाण्डुरैः सलिल उत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा ॥१-४३-२२॥
चित्रकूटम् त्वयि प्राप्ते विमानैः अतुल प्रभैः । इतः ते दिवम् आरूढा यान् अहम् पर्यचारिषम् ॥३-७४-१४॥
translation: The men I served have ascended heaven on aerial chariots of incomparable radiance the moment you touched Chitrakuta.

raw: तावुभौ युगपद्वीरौ हनुमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ । उल्काहस्तौ तदा रात्रौ रणशीर्षे विचेरतुः ॥६-७४-७॥
translation: The two heroes, Hanuman and Vibheeshana, and the foremost of Rakshasas with torch in hand searched for the left over Vanaras in the battlefield.

raw: प्रसन्न सलिले रम्ये तस्मिन् सरसि शुश्रुवे । गीत वादित्र निर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते ॥३-११-७॥
translation: In that lake of clear waters they heard the sounds of songs and musical instruments, while there were none around.

raw: आज्ञापयद्राक्षसेन्द्रः पुरं सर्वं सचत्वरम् । लाङ्गूलेन प्रदीप्तेन रक्षोभिः परिणीयताम् ॥५-५३-५॥
translation: "Then all his friends, relatives and his kinsmen will see his disfigured and handicapped form. The demon king having ordered thus, the monkey was taken by the ogres round the junctions of the roads all over the city with his tail on fire.

raw: क्षुब्धानां सागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः । व्यथिताः पन्नगाः सर्वे दानवाश्च सहस्रशः ॥६-११०-१८॥
translation: By the agitation and sounds in the seas, all the Danavas and snakes in thousands inhabiting the seas got distressed.

raw: भ्रातृभिः च सुरान् युद्धे समग्रान् न अभिचिंतये । तत् सहायो भव त्वम् मे समर्थो हि असि राक्षस ॥३-३६-१५॥
translation: You are mighty. I do not care to fight even the gods when you and my brothers are by my side. Therefore, O demon, be my accomplice. (I know) you are capable of that.

raw: जनकानाम् कुले कीर्तिम् आहरिष्यति मे सुता । सीता भर्तारम् आसाद्य रामम् दशरथ आत्मजम् ॥१-६७-२२॥
translation: By receiving Rama, son of Dasaratha, as her husband, my daughter Sita will bring glory to my dynasty.

raw: न शक्या यज्ञ मध्यस्था वेदिः स्रुक् भाण्ड मण्डिता । द्विजाति मंत्र संपूता चण्डालेन अवमर्दितुम् ॥३-५६-१८॥
translation: The sacrificial altar adorned with ladles and vessels and sanctified by the sacred mantras recited by brahmins cannot be defiled by a chandala (man of lowest caste).

raw: सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः । भवन्ति बहुविघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि ॥२-४-२४॥
translation: Many impediments befall acts of this sort indeed. Alert your friends to protect you from all sides today onwards.

raw: निवार्यमाणस्य मया हित एषिणा । न रोचते ते वचनम् निशा चर । परीत काला हि गत आयुषो नरा । हितम् न गृह्णन्ति सुहृद्भिर् ईरितम् ॥६-१६-२७॥
translation: "O King My words (of advice), given in your interest to prevent you, are not palatable to you. Good advice tendered by friends at the time of death will not be received by those beings whose life is over." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषोडशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the sixteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ततः समुद्र द्वीपान् च सुभीमान् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ । ऊर्मिमंतम् महारौद्रम् क्रोशंतम् अनिल उद्धितम् ॥४-४०-३६॥
translation: 'Then you may continue your search in the frightening islands of the sea as well as the sea which roars when stirred up by the wind.

raw: ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च । प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिदृक्षवः ॥५-५७-२६॥
translation: The vanaras were very happy. Longing to see Hanuman, they jumped from one tree top to another and from one peak of a mountain to the other.

raw: सरय्वाः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिर् विधीयताम् । सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रान् अभिप्रेतान् च पार्थिव ॥१-८-१२॥
ते पादपशिलाशैलैश्चक्रुर्वृष्टिमनूपमाम् । बाणौघैर्वायमाणाश्च हरयो भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-६९-४९॥
translation: The Vanaras of dreadful valour and unparalleled might waged with trees, rock and mountain when obstructed by the Rakshasas।।

raw: रावणेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो रथानारुरुहुस्तदा ॥६-९६-३०॥
translation: Duly permitted by Ravana, Mahaparsva and Mahodara who are difficult to overpower and also Virupaksha ascended their chariots.

raw: इहोपहारं भूतानां बलवान् रावणात्मजः । उपहृत्य ततः पश्चात् सङ्ग्राममभिवर्तते ॥६-८७-४॥
translation: "Mighty son of Ravana having offered oblations for all beings he comes to the battlefield. (Said Vibheeshana)"

raw: तं क्षिप्रतरमाप्लुत्य परामृश्याङ्गदो बली । करेण तस्य तं खड्गं समाच्छिद्य ननाद च ॥६-७६-९॥
translation: Mighty Angada springing up at a higher speed grasped his (Sonitaksha) hand and irritated him with a sword making loud noise.

raw: एष्टव्या बहव: पुत्रा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुता: । तेषां वै समवेतानामपि कश्चिद्गयां व्रजेत् ॥२-१०७-१३॥
translation: One should desire many virtuous and learned sons so that at least one of them may go to Gaya (to perform the father's obsequies).

raw: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता । सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता ॥७-२६-१४॥
translation: At that very moment, Rambha, the foremost of all Apsaras, appeared there, adorned with divine ornaments and divine flowers.

raw: यक्षाणां तु प्रहस्तेन सहस्रं निहतं रणे । महोदरेण चानिन्द्यं सहस्रमपरं हतम् ॥७-१५-७॥
translation: Indeed, a thousand Yakshas were slain in battle by Prahasta, and another thousand blameless (excellent) Yaksha warriors were slain by Mahodara.

raw: कृत कृत्या हि वैदेही चाया इव अनुगता पतिम् । न जहाति रता धर्मे मेरुम् अर्क प्रभा यथा ॥२-४०-२४॥
translation: Sita, deeply attached to her duty, and with her desire fulfilled is following her husband like a shadow just as the sunlight which never leaves mount Meru.

raw: कत्थसे किं वृथा रक्षो बहून्यसदृशानि तु । न रणे शक्यते जेतुं विना युद्धेन वाग्बलात् ॥६-७९-१८॥
translation: "Rakshasa! Why so much of wasteful talk about What you can't accomplish? Victory is not possible on the battlefield with your force of speech"

raw: स बाष्प कलया वाचा कल हम्स स्वरः युवा । विललाप सभा मध्ये जगर्हे च पुरोहितम् ॥२-८२-१०॥
translation: Young Bharata with the melodious voice of a swan, choked with tears, lamenting in the assembly, reproached the family priest Vasistha, saying:

raw: स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः । जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः ॥६-५९-१०६॥
translation: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.

raw: अथ अंगद वचः श्रुत्वा तेन एव च समागतौ । मंत्रिणो वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मत उदार दर्शिनौ ॥४-३१-४२॥
translation: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

raw: ज्योत्स्ना तुषार मलिना पौर्णमास्याम् न राजते । सीता इव च आतप श्यामा लक्ष्यते न तु शोभते ॥३-१६-१४॥
translation: On a fullmoon night the beams of the moon faded by forest look pale, dull like Sita scorched by the heat of the Sun.

raw: विवर्जितो नरै: पापैर्मम पूर्वै: सुरक्षित: । कच्चिज्जनपद: स्फीत: सुखं वसति राघव ॥२-१००-४७॥
translation: O Bharata, my country which is marked with hundreds of sanctuaries near villages where life of the people is made comfortable, where there are shrines, water distribution facilities and tanks, which is wellploughed and rich in cattlewealth, free from violence and independent of rain. It is enchanting. It is safe from wild animals. With fears expelled, free from sinful people, adorned with mines and wellprotected by my ancestors, it is prosperous and I hope people are living comfortably.

raw: कृत्वा शाप समायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरः तदा । शुनःशेपम् उवाच आर्तम् कृत्वा रक्षाम् निरामयाम् ॥१-६२-१८॥
translation: Viswamitra the best of ascetics, thus cursed his sons. Sunassepha, (now) was filled with distress. To relieve him of his pain he said:

raw: किं निमित्तमिमं देशं कृष्णाजिनजटाधर: । हित्वा राज्यं प्रविष्टस्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-३॥
translation: What made you come to this region, leaving the kingdom and wearing deer skin and matted hair? You should tell me everything.

raw: कशाभिः इव हैमीभिः विद्युद्भिः इव ताडितम् । अन्तः स्तनित निर्घोषम् सवेदनम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-११॥
translation: 'The sky lashed with lightnings with whips of gold and emitting groans in the form of peals of thunder, appears as though crying in severe pain.

raw: ततस्तु तत्स्यन्दननिःस्वनं च मृदङ्गभेरीपटहस्वनं च । विकृष्यमाणस्य च कार्मुकस्य निशम्य घोषं पुनरुत्पपात ॥५-४८-३०॥
translation: Thereupon, hearing the rumbling of the chariot, the sounds of mrudangas, bheris, and patahas drawing towards him, and percieving the loud twang of the bow (of Indrajit) Hanuman sprang up again.

raw: प्रक्षिव्य नरके सा त्वम् कैकेयि सुखिता भव । मया रामेण च त्यक्तम् शाश्वतम् सत्कृतम् गुणैः ॥२-१२-९२॥
ततो देवसखो नाम पर्वतः पतग आलय । नाना पक्षि समाकीर्णो विविध द्रुम भूषितः ॥४-४३-१७॥
translation: 'Then proceed to mount Devasakha inhabited by a variety of birds adorning the trees.

raw: तेन गन्धर्व यक्षाणाम् देवतानाम् च रक्षसाम् । अवध्योऽस्मि इति वागुक्ता तथेति उक्तम् च तन् मया ॥१-१५-१३॥
translation: When he asked gandharvas, yakshas, gods, demons or rakshasas should never be able to kill him, I said, "So be it".

raw: ततः पुष्करिणीम् वीरौ पंपाम् नाम गमिष्यथः । अशर्कराम् अविभ्रंशाम् सम तीर्थम् अशैवलाम् ॥३-७३-११॥
एवम् उक्तः सुर पतिः प्रमुमोच महाबलः । तेजसा पृथिवी येन व्याप्ता स गिरि कानना ॥१-३६-१६॥
translation: Thus replied by the devatas, the god of the gods released his vital fluid on earth. It pervaded the entire earth including mountains and forests.

raw: तस्य राक्षसराजस्य तथा त्वम् कुरु राघव । दृष्ट्वा ताम् हि पुरीम् लङ्काम् त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम् ॥६-२-१०॥
अद्य ते भिन्न कण्ठस्य फेन बुद्बुद भूषितम् । विदारितस्य मत् बाणैः मही पास्यति शोणितम् ॥३-३०-६॥
translation: Now with your throat split open by my arrows , the earth will drink your foamy blood full of bubbles.

raw: तं च देहं नरेन्द्रस्य रक्षन्ति स्म द्विजोत्तमाः । गन्धैर्माल्यैश्च वस्त्रैश्च पौरभृत्यसमन्विताः ॥७-५७-११॥
translation: And the best among the twice-born, accompanied by citizens and servants, protected that body of the king with fragrances, garlands, and clothes.

raw: शर जाल आवृतः सूर्यो न तदा स्म प्रकाशते । अन्योन्य वध संरम्भात् उभयोः संप्रयुध्यतोः ॥३-२८-९॥
translation: While they were engaged in the battle, eager to kill each other the sky was covered with arrow and the Sun could not be seen.

raw: स सम्तीर्य महाबाहुः श्रीमान् शिवमकण्टकम् । प्रापद्यत महामार्गमभयम् भयदर्शिनाम् ॥२-४६-२९॥
translation: Having crossed the river, the mightyarmed and gracious Rama proceeded on the auspicious and thornless highway arousing confidence even in the timid.

raw: भवन्तो मम सर्वस्वं भवन्तो जीवितं मम । भवद्भिश्च कृतं राज्यं पालयामि नरेश्वराः ॥७-४४-१९॥
translation: Rama declared to the kings that they were his everything and his very life, and that he ruled the kingdom which they had helped establish.

raw: अभिपूज्य तदा हृष्टाः सर्वे चक्रुः यथा विधि । प्रातः सवन पूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुंगवाः ॥१-१४-५॥
translation: Thereafter the eminent ascetics, rejoicing in their hearts performed the worship (of celestial beings) and conducted the prescribed rituals starting with morning ablutions etc.

raw: निक्षिप्य परमायत्तो निकुम्भं निष्पिपेष ह । उत्पत्य चास्य वेगेन पपातोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-७७-२२॥
translation: Throwing down Nikumbha with great effort, Hanuman endowed with speed sprang up and fell on his chest.

raw: सा च कामैः प्रलोभ्यन्ती भक्ष्यैः भोज्यैः च मैथिली । न भोक्ष्यति महाभागा दुःख मग्ना यशस्विनी ॥४-६२-७॥
translation: 'Immersed in grief, chaste and famed Sita, will not take any food or enjoy pleasures however much she is tempted.

raw: यो हि शत्रुं समुत्पाट्य पार्थिवस्य पुनः क्षये । न विधत्ते नृपं तत्र नरकं स हि गच्छति ॥७-६२-१८॥
translation: Indeed, whoever uproots an enemy and, in the destruction of that king's domain, does not establish a new ruler there, he certainly goes to hell.

raw: काचिद्दध्यौ सुदुःखार्ता अपि मां मारयेदयम् । इति मातृपितऽन्स्मृत्वा भर्तऽन्भ्रातऽंस्तथैव च । दुःखशोकसमाविष्टा विलेपुः सहिताः स्त्रियः ॥७-२४-१२॥
translation: Some, greatly distressed, wondered if Rāvaṇa would kill them, and thus, remembering their mothers, fathers, husbands, and brothers, all the women together lamented, overcome by pain and sorrow.

raw: कस्य रूपम् इदम् दृष्ट्वा जांबूनदमय प्रभम् । नाना रत्नमयम् दिव्यम् न मनो विस्मयम् व्रजेत् ॥३-४३-३०॥
translation: Whose mind will not be filled with wonder on seeing this divine beauty glittering like lustrous gold and studded with a variety of gems ?

raw: सह नूनं मम भ्रात्रा पुरस्यास्यद्युतिर्गता । नहि राजत्ययोध्येयं सासारेवार्जुनी क्षपा ॥२-११४-२७॥
translation: Certainly splendour has left along with my brother. Like the night when the rain pours down during the waning of the Moon, Ayodhya shines not.

raw: सा सेना शक्रयुक्तेव नगरान्निर्ययावथ । राघवानुगता दूरं दुराधर्षा सुरैरपि ॥७-१००-२१॥
translation: That army, as if accompanied by Indra, then departed far from the city, following Bharata, and was unconquerable even by the gods.

raw: नभस्थलम् विशेयुर् च गृह्णीयुर् अपि तोयदान् । गृह्णीयुर् अपि मातंगान् मत्तान् प्रव्रजतो वने ॥१-१७-२८॥
योजयस्व रथं शीघ्रमद्य भागीरथीजलम् । शिरसा धारयिष्यामि त्र्यम्बकः पर्वते यथा ॥७-४६-२०॥
translation: Lakshmana instructed the charioteer to quickly harness the chariot, stating that he would bear the waters of the Bhagirathi on his head today, just as Lord Shiva bears them on the mountain.

raw: गंगायाः पतनम् राजन् पृथिवी न सहिष्यते । ताम् वै धारयितुम् राजन् न अन्यम् पश्यामि शूलिनः ॥१-४२-२४॥
translation: 'O King Ganga's descent cannot be sustained by earth. O Hero I do not see any other person to hold her than the wielder of the trident (Siva)'.

raw: तद् राज गुण सम्पन्नम् मुख्यैः च वर चन्दनैः । भेरी मृदन्ग अभिरुतम् शन्ख घोष विनादितम् ॥५-६-११॥
तद्धि यज्ञ फलम् तेन मैथिलेन उत्तमम् धनुः । याचितम् नर शार्दूल सुनाभम् सर्व दैवतैः ॥१-३१-१२॥
translation: O best among men, that excellent bow strong in the middle was offered by king of Mithila, Devarata as well as by all devatas as fruit of the sacrifice.

raw: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ तत् सैन्यं सम्प्रचुक्षुभे । अभवच्च महान् क्रोधः समरे रावणस्य तु ॥६-९९-२३॥
translation: Mahaparsva having fallen down in the battle, the army was bewildered, and Ravana was overcome with anger.

raw: या मम् अनुगता मन्दम् पित्रा प्रस्थापितुम् वनम् । सीता धर्मम् समास्थय क्व नु सा वर्तते प्रिया ॥४-१-१०७॥
translation: Where now is my beloved Sita, who, treading the path of virtue, followed me—unfortunate, banished to the forest by my father?

raw: सानुक्रोशाम् वदान्याम् च धर्मज्ञाम् च यशस्विनीम् । कौसल्याम् शरणम् यामः सा हि नो अस्तु ध्रुवा गतिः ॥२-७८-१५॥
translation: Let us seek refuge under the illustrious Kausalya, who is compassionate, generous, and knower of righteousness. She is our sure saviour.

raw: तान् पार्थिवान् वारणयूथपाभान् समागतांस्तत्र महत्यरण्ये । वनौकसस्तेऽपि समीक्ष्य सर्वेप्यश्रूण्यमुञ्चन् प्रविहाय हर्षम् ॥२-९९-४२॥
translation: On seeing the princes now assembled in the great forest like mighty leaders of elephant herds, inhabitants of the forest had nothing but tears of grief, not joy, to shed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: सौमित्रे यो अभिषेक अर्थे मम सम्भार सम्भ्रमः । अभिषेक निवृत्ति अर्थे सो अस्तु सम्भार सम्भ्रमः ॥२-२२-५॥
translation: O Lakshmana the same enthusiasm with which preparations for my consecration were made be shown for the cessation of those arrangements.

raw: ऋक्षाः शाखामृगाश्चापि द्रुमाद्रिनखयोधिनः । अभ्यधावन्त सहितास्तदनीकमवस्थितम् ॥६-८६-७॥
translation: The Bears and monkeys together initiated a fight with the army with trees, mountains, and nails as weapons.

raw: धर्मात् प्रच्युतशीलं हि पुरुषं पापनिश्चयम् । त्यक्त्वा सुखमवाप्नोति हस्तादाशीविषं यथा ॥६-८७-२२॥
translation: "The association of one who has renounced righteousness and is of sinful deeds is left by a righteous man who undoubtedly attains happiness, is like shaking of a venomous serpent from the hand."

raw: यदि ह्यन्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः । म्रियते वा दशग्रीवस्तदाप्युभयतो ऽनृतम् ॥७-२२-४४॥
translation: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).

raw: न सत्यम् दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः । तथा बलकराः सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्मता ॥२-३०-३५॥
translation: Truth or munificence or homage or distribution of gifts to the revered ones or sacrifices, O Sita, are not considered as efficacious as service to father.

raw: निष्क्रांतस्य जनस्थानात् सह भ्रात्रा यथा सुखम् । नाम मात्रम् तु जानामि न रूपम् तस्य रक्षसः ॥३-७१-२२॥
औपवाह्यम् रथम् युक्त्वा त्वम् आयाहि हय उत्तमैः । प्रापय एनम् महा भागम् इतः जन पदात् परम् ॥२-३९-१०॥
translation: Harness the finest horses to the chariot suitable for the journey, drive this magnanimous Rama to a place outside the city, and come back.

raw: तम् दृष्ट्वा नागरः सर्वे क्रुद्धा राजानम् अब्रुवन् । असमन्जम् वृषीण्व एकम् अस्मान् वा राष्ट्र वर्धन ॥२-३६-२०॥
translation: Watching it, all the enraged citizens said to the king, 'O enhancer of the prosperity of the kingdom, either you choose Asamanjasa or us'.

raw: ततो राक्षसशार्दूलो विद्राव्य हरिवाहिनीम् । स ददर्श ततो रामं तिष्ठन्तमपारजितम् ॥६-१००-११॥
translation: Thereafter, the tiger among Rakshasas having routed the Vanaras from there, saw the lotus petaleyed Rama, endowed with long arms, an unconquered one, the tamer of enemies, standing with his brother Lakshmana like Lord Vishnu with Indra, holding a huge bow that was scraping the sky.

raw: तम् एवम् शोक सम्तप्तम् भरतम् केकयी सुतम् । उवाच वदताम् श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठः श्रेष्ठ वाग् ऋषिः ॥२-७६-१॥
translation: Vasistha, the most eloquent and the best of ascetics said to Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi who was tormented with grief:

raw: न स क्षमः कोपयितुम् यः प्रसाद्य पुनर् भवेत् । पूर्व उपकारम् स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः ॥४-३२-२०॥
translation: 'He who deserves propitiation, should not be offended, more so by a grateful man, remembering the help received by him earlier.

raw: यथा मधुकर्स्तराषात्काशपुष्पम् पिबन्नपि । रसमत्र न विन्देत तथानार्येषु सौहृदम् ॥६-१६-१४॥
translation: "Just as honeybees do not stay at the flower after satisfaction with the nectar, in the same way is the friendship with unworthy ones."

raw: तौ तु क्रूरेण निहतौ रक्षसा कामरूपिणा । असृक् सुस्रुवतुस्तीव्रं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव ॥६-४५-२१॥
translation: Wounded by the cruel Rakshasas capable of changing form at their will, blood flowed from their body copiously like water from spring bringing out their vital life breaths.

raw: अस्मिन् कार्ये विनिवृत्ते कृते दाशरथेः प्रिये । ऋणान् मुक्ता भविष्यामः कृत अर्था अर्थविदाम् वराः ॥४-४३-५॥
translation: 'We should be succeessful in our endeavour when we have completed the task dear to Rama. We will be redeemed of our debt to him.

raw: जनस्थान समीपे च समाक्रम्य खर स्वनाः । विस्वरान् विविधान् च चक्रुः मांस आदा मृग पक्षिणः ॥३-२३-५॥
translation: Flesheating beasts and birds flocked at Janasthana producing a cacophony.

raw: लताः समनुवर्तन्ते मत्ता इव वर स्त्रियः । पादपात् पादपम् गच्छन् शैलात् शैलम् वनात् वनम् ॥४-१-८५॥
काम वृत्तम् च सुग्रीवम् नष्टाम् च जनक आत्मजाम् । दृष्ट्वा कालम् अतीतम् च मुमोह परम आतुरः ॥४-३०-३॥
translation: While Sugriva was in his residence, Rama was (in Prasravana mountain) spending his rainy nights tormented by passion (for Sita). Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. When the sky became clear of clouds after the rainy season, Rama sat gazing at the clear autumnal Moon's orb. He was besmeared with moonlight and felt perturbed as time was running out. And then fell into a swoon. (only a few months remained for the completion of the exile and Bharata will put an end to himself if Rama does not return to Ayodhya on the stipulated day. This worried Rama.)

raw: प्रहृष्टः तु अभवत् तेन वचनेन स राक्षसः । परिष्वज्य सुसंश्लिष्टम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-४२-५॥
translation: Ravana was so overwhelmed with joy to hear those words that he embraced him tightly and said:.

raw: इति उक्त्वा राघवः क्रुद्धो भार्गवस्य वर आयुधम् । शरम् च प्रतिजग्राह हस्तात् लघु पराक्रमः ॥१-७६-४॥
translation: Having spoken thus, the enraged Rama, gifted with quick vigour, seized the bow and arrow from Parasurama's hands.

raw: ततः स कपिशार्दूलः स्वामिसन्दर्शनोत्सुकः । आरुरोह गिरिश्रेष्ठमरिष्टमरिमर्दनः ॥५-५६-९॥
translation: Then Hanuman, the crusher of enemies, a tiger among vanaras anxious to see his lord ascended the mount Arishta.

raw: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । समेयुर्द्वैरथं दृष्टुं रावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः ॥६-१०८-१८॥
translation: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas and sages longing for the end of Ravana came there to witness the duel.

raw: रुरून् अपेता अपजयान् दृष्ट्वा शोकम् प्रहास्यसि । राम तस्य तु शैलस्य महती शोभते गुहा ॥३-७३-३९॥
सा राक्षसानाम् प्रवरेण बाला । स्व शील सम्रक्षण तत् परा सती । अनेन नूनम् प्रतिदुष्ट कर्मणा । हता भवेद् आर्य पथे परे स्थिता ॥५-१२-३॥
translation: 'Janaki, follower of noble path, anxious to protect her chastity must have been killed by the wicked demon king.

raw: अवेक्षमाणः चारेण प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षयन् । प्रजानाम् पालनम् कुर्वन् अधर्मम् परिवर्जयन् ॥१-७-२१॥
एते ते शैल राजस्य सुते लोक नमस्कृते । गंगा च सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा उमादेवी च राघव ॥१-३५-२२॥
translation: O son of the Raghus Ganga, the holiest of rivers and Uma devi are two daughters of the king of the mountains, (Himavan). They are worshipped by the entire world.

raw: बभूव परमप्रीता सिद्धिं प्राप्येव मन्थरा । अथ सा रुषिता देवी सम्यक्कृत्वा विनिश्चयम् ॥२-१०-५॥
उपहारश्च कर्तव्यः कुसुमैः स्वयमाहृतैः । आर्षेण विधिना वेद्याम् बाले दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१६॥
translation: Flowers collected with one's own hands, O innocent one, should be offered on the altar as per injunction of the Vedas. Therefore (life in the) forest is difficult.

raw: पुरा प्राकारमायान्ति क्षिप्रमेकतरम् कुरु । सीताम् वास्मै प्रयच्चाशु युद्धम् वापि प्रदीयताम् ॥६-२४-३५॥
translation: "They will reach the boundary wall. At once you may do one of the two that I suggest you do. I implore you either to give away Sita or give good battle."

raw: अथायोध्यां समासाद्य रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ॥७-१९-५॥
translation: Then, Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, having reached Ayodhya...

raw: वस्वौकसारां नलिनीमत्येतीवोत्तरान् कुरून् । पर्वतश्चित्रकूटो ऽसौ बहुमूलफलोदक: ॥२-९४-२६॥
translation: This Chitrakuta mountain, with abundance of roots, fruits and water surpasses in beauty Vasvaukasara, the capital city of Kubera or Nalini, his celestial garden or the land of Uttarakuru.

raw: उपकार फलम् मित्रम् अपकारो अरि लक्षणम् । अद्य एव तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्या अपहारिणम् ॥४-८-२१॥
translation: 'While a friend is known for his help, an enemy is known for his offensiveness. I will this very day kill the one who wrested your wife.

raw: आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघवः । उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्निं जलौघैरिव वासवः ॥६-१०४-२३॥
translation: Raghava intercepted the trident, just as the fire was obstructed by the flow of water, at the time of universal dissolution, and obstructed.

raw: संविवेशाबला भूमौ निवेश्य भृकुटिं मुखे । ततश्चित्राणि माल्यानि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च ॥२-१०-६॥
तप्यमानम् समाज्ञाय वयस्याः प्रिय वादिनः । आयासम् हि विनेष्यन्तः सभायाम् चक्रिरे कथाः ॥२-६९-३॥
translation: Observing him griefstricken his peers who always spoke pleasant words, engaged him in a variety of ways in the assembly in order to divert him.

raw: पुष्प सम्चय चित्रेषु चन्दन अगरु गन्धिषु । पाण्डुर अभ्र प्रकाशेषु शुक सम्घ रुतेषु च ॥२-८८-६॥
translation: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).

raw: अधार्यम् चर्म मे सद्भी रोमाणि अस्थि च वर्जितम् । अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि त्वत् विधैः धर्मचारिभिः ॥४-१७-३८॥
translation: 'My skin is not fit to be worn by the virtuous, my hair and bones are also prohibited from any use. My flesh is also not at all fit to be eaten by righteous people like you

raw: ते द्विजाः पूर्णकलशैः सर्वतीर्थाम्बुसत्कृतैः । गृहीत्वा फलमूलं च रामस्याभ्याहरन्बहु ॥७-६०-८॥
translation: Those Brahmins brought many offerings for Rama, including full pitchers honored with waters from all sacred pilgrimage sites, and various fruits and roots.

raw: तेषां निविशमानानां सैन्यसन्नाहनिस्स्वनः । अन्तर्धाय महानादमर्णवस्य प्रशुश्रुवे ॥६-४-१०९॥
translation: The noise of the ocean was drowned by the great sound produced by the assembly of the army quartered there.

raw: अयोध्या ऽपि पुरी रम्या शून्या वर्षगणान्बहून् । ऋषभं प्राप्य राजानं निवासमुपयास्यति ॥७-१११-९॥
translation: The beautiful city of Ayodhya, which has been deserted for many years, will once again become inhabited when King Rishabha takes the throne.

raw: शाद्वलेषु यद् आसिष्ये वन अन्ते वन गोरचा । कुथा आस्तरण तल्पेषु किम् स्यात् सुखतरम् ततः ॥२-३०-१४॥
translation: O rover of the forest I will feel happier when I sleep on the meadows (of tender green grass) on the outskirts of the forest than when I sleep on the couch spread with carpets.

raw: वरप्राप्तिं पितुस्ते तु ज्ञात्वेश्वरतपोबलात् । तपस्तप्तुं गता मेरुं भ्रातरः कृतनिश्चयाः ॥७-५-९॥
translation: Having learned of their father's boon obtained through the power of Shiva's penance, the brothers, having made a firm resolve, went to Mount Meru to perform penance.

raw: एतां बुद्धिं तदा कृत्वा सीता सा तनुमध्यमा । न प्रतिव्याजहाराथ वानरं जनकात्मजा ॥५-३४-२६॥
translation: Having entertained such thoughts, Sita, the lady with a fairwaist, daughter of Janaka, did not respond to the vanara.

raw: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा मधुष्यन्द आदयः सुताः । स अभिमानम् नरश्रेष्ठ स लीलम् इदम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-६२-१३॥
translation: "O Best of men (Rama) in response to the words of the sage Madhuchanda and others said thus in a casual way with selfesteem.

raw: रंभाम् अप्सरसम् शक्रः सह सर्वैः मरुत् गणैः । उवाच आत्म हितम् वाक्यम् अहितम् कौशिकस्य च ॥१-६३-२६॥
translation: Indra along with all the maruts spoke to the celestial nymph Rambha, words that augured well for them and not for kaushika (Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: ततो द्रुतं रावणवाक्यचोदितः प्रचोदयामास हयान् स सारथिः । स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य ततो महारथः क्षणेन रामस्य रणाग्रतो ऽभवत् ॥६-१०६-२९॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १२३ ॥६-१२३-२५॥
सुमहन् नो बलम् कस्माद् विषादम् भजते भवान् । त्वया भोगवतीम् गत्वा निर्जताः पन्नगा युधि ॥६-७-३॥
translation: "Why are you despondent? You have huge and mighty army strength. When you went to Bhogavathi, the Nagas were subdued in war by your mighty army."

raw: प्रहेतिर्धार्मिकस्तत्र तपोवनगतस्तदा । हेतिर्दारक्रियार्थे तु परं यत्नमथाकरोत् ॥७-४-१५॥
translation: At that time, Praheti, being righteous, went to a hermitage, while Heti made a great effort to find a wife.

raw: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वायोः अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः । अपहास्य ततो वाक्यम् कन्या शतम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-३२-१८॥
translation: At the works of the untiringly blowing Windgod the lunged maidens laughed and said:

raw: अद्य मत्कार्मुकोत्सृष्टं शरवर्षं दुरासदम् । मुक्तं वर्षमिवाकाशे वारयिष्यथ संयुगे ॥६-८८-६॥
translation: "See my valour and prowess now. I will release shower of arrows from the sky like rain and it will be difficult for others to counter."

raw: न राम रामानुज शासनम् त्वयाकपीन्द्र युक्तम् मनसा अपि अपोहितुम् । मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषम् बलम्स राघवस्य अस्य सुरेन्द्र वर्चसः ॥४-३२-२२॥
translation: 'O king of monkeys It is not right for you to overlook the commands of Rama or Lakshmana even in mind. You know the superhuman virtues of Rama, particularly his valour. The two brothers are like Indra (and Upendra) in valour and might. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: तिष्ठ इति राजा चुक्रोष याहि याहि इति राघवः । सुमन्त्रस्य बभूव आत्मा चक्रयोः इव च अन्तरा ॥२-४०-४६॥
translation: The king cried, 'Stay, Stay', while Rama said 'Go on, Go on'. Sumantra's mind was caught as if in between two wheels.

raw: रामस्य एवम् ब्रुवाणस्य त्वरितस्य युयुत्सया । प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः स उपाध्याय पुरोहिता ॥१-३०-८॥
translation: While he was fracing up for a fight, the fire on the sacrificial altar with the officiating priests and spiritual guides suddenly brightened.

raw: तृप्तिर्न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मा ऽपि वने सत्वनिषेविते । पुरा तु भिक्षमाणाय भिक्षा वै यतये नृप । न हि दत्ता त्वयेन्द्राभ यस्मादतिथये ऽपि वै ॥७-७८-१६॥
translation: O King, even a little satisfaction is not yours in this forest inhabited by creatures, because formerly, O Indra-like one, you did not give alms to a begging ascetic, nor indeed to any guest.

raw: क्वचिद् अर्ध अवशेषाणि क्वचित् पीतानि सर्वशः । क्वचिन् न एव प्रपीतानि पानानि स ददर्श ह ॥५-११-२५॥
translation: He saw wine jars at one place, some fully drained, and at another place not touched at all.

raw: सप्तभिस्तु महा वीर्यो मैन्दं मर्मविदारणैः । पञ्चभिर्विशिखैश्चैव गजं विव्याध संयुगे ॥६-७३-४३॥
translation: Indrajith, the eminent hero, hurt Mainda in private parts and even afflicted Gaja with five spades in the battle.

raw: लोभात् तु मत् कृतम् नूनम् न अनुगच्छसि राघवम् । व्यसनम् ते प्रियम् मन्ये स्नेहो भ्रातरि न अस्ति ते ॥३-४५-७॥
ते न शक्या रणे हंतुम् असहायेन लक्ष्मण । रावणः क्रूर कर्मा च सुग्रीवेण विशेषतः ॥४-३५-१७॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana moreover it is not possible for Sugriva alone to kill the wicked Ravana without the help of the monkeys.

raw: ततो विनिक्षिप्य बलम् सर्वम् नगरगुप्तये । प्रहस्तः प्रमुखे राज्ञो निषसाद जगाद च ॥६-१२-४॥
translation: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.

raw: तव दैवासुरे युद्धे सहराजर्षिभिः पतिः । अगच्छत्त्वामुपादाय देवराजस्य साह्यकृत् ॥२-९-११॥
translation: O queen during the war between gods and asuras, your husband went with royal saints intending to render assistance to Indra, king of the gods, taking you along with him. He set off in the southern direction of Dandaka forest to a renowned city called Vaijayanta where asura Timidhvaja lived.

raw: स शरैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः सुमुक्तैः शीघ्रगामिभिः । वानराणामनीकानि निर्ममन्थ महारणे ॥६-७३-४६॥
translation: He, with his swift moving arrows, bright like the Sun , stretching to the ear hurt many vanaras in that great war.

raw: हृतायाम् अपि वैदेह्याम् नष्टायाम् अपि राघव । शोचितुम् न अर्हसे वीर यथा अन्यः प्राकृतः तथा ॥३-६६-१४॥
translation: Even if Vaidehi is killed or abducted, you should not grieve like ordinary men, O sinless hero

raw: दातुमर्हति धर्मात्मा लोकपालो महायशाः । ईदृषस्य ममाक्षय्या मेकामभयदक्षिणाम् ॥२-६४-४०॥
translation: 'That lord of justice, who is highly renowned, righteous and the guardian of the worlds will grant me one unfailing boon of protection from fear.

raw: अगुरूणाम् च मुख्यानाम् वनानि उपवनानि च । तक्कोलानाम् च जात्यानाम् फलानाम् च सुगन्धिनाम् ॥३-३५-२२॥
translation: (He saw) very fine aguru trees in the forest as well as pleasuregroves of takkola fruits, fragrant trees of a fine variety and fragrant nutmegs.

raw: अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् अवसुप्तम् अनन्तरम् । प्रबोधयाम् आस शनैः लक्ष्मणम् रघु नन्दनः ॥२-५६-१॥
translation: When the night was over, Rama, Delight of the Raghus, gently awakened Lakshmana who was asleep.

raw: यत् त्वया धार्मिको रामः नित्यम् सत्य परायणः । वनम् प्रस्थापितः दुह्खात् पिता च त्रिदिवम् गतः ॥२-७४-१०॥
translation: As you sent virtuous Rama, ever devoted to truth, into the forest, my father died out of grief (due to separation from his son). Therefore, you are not the true daughter of the righteous and sagacious king Aswapati but a demoness born there to destroy your father's race.

raw: गत्वा रसातलं दिव्यः शरो विबुधपूजितः । पुनरेवागमत्तूर्णमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् ॥७-६९-३६॥
translation: Having gone to the netherworld, the divine arrow, worshipped by gods, quickly returned to Shatrughna, the delight of the Ikshvaku family.

raw: तम् च राजा दशरथो यशस् कामः कृतांलिः । ऋष्यशृङ्गम् द्विज श्रेष्ठम् वरयिष्यति धर्मवित् ॥१-११-८॥
translation: King Dasaratha, lord of the people, and knower of dharma and truth, desirous of performing the sacrifice would ask Rsyasringa, with folded palms for granting a boon to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain children and to attain heaven. The king will get those desires fulfilled through that chief brahmin.

raw: तानि च आस्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानि इति स्म मन्यते । अनास्वादित पूर्वाणि वने नित्य निवासिनाम् ॥१-१०-२१॥
translation: The lustrous (Rsyasringa) who had never tasted any food other than what was offered by the permanent forestdwellers mistook them for fruits.

raw: मुञ्च रामाद्भयं राजन् हनिष्यामीह संयुगे । राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । हनुमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं लङ्का येन प्रदीपिता ॥६-६३-४९॥
translation: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."

raw: अङ्गदो नाम लक्ष्मीवान् वालिसूनुर्महाबलः । प्रस्थितः कापिशार्दूलस्त्रिभागबलसंवृतः ॥५-३५-५६॥
translation: The prosperous and mighty son of Vali, a tiger among monkeys named Angada, set out together with a third of the army.

raw: स तत् प्रकर्षन् हरिणाम् महत् बलम्बभूव वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः । गत अंबुदे व्योम्नि विशुद्ध मण्डलःशशी इव नक्षत्र गणोपशोभितः ॥४-४४-१६॥
translation: Like the moon adorned by hosts of stars in the cloudless sky, the mighty heroic Hanuman, the great son of the Windgod, shone in the midst of the army of monkeys.

raw: अदृष्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वेषां धनदाज्ञया । चराम्यहं प्रभावेण तवाज्ञां परिपालयन् ॥७-४१-१०॥
translation: By Kubera's command, I am invisible to all beings and I move by my own power, obeying your command.

raw: दैत्याश्च शतशस्तत्र कृतवैराश्च दैवतैः । रावणं प्रेक्ष्य गच्छन्तमन्वगच्छन्हि पृष्ठतः ॥७-२५-३७॥
translation: Hundreds of Daityas, who had long-standing enmity with the gods, saw Ravana going and indeed followed him from behind.

raw: अक्षतम् जात रूपम् च प्रियंगु मधु सर्पिषी । दधि चर्म च वैयाघ्रम् परार्ध्ये च अपि उपानहौ ॥४-२६-२७॥
translation: The monkeys brought a white canopy decorated with gold and two chamaras with glorious golden staff. They also brought jewels, all kinds of medicinal herbs, sprouts, sap from trees, white flowers and white clothes, unguents, garlands of fragrant lotuses that grow on land and water, heavently sandal, fragrants of different kinds, goldcoloured paddy, honey of priyanga, curds, tiger skin and sandals made of boar skin. Then sixteen beautiful, cheerful females appeared with unguent, gorochana mixed with red arsenic (used for putting tilaka on the forehead).

raw: प्रधर्षितायाम् वैदेह्याम् बभूव स चरा अचरम् । जगत् सर्वम् अमर्यादम् तमसा अन्धेन संवृतम् ॥३-५२-९॥
translation: While Sita was being assaulted, the earth with the animate and the inanimate crossed all limits of moral law and became enveloped in blinding darkness. The wind ceased to blow and the Sun, to shine.

raw: तदप्रमेयाप्रतिकारकृत्रिमम् । कृतम् स्वयम् साध्विति विश्वकर्मणाः । दिवम् गतम् वायुपथप्रतिष्ठितम् । व्यराजतादित्यपथस्य लक्ष्मिवत् ॥५-८-२॥
translation: The immeasurable Pushpaka fashioned by Visvakarma with images of incomparable beauty was not possible to describe. An excellent product of his achievement, it was placed in the aerial path appearing as a beaconlight (signpost) in the orbit of the Sun.

raw: अप्रहृष्ट बलाम् न्यूनाम् विषमस्थाम् अनावृताम् । शत्रवो न अभिमन्यन्ते भक्ष्यान् विष कृतान् इव ॥२-८८-२५॥
translation: Now the gates of our capital city (Ayodhya) are wide open. The city is unprotected and endangered. There are no guards to keep vigil over the ramparts. The horses and elephants are not in control (hence unprepared for battle). The army is unhappy and demoralised. At this state even the enemies will not like to seize the city, they will shun it like food mixed with poison.

raw: शुश्रुवस्तस्य ते सर्वे वानराः परिदेवनम् । वर्तयाञ्चकुरश्रूणि नेत्रैः कृष्णेतरेक्षणाः ॥६-४९-३१॥
translation: All the Vanaras started shedding tears from their tawny eyes on listening to the lamentation of Rama.

raw: एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण वानरास्ते महाबलाः । ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो रामं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ॥६-१२५-२०॥
translation: After Rama had spoken that way Sugriva, Vibheeshana, monkeys and Rakshasas saluted Rama and said as follows.

raw: अपि ते जीवित अंताय न उत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा । अपि सीता निमित्तम् च न भवेत् व्यसनम् महत् ॥३-३७-५॥
translation: Hope the daughter of Janaka is not born to put an end to your life. Hope I will not face any disaster on account of Sita.

raw: यथा श्रुत्वैव नचिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु ॥५-५८-१०५॥
translation: 'O heroic Hanuman narrate in such a way that by hearing you both Rama and Lakshmana will come here soon, accompanied by Sugriva.

raw: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिञ्जयः । अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे यद्येष मुच्यते ॥७-३०-८॥
translation: Then, the greatly effulgent Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, spoke, saying, "O god, I choose immortality if this one (Indra) is released."

raw: अद्य विप्रसरिष्यन्ति राक्षस्यो हत बान्धवाः । बाष्प आर्द्र वदना दीना भयात् अन्य भयावहाः ॥३-३०-१०॥
translation: Having lost all their relations, the demonesses, who were causing fear to others,will move away with faces full of tears.

raw: गतो राम इति श्रुत्वा हृष्टः प्रमुदितो नृपः । पुनर्जातम् तदा मेने पुत्रम् आत्मानम् एव च ॥१-७७-५॥
translation: On hearing the words 'Parasurama has departed' from Rama, king Dasaratha embraced him and kissed his forehead. The king, immensely happy, felt he and his son were reborn.

raw: विभीषणस्य शूरस्य यथार्थं क्रियतां वचः । अलं कालात्ययं कृत्वा समुद्रो ऽयं नियुज्यताम् । यथा सैन्येन गच्छामः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ॥६-१९-४३॥
translation: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

raw: तेन सत्याभिसंधेन त्रिवर्गम् अनुष्टिता । पालिता सा पुरी श्रेष्टा इन्द्रेण इव अमरावती ॥१-६-५॥
translation: King Dasaratha, who always kept his word and followed dharma, attained prosperity and pleasure in equal measure by righteous means ruled that best of the cities as Indra ruled Amaravati.

raw: तद् विनाशे अपि मे दुःखम् प्रमृष्टम् स्यात् अनन्तरम् । सुखम् मे जीवितम् चैव तद् विनाश निबन्धनम् ॥४-८-३९॥
translation: 'My sorrow will go only with his death. My happiness and my life are also subject to his destruction.

raw: तानि तान्यात्मरूपाणि सृजसि त्वमनेकशः ॥६-५९-८६॥
translation: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."

raw: अद्य पुत्रं हतं सङ्ख्ये कैकेयी राज्यकामुका । मया पश्येत् सुदु:खार्त्ता हस्तिभग्नमिव द्रुमम् ॥२-९६-२६॥
translation: Let that Kaikeyi, greedy for the kingdom, see in great anguish her son who shall be slain by me today in a battle like a tree felled by an elephant.

raw: तस्मिन्प्रशासति तदा सर्वकामदुघा मही । रसवन्ति प्रभूनानि मूलानि च फलानि च ॥७-८४-७॥
translation: While he was ruling, the earth became a wish-fulfilling cow, providing abundant and juicy roots and fruits.

raw: कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम् । व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ॥७-६८-१॥
translation: While they were conversing and wishing for an auspicious victory, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.

raw: एका तु तस्य राजर्षेर्नाहुषस्य पुरस्कृता । शर्मिष्ठा नाम दैतेयी दुहिता वृषपर्वणः ॥७-५८-८॥
translation: One of those wives, honored by the royal sage Yayati, son of Nahusha, was named Sharmishtha, the daughter of the Daitya king Vrishaparvan.

raw: आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रम् नदीम् ताम् सह सीतया । प्राणमत्प्रीतिसम्हृष्टो लक्ष्मणश्चामितप्रभः ॥२-५२-७९॥
translation: Rama of undimmed radiance sipped the waters (of the Ganga) in accordance with the scriptures and with great pleasure and paid obeisance to the river with Sita and Lakshmana.

raw: गीतो अयम् ब्रह्मणा श्लोकः सर्व लोक नमस्कृतः । दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नम् क्रुद्धेन तम् निबोध प्लवम्गम ॥४-३४-११॥
translation: 'O lord of the monkeys here is a verse worthy of appreciation by all the worlds, sung by a brahmin, when he saw an ungrateful person. Listen:

raw: कथम् दासस्य मे दासी भार्या भवितुम् इच्छसि । सो अहम् आर्येण परवान् भ्रात्रा कमल वर्णिनी ॥३-१८-९॥
translation: O lotuscomplexioned woman , how can you act as a maid to a slave ? Why do you intend to be so? I am already dependent on my revered brother.

raw: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय तं परिष्वज्य सादरम् । शत्रुघ्नं च परिष्वज्य भरतं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-११२-२६॥
translation: 'Be it so', assured Rama and then affectionately embracing both Bharata and Satrughna, said to Bharata:

raw: विदेहराजस्य सुता स्नुषा दशरथस्य च । रामपत्नी कथं दु:खं सम्प्राप्ता निर्जने वने ॥२-१०३-२४॥
translation: How is it that Sita, daughter of Janaka, king of Videha, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha and wife of Rama, has to undergo such hardships in the lonely forest.

raw: गृह्यताम् मागमल्लङ्का मेतद्धि मम रोचते । ततो राज्ञा समादिष्टाः समुत्पत्य वलीमुखाः ॥६-२०-३२॥
मा भैष्ट नास्त्यत्र विषादकालो यदार्यपुत्रौ ह्यवशौ विषण्णौ । स्वयम्भुवो वाक्यमथोद्वहन्तौ यत् सादिताविन्द्रजिदस्त्रजालैः ॥६-७४-३॥
translation: "O Noble men! Do not fear. Rama and Lakshmana are afflicted by Indrajith's volley of arrows and have lost senses. They are despondent to honour the statement of the creator not otherwise."

raw: नावज्ञा तत्र कर्तव्या वानरेषु कदाचन । द्विषतां बलमुद्युक्तमापतत् किं स्थितं सदा ॥६-७२-१६॥
translation: " At all times, whether it is evening or midnight or early morning, Vanaras movements are to be watched by the army without indifference. Indeed, the army should be active or inactive, standing, advancing constantly and staying wherever they are."

raw: अयोध्यां गच्छ भरत प्रकृतीरनुरञ्जय । शत्रुघ्नसहितो वीर सह सर्वैर्द्विजातिभि: ॥२-१०७-१५॥
translation: O valiant Bharata, go to Ayodhya accompanied by Satrughna and the twiceborn (brahmins) and keep the subjects delighted like pleased (with your rule).

raw: नयने विप्रकाशेते पर्वतस्थाविवानलौ । पिङ्गे पिङ्गाक्षमुख्यस्य बृहती परिमण्डले ॥५-१-५९॥
तस्याहं कुर्वतो नित्यं वेदाभ्यासं महात्मनः । सम्भूय वाङ्मयी कन्या नाम्ना वेदवती स्मृता ॥७-१७-८॥
translation: While my great-souled father was constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas, I was born as a daughter, manifested from his speech, and was known by the name Vedavati.

raw: इत्युक्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् । परुषं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा ॥४-१८-१॥
translation: To these harsh words though seemingly wellmeaning, courteous and righteous, Vali who had been mortally wounded and confused in mind, Rama replied:

raw: हन्यतां दह्यतां वापि भक्ष्यतामिति चापरे । राक्षसास्तत्र संक्रुद्धाः परस्परमथाब्रुवन् ॥५-४८-५७॥
translation: Thereafter other ogres angrily said 'Let us kill him, burn him or otherwise devour him,' thus they spoke to one another.

raw: मासं स स्त्री तदा भूत्वा रमयत्यनिशं शुदा । मासं पुरुषभावेन धर्मबुद्धिं चकार सः ॥७-८९-२२॥
translation: For one month, he became a woman and constantly delighted happily, and for the next month, he assumed the state of a man and focused his mind on righteousness.

raw: जल प्रपात अस्र मुखाः शृन्गैः उच्छ्रित बाहवः । सीतायाम् ह्रियमाणायाम् विक्रोशन्ति इव पर्वताः ॥३-५२-३७॥
translation: The mountains were shedding tears in the form of waterfalls, and crying with hands lifted up in the form of peaks, while Sita was being carried away.

raw: एवमार्त्तां सपत्न्यस्ता जग्मुराश्वास्य तां तदा । ददृशुश्चाश्रमे रामं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम् ॥२-१०३-१६॥
translation: The cowives, having thus consoled the distressed Kausalya, went to the hermitage. There they beheld Rama who looked like a god dislodged from heaven.

raw: तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रविष्टा सा प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत् । कुम्भकर्ण महाबाहो वरं वरय यो मतः ॥७-१०-४४॥
translation: After Saraswati entered, Prajapati Brahma then addressed Kumbhakarna, the mighty-armed one, telling him to choose whatever boon he desired.

raw: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसाधिपः । प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनाम् ॥५-२०-१॥
एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः । इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥७-२२-४८॥
translation: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.

raw: तदा दैवासुरे युद्धे तस्य कालोऽय मागतः । नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः ॥२-११-२६॥
तस्य कार्मुकमुक्तैश्च शरैस्तत्पुरगोपुरम् । कैलासशृङ्गप्रतिमं विकीर्णमपतद्भुवि ॥६-७५-३८॥
translation: The entrance gate of Lanka, which was like Kailasa, crumbled and fell by the shaft released from the bow of Rama.

raw: तवाहं पूर्वसद्भावे पुत्रः परपुरञ्जय । मायासम्भावितो वीर कालः सर्वसमाहरः ॥७-१०४-२॥
translation: O conqueror of enemy cities, O hero, I am your son from a previous existence, created by your divine power as Time, the destroyer of all.

raw: तस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूलेविसंज्ञेपतितेभुवि । तच्छूलंसमुपादायसुग्रीवमभिदुद्रुवे ॥६-६७-५१॥
translation: When the tiger among the monkeys fell unconscious on ground, Kumbhakarna rushed towards Sugriva taking out the pike.

raw: हयम् च तस्य देवस्य चरन्तम् अविदूरतः । प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् प्रप्तः सर्वे ते रघुनंदन ॥१-४०-२६॥
translation: Great sons of Sagara terribly swiftfooted and exceedingly powerful beheld the eternal Visnu in (sage) Kapila and not far away from him the horse grazing. O descendant of Raghu they all experienced unparalleled joy.

raw: कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम् । मायां च तामसीं नाम यया सम्पद्यते तमः ॥७-२५-१०॥
translation: He obtained a divine chariot that moves at will, travels in the sky, and is firm, and also an illusion named Tamasi, by which darkness is produced.

raw: हमुमानपि दुःखार्तां तां दृष्ट्वा भयमोहिताम् । अवन्दत महाबाहुस्ततस्तां जनकात्मजाम् । सा चैनं भयवित्रस्ता भूयो नैवाभ्युदैक्षत ॥५-३४-१२॥
translation: The longarmed Hanuman saw Sita, who was stricken with grief and deluded with fear. He prostrated to her. But out of fear she did not look at him.

raw: सर्व उपायम् तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुम् बलात् । समक्षम् आर्य मिश्राणाम् साधूनाम् गुण वर्तिनाम् ॥२-८२-१९॥
translation: I shall employ all possible means to bring him back and join you who are respectable, virtuous and pious.

raw: तथा प्रोत्साहिता देवी गता मन्थरया सह । क्रोधागारं विशालाक्षी सौभाग्यमदगर्विता ॥२-९-५५॥
translation: That beautiful, largeeyed Kaikeyi, puffed with the pride of her intoxicating beauty, encourged and influenced by the words of that hunchback, entered the chamber of wrath. She cast off her highly precious pearl necklace worth many hundreds of thousands (of rupees) and other costly, beautiful ornaments. Thereafter that goldenhued Kaikeyi lay down on the floor and said to Manthara:

raw: अहम् किम् च अपि वक्ष्यामि देवीम् तव सुतः मया । नीतः असौ मातुल कुलम् सम्तापम् मा कृथाइति ॥२-५२-४५॥
translation: What shall I say to Kausalya? Shall I say 'O venerable queen I have left your son at his maternal uncle's, hence don't grieve'.

raw: उत्तरं च न वक्तव्यं शूर वाक्यान्तरे मम । बालेन पूर्वजस्याज्ञा कर्तव्या नात्र संशयः ॥७-६२-२०॥
translation: O hero, do not speak a reply while I am speaking, for a younger brother must obey the command of an elder, there is no doubt about this.

raw: तस्यांसफलके खड्गं निजघान ततो ऽङ्गदः । यज्ञोपवीतवच्चैनं चिच्छेद कपिकुञ्जरः ॥६-७६-१०॥
translation: Then Angada pierced his sword on the fl at surface of his shoulder diagonally and cut him with his sword.

raw: तौ आसीनौ ततः दृष्ट्वा हनूमान् अपि लक्ष्मणम् । साल शाखाम् समुत्पाट्य विनीतम् उपवेशयत् ॥४-८-१४॥
translation: Thereafter Hanuman also broke a branch of the sala tree and seated Lakshmana on it.

raw: विदर्शिता यदा देवी कुब्जया पापया भृशम् । तदा शेते स्म सा भूमौ दिग्धविद्धेव किन्नरी ॥२-१०-१॥
translation: Perversely advised by the extremely sinful hunchback the queen (Kaikeyi) lay down on the ground like a kinnari struck as though by a poisonous arrow.

raw: सागरः समतिक्रम्य पूर्वम् आमन्त्र्य वीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् राघवम् शर पाणिनम् ॥६-२२-२४॥
translation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

raw: न असहायम् अहम् मन्ये सुग्रीवम् तम् इह आगतम् । अवष्टब्ध सहायः च यम् आश्रित्य एष गर्जति ॥४-१५-१३॥
translation: 'Certainly Sugriva has not come here to give a warcry without any external help. The person whose refuge he has sought is not a small one.

raw: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मुनिं तमभिवाद्य च । प्रययौ दक्षिणामाशां प्रविष्टः सह मन्त्रिभिः ॥७-२०-२५॥
translation: Having thus spoken and saluted that sage, Dashagriva (Ravana) departed towards the southern direction, accompanied by his ministers.

raw: शिखिनी मन्मथ आर्तैः एषा भर्तारम् गिरि सानुनि । ताम् एव मनसा रामाम् मयुरोऽपि अनुधावति ॥४-१-३९॥
संवृतः स्वैरथानीकैः प्रहरन्तं निशाचरम् । विक्रमेण महातेजा वारयामास संयुगे ॥७-२७-४३॥
translation: The greatly effulgent Savitra, surrounded by his own chariot divisions, checked the attacking demon with his valor in battle.

raw: तस्य तं स्वरमाज्ञाय क्षुधार्तस्य द्विजस्य वै । अन्वगात्पृष्ठतः सा गौर्गच्छन्तं पावकोपमम् ॥७-५३-१३॥
translation: Having recognized the voice of that hungry Brahmana, the cow indeed followed him from behind as he, radiant like fire, walked away.

raw: अनसूया व्रतै: स्नाता प्रत्यूहाश्च निवर्त्तिता: । देवकार्यनिमित्तं च यया संत्वरमाणया । दशरात्रं कृता रात्रि: सेयं मातेव ते ऽनघ ॥२-११७-११॥
translation: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.

raw: मुहुर् ऊर्ध्व पथम् गत्वा पपात वसुधाम् पुनः । तत् शंकर शिरो भ्रष्टम् भ्रष्टम् भूमि तले पुनः ॥१-४३-२५॥
सुपर्णपक्षानिलनुन्नपक्षं भ्रमत्पताकं प्रविकीर्णशस्त्रम् । चचाल तद्राक्षसराजसैन्यं चलोपलं नील इवाचलेन्द्रः ॥७-६-७०॥
translation: That army of the Rakshasa king, with its banners scattered by the wind from Garuda's wings, fluttering flags, and scattered weapons, trembled like a blue mountain king with dislodged rocks.

raw: ततः करुण वेदित्वात् अधर्मो अयम् इति द्विजः । निशाम्य रुदतीम् क्रौन्चीम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रैइत् ॥१-२-१४॥
translation: Having heard the wailing of the female bird, the sage (Valmiki) moved to pity at this irreligious act uttered the following words.

raw: या च इयम् जगतो माता सर्व लोक नमस्कृता । अस्याः च चलनम् भूमेः दृश्यते कोसलेश्वर ॥३-६६-१०॥
translation: You (rigidly) adhere to truth.(Like you) the mother earth who is adored by all the worlds, is unshakeable. Yet she is seen to be shaking at times.

raw: गीतिभिः मधुरैः स्निग्धैः मन्त्र आह्वानैः यथार्हतः । होतारो ददुरावाह्य हविर्भागान् दिवौकसाम् ॥१-१४-९॥
प्रेषितो ऽहं तव भ्रात्रा दशग्रीवेण सुव्रत । त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर ॥७-११-२७॥
translation: O one of good vows, O mighty-armed, O best among all weapon-bearers, I have been sent to your presence by your brother, Dashagriva.

raw: दत्त्वा पुण्यामिमां वीर सौम्यामभयदक्षिणाम् ॥७-१-३३॥
यथा च्न्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा गावो विना वृषम् । एवं हि भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र राजा न दृश्यते ॥२-१४-५७॥
translation: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

raw: ऋतुस्नाताम् सतीम् भार्यामृतुकालानुरोधिनीम् । अतिवर्तेत दुष्टात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५२॥
translation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person who neglects his chaste wife observing the menstrual period unfavourable for conception and had bathed after menstruation acquires

raw: निपातितमहावीरां द्रवन्तीं वानरीं चमूम् । राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत् ॥६-५९-१२३॥
translation: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.

raw: प्रख्यातबलवीर्येण पुत्रेणेन्द्रजिता मम । यौ हि तौ भ्रातरौ वीरौ बद्धौ दत्तवरैः शरैः ॥६-७२-५॥
translation: "Both the famous brothers, Rama and Lakshmana were bound with arrows by my heroic son Indrajith who is conferred with boons and whose strength is well known.

raw: राम षड् युक्तयो लोके याभिः सर्वम् विमृश्यते । परिमृष्टो दश अन्तेन दश आभागेन सेव्यते ॥३-७२-८॥
translation: O Rama there are six expedients (peace,war,marching,neutrality, alliance, making peace with one and waging war with another, for attaining your goal in the world. Only the unlucky can help the unfortunate.

raw: सुमन्त्रस्त्वपि शत्रुघ्नमदूरादन्वपद्यत । रामदर्शनजस्तर्षो भरतस्येव तस्य च ॥२-९९-३॥
translation: Sumantra, who was overeager, like Bharata, to see Rama, followed Satrughna who was not far from him.

raw: ततोऽब्रवीद्दाशरथिः सुमन्त्रम् । स्पृशन् करेणोत्तमदक्षिणेन । सुमन्त्र शीघ्रम् पुनरेव याहि । राज्ञः सकाशे भवचाप्रमत्तः ॥२-५२-१३॥
translation: Rama then caressed Sumantra with his right hand and said, Sumantra, go back immediately and never be inattentive in serving the king.

raw: अहमाख्यामि ते राजञ्छ्रूयतां सर्वमेव तत् । यज्ञास्ते सप्त पुत्रेण प्राप्तास्सुबहुविस्तराः ॥७-२५-७॥
translation: Ushana then said, "O King, I will tell you all about it; listen, for your son has completed seven very extensive sacrifices."

raw: अन्तर्धानगतेनाजौ यस्त्वया ऽ ऽचरितस्तदा । तस्कराचरितो मार्गो नैष वीरनिषेवितः ॥६-८८-१५॥
translation: "Remaining invisible and moving in the battle then is the path of a thief which is not chosen by warriors."

raw: सङ्गत्या भरतः श्रीमान् राज्यार्थी चेत् स्वयं भवेत् । प्रशास्तु वसुधां कृत्स्नामखिलां रघुनन्दनः ॥६-१२८-१७॥
translation: "If the glorious Bharata who is an enhancer of the joy of Raghus having enjoyed the kingdom for long himself, let him rule all the entire earth it is laudable."

raw: अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमवस्थानं सविग्रहम् । परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम् ॥६-४०-२५॥
translation: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

raw: इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वा ऽपूर्वदर्शनम् । मूर्च्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायतां विगतज्वरौ ॥७-९३-१४॥
translation: Harmonize these very sweet strings or notes in an unprecedented manner, and sing very sweetly, free from any anxiety.

raw: सैषा शाप कृताम् अर्षा ताटका क्रोध मूर्छिता । देशम् उत्सादयति एनम् अगस्त्या चरितम् शुभम् ॥१-२५-१४॥
translation: Enraged at the curse, senseless, Tataka with anger, has been ravaging this sacred land when Agastya walked.

raw: मलिनम् च अश्रु पूर्ण अक्षम् दीनम् ध्यान परम् कृशम् । सस्त्री पुम्सम् च पश्यामि जनम् उत्कण्ठितम् पुरे ॥२-७१-४४॥
translation: I see groups of birds frequenting the temples. The sanctuaries appear dispirited. The people in the city, both men and women look dull, emaciated, pitiable with throats choked. Their eyes are filled with tears and minds absorbed in distressing thoughts.

raw: ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि । राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने ॥५-३०-२६॥
translation: "Thereafter the ogresses will draw the attention of demon guards engaged by the king of demons at his residence towards me.

raw: आसितम् शयितम् भुक्तम् सूत रामस्य कीर्तय । जीविष्याम्यहमेतेन ययातिरिव साधुषु ॥२-५८-१२॥
translation: Tell me, O charioteer where Rama sat, where he slept, what (food) he ate. Only your words will enable me to live like Yayati among saints.

raw: स भग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः । अंकेन आदाय वैदेहीम् पपात भुवि रावणः ॥३-५१-१९॥
translation: With the bow broken, the chariot destroyed, asses (drawing the chariot) and the charioteer dead, Ravana fell down on the ground holding Vaidehi on his lap.

raw: गिरि गह्वर संलीनम् दीप्तम् आशी विषम् यथा । तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्य च बभौ द्युतिः ॥४-२३-१८॥
न अनुतिष्ठति कार्याणि भयेषु न बिभेति च । क्षिप्रम् राज्यात् च्युतो दीनः तृणैः तुल्यो भवेत् इह ॥३-३३-१७॥
translation: A king who does not do what ought to be done, does not fear what ought to be feared, will surely be dislodged from the kingdom and live a wretched life like a blade of grass.

raw: न च अहम् हरि राज्यस्य प्रभवामि अंगदस्य वा । पितृव्यः तस्य सुग्रीवः सर्व कार्येषुइ अनंतरः ॥४-२१-१४॥
translation: I have no authority over the monkey-king's affairs or over Angada; his paternal uncle Sugriva is the one to act in all matters hereafter.

raw: एवम् स देव प्रवरः पूर्वम् कथितवान् कथाम् । सनत्कुमारो भगवान् पुरा देवयुगे प्रभुः ॥१-११-११॥
translation: In early times of Kritayuga, this story was narrated by the holy and competent Sanatkumara, the great one among the devatas".

raw: स दिशो दश धोषेण रथस्यातिरथो महान् । नादयन् प्रययौ तूर्णं राघवं चाभ्यवर्तत ॥६-१००-६॥
translation: Ravana, the great charioteer, who could surpass many rushed quickly towards Raghava, by the chariot making great noise reverberating in all directions.

raw: रथाश्चाश्वाश्च नागाश्च हताः शतसहस्रशः । रणे रामेण शूरेण राक्षसाश्च पदातयः ॥६-९५-२२॥
translation: "Horses, elephants, warriors, even foot soldiers were killed, chariots were destroyed, and hundreds and thousands struck down in war by Rama."

raw: नैर्ऋतेन्द्र महावीर्य स्वरेण त्वा ऽभिलक्षये । पीड्यमानः शितैर्बाणैर्न त्वां पश्यामि चक्षुषा ॥६-७४-१७॥
translation: "Great hero, Vibheeshana! I recognise you by your voice. Pierced with sharp arrows I am not able to see you."

raw: न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येनमैथिली । मयाधिकावातुल्यावातत्त्वंमोहान्नबुध्यसे ॥६-११४-२८॥
translation: "Mythili by race is not superior to me even a little, not in civility. Out of infatuation you did not perceive this."

raw: तत् एतत् कारणम् पश्य यत् अर्थम् त्वम् मया हतः । भ्रातुर् वर्तसि भार्यायाम् त्यक्त्वा धर्मम् सनातनम् ॥४-१८-१८॥
translation: 'Now know the reason why I struck you down. Having abandoned the eternal law, you are living with your younger brother's wife.

raw: रमणीयप्रदेशे ऽस्मिन् वने यद्दृष्टवानहम् । आश्चर्यं मे महाबाहो दानमाश्रित्य केवलम् ॥७-७६-५२॥
translation: O mighty-armed one, I saw a wonder in this beautiful forest region, which was solely concerning the power of charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 76 ।। Thus ends the seventy-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं वै बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् ॥७-११-२०॥
translation: Thus addressed, Ravana, with his inner self delighted, thought for a moment and then said, "Very well."

raw: उद्वीक्ष्य उद्वीक्ष्य नयनैः अस्र पात आविल ईक्षणाः । सुप्रवेपित गात्राः च बभूवुः वन देवताः ॥३-५२-४१॥
कुरु राम कथाम् पुण्याम् श्लोक बद्धाम् मनोरमाम् । यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयः सरितः च महीतले ॥१-२-३६॥
अर्चिष्मानर्चितो ऽत्यर्थं ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः । साधूनामुपकारज्ञः प्रचारज्ञश्च कर्मणाम् ॥५-३५-१२॥
translation: "He is luminous and highly revered. He observes vow of selfcontrol. He is steadfast and recognises services rendered by sages. He is aware of the rites and the ways of administration.

raw: महावृन्दसहस्राणाम् शतम् पद्ममिहोच्यते । शतम् पद्मसहस्राणाम् महापद्ममिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३६॥
translation: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.

raw: एवं दत्तास्मि रामाय तदा तस्मिन् स्वयम्वरे । अनुरक्तास्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम् ॥२-११८-५४॥
translation: In this way my father bestowed me on Rama in that swayamvara and I remain devoted to my husband who is the foremost among the valiant in treading the path of righteousness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the one hundredeighteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

raw: रामो नाम स धर्मात्मा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । दीर्घ बाहुः विशालाक्षो दैवतम् स पतिः मम ॥३-५६-३॥
translation: The longarmed, largeeyed Rama is famous in all the three worlds. He is my husband, a righteous soul and a god to all.

raw: स पुत्रान् सम्परिष्वज्य भूषयित्वा च भूषणैः । आशीर्भिश्च प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास संयुगे ॥६-६९-१५॥
translation: Ravana embraced his sons, decked them with ornaments and jewels and enriched them and offered benediction and sent to encounter.

raw: न मया स्वेच्छया वीर रथो ऽयमपवाहितः ॥६-१०६-२२॥
व्यवसायः तु ते नीच भविष्यति निरर्थकः । न हि अहम् तम् अपश्यन्ती भर्तारम् विबुध उपमम् ॥३-५३-१५॥
तं दृष्ट्वा त्वभिनिर्यान्तं नगर्याः काननौकसः । उत्पेतुरभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः शिलाहस्ता युयुत्सवः ॥६-८१-७॥
translation: All the forest animals perceiving Indrajithadvancing became angry and with rocks in hand faced him with enthusiasm.

raw: स हताश्वो महातेजा भूमौ तिष्ठन्निशाचरः । इन्द्रजित् परमक्रुद्धः सम्प्रजज्वाल तेजसा ॥६-९१-१॥
translation: The nightranger, effulgent Indrajith standing on the ground very angry, with horses lost, was flaming with energy.

raw: न नूनम् तपसो वा अस्ति फल योगः श्रुतस्य वा । पिता यन् माम् न जानाति शयानम् पतितम् भुवि ॥२-६३-४४॥
translation: 'My father does not know that I am lying on the ground. It is true that there is no reward either for asceticism or for scriptural knowledge.

raw: निकुम्भिलामधिष्ठाय पावकं जुहवेन्द्रजित् ॥६-८२-२६॥
गजांश्च सगजारोहान् सरथान् रथिनस्तथा । जघान हनुमान् धीमान् राक्षसांश्च पदातिगान् ॥६-५६-२३॥
translation: Hanuman struck the mahouts, elephants, similarly the chariots and riders of chariots as well as the terrific Rakshasas who fought standing on feet.

raw: सङ्गतः सुमहाक्रोधो राक्षसो रावणानुजः । समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन मित्रघ्नेन विभीषणः ॥६-४३-८॥
translation: Highly furious Rakshasa, Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana fought with Rakshasa, Mitraghna.

raw: तम् श्रुत्वा निनदम् भ्रातुः क्रुद्धो वाली महाबलः । निष्पपात सुसंरब्धो भास्करो अस्त तटात् इव ॥४-१२-१६॥
translation: On hearing his brother roaring, powerful Vali was enraged and rushed like the Sun from behind the western shore of the ocean (this simile suggests the downfall of Vali).

raw: निर्दग्ध पत्रः पतितो विन्ध्ये अहम् वानरर्षभाः । अहम् अस्मिन् वसन् भ्रातुः प्रवृत्तिम् न उपलक्षये ॥४-५८-७॥
translation: 'O bulls among monkeys, consequently my wings were burnt and I dropped down on Vindhya. Here I have been living, knowing not my brother's whereabouts.'

raw: राक्षसानाम् इदम् वस्त सुराणाम् अधवा अपि । तरुण आदित्य संकाशम् वैदूर्य गुलिका चितम् ॥३-६४-४४॥
यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति । प्रभूतरत्नाकरशैलपत्तनाम् । तदा गमिष्यस्यशुभं पराभवं । सहैव दीना भरतेन भामिनि ॥२-८-३८॥
translation: O lovely lady when Rama becomes the lord of this earth with its oceans, mountains and cities, then along with Bharata you will become miserable and fall into disgrace.

raw: शङ्काहतात्मा दध्यौ स कपान्द्रं तेजसावृतम् । किमेष भगवान्नन्दी भवेत् साक्षादिहागतः ॥५-५०-२॥
संप्रधृष्य च दुर्धर्षं चैत्यप्रासादमुत्तमम् । हनुमान् प्रज्वलन् लक्ष्म्या पारियात्रोपमो ऽभवत् ॥५-४३-४॥
translation: Having destroyed the fine palace building, the indomitable Hanuman was blazing with glory like the mountain Pariyatra. (one of the seven Kula mountains viz., Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shuktiman, Riksha, Vindhya and Pariyatra)

raw: वीर्यशुल्कां मम सुतां सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम् द्वितीयामूर्मिलां चैव त्रिर्ददामि न संशय: ॥१-७१-२१॥
translation: I offer my daughter Sita, who looks like a celestial maiden as reward for (Rama's) prowess and my second daughter Urmila (to Lakshmana). I proclaim it three times so that there is no doubt about it.

raw: महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः । कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः ॥५-४५-२॥
translation: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.

raw: विविधा विविधैः पुष्पैः तैः एव नगसानुषु । विस्तेएर्णाः पीत रक्ताभा सौमित्रे प्रस्तराः कृताः ॥४-१-९०॥
translation: 'O Saumitri varieties of colourful flowers, some red and some yellow, are spread out on the mountain slopes.

raw: नरः शक्नोति अपाक्रष्टुम् अतिक्रान्ते अपि राघवे । यश्च रामं न पश्येत्तु यं च रामो न पश्यति ॥२-१७-१४॥
उपस्थिता सा मृदुसर्वगात्रा शाखां गृहीत्वा ऽथ नगस्य तस्य ॥५-२८-१९॥
यद्वा दहनकर्मा ऽयं सर्वत्र प्रभुरव्ययः । न मे दहति लाङ्गूलं कथमार्यां प्रधक्ष्यति ॥५-५५-२७॥
translation: 'If not so, the firegod who never fails in burning has not burnt my tail. How will he burn noble Sita?'

raw: पुत्रद्वयविहीनम् च स्नुषयापि विवर्जितम् । अपश्यद्भवनम् राजा नष्टचन्ध्रमिवाम्बरम् ॥२-४२-२९॥
translation: To the king, the palace deserted by his two sons and his daughterinlaw, seemed like the sky without the Moon.

raw: रावणो अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा तलेन अभिजघान ह । स वालि पुत्र अभिहतो वक्त्रात् शोणितम् उद्वमन् ॥४-४८-२१॥
अभवत् सुदिने चापि दुर्दिनं रूक्षमारुतम् । ऊचुः खगा मृगाः सर्वे वाचः क्रूरा भयावहाः ॥६-५५-११॥
translation: At a time on a good day of fine weather, it became cloudy, birds and beasts were making frightening cries all over.

raw: तत्पर्वताग्रमाकाशे रक्षोबाणविदारितम् । विशीर्णं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ॥६-५६-१९॥
translation: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.

raw: मुक्ता मणि विचित्र अंगम् ददर्श परम अंगना । तम् वै रुचिर दंत ओष्ठम् रूप्य धातु तनू रुहम् ॥३-४२-३३॥
केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम् । कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ॥५-३८-२६॥
translation: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?

raw: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वा ऽर्थः किं करोम्यहम् । व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं प्रतिपाल्यताम् ॥७-१०५-४॥
translation: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."

raw: कथम् त्वम् कर्मणा शक्तः कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः । करिष्यसि पितुर्वाक्यमधर्मिष्ठम् विगर्हितम् ॥२-२३-१२॥
translation: When you are able to counter (this move), why do you want to execute the unjustifiable and contemptible words of the king who is under the spell of Kaikeyi?

raw: ततःकराग्रैःसहसासमेत्यराजाहरीणाममरेन्द्रशत्रुम् । खरैश्चकर्णौदशनैश्चनासांददंशपार्श्वेषु च कुम्भकर्णम् ॥६-६७-८७॥
translation: There after the king of Vanaras decided to act and tore off the ears of the enemy ruler of gods (Kumbhakarna) with his sharp nails, bit off the nose with his teeth, and sides of Kumbhakarna.

raw: तस्य ते विग्रहे ताभ्यां युगग्रहणमस्थिरम् । वृत्रस्येवेन्द्रबाहुभ्यां बाहोरेकस्य निग्रहः ॥५-१९-२८॥
यज्ञो मे क्रियताम् ब्रह्मन् यथोक्तम् मुनिपुङ्गव । यथा न विघ्नाः क्रियन्ते यज्ञांगेषु विधीयताम् ॥१-१३-३॥
translation: "O foremost among ascetics O brahman, may the sacrifice be performed according to tradition in such a manner that the sacrifice is performed unhindered.

raw: तान्यनीकानि सर्वाणि विभक्तानि समन्ततः । विन्यस्ता यूथपाश्चैव यथान्यायं विभागशः ॥६-८५-६॥
translation: All the army forces have been collected, divided, and assigned to respective places separately.

raw: इदानीं तु विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः । वधार्थं रावणस्येदं विहितं पुरुषोत्तम ॥६-१२२-१८॥
translation: "O gentle son! I did not know that the ruler of gods had sent you for the destruction of Ravana, O excellent one."

raw: अथ क्रुद्धो महातेजा व्याजहार महामुनिः । या मे दर्शनमागच्छेत्सा गर्भं धारयिष्यति ॥७-२-१२॥
translation: Then, the greatly effulgent great sage, being angered, declared, "Whoever comes into my sight will conceive a child."

raw: आदिप्रभृति वै राजन्पञ्चसर्गशतानि च । काण्डानि षट् कृतानीह सोत्तराणि महात्मना । कृतानि गुरुणास्माकमृषिणा चरितं तव ॥७-९४-२७॥
translation: O King, from the very beginning, this work, comprising five hundred sargas and six sections including the Uttara Kanda, has been composed here by our great sage and preceptor, detailing your deeds.

raw: उत्थाप्यमानः शक्रस्य यन्त्र ध्वजैव च्युतः । अभिपेतुस् ततः सर्वे तस्य अमात्याः शुचि व्रतम् ॥२-७७-१०॥
तस्य रामस्य सुप्तस्य कुश आस्तीर्णे मही तले । नियमाद् अप्रमत्तस्य निशास् तिस्रो अतिचक्रमुः ॥६-२१-१०॥
translation: As Rama kept himself alert with a vow and lay on the kusa grass m at spread on the ground, three nights rolled fast.

raw: मेघाश्च खरनिर्घोषा रथस्योपरि रक्षसः । ववृषू रुधिरं चास्य सिषिचुश्च पुरस्सरान् ॥६-५७-३८॥
translation: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

raw: ज्ञातीनाम् विपुलः शोकः त्वया तात प्रणाशितः । तव कल्याण रुचयः कपि मुख्याः समागताः ॥४-६७-३२॥
न एषा हि सा स्त्री भवति श्लाघनीयेन धीमता । उभयोः लोकयोः वीर पत्या या सम्प्रसाद्यते ॥२-६२-१३॥
translation: O heroic one a woman, who is entreated by her sagacious and praiseworthy husband, loses both the worlds.

raw: तस्याः तत् विमलम् - सु नसम् - वक्त्रम् आकाशे रावण अंक गम् । न रराज विना रामम् विनालम् इव पंकजम् ॥३-५२-१८॥
translation: Sita's face with her beautiful nose on Ravana's lap and not on Rama's, shone no more like a lotus without its stalk.

raw: एतत् श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो राक्षस प्रतिवेदितम् । अशोक वनिकाम् त्यक्त्वा मन्त्रिणाम् दर्शनम् ययौ ॥६-३२-३८॥
translation: On hearing the submission of the rakshasa, the tenheaded king left the Asoka grove to see the ministers.

raw: भृत्यो युक्तः समर्थश्च तमाहुर्मध्यम् नरम् । नियुक्तो नृपतेः कार्यम् न कुर्याद्यः समाहितः ॥६-१-९॥
स्नेहात् च बहुमानात् च स्मारये त्वाम् न शिक्षये । न कथंचन सा कार्या गृहीत धनुषा त्वया ॥३-९-२४॥
सास्म्यगाधे भये मग्ना दुःखशोकसमन्विता । दह्यमानाऽ नलेनेव त्वद्धितार्थमिहागता ॥२-७-२१॥
translation: Plunged in unfathomable fear and stricken with grief and tears I am here seeking your wellbeing and yet consumed as though by fire.

raw: भवनाद्भवनं गच्छ्न् ददर्श पवनात्मजः । विविधाकृतिरूपाणि भवनानि ततस्ततः ॥५-४-९॥
translation: Going from one building to another, Hanuman saw mansions of different kinds structures.
